title: Psalm 21
sefariaRef: Psalms 21
useCase: Gratitude for a ruler's deliverance Themes: gratitude, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה בְּעָזְּךָ יִשְׂמַח־מֶלֶךְ וּבִישׁוּעָתְךָ מַה־יגיל [יָּגֶל] מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, in Thy strength the king rejoiceth; and in Thy salvation how greatly doth he exult!
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI be-oh-ze-KHAH yees-mahkh MEH-lehkh oo-vee-SHOO-ah-te-KHAH mah-YAH-gehl me-OHD

tokens.hebrew: תַּאֲוַת לִבּוֹ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ וַאֲרֶשֶׁת שְׂפָתָיו בַּל־מָנַעְתָּ סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and the request of his lips Thou hast not withholden. Selah
tokens.transliteration: tah-ah-VAHT lee-BOH nah-TAH-tah LOH vah-ah-REH-sheht se-fah-TAHV bahl mah-NAH-tah SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־תְקַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכוֹת טוֹב תָּשִׁית לְרֹאשׁוֹ עֲטֶרֶת פָּז׃
tokens.translation: For Thou meetest him with choicest blessings; Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.
tokens.transliteration: kee te-kah-de-meh-NOO beer-KHOHT TOHV tah-SHEET le-roh-SHOH ah-TEH-reht PAHZ

tokens.hebrew: חַיִּים שָׁאַל מִמְּךָ נָתַתָּה לּוֹ אֹרֶךְ יָמִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: He asked life of Thee, Thou gavest it him; even length of days for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: khah-YEEM shah-AHL mee-me-KHAH nah-TAH-tah LOH OH-rehkh yah-MEEM oh-LAHM vah-EHD

tokens.hebrew: גָּדוֹל כְּבוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ הוֹד וְהָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּה עָלָיו׃
tokens.translation: His glory is great through Thy salvation; Honour and majesty dost Thou lay upon him.
tokens.transliteration: gah-DOHL ke-voh-DOH bee-shoo-ah-TEH-khah HOHD ve-hah-DAHR te-shah-VEH ah-LAHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־תְשִׁיתֵהוּ בְרָכוֹת לָעַד תְּחַדֵּהוּ בְשִׂמְחָה אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou makest him most blessed for ever; Thou makest him glad with joy in Thy presence.
tokens.transliteration: kee te-shee-TEH-hoo ve-rah-KHOHT lah-AHD te-khah-DEH-hoo ve-seem-KHAH eht pah-NEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הַמֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵחַ בַּיהוָה וּבְחֶסֶד עֶלְיוֹן בַּל־יִמּוֹט׃
tokens.translation: For the king trusteth in the LORD, yea, in the mercy of the Most High; he shall not be moved.
tokens.transliteration: kee hah-meh-LEHKH boh-TEH-ahkh bah-ah-doh-NAI oo-ve-KHEH-sehd ehl-YOHN bahl yee-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: תִּמְצָא יָדְךָ לְכָל־אֹיְבֶיךָ יְמִינְךָ תִּמְצָא שֹׂנְאֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thy hand shall be equal to all thine enemies; Thy right hand shall overtake those that hate thee.
tokens.transliteration: teem-TSAH yah-de-KHAH le-khohl oh-ye-VEY-khah ye-mee-ne-KHAH teem-TSAH soh-ne-EY-khah

tokens.hebrew: תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ כְּתַנּוּר אֵשׁ לְעֵת פָּנֶיךָ יְהוָה בְּאַפּוֹ יְבַלְּעֵם וְתֹאכְלֵם אֵשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Thou shalt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger; The LORD shall swallow them up in His wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
tokens.transliteration: te-shee-TEH-moh ke-tah-NOOR EHSH le-EHT pah-NEY-khah ah-doh-NAI be-ah-POH ye-vah-le-EHM ve-toh-khe-LEHM EHSH

tokens.hebrew: פִּרְיָמוֹ מֵאֶרֶץ תְּאַבֵּד וְזַרְעָם מִבְּנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
tokens.transliteration: peer-yah-MOH meh-EH-rehts te-ah-BEHD ve-zahr-AHM mee-be-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־נָטוּ עָלֶיךָ רָעָה חָשְׁבוּ מְזִמָּה בַּל־יוּכָלוּ׃
tokens.translation: For they intended evil against thee, They imagined a device, wherewith they shall not prevail.
tokens.transliteration: kee nah-TOO ah-LEY-khah rah-AH khah-she-VOO me-zee-MAH bahl yoo-KHAH-loo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ שֶׁכֶם בְּמֵיתָרֶיךָ תְּכוֹנֵן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: For thou shalt make them turn their back, Thou shalt make ready with thy bowstrings against the face of them.
tokens.transliteration: KEE te-shee-TEH-moh SHEH-khehm be-mey-tah-REY-khah te-khoh-NEHN ahl pe-ney-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: רוּמָה יְהוָה בְּעֻזֶּךָ נָשִׁירָה וּנְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Be Thou exalted, O LORD, in Thy strength; so will we sing and praise Thy power.
tokens.transliteration: ROO-mah ah-doh-NAI be-oo-ZEH-khah nah-SHEE-rah oo-ne-zah-me-RAH ge-voo-rah-TEH-khah

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 22
sefariaRef: Psalms 22
useCase: Abandonment, suffering, and eventual praise Themes: wellness, hope, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Aijeleth ha-Shahar. A Psalm of David.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-tseh-AHKH ahl ah-YEH-leht hah-SHAH-khahr meez-MOHR le-dah-VEED

tokens.hebrew: אֵלִי אֵלִי לָמָה עֲזַבְתָּנִי רָחוֹק מִישׁוּעָתִי דִּבְרֵי שַׁאֲגָתִי׃
tokens.translation: My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me, and art far from my help at the words of my cry?
tokens.transliteration: eh-LEE eh-LEE lah-MAH ah-zahv-TAH-nee rah-KHOHK mee-shoo-ah-TEE deev-REY shah-ah-gah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי אֶקְרָא יוֹמָם וְלֹא תַעֲנֶה וְלַיְלָה וְלֹא־דוּמִיָּה לִי׃
tokens.translation: O my God, I call by day, but Thou answerest not; and at night, and there is no surcease for me.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HAHY ehk-RAH yoh-MAHM ve-LOH tah-ah-NEH ve-LAHY-lah ve-loh doo-mee-YAH LEE

tokens.translation: Yet Thou art holy, O Thou that art enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
In Thee did our fathers trust; they trusted, and Thou didst deliver them.

tokens.hebrew: אֵלֶיךָ זָעֲקוּ וְנִמְלָטוּ בְּךָ בָטְחוּ וְלֹא־בוֹשׁוּ׃
tokens.translation: Unto Thee they cried, and escaped; in Thee did they trust, and were not ashamed.
tokens.transliteration: eh-LEY-khah zah-ah-KOO ve-neem-LAH-too be-KHAH vah-te-KHOO ve-loh VOH-shoo

tokens.hebrew: וְאָנֹכִי תוֹלַעַת וְלֹא־אִישׁ חֶרְפַּת אָדָם וּבְזוּי עָם׃
tokens.translation: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-noh-KHEE toh-LAH-aht ve-loh EESH khehr-PAHT ah-DAHM oo-ve-ZOOY AHM

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־רֹאַי יַלְעִגוּ לִי יַפְטִירוּ בְשָׂפָה יָנִיעוּ רֹאשׁ׃
tokens.translation: All they that see me laugh me to scorn; they shoot out the lip, they shake the head:
tokens.transliteration: kohl roh-AHY yahl-EE-goo LEE yahf-TEE-roo ve-sah-FAH yah-NEE-oo ROHSH

tokens.hebrew: גֹּל אֶל־יְהוָה יְפַלְּטֵהוּ יַצִּילֵהוּ כִּי חָפֵץ בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: 'Let him commit himself unto the LORD! let Him rescue him; let Him deliver him, seeing He delighteth in him.'
tokens.transliteration: GOHL ehl ah-doh-NAI ye-fah-le-TEH-hoo yah-tsee-LEH-hoo KEE KHAH-fehts BOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה גֹחִי מִבָּטֶן מַבְטִיחִי עַל־שְׁדֵי אִמִּי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art He that took me out of the womb; Thou madest me trust when I was upon my mother's breasts.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH goh-KHEE mee-BAH-tehn mahv-tee-KHEE ahl she-DEY ee-MEE

tokens.hebrew: עָלֶיךָ הָשְׁלַכְתִּי מֵרָחֶם מִבֶּטֶן אִמִּי אֵלִי אָתָּה׃
tokens.translation: Upon Thee I have been cast from my birth; Thou art my God from my mother's womb.
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley-KHAH hah-she-LAHKH-tee meh-RAH-khehm mee-BEH-tehn ee-MEE EH-lee AH-tah

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי כִּי־צָרָה קְרוֹבָה כִּי־אֵין עוֹזֵר׃
tokens.translation: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
tokens.transliteration: ahl teer-KHAHK mee-meh-NEE kee tsah-RAH ke-roh-VAH kee EYN oh-ZEHR

tokens.hebrew: סְבָבוּנִי פָּרִים רַבִּים אַבִּירֵי בָשָׁן כִּתְּרוּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Many bulls have encompassed me; strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
tokens.transliteration: se-vah-voo-NEE pah-REEM rah-BEEM ah-bee-REY vah-SHAHN kee-te-ROO-nee

tokens.hebrew: פָּצוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף וְשֹׁאֵג׃
tokens.translation: They open wide their mouth against me, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
tokens.transliteration: pah-TSOO ah-LAHY pee-HEHM ahr-YEH toh-REHF ve-shoh-EHG

tokens.hebrew: כַּמַּיִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי וְהִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָי הָיָה לִבִּי כַּדּוֹנָג נָמֵס בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃
tokens.translation: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint; my heart is become like wax; it is melted in mine inmost parts.
tokens.transliteration: kah-MAH-yeem neesh-pahkh-TEE ve-heet-pah-re-DOO kahl ahts-moh-TAHY hah-YAH lee-BEE kah-doh-NAHG nah-MEHS be-TOHKH meh-AHY

tokens.hebrew: יָבֵשׁ כַּחֶרֶשׂ כֹּחִי וּלְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּק מַלְקוֹחָי וְלַעֲפַר־מָוֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my throat; and Thou layest me in the dust of death.
tokens.transliteration: yah-VEHSH kah-KHEH-rehs koh-KHEE oo-le-shoh-NEE mood-BAHK mahl-koh-KHAHY ve-lah-ah-fahr MAH-veht teesh-pe-TEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי סְבָבוּנִי כְּלָבִים עֲדַת מְרֵעִים הִקִּיפוּנִי כָּאֲרִי יָדַי וְרַגְלָי׃
tokens.translation: For dogs have encompassed me; a company of evil-doers have inclosed me; like a lion, they are at my hands and my feet.
tokens.transliteration: KEE se-vah-VOO-nee ke-lah-VEEM ah-DAHT me-reh-EEM hee-kee-FOO-nee kah-ah-REE yah-DAHY ve-rahg-LAHY

tokens.translation: I may count all my bones; they look and gloat over me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-sah-PEHR kohl ahts-moh-TAHY HEH-mah yah-BEE-too yeer-oo VEE

tokens.hebrew: יְחַלְּקוּ בְגָדַי לָהֶם וְעַל־לְבוּשִׁי יַפִּילוּ גוֹרָל׃
tokens.translation: They part my garments among them, and for my vesture do they cast lots.
tokens.transliteration: ye-khah-le-KOO ve-gah-DAHY lah-HEHM ve-ahl le-voo-SHEE yah-PEE-loo goh-RAHL

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תִּרְחָק אֱיָלוּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃
tokens.translation: But Thou, O LORD, be not far off; O Thou my strength, hasten to help me.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI ahl teer-KHAHK eh-yah-loo-TEE le-ehz-RAH-tee KHOO-shah

tokens.translation: Deliver my soul from the sword; mine only one from the power of the dog.
tokens.transliteration: hah-TSEE-lah meh-KHEH-rehv nahf-SHEE mee-yahd keh-LEHV ye-khee-dah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּי אַרְיֵה וּמִקַּרְנֵי רֵמִים עֲנִיתָנִי׃
tokens.translation: Save me from the lion's mouth; yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen do Thou answer me.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-shee-eh-NEE mee-PEE ahr-YEH oo-mee-kahr-NEY reh-MEEM ah-nee-TAH-nee

tokens.hebrew: אֲסַפְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לְאֶחָי בְּתוֹךְ קָהָל אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃
tokens.translation: I will declare Thy name unto my brethren; in the midst of the congregation will I praise Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-sah-pe-RAH sheem-KHAH le-eh-KHAHY be-TOHKH kah-HAHL ah-hah-le-LEH-kah

tokens.hebrew: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב כַּבְּדוּהוּ וְגוּרוּ מִמֶּנּוּ כָּל־זֶרַע יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: 'Ye that fear the LORD, praise Him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify Him; and stand in awe of Him, all ye the seed of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: yeer-EY ah-doh-NAI hah-le-LOO-hoo kohl ZEH-rah yah-ah-KOHV kah-be-DOO-hoo ve-GOO-roo mee-MEH-noo kohl ZEH-rah yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־בָזָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּץ עֱנוּת עָנִי וְלֹא־הִסְתִּיר פָּנָיו מִמֶּנּוּ וּבְשַׁוְּעוֹ אֵלָיו שָׁמֵעַ׃
tokens.translation: For He hath not despised nor abhorred the lowliness of the poor; neither hath He hid His face from him; but when he cried unto Him, He heard.'
tokens.transliteration: KEE loh vah-ZAH ve-LOH shee-KAHTS eh-NOOT ah-NEE ve-loh hees-TEER pah-NAHV mee-MEH-noo oo-ve-shah-ve-OH eh-LAHV shah-MEH-ah

tokens.hebrew: מֵאִתְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי בְּקָהָל רָב נְדָרַי אֲשַׁלֵּם נֶגֶד יְרֵאָיו׃
tokens.translation: From Thee cometh my praise in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before them that fear Him.
tokens.transliteration: MEH-ee-te-KHAH te-hee-lah-TEE be-kah-HAHL RAHV ne-dah-RAHY ah-shah-LEHM NEH-gehd ye-reh-AHV

tokens.hebrew: יֹאכְלוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂבָּעוּ יְהַלְלוּ יְהוָה דֹּרְשָׁיו יְחִי לְבַבְכֶם לָעַד׃
tokens.translation: Let the humble eat and be satisfied; let them praise the LORD that seek after Him; may your heart be quickened for ever!
tokens.transliteration: yoh-khe-LOO ah-nah-VEEM ve-yees-BAH-oo ye-hah-le-LOO ah-doh-NAI DOH-re-SHAHV ye-KHEE le-vahv-KHEHM lah-AHD

tokens.hebrew: יִזְכְּרוּ וְיָשֻׁבוּ אֶל־יְהוָה כָּל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁפְּחוֹת גּוֹיִם׃
tokens.translation: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto the LORD; and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: yeez-ke-ROO ve-yah-SHOO-voo ehl ah-doh-NAI kohl ahf-sey AH-rehts ve-yee-she-tah-khah-VOO le-fah-NEY-khah kahl meesh-pe-KHOHT goh-YEEM

tokens.translation: For the kingdom is the LORD’S; and He is the ruler over the nations.

title: Psalm 23

useCase: The shepherd, provision, and comfort Themes: wellness, provision, grief, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה רֹעִי לֹא אֶחְסָר׃

tokens.transliteration: meez-MOHR le-dah-VEED ah-doh-NAI roh-EE LOH ehkh-SAHR

tokens.hebrew: בִּנְאוֹת דֶּשֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵנִי עַל־מֵי מְנֻחוֹת יְנַהֲלֵנִי׃

tokens.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי יְשׁוֹבֵב יַנְחֵנִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶדֶק לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He restoreth my soul; He guideth me in straight paths for His name's sake.
tokens.transliteration: nahf-SHEE ye-shoh-VEHV yah-ne-KHEH-nee ve-mah-ge-ley tseh-DEHK le-MAH-ahn she-MOH

tokens.hebrew: גַּם כִּי־אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת לֹא־אִירָא רָע כִּי־אַתָּה עִמָּדִי שִׁבְטְךָ וּמִשְׁעַנְתֶּךָ הֵמָּה יְנַחֲמֻנִי׃
tokens.translation: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff, they comfort me.
tokens.transliteration: GAHM kee eh-LEHKH be-GEY tsahl-MAH-veht loh ee-RAH RAH kee ah-TAH ee-mah-DEE sheev-te-KHAH oo-meesh-ahn-TEH-khah HEH-mah ye-nah-khah-MOO-nee

tokens.hebrew: תַּעֲרֹךְ לְפָנַי שֻׁלְחָן נֶגֶד צֹרְרָי דִּשַּׁנְתָּ בַשֶּׁמֶן רֹאשִׁי כּוֹסִי רְוָיָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; Thou hast anointed my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
tokens.transliteration: tah-ah-ROHKH le-fah-NAHY shool-KHAHN NEH-gehd tsoh-re-RAHY dee-SHAHN-tah vah-SHEH-mehn roh-SHEE koh-SEE re-vah-YAH

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ טוֹב וָחֶסֶד יִרְדְּפוּנִי כָּל־יְמֵי חַיָּי וְשַׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית־יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃
tokens.translation: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.

title: Psalm 24

summary: The earth, purity, and the King of glory
useCase: The earth, purity, and the King of glory Themes: nature, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר לַיהוָה הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED meez-MOHR lah-ah-doh-NAI hah-AH-rehts oo-me-loh-AHH teh-VEHL ve-YOH-she-vey VAHH

tokens.translation: For He hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
tokens.transliteration: kee HOO ahl yah-MEEM ye-sah-DAHH ve-ahl ne-hah-ROHT ye-khoh-ne-NEH-hah

tokens.translation: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the LORD? And who shall stand in His holy place?
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-ah-LEH ve-hahr ah-doh-NAI oo-mee yah-KOOM beem-KOHM kohd-SHOH

tokens.hebrew: נְקִי כַפַּיִם וּבַר־לֵבָב אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה׃
tokens.translation: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not taken My name in vain, and hath not sworn deceitfully.
tokens.transliteration: ne-KEE khah-PAH-yeem oo-vahr leh-VAHV ah-SHEHR loh nah-SAH lah-SHAHV nahf-SHEE ve-LOH neesh-BAH le-meer-MAH

tokens.hebrew: יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת יְהוָה וּצְדָקָה מֵאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
tokens.transliteration: yee-SAH ve-rah-KHAH meh-EHT ah-doh-NAI oo-tse-dah-KAH meh-eh-loh-HEY yeesh-OH

tokens.hebrew: זֶה דּוֹר דרשו [דֹּרְשָׁיו] מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Such is the generation of them that seek after Him, that seek Thy face, even Jacob. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ZEH DOHR doh-re-SHAHV me-vahk-SHEY fah-NEY-khah yah-ah-KOHV SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃
tokens.translation: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors; that the King of glory may come in.
tokens.transliteration: se-OO she-ah-REEM rah-shey-KHEHM ve-hee-nah-se-OO peet-KHEY oh-LAHM ve-yah-VOH MEH-lehkh hah-kah-VOHD

tokens.translation: 'Who is the King of glory?' 'The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.'

tokens.hebrew: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד׃
tokens.translation: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors; That the King of glory may come in.

title: Psalm 25
sefariaRef: Psalms 25
useCase: Guidance, forgiveness, and protection Themes: wisdom, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Unto Thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי בְּךָ בָטַחְתִּי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה אַל־יַעַלְצוּ אֹיְבַי לִי׃
tokens.translation: O my God, in Thee have I trusted, let me not be ashamed; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HAHY be-KHAH vah-tahkh-TEE ahl eh-VOH-shah ahl yah-ahl-TSOO oh-ye-VAHY LEE

tokens.hebrew: גַּם כָּל־קֹוֶיךָ לֹא יֵבֹשׁוּ יֵבֹשׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִים רֵיקָם׃
tokens.translation: Yea, none that wait for Thee shall be ashamed; They shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause.
tokens.transliteration: GAHM kohl koh-vey-KHAH LOH yeh-VOH-shoo yeh-VOH-shoo hah-boh-ge-DEEM rey-KAHM

tokens.translation: Show me Thy ways, O LORD; teach me Thy paths.

tokens.hebrew: הַדְרִיכֵנִי בַאֲמִתֶּךָ וְלַמְּדֵנִי כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי אוֹתְךָ קִוִּיתִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Guide me in Thy truth, and teach me; For Thou art the God of my salvation; For Thee do I wait all the day.
tokens.transliteration: hahd-ree-KHEH-nee vah-ah-mee-TEH-khah ve-lah-me-DEH-nee kee ah-TAH eh-loh-HEY yeesh-EE oh-te-KHAH kee-VEE-tee kohl hah-YOHM

tokens.hebrew: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶיךָ יְהוָה וַחֲסָדֶיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵמָּה׃
tokens.translation: Remember, O LORD, Thy compassions and Thy mercies; For they have been from of old.
tokens.transliteration: ze-khohr rah-khah-MEY-khah ah-doh-NAI vah-khah-sah-DEY-khah KEE meh-oh-LAHM HEH-mah

tokens.hebrew: חַטֹּאות נְעוּרַי וּפְשָׁעַי אַל־תִּזְכֹּר כְּחַסְדְּךָ זְכָר־לִי־אַתָּה לְמַעַן טוּבְךָ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; According to Thy mercy remember Thou me, For Thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
tokens.transliteration: khah-TOHVT ne-oo-RAHY oo-fe-shah-AHY ahl teez-KOHR ke-khahs-de-KHAH ze-khahr lee AH-tah le-MAH-ahn too-ve-KHAH ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁר יְהוָה עַל־כֵּן יוֹרֶה חַטָּאִים בַּדָּרֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: Good and upright is the LORD; Therefore doth He instruct sinners in the way.
tokens.transliteration: tohv ve-yah-SHAHR ah-doh-NAI ahl KEHN yoh-REH khah-tah-EEM bah-DAH-rehkh

tokens.hebrew: יַדְרֵךְ עֲנָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּט וִילַמֵּד עֲנָוִים דַּרְכּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He guideth The humble in justice; And He teacheth the humble His way.
tokens.transliteration: yahd-REHKH ah-nah-VEEM bah-meesh-PAHT vee-lah-MEHD ah-nah-VEEM dahr-KOH

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־אָרְחוֹת יְהוָה חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת לְנֹצְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וְעֵדֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth Unto such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.
tokens.transliteration: kohl ohr-KHOHT ah-doh-NAI KHEH-sehd veh-eh-MEHT le-noh-tse-REY ve-ree-TOH ve-eh-doh-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנִי כִּי רַב־הוּא׃
tokens.translation: For Thy name's sake, O LORD, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.
tokens.transliteration: le-mah-ahn sheem-KHAH ah-doh-NAI ve-sah-lahkh-TAH lah-ah-voh-NEE KEE rahv HOO

tokens.hebrew: מִי־זֶה הָאִישׁ יְרֵא יְהוָה יוֹרֶנּוּ בְּדֶרֶךְ יִבְחָר׃
tokens.translation: What man is he that feareth the LORD? Him will He instruct in the way that He should choose.
tokens.transliteration: mee ZEH hah-EESH ye-REH ah-doh-NAI yoh-REH-noo be-DEH-rehkh yeev-KHAHR

tokens.hebrew: נַפְשׁוֹ בְּטוֹב תָּלִין וְזַרְעוֹ יִירַשׁ אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: His soul shall abide in prosperity; And his seed shall inherit the land.
tokens.transliteration: nahf-SHOH be-TOHV tah-LEEN ve-zahr-OH YEE-rahsh AH-rehts

tokens.translation: The counsel of the LORD is with them that fear Him; And His covenant, to make them know it.

tokens.hebrew: עֵינַי תָּמִיד אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי הוּא־יוֹצִיא מֵרֶשֶׁת רַגְלָי׃
tokens.translation: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; For He will bring forth my feet out of the net.
tokens.transliteration: ey-NAHY tah-MEED ehl ah-doh-NAI KEE hoo yoh-TSEE meh-REH-sheht rahg-LAHY

tokens.translation: Turn Thee unto me, and be gracious unto me; For I am solitary and afflicted.
tokens.transliteration: pe-neh eh-LAHY ve-khoh-NEH-nee kee yah-KHEED ve-ah-NEE AH-nee

tokens.translation: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; O bring Thou me out of my distresses.
See mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.
tokens.transliteration: re-EH ohn-YEE vah-ah-mah-LEE ve-SAH le-khohl khah-toh-v-TAHY

tokens.translation: Consider how many are mine enemies, And the cruel hatred wherewith they hate me. .
tokens.transliteration: re-eh oh-ye-VAHY kee RAH-boo ve-seen-AHT khah-MAHS se-neh-OO-nee

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵנִי אַל־אֵבוֹשׁ כִּי־חָסִיתִי בָךְ׃
tokens.translation: O keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: shah-me-RAH nahf-SHEE ve-hah-tsee-LEH-nee ahl eh-VOHSH kee khah-SEE-tee VAHKH

tokens.translation: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, Because I wait for Thee.
Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
tokens.transliteration: pe-DEH eh-loh-HEEM eht yees-rah-EHL mee-KOHL TSAH-roh-tahv

title: Psalm 26
sefariaRef: Psalms 26
summary: Integrity and love of God's house
useCase: Integrity and love of God's house Themes: wisdom, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד שָׁפְטֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי הָלַכְתִּי וּבַיהוָה בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אֶמְעָד׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O LORD, for I have walked in mine integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED shah-fe-TEH-nee ah-doh-NAI kee ah-NEE be-too-MEE hah-LAHKH-tee oo-ah-doh-NAI bah-TAHKH-tee LOH ehm-AHD

tokens.hebrew: בְּחָנֵנִי יְהוָה וְנַסֵּנִי צרופה [צָרְפָה] כִלְיוֹתַי וְלִבִּי׃
tokens.translation: Examine me, O LORD, and try me; test my reins and my heart.
tokens.transliteration: be-khah-NEH-nee ah-doh-NAI ve-nah-SEH-nee tsah-re-FAH kheel-yoh-TAHY ve-lee-BEE

tokens.translation: For Thy mercy is before mine eyes; and I have walked in Thy truth.
tokens.transliteration: kee khahs-de-KHAH le-NEH-gehd ey-NAHY ve-heet-hah-LAHKH-tee bah-ah-mee-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־יָשַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁוְא וְעִם נַעֲלָמִים לֹא אָבוֹא׃
tokens.translation: I have not sat with men of falsehood; neither will I go in with dissemblers.
tokens.transliteration: loh yah-shahv-TEE eem me-tey SHAHV ve-EEM nah-ah-lah-MEEM LOH ah-VOH

tokens.hebrew: שָׂנֵאתִי קְהַל מְרֵעִים וְעִם־רְשָׁעִים לֹא אֵשֵׁב׃
tokens.translation: I hate the gathering of evil doers, and will not sit with the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: sah-neh-TEE ke-HAHL me-reh-EEM ve-eem re-shah-EEM LOH eh-SHEHV

tokens.hebrew: אֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי וַאֲסֹבְבָה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: I will wash my hands in innocency; so will I compass Thine altar, O LORD,
tokens.transliteration: ehr-KHAHTS be-nee-kah-YOHN kah-PAHY vah-ah-soh-ve-VAH eht meez-bah-khah-KHAH ah-doh-NAI

tokens.translation: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all Thy wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration: lahsh-mee-AH be-KOHL toh-DAH oo-le-sah-PEHR kohl neef-le-oh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אָהַבְתִּי מְעוֹן בֵּיתֶךָ וּמְקוֹם מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃

tokens.translation: A Psalm; a Song at the Dedication of the House; of David.

tokens.hebrew: אֲרוֹמִמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי דִלִּיתָנִי וְלֹא־שִׂמַּחְתָּ אֹיְבַי לִי׃
tokens.translation: I will extol thee, O LORD, for Thou hast raised me up, and hast not suffered mine enemies to rejoice over me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-roh-meem-KHAH ah-doh-NAI KEE dee-lee-TAH-nee ve-loh see-MAHKH-tah oh-ye-VAHY LEE

tokens.translation: O LORD my God, I cried unto Thee, and Thou didst heal me;

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה הֶעֱלִיתָ מִן־שְׁאוֹל נַפְשִׁי חִיִּיתַנִי מיורדי־[מִיָּרְדִי־] בוֹר׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, Thou broughtest up my soul from the nether-world; Thou didst kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI heh-eh-LEE-tah meen she-OHL nahf-SHEE khee-yee-TAH-nee mee-yah-re-dee VOHR

tokens.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה חֲסִידָיו וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Sing praise unto the LORD, O ye His godly ones, and give thanks to His holy name.
tokens.transliteration: zah-me-ROO lah-ah-doh-NAI khah-see-DAHV ve-hoh-DOO le-ZEH-khehr kohd-SHOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי רֶגַע בְּאַפּוֹ חַיִּים בִּרְצוֹנוֹ בָּעֶרֶב יָלִין בֶּכִי וְלַבֹּקֶר רִנָּה׃
tokens.translation: For His anger is but for a moment, His favour is for a life-time; weeping may tarry for the night, but joy cometh in the morning.
tokens.transliteration: KEE REH-gah be-ah-POH khah-YEEM beer-tsoh-NOH bah-eh-REHV yah-LEEN BEH-khee ve-lah-BOH-kehr ree-NAH

tokens.translation: Now I had said in my security: 'I shall never be moved.'
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-MAHR-tee ve-shahl-VEE bahl eh-MOHT le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹנְךָ הֶעֱמַדְתָּה לְהַרְרִי עֹז הִסְתַּרְתָּ פָנֶיךָ הָיִיתִי נִבְהָל׃
tokens.translation: Thou hadst established, O LORD, in Thy favour my mountain as a stronghold— Thou didst hide Thy face; I was affrighted.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI beer-tsoh-ne-KHAH heh-eh-MAHD-tah le-hahr-REE OHZ hees-TAHR-tah fah-NEY-khah hah-YEE-tee neev-HAHL

tokens.translation: Unto Thee, O LORD, did I call, And unto the LORD I made supplication:
tokens.transliteration: eh-LEY-khah ah-doh-NAI ehk-RAH ve-ehl ah-doh-NAHY eht-khah-NAHN

tokens.hebrew: מַה־בֶּצַע בְּדָמִי בְּרִדְתִּי אֶל־שָׁחַת הֲיוֹדְךָ עָפָר הֲיַגִּיד אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: 'What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise Thee? shall it declare Thy truth?
tokens.transliteration: mahh BEH-tsah be-dah-MEE be-reed-TEE EHL SHAH-khaht hah-yoh-de-KHAH ah-FAHR hah-yah-GEED ah-mee-TEH-khah

tokens.translation: Hear, O LORD, and be gracious unto me; LORD, be Thou my helper.'
tokens.transliteration: she-mah ah-doh-NAI ve-khoh-NEH-nee ah-doh-NAI heh-yeh oh-ZEHR LEE

tokens.hebrew: הָפַכְתָּ מִסְפְּדִי לְמָחוֹל לִי פִּתַּחְתָּ שַׂקִּי וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי שִׂמְחָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst turn for me my mourning into dancing; Thou didst loose my sackcloth, and gird me with gladness;
tokens.transliteration: hah-FAHKH-tah mees-pe-DEE le-mah-KHOHL LEE pee-TAHKH-tah sah-KEE vah-te-ah-ze-REH-nee seem-KHAH

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יְזַמֶּרְךָ כָבוֹד וְלֹא יִדֹּם יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי לְעוֹלָם אוֹדֶךָּ׃
tokens.translation: So that my glory may sing praise to Thee, and not be silent; O LORD my God, I will give thanks unto Thee for ever.
tokens.transliteration: le-MAH-ahn ye-zah-mehr-KHAH khah-VOHD ve-LOH yee-DOHM ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HAHY le-oh-LAHM oh-DEH-kah

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 31
sefariaRef: Psalms 31
useCase: Refuge amid distress and betrayal Themes: protection, wellness, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: בְּךָ יְהוָה חָסִיתִי אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ פַלְּטֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: In thee, O LORD, have I taken refuge; let me never be ashamed; Deliver me in Thy righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: be-KHAH ah-doh-NAI khah-see-TEE ahl eh-VOH-shah le-oh-LAHM be-tseed-kah-te-KHAH fah-le-TEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: הַטֵּה אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ מְהֵרָה הַצִּילֵנִי הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר־מָעוֹז לְבֵית מְצוּדוֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Incline Thine ear unto me, deliver me speedily; Be Thou to me a rock of refuge, even a fortress of defence, to save me.
tokens.transliteration: hah-TEH eh-LAHY ohz-ne-KHAH me-heh-RAH hah-tsee-LEH-nee heh-YEH LEE le-tsoor mah-OHZ le-VEYT me-tsoo-DOHT le-hoh-shee-EH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה וּלְמַעַן שִׁמְךָ תַּנְחֵנִי וּתְנַהֲלֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art my rock and my fortress; Therefore for Thy name's sake lead me and guide me.
tokens.transliteration: kee sahl-EE oo-me-tsoo-dah-TEE AH-tah oo-le-MAH-ahn sheem-KHAH tah-ne-KHEH-nee oo-te-nah-hah-LEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹצִיאֵנִי מֵרֶשֶׁת זוּ טָמְנוּ לִי כִּי־אַתָּה מָעוּזִּי׃
tokens.translation: Bring me forth out of the net that they have hidden for me; For Thou art my stronghold.
tokens.transliteration: toh-tsee-EH-nee meh-REH-sheht ZOO TAH-me-noo LEE kee ah-TAH mah-oo-ZEE

tokens.hebrew: בְּיָדְךָ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי פָּדִיתָה אוֹתִי יְהוָה אֵל אֱמֶת׃
tokens.translation: Into Thy hand I commit my spirit; Thou hast redeemed me, O LORD, Thou God of truth.
tokens.transliteration: be-yah-de-KHAH ahf-KEED roo-KHEE pah-DEE-tah oh-TEE ah-doh-NAI EHL eh-MEHT

tokens.hebrew: שָׂנֵאתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִים הַבְלֵי־שָׁוְא וַאֲנִי אֶל־יְהוָה בָּטָחְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: I hate them that regard lying vanities; But I trust in the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: sah-NEH-tee hah-shoh-me-REEM hahv-ley SHAHV vah-ah-NEE ehl ah-doh-NAI bah-TAH-khe-tee

tokens.hebrew: אָגִילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָה בְּחַסְדֶּךָ אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתָ אֶת־עָנְיִי יָדַעְתָּ בְּצָרוֹת נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: I will be glad and rejoice in Thy lovingkindness; For Thou hast seen mine affliction, Thou hast taken cognizance of the troubles of my soul,
tokens.transliteration: ah-GEE-lah ve-ehs-me-KHAH be-khahs-DEH-khah ah-SHEHR rah-ee-TAH eht ohn-YEE yah-DAH-tah be-tsah-ROHT nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹא הִסְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־אוֹיֵב הֶעֱמַדְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָב רַגְלָי׃
tokens.translation: And Thou hast not given me over into the hand of the enemy; Thou hast set my feet in a broad place.
tokens.transliteration: ve-LOH hees-gahr-tah-NEE be-yahd oh-YEHV heh-eh-MAHD-tah vah-mehr-KHAHV rahg-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי יְהוָה כִּי צַר־לִי עָשְׁשָׁה בְכַעַס עֵינִי נַפְשִׁי וּבִטְנִי׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, for I am in distress; Mine eye wasteth away with vexation, yea, my soul and my body.
tokens.transliteration: khoh-NEH-nee ah-doh-NAI KEE TSAHR LEE ah-she-SHAH ve-KHAH-ahs ey-NEE nahf-SHEE oo-veet-NEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כָלוּ בְיָגוֹן חַיַּי וּשְׁנוֹתַי בַּאֲנָחָה כָּשַׁל בַּעֲוֺנִי כֹחִי וַעֲצָמַי עָשֵׁשׁוּ׃
tokens.translation: For my life is spent in sorrow, and my years in sighing; My strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are wasted away.
tokens.transliteration: KEE khah-LOO ve-yah-GOHN khah-YAHY oo-she-noh-TAHY bah-ah-nah-KHAH kah-SHAHL bah-ah-voh-NEE khoh-KHEE vah-ah-tsah-MAHY ah-SHEH-shoo

tokens.hebrew: מִכָּל־צֹרְרַי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַי מְאֹד וּפַחַד לִמְיֻדָּעָי רֹאַי בַּחוּץ נָדְדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbours exceedingly, and a dread to mine acquaintance; They that see me without flee from me.
tokens.transliteration: mee-kohl tsoh-re-RAHY hah-YEE-tee khehr-PAH ve-lee-shah-kheh-NAHY me-OHD oo-FAH-khahd lee-me-yoo-dah-AHY roh-AHY bah-KHOOTS nah-de-DOO mee-MEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: נִשְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵת מִלֵּב הָיִיתִי כִּכְלִי אֹבֵד׃
tokens.translation: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind; I am like a useless vessel.
tokens.transliteration: neesh-kahkh-TEE ke-MEHT mee-LEHV hah-YEE-tee keekh-LEE oh-VEHD

tokens.hebrew: כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי דִּבַּת רַבִּים מָגוֹר מִסָּבִיב בְּהִוָּסְדָם יַחַד עָלַי לָקַחַת נַפְשִׁי זָמָמוּ׃
tokens.translation: For I have heard the whispering of many, Terror on every side; While they took counsel together against me, They devised to take away my life.
tokens.transliteration: KEE shah-MAH-tee dee-BAHT rah-BEEM mah-GOHR mee-sah-VEEV be-hee-vah-se-DAHM YAH-khahd ah-LAHY lah-KAH-khaht nahf-SHEE zah-MAH-moo

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָלֶיךָ בָטַחְתִּי יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהַי אָתָּה׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, I have trusted in Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my God.'
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-LEY-khah vah-TAHKH-tee ah-doh-NAI ah-MAHR-tee eh-loh-HAHY AH-tah

tokens.translation: My times are in Thy hand; Deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
tokens.transliteration: be-yah-de-KHAH ee-toh-TAHY hah-tsee-LEH-nee mee-yahd oh-ye-VAHY oo-meh-roh-de-FAHY

tokens.translation: Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; Save me in Thy lovingkindness.
tokens.transliteration: hah-EE-rah fah-ney-KHAH ahl ahv-DEH-khah HOH-shee-EH-nee ve-khahs-DEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אַל־אֵבוֹשָׁה כִּי קְרָאתִיךָ יֵבֹשׁוּ רְשָׁעִים יִדְּמוּ לִשְׁאוֹל׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon Thee; Let the wicked be ashamed, let them be put to silence in the nether-world.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ahl eh-voh-SHAH KEE ke-rah-TEE-khah yeh-VOH-shoo re-shah-EEM yee-de-MOO leesh-OHL

tokens.hebrew: תֵּאָלַמְנָה שִׂפְתֵי שָׁקֶר הַדֹּבְרוֹת עַל־צַדִּיק עָתָק בְּגַאֲוָה וָבוּז׃
tokens.translation: Let the lying lips be dumb, Which speak arrogantly against the righteous, With pride and contempt.
tokens.transliteration: TEH-ah-LAHM-nah seef-TEY SHAH-kehr hah-doh-ve-ROHT ahl tsah-DEEK ah-TAHK be-gah-ah-VAH vah-VOOZ

tokens.hebrew: מָה רַב־טוּבְךָ אֲשֶׁר־צָפַנְתָּ לִּירֵאֶיךָ פָּעַלְתָּ לַחֹסִים בָּךְ נֶגֶד בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Oh how abundant is Thy goodness, which Thou hast laid up for them that fear Thee; Which Thou hast wrought for them that take their refuge in Thee, in the sight of the sons of men!
tokens.transliteration: MAH rahv too-ve-KHAH ah-shehr tsah-FAHN-tah lee-reh-EY-khah pah-ahl-TAH lah-khoh-SEEM BAHKH neh-GEHD be-NEY ah-dahm

tokens.hebrew: תַּסְתִּירֵם בְּסֵתֶר פָּנֶיךָ מֵרֻכְסֵי אִישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵם בְּסֻכָּה מֵרִיב לְשֹׁנוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Thou hidest them in the covert of Thy presence from the plottings of man; Thou concealest them in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
tokens.transliteration: tahs-tee-REHM be-SEH-tehr pah-ney-KHAH meh-rookh-SEY EESH teets-pe-NEHM be-soo-KAH meh-REEV le-shoh-NOHT

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה כִּי הִפְלִיא חַסְדּוֹ לִי בְּעִיר מָצוֹר׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be the LORD; For He hath shown me His wondrous lovingkindness in an entrenched city.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ROOKH ah-doh-NAI KEE heef-LEE khahs-DOH LEE be-EER mah-TSOHR

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָמַרְתִּי בְחָפְזִי נִגְרַזְתִּי מִנֶּגֶד עֵינֶיךָ אָכֵן שָׁמַעְתָּ קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִי אֵלֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: As for me, I said in my haste: 'I am cut off from before Thine eyes'; Nevertheless Thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-MAHR-tee ve-khah-fe-ZEE neeg-rahz-TEE mee-NEH-gehd ey-NEY-khah ah-KHEHN shah-mah-TAH KOHL tah-khah-noo-NAHY be-shah-ve-EE eh-LEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אֶהֱבוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־חֲסִידָיו אֱמוּנִים נֹצֵר יְהוָה וּמְשַׁלֵּם עַל־יֶתֶר עֹשֵׂה גַאֲוָה׃
tokens.translation: O love the LORD, all ye His godly ones; The LORD preserveth the faithful, And plentifully repayeth him that acteth haughtily.
tokens.transliteration: eh-heh-VOO eht ah-doh-NAI kahl khah-see-DAHV eh-moo-NEEM noh-TSEHR ah-doh-NAI oo-me-shah-LEHM ahl yeh-TEHR oh-SEH gah-ah-VAH

tokens.translation: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, All ye that wait for the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: kheez-KOO ve-yah-ah-MEHTS le-vahv-KHEHM kohl hah-me-yah-khah-LEEM lah-ah-doh-NAI

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 32
sefariaRef: Psalms 32
useCase: Confession, forgiveness, and instruction Themes: repentance, wisdom, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד מַשְׂכִּיל אַשְׁרֵי נְשׂוּי־פֶּשַׁע כְּסוּי חֲטָאָה׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Maschil. Happy is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is pardoned.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED mahs-KEEL ahsh-REY ne-sooy PEH-shah ke-SOOY khah-tah-AH

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם לֹא יַחְשֹׁב יְהוָה לוֹ עָוֺן וְאֵין בְּרוּחוֹ רְמִיָּה׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the man unto whom the LORD counteth not iniquity, And in whose spirit there is no guile.
tokens.transliteration: AHSH-rey ah-DAHM LOH yahkh-SHOHV ah-doh-NAI LOH ah-VOHN ve-EYN be-roo-KHOH re-mee-yah

tokens.translation: When I kept silence, my bones wore away Through my groaning all the day long.
tokens.transliteration: kee heh-kheh-rahsh-TEE bah-LOO ah-tsah-MAHY be-shah-ah-gah-TEE kohl hah-YOHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה תִּכְבַּד עָלַי יָדֶךָ נֶהְפַּךְ לְשַׁדִּי בְּחַרְבֹנֵי קַיִץ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: For day and night Thy hand was heavy upon me; My sap was turned as in the droughts of summer. Selah
tokens.transliteration: KEE yoh-MAHM vah-lahy-LAH teekh-BAHD ah-LAHY yah-DEH-khah neh-PAHKH le-shah-DEE be-khahr-VOH-ney KAH-yeets SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: חַטָּאתִי אוֹדִיעֲךָ וַעֲוֺנִי לֹא־כִסִּיתִי אָמַרְתִּי אוֹדֶה עֲלֵי פְשָׁעַי לַיהוָה וְאַתָּה נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן חַטָּאתִי סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: I acknowledged my sin unto Thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid; I said: 'I will make confession concerning my transgressions unto the LORD' — And Thou, Thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah
tokens.transliteration: khah-tah-TEE oh-DEE-ah-KHAH vah-ah-voh-NEE loh khee-SEE-tee ah-MAHR-tee oh-DEH ah-LEY fe-shah-AHY lah-ah-doh-NAI ve-ah-TAH nah-SAH-tah ah-VOHN khah-tah-TEE SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: עַל־זֹאת יִתְפַּלֵּל כָּל־חָסִיד אֵלֶיךָ לְעֵת מְצֹא רַק לְשֵׁטֶף מַיִם רַבִּים אֵלָיו לֹא יַגִּיעוּ׃
tokens.translation: For this let every one that is godly pray unto Thee in a time when Thou mayest be found; Surely, when the great waters overflow, they will not reach unto him.
tokens.transliteration: ahl ZOHT yeet-pah-LEHL kohl khah-SEED eh-ley-KHAH le-EHT me-TSOH RAHK le-sheh-TEHF MAH-yeem rah-BEEM eh-LAHV LOH yah-GEE-oo

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה סֵתֶר לִי מִצַּר תִּצְּרֵנִי רָנֵּי פַלֵּט תְּסוֹבְבֵנִי סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou art my hiding-place; Thou wilt preserve me from the adversary; With songs of deliverance Thou wilt compass me about. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH SEH-tehr LEE mee-TSAHR tee-tse-REH-nee rah-NEY fah-LEHT te-SOH-ve-VEH-nee SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׂכִּילְךָ וְאוֹרְךָ בְּדֶרֶךְ־זוּ תֵלֵךְ אִיעֲצָה עָלֶיךָ עֵינִי׃
tokens.translation: 'I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go; I will give counsel, Mine eye being upon thee.'
tokens.transliteration: ahs-kee-le-KHAH ve-oh-re-KHAH be-deh-rehkh ZOO teh-LEHKH ee-ah-TSAH ah-LEY-khah ey-NEE

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּהְיוּ כְּסוּס כְּפֶרֶד אֵין הָבִין בְּמֶתֶג־וָרֶסֶן עֶדְיוֹ לִבְלוֹם בַּל קְרֹב אֵלֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding; Whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, That they come not near unto thee.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tee-he-YOO ke-SOOS ke-feh-REHD EYN hah-VEEN be-meh-tehg vah-REH-sehn ehd-YOH leev-LOHM BAHL ke-ROHV eh-LEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: רַבִּים מַכְאוֹבִים לָרָשָׁע וְהַבּוֹטֵחַ בַּיהוָה חֶסֶד יְסוֹבְבֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Many are the sorrows of the wicked; But he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy compasseth him about.
tokens.transliteration: rah-BEEM mahkh-oh-VEEM lah-rah-SHAH ve-hah-boh-TEH-ahkh bah-ah-doh-NAI kheh-SEHD ye-soh-ve-VEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: שִׂמְחוּ בַיהוָה וְגִילוּ צַדִּיקִים וְהַרְנִינוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
tokens.translation: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous; And shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.
tokens.transliteration: seem-KHOO vah-ah-doh-NAI ve-gee-LOO tsah-dee-KEEM ve-hahr-NEE-noo kohl yeesh-rey LEHV

title: Psalm 33
sefariaRef: Psalms 33
useCase: Creation, trust, and communal praise Themes: gratitude, community, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃
tokens.translation: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous, Praise is comely for the upright.
tokens.transliteration: rah-ne-NOO tsah-dee-KEEM bah-ah-doh-NAI lahy-shah-REEM nah-VAH te-hee-LAH

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Give thanks unto the LORD with harp, Sing praises unto Him with the psaltery of ten strings.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI be-khee-NOHR be-NEH-vehl ah-SOHR zah-me-roo LOH

tokens.hebrew: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ שִׁיר חָדָשׁ הֵיטִיבוּ נַגֵּן בִּתְרוּעָה׃
tokens.translation: Sing unto Him a new song; Play skilfully amid shouts of joy.
tokens.transliteration: shee-roo LOH SHEER khah-DAHSH hey-TEE-voo nah-GEHN beet-roo-AH

tokens.translation: For the word of the LORD is upright; And all His work is done in faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration: kee yah-SHAHR de-vahr ah-doh-NAI ve-khohl mah-ah-SEH-hoo beh-eh-moo-NAH

tokens.hebrew: אֹהֵב צְדָקָה וּמִשְׁפָּט חֶסֶד יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: He loveth righteousness and justice; The earth is full of the lovingkindness of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: oh-HEHV tse-dah-KAH oo-meesh-PAHT KHEH-sehd ah-doh-NAI mah-le-AH hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: בִּדְבַר יְהוָה שָׁמַיִם נַעֲשׂוּ וּבְרוּחַ פִּיו כָּל־צְבָאָם׃
tokens.translation: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.
tokens.transliteration: beed-VAHR ah-doh-NAI shah-MAH-yeem nah-ah-SOO oo-ve-ROO-ahkh PEEV kohl tse-vah-AHM

tokens.hebrew: כֹּנֵס כַּנֵּד מֵי הַיָּם נֹתֵן בְּאֹצָרוֹת תְּהוֹמוֹת׃
tokens.translation: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as a heap; He layeth up the deeps in storehouses.
tokens.transliteration: koh-NEHS kah-NEHD MEY hah-YAHM noh-TEHN be-oh-tsah-ROHT te-hoh-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: יִירְאוּ מֵיְהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מִמֶּנּוּ יָגוּרוּ כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל׃
tokens.translation: Let all the earth fear the LORD; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of Him.
tokens.transliteration: yee-re-OO meh-ah-doh-NAI kohl hah-AH-rehts mee-MEH-noo yah-GOO-roo kohl yoh-she-VEY teh-VEHL

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אָמַר וַיֶּהִי הוּא־צִוָּה וַיַּעֲמֹד׃
tokens.translation: For He spoke, and it was; He commanded, and it stood.
tokens.transliteration: KEE HOO ah-MAHR vah-YEH-hee hoo tsee-VAH vah-yah-ah-MOHD

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה הֵפִיר עֲצַת־גּוֹיִם הֵנִיא מַחְשְׁבוֹת עַמִּים׃
tokens.translation: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the nations to nought; He maketh the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI heh-FEER ah-tsaht goh-YEEM heh-NEE mahkh-she-VOHT ah-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: עֲצַת יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תַּעֲמֹד מַחְשְׁבוֹת לִבּוֹ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, The thoughts of His heart to all generations.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TSAHT ah-doh-NAI le-oh-LAHM tah-ah-MOHD mahkh-she-VOHT lee-BOH le-DOHR vah-DOHR

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו הָעָם בָּחַר לְנַחֲלָה לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the nation whose God is the LORD; The people whom He hath chosen for His own inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY hah-GOHY ah-shehr ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HAHV hah-AHM bah-KHAHR le-nah-khah-LAH LOH

tokens.hebrew: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִבִּיט יְהוָה רָאָה אֶת־כָּל־בְּנֵי הָאָדָם׃
tokens.translation: The LORD looketh from heaven; He beholdeth all the sons of men;
tokens.transliteration: mee-shah-mah-YEEM hee-BEET ah-doh-NAI rah-AH eht kohl be-NEY hah-ah-DAHM

tokens.translation: From the place of His habitation He looketh intently Upon all the inhabitants of the earth;
tokens.transliteration: mee-me-khohn sheev-TOH heesh-GEE-ahkh EHL kohl yoh-she-VEY hah-AH-rehts

tokens.translation: He that fashioneth the hearts of them all, That considereth all their doings.
tokens.transliteration: hah-yoh-TSEHR YAH-khahd lee-BAHM hah-meh-VEEN ehl kohl mah-ah-sey-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: אֵין־הַמֶּלֶךְ נוֹשָׁע בְּרָב־חָיִל גִּבּוֹר לֹא־יִנָּצֵל בְּרָב־כֹּחַ׃
tokens.translation: A king is not saved by the multitude of a host; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.
tokens.transliteration: eyn hah-meh-LEHKH noh-SHAH be-rohv KHAH-yeel gee-BOHR loh yee-nah-TSEHL be-rohv KOH-ahkh

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁקֶר הַסּוּס לִתְשׁוּעָה וּבְרֹב חֵילוֹ לֹא יְמַלֵּט׃
tokens.translation: A horse is a vain thing for safety; Neither doth it afford escape by its great strength.
tokens.transliteration: SHEH-kehr hah-SOOS leet-shoo-AH oo-ve-ROHV khey-LOH LOH ye-mah-LEHT

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה עֵין יְהוָה אֶל־יְרֵאָיו לַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Behold, the eye of the LORD is toward them that fear Him, Toward them that wait for His mercy;
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH EYN ah-doh-NAI ehl ye-reh-AHV lah-me-yah-khah-LEEM le-khahs-DOH

tokens.translation: To deliver their soul from death, And to keep them alive in famine.

tokens.hebrew: נַפְשֵׁנוּ חִכְּתָה לַיהוָה עֶזְרֵנוּ וּמָגִנֵּנוּ הוּא׃
tokens.translation: Our soul hath waited for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
tokens.transliteration: nahf-sheh-NOO khee-ke-TAH lah-ah-doh-NAI ehz-REH-noo oo-mah-gee-NEH-noo HOO

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־בוֹ יִשְׂמַח לִבֵּנוּ כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ בָטָחְנוּ׃
tokens.translation: For in Him doth our heart rejoice, Because we have trusted in His holy name.
tokens.transliteration: kee VOH yees-MAHKH lee-BEH-noo KEE ve-SHEHM kohd-SHOH vah-TAH-khe-noo

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי־חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה עָלֵינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַלְנוּ לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: Let Thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, According as we have waited for Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee khahs-de-KHAH ah-doh-NAI ah-LEY-noo kah-ah-SHEHR yee-KHAHL-noo LAHKH

title: Psalm 34
sefariaRef: Psalms 34
summary: Rescue, ethical speech, and care for the brokenhearted
useCase: Rescue, ethical speech, and care for the brokenhearted Themes: wellness, relationships, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד בְּשַׁנּוֹתוֹ אֶת־טַעְמוֹ לִפְנֵי אֲבִימֶלֶךְ וַיְגָרֲשֵׁהוּ וַיֵּלַךְ׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David; when he changed his demeanour before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED be-shah-noh-TOH eht tah-MOH leef-NEY ah-vee-MEH-lehkh vah-ye-gah-rah-SHEH-hoo vah-yeh-LAHKH

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָרֲכָה אֶת־יְהוָה בְּכָל־עֵת תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֹ בְּפִי׃
tokens.translation: I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise shall continually be in my mouth.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vah-rah-KHAH eht ah-doh-NAI be-khohl EHT tah-MEED te-hee-lah-TOH be-FEE

tokens.hebrew: בַּיהוָה תִּתְהַלֵּל נַפְשִׁי יִשְׁמְעוּ עֲנָוִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ׃
tokens.translation: My soul shall glory in the LORD; The humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ah-doh-NAI teet-hah-LEHL nahf-SHEE yeesh-me-OO ah-nah-VEEM ve-yees-MAH-khoo

tokens.hebrew: גַּדְּלוּ לַיהוָה אִתִּי וּנְרוֹמְמָה שְׁמוֹ יַחְדָּו׃
tokens.translation: O magnify the LORD with me, And let us exalt His name together.
tokens.transliteration: gah-de-LOO lah-ah-doh-NAI ee-TEE oo-ne-roh-me-MAH she-MOH yahkh-DAHV

tokens.translation: I sought the LORD, and He answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.
tokens.transliteration: dah-RAHSH-tee eht ah-doh-NAI ve-ah-NAH-nee oo-mee-kohl me-goo-roh-TAHY hee-tsee-LAH-nee

tokens.translation: They looked unto Him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be abashed.
tokens.transliteration: hee-BEE-too eh-LAHV ve-nah-HAH-roo oo-fe-ney-HEHM ahl yehkh-PAH-roo

tokens.hebrew: זֶה עָנִי קָרָא וַיהוָה שָׁמֵעַ וּמִכָּל־צָרוֹתָיו הוֹשִׁיעוֹ׃
tokens.translation: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard, And saved him out of all his troubles.
tokens.transliteration: ZEH ah-NEE kah-RAH vah-ah-doh-NAI shah-MEH-ah oo-mee-kohl tsah-roh-TAHV hoh-shee-OH

tokens.translation: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear Him, And delivereth them.
tokens.transliteration: khoh-NEH mahl-ahkh ah-doh-NAI sah-VEEV lee-reh-AHV vah-ye-khah-le-TSEHM

tokens.hebrew: טַעֲמוּ וּרְאוּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר יֶחֱסֶה־בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: O consider and see that the LORD is good; Happy is the man that taketh refuge in Him.
tokens.transliteration: tah-ah-MOO oo-re-OO kee TOHV ah-doh-NAI ah-she-REY hah-GEH-vehr yeh-kheh-seh BOH

tokens.hebrew: יְראוּ אֶת־יְהוָה קְדֹשָׁיו כִּי־אֵין מַחְסוֹר לִירֵאָיו׃
tokens.translation: O fear the LORD, ye His holy ones; For there is no want to them that fear Him.
tokens.transliteration: ye-R-oo eht ah-doh-NAI ke-doh-SHAHV kee EYN mahkh-SOHR lee-reh-AHV

tokens.hebrew: כְּפִירִים רָשׁוּ וְרָעֵבוּ וְדֹרְשֵׁי יְהוָה לֹא־יַחְסְרוּ כָל־טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek the LORD want not any good thing.
tokens.transliteration: ke-fee-REEM rah-SHOO ve-rah-EH-voo ve-doh-re-SHEY ah-doh-NAI loh yahkh-se-ROO khohl TOHV

tokens.translation: Come, ye children, hearken unto me; I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: le-khoo vah-NEEM sheem-oo LEE yee-re-AHT ah-doh-NAI ah-lah-mehd-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: מִי־הָאִישׁ הֶחָפֵץ חַיִּים אֹהֵב יָמִים לִרְאוֹת טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: Who is the man that desireth life, and loveth days, That he may see good therein?
tokens.transliteration: mee hah-EESH heh-khah-FEHTS khah-YEEM oh-HEHV yah-MEEM leer-OHT TOHV

tokens.hebrew: נְצֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתֶיךָ מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה׃
tokens.translation: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.
tokens.transliteration: ne-TSOHR le-shoh-ne-KHAH meh-RAH oo-se-fah-TEY-khah mee-dah-BEHR meer-MAH

tokens.hebrew: סוּר מֵרָע וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ׃
tokens.translation: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.
tokens.transliteration: SOOR meh-RAH vah-ah-seh TOHV bah-KEHSH shah-LOHM ve-rah-de-FEH-hoo

tokens.translation: The eyes of the LORD are toward the righteous, And His ears are open unto their cry.
tokens.transliteration: ey-NEY ah-doh-NAI ehl tsah-dee-KEEM ve-ohz-NOHYV ehl shahv-ah-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: פְּנֵי יְהוָה בְּעֹשֵׂי רָע לְהַכְרִית מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
tokens.translation: The face of the LORD is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
tokens.transliteration: pe-NEY ah-doh-NAI be-OH-sey RAH le-hahkh-REET meh-EH-rehts zeekh-RAHM

tokens.translation: They cried, and the LORD heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.
tokens.transliteration: tsah-ah-KOO vah-ah-doh-NAI shah-MEH-ah oo-mee-kohl tsah-roh-TAHM hee-tsee-LAHM

tokens.translation: The LORD is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.
tokens.transliteration: kah-ROHV ah-doh-NAI le-neesh-be-rey LEHV ve-eht dah-ke-ey ROO-ahkh yoh-SHEE-ah

tokens.hebrew: רַבּוֹת רָעוֹת צַדִּיק וּמִכֻּלָּם יַצִּילֶנּוּ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Many are the ills of the righteous, But the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
tokens.transliteration: rah-BOHT rah-OHT tsah-DEEK oo-mee-koo-LAHM yah-tsee-LEH-noo ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר כָּל־עַצְמוֹתָיו אַחַת מֵהֵנָּה לֹא נִשְׁבָּרָה׃
tokens.translation: He keepeth all his bones; Not one of them is broken.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-MEHR kohl ahts-moh-TAHV ah-KHAHT meh-HEH-nah LOH neesh-BAH-rah

tokens.hebrew: תְּמוֹתֵת רָשָׁע רָעָה וְשֹׂנְאֵי צַדִּיק יֶאְשָׁמוּ׃
tokens.translation: Evil shall kill the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be held guilty.
tokens.transliteration: te-moh-TEHT rah-SHAH rah-AH ve-soh-ne-EY tsah-DEEK yeh-SHAH-moo

tokens.hebrew: פּוֹדֶה יְהוָה נֶפֶשׁ עֲבָדָיו וְלֹא יֶאְשְׁמוּ כָּל־הַחֹסִים בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD redeemeth the soul of His servants; And none of them that take refuge in Him shall be desolate.
tokens.transliteration: poh-DEH ah-doh-NAI NEH-fehsh ah-vah-DAHV ve-LOH yeh-she-MOO kahl hah-khoh-SEEM BOH

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 35
sefariaRef: Psalms 35
useCase: Help against unjust opponents Themes: justice, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד רִיבָה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרִיבַי לְחַם אֶת־לֹחֲמָי׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Strive, O LORD, with them that strive with me; Fight against them that fight against me.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED ree-VAH ah-doh-NAI eht ye-ree-VAHY le-KHAHM eht loh-khah-MAHY

tokens.translation: Take hold of shield and buckler, And rise up to my help.

tokens.hebrew: וְהָרֵק חֲנִית וּסְגֹר לִקְרַאת רֹדְפָי אֱמֹר לְנַפְשִׁי יְשֻׁעָתֵךְ אָנִי׃
tokens.translation: Draw out also the spear, and the battle-axe, against them that pursue me; Say unto my soul: 'I am Thy salvation.'
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-REHK khah-NEET oo-se-GOHR leek-RAHT roh-de-FAHY eh-MOHR le-nahf-SHEE ye-shoo-ah-TEHKH AH-nee

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִכָּלְמוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיַחְפְּרוּ חֹשְׁבֵי רָעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion that seek after my soul; Let them be turned back and be abashed that devise my hurt.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-VOH-shoo ve-yee-kah-le-MOO me-vahk-SHEY nahf-SHEE yee-SOH-goo ah-KHOHR ve-yahkh-pe-ROO khoh-she-VEY rah-ah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: יִהְיוּ כְּמֹץ לִפְנֵי־רוּחַ וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה דּוֹחֶה׃
tokens.translation: Let them be as chaff before the wind, The angel of the LORD thrusting them.
tokens.transliteration: yee-he-YOO ke-MOHTS leef-ney ROO-ahkh oo-mahl-AHKH ah-doh-NAI doh-KHEH

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי־דַרְכָּם חֹשֶׁךְ וַחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת וּמַלְאַךְ יְהוָה רֹדְפָם׃
tokens.translation: Let their way be dark and slippery, The angel of the LORD pursuing them.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee dahr-KAHM KHOH-shehkh vah-khah-lahk-lah-KOHT oo-mahl-AHKH ah-doh-NAI roh-de-FAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־חִנָּם טָמְנוּ־לִי שַׁחַת רִשְׁתָּם חִנָּם חָפְרוּ לְנַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: For without cause have they hid for me the pit, even their net, Without cause have they digged for my soul. .
tokens.transliteration: kee khee-NAHM tah-me-noo LEE SHAH-khaht reesh-TAHM khee-NAHM khah-fe-ROO le-nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: תְּבוֹאֵהוּ שׁוֹאָה לֹא־יֵדָע וְרִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־טָמַן תִּלְכְּדוֹ בְּשׁוֹאָה יִפָּל־בָּהּ׃
tokens.translation: Let destruction come upon him unawares; And let his net that he hath hid catch himself; With destruction let him fall therein.
tokens.transliteration: te-voh-EH-hoo shoh-AH loh yeh-DAH ve-reesh-TOH ah-shehr tah-MAHN teel-ke-DOH be-shoh-AH yee-pahl BAHH

tokens.translation: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD; It shall rejoice in His salvation.

tokens.hebrew: כָּל עַצְמוֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה יְהוָה מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנּוּ וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלוֹ׃
tokens.translation: All my bones shall say: 'LORD, who is like unto Thee, Who deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, Yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?'
tokens.transliteration: KOHL ahts-moh-TAHY toh-mahr-NAH ah-doh-NAI MEE khah-MOH-khah mah-TSEEL ah-NEE meh-khah-ZAHK mee-MEH-noo ve-ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN mee-goh-ze-LOH

tokens.hebrew: יְקוּמוּן עֵדֵי חָמָס אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי יִשְׁאָלוּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Unrighteous witnesses rise up; They ask me of things that I know not.
tokens.transliteration: ye-koo-MOON eh-DEY khah-MAHS ah-SHEHR loh yah-DAH-tee yeesh-ah-LOO-nee

tokens.hebrew: יְשַׁלְּמוּנִי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה שְׁכוֹל לְנַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: They repay me evil for good; Bereavement is come to my soul.
tokens.transliteration: ye-shah-le-MOO-nee rah-AH TAH-khaht toh-VAH she-KHOHL le-nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹתָם לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק עִנֵּיתִי בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וּתְפִלָּתִי עַל־חֵיקִי תָשׁוּב׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth, I afflicted my soul with fasting; And my prayer, may it return into mine own bosom.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE bah-khah-loh-TAHM le-VOO-shee SAHK ee-NEY-tee vah-TSOHM nahf-SHEE oo-te-fee-lah-TEE ahl khey-KEE tah-SHOOV

tokens.hebrew: כְּרֵעַ־כְּאָח לִי הִתְהַלָּכְתִּי כַּאֲבֶל־אֵם קֹדֵר שַׁחוֹתִי׃
tokens.translation: I went about as though it had been my friend or my brother; I bowed down mournful, as one that mourneth for his mother.
tokens.transliteration: ke-reh-ah ke-AHKH LEE heet-hah-LAH-khe-tee kah-ah-vehl EHM koh-DEHR shah-KHOH-tee

tokens.hebrew: וּבְצַלְעִי שָׂמְחוּ וְנֶאֱסָפוּ נֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי נֵכִים וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי קָרְעוּ וְלֹא־דָמּוּ׃
tokens.translation: But when I halt they rejoice, and gather themselves together; The abjects gather themselves together against me, and those whom I know not; They tear me, and cease not;
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-tsahl-EE sah-me-KHOO ve-neh-eh-SAH-foo neh-ehs-FOO ah-LAHY neh-KHEEM ve-LOH yah-DAH-tee kah-re-OO ve-loh DAH-moo

tokens.hebrew: בְּחַנְפֵי לַעֲגֵי מָעוֹג חָרֹק עָלַי שִׁנֵּימוֹ׃
tokens.translation: With the profanest mockeries of backbiting They gnash at me with their teeth.
tokens.transliteration: be-khahn-FEY lah-ah-GEY mah-OHG khah-ROHK ah-LAHY shee-NEY-moh

tokens.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי כַּמָּה תִּרְאֶה הָשִׁיבָה נַפְשִׁי מִשֹּׁאֵיהֶם מִכְּפִירִים יְחִידָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Lord, how long wilt Thou look on? Rescue my soul from their destructions, Mine only one from the lions.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAHY kah-MAH teer-EH hah-SHEE-vah nahf-SHEE mee-shoh-ey-HEHM mee-ke-fee-REEM ye-khee-dah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ בְּקָהָל רָב בְּעַם עָצוּם אֲהַלְלֶךָּ׃
tokens.translation: I will give Thee thanks in the great congregation; I will praise Thee among a numerous people.
tokens.transliteration: oh-de-KHAH be-kah-HAHL RAHV be-AHM ah-TSOOM ahhah-le-LEH-kah

tokens.hebrew: אַל־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם יִקְרְצוּ־עָיִן׃
tokens.translation: Let not them that are wrongfully mine enemies rejoice over me; Neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
tokens.transliteration: ahl yees-me-khoo LEE oh-ye-VAHY SHEH-kehr soh-ne-AHY khee-NAHM yeek-re-tsoo AH-yeen

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא שָׁלוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ וְעַל רִגְעֵי־אֶרֶץ דִּבְרֵי מִרְמוֹת יַחֲשֹׁבוּן׃
tokens.translation: For they speak not peace; But they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.
tokens.transliteration: KEE LOH shah-LOHM ye-dah-BEH-roo ve-AHL reeg-ey EH-rehts deev-REY meer-MOHT yah-khah-shoh-VOON

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּרְחִיבוּ עָלַי פִּיהֶם אָמְרוּ הֶאָח הֶאָח רָאֲתָה עֵינֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, they open their mouth wide against me; They say: 'Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.'
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahr-KHEE-voo ah-LAHY pee-HEHM ah-me-ROO heh-AHKH heh-AHKH rah-ah-TAH ey-NEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: רָאִיתָה יְהוָה אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ אֲדֹנָי אֲל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast seen, O LORD; keep not silence; O Lord, be not far from me.
tokens.transliteration: rah-EE-tah ah-doh-NAI ahl teh-kheh-RAHSH ah-doh-NAHY ahl teer-KHAHK mee-MEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: הָעִירָה וְהָקִיצָה לְמִשְׁפָּטִי אֱלֹהַי וַאדֹנָי לְרִיבִי׃
tokens.translation: Rouse Thee, and awake to my judgment, Even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
tokens.transliteration: hah-EE-rah ve-hah-kee-TSAH le-meesh-pah-TEE eh-loh-HAHY vah-doh-NAHY le-ree-VEE

tokens.translation: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to Thy righteousness; And let them not rejoice over me.
tokens.transliteration: shah-fe-TEH-nee khe-tseed-ke-KHAH ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HAHY ve-ahl yees-me-khoo LEE

tokens.hebrew: אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בְלִבָּם הֶאָח נַפְשֵׁנוּ אַל־יֹאמְרוּ בִּלַּעֲנוּהוּ׃
tokens.translation: Let them not say in their heart: 'Aha, we have our desire'; Let them not say: 'We have swallowed him up.'
tokens.transliteration: ahl yoh-me-ROO ve-lee-BAHM heh-AHKH nahf-SHEH-noo ahl yoh-me-ROO bee-lah-ah-NOO-hoo

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחְדָּו שְׂמֵחֵי רָעָתִי יִלְבְּשׁוּ־בֹשֶׁת וּכְלִמָּה הַמַּגְדִּילִים עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: Let them be ashamed and abashed together that rejoice at my hurt; Let them be clothed with shame and confusion that magnify themselves against me. .
tokens.transliteration: yeh-VOH-shoo ve-yahkh-pe-ROO yahkh-DAHV se-meh-KHEY rah-ah-TEE yee-le-be-shoo VOH-sheht oo-khe-lee-MAH hah-mahg-dee-LEEM ah-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: יָרֹנּוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ חֲפֵצֵי צִדְקִי וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה הֶחָפֵץ שְׁלוֹם עַבְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that delight in my righteousness; Yea, let them say continually: 'Magnified be the LORD, Who delighteth in the peace of His servant.'
tokens.transliteration: yah-ROH-noo ve-yees-me-KHOO khah-feh-TSEY tseed-KEE ve-yoh-me-ROO tah-MEED yeeg-DAHL ah-doh-NAI heh-khah-FEHTS she-LOHM ahv-DOH

tokens.translation: And my tongue shall speak of Thy righteousness, And of Thy praise all the day.
tokens.transliteration: oo-le-shoh-NEE teh-GEH tseed-KEH-khah kohl hah-YOHM te-hee-lah-TEH-khah

title: Psalm 36
sefariaRef: Psalms 36
useCase: Human wrongdoing and divine lovingkindness Themes: justice, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.

tokens.hebrew: נְאֻם־פֶּשַׁע לָרָשָׁע בְּקֶרֶב לִבִּי אֵין־פַּחַד אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגֶד עֵינָיו׃
tokens.translation: Transgression speaketh to the wicked, methinks— There is no fear of God before his eyes.
tokens.transliteration: ne-oom PEH-shah lah-rah-SHAH be-KEH-rehv lee-BEE eyn PAH-khahd eh-loh-HEEM le-NEH-gehd ey-NAHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הֶחֱלִיק אֵלָיו בְּעֵינָיו לִמְצֹא עֲוֺנוֹ לִשְׂנֹא׃
tokens.translation: For it flattereth him in his eyes, Until his iniquity be found, and he be hated.
tokens.transliteration: kee heh-kheh-LEEK eh-LAHV be-ey-NAHV leem-TSOH ah-voh-NOH lees-NOH

tokens.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי־פִיו אָוֶן וּמִרְמָה חָדַל לְהַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵיטִיב׃
tokens.translation: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit; He hath left off to be wise, to do good.
tokens.transliteration: deev-rey FEEV AH-vehn oo-meer-MAH khah-DAHL le-hahs-KEEL le-hey-TEEV

tokens.hebrew: אָוֶן יַחְשֹׁב עַל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ יִתְיַצֵּב עַל־דֶּרֶךְ לֹא־טוֹב רָע לֹא יִמְאָס׃
tokens.translation: He deviseth iniquity upon his bed; He setteth himself in a way that is not good; He abhorreth not evil.
tokens.transliteration: AH-vehn yahkh-SHOHV ahl meesh-kah-VOH yeet-yah-TSEHV ahl DEH-rehkh loh TOHV RAH LOH yeem-AHS

tokens.translation: Thy lovingkindness, O LORD, is in the heavens; Thy faithfulness reacheth unto the skies.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI be-hah-shah-MAH-yeem khahs-DEH-khah eh-moo-nah-te-KHAH ahd she-khah-KEEM

tokens.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ כְּהַרְרֵי־אֵל מִשְׁפָּטֶךָ תְּהוֹם רַבָּה אָדָם־וּבְהֵמָה תוֹשִׁיעַ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Thy righteousness is like the mighty mountains; Thy judgments are like the great deep; Man and beast Thou preservest, O LORD.
tokens.transliteration: tseed-kah-te-KHAH ke-hahr-rey EHL meesh-pah-teh-KHAH te-HOHM rah-BAH AH-dahm oo-ve-heh-MAH toh-SHEE-ah ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: מַה־יָּקָר חַסְדְּךָ אֱלֹהִים וּבְנֵי אָדָם בְּצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ יֶחֱסָיוּן׃
tokens.translation: How precious is Thy lovingkindness, O God! And the children of men take refuge in the shadow of Thy wings.
tokens.transliteration: mahh yah-KAHR khahs-de-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM oo-ve-NEY ah-DAHM be-TSEHL ke-nah-FEY-khah yeh-kheh-sah-YOON

tokens.hebrew: יִרְוְיֻן מִדֶּשֶׁן בֵּיתֶךָ וְנַחַל עֲדָנֶיךָ תַשְׁקֵם׃
tokens.translation: They are abundantly satisfied with the fatness of Thy house; And Thou makest them drink of the river of Thy pleasures.
tokens.transliteration: yeer-ve-YOON mee-DEH-shehn bey-TEH-khah ve-NAH-khahl ah-dah-NEY-khah tahsh-KEHM

tokens.translation: For with Thee is the fountain of life; In Thy light do we see light.
tokens.transliteration: kee ee-me-KHAH me-KOHR khah-YEEM be-oh-re-KHAH neer-eh OHR

tokens.translation: O continue Thy lovingkindness unto them that know Thee; And Thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
tokens.transliteration: me-SHOHKH khahs-de-KHAH le-yoh-de-EY-khah ve-tseed-kah-te-KHAH le-yeesh-rey LEHV

tokens.translation: Let not the foot of pride overtake me, And let not the hand of the wicked drive me away.
tokens.transliteration: ahl te-voh-eh-NEE REH-gehl gah-ah-VAH ve-yahd re-shah-EEM ahl te-nee-DEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: שָׁם נָפְלוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן דֹּחוּ וְלֹא־יָכְלוּ קוּם׃
tokens.translation: There are the workers of iniquity fallen; They are thrust down, and are not able to rise.
tokens.transliteration: SHAHM nah-fe-LOO POH-ah-ley AH-vehn doh-KHOO ve-loh YAH-khe-loo KOOM

title: Psalm 37
sefariaRef: Psalms 37
useCase: Patience, upright conduct, and provision Themes: provision, opportunity, wisdom, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד אַל־תִּתְחַר בַּמְּרֵעִים אַל־תְּקַנֵּא בְּעֹשֵׂי עַוְלָה׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Fret not thyself because of evil-doers, neither be thou envious against them that work unrighteousness.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED ahl teet-KHAHR bah-me-reh-EEM ahl te-kah-NEH be-oh-SEY ahv-LAH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כֶחָצִיר מְהֵרָה יִמָּלוּ וּכְיֶרֶק דֶּשֶׁא יִבּוֹלוּן׃
tokens.translation: For they shall soon wither like the grass, and fade as the green herb.
tokens.transliteration: KEE kheh-khah-TSEER me-heh-RAH yee-MAH-loo oo-khe-YEH-rehk deh-SHEH yee-boh-LOON

tokens.hebrew: בְּטַח בַּיהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־טוֹב שְׁכָן־אֶרֶץ וּרְעֵה אֱמוּנָה׃
tokens.translation: Trust in the LORD, and do good; dwell in the land, and cherish faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration: be-TAHKH bah-ah-doh-NAI vah-ah-seh TOHV she-khahn eh-REHTS oo-re-EH eh-moo-NAH

tokens.translation: So shalt thou delight thyself in the LORD; and He shall give thee the petitions of thy heart.
tokens.transliteration: ve-heet-ah-NAHG ahl ah-doh-NAI ve-yee-tehn le-KHAH meesh-ah-LOHT lee-BEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: גּוֹל עַל־יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ וּבְטַח עָלָיו וְהוּא יַעֲשֶׂה׃
tokens.translation: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in Him, and He will bring it to pass.
tokens.transliteration: GOHL ahl ah-doh-NAI dahr-KEH-khah oo-ve-TAHKH ah-LAHV ve-HOO yah-ah-SEH

tokens.translation: And He will make thy righteousness to go forth as the light, and thy right as the noonday.

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹם לַיהוָה וְהִתְחוֹלֵל לוֹ אַל־תִּתְחַר בְּמַצְלִיחַ דַּרְכּוֹ בְּאִישׁ עֹשֶׂה מְזִמּוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Resign thyself unto the LORD, and wait patiently for Him; fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
tokens.transliteration: DOHM lah-ah-doh-NAI ve-heet-KHOH-LEHL LOH ahl teet-KHAHR be-mahts-LEE-ahkh dahr-KOH be-EESH oh-SEH me-zee-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: הֶרֶף מֵאַף וַעֲזֹב חֵמָה אַל־תִּתְחַר אַךְ־לְהָרֵעַ׃
tokens.translation: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath; fret not thyself, it tendeth only to evil-doing.
tokens.transliteration: HEH-rehf meh-AHF vah-ah-ZOHV kheh-MAH ahl teet-KHAHR ahkh le-hah-REH-ah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־מְרֵעִים יִכָּרֵתוּן וְקֹוֵי יְהוָה הֵמָּה יִירְשׁוּ־אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: For evil-doers shall be cut off; but those that wait for the LORD, they shall inherit the land.
tokens.transliteration: kee me-reh-EEM yee-kah-reh-TOON ve-koh-VEY ah-doh-NAI HEH-mah yee-re-shoo AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: וְעוֹד מְעַט וְאֵין רָשָׁע וְהִתְבּוֹנַנְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: And yet a little while, and the wicked is no more; yea, thou shalt look well at his place, and he is not.
tokens.transliteration: ve-OHD me-AHT ve-EYN rah-SHAH ve-heet-boh-NAHN-tah ahl me-koh-MOH ve-ey-NEH-noo

tokens.translation: But the humble shall inherit the land, and delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-nah-VEEM yee-re-shoo AH-rehts ve-heet-ah-ne-GOO ahl ROHV shah-LOHM

tokens.hebrew: זֹמֵם רָשָׁע לַצַּדִּיק וְחֹרֵק עָלָיו שִׁנָּיו׃
tokens.translation: The wicked plotteth against the righteous, and gnasheth at him with his teeth.
tokens.transliteration: zoh-MEHM rah-SHAH lah-tsah-DEEK ve-khoh-REHK ah-LAHV shee-NAHV

tokens.translation: The Lord doth laugh at him; for He seeth that his day is coming.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAHY yees-khahk LOH kee rah-AH kee yah-VOH yoh-MOH

tokens.hebrew: חֶרֶב פָּתְחוּ רְשָׁעִים וְדָרְכוּ קַשְׁתָּם לְהַפִּיל עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן לִטְבוֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָרֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow; to cast down the poor and needy, to slay such as are upright in the way;
tokens.transliteration: KHEH-rehv pah-te-KHOO re-shah-EEM ve-dah-re-KHOO kahsh-TAHM le-hah-PEEL ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN leet-VOH-ahkh yeesh-rey DAH-rehkh

tokens.translation: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
Better is a little that the righteous hath than the abundance of many wicked.
tokens.transliteration: tohv me-AHT lah-tsah-DEEK meh-hah-MOHN re-shah-EEM rah-BEEM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי זְרוֹעוֹת רְשָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַרְנָה וְסוֹמֵךְ צַדִּיקִים יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken; but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ze-roh-OHT re-shah-EEM tee-shah-VAHR-nah ve-soh-MEHKH tsah-dee-KEEM ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדֵעַ יְהוָה יְמֵי תְמִימִם וְנַחֲלָתָם לְעוֹלָם תִּהְיֶה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD knoweth the days of them that are wholehearted; and their inheritance shall be for ever.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DEH-ah ah-doh-NAI ye-MEY te-mee-MEEM ve-nah-khah-lah-TAHM le-oh-LAHM teeh-YEH

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ בְּעֵת רָעָה וּבִימֵי רְעָבוֹן יִשְׂבָּעוּ׃
tokens.translation: They shall not be ashamed in the time of evil; and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
tokens.transliteration: loh yeh-voh-SHOO be-EHT rah-AH oo-vee-MEY re-ah-VOHN yees-BAH-oo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי רְשָׁעִים יֹאבֵדוּ וְאֹיְבֵי יְהוָה כִּיקַר כָּרִים כָּלוּ בֶעָשָׁן כָּלוּ׃
tokens.translation: For the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD shall be as the fat of lambs— They shall pass away in smoke, they shall pass away.
tokens.transliteration: KEE re-shah-EEM yoh-VEH-doo ve-oh-ye-VEY ah-doh-NAI kee-KAHR kah-REEM kah-LOO veh-ah-SHAHN KAH-loo

tokens.hebrew: לֹוֶה רָשָׁע וְלֹא יְשַׁלֵּם וְצַדִּיק חוֹנֵן וְנוֹתֵן׃
tokens.translation: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not; but the righteous dealeth graciously, and giveth.
tokens.transliteration: loh-VEH rah-SHAH ve-LOH ye-shah-LEHM ve-tsah-DEEK khoh-NEHN ve-noh-TEHN

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מְבֹרָכָיו יִירְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּמְקֻלָּלָיו יִכָּרֵתוּ׃
tokens.translation: For such as are blessed of Him shall inherit the land; and they that are cursed of Him shall be cut off.
tokens.transliteration: KEE me-voh-rah-KHAHV YEE-re-shoo AH-rehts oo-me-koo-lah-LAHV yee-kah-REH-too

tokens.translation: It is of the LORD that a man's goings are established; and He delighted in his way.
tokens.transliteration: meh-ah-doh-NAI mee-tse-ah-dey GEH-vehr koh-NAH-noo ve-dahr-KOH yehkh-PAHTS

tokens.translation: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down; for the LORD upholdeth his hand.
tokens.transliteration: kee yee-POHL loh yoo-TAHL kee ah-doh-NAI soh-MEHKH yah-DOH

tokens.hebrew: נַעַר הָיִיתִי גַּם־זָקַנְתִּי וְלֹא־רָאִיתִי צַדִּיק נֶעֱזָב וְזַרְעוֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָחֶם׃
tokens.translation: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
tokens.transliteration: NAH-ahr hah-YEE-tee gahm zah-KAHN-tee ve-loh rah-ee-TEE tsah-DEEK neh-eh-ZAHV ve-zahr-OH me-vah-kehsh LAH-khehm

tokens.translation: All the day long he dealeth graciously, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
tokens.transliteration: kohl hah-YOHM khoh-NEHN oo-mahl-VEH ve-zahr-OH leev-rah-KHAH

tokens.translation: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
tokens.transliteration: SOOR meh-RAH vah-ah-seh TOHV oo-she-KHOHN le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי יְהוָה אֹהֵב מִשְׁפָּט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹב אֶת־חֲסִידָיו לְעוֹלָם נִשְׁמָרוּ וְזֶרַע רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָת׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD loveth justice, And forsaketh not His saints; they are preserved for ever; but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ah-doh-NAI oh-HEHV meesh-PAHT ve-loh yah-ah-ZOHV eht khah-see-DAHV le-oh-LAHM neesh-MAH-roo ve-ZEH-rah re-shah-EEM neekh-RAHT

tokens.translation: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
tokens.transliteration: tsah-dee-KEEM yee-re-shoo AH-rehts ve-yeesh-ke-NOO lah-AHD ah-LEY-hah

tokens.hebrew: פִּי־צַדִּיק יֶהְגֶּה חָכְמָה וּלְשׁוֹנוֹ תְּדַבֵּר מִשְׁפָּט׃
tokens.translation: The mouth of the righteous uttereth wisdom, and his tongue speaketh justice.
tokens.transliteration: pee tsah-DEEK yeh-GEH khohkh-MAH oo-le-shoh-NOH te-dah-BEHR meesh-PAHT

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹרַת אֱלֹהָיו בְּלִבּוֹ לֹא תִמְעַד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃
tokens.translation: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps slide.
tokens.transliteration: toh-RAHT eh-loh-HAHV be-lee-BOH LOH teem-AHD ah-shoo-rahv

tokens.translation: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶנּוּ בְיָדוֹ וְלֹא יַרְשִׁיעֶנּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor suffer him to be condemned when he is judged.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI loh yah-ahz-VEH-noo ve-yah-DOH ve-LOH yahr-shee-EH-noo be-hee-shah-fe-TOH

tokens.hebrew: קַוֵּה אֶל־יְהוָה וּשְׁמֹר דַּרְכּוֹ וִירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶשֶׁת אָרֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
tokens.translation: Wait for the LORD, and keep His way, and He will exalt thee to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
tokens.transliteration: kah-VEH ehl ah-doh-NAI oo-she-MOHR dahr-KOH vee-roh-meem-KHAH lah-REH-sheht AH-rehts be-hee-kah-REHT re-shah-EEM teer-EH

tokens.hebrew: רָאִיתִי רָשָׁע עָרִיץ וּמִתְעָרֶה כְּאֶזְרָח רַעֲנָן׃
tokens.translation: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a leafy tree in its native soil.
tokens.transliteration: rah-ee-TEE rah-SHAH ah-REETS oo-meet-ah-REH ke-ehz-RAHKH rah-ah-NAHN

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵינֶנּוּ וָאֲבַקְשֵׁהוּ וְלֹא נִמְצָא׃
tokens.translation: But one passed by, and, lo, he was not; yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-ah-VOHR ve-hee-NEH ey-NEH-noo vah-ah-vahk-SHEH-hoo ve-LOH neem-TSAH

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמָר־תָּם וּרְאֵה יָשָׁר כִּי־אַחֲרִית לְאִישׁ שָׁלוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Mark the man of integrity, and behold the upright; for there is a future for the man of peace.
tokens.transliteration: she-mohr TAHM oo-re-EH yah-SHAHR kee ah-khah-REET le-EESH shah-LOHM

tokens.hebrew: וּפֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְדוּ יַחְדָּו אַחֲרִית רְשָׁעִים נִכְרָתָה׃
tokens.translation: But transgressors shall be destroyed together; the future of the wicked shall be cut off.
tokens.transliteration: oo-foh-she-EEM neesh-me-DOO yahkh-DAHV ah-khah-REET re-shah-EEM neekh-RAH-tah

tokens.hebrew: וּתְשׁוּעַת צַדִּיקִים מֵיְהוָה מָעוּזָּם בְּעֵת צָרָה׃
tokens.translation: But the salvation of the righteous is of the LORD; He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
tokens.transliteration: oo-te-shoo-AHT tsah-dee-KEEM meh-ah-doh-NAI mah-oo-ZAHM be-EHT tsah-RAH

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּעְזְרֵם יְהוָה וַיְפַלְּטֵם יְפַלְּטֵם מֵרְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם כִּי־חָסוּ בוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And the LORD helpeth them, and delivereth them; He delivereth them from the wicked, and saveth them, because they have taken refuge in Him.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-ze-REHM ah-doh-NAI vah-ye-fah-le-TEHM ye-fah-le-TEHM meh-re-shah-EEM ve-yoh-shee-EHM kee KHAH-soo VOH
