title: Psalm 38
sefariaRef: Psalms 38
summary: Affliction, guilt, and a plea for help
useCase: Affliction, guilt, and a plea for help Themes: health, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm of David, to make memorial.
O LORD, rebuke me not in Thine anger; neither chasten me in Thy wrath.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ahl be-kehts-pe-KHAH toh-khee-KHEH-nee oo-vah-khah-mah-te-KHAH te-yah-se-REH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־חִצֶּיךָ נִחֲתוּ בִי וַתִּנְחַת עָלַי יָדֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thine arrows are gone deep into me, and Thy hand is come down upon me.
tokens.transliteration: kee khee-tseh-KHAH NEE-khah-too VEE vah-teen-KHAHT ah-LAHY yah-DEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אֵין־מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי מִפְּנֵי זַעְמֶךָ אֵין־שָׁלוֹם בַּעֲצָמַי מִפְּנֵי חַטָּאתִי׃
tokens.translation: There is no soundness in my flesh because of Thine indignation; neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
tokens.transliteration: eyn me-TOHM beev-sah-REE mee-pe-NEY zah-MEH-khah eyn shah-LOHM bah-ah-tsah-MAHY mee-pe-NEY khah-tah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּי עֲוֺנֹתַי עָבְרוּ רֹאשִׁי כְּמַשָּׂא כָבֵד יִכְבְּדוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: For mine iniquities are gone over my head; as a heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ah-voh-noh-TAHY ah-ve-ROO roh-SHEE ke-mah-SAH khah-VEHD yeekh-be-DOO mee-MEH-nee

tokens.translation: My wounds are noisome, they fester, because of my foolishness.

tokens.hebrew: נַעֲוֵיתִי שַׁחֹתִי עַד־מְאֹד כָּל־הַיּוֹם קֹדֵר הִלָּכְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: I am bent and bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day.
tokens.transliteration: nah-ah-VEY-tee shah-KHOH-tee ahd me-OHD kohl hah-YOHM koh-DEHR hee-LAH-khe-tee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־כְסָלַי מָלְאוּ נִקְלֶה וְאֵין מְתֹם בִּבְשָׂרִי׃
tokens.translation: For my loins are filled with burning; and there is no soundness in my flesh.
tokens.transliteration: kee khe-sah-LAHY mah-le-OO neek-LEH ve-EYN me-TOHM beev-sah-REE

tokens.hebrew: נְפוּגוֹתִי וְנִדְכֵּיתִי עַד־מְאֹד שָׁאַגְתִּי מִנַּהֲמַת לִבִּי׃
tokens.translation: I am benumbed and sore crushed; I groan by reason of the moaning of my heart.
tokens.transliteration: ne-foo-GOH-tee ve-need-KEY-tee ahd me-OHD shah-AHG-tee mee-nah-hah-MAHT lee-BEE

tokens.hebrew: אֲ‍דֹנָי נֶגְדְּךָ כָל־תַּאֲוָתִי וְאַנְחָתִי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִסְתָּרָה׃
tokens.translation: Lord, all my desire is before Thee; and my sighing is not hid from Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-nahy nehg-de-KHAH khohl tah-ah-vah-TEE ve-ahn-khah-TEE mee-me-KHAH loh nees-TAH-rah

tokens.hebrew: לִבִּי סְחַרְחַר עֲזָבַנִי כֹחִי וְאוֹר־עֵינַי גַּם־הֵם אֵין אִתִּי׃
tokens.translation: My heart fluttereth, my strength faileth me; as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
tokens.transliteration: lee-BEE se-khahr-KHAHR ah-zah-VAH-nee khoh-KHEE ve-ohr ey-NAHY gahm HEHM EYN ee-TEE

tokens.hebrew: אֹהֲבַי וְרֵעַי מִנֶּגֶד נִגְעִי יַעֲמֹדוּ וּקְרוֹבַי מֵרָחֹק עָמָדוּ׃
tokens.translation: My friends and my companions stand aloof from my plague; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
tokens.transliteration: oh-hah-VAHY ve-reh-AHY mee-NEH-gehd neeg-EE yah-ah-MOH-doo oo-ke-roh-VAHY meh-rah-KHOHK ah-MAH-doo

tokens.hebrew: וַיְנַקְשׁוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי וְדֹרְשֵׁי רָעָתִי דִּבְּרוּ הַוּוֹת וּמִרְמוֹת כָּל־הַיּוֹם יֶהְגּוּ׃
tokens.translation: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me; and they that seek my hurt speak crafty devices, and utter deceits all the day.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-nahk-SHOO me-vahk-SHEY nahf-SHEE ve-doh-re-SHEY rah-ah-TEE dee-be-ROO hah-VOHT oo-meer-MOHT kohl hah-YOHM yeh-GOO

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כְחֵרֵשׁ לֹא אֶשְׁמָע וּכְאִלֵּם לֹא יִפְתַּח־פִּיו׃
tokens.translation: But I am as a deaf man, I hear not; and I am as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE khe-kheh-REHSH LOH ehsh-MAH oo-khe-ee-LEHM LOH yeef-tahkh PEEV

tokens.hebrew: וָאֱהִי כְּאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־שֹׁמֵעַ וְאֵין בְּפִיו תּוֹכָחוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Yea, I am become as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no arguments.
tokens.transliteration: vah-eh-HEE ke-EESH ah-SHEHR loh shoh-MEH-ah ve-EYN be-FEEV toh-khah-KHOHT

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־לְךָ יְהוָה הוֹחָלְתִּי אַתָּה תַעֲנֶה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהָי׃
tokens.translation: For in Thee, O LORD, do I hope; Thou wilt answer, O Lord my God.
tokens.transliteration: kee le-KHAH ah-doh-NAI hoh-KHAH-le-tee ah-TAH tah-ah-NEH ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HAHY

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי פֶּן־יִשְׂמְחוּ־לִי בְּמוֹט רַגְלִי עָלַי הִגְדִּילוּ׃
tokens.translation: For I said: 'Lest they rejoice over me; when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.'
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-mahr-TEE pehn yees-me-khoo LEE be-MOHT rahg-LEE ah-LAHY heeg-DEE-loo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אֲנִי לְצֶלַע נָכוֹן וּמַכְאוֹבִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
tokens.translation: For I am ready to halt, and my pain is continually before me.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-NEE le-TSEH-lah nah-KHOHN oo-mahkh-oh-VEE nehg-DEE tah-MEED

tokens.translation: For I do declare mine iniquity; I am full of care because of my sin.

tokens.hebrew: וְאֹיְבַי חַיִּים עָצֵמוּ וְרַבּוּ שֹׂנְאַי שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: But mine enemies are strong in health; and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
tokens.transliteration: ve-oh-ye-VAHY khah-YEEM ah-TSEH-moo ve-rah-BOO soh-ne-AHY SHAH-kehr

tokens.hebrew: וּמְשַׁלְּמֵי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה יִשְׂטְנוּנִי תַּחַת רדופי־[רָדְפִי־] טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: They also that repay evil for good are adversaries unto me, because I follow the thing that is good.
tokens.transliteration: oo-me-shah-le-MEY rah-AH TAH-khaht toh-VAH yees-te-NOO-nee TAH-khaht rah-de-fee TOHV

tokens.translation: Forsake me not, O LORD; O my God, be not far from me.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tah-ahz-VEH-nee ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HAHY ahl teer-KHAHK mee-MEH-nee

tokens.translation: Make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.

title: Psalm 39
sefariaRef: Psalms 39
summary: Human frailty and the brevity of life
useCase: Human frailty and the brevity of life Themes: grief, wellness, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader, for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי אֶשְׁמְרָה לְפִי מַחְסוֹם בְּעֹד רָשָׁע לְנֶגְדִּי׃
tokens.translation: I said: 'I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue; I will keep a curb upon my mouth, while the wicked is before me.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR-tee eh-she-me-RAH de-rah-KHAHY meh-khah-TOH veel-shoh-NEE ehsh-me-RAH le-FEE mahkh-SOHM be-OHD rah-SHAH le-nehg-DEE

tokens.hebrew: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי דוּמִיָּה הֶחֱשֵׁיתִי מִטּוֹב וּכְאֵבִי נֶעְכָּר׃
tokens.translation: I was dumb with silence; I held my peace, had no comfort; and my pain was held in check.
tokens.transliteration: neh-eh-LAHM-tee doo-mee-YAH heh-kheh-SHEY-tee mee-TOHV oo-khe-eh-VEE neh-KAHR

tokens.hebrew: חַם־לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי בַּהֲגִיגִי תִבְעַר־אֵשׁ דִּבַּרְתִּי בִּלְשׁוֹנִי׃
tokens.translation: My heart waxed hot within me; while I was musing, the fire kindled; Then spoke I with my tongue:
tokens.transliteration: khahm lee-BEE be-keer-BEE bah-hah-gee-GEE teev-ahr EHSH dee-BAHR-tee beel-SHOH-nee

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדִיעֵנִי יְהוָה קִצִּי וּמִדַּת יָמַי מַה־הִיא אֵדְעָה מֶה־חָדֵל אָנִי׃
tokens.translation: 'LORD, make me to know mine end, And the measure of my days, what it is; Let me know how short-lived I am.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-dee-EH-nee ah-doh-NAI kee-TSEE oo-mee-DAHT yah-MAHY mahh HEE eh-de-AH meh khah-DEHL AH-nee

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה טְפָחוֹת נָתַתָּה יָמַי וְחֶלְדִּי כְאַיִן נֶגְדֶּךָ אַךְ כָּל־הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם נִצָּב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Behold, Thou hast made my days as hand-breadths; and mine age is as nothing before Thee; surely every man at his best estate is altogether vanity. Selah
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH te-fah-KHOHT nah-TAH-tah yah-MAHY ve-khehl-DEE khe-AH-yeen nehg-DEH-khah AHKH kahl HEH-vehl kohl ah-DAHM nee-TSAHV SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּצֶלֶם יִתְהַלֶּךְ־אִישׁ אַךְ־הֶבֶל יֶהֱמָיוּן יִצְבֹּר וְלֹא־יֵדַע מִי־אֹסְפָם׃
tokens.translation: Surely man walketh as a mere semblance; surely for vanity they are in turmoil; He heapeth up riches, and knoweth not who shall gather them.
tokens.transliteration: ahkh be-TSEH-lehm yee-te-hah-lehkh EESH ahkh HEH-vehl yeh-heh-mah-YOON yeets-BOHR ve-loh yeh-DAH mee oh-se-FAHM

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה מַה־קִּוִּיתִי אֲדֹנָי תּוֹחַלְתִּי לְךָ הִיא׃
tokens.translation: And now, Lord, what wait I for? My hope, it is in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH mahh kee-VEE-tee ah-doh-NAHY toh-khahl-TEE le-KHAH HEE

tokens.translation: Deliver me from all my transgressions; make me not the reproach of the base.
tokens.transliteration: mee-kohl pe-shah-AHY hah-tsee-LEH-nee khehr-PAHT nah-VAHL ahl te-see-MEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: נֶאֱלַמְתִּי לֹא אֶפְתַּח־פִּי כִּי אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃
tokens.translation: I am dumb, I open not my mouth; because Thou hast done it.
tokens.transliteration: neh-eh-lahm-TEE LOH ehf-tahkh PEE KEE ah-TAH ah-SEE-tah

tokens.hebrew: הָסֵר מֵעָלַי נִגְעֶךָ מִתִּגְרַת יָדְךָ אֲנִי כָלִיתִי׃
tokens.translation: Remove Thy stroke from off me; I am consumed by the blow of Thy hand.
tokens.transliteration: hah-SEHR meh-ah-LAHY neeg-EH-khah mee-teeg-RAHT yah-de-KHAH ah-NEE khah-LEE-tee

tokens.hebrew: בְּתוֹכָחוֹת עַל־עָוֺן יִסַּרְתָּ אִישׁ וַתֶּמֶס כָּעָשׁ חֲמוּדוֹ אַךְ הֶבֶל כָּל־אָדָם סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: With rebukes dost Thou chasten man for iniquity, and like a moth Thou makest his beauty to consume away; surely every man is vanity. Selah
tokens.transliteration: be-toh-khah-KHOHT ahl ah-VOHN yee-SAHR-tah EESH vah-TEH-mehs kah-AHSH khah-moo-DOH AHKH HEH-vehl kohl ah-DAHM SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה־תְפִלָּתִי יְהוָה וְשַׁוְעָתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־דִּמְעָתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ כִּי גֵר אָנֹכִי עִמָּךְ תּוֹשָׁב כְּכָל־אֲבוֹתָי׃
tokens.translation: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; keep not silence at my tears; for I am a stranger with Thee, a sojourner, as all my fathers were.
tokens.transliteration: shee-me-AH te-fee-lah-TEE ah-doh-NAI ve-shahv-ah-TEE hah-ah-zee-NAH ehl deem-ah-TEE ahl teh-kheh-RAHSH KEE GEHR ah-noh-KHEE ee-MAHKH toh-SHAHV ke-khohl ah-voh-TAHY

tokens.hebrew: הָשַׁע מִמֶּנִּי וְאַבְלִיגָה בְּטֶרֶם אֵלֵךְ וְאֵינֶנִּי׃
tokens.translation: Look away from me, that I may take comfort, before I go hence, and be no more.'
tokens.transliteration: hah-SHAH mee-MEH-nee ve-ahv-LEE-gah be-TEH-rehm eh-LEHKH ve-ey-NEH-nee

title: Psalm 40
sefariaRef: Psalms 40
useCase: Rescue, willingness, and renewed need Themes: gratitude, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: קַוֺּה קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה וַיֵּט אֵלַי וַיִּשְׁמַע שַׁוְעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: I waited patiently for the LORD; and He inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
tokens.transliteration: kah-VOHH kee-VEE-tee ah-doh-NAI vah-YEHT eh-LAHY vah-yeesh-MAH shahv-ah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּעֲלֵנִי מִבּוֹר שָׁאוֹן מִטִּיט הַיָּוֵן וַיָּקֶם עַל־סֶלַע רַגְלַי כּוֹנֵן אֲשֻׁרָי׃
tokens.translation: He brought me up also out of the tumultuous pit, out of the miry clay; and He set my feet upon a rock, He established my goings.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-ah-LEH-nee mee-BOHR shah-OHN mee-TEET hah-yah-VEHN vah-YAH-kehm ahl SEH-lah rahg-LAHY koh-NEHN ah-shoo-RAHY

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן בְּפִי שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּה לֵאלֹהֵינוּ יִרְאוּ רַבִּים וְיִירָאוּ וְיִבְטְחוּ בַּיהוָה׃
tokens.translation: And He hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God; many shall see, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TEHN be-FEE SHEER khah-DAHSH te-hee-LAH leh-loh-HEY-noo yeer-OO rah-BEEM ve-yee-RAH-oo ve-yeev-te-KHOO bah-ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם יְהֹוָה מִבְטַחוֹ וְלֹא־פָנָה אֶל־רְהָבִים וְשָׂטֵי כָזָב׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the man that hath made the LORD his trust, and hath not turned unto the arrogant, nor unto such as fall away treacherously.
tokens.transliteration: AHSH-rey hah-GEH-vehr ah-shehr SAHM ah-doh-NAI meev-tah-KHOH ve-loh fah-NAH ehl re-hah-VEEM ve-sah-TEY khah-ZAHV

tokens.hebrew: רַבּוֹת עָשִׂיתָ אַתָּה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי נִפְלְאֹתֶיךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ אֵלֵינוּ אֵין עֲרֹךְ אֵלֶיךָ אַגִּידָה וַאֲדַבֵּרָה עָצְמוּ מִסַּפֵּר׃
tokens.translation: Many things hast Thou done, O LORD my God, even Thy wonderful works, and Thy thoughts toward us; there is none to be compared unto Thee! If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be told.
tokens.transliteration: rah-BOHT ah-SEE-tah ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HAHY nee-fe-le-oh-TEY-khah oo-mahkh-she-voh-TEY-khah eh-LEY-noo EYN ah-ROHKH eh-LEY-khah ah-GEE-dah vah-ah-dah-BEH-rah ah-tse-MOO mee-sah-PEHR

tokens.hebrew: זֶבַח וּמִנְחָה לֹא־חָפַצְתָּ אָזְנַיִם כָּרִיתָ לִּי עוֹלָה וַחֲטָאָה לֹא שָׁאָלְתָּ׃
tokens.translation: Sacrifice and meal-offering Thou hast no delight in; mine ears hast Thou opened; burnt-offering and sin-offering hast Thou not required.
tokens.transliteration: ZEH-vahkh oo-meen-KHAH loh khah-FAHTS-tah ohz-nah-YEEM kah-REE-tah LEE oh-LAH vah-khah-tah-AH LOH shah-AH-le-tah

tokens.hebrew: אָז אָמַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָאתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵפֶר כָּתוּב עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: Then said I: 'Lo, I am come with the roll of a book which is prescribed for me;
tokens.transliteration: AHZ ah-mahr-TEE hee-neh VAH-tee beem-gee-laht seh-FEHR kah-TOOV ah-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: לַעֲשׂוֹת־רְצוֹנְךָ אֱלֹהַי חָפָצְתִּי וְתוֹרָתְךָ בְּתוֹךְ מֵעָי׃
tokens.translation: I delight to do Thy will, O my God; yea, Thy law is in my inmost parts.'
tokens.transliteration: lah-ah-soht re-tsoh-ne-KHAH eh-loh-HAHY khah-FAH-tse-tee ve-TOH-rah-te-KHAH be-TOHKH meh-AHY

tokens.hebrew: בִּשַּׂרְתִּי צֶדֶק בְּקָהָל רָב הִנֵּה שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֶכְלָא יְהוָה אַתָּה יָדָעְתָּ׃
tokens.translation: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation, Lo, I did not refrain my lips; O LORD, Thou knowest.
tokens.transliteration: bee-SAHR-tee TSEH-dehk be-kah-HAHL RAHV hee-NEH se-fah-TAHY LOH ehkh-LAH ah-doh-NAI ah-TAH yah-DAH-e-tah

tokens.hebrew: צִדְקָתְךָ לֹא־כִסִּיתִי בְּתוֹךְ לִבִּי אֱמוּנָתְךָ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ אָמָרְתִּי לֹא־כִחַדְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ לְקָהָל רָב׃
tokens.translation: I have not hid Thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared Thy faithfulness and Thy salvation; I have not concealed Thy mercy and Thy truth from the great congregation.
tokens.transliteration: tseed-kah-te-KHAH loh khee-SEE-tee be-TOHKH lee-BEE eh-moo-nah-te-KHAH oo-te-shoo-ah-te-KHAH ah-MAH-re-tee loh khee-KHAHD-tee khahs-de-KHAH vah-ah-mee-te-KHAH le-kah-HAHL RAHV

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה יְהוָה לֹא־תִכְלָא רַחֲמֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי חַסְדְּךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ תָּמִיד יִצְּרוּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Thou, O LORD, wilt not withhold Thy compassions from me; let Thy mercy and Thy truth continually preserve me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI loh teekh-LAH rah-khah-MEY-khah mee-MEH-nee khahs-de-KHAH vah-ah-mee-te-KHAH tah-MEED yee-tse-ROO-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אָפְפוּ־עָלַי רָעוֹת עַד־אֵין מִסְפָּר הִשִּׂיגוּנִי עֲוֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹלְתִּי לִרְאוֹת עָצְמוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי וְלִבִּי עֲזָבָנִי׃
tokens.translation: For innumerable evils have compassed me about, mine iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart hath failed me.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ah-fe-FOO ah-LAHY rah-OHT ahd EYN mees-PAHR hee-see-GOO-nee ah-voh-noh-TAHY ve-loh yah-KHOH-le-tee leer-OHT ah-tse-MOO mee-sah-ah-ROHT roh-SHEE ve-lee-BEE ah-zah-VAH-nee

tokens.hebrew: רְצֵה יְהוָה לְהַצִּילֵנִי יְהוָה לְעֶזְרָתִי חוּשָׁה׃
tokens.translation: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; O LORD, make haste to help me.
tokens.transliteration: re-TSEH ah-doh-NAI le-hah-tsee-LEH-nee ah-doh-NAI le-ehz-RAH-tee KHOO-shah

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ יַחַד מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי לִסְפּוֹתָהּ יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Let them be ashamed and abashed together that seek after my soul to sweep it away; let them be turned backward and brought to confusion that delight in my hurt.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-VOH-shoo ve-yahkh-pe-ROO yah-KHAHD me-vahk-SHEY nahf-SHEE lees-poh-TAHH yee-SOH-goo ah-KHOHR ve-yee-kah-le-MOO khah-feh-TSEY rah-ah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: יָשֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים לִי הֶאָח הֶאָח׃
tokens.translation: Let them be appalled by reason of their shame that say unto me: 'Aha, aha.'
tokens.transliteration: yah-shoh-MOO ahl EH-kehv bohsh-TAHM hah-oh-me-REEM LEE heh-AHKH heh-AHKH

tokens.hebrew: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ יֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל יְהוָה אֹהֲבֵי תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'The LORD be magnified.'
tokens.transliteration: yah-SEE-soo ve-yees-me-KHOO be-KHAH kahl me-vahk-SHEY-khah yoh-me-ROO tah-MEED yeeg-DAHL ah-doh-NAI oh-hah-VEY te-shoo-ah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֲדֹנָי יַחֲשָׁב לִי עֶזְרָתִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי אַל־תְּאַחַר׃
tokens.translation: But, as for me, that am poor and needy, the Lord will account it unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O my God, tarry not.

title: Psalm 41
sefariaRef: Psalms 41
summary: Care for the vulnerable and sickness
useCase: Care for the vulnerable and sickness Themes: health, caregiving. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי מַשְׂכִּיל אֶל־דָּל בְּיוֹם רָעָה יְמַלְּטֵהוּ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Happy is he that considereth the poor; the LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY mahs-KEEL ehl DAHL be-YOHM rah-AH ye-mah-le-TEH-hoo ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה יִשְׁמְרֵהוּ וִיחַיֵּהוּ יאשר [וְאֻשַּׁר] בָּאָרֶץ וְאַל־תִּתְּנֵהוּ בְּנֶפֶשׁ אֹיְבָיו׃
tokens.translation: The LORD preserve him, and keep him alive, let him be called happy in the land; and deliver not Thou him unto the greed of his enemies.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI yeesh-me-REH-hoo vee-khah-yeh-HOO ve-oo-SHAHR bah-AH-rehts ve-ahl tee-te-NEH-hoo be-NEH-fehsh oh-ye-VAHV

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה יִסְעָדֶנּוּ עַל־עֶרֶשׂ דְּוָי כָּל־מִשְׁכָּבוֹ הָפַכְתָּ בְחָלְיוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD support him upon the bed of illness; mayest Thou turn all his lying down in his sickness.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI yees-ah-deh-NOO ahl EH-rehs de-VAHY kohl meesh-kah-VOH hah-FAHKH-tah ve-khohl-YOH

tokens.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי רְפָאָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָטָאתִי לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: As for me, I said: 'O LORD, be gracious unto me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against Thee.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-nee ah-mahr-TEE ah-doh-NAI khoh-NEH-nee re-fah-AH nahf-SHEE kee khah-TAH-tee LAHKH

tokens.hebrew: אוֹיְבַי יֹאמְרוּ רַע לִי מָתַי יָמוּת וְאָבַד שְׁמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Mine enemies speak evil of me: 'When shall he die, and his name perish?'
tokens.transliteration: oh-ye-VAHY yoh-me-ROO RAH LEE mah-TAHY yah-MOOT ve-ah-VAHD she-MOH

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם־בָּא לִרְאוֹת שָׁוְא יְדַבֵּר לִבּוֹ יִקְבָּץ־אָוֶן לוֹ יֵצֵא לַחוּץ יְדַבֵּר׃
tokens.translation: And if one come to see me, he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he speaketh of it.
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem BAH leer-OHT SHAHV ye-dah-BEHR lee-BOH yeek-bahts AH-vehn LOH yeh-TSEH lah-KHOOTS ye-dah-BEHR

tokens.hebrew: יַחַד עָלַי יִתְלַחֲשׁוּ כָּל־שֹׂנְאָי עָלַי יַחְשְׁבוּ רָעָה לִי׃
tokens.translation: All that hate me whisper together against me, against me do they devise my hurt:
tokens.transliteration: YAH-khahd ah-LAHY yeet-lah-khah-SHOO kohl soh-ne-AHY ah-LAHY yahkh-she-VOO rah-AH LEE

tokens.hebrew: דְּבַר־בְּלִיַּעַל יָצוּק בּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר שָׁכַב לֹא־יוֹסִיף לָקוּם׃
tokens.translation: 'An evil thing cleaveth fast unto him; and now that he lieth, he shall rise up no more.'
tokens.transliteration: de-vahr be-lee-yah-AHL yah-TSOOK BOH vah-ah-SHEHR shah-KHAHV loh yoh-SEEF lah-KOOM

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־אִישׁ שְׁלוֹמִי אֲשֶׁר־בָּטַחְתִּי בוֹ אוֹכֵל לַחְמִי הִגְדִּיל עָלַי עָקֵב׃
tokens.translation: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.
tokens.transliteration: gahm EESH she-loh-MEE ah-shehr bah-TAHKH-tee VOH oh-KHEHL lahkh-MEE heeg-DEEL ah-LAHY ah-KEHV

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה חָנֵּנִי וַהֲקִימֵנִי וַאֲשַׁלְּמָה לָהֶם׃
tokens.translation: But Thou, O LORD, be gracious unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI khoh-NEH-nee vah-hah-kee-MEH-nee vah-ah-shah-le-MAH lah-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: בְּזֹאת יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־חָפַצְתָּ בִּי כִּי לֹא־יָרִיעַ אֹיְבִי עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: By this I know that Thou delightest in me, that mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
tokens.transliteration: be-ZOHT yah-dah-TEE kee khah-FAHTS-tah BEE KEE loh yah-REE-ah oh-ye-VEE ah-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בְּתֻמִּי תָּמַכְתָּ בִּי וַתַּצִּיבֵנִי לְפָנֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: And as for me, Thou upholdest me because of mine integrity, and settest me before Thy face for ever.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE be-too-MEE tah-MAHKH-tah BEE vah-tah-tsee-VEH-nee le-fah-NEY-khah le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מֵהָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ROOKH ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY yees-rah-EHL meh-hah-oh-LAHM ve-AHD hah-oh-LAHM ah-MEHN ve-ah-MEHN

title: Psalm 42
sefariaRef: Psalms 42
useCase: Longing, tears, and hope Themes: wellness, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; Maschil of the sons of Korah.

tokens.hebrew: כְּאַיָּל תַּעֲרֹג עַל־אֲפִיקֵי־מָיִם כֵּן נַפְשִׁי תַעֲרֹג אֵלֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after Thee, O God.
tokens.transliteration: ke-ah-YAHL tah-ah-ROHG ahl ah-fee-key MAH-yeem KEHN nahf-SHEE tah-ah-ROHG eh-LEY-khah eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: צָמְאָה נַפְשִׁי לֵאלֹהִים לְאֵל חָי מָתַי אָבוֹא וְאֵרָאֶה פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: 'When shall I come and appear before God?'
tokens.transliteration: tsah-me-AH nahf-SHEE leh-loh-HEEM le-EHL KHAHY mah-TAHY ah-VOH ve-eh-rah-EH pe-NEY eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: הָיְתָה־לִּי דִמְעָתִי לֶחֶם יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה בֶּאֱמֹר אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: My tears have been my food day and night, while they say unto me all the day: 'Where is Thy God?'
tokens.transliteration: hah-ye-tah LEE deem-ah-TEE leh-KHEHM yoh-MAHM vah-LAH-ye-lah beh-eh-MOHR eh-LAHY kohl hah-YOHM ah-YEH eh-loh-HEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אֶזְכְּרָה וְאֶשְׁפְּכָה עָלַי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֶעֱבֹר בַּסָּךְ אֶדַּדֵּם עַד־בֵּית אֱלֹהִים בְּקוֹל־רִנָּה וְתוֹדָה הָמוֹן חוֹגֵג׃
tokens.translation: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I passed on with the throng, and led them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday.
tokens.transliteration: EH-leh ehz-ke-RAH ve-ehsh-pe-KHAH ah-LAHY nahf-SHEE KEE eh-eh-VOHR bah-SAHKH eh-dah-DEHM ahd BEYT eh-loh-HEEM be-kohl ree-NAH ve-toh-DAH hah-MOHN khoh-GEHG

tokens.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וַתֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעוֹת פָּנָיו׃
tokens.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him for the salvation of His countenance.
tokens.transliteration: mahh teesh-TOH-khah-KHEE nahf-SHEE vah-teh-heh-MEE ah-LAHY hoh-KHEE-lee leh-loh-HEEM kee OHD oh-DEH-noo ye-shoo-OHT pah-NAHV

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי עָלַי נַפְשִׁי תִשְׁתּוֹחָח עַל־כֵּן אֶזְכָּרְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ יַרְדֵּן וְחֶרְמוֹנִים מֵהַר מִצְעָר׃
tokens.translation: O my God, my soul is cast down within me; therefore do I remember Thee from the land of Jordan, and the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HAHY ah-LAHY nahf-SHEE teesh-toh-KHAHKH ahl KEHN ehz-kah-re-KHAH meh-EH-rehts yahr-DEHN ve-khehr-moh-NEEM meh-HAHR meets-AHR

tokens.hebrew: תְּהוֹם־אֶל־תְּהוֹם קוֹרֵא לְקוֹל צִנּוֹרֶיךָ כָּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ וְגַלֶּיךָ עָלַי עָבָרוּ׃
tokens.translation: Deep calleth unto deep at the voice of Thy cataracts; all Thy waves and Thy billows are gone over me.
tokens.transliteration: te-hohm ehl te-HOHM koh-REH le-KOHL tsee-noh-REY-khah kahl meesh-bah-REY-khah ve-gah-LEY-khah ah-LAHY ah-VAH-roo

tokens.hebrew: יוֹמָם יְצַוֶּה יְהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וּבַלַּיְלָה שירה [שִׁירוֹ] עִמִּי תְּפִלָּה לְאֵל חַיָּי׃
tokens.translation: By day the LORD will command His lovingkindness, and in the night His song shall be with me, even a prayer unto the God of my life.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-MAHM ye-tsah-VEH ah-doh-NAI khahs-DOH oo-vah-lahy-LAH shee-ROH ee-MEE te-fee-LAH le-EHL khah-YAHY

tokens.hebrew: אוֹמְרָה לְאֵל סַלְעִי לָמָה שְׁכַחְתָּנִי לָמָּה־קֹדֵר אֵלֵךְ בְּלַחַץ אוֹיֵב׃
tokens.translation: I will say unto God my Rock: 'Why hast Thou forgotten me? Why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?'

tokens.hebrew: בְּרֶצַח בְּעַצְמוֹתַי חֵרְפוּנִי צוֹרְרָי בְּאָמְרָם אֵלַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם אַיֵּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: As with a crushing in my bones, mine adversaries taunt me; while they say unto me all the day: 'Where is Thy God?'
tokens.transliteration: be-REH-tsahkh be-ahts-moh-TAHY kheh-re-FOO-nee tsoh-re-RAHY be-ah-me-RAHM eh-LAHY kohl hah-YOHM ah-YEH eh-loh-HEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: מַה־תִּשְׁתּוֹחֲחִי נַפְשִׁי וּמַה־תֶּהֱמִי עָלָי הוֹחִילִי לֵאלֹהִים כִּי־עוֹד אוֹדֶנּוּ יְשׁוּעֹת פָּנַי וֵאלֹהָי׃
tokens.translation: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? And why moanest thou within me? Hope thou in God; for I shall yet praise Him, the salvation of my countenance, and my God.
tokens.transliteration: mahh teesh-TOH-khah-KHEE nahf-SHEE oo-mahh teh-heh-MEE ah-LAHY hoh-KHEE-lee leh-loh-HEEM kee OHD oh-DEH-noo ye-shoo-OHT pah-NAHY veh-loh-HAHY

title: Psalm 43
sefariaRef: Psalms 43
useCase: Light, truth, and renewed hope Themes: wisdom, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁפְטֵנִי אֱלֹהִים וְרִיבָה רִיבִי מִגּוֹי לֹא־חָסִיד מֵאִישׁ־מִרְמָה וְעַוְלָה תְפַלְּטֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Be Thou my judge, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
tokens.transliteration: shah-fe-TEH-nee eh-loh-HEEM ve-ree-VAH ree-VEE mee-GOHY loh khah-SEED MEH-eesh meer-MAH ve-ahv-LAH te-fah-le-TEH-nee

tokens.translation: For Thou art the God of my strength; why hast Thou cast me off? Why go I mourning under the oppression of the enemy?

tokens.hebrew: שְׁלַח־אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתְּךָ הֵמָּה יַנְחוּנִי יְבִיאוּנִי אֶל־הַר־קָדְשְׁךָ וְאֶל־מִשְׁכְּנוֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: O send out Thy light and Thy truth; let them lead me; Let them bring me unto Thy holy mountain, and to Thy dwelling-places.

tokens.hebrew: וְאָבוֹאָה אֶל־מִזְבַּח אֱלֹהִים אֶל־אֵל שִׂמְחַת גִּילִי וְאוֹדְךָ בְכִנּוֹר אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהָי׃
tokens.translation: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God, my exceeding joy; And praise Thee upon the harp, O God, my God.

title: Psalm 44
sefariaRef: Psalms 44
summary: Communal suffering and an appeal for aid
useCase: Communal suffering and an appeal for aid Themes: community, grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּאָזְנֵינוּ שָׁמַעְנוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ סִפְּרוּ־לָנוּ פֹּעַל פָּעַלְתָּ בִימֵיהֶם בִּימֵי קֶדֶם׃
tokens.translation: O God, we have heard with our ears, our fathers have told us; a work Thou didst in their days, in the days of old.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM be-ohz-NEY-noo shah-MAH-noo ah-voh-TEY-noo see-pe-roo LAH-noo POH-ahl pah-AHL-tah vee-mey-HEHM BEE-mey KEH-dehm

tokens.translation: Thou with Thy hand didst drive out the nations, and didst plant them in; Thou didst break the peoples, and didst spread them abroad.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH yah-de-KHAH goh-YEEM hoh-rahsh-TAH vah-tee-tah-EHM tah-RAH le-oo-MEEM vah-te-shah-le-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְחַרְבָּם יָרְשׁוּ אָרֶץ וּזְרוֹעָם לֹא־הוֹשִׁיעָה לָּמוֹ כִּי־יְמִינְךָ וּזְרוֹעֲךָ וְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ כִּי רְצִיתָם׃
tokens.translation: For not by their own sword did they get the land in possession, Neither did their own arm save them; but Thy right hand, and Thine arm, and the light of Thy countenance, because Thou wast favourable unto them.
tokens.transliteration: KEE LOH ve-khahr-BAHM YAH-re-shoo AH-rehts oo-ze-roh-AHM loh hoh-SHEE-AH LAH-moh kee ye-mee-ne-KHAH oo-ze-roh-ah-KHAH ve-OHR pah-NEY-khah KEE re-tsee-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה־הוּא מַלְכִּי אֱלֹהִים צַוֵּה יְשׁוּעוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: Thou art my King, O God; command the salvation of Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah HOO mahl-KEE eh-loh-HEEM tsah-VEH ye-shoo-OHT yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.hebrew: בְּךָ צָרֵינוּ נְנַגֵּחַ בְּשִׁמְךָ נָבוּס קָמֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Through Thee do we push down our adversaries; through Thy name do we tread them under that rise up against us.
tokens.transliteration: be-KHAH tsah-REY-noo ne-nah-GEH-ahkh be-sheem-KHAH nah-VOOS kah-MEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְקַשְׁתִּי אֶבְטָח וְחַרְבִּי לֹא תוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: For I trust not in my bow, neither can my sword save me.
tokens.transliteration: KEE LOH ve-kahsh-TEE ehv-TAHKH ve-khahr-BEE LOH toh-shee-EH-nee

tokens.translation: But Thou hast saved us from our adversaries, and hast put them to shame that hate us.

tokens.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים הִלַּלְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם וְשִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם נוֹדֶה סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: In God have we gloried all the day, and we will give thanks unto Thy name for ever. Selah
tokens.transliteration: beh-loh-HEEM hee-LAHL-noo khohl hah-YOHM ve-sheem-KHAH le-oh-LAHM noh-DEH SEH-lah

tokens.translation: Yet Thou hast cast off, and brought us to confusion; and goest not forth with our hosts.
tokens.transliteration: ahf zah-nahkh-TAH vah-tahkh-lee-MEH-noo ve-loh teh-TSEH be-tseev-oh-TEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ אָחוֹר מִנִּי־צָר וּמְשַׂנְאֵינוּ שָׁסוּ לָמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Thou makest us to turn back from the adversary; and they that hate us spoil at their will.
tokens.transliteration: te-shee-VEH-noo ah-KHOHR mee-nee TSAHR oo-me-sahn-EY-noo SHAH-soo LAH-moh

tokens.translation: Thou hast given us like sheep to be eaten; and hast scattered us among the nations.
Thou sellest Thy people for small gain, and hast not set their prices high.
tokens.transliteration: teem-kohr ah-me-KHAH ve-loh HOHN ve-LOH ree-BEE-tah beem-khee-rey-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: תְּשִׂימֵנוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Thou makest us a taunt to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
tokens.transliteration: te-see-MEH-noo khehr-PAH leesh-kheh-NEY-noo LAH-ahg vah-KEH-lehs lees-vee-voh-TEY-noo

tokens.translation: Thou makest us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.
tokens.transliteration: te-see-MEH-noo mah-SHAHL bah-goh-YEEM me-nohd ROHSH bahl oo-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם כְּלִמָּתִי נֶגְדִּי וּבֹשֶׁת פָּנַי כִּסָּתְנִי׃
tokens.translation: All the day is my confusion before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
tokens.transliteration: kohl hah-YOHM ke-lee-mah-TEE nehg-DEE oo-VOH-sheht pah-NAHY kee-SAH-te-nee

tokens.hebrew: מִקּוֹל מְחָרֵף וּמְגַדֵּף מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב וּמִתְנַקֵּם׃
tokens.translation: For the voice of him that taunteth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and the revengeful.
tokens.transliteration: mee-KOHL me-khah-REHF oo-me-gah-DEHF mee-pe-NEY oh-YEHV oo-meet-nah-KEHM

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־זֹאת בָּאַתְנוּ וְלֹא שְׁכַחֲנוּךָ וְלֹא־שִׁקַּרְנוּ בִּבְרִיתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten Thee, neither have we been false to Thy covenant.
tokens.transliteration: kohl ZOHT bah-aht-NOO ve-LOH she-khah-khah-NOO-khah ve-loh shee-KAHR-noo beev-ree-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־נָסוֹג אָחוֹר לִבֵּנוּ וַתֵּט אֲשֻׁרֵינוּ מִנִּי אָרְחֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from Thy path;
tokens.transliteration: loh nah-SOHG ah-KHOHR lee-BEH-noo vah-TEHT ah-shoo-REY-noo mee-NEE ohr-KHEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי דִכִּיתָנוּ בִּמְקוֹם תַּנִּים וַתְּכַס עָלֵינוּ בְצַלְמָוֶת׃
tokens.translation: Though Thou hast crushed us into a place of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.
tokens.transliteration: KEE dee-kee-tah-NOO beem-KOHM tah-NEEM vah-te-KHAHS ah-LEY-noo ve-tsahl-MAH-veht

tokens.hebrew: אִם־שָׁכַחְנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַנִּפְרֹשׂ כַּפֵּינוּ לְאֵל זָר׃
tokens.translation: If we had forgotten the name of our God, or spread forth our hands to a strange god; .
tokens.transliteration: eem shah-khahkh-NOO SHEHM eh-loh-HEY-noo vah-neef-ROHS kah-PEY-noo le-EHL ZAHR

tokens.hebrew: הֲלֹא אֱלֹהִים יַחֲקָר־זֹאת כִּי־הוּא יֹדֵעַ תַּעֲלֻמוֹת לֵב׃
tokens.translation: Would not God search this out? For He knoweth the secrets of the heart.
tokens.transliteration: hah-LOH eh-loh-HEEM yah-khah-kahr ZOHT kee HOO yoh-DEH-ah tah-ah-loo-MOHT LEHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ הֹרַגְנוּ כָל־הַיּוֹם נֶחְשַׁבְנוּ כְּצֹאן טִבְחָה׃
tokens.translation: Nay, but for Thy sake are we killed all the day; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-ley-KHAH hoh-RAHG-noo khohl hah-YOHM nehkh-SHAHV-noo ke-TSOHN teev-KHAH

tokens.hebrew: עוּרָה לָמָּה תִישַׁן אֲדֹנָי הָקִיצָה אַל־תִּזְנַח לָנֶצַח׃
tokens.translation: Awake, why sleepest Thou, O Lord? Arouse Thyself, cast not off for ever.
tokens.transliteration: OO-rah LAH-mah tee-SHAHN ah-doh-NAHY hah-KEE-tsah ahl teez-NAHKH lah-NEH-tsahkh

tokens.translation: Wherefore hidest Thou Thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
tokens.transliteration: lah-mah fah-NEY-khah tahs-TEER teesh-KAHKH ohn-YEH-noo ve-lah-khah-TSEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי שָׁחָה לֶעָפָר נַפְשֵׁנוּ דָּבְקָה לָאָרֶץ בִּטְנֵנוּ׃
tokens.translation: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
tokens.transliteration: KEE SHAH-khah leh-ah-FAHR nahf-SHEH-noo dah-ve-KAH lah-AH-rehts beet-NEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה עֶזְרָתָה לָּנוּ וּפְדֵנוּ לְמַעַן חַסְדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Arise for our help, and redeem us for Thy mercy's sake.
tokens.transliteration: koo-MAH ehz-RAH-tah LAH-noo oo-fe-DEH-noo le-MAH-ahn khahs-DEH-khah

title: Psalm 45
sefariaRef: Psalms 45
useCase: A royal wedding song Themes: relationships, life-cycle. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שֹׁשַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־קֹרַח מַשְׂכִּיל שִׁיר יְדִידֹת׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl shoh-shah-NEEM leev-ney KOH-rahkh mahs-KEEL SHEER ye-dee-DOHT

tokens.hebrew: רָחַשׁ לִבִּי דָּבָר טוֹב אֹמֵר אָנִי מַעֲשַׂי לְמֶלֶךְ לְשׁוֹנִי עֵט סוֹפֵר מָהִיר׃
tokens.translation: My heart overfloweth with a goodly matter; I say: 'My work is concerning a king'; My tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
tokens.transliteration: rah-KHAHSH lee-BEE dah-VAHR TOHV oh-MEHR ah-NEE mah-ah-SAHY le-MEH-lehkh le-shoh-NEE EHT soh-FEHR mah-HEER

tokens.hebrew: יָפְיָפִיתָ מִבְּנֵי אָדָם הוּצַק חֵן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶיךָ עַל־כֵּן בֵּרַכְךָ אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: Thou art fairer than the children of men; Grace is poured upon thy lips; Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
tokens.transliteration: yohf-yah-FEE-tah mee-be-NEY ah-DAHM HOO-tsahk KHEHN be-se-fe-toh-TEY-khah ahl KEHN beh-rahkh-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM le-oh-LAHM

tokens.translation: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O mighty one, Thy glory and thy majesty.
tokens.transliteration: khah-gohr khahr-be-KHAH ahl yah-REHKH gee-BOHR hoh-de-KHAH vah-hah-dah-REH-khah

tokens.hebrew: וַהֲדָרְךָ צְלַח רְכַב עַל־דְּבַר־אֱמֶת וְעַנְוָה־צֶדֶק וְתוֹרְךָ נוֹרָאוֹת יְמִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: And in thy majesty prosper, ride on, In behalf of truth and meekness and righteousness; And let thy right hand teach thee tremendous things.
tokens.transliteration: vah-hah-DAH-re-KHAH tse-LAHKH re-KHAHV ahl de-vahr eh-MEHT ve-ahn-vah TSEH-dehk ve-toh-re-KHAH noh-rah-OHT ye-mee-NEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: חִצֶּיךָ שְׁנוּנִים עַמִּים תַּחְתֶּיךָ יִפְּלוּ בְּלֵב אוֹיְבֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: Thine arrows are sharp— The peoples fall under thee— [They sink] into the heart of the king's enemies.
tokens.transliteration: khee-TSEH-khah she-noo-NEEM ah-MEEM tahkh-TEY-khah yee-pe-LOO be-LEHV oh-ye-VEY hah-MEH-lehkh

tokens.hebrew: כִּסְאֲךָ אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד שֵׁבֶט מִישֹׁר שֵׁבֶט מַלְכוּתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thy throne given of God is for ever and ever; A sceptre of equity is the sceptre of thy kingdom.
tokens.transliteration: kees-ah-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM oh-LAHM vah-EHD SHEH-veht mee-SHOHR SHEH-veht mahl-khoo-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ צֶּדֶק וַתִּשְׂנָא רֶשַׁע עַל־כֵּן מְשָׁחֲךָ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ שֶׁמֶן שָׂשׂוֹן מֵחֲבֵרֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast loved righteousness, and hated wickedness; Therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee With the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
tokens.transliteration: ah-HAHV-tah tseh-DEHK vah-tees-NAH REH-shah ahl KEHN me-shah-khah-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-hey-KHAH SHEH-mehn sah-SOHN meh-khah-veh-REY-khah

tokens.hebrew: מֹר־וַאֲהָלוֹת קְצִיעוֹת כָּל־בִּגְדֹתֶיךָ מִן־הֵיכְלֵי שֵׁן מִנִּי שִׂמְּחוּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Myrrh, and aloes, and cassia are all thy garments; Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made thee glad.
tokens.transliteration: mohr vah-ah-hah-LOHT ke-tsee-OHT kohl beeg-doh-TEY-khah meen HEY-khe-ley SHEHN mee-NEE see-me-KHOO-khah

tokens.hebrew: בְּנוֹת מְלָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶיךָ נִצְּבָה שֵׁגַל לִימִינְךָ בְּכֶתֶם אוֹפִיר׃
tokens.translation: Kings' daughters are among thy favourites; At thy right hand doth stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
tokens.transliteration: be-NOHT me-lah-KHEEM be-yee-ke-roh-TEY-khah nee-tse-VAH sheh-GAHL lee-mee-ne-KHAH be-KHEH-tehm oh-FEER

tokens.hebrew: שִׁמְעִי־בַת וּרְאִי וְהַטִּי אָזְנֵךְ וְשִׁכְחִי עַמֵּךְ וּבֵית אָבִיךְ׃
tokens.translation: 'Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; Forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
tokens.transliteration: sheem-ee VAHT oo-re-EE ve-hah-TEE ohz-NEHKH ve-sheekh-KHEE ah-MEHKH oo-VEYT ah-VEEKH

tokens.hebrew: וְיִתְאָו הַמֶּלֶךְ יָפְיֵךְ כִּי־הוּא אֲדֹנַיִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִי־לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: So shall the king desire thy beauty; For he is thy lord; and do homage unto him. .
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeet-AHV hah-MEH-lehkh yohf-YEHKH kee HOO ah-doh-NAH-yeekh ve-heesh-tah-khah-vee LOH

tokens.hebrew: וּבַת־צֹר בְּמִנְחָה פָּנַיִךְ יְחַלּוּ עֲשִׁירֵי עָם׃
tokens.translation: And, O daughter of Tyre, the richest of the people Shall entreat thy favour with a gift.'
tokens.transliteration: oo-vaht TSOHR be-meen-KHAH pah-NAH-yeekh ye-khah-LOO ah-SHEE-rey AHM

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־כְּבוּדָּה בַת־מֶלֶךְ פְּנִימָה מִמִּשְׁבְּצוֹת זָהָב לְבוּשָׁהּ׃
tokens.translation: All glorious is the king's daughter within the palace; Her raiment is of chequer work inwrought with gold.
tokens.transliteration: kohl ke-voo-DAH vaht MEH-lehkh pe-NEE-mah mee-meesh-be-TSOHT zah-HAHV le-voo-SHAHH

tokens.hebrew: לִרְקָמוֹת תּוּבַל לַמֶּלֶךְ בְּתוּלוֹת אַחֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶיהָ מוּבָאוֹת לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: She shall be led unto the king on richly woven stuff; The virgins her companions in her train being brought unto thee.
tokens.transliteration: leer-kah-MOHT too-VAHL lah-MEH-lehkh be-too-LOHT ah-khah-rey-HAH reh-oh-TEY-hah MOO-vah-OHT LAHKH

tokens.hebrew: תּוּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹת וָגִיל תְּבֹאֶינָה בְּהֵיכַל מֶלֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: They shall be led with gladness and rejoicing; They shall enter into the king's palace.
tokens.transliteration: too-vahl-NAH bees-mah-KHOHT vah-GEEL te-voh-EY-nah be-HEY-khahl MEH-lehkh

tokens.hebrew: תַּחַת אֲבֹתֶיךָ יִהְיוּ בָנֶיךָ תְּשִׁיתֵמוֹ לְשָׂרִים בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy sons, Whom thou shalt make princes in all the land.
tokens.transliteration: TAH-khaht ah-voh-tey-KHAH yeeh-YOO vah-NEY-khah te-shee-TEH-moh le-sah-REEM be-khohl hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: אַזְכִּירָה שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל־דֹּר וָדֹר עַל־כֵּן עַמִּים יְהוֹדֻךָ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore shall the peoples praise thee for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: ahz-KEE-rah sheem-KHAH be-khohl DOHR vah-DOHR ahl KEHN ah-MEEM ye-hoh-DOO-khah le-oh-LAHM vah-EHD

title: Psalm 46
sefariaRef: Psalms 46
useCase: Refuge amid upheaval Themes: protection, peace. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; [a Psalm] of the sons of Korah; upon Alamoth. A Song.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh leev-ney KOH-rahkh ahl ah-lah-MOHT SHEER

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים לָנוּ מַחֲסֶה וָעֹז עֶזְרָה בְצָרוֹת נִמְצָא מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: God is our refuge and strength, A very present help in trouble.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM lah-NOO mah-khah-SEH vah-OHZ ehz-RAH ve-tsah-ROHT neem-TSAH me-OHD

tokens.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־נִירָא בְּהָמִיר אָרֶץ וּבְמוֹט הָרִים בְּלֵב יַמִּים׃
tokens.translation: Therefore will we not fear, though the earth do change, And though the mountains be moved into the heart of the seas;
tokens.transliteration: ahl KEHN loh nee-RAH be-hah-MEER AH-rehts oo-ve-MOHT hah-REEM be-LEHV yah-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: יֶהֱמוּ יֶחְמְרוּ מֵימָיו יִרְעֲשׁוּ־הָרִים בְּגַאֲוָתוֹ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Though the waters thereof roar and foam, Though the mountains shake at the swelling thereof. Selah
tokens.transliteration: yeh-heh-MOO yehkh-me-ROO mey-MAHV yee-re-ah-shoo hah-REEM be-gah-ah-vah-TOH SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: נָהָר פְּלָגָיו יְשַׂמְּחוּ עִיר־אֱלֹהִים קְדֹשׁ מִשְׁכְּנֵי עֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: There is a river, the streams whereof make glad the city of God, The holiest dwelling-place of the Most High.
tokens.transliteration: nah-HAHR pe-lah-GAHV ye-sah-me-KHOO eer eh-loh-HEEM ke-DOHSH meesh-ke-NEY ehl-YOHN

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בְּקִרְבָּהּ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יַעְזְרֶהָ אֱלֹהִים לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר׃
tokens.translation: God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved; God shall help her, at the approach of morning.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM be-keer-BAHH bahl tee-MOHT yah-ze-REH-hah eh-loh-HEEM leef-NOHT BOH-kehr

tokens.hebrew: הָמוּ גוֹיִם מָטוּ מַמְלָכוֹת נָתַן בְּקוֹלוֹ תָּמוּג אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Nations were in tumult, kingdoms were moved; He uttered His voice, the earth melted.
tokens.transliteration: hah-MOO goh-YEEM MAH-too mahm-lah-KHOHT nah-TAHN be-koh-LOH tah-MOOG AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-OHT ee-MAH-noo mees-gahv lah-NOO eh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: לְכוּ־חֲזוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׂם שַׁמּוֹת בָּאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Come, behold the works of the LORD, Who hath made desolations in the earth.
tokens.transliteration: le-khoo khah-ZOO meef-ah-LOHT ah-doh-NAI ah-shehr SAHM shah-MOHT bah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: מַשְׁבִּית מִלְחָמוֹת עַד־קְצֵה הָאָרֶץ קֶשֶׁת יְשַׁבֵּר וְקִצֵּץ חֲנִית עֲגָלוֹת יִשְׂרֹף בָּאֵשׁ׃
tokens.translation: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; He breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; He burneth the chariots in the fire.
tokens.transliteration: mahsh-BEET meel-khah-MOHT ahd ke-TSEH hah-AH-rehts KEH-sheht ye-shah-BEHR ve-kee-TSEHTS khah-NEET ah-gah-LOHT yees-ROHF bah-EHSH

tokens.hebrew: הַרְפּוּ וּדְעוּ כִּי־אָנֹכִי אֱלֹהִים אָרוּם בַּגּוֹיִם אָרוּם בָּאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: 'Let be, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'
tokens.transliteration: hahr-POO oo-de-OO kee ah-noh-KHEE eh-loh-HEEM ah-ROOM bah-goh-YEEM ah-ROOM bah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּנוּ מִשְׂגָּב־לָנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD of hosts is with us; The God of Jacob is our high tower. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-OHT ee-MAH-noo mees-gahv lah-NOO eh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV SEH-lah

title: Psalm 47
sefariaRef: Psalms 47
useCase: Universal praise and kingship Themes: gratitude, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־הָעַמִּים תִּקְעוּ־כָף הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים בְּקוֹל רִנָּה׃
tokens.translation: O clap your hands, all ye peoples; shout unto God with the voice of triumph. .
tokens.transliteration: kahl hah-ah-MEEM teek-oo KHAHF hah-REE-oo leh-loh-HEEM be-KOHL ree-NAH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן נוֹרָא מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD is most high, awful; a great King over all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-doh-NAI ehl-YOHN noh-RAH MEH-lehkh gah-DOHL ahl kohl hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: יַדְבֵּר עַמִּים תַּחְתֵּינוּ וּלְאֻמִּים תַּחַת רַגְלֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: He subdueth peoples under us, and nations under our feet.
tokens.transliteration: yahd-BEHR ah-MEEM tahkh-TEY-noo oo-le-oo-MEEM TAH-khaht rahg-LEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: יִבְחַר־לָנוּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֵנוּ אֶת גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר־אָהֵב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: He chooseth our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob whom He loveth. Selah
tokens.transliteration: yeev-khahr LAH-noo eht nah-khah-lah-TEH-noo EHT ge-OHN yah-ah-KOHV ah-shehr ah-HEHV SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: עָלָה אֱלֹהִים בִּתְרוּעָה יְהֹוָה בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר׃
tokens.translation: God is gone up amidst shouting, the LORD amidst the sound of the horn.
tokens.transliteration: ah-LAH eh-loh-HEEM beet-roo-AH ah-doh-NAI be-KOHL shoh-FAHR

tokens.hebrew: זַמְּרוּ אֱלֹהִים זַמֵּרוּ זַמְּרוּ לְמַלְכֵּנוּ זַמֵּרוּ׃
tokens.translation: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
tokens.transliteration: zah-me-ROO eh-loh-HEEM zah-MEH-roo zah-me-ROO le-mahl-KEH-noo zah-MEH-roo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מֶלֶךְ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ אֱלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ מַשְׂכִּיל׃
tokens.translation: For God is the King of all the earth; sing ye praises in a skilful song.
tokens.transliteration: KEE MEH-lehkh kohl hah-AH-rehts eh-loh-HEEM zah-me-ROO mahs-KEEL

tokens.hebrew: מָלַךְ אֱלֹהִים עַל־גּוֹיִם אֱלֹהִים יָשַׁב עַל־כִּסֵּא קָדְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: God reigneth over the nations; God sitteth upon His holy throne.
tokens.transliteration: mah-LAHKH eh-loh-HEEM ahl goh-YEEM eh-loh-HEEM yah-SHAHV ahl kee-SEH kohd-SHOH

tokens.hebrew: נְדִיבֵי עַמִּים נֶאֱסָפוּ עַם אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם כִּי לֵאלֹהִים מָגִנֵּי־אֶרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלָה׃
tokens.translation: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for unto God belong the shields of the earth; He is greatly exalted.
tokens.transliteration: ne-dee-VEY ah-MEEM neh-eh-SAH-foo AHM eh-loh-HEY ahv-rah-HAHM KEE leh-loh-HEEM mah-gee-ney EH-rehts me-OHD nah-ah-LAH

title: Psalm 48
sefariaRef: Psalms 48
useCase: Zion and communal memory Themes: community, jerusalem. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah.

tokens.hebrew: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַר־קָדְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised, In the city of our God, His holy mountain,
tokens.transliteration: gah-DOHL ah-doh-NAI oo-me-hoo-LAHL me-OHD be-EER eh-loh-HEY-noo hahr kohd-SHOH

tokens.hebrew: יְפֵה נוֹף מְשׂוֹשׂ כָּל־הָאָרֶץ הַר־צִיּוֹן יַרְכְּתֵי צָפוֹן קִרְיַת מֶלֶךְ רָב׃
tokens.translation: Fair in situation, the joy of the whole earth; Even mount Zion, the uttermost parts of the north, The city of the great King.
tokens.transliteration: ye-FEH NOHF me-SOHS kohl hah-AH-rehts hahr tsee-YOHN yahr-ke-TEY tsah-FOHN keer-YAHT MEH-lehkh RAHV

tokens.translation: God in her palaces Hath made Himself known for a stronghold.
For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They came onward together.
tokens.transliteration: kee hee-NEH hah-me-lah-KHEEM noh-ah-DOO ah-ve-ROO yahkh-DAHV

tokens.hebrew: הֵמָּה רָאוּ כֵּן תָּמָהוּ נִבְהֲלוּ נֶחְפָּזוּ׃
tokens.translation: They saw, straightway they were amazed; They were affrighted, they hasted away.
tokens.transliteration: HEH-mah rah-OO KEHN tah-MAH-hoo neev-hah-LOO nehkh-PAH-zoo

tokens.translation: Trembling took hold of them there, Pangs, as of a woman in travail.
With the east wind Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish.

tokens.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר שָׁמַעְנוּ כֵּן רָאִינוּ בְּעִיר־יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֱלֹהִים יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עַד־עוֹלָם סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God— God establish it for ever. Selah
tokens.transliteration: kah-ah-SHEHR shah-MAH-noo KEHN rah-EE-noo be-eer ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-OHT be-EER eh-loh-HEY-noo eh-loh-HEEM ye-khoh-ne-NEH-hah ahd oh-LAHM SEH-lah

tokens.translation: We have thought on Thy lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of Thy temple.

tokens.hebrew: כְּשִׁמְךָ אֱלֹהִים כֵּן תְּהִלָּתְךָ עַל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ צֶדֶק מָלְאָה יְמִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: As is Thy name, O God, So is Thy praise unto the ends of the earth; Thy right hand is full of righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: ke-sheem-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM KEHN te-hee-lah-te-KHAH ahl kahts-vey EH-rehts tseh-DEHK mah-le-AH ye-mee-NEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח הַר־צִיּוֹן תָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Let mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of Thy judgments.
tokens.transliteration: yees-MAHKH hahr tsee-YOHN tah-geh-le-NAH be-NOHT ye-hoo-DAH le-MAH-ahn meesh-pah-TEY-khah

tokens.translation: Walk about Zion, and go round about her; Count the towers thereof.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיתוּ לִבְּכֶם לְחֵילָה פַּסְּגוּ אַרְמְנוֹתֶיהָ לְמַעַן תְּסַפְּרוּ לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן׃
tokens.translation: Mark ye well her ramparts, Traverse her palaces; That ye may tell it to the generation following. .
tokens.transliteration: SHEE-too lee-be-KHEHM le-khey-LAH pah-se-GOO ahr-me-noh-TEY-hah le-MAH-ahn te-sah-pe-ROO le-DOHR ah-khah-ROHN

tokens.hebrew: כִּי זֶה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ עוֹלָם וָעֶד הוּא יְנַהֲגֵנוּ עַל־מוּת׃
tokens.translation: For such is God, our God, for ever and ever; He will guide us eternally.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ZEH eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-hey-NOO oh-LAHM vah-EHD HOO ye-nah-hah-GEH-noo ahl MOOT

title: Psalm 49
sefariaRef: Psalms 49
useCase: Wealth, mortality, and perspective Themes: provision, wisdom, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; a Psalm for the sons of Korah.
Hear this, all ye peoples; Give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world,
tokens.transliteration: sheem-oo ZOHT kohl hah-ah-MEEM hah-ah-ZEE-noo kohl YOH-she-vey KHAH-lehd

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם־בְּנֵי־אִישׁ יַחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: Both low and high, Rich and poor together.
tokens.transliteration: gahm be-NEY ah-DAHM gahm be-ney EESH yah-KHAHD ah-SHEER ve-ehv-YOHN

tokens.hebrew: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנוֹת׃
tokens.translation: My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be understanding.
tokens.transliteration: PEE ye-dah-BEHR khohkh-MOHT ve-hah-GOOT lee-BEE te-voo-NOHT

tokens.hebrew: אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי אֶפְתַּח בְּכִנּוֹר חִידָתִי׃
tokens.translation: I will incline mine ear to a parable; I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TEH le-mah-SHAHL ohz-NEE ehf-TAHKH be-khee-NOHR khee-dah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה אִירָא בִּימֵי רָע עֲוֺן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my supplanters compasseth me about,
tokens.transliteration: LAH-mah ee-RAH BEE-mey RAH ah-VOHN ah-keh-VAHY ye-soo-BEH-nee

tokens.translation: Of them that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches?
tokens.transliteration: hah-boh-te-KHEEM ahl khey-LAHM oo-ve-ROHV ohsh-RAHM yeet-hah-LAH-loo

tokens.hebrew: אָח לֹא־פָדֹה יִפְדֶּה אִישׁ לֹא־יִתֵּן לֵאלֹהִים כָּפְרוֹ׃
tokens.translation: No man can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him—
tokens.transliteration: AHKH loh fah-DOHH yeef-DEH EESH loh yee-TEHN leh-loh-HEEM kah-fe-ROH

tokens.translation: For too costly is the redemption of their soul, and must be let alone for ever—
That he should still live always, that he should not see the pit.
tokens.transliteration: vee-khee OHD lah-NEH-tsahkh LOH yeer-EH hah-SHAH-khaht

tokens.hebrew: כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמוּתוּ יַחַד כְּסִיל וָבַעַר יֹאבֵדוּ וְעָזְבוּ לַאֲחֵרִים חֵילָם׃
tokens.translation: For he seeth that wise men die, The fool and the brutish together perish, And leave their wealth to others.
tokens.transliteration: KEE yeer-EH khah-khah-MEEM yah-MOO-too YAH-khahd ke-SEEL vah-VAH-ahr yoh-VEH-doo ve-ah-ze-VOO lah-ah-kheh-REEM khey-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּימוֹ לְעוֹלָם מִשְׁכְּנֹתָם לְדֹר וָדֹר קָרְאוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם עֲלֵי אֲדָמוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, And their dwelling-places to all generations; They call their lands after their own names.
tokens.transliteration: keer-BAHM bah-TEY-moh le-oh-LAHM meesh-ke-noh-TAHM le-DOHR vah-DOHR kah-re-OO veesh-moh-TAHM ah-LEY ah-dah-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: וְאָדָם בִּיקָר בַּל־יָלִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃
tokens.translation: But man abideth not in honour; He is like the beasts that perish.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-DAHM bee-KAHR bahl yah-LEEN neem-SHAHL kah-be-heh-MOHT need-MOO

tokens.hebrew: זֶה דַרְכָּם כֵּסֶל לָמוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: This is the way of them that are foolish, and of those who after them approve their sayings. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ZEH dahr-KAHM KEH-sehl LAH-moh ve-ah-khah-rey-HEHM be-fee-HEHM yeer-TSOO SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: כַּצֹּאן לִשְׁאוֹל שַׁתּוּ מָוֶת יִרְעֵם וַיִּרְדּוּ בָם יְשָׁרִים לַבֹּקֶר וצירם [וְצוּרָם] לְבַלּוֹת שְׁאוֹל מִזְּבֻל לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Like sheep they are appointed for the nether-world; death shall be their shepherd; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; And their form shall be for the nether-world to wear away, That there be no habitation for it.
tokens.transliteration: kah-TSOHN lee-she-OHL shah-TOO MAH-veht yeer-EHM vah-yeer-DOO VAHM ye-shah-REEM lah-BOH-kehr ve-tsoo-RAHM le-vah-LOHT she-OHL mee-ze-VOOL LOH

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵנִי סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the nether-world; For He shall receive me. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ahkh eh-loh-HEEM yeef-DEH nahf-SHEE mee-yahd she-OHL KEE yee-kah-KHEH-nee SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּירָא כִּי־יַעֲשִׁר אִישׁ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה כְּבוֹד בֵּיתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Be not thou afraid when one waxeth rich, When the wealth of his house is increased;
tokens.transliteration: ahl tee-RAH kee yah-ah-SHEER EESH kee yeer-BEH ke-VOHD bey-TOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל לֹא־יֵרֵד אַחֲרָיו כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away; His wealth shall not descend after him.
tokens.transliteration: KEE LOH ve-moh-TOH yee-KAHKH hah-KOHL loh yeh-REHD ah-khah-RAHV ke-voh-DOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ וְיוֹדֻךָ כִּי־תֵיטִיב לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: 'Men will praise thee, when thou shalt do well to thyself';
tokens.transliteration: kee nahf-SHOH be-khah-YAHV ye-vah-REHKH ve-yoh-DOO-khah kee tey-TEEV LAHKH

tokens.hebrew: תָּבוֹא עַד־דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו עַד־נֵצַח לֹא יִרְאוּ־אוֹר׃
tokens.translation: It shall go to the generation of his fathers; They shall never see the light. .
tokens.transliteration: tah-VOH ahd DOHR ah-voh-TAHV ahd neh-TSAHKH LOH yeer-oo OHR

tokens.hebrew: אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֹא יָבִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּהֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ׃
tokens.translation: Man that is in honour understandeth not; He is like the beasts that perish.
tokens.transliteration: ah-DAHM bee-KAHR ve-LOH yah-VEEN neem-SHAHL kah-be-heh-MOHT need-MOO

title: Psalm 50
sefariaRef: Psalms 50
summary: Sincere worship, thanksgiving, and moral responsibility
useCase: Sincere worship, thanksgiving, and moral responsibility Themes: gratitude, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֵל אֱ‍לֹהִים יְהוָה דִּבֶּר וַיִּקְרָא־אָרֶץ מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבֹאוֹ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. God, God, the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
tokens.transliteration: meez-MOHR le-ah-SAHF EHL eh-loh-HEEM ah-doh-NAI dee-BEHR vah-yeek-rah AH-rehts mee-meez-rahkh sheh-MEHSH ahd me-voh-OH

tokens.translation: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined forth.

tokens.hebrew: יָבֹא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְאַל־יֶחֱרַשׁ אֵשׁ־לְפָנָיו תֹּאכֵל וּסְבִיבָיו נִשְׂעֲרָה מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: Our God cometh, and doth not keep silence; a fire devoureth before Him, And round about Him it stormeth mightily.
tokens.transliteration: YAH-VOH eh-loh-HEY-noo ve-ahl yeh-kheh-RAHSH ehsh le-fah-NAHV toh-KHEHL oo-se-vee-VAHV nees-ah-RAH me-OHD

tokens.hebrew: יִקְרָא אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם מֵעָל וְאֶל־הָאָרֶץ לָדִין עַמּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He calleth to the heavens above, and to the earth, that He may judge His people:
tokens.transliteration: yeek-RAH ehl hah-shah-MAH-yeem meh-AHL ve-ehl hah-AH-rehts lah-DEEN ah-MOH

tokens.translation: 'Gather My saints together unto Me; those that have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.'
tokens.transliteration: ees-foo LEE khah-see-DAHY koh-re-TEY ve-ree-TEE ah-ley ZAH-vahkh

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּגִּידוּ שָׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט הוּא סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: And the heavens declare His righteousness; for God, He is judge. Selah
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-GEE-doo shah-MAH-yeem tseed-KOH kee eh-loh-HEEM shoh-FEHT HOO SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: שִׁמְעָה עַמִּי וַאֲדַבֵּרָה יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֶיךָ אָנֹכִי׃
tokens.translation: 'Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: God, thy God, am I.
tokens.transliteration: sheem-AH ah-MEE vah-ah-dah-BEH-rah yees-rah-EHL ve-ah-EE-dah BAHKH eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-HEY-khah ah-NOH-khee

tokens.hebrew: לֹא עַל־זְבָחֶיךָ אוֹכִיחֶךָ וְעוֹלֹתֶיךָ לְנֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
tokens.translation: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices; and thy burnt-offerings are continually before Me.
tokens.transliteration: LOH ahl ze-vah-khey-KHAH oh-khee-KHEH-khah ve-oh-loh-TEY-khah le-nehg-DEE tah-MEED

tokens.translation: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he-goats out of thy folds.
tokens.transliteration: loh eh-KAHKH mee-bey-te-KHAH FAHR mee-meekh-le-oh-TEY-khah ah-too-DEEM

tokens.translation: For every beast of the forest is Mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.
tokens.transliteration: kee LEE khohl khahy-toh YAH-ahr be-heh-MOHT be-hahr-rey AH-lehf

tokens.hebrew: יָדַעְתִּי כָּל־עוֹף הָרִים וְזִיז שָׂדַי עִמָּדִי׃
tokens.translation: I know all the fowls of the mountains; and the wild beasts of the field are Mine.
tokens.transliteration: yah-dah-TEE kohl OHF hah-REEM ve-ZEEZ sah-DAHY ee-mah-DEE

tokens.hebrew: אִם־אֶרְעַב לֹא־אֹמַר לָךְ כִּי־לִי תֵבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ׃
tokens.translation: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee; for the world is Mine, and the fulness thereof.
tokens.transliteration: eem ehr-AHV loh OH-mahr LAHKH kee LEE teh-VEHL oo-me-loh-AHH

tokens.hebrew: הַאוֹכַל בְּשַׂר אַבִּירִים וְדַם עַתּוּדִים אֶשְׁתֶּה׃
tokens.translation: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
tokens.transliteration: hah-oh-KHAHL be-SAHR ah-bee-REEM ve-DAHM ah-too-DEEM ehsh-TEH

tokens.hebrew: זְבַח לֵאלֹהִים תּוֹדָה וְשַׁלֵּם לְעֶלְיוֹן נְדָרֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Offer unto God the sacrifice of thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the Most High;
tokens.transliteration: ze-VAHKH leh-loh-HEEM toh-DAH ve-shah-LEHM le-ehl-YOHN ne-dah-REY-khah

tokens.translation: And call upon Me in the day of trouble; I will deliver thee, and thou shalt honour Me.'

tokens.hebrew: וְלָרָשָׁע אָמַר אֱלֹהִים מַה־לְּךָ לְסַפֵּר חֻקָּי וַתִּשָּׂא בְרִיתִי עֲלֵי־פִיךָ׃
tokens.translation: But unto the wicked God saith: 'What hast thou to do to declare My statutes, And that thou hast taken My covenant in thy mouth?
tokens.transliteration: ve-LAH-rah-SHAH ah-MAHR eh-loh-HEEM mahh le-KHAH le-sah-PEHR khoo-KAHY vah-tee-SAH ve-ree-TEE ah-ley FEE-khah

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה שָׂנֵאתָ מוּסָר וַתַּשְׁלֵךְ דְּבָרַי אַחֲרֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest My words behind thee.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH sah-NEH-tah moo-SAHR vah-tahsh-LEHKH de-vah-RAHY ah-khah-REY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אִם־רָאִיתָ גַנָּב וַתִּרֶץ עִמּוֹ וְעִם מְנָאֲפִים חֶלְקֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: When thou sawest a thief, thou hadst company with him, and with adulterers was thy portion.
tokens.transliteration: eem rah-EE-tah gah-NAHV vah-TEE-rehts ee-MOH ve-EEM me-nah-ah-FEEM khehl-KEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: פִּיךָ שָׁלַחְתָּ בְרָעָה וּלְשׁוֹנְךָ תַּצְמִיד מִרְמָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast let loose thy mouth for evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit. .
tokens.transliteration: pee-KHAH shah-LAHKH-tah ve-rah-AH oo-le-shoh-ne-KHAH tahts-MEED meer-MAH

tokens.translation: Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; Thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
tokens.transliteration: teh-SHEHV be-ah-KHEE-khah te-dah-BEHR be-vehn ee-me-KHAH tee-tehn DOH-fee

tokens.hebrew: אֵלֶּה עָשִׂיתָ וְהֶחֱרַשְׁתִּי דִּמִּיתָ הֱיוֹת־אֶהְיֶה כָמוֹךָ אוֹכִיחֲךָ וְאֶעֶרְכָה לְעֵינֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: These things hast thou done, and should I have kept silence? Thou hadst thought that I was altogether such a one as thyself; but I will reprove thee, and set the cause before thine eyes.
tokens.transliteration: EH-leh ah-SEE-tah ve-heh-kheh-RAHSH-tee dee-MEE-tah heh-yoht eh-he-YEH khah-MOH-khah oh-khee-khah-KHAH ve-eh-ehr-KHAH le-ey-NEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: בִּינוּ־נָא זֹאת שֹׁכְחֵי אֱלוֹהַּ פֶּן־אֶטְרֹף וְאֵין מַצִּיל׃
tokens.translation: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear in pieces, and there be none to deliver.
tokens.transliteration: bee-noo NAH ZOHT shoh-khe-KHEY eh-LOH-ahh pehn eht-ROHF ve-EYN mah-TSEEL

tokens.hebrew: זֹבֵחַ תּוֹדָה יְכַבְּדָנְנִי וְשָׂם דֶּרֶךְ אַרְאֶנּוּ בְּיֵשַׁע אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Whoso offereth the sacrifice of thanksgiving honoureth Me; and to him that ordereth his way aright Will I show the salvation of God.'
tokens.transliteration: zoh-VEH-ahkh toh-DAH ye-khah-be-DAH-ne-nee ve-SAHM DEH-rehkh ahr-EH-noo be-YEH-shah eh-loh-HEEM

title: Psalm 51
sefariaRef: Psalms 51
useCase: Confession and a clean heart Themes: repentance, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David;
when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.
tokens.transliteration: be-voh eh-LAHV nah-TAHN hah-nah-VEE kah-ah-shehr BAH ehl baht SHAH-vah

tokens.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כְּחַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ מְחֵה פְשָׁעָי׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O God, according to Thy mercy; According to the multitude of Thy compassions blot out my transgressions.
tokens.transliteration: khoh-NEH-nee eh-loh-HEEM ke-khahs-DEH-khah ke-ROHV rah-khah-MEY-khah me-KHEH fe-shah-AHY

tokens.translation: Wash me thoroughly from mine iniquity, And cleanse me from my sin.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־פְשָׁעַי אֲנִי אֵדָע וְחַטָּאתִי נֶגְדִּי תָמִיד׃
tokens.translation: For I know my transgressions; And my sin is ever before me.
tokens.transliteration: kee fe-shah-AHY ah-NEE eh-DAH ve-khah-tah-TEE nehg-DEE tah-MEED

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ חָטָאתִי וְהָרַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ עָשִׂיתִי לְמַעַן תִּצְדַּק בְּדָבְרֶךָ תִּזְכֶּה בְשָׁפְטֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Against Thee, Thee only, have I sinned, And done that which is evil in Thy sight; That Thou mayest be justified when Thou speakest, And be in the right when Thou judgest.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHAH le-vah-de-KHAH khah-tah-TEE ve-hah-RAH be-ey-NEY-khah ah-SEE-tee le-mah-AHN teets-DAHK be-dah-ve-REH-khah teez-KEH ve-shah-fe-TEH-khah

tokens.translation: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity, and in sin did my mother conceive me.
tokens.transliteration: hehn be-ah-VOHN khoh-LAH-le-tee oo-ve-KHEHT yeh-kheh-MAHT-nee ee-MEE

tokens.hebrew: הֵן־אֱמֶת חָפַצְתָּ בַטֻּחוֹת וּבְסָתֻם חָכְמָה תוֹדִיעֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Behold, Thou desirest truth in the inward parts; make me, therefore, to know wisdom in mine inmost heart.
tokens.transliteration: hehn eh-MEHT khah-FAHTS-tah vah-too-KHOHT oo-ve-sah-TOOM khohkh-MAH toh-dee-EH-nee

tokens.hebrew: תְּחַטְּאֵנִי בְאֵזוֹב וְאֶטְהָר תְּכַבְּסֵנִי וּמִשֶּׁלֶג אַלְבִּין׃
tokens.translation: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
tokens.transliteration: te-khah-te-EH-nee ve-eh-ZOHV ve-eht-HAHR te-khah-be-SEH-nee oo-mee-SHEH-lehg ahl-BEEN

tokens.hebrew: תַּשְׁמִיעֵנִי שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה תָּגֵלְנָה עֲצָמוֹת דִּכִּיתָ׃
tokens.translation: Make me to hear joy and gladness; that the bones which Thou hast crushed may rejoice.
tokens.transliteration: tahsh-mee-eh-NEE sah-SOHN ve-seem-KHAH tah-GEH-le-nah ah-tsah-MOHT dee-KEE-tah

tokens.translation: Hide Thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
tokens.transliteration: hahs-TEHR pah-ney-KHAH meh-khah-tah-AHY ve-khohl ah-VOH-noh-TAHY me-KHEH

tokens.hebrew: לֵב טָהוֹר בְּרָא־לִי אֱלֹהִים וְרוּחַ נָכוֹן חַדֵּשׁ בְּקִרְבִּי׃
tokens.translation: Create me a clean heart, O God; and renew a stedfast spirit within me.
tokens.transliteration: LEHV tah-HOHR be-rah LEE eh-loh-HEEM ve-ROO-ahkh nah-KHOHN khah-DEHSH be-keer-BEE

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי מִלְּפָנֶיךָ וְרוּחַ קָדְשְׁךָ אַל־תִּקַּח מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: Cast me not away from Thy presence; and take not Thy holy spirit from me.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tahsh-lee-KHEH-nee mee-le-fah-NEY-khah ve-ROO-ahkh kohd-she-KHAH ahl tee-KAHKH mee-MEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: הָשִׁיבָה לִּי שְׂשׂוֹן יִשְׁעֶךָ וְרוּחַ נְדִיבָה תִסְמְכֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation; and let a willing spirit uphold me.
tokens.transliteration: hah-SHEE-vah LEE se-SOHN yeesh-EH-khah ve-ROO-ahkh ne-dee-VAH tees-me-KHEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: אֲלַמְּדָה פֹשְׁעִים דְּרָכֶיךָ וְחַטָּאִים אֵלֶיךָ יָשׁוּבוּ׃
tokens.translation: Then will I teach transgressors Thy ways; and sinners shall return unto Thee. .
tokens.transliteration: ah-lah-me-DAH foh-she-EEM de-rah-KHEY-khah ve-khah-tah-EEM eh-LEY-khah yah-SHOO-voo

tokens.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִדָּמִים אֱ‍לֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי תְּשׁוּעָתִי תְּרַנֵּן לְשׁוֹנִי צִדְקָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, Thou God of my salvation; so shall my tongue sing aloud of Thy righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: hah-tsee-LEH-nee mee-dah-MEEM eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-HEY te-shoo-ah-TEE te-rah-NEHN le-shoh-NEE tseed-kah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח וּפִי יַגִּיד תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: O Lord, open Thou my lips; and my mouth shall declare Thy praise.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAHY se-fah-TAHY teef-TAHKH oo-FEE yah-GEED te-hee-lah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־תַחְפֹּץ זֶבַח וְאֶתֵּנָה עוֹלָה לֹא תִרְצֶה׃
tokens.translation: For Thou delightest not in sacrifice, else would I give it; Thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.
tokens.transliteration: KEE loh tahkh-POHTS ZEH-vahkh ve-eh-TEH-nah oh-LAH LOH teer-TSEH

tokens.hebrew: זִבְחֵי אֱלֹהִים רוּחַ נִשְׁבָּרָה לֵב־נִשְׁבָּר וְנִדְכֶּה אֱלֹהִים לֹא תִבְזֶה׃
tokens.translation: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, Thou wilt not despise.
tokens.transliteration: zee-ve-KHEY eh-loh-HEEM ROO-ahkh neesh-bah-RAH lehv neesh-BAHR ve-need-KEH eh-loh-HEEM LOH teev-ZEH

tokens.hebrew: הֵיטִיבָה בִרְצוֹנְךָ אֶת־צִיּוֹן תִּבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם׃
tokens.translation: Do good in Thy favour unto Zion; build Thou the walls of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: hey-TEE-vah veer-tsoh-ne-KHAH eht tsee-YOHN teev-NEH khoh-MOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem

tokens.hebrew: אָז תַּחְפֹּץ זִבְחֵי־צֶדֶק עוֹלָה וְכָלִיל אָז יַעֲלוּ עַל־מִזְבַּחֲךָ פָרִים׃
tokens.translation: Then wilt Thou delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt-offering and whole offering; Then will they offer bullocks upon Thine altar.
tokens.transliteration: AHZ tahkh-POHTS zeev-khey tseh-DEHK oh-LAH ve-khah-LEEL AHZ yah-ah-LOO ahl meez-bah-khah-KHAH fah-REEM

title: Psalm 52
sefariaRef: Psalms 52
useCase: Destructive speech and trust Themes: relationships, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. Maschil of David;

tokens.hebrew: בְּבוֹא דּוֹאֵג הָאֲדֹמִי וַיַּגֵּד לְשָׁאוּל וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בָּא דָוִד אֶל־בֵּית אֲחִימֶלֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him: 'David is come to the house of Ahimelech.'
tokens.transliteration: be-VOH doh-EHG hah-ah-doh-MEE vah-yah-GEHD le-shah-OOL vah-YOH-mehr LOH BAH dah-VEED ehl BEYT ah-khee-MEH-lehkh

tokens.hebrew: מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּל בְּרָעָה הַגִּבּוֹר חֶסֶד אֵל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Why boastest thou thyself of evil, O mighty man? The mercy of God endureth continually.
tokens.transliteration: mahh teet-hah-LEHL be-rah-AH hah-gee-BOHR KHEH-sehd EHL kohl hah-YOHM

tokens.hebrew: הַוּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁב לְשׁוֹנֶךָ כְּתַעַר מְלֻטָּשׁ עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה׃
tokens.translation: Thy tongue deviseth destruction; Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
tokens.transliteration: hah-VOHT tahkh-SHOHV le-shoh-NEH-khah ke-TAH-ahr me-loo-TAHSH oh-SEH re-mee-YAH

tokens.hebrew: אָהַבְתָּ רָּע מִטּוֹב שֶׁקֶר מִדַּבֵּר צֶדֶק סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou lovest evil more than good; Falsehood rather than speaking righteousness. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-HAHV-tah RAH mee-TOHV SHEH-kehr mee-dah-BEHR TSEH-dehk SEH-lah

tokens.translation: Thou lovest all devouring words, The deceitful tongue.
tokens.transliteration: ah-HAHV-tah khahl deev-rey VAH-lah le-SHOHN meer-MAH

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־אֵל יִתָּצְךָ לָנֶצַח יַחְתְּךָ וְיִסָּחֲךָ מֵאֹהֶל וְשֵׁרֶשְׁךָ מֵאֶרֶץ חַיִּים סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: God will likewise break thee for ever, He will take thee up, and pluck thee out of thy tent, And root thee out of the land of the living. Selah
tokens.transliteration: gahm EHL yee-tah-tse-KHAH lah-NEH-tsahkh yahkh-te-KHAH ve-yee-sah-khah-KHAH meh-OH-hehl ve-sheh-rehsh-KHAH meh-EH-rehts khah-YEEM SEH-lah

tokens.translation: The righteous also shall see, and fear, And shall laugh at him:

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה הַגֶּבֶר לֹא יָשִׂים אֱלֹהִים מָעוּזּוֹ וַיִּבְטַח בְּרֹב עָשְׁרוֹ יָעֹז בְּהַוָּתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: 'Lo, this is the man that made not God his stronghold; But trusted in the abundance of his riches, And strengthened himself in his wickedness.'
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH hah-GEH-vehr LOH yah-SEEM eh-loh-HEEM mah-oo-ZOH vah-yeev-TAHKH be-ROHV ohsh-ROH yah-OHZ be-hah-vah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כְּזַיִת רַעֲנָן בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי בְחֶסֶד־אֱלֹהִים עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, I am like a leafy olive-tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ke-ZAH-yeet rah-ah-NAHN be-VEYT eh-loh-HEEM bah-TAHKH-tee ve-kheh-sehd eh-loh-HEEM oh-LAHM vah-EHD

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲקַוֶּה שִׁמְךָ כִי־טוֹב נֶגֶד חֲסִידֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I will give Thee thanks for ever, because Thou hast done it; And I will wait for Thy name, for it is good, in the presence of Thy saints.
tokens.transliteration: oh-de-KHAH le-oh-LAHM KEE ah-SEE-tah vah-ah-kah-VEH sheem-KHAH khee TOHV NEH-gehd khah-see-DEY-khah

title: Psalm 53
sefariaRef: Psalms 53
useCase: Corruption and longing for deliverance Themes: justice, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Mahalath. Maschil of David.

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר נָבָל בְּלִבּוֹ אֵין אֱלֹהִים הִשְׁחִיתוּ וְהִתְעִיבוּ עָוֶל אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: The fool hath said in his heart: 'There is no God'; They have dealt corruptly, and have done abominable iniquity; There is none that doeth good.
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR nah-VAHL be-lee-BOH EYN eh-loh-HEEM hee-she-KHEE-too ve-hee-te-EE-voo ah-VEHL EYN oh-seh TOHV

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁקִיף עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם לִרְאוֹת הֲיֵשׁ מַשְׂכִּיל דֹּרֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: God looked forth from heaven upon the children of men, To see if there were any man of understanding, that did seek after God.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM mee-shah-mah-YEEM heesh-KEEF ahl be-NEY ah-DAHM leer-OHT hah-YEHSH mahs-KEEL doh-REHSH eht eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלּוֹ סָג יַחְדָּו נֶאֱלָחוּ אֵין עֹשֵׂה־טוֹב אֵין גַּם־אֶחָד׃
tokens.translation: Every one of them is unclean, they are together become impure; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
tokens.transliteration: koo-LOH SAHG yahkh-DAHV neh-eh-LAH-khoo EYN oh-seh TOHV EYN gahm eh-KHAHD

tokens.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָדְעוּ פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן אֹכְלֵי עַמִּי אָכְלוּ לֶחֶם אֱלֹהִים לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
tokens.translation: ’Shall not the workers of iniquity know it, Who eat up My people as they eat bread, And call not upon God?'
tokens.transliteration: hah-LOH yah-de-OO POH-ah-LEY AH-vehn oh-khe-LEY ah-MEE OHKH-loo LEH-khehm eh-loh-HEEM LOH kah-RAH-oo

tokens.hebrew: שָׁם פָּחֲדוּ־פַחַד לֹא־הָיָה פָחַד כִּי־אֱלֹהִים פִּזַּר עַצְמוֹת חֹנָךְ הֱבִשֹׁתָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מְאָסָם׃
tokens.translation: There are they in great fear, where no fear was; For God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee; Thou hast put them to shame, because God hath rejected them.
tokens.transliteration: SHAHM pah-khah-doo fah-KHAHD loh HAH-YAH FAH-khahd kee eh-loh-HEEM pee-ZAHR ahts-MOHT khoh-NAHKH heh-vee-SHOH-tah kee eh-loh-HEEM me-ah-SAHM

tokens.hebrew: מִי יִתֵּן מִצִּיּוֹן יְשֻׁעוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּשׁוּב אֱלֹהִים שְׁבוּת עַמּוֹ יָגֵל יַעֲקֹב יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God turneth the captivity of His people, Let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
tokens.transliteration: MEE yee-TEHN mee-tsee-YOHN ye-shoo-OHT yees-rah-EHL be-SHOOV eh-loh-HEEM she-VOOT ah-MOH yah-GEHL yah-ah-KOHV yees-MAHKH yees-rah-EHL

title: Psalm 54
sefariaRef: Psalms 54
useCase: An appeal for rescue Themes: protection, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David:

tokens.hebrew: בְּבוֹא הַזִּיפִים וַיֹּאמְרוּ לְשָׁאוּל הֲלֹא דָוִד מִסְתַּתֵּר עִמָּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: when the Ziphites came and said to Saul: 'Doth not David hide himself with us?'
tokens.transliteration: be-VOH hah-zee-FEEM vah-yoh-me-ROO le-shah-OOL hah-LOH dah-VEED mees-tah-TEHR ee-MAH-noo

tokens.translation: O God, save me by Thy name, And right me by Thy might.
O God, hear my prayer; give ear to the words of my mouth.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM she-MAH te-fee-lah-TEE hah-ah-ZEE-nah le-eem-rey FEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּי זָרִים קָמוּ עָלַי וְעָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי לֹא שָׂמוּ אֱלֹהִים לְנֶגְדָּם סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: For strangers are risen up against me, And violent men have sought after my soul; They have not set God before them. Selah
tokens.transliteration: KEE zah-REEM KAH-moo ah-LAHY ve-ah-ree-TSEEM beek-SHOO nahf-SHEE LOH SAH-moo eh-loh-HEEM le-nehg-DAHM SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה אֱלֹהִים עֹזֵר לִי אֲדֹנָי בְּסֹמְכֵי נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: Behold, God is my helper; The Lord is for me as the upholder of my soul.
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH eh-loh-HEEM oh-ZEHR LEE ah-doh-NAHY be-soh-me-KHEY nahf-SHEE

tokens.translation: He will requite the evil unto them that lie in wait for me; Destroy Thou them in Thy truth.

tokens.hebrew: בִּנְדָבָה אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּךְ אוֹדֶה שִּׁמְךָ יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: With a freewill-offering will I sacrifice unto Thee; I will give thanks unto Thy name, O LORD, for it is good.
tokens.transliteration: been-dah-VAH ehz-be-khah LAHKH OH-deh sheem-KHAH ah-doh-NAI kee TOHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מִכָּל־צָרָה הִצִּילָנִי וּבְאֹיְבַי רָאֲתָה עֵינִי׃
tokens.translation: For He hath delivered me out of all trouble; And mine eye hath gazed upon mine enemies.
tokens.transliteration: KEE mee-kohl tsah-RAH hee-tsee-LAH-nee oo-ve-oh-ye-VAHY rah-ah-TAH ey-NEE
