title: Psalm 55
sefariaRef: Psalms 55
summary: Betrayal, anguish, and casting one's burden on God
useCase: Betrayal, anguish, and casting one's burden on God Themes: wellness, relationships, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. Maschil of David.
Give ear, O God, to my prayer; And hide not Thyself from my supplication.
tokens.transliteration: hah-ah-ZEE-nah eh-loh-HEEM te-fee-lah-TEE ve-ahl teet-ah-LAHM mee-te-khee-nah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: הַקְשִׁיבָה לִּי וַעֲנֵנִי אָרִיד בְּשִׂיחִי וְאָהִימָה׃
tokens.translation: Attend unto me, and hear me; I am distraught in my complaint, and will moan;
tokens.transliteration: hahk-SHEE-vah LEE vah-ah-NEH-nee ah-REED be-see-KHEE ve-ah-HEE-mah

tokens.hebrew: מִקּוֹל אוֹיֵב מִפְּנֵי עָקַת רָשָׁע כִּי־יָמִיטוּ עָלַי אָוֶן וּבְאַף יִשְׂטְמוּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast mischief upon me, and in anger they persecute me.
tokens.transliteration: mee-KOHL oh-YEHV mee-pe-NEY ah-KAHT rah-SHAH kee yah-MEE-too ah-LAHY ah-VEHN oo-ve-AHF yees-te-MOO-nee

tokens.hebrew: לִבִּי יָחִיל בְּקִרְבִּי וְאֵימוֹת מָוֶת נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: My heart doth writhe within me; and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
tokens.transliteration: lee-BEE yah-KHEEL be-keer-BEE ve-ey-MOHT mah-VEHT nah-fe-LOO ah-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: יִרְאָה וָרַעַד יָבֹא בִי וַתְּכַסֵּנִי פַּלָּצוּת׃
tokens.translation: Fear and trembling come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
tokens.transliteration: yeer-AH vah-rah-AHD YAH-voh VEE vah-te-khah-SEH-nee pah-lah-TSOOT

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמַר מִי־יִתֶּן־לִּי אֵבֶר כַּיּוֹנָה אָעוּפָה וְאֶשְׁכֹּנָה׃
tokens.translation: And I said: 'Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.
tokens.transliteration: vah-oh-MAHR mee yee-tehn LEE eh-VEHR kah-yoh-NAH ah-OO-fah ve-ehsh-KOH-nah

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה אַרְחִיק נְדֹד אָלִין בַּמִּדְבָּר סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. Selah
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH ahr-KHEEK ne-DOHD ah-LEEN bah-meed-BAHR SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אָחִישָׁה מִפְלָט לִי מֵרוּחַ סֹעָה מִסָּעַר׃
tokens.translation: I would haste me to a shelter from the stormy wind and tempest.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-KHEE-shah meef-LAHT LEE meh-ROO-ahkh soh-AH mee-SAH-ahr

tokens.hebrew: בַּלַּע אֲדֹנָי פַּלַּג לְשׁוֹנָם כִּי־רָאִיתִי חָמָס וְרִיב בָּעִיר׃
tokens.translation: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.
tokens.transliteration: bah-LAH ah-doh-NAHY pah-LAHG le-shoh-NAHM kee rah-EE-tee khah-MAHS ve-REEV bah-EER

tokens.hebrew: יוֹמָם וָלַיְלָה יְסוֹבְבֻהָ עַל־חוֹמֹתֶיהָ וְאָוֶן וְעָמָל בְּקִרְבָּהּ׃
tokens.translation: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof; iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-MAHM vah-LAHY-lah ye-soh-ve-VOO-hah ahl khoh-moh-TEY-hah ve-AH-vehn ve-ah-MAHL be-keer-BAHH

tokens.hebrew: הַוּוֹת בְּקִרְבָּהּ וְלֹא־יָמִישׁ מֵרְחֹבָהּ תֹּךְ וּמִרְמָה׃
tokens.translation: Wickedness is in the midst thereof; oppression and guile depart not from her broad place.
tokens.transliteration: hah-VOHT be-keer-BAHH ve-loh yah-MEESH meh-re-khoh-VAHH TOHKH oo-meer-MAH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־אוֹיֵב יְחָרְפֵנִי וְאֶשָּׂא לֹא־מְשַׂנְאִי עָלַי הִגְדִּיל וְאֶסָּתֵר מִמֶּנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: For it was not an enemy that taunted me, Then I could have borne it; Neither was it mine adversary that did magnify himself against me, Then I would have hid myself from him.
tokens.transliteration: KEE loh oh-YEHV ye-khah-re-FEH-nee ve-eh-SAH loh me-sahn-EE ah-LAHY heeg-DEEL ve-eh-sah-TEHR mee-MEH-noo

tokens.translation: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend;

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָגֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: We took sweet counsel together, In the house of God we walked with the throng.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR yahkh-DAHV nahm-TEEK SOHD be-VEYT eh-loh-HEEM ne-hah-LEHKH be-RAH-gehsh

tokens.hebrew: ישימות [יַשִּׁי] [מָוֶת ] עָלֵימוֹ יֵרְדוּ שְׁאוֹל חַיִּים כִּי־רָעוֹת בִּמְגוּרָם בְּקִרְבָּם׃
tokens.translation: May He incite death against them, Let them go down alive into the nether-world; For evil is in their dwelling, and within them.
tokens.transliteration: yah-SHEE MAH-veht ah-LEY-moh yeh-re-DOO she-OHL khah-YEEM kee rah-OHT beem-goo-RAHM be-keer-BAHM

tokens.translation: As for me, I will call upon God; And the LORD shall save me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NEE ehl eh-loh-HEEM ehk-RAH vah-ah-doh-NAI yoh-shee-EH-nee

tokens.hebrew: עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר וְצָהֳרַיִם אָשִׂיחָה וְאֶהֱמֶה וַיִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי׃
tokens.translation: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I complain, and moan; And He hath heard my voice.
tokens.transliteration: EH-rehv vah-VOH-kehr ve-tsoh-hoh-rah-YEEM ah-SEE-khah ve-eh-heh-MEH vah-yeesh-MAH koh-LEE

tokens.hebrew: פָּדָה בְשָׁלוֹם נַפְשִׁי מִקֲּרָב־לִי כִּי־בְרַבִּים הָיוּ עִמָּדִי׃
tokens.translation: He hath redeemed my soul in peace so that none came nigh me; For they were many that strove with me.
tokens.transliteration: pah-DAH ve-shah-LOHM nahf-SHEE mee-kah-rohv LEE kee ve-rah-BEEM hah-YOO ee-mah-DEE

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁמַע אֵל וְיַעֲנֵם וְיֹשֵׁב קֶדֶם סֶלָה אֲשֶׁר אֵין חֲלִיפוֹת לָמוֹ וְלֹא יָרְאוּ אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: God shall hear, and humble them, even He that is enthroned of old, Selah, such as have no changes, and fear not God.
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-MAH EHL ve-yah-ah-NEHM ve-YOH-SHEHV KEH-dehm SEH-lah ah-SHEHR EYN khah-lee-FOHT LAH-moh ve-LOH yah-re-OO eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.translation: He hath put forth his hands against them that were at peace with him; He hath profaned his covenant.

tokens.hebrew: חָלְקוּ מַחְמָאֹת פִּיו וּקֲרָב־לִבּוֹ רַכּוּ דְבָרָיו מִשֶּׁמֶן וְהֵמָּה פְתִחוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Smoother than cream were the speeches of his mouth, But his heart was war; His words were softer than oil, Yet were they keen-edged swords.
tokens.transliteration: khah-le-KOO mahkh-mah-OHT PEEV oo-kah-rohv lee-BOH rah-KOO de-vah-RAHV mee-SHEH-mehn ve-HEH-mah fe-tee-KHOHT

tokens.hebrew: הַשְׁלֵךְ עַל־יְהוָה יְהָבְךָ וְהוּא יְכַלְכְּלֶךָ לֹא־יִתֵּן לְעוֹלָם מוֹט לַצַּדִּיק׃
tokens.translation: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and He will sustain thee; He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.
tokens.transliteration: hahsh-LEHKH ahl ah-doh-NAI ye-hah-ve-KHAH ve-HOO ye-khahl-ke-LEH-khah loh yee-TEHN le-oh-LAHM MOHT lah-tsah-DEEK

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֱלֹהִים תּוֹרִדֵם לִבְאֵר שַׁחַת אַנְשֵׁי דָמִים וּמִרְמָה לֹא־יֶחֱצוּ יְמֵיהֶם וַאֲנִי אֶבְטַח־בָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: But Thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the nethermost pit; Men of blood and deceit shall not live out half their days; But as for me, I will trust in Thee.

title: Psalm 56
sefariaRef: Psalms 56
useCase: Fear, tears, and trust Themes: wellness, protection, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־יוֹנַת אֵלֶם רְחֹקִים לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בֶּאֱחֹז אֹתוֹ פְלִשְׁתִּים בְּגַת׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Jonath-elem-rehokim. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when the Philistines took him in Gath. .
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl YOH-naht EH-lehm re-khoh-KEEM le-dah-VEED meekh-TAHM beh-eh-KHOHZ oh-TOH fe-leesh-TEEM be-GAHT

tokens.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי־שְׁאָפַנִי אֱנוֹשׁ כָּל־הַיּוֹם לֹחֵם יִלְחָצֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O God, for man would swallow me up; All the day he fighting oppresseth me.
tokens.transliteration: khoh-NEH-nee eh-loh-HEEM kee she-ah-FAH-nee eh-NOHSH kohl hah-YOHM loh-KHEHM yeel-khah-TSEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: שָׁאֲפוּ שׁוֹרְרַי כָּל־הַיּוֹם כִּי־רַבִּים לֹחֲמִים לִי מָרוֹם׃
tokens.translation: They that lie in wait for me would swallow me up all the day; For they are many that fight against me, O Most High,
tokens.transliteration: shah-ah-FOO shoh-re-RAHY kohl hah-YOHM kee rah-BEEM loh-khah-MEEM LEE mah-ROHM

tokens.translation: In the day that I am afraid, I will put my trust in Thee.

tokens.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דְּבָרוֹ בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה בָשָׂר לִי׃
tokens.translation: In God—I will praise His word— In God do I trust, I will not be afraid; What can flesh do unto me?
tokens.transliteration: beh-loh-HEEM ah-hah-LEHL de-vah-ROH beh-loh-HEEM bah-tahkh-TEE LOH ee-RAH mahh yah-ah-SEH vah-SAHR LEE

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם דְּבָרַי יְעַצֵּבוּ עָלַי כָּל־מַחְשְׁבֹתָם לָרָע׃
tokens.translation: All the day they trouble mine affairs; All their thoughts are against me for evil.
tokens.transliteration: kohl hah-YOHM de-vah-RAHY ye-ah-TSEH-voo ah-LAHY kohl mahkh-she-voh-TAHM lah-RAH

tokens.hebrew: יָגוּרוּ יצפינו [יִצְפּוֹנוּ] הֵמָּה עֲקֵבַי יִשְׁמֹרוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר קִוּוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, They mark my steps; According as they have waited for my soul.
tokens.transliteration: yah-GOO-roo yeets-POH-noo heh-MAH ah-keh-VAHY yeesh-MOH-roo kah-ah-SHEHR kee-VOO nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: עַל־אָוֶן פַּלֶּט־לָמוֹ בְּאַף עַמִּים הוֹרֵד אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Because of iniquity cast them out; In anger bring down the peoples, O God.
tokens.transliteration: ahl AH-vehn pah-leht LAH-moh be-AHF ah-MEEM hoh-REHD eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: נֹדִי סָפַרְתָּה אָתָּה שִׂימָה דִמְעָתִי בְנֹאדֶךָ הֲלֹא בְּסִפְרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou has counted my wanderings; Put Thou my tears into Thy bottle; Are they not in Thy book?
tokens.transliteration: noh-DEE sah-FAHR-TAH AH-tah SEE-mah deem-ah-TEE ve-noh-DEH-khah hah-LOH be-seef-rah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אָז יָשׁוּבוּ אוֹיְבַי אָחוֹר בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא זֶה־יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־אֱלֹהִים לִי׃
tokens.translation: Then shall mine enemies turn back in the day that I call; This I know, that God is for me.
tokens.transliteration: AHZ yah-SHOO-voo oh-ye-VAHY ah-KHOHR be-YOHM ehk-RAH zeh yah-DAH-tee kee eh-loh-HEEM LEE

tokens.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר בַּיהוָה אֲהַלֵּל דָּבָר׃
tokens.translation: In God—I will praise His word— In the LORD—I will praise His word—
tokens.transliteration: beh-loh-HEEM ah-hah-LEHL dah-VAHR bah-ah-doh-NAI ah-hah-LEHL dah-VAHR

tokens.hebrew: בֵּאלֹהִים בָּטַחְתִּי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה אָדָם לִי׃
tokens.translation: In God do I trust, I will not be afraid; What can man do unto me?
tokens.transliteration: beh-loh-HEEM bah-tahkh-TEE LOH ee-RAH mahh yah-ah-SEH ah-DAHM LEE

tokens.hebrew: עָלַי אֱלֹהִים נְדָרֶיךָ אֲשַׁלֵּם תּוֹדֹת לָךְ׃
tokens.translation: Thy vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank-offerings unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-LAHY eh-loh-HEEM ne-dah-REY-khah ah-shah-LEHM toh-DOHT LAHKH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת הֲלֹא רַגְלַי מִדֶּחִי לְהִתְהַלֵּךְ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים בְּאוֹר הַחַיִּים׃
tokens.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death; Hast Thou not delivered my feet from stumbling? That I may walk before God in the light of the living?
tokens.transliteration: KEE hee-TSAHL-tah nahf-SHEE mee-mah-VEHT hah-LOH rahg-LAHY mee-DEH-khee le-hee-te-hah-LEHKH leef-NEY eh-loh-HEEM be-OHR hah-khah-YEEM

title: Psalm 57
sefariaRef: Psalms 57
useCase: Refuge and steadfast praise Themes: protection, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי־שָׁאוּל בַּמְּעָרָה׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when he fled from Saul, in the cave.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl tahsh-KHEHT le-dah-VEED meekh-TAHM be-vah-re-KHOH mee-pe-ney shah-OOL bah-me-ah-RAH

tokens.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֱלֹהִים חָנֵּנִי כִּי בְךָ חָסָיָה נַפְשִׁי וּבְצֵל־כְּנָפֶיךָ אֶחְסֶה עַד יַעֲבֹר הַוּוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O God, be gracious unto me, for in Thee hath my soul taken refuge; yea, in the shadow of Thy wings will I take refuge, until calamities be overpast.
tokens.transliteration: khoh-NEH-nee eh-loh-HEEM khoh-NEH-nee KEE ve-KHAH khah-SAH-yah nahf-SHEE oo-ve-tsehl ke-nah-FEY-khah ehkh-SEH AHD yah-ah-VOHR hah-VOHT

tokens.hebrew: אֶקְרָא לֵאלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן לָאֵל גֹּמֵר עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: I will cry unto God Most high; unto God that accomplisheth it for me.
tokens.transliteration: ehk-RAH leh-loh-HEEM ehl-YOHN lah-EHL goh-MEHR ah-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח מִשָּׁמַיִם וְיוֹשִׁיעֵנִי חֵרֵף שֹׁאֲפִי סֶלָה יִשְׁלַח אֱלֹהִים חַסְדּוֹ וַאֲמִתּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He will send from heaven, and save me, when he that would swallow me up taunteth, Selah; God shall send forth His mercy and His truth.
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-LAHKH mee-shah-MAH-yeem ve-yoh-shee-EH-nee kheh-REHF shoh-ah-FEE SEH-lah yeesh-LAHKH eh-loh-HEEM khahs-DOH vah-ah-mee-TOH

tokens.hebrew: נַפְשִׁי בְּתוֹךְ לְבָאִם אֶשְׁכְּבָה לֹהֲטִים בְּנֵי־אָדָם שִׁנֵּיהֶם חֲנִית וְחִצִּים וּלְשׁוֹנָם חֶרֶב חַדָּה׃
tokens.translation: My soul is among lions, I do lie down among them that are aflame; Even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, And their tongue a sharp sword.
tokens.transliteration: nahf-SHEE be-TOHKH le-vah-EEM ehsh-ke-VAH loh-hah-TEEM be-ney ah-DAHM shee-ney-HEHM khah-NEET ve-khee-TSEEM oo-le-shoh-NAHM KHEH-rehv khah-DAH

tokens.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־הַשָּׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ROO-mah ahl hah-shah-MAH-yeem eh-loh-HEEM AHL kohl hah-AH-rehts ke-voh-DEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: רֶשֶׁת הֵכִינוּ לִפְעָמַי כָּפַף נַפְשִׁי כָּרוּ לְפָנַי שִׁיחָה נָפְלוּ בְתוֹכָהּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: They have prepared a net for my steps, My soul is bowed down; They have digged a pit before me, They are fallen into the midst thereof themselves. Selah
tokens.transliteration: REH-sheht heh-KHEE-noo leef-ah-MAHY kah-FAHF nahf-SHEE kah-ROO le-fah-NAHY shee-KHAH nah-fe-LOO ve-toh-KHAHH SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים נָכוֹן לִבִּי אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמֵּרָה׃
tokens.translation: My heart is stedfast, O God, my heart is stedfast; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises.
tokens.transliteration: nah-KHOHN lee-BEE eh-loh-HEEM nah-KHOHN lee-BEE ah-SHEE-rah vah-ah-zah-MEH-rah

tokens.hebrew: עוּרָה כְבוֹדִי עוּרָה הַנֵּבֶל וְכִנּוֹר אָעִירָה שָּׁחַר׃
tokens.translation: Awake, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
tokens.transliteration: OO-rah khe-voh-DEE oo-RAH hah-NEH-vehl ve-khee-NOHR ah-EE-rah SHAH-khahr

tokens.translation: I will give thanks unto Thee, O Lord, among the peoples; I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
tokens.transliteration: oh-de-KHAH vah-ah-MEEM ah-doh-NAHY ah-zah-mehr-KHAH bahl oo-MEEM

tokens.translation: For Thy mercy is great unto the heavens, And Thy truth unto the skies.
tokens.transliteration: kee gah-DOHL ahd shah-MAH-yeem khahs-DEH-khah ve-ahd she-khah-KEEM ah-mee-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים עַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; Thy glory be above all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ROO-mah ahl shah-MAH-yeem eh-loh-HEEM AHL kohl hah-AH-rehts ke-voh-DEH-khah

title: Psalm 58
sefariaRef: Psalms 58
useCase: Condemnation of unjust judgment Themes: justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam.

tokens.hebrew: הַאֻמְנָם אֵלֶם צֶדֶק תְּדַבֵּרוּן מֵישָׁרִים תִּשְׁפְּטוּ בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Do ye indeed speak as a righteous company? Do ye judge with equity the sons of men?
tokens.transliteration: hah-oom-NAHM EH-lehm tseh-DEHK te-dah-beh-ROON mey-shah-REEM teesh-pe-TOO be-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: אַף־בְּלֵב עוֹלֹת תִּפְעָלוּן בָּאָרֶץ חֲמַס יְדֵיכֶם תְּפַלֵּסוּן׃
tokens.translation: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; Ye weigh out in the earth the violence of your hands.
tokens.transliteration: ahf be-LEHV oh-LOHT teef-ah-LOON bah-AH-rehts khah-MAHS ye-dey-KHEHM te-fah-leh-SOON

tokens.hebrew: זֹרוּ רְשָׁעִים מֵרָחֶם תָּעוּ מִבֶּטֶן דֹּבְרֵי כָזָב׃
tokens.translation: The wicked are estranged from the womb; The speakers of lies go astray as soon as they are born.
tokens.transliteration: ZOH-roo re-shah-EEM meh-RAH-khehm tah-OO mee-BEH-tehn doh-ve-REY khah-ZAHV

tokens.hebrew: חֲמַת־לָמוֹ כִּדְמוּת חֲמַת־נָחָשׁ כְּמוֹ־פֶתֶן חֵרֵשׁ יַאְטֵם אָזְנוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Their venom is like the venom of a serpent; They are like the deaf asp that stoppeth her ear;
tokens.transliteration: khah-maht LAH-moh keed-MOOT khah-maht nah-KHAHSH ke-moh FEH-tehn kheh-REHSH yah-TEHM ohz-NOH

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִשְׁמַע לְקוֹל מְלַחֲשִׁים חוֹבֵר חֲבָרִים מְחֻכָּם׃
tokens.translation: Which hearkeneth not to the voice of charmers, Or of the most cunning binder of spells.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR loh yeesh-MAH le-KOHL me-lah-khah-SHEEM khoh-VEHR khah-vah-REEM me-khoo-KAHM

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים הֲרָס־שִׁנֵּימוֹ בְּפִימוֹ מַלְתְּעוֹת כְּפִירִים נְתֹץ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth; Break out the cheek-teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM hah-rahs shee-NEY-moh be-FEE-moh mahl-te-OHT ke-fee-REEM ne-TOHTS ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: יִמָּאֲסוּ כְמוֹ־מַיִם יִתְהַלְּכוּ־לָמוֹ יִדְרֹךְ חצו [חִצָּיו] כְּמוֹ יִתְמֹלָלוּ׃
tokens.translation: Let them melt away as water that runneth apace; When he aimeth his arrows, let them be as though they were cut off.
tokens.transliteration: yee-mah-ah-SOO khe-moh mah-YEEM yeet-hah-le-khoo LAH-moh yeed-ROHKH khee-TSAHV ke-MOH yeet-moh-LAH-loo

tokens.hebrew: כְּמוֹ שַׁבְּלוּל תֶּמֶס יַהֲלֹךְ נֵפֶל אֵשֶׁת בַּל־חָזוּ שָׁמֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Let them be as a snail which melteth and passeth away; Like the untimely births of a woman, that have not seen the sun.
tokens.transliteration: ke-MOH shah-be-LOOL TEH-mehs yah-hah-LOHKH NEH-fehl eh-SHEHT bahl KHAH-zoo SHAH-mehsh

tokens.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם יָבִינוּ סִּירֹתֵיכֶם אָטָד כְּמוֹ־חַי כְּמוֹ־חָרוֹן יִשְׂעָרֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Before your pots can feel the thorns, He will sweep it away with a whirlwind, the raw and the burning alike.
tokens.transliteration: be-TEH-rehm yah-VEE-noo see-roh-tey-KHEHM ah-TAHD ke-moh KHAHY ke-moh khah-ROHN yees-ah-REH-noo

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק כִּי־חָזָה נָקָם פְּעָמָיו יִרְחַץ בְּדַם הָרָשָׁע׃
tokens.translation: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance; He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: yees-MAHKH tsah-DEEK kee khah-ZAH nah-KAHM pe-ah-MAHV yeer-KHAHTS be-DAHM hah-rah-SHAH

tokens.hebrew: וְיֹאמַר אָדָם אַךְ־פְּרִי לַצַּדִּיק אַךְ יֵשׁ־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפְטִים בָּאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: And men shall say: 'Verily there is a reward for the righteous; Verily there is a God that judgeth in the earth.'
tokens.transliteration: ve-yoh-MAHR ah-DAHM ahkh pe-REE lah-tsah-DEEK AHKH yehsh eh-loh-HEEM shoh-fe-TEEM bah-AH-rehts

title: Psalm 59
sefariaRef: Psalms 59
useCase: Protection from violent enemies Themes: protection, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ אַל־תַּשְׁחֵת לְדָוִד מִכְתָּם בִּשְׁלֹחַ שָׁאוּל וַיִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת־הַבַּיִת לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. [A Psalm] of David; Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl tahsh-KHEHT le-dah-VEED meekh-TAHM beesh-LOH-ahkh shah-OOL vah-yeesh-me-ROO eht hah-BAH-yeet lah-hah-mee-TOH

tokens.translation: Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God; set me on high from them that rise up against me.

tokens.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִפֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן וּמֵאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from the men of blood.
tokens.transliteration: hah-tsee-leh-NEE mee-POH-ah-ley AH-vehn oo-meh-ahn-SHEY dah-MEEM hoh-shee-EH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה אָרְבוּ לְנַפְשִׁי יָגוּרוּ עָלַי עַזִים לֹא־פִשְׁעִי וְלֹא־חַטָּאתִי יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul; the impudent gather themselves together against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O LORD.
tokens.transliteration: KEE hee-NEH ah-re-VOO le-nahf-SHEE yah-GOO-roo ah-LAHY ah-ZEEM loh feesh-EE ve-loh khah-tah-TEE ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: בְּלִי־עָוֺן יְרוּצוּן וְיִכּוֹנָנוּ עוּרָה לִקְרָאתִי וּרְאֵה׃
tokens.translation: Without my fault, they run and prepare themselves; awake Thou to help me, and behold.
tokens.transliteration: be-lee ah-VOHN ye-roo-TSOON ve-yee-koh-NAH-noo OO-rah leek-rah-TEE oo-re-eh

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה־אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הָקִיצָה לִפְקֹד כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם אַל־תָּחֹן כָּל־בֹּגְדֵי אָוֶן סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, arouse Thyself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to any iniquitous traitors. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH ah-doh-NAIeh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT eh-loh-HEY yees-rah-EHL hah-KEE-tsah leef-KOHD kahl hah-goh-YEEM ahl tah-KHOHN kohl BOH-ge-dey AH-vehn SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃
tokens.translation: They return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
tokens.transliteration: yah-SHOO-voo lah-eh-REHV yeh-heh-MOO khah-KAH-lehv vee-SOH-ve-voo EER

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּה יַבִּיעוּן בְּפִיהֶם חֲרָבוֹת בְּשִׂפְתוֹתֵיהֶם כִּי־מִי שֹׁמֵעַ׃
tokens.translation: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: 'For who doth hear?'
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH yah-bee-OON be-fee-HEHM khah-rah-VOHT be-seef-toh-tey-HEHM kee MEE shoh-MEH-ah

tokens.translation: But Thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; Thou shalt have all the nations in derision.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI tees-khahk LAH-moh teel-AHG le-khohl goh-YEEM

tokens.translation: Because of his strength, I will wait for Thee; for God is my high tower.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ZOH eh-LEY-khah ehsh-MOH-rah kee eh-loh-HEEM mees-gah-BEE

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵי חסדו [חַסְדִּי] יְקַדְּמֵנִי אֱלֹהִים יַרְאֵנִי בְשֹׁרְרָי׃
tokens.translation: The God of my mercy will come to meet me; God will let me gaze upon mine adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEY khahs-DEE ye-kah-de-MEH-nee eh-loh-HEEM yahr-EH-nee ve-shoh-re-RAHY

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּהַרְגֵם פֶּן־יִשְׁכְּחוּ עַמִּי הֲנִיעֵמוֹ בְחֵילְךָ וְהוֹרִידֵמוֹ מָגִנֵּנוּ אֲדֹנָי׃
tokens.translation: Slay them not, lest my people forget, make them wander to and fro by Thy power, and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tah-hahr-GEHM pehn yeesh-ke-KHOO ah-MEE hah-nee-EH-moh ve-khey-le-KHAH ve-hoh-ree-DEH-moh mah-gee-NEH-noo ah-doh-NAHY

tokens.hebrew: חַטַּאת־פִּימוֹ דְּבַר־שְׂפָתֵימוֹ וְיִלָּכְדוּ בִגְאוֹנָם וּמֵאָלָה וּמִכַּחַשׁ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃
tokens.translation: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride, and for cursing and lying which they speak.
tokens.transliteration: khah-taht PEE-moh de-vahr se-fah-TEY-moh ve-yee-lah-khe-DOO veeg-oh-NAHM oo-meh-ah-LAH oo-mee-KAH-khahsh ye-sah-PEH-roo

tokens.hebrew: כַּלֵּה בְחֵמָה כַּלֵּה וְאֵינֵמוֹ וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מֹשֵׁל בְּיַעֲקֹב לְאַפְסֵי הָאָרֶץ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they be no more; and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah
tokens.transliteration: kah-LEH ve-kheh-MAH kah-LEH ve-ey-NEH-moh ve-yeh-de-OO kee eh-loh-HEEM moh-SHEHL be-yah-ah-KOHV le-ahf-SEY hah-AH-rehts SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: וְיָשׁוּבוּ לָעֶרֶב יֶהֱמוּ כַכָּלֶב וִיסוֹבְבוּ עִיר׃
tokens.translation: And they return at evening, they howl like a dog, and go round about the city;
tokens.transliteration: ve-yah-SHOO-voo lah-eh-REHV yeh-heh-MOO khah-KAH-lehv vee-SOH-ve-voo EER

tokens.hebrew: הֵמָּה ינועון [יְנִיעוּן] לֶאֱכֹל אִם־לֹא יִשְׂבְּעוּ וַיָּלִינוּ׃
tokens.translation: They wander up and down to devour, and tarry all night if they have not their fill.
tokens.transliteration: heh-MAH ye-nee-OON leh-eh-KHOHL eem LOH yees-be-OO vah-yah-LEE-noo

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אָשִׁיר עֻזֶּךָ וַאֲרַנֵּן לַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־הָיִיתָ מִשְׂגָּב לִי וּמָנוֹס בְּיוֹם צַר־לִי׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, I will sing of Thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of Thy mercy in the morning; for Thou hast been my high tower, and a refuge in the day of my distress.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-SHEER oo-zeh-KHAH vah-ah-rah-NEHN lah-BOH-kehr khahs-DEH-khah kee hah-YEE-tah mees-GAHV LEE oo-mah-NOHS be-YOHM tsahr LEE

tokens.hebrew: עֻזִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲזַמֵּרָה כִּי־אֱלֹהִים מִשְׂגַּבִּי אֱלֹהֵי חַסְדִּי׃
tokens.translation: O my strength, unto Thee will I sing praises; for God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ZEE eh-LEY-khah ah-zah-MEH-rah kee eh-loh-HEEM mees-gah-BEE eh-loh-HEY khahs-DEE

title: Psalm 60
sefariaRef: Psalms 60
useCase: Communal defeat and renewed hope Themes: community, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־שׁוּשַׁן עֵדוּת מִכְתָּם לְדָוִד לְלַמֵּד׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Shushan Eduth; Michtam of David, to teach;
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-tseh-AHKH ahl shoo-SHAHN eh-DOOT meekh-TAHM le-dah-VEED le-lah-MEHD

tokens.hebrew: בְּהַצּוֹתוֹ אֶת אֲרַם נַהֲרַיִם וְאֶת־אֲרַם צוֹבָה וַיָּשָׁב יוֹאָב וַיַּךְ אֶת־אֱדוֹם בְּגֵיא־מֶלַח שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר אָלֶף׃
tokens.translation: when he strove with Aram-naharaim and with Aram-zobah, and Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the Valley of Salt twelve thousand.
tokens.transliteration: be-hah-tsoh-TOH EHT ah-RAHM nah-hah-rah-YEEM ve-eht ah-RAHM tsoh-VAH vah-YAH-shohv yoh-AHV vah-YAHKH eht eh-DOHM be-gey MEH-lahkh she-NEYM ah-SAHR AH-lehf

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ פְרַצְתָּנוּ אָנַפְתָּ תְּשׁוֹבֵב לָנוּ׃
tokens.translation: O God, Thou hast cast us off, Thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; O restore us.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM ze-nahkh-TAH-noo fe-rahts-TAH-noo ah-NAHF-tah te-SHOH-VEHV LAH-noo

tokens.hebrew: הִרְעַשְׁתָּה אֶרֶץ פְּצַמְתָּהּ רְפָה שְׁבָרֶיהָ כִי־מָטָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast made the land to shake, Thou hast cleft it; Heal the breaches thereof; for it tottereth.
tokens.transliteration: heer-AHSH-tah EH-rehts pe-tsahm-TAHH re-FAH she-vah-REY-hah khee MAH-tah

tokens.hebrew: הִרְאִיתָה עַמְּךָ קָשָׁה הִשְׁקִיתָנוּ יַיִן תַּרְעֵלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast made Thy people to see hard things; Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.
tokens.transliteration: heer-EE-tah ah-me-KHAH kah-SHAH heesh-kee-TAH-noo YAH-yeen tahr-eh-LAH

tokens.hebrew: נָתַתָּה לִּירֵאֶיךָ נֵּס לְהִתְנוֹסֵס מִפְּנֵי קֹשֶׁט סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear Thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah
tokens.transliteration: nah-TAH-tah lee-reh-EY-khah NEHS le-heet-noh-SEHS mee-pe-NEY KOH-sheht SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ ועננו [וַעֲנֵנִי׃]
tokens.translation: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
tokens.transliteration: le-mah-AHN yeh-khah-le-TSOON ye-dee-DEY-khah hoh-SHEE-ah ye-mee-ne-KHAH vah-ah-NEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
tokens.translation: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM dee-BEHR be-kohd-SHOH eh-LOH-zah ah-khah-le-KAH she-KHEHM ve-EH-mehk soo-KOHT ah-mah-DEHD

tokens.hebrew: לִי גִלְעָד וְלִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
tokens.translation: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
tokens.transliteration: LEE geel-AHD ve-LEE me-nah-SHEH ve-ehf-rah-YEEM mah-OHZ roh-SHEE ye-hoo-DAH me-KHOH-ke-kee

tokens.hebrew: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עָלַי פְּלֶשֶׁת הִתְרֹעָעִי׃
tokens.translation: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Philistia, cry aloud because of me!
tokens.transliteration: moh-AHV SEER rahkh-TSEE ahl eh-DOHM ahsh-LEEKH nah-ah-LEE ah-LAHY pe-LEH-sheht heet-roh-ah-EE

tokens.hebrew: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מָצוֹר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
tokens.transliteration: MEE yoh-vee-leh-NEE EER mah-TSOHR MEE nah-KHAH-nee ahd eh-DOHM

tokens.hebrew: הֲלֹא־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים זְנַחְתָּנוּ וְלֹא־תֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים בְּצִבְאוֹתֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.
tokens.transliteration: hah-loh ah-TAH eh-loh-HEEM ze-nahkh-TAH-noo ve-loh teh-TSEH eh-loh-HEEM be-tseev-oh-TEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
tokens.transliteration: hah-vah LAH-noo ehz-RAHT mee-TSAHR ve-SHAHV te-shoo-AHT ah-dahm

tokens.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: beh-loh-HEEM nah-ah-seh KHAH-yeel ve-HOO yah-VOOS tsah-REY-noo

title: Psalm 61
sefariaRef: Psalms 61
useCase: Refuge and an enduring shelter Themes: protection, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. [A Psalm] of David.
Hear my cry, O God; Attend unto my prayer.

tokens.hebrew: מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא בַּעֲטֹף לִבִּי בְּצוּר־יָרוּם מִמֶּנִּי תַנְחֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: From the end of the earth will I call unto Thee, when my heart fainteth; Lead me to a rock that is too high for me.
tokens.transliteration: meek-TSEH hah-AH-rehts eh-LEY-khah ehk-RAH bah-ah-TOHF lee-BEE be-tsoor yah-ROOM mee-MEH-nee tahn-KHEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתָ מַחְסֶה לִי מִגְדַּל־עֹז מִפְּנֵי אוֹיֵב׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast been a refuge for me, A tower of strength in the face of the enemy.
tokens.transliteration: kee hah-YEE-tah mahkh-SEH LEE meeg-dahl OHZ mee-pe-NEY oh-YEHV

tokens.hebrew: אָגוּרָה בְאָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִים אֶחֱסֶה בְסֵתֶר כְּנָפֶיךָ סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: I will dwell in Thy Tent for ever; I will take refuge in the covert of Thy wings. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-GOO-rah ve-ah-hah-le-KHAH oh-lah-MEEM eh-kheh-SEH ve-SEH-tehr ke-nah-FEY-khah SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים שָׁמַעְתָּ לִנְדָרָי נָתַתָּ יְרֻשַּׁת יִרְאֵי שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou, O God, hast heard my vows; Thou hast granted the heritage of those that fear Thy name. .
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH eh-loh-HEEM shah-MAH-tah leen-dah-RAHY nah-TAH-tah ye-roo-SHAHT yeer-EY she-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: יָמִים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶלֶךְ תּוֹסִיף שְׁנוֹתָיו כְּמוֹ־דֹר וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: Mayest Thou add days unto the king's days! May his years be as many generations!
tokens.transliteration: yah-MEEM ahl ye-mey MEH-lehkh toh-SEEF she-noh-TAHV ke-moh DOHR vah-DOHR

tokens.hebrew: יֵשֵׁב עוֹלָם לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת מַן יִנְצְרֻהוּ׃
tokens.translation: May he be enthroned before God for ever! Appoint mercy and truth, that they may preserve him.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-SHEHV oh-LAHM leef-NEY eh-loh-HEEM KHEH-sehd veh-eh-MEHT MAHN yeen-tse-ROO-hoo

tokens.hebrew: כֵּן אֲזַמְּרָה שִׁמְךָ לָעַד לְשַׁלְּמִי נְדָרַי יוֹם יוֹם׃
tokens.translation: So will I sing praise unto Thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows.
tokens.transliteration: KEHN ah-zah-me-RAH sheem-KHAH lah-AHD le-shah-le-MEE ne-dah-RAHY YOHM YOHM

title: Psalm 62
sefariaRef: Psalms 62
summary: Quiet trust and the limits of wealth
useCase: Quiet trust and the limits of wealth Themes: wellness, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ אֶל־אֱלֹהִים דּוּמִיָּה נַפְשִׁי מִמֶּנּוּ יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Only for God doth my soul wait in stillness; From Him cometh my salvation.
tokens.transliteration: AHKH ehl eh-loh-HEEM doo-mee-YAH nahf-SHEE mee-MEH-noo ye-shoo-ah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא־אֶמּוֹט רַבָּה׃
tokens.translation: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be greatly moved.
tokens.transliteration: ahkh HOO tsoo-REE vee-shoo-ah-TEE mees-gah-BEE loh eh-MOHT rah-BAH

tokens.hebrew: עַד־אָנָה תְּהוֹתְתוּ עַל אִישׁ תְּרָצְּחוּ כֻלְּכֶם כְּקִיר נָטוּי גָּדֵר הַדְּחוּיָה׃
tokens.translation: How long will ye set upon a man, That ye may slay him, all of you, As a leaning wall, a tottering fence?
tokens.transliteration: ahd AH-nah te-hoh-te-TOO ahl EESH te-rah-tse-KHOO khoo-le-KHEHM ke-KEER nah-TOOY gah-DEHR hah-de-khoo-YAH

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ מִשְּׂאֵתוֹ יָעֲצוּ לְהַדִּיחַ יִרְצוּ כָזָב בְּפִיו יְבָרֵכוּ וּבְקִרְבָּם יְקַלְלוּ־סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: They only devise to thrust him down from his height, delighting in lies; They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah
tokens.transliteration: AHKH mee-se-eh-TOH yah-ah-TSOO le-hah-dee-AHKH yeer-TSOO khah-ZAHV be-FEEV ye-vah-REH-khoo oo-ve-keer-BAHM ye-kahl-loo SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ לֵאלֹהִים דּוֹמִּי נַפְשִׁי כִּי־מִמֶּנּוּ תִּקְוָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Only for God wait thou in stillness, my soul; For from Him cometh my hope.
tokens.transliteration: AHKH leh-loh-HEEM DOH-mee nahf-SHEE kee mee-MEH-noo teek-vah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ־הוּא צוּרִי וִישׁוּעָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי לֹא אֶמּוֹט׃
tokens.translation: He only is my rock and my salvation, My high tower, I shall not be moved.
tokens.transliteration: ahkh HOO tsoo-REE vee-shoo-ah-TEE mees-gah-BEE LOH eh-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: עַל־אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁעִי וּכְבוֹדִי צוּר־עֻזִּי מַחְסִי בֵּאלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Upon God resteth my salvation and my glory; The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
tokens.transliteration: ahl eh-loh-HEEM yeesh-EE oo-khe-voh-DEE tsoor oo-ZEE mahkh-SEE beh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: בִּטְחוּ בוֹ בְכָל־עֵת עָם שִׁפְכוּ־לְפָנָיו לְבַבְכֶם אֱלֹהִים מַחֲסֶה־לָּנוּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Trust in Him at all times, ye people; Pour out your heart before Him; God is a refuge for us. Selah
tokens.transliteration: beet-KHOO VOH ve-khohl EHT AHM sheef-khoo le-fah-NAHV le-vahv-KHEHM eh-loh-HEEM mah-khah-seh LAH-noo SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ הֶבֶל בְּנֵי־אָדָם כָּזָב בְּנֵי אִישׁ בְּמֹאזְנַיִם לַעֲלוֹת הֵמָּה מֵהֶבֶל יָחַד׃
tokens.translation: Men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie; If they be laid in the balances, they are together lighter than vanity.
tokens.transliteration: AHKH HEH-vehl be-ney ah-DAHM kah-ZAHV be-NEY EESH be-moh-ze-NAH-yeem lah-ah-LOHT heh-MAH meh-HEH-vehl YAH-khahd

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בְעֹשֶׁק וּבְגָזֵל אַל־תֶּהְבָּלוּ חַיִל כִּי־יָנוּב אַל־תָּשִׁיתוּ לֵב׃
tokens.translation: Trust not in oppression, And put not vain hope in robbery; If riches increase, set not your heart thereon.
tokens.transliteration: ahl teev-te-KHOO ve-oh-SHEHK oo-ve-gah-ZEHL ahl teh-BAH-loo KHAH-yeel kee yah-NOOV ahl tah-SHEE-too LEHV

tokens.hebrew: אַחַת דִּבֶּר אֱלֹהִים שְׁתַּיִם־זוּ שָׁמָעְתִּי כִּי עֹז לֵאלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: God hath spoken once, Twice have I heard this: That strength belongeth unto God;
tokens.transliteration: ah-KHAHT dee-BEHR eh-loh-HEEM she-tah-yeem ZOO shah-MAH-e-tee KEE OHZ leh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: וּלְךָ־אֲדֹנָי חָסֶד כִּי־אַתָּה תְשַׁלֵּם לְאִישׁ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ׃
tokens.translation: Also unto Thee, O Lord, belongeth mercy; For Thou renderest to every man according to his work.
tokens.transliteration: oo-le-khah ah-doh-NAHY KHAH-sehd kee ah-TAH te-shah-LEHM le-EESH ke-mah-ah-SEH-hoo

title: Psalm 63
sefariaRef: Psalms 63
summary: Longing for God and nighttime remembrance
useCase: Longing for God and nighttime remembrance Themes: devotion, sleep. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אֵלִי אַתָּה אֲ‍שַׁחֲרֶךָּ צָמְאָה לְךָ נַפְשִׁי כָּמַהּ לְךָ בְשָׂרִי בְּאֶרֶץ־צִיָּה וְעָיֵף בְּלִי־מָיִם׃
tokens.translation: O God, Thou art my God, earnestly will I seek Thee; My soul thirsteth for Thee, my flesh longeth for Thee, In a dry and weary land, where no water is.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM eh-LEE ah-TAH ah-shah-khah-REH-kah tsah-me-AH le-KHAH nahf-SHEE kah-MAHH le-KHAH ve-sah-REE be-eh-rehts tsee-YAH ve-ah-YEHF be-lee MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: כֵּן בַּקֹּדֶשׁ חֲזִיתִיךָ לִרְאוֹת עֻזְּךָ וּכְבוֹדֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: So have I looked for Thee in the sanctuary, To see Thy power and Thy glory. .
tokens.transliteration: KEHN bah-KOH-dehsh khah-zee-TEE-khah leer-OHT oo-ze-KHAH oo-khe-voh-DEH-khah

tokens.translation: For Thy lovingkindness is better than life; My lips shall praise Thee.
tokens.transliteration: kee TOHV khahs-de-KHAH meh-khah-YEEM se-fah-TAHY ye-shah-be-KHOO-ne-khah

tokens.hebrew: כֵּן אֲבָרֶכְךָ בְחַיָּי בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂא כַפָּי׃
tokens.translation: So will I bless Thee as long as I live; In Thy name will I lift up my hands.
tokens.transliteration: KEHN ah-vah-rehkh-KHAH ve-khah-YAHY be-sheem-KHAH eh-SAH khah-PAHY

tokens.hebrew: כְּמוֹ חֵלֶב וָדֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּע נַפְשִׁי וְשִׂפְתֵי רְנָנוֹת יְהַלֶּל־פִּי׃
tokens.translation: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness; And my mouth doth praise Thee with joyful lips;
tokens.transliteration: ke-MOH KHEH-lehv vah-deh-SHEHN tees-BAH nahf-SHEE ve-seef-TEY re-nah-NOHT ye-hah-lehl PEE

tokens.translation: When I remember Thee upon my couch, And meditate on Thee in the night-watches.
tokens.transliteration: eem ze-khahr-TEE-khah ahl ye-tsoo-AHY be-ahsh-moo-ROHT eh-geh BAHKH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הָיִיתָ עֶזְרָתָה לִּי וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast been my help, And in the shadow of Thy wings do I rejoice.
tokens.transliteration: kee hah-YEE-tah ehz-RAH-tah LEE oo-ve-TSEHL ke-nah-FEY-khah ah-rah-NEHN

tokens.hebrew: דָּבְקָה נַפְשִׁי אַחֲרֶיךָ בִּי תָּמְכָה יְמִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: My soul cleaveth unto Thee; Thy right hand holdeth me fast.
tokens.transliteration: dah-ve-KAH nahf-SHEE ah-khah-REY-khah BEE tah-me-KHAH ye-mee-NEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: וְהֵמָּה לְשׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי יָבֹאוּ בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, Shall go into the nethermost parts of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-HEH-mah le-shoh-AH ye-vahk-SHOO nahf-SHEE yah-VOH-oo be-tahkh-tee-YOHT hah-AH-rehts

tokens.translation: They shall be hurled to the power of the sword; They shall be a portion for foxes.
tokens.transliteration: yah-gee-ROO-hoo ahl ye-dey KHAH-rehv me-NAHT shoo-ah-LEEM yeeh-YOO

tokens.hebrew: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ יִשְׂמַח בֵּאלֹהִים יִתְהַלֵּל כָּל־הַנִּשְׁבָּע בּוֹ כִּי יִסָּכֵר פִּי דוֹבְרֵי־שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: But the king shall rejoice in God; Every one that sweareth by Him shall glory; For the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-meh-LEHKH yees-MAHKH beh-loh-HEEM yeet-hah-LEHL kohl hah-neesh-BAH BOH KEE yee-sah-KHEHR PEE doh-ve-rey SHAH-kehr

title: Psalm 64
sefariaRef: Psalms 64
useCase: Protection from harmful speech Themes: protection, relationships. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע־אֱלֹהִים קוֹלִי בְשִׂיחִי מִפַּחַד אוֹיֵב תִּצֹּר חַיָּי׃
tokens.translation: Hear my voice, O God, in my complaint; preserve my life from the terror of the enemy.
tokens.transliteration: she-mah eh-loh-HEEM koh-LEE ve-see-KHEE mee-PAH-khahd oh-YEHV tee-TSOHR khah-YAHY

tokens.hebrew: תַּסְתִּירֵנִי מִסּוֹד מְרֵעִים מֵרִגְשַׁת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: Hide me from the council of evil-doers; from the tumult of the workers of iniquity;
tokens.transliteration: tahs-tee-reh-NEE mee-SOHD me-reh-EEM meh-reeg-SHAHT POH-ah-ley AH-vehn

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר שָׁנְנוּ כַחֶרֶב לְשׁוֹנָם דָּרְכוּ חִצָּם דָּבָר מָר׃
tokens.translation: Who have whet their tongue like a sword, and have aimed their arrow, a poisoned word;
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR shah-ne-NOO khah-KHEH-rehv le-shoh-NAHM dah-re-KHOO khee-TSAHM dah-VAHR MAHR

tokens.hebrew: לִירוֹת בַּמִּסְתָּרִים תָּם פִּתְאֹם יֹרֻהוּ וְלֹא יִירָאוּ׃
tokens.translation: That they may shoot in secret places at the blameless; suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
tokens.transliteration: lee-ROHT bah-mees-tah-REEM TAHM peet-OHM yoh-ROO-hoo ve-LOH yee-RAH-oo

tokens.hebrew: יְחַזְּקוּ־לָמוֹ דָּבָר רָע יְסַפְּרוּ לִטְמוֹן מוֹקְשִׁים אָמְרוּ מִי יִרְאֶה־לָּמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: They encourage one another in an evil matter; they converse of laying snares secretly; they ask, who would see them.
tokens.transliteration: ye-khah-ze-koo LAH-moh dah-VAHR RAH ye-sah-pe-ROO leet-MOHN moh-ke-SHEEM ah-me-ROO MEE yeer-eh LAH-moh

tokens.hebrew: יַחְפְּשׂוּ־עוֹלֹת תַּמְנוּ חֵפֶשׂ מְחֻפָּשׂ וְקֶרֶב אִישׁ וְלֵב עָמֹק׃
tokens.translation: They search out iniquities, they have accomplished a diligent search; even in the inward thought of every one, and the deep heart.
tokens.transliteration: yah-khe-pe-soo oh-LOHT tahm-NOO KHEH-fehs me-khoo-PAHS ve-KEH-rehv EESH ve-LEHV ah-MOHK

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּרֵם אֱלֹהִים חֵץ פִּתְאוֹם הָיוּ מַכּוֹתָם׃
tokens.translation: But God doth shoot at them with an arrow suddenly; thence are their wounds.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-REHM eh-loh-HEEM KHEHTS peet-OHM hah-YOO mah-koh-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּכְשִׁילוּהוּ עָלֵימוֹ לְשׁוֹנָם יִתְנֹדֲדוּ כָּל־רֹאֵה בָם׃
tokens.translation: So they make their own tongue a stumbling unto themselves; all that see them shake the head.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahkh-shee-LOO-hoo ah-LEY-moh le-shoh-NAHM yeet-noh-dah-DOO kohl ROH-eh VAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ כָּל־אָדָם וַיַּגִּידוּ פֹּעַל אֱלֹהִים וּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ הִשְׂכִּילוּ׃
tokens.translation: And all men fear; and they declare the work of God, and understand His doing.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-re-OO kohl ah-DAHM vah-yah-gee-DOO POH-ahl eh-loh-HEEM oo-mah-ah-SEH-hoo hees-KEE-loo

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂמַח צַדִּיק בַּיהוָה וְחָסָה בוֹ וְיִתְהַלְלוּ כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
tokens.translation: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in Him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
tokens.transliteration: yees-MAHKH tsah-DEEK bah-ah-doh-NAI ve-KHAH-sah VOH ve-yeet-hah-le-LOO kohl yeesh-rey LEHV

title: Psalm 65
sefariaRef: Psalms 65
summary: Forgiveness, rain, and the earth's abundance
useCase: Forgiveness, rain, and the earth's abundance Themes: repentance, nature, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm. A Song of David.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ דֻמִיָּה תְהִלָּה אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן וּלְךָ יְשֻׁלַּם־נֶדֶר׃
tokens.translation: Praise waiteth for Thee, O God, in Zion; and unto Thee the vow is performed.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHAH doo-mee-YAH te-hee-LAH eh-loh-HEEM be-tsee-YOHN oo-le-KHAH ye-shoo-lahm NEH-dehr

tokens.translation: O Thou that hearest prayer, unto Thee doth all flesh come.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-MEH-ah te-fee-LAH ah-DEY-khah kohl bah-SAHR yah-VOH-oo

tokens.hebrew: דִּבְרֵי עֲוֺנֹת גָּבְרוּ מֶנִּי פְּשָׁעֵינוּ אַתָּה תְכַפְּרֵם׃
tokens.translation: The tale of iniquities is too heavy for me; as for our transgressions, Thou wilt pardon them.
tokens.transliteration: deev-REY ah-voh-NOHT GAH-ve-roo MEH-nee pe-shah-EY-noo ah-TAH te-khah-pe-REHM

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי תִּבְחַר וּתְקָרֵב יִשְׁכֹּן חֲצֵרֶיךָ נִשְׂבְּעָה בְּטוּב בֵּיתֶךָ קְדֹשׁ הֵיכָלֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the man whom Thou choosest, and bringest near, that he may dwell in Thy courts; may we be satisfied with the goodness of Thy house, the holy place of Thy temple!
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY tee-ve-KHAHR oo-te-kah-REHV yeesh-KOHN khah-tseh-REY-khah nees-be-AH be-TOOV bey-TEH-khah ke-DOHSH hey-khah-LEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: נוֹרָאוֹת בְּצֶדֶק תַּעֲנֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ מִבְטָח כָּל־קַצְוֵי־אֶרֶץ וְיָם רְחֹקִים׃
tokens.translation: With wondrous works dost Thou answer us in righteousness, O God of our salvation; Thou the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of the far distant seas;
tokens.transliteration: NOH-rah-OHT be-TSEH-dehk tah-ah-neh-NOO eh-loh-HEY yeesh-EH-noo meev-TAHKH kohl kahts-vey eh-REHTS ve-YAHM re-khoh-KEEM

tokens.translation: Who by Thy strength settest fast the mountains, who art girded about with might;

tokens.hebrew: מַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן יַמִּים שְׁאוֹן גַּלֵּיהֶם וַהֲמוֹן לְאֻמִּים׃
tokens.translation: Who stillest the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the tumult of the peoples;
tokens.transliteration: mahsh-BEE-ahkh she-OHN yah-MEEM she-OHN gah-ley-HEHM vah-hah-MOHN le-oo-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּירְאוּ יֹשְׁבֵי קְצָוֺת מֵאוֹתֹתֶיךָ מוֹצָאֵי־בֹקֶר וָעֶרֶב תַּרְנִין׃
tokens.translation: So that they that dwell in the uttermost parts stand in awe of Thy signs; Thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YEE-re-OO yoh-she-VEY ke-tsah-VOHT meh-oh-toh-TEY-khah MOH-tsah-ey VOH-kehr vah-EH-rehv tahr-NEEN

tokens.hebrew: פָּקַדְתָּ הָאָרֶץ וַתְּשֹׁקְקֶהָ רַבַּת תַּעְשְׁרֶנָּה פֶּלֶג אֱלֹהִים מָלֵא מָיִם תָּכִין דְּגָנָם כִּי־כֵן תְּכִינֶהָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast remembered the earth, and watered her, greatly enriching her, with the river of God that is full of water; Thou preparest them corn, for so preparest Thou her.
tokens.transliteration: pah-KAHD-tah hah-AH-rehts vah-te-SHOH-ke-KEH-hah rah-BAHT tah-she-REH-nah PEH-lehg eh-loh-HEEM MAH-leh MAH-yeem tah-KHEEN de-gah-NAHM kee KHEHN te-khee-NEH-hah

tokens.hebrew: תְּלָמֶיהָ רַוֵּה נַחֵת גְּדוּדֶיהָ בִּרְבִיבִים תְּמֹגְגֶנָּה צִמְחָהּ תְּבָרֵךְ׃
tokens.translation: Watering her ridges abundantly, settling down the furrows thereof, Thou makest her soft with showers; Thou blessest the growth thereof.
tokens.transliteration: te-lah-MEY-hah rah-VEH nah-KHEHT ge-doo-DEY-hah beer-vee-VEEM te-moh-ge-GEH-nah tseem-KHAHH te-vah-REHKH

tokens.hebrew: עִטַּרְתָּ שְׁנַת טוֹבָתֶךָ וּמַעְגָּלֶיךָ יִרְעֲפוּן דָּשֶׁן׃
tokens.translation: Thou crownest the year with Thy goodness; and Thy paths drop fatness.
tokens.transliteration: ee-tahr-TAH she-NAHT toh-vah-TEH-khah oo-mah-gah-LEY-khah yeer-ah-FOON DAH-shehn

tokens.hebrew: יִרְעֲפוּ נְאוֹת מִדְבָּר וְגִיל גְּבָעוֹת תַּחְגֹּרְנָה׃
tokens.translation: The pastures of the wilderness do drop; and the hills are girded with joy.
tokens.transliteration: yeer-ah-FOO ne-OHT meed-BAHR ve-GEEL ge-vah-OHT tahkh-GOH-re-nah

tokens.hebrew: לָבְשׁוּ כָרִים הַצֹּאן וַעֲמָקִים יַעַטְפוּ־בָר יִתְרוֹעֲעוּ אַף־יָשִׁירוּ׃
tokens.translation: The meadows are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, yea, they sing.
tokens.transliteration: lah-ve-SHOO khah-REEM hah-TSOHN vah-ah-mah-KEEM yah-aht-foo VAHR yeet-roh-ah-OO ahf yah-SHEE-roo

title: Psalm 66
sefariaRef: Psalms 66
useCase: Collective and personal thanksgiving Themes: gratitude, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהִים כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Song, a Psalm. Shout unto God, all the earth;
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-tseh-AHKH SHEER meez-MOHR hah-REE-oo leh-loh-HEEM kohl hah-AH-rehts

tokens.translation: Sing praises unto the glory of His name; Make His praise glorious.
tokens.transliteration: zah-me-ROO khe-vohd she-MOH SEE-moo khah-VOHD te-hee-lah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: אִמְרוּ לֵאלֹהִים מַה־נּוֹרָא מַעֲשֶׂיךָ בְּרֹב עֻזְּךָ יְכַחֲשׁוּ לְךָ אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Say unto God: 'How tremendous is Thy work! Through the greatness of Thy power shall Thine enemies dwindle away before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: eem-ROO leh-loh-HEEM mahh noh-RAH mah-ah-SEY-khah be-ROHV oo-ze-KHAH ye-khah-khah-SHOO le-KHAH oh-ye-VEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְךָ וִיזַמְּרוּ־לָךְ יְזַמְּרוּ שִׁמְךָ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: All the earth shall worship Thee, And shall sing praises unto Thee; They shall sing praises to Thy name.' Selah
tokens.transliteration: kohl hah-AH-rehts yeesh-tah-khah-VOO le-KHAH vee-zah-me-roo LAHKH ye-zah-me-ROO sheem-KHAH SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: לְכוּ וּרְאוּ מִפְעֲלוֹת אֱלֹהִים נוֹרָא עֲלִילָה עַל־בְּנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Come, and see the works of God; He is terrible in His doing toward the children of men.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHOO oo-re-OO meef-ah-LOHT eh-loh-HEEM noh-RAH ah-lee-LAH ahl be-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: הָפַךְ יָם לְיַבָּשָׁה בַּנָּהָר יַעַבְרוּ בְרָגֶל שָׁם נִשְׂמְחָה־בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He turned the sea into dry land; They went through the river on foot; There let us rejoice in Him!
tokens.transliteration: HAH-fahkh YAHM le-yah-bah-SHAH bah-nah-HAHR yah-ahv-ROO ve-RAH-gehl SHAHM nees-me-khah BOH

tokens.hebrew: מֹשֵׁל בִּגְבוּרָתוֹ עוֹלָם עֵינָיו בַּגּוֹיִם תִּצְפֶּינָה הַסּוֹרְרִים אַל־ירימו [יָרוּמוּ] לָמוֹ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Who ruleth by His might for ever; His eyes keep watch upon the nations; Let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
tokens.transliteration: moh-SHEHL beeg-voo-rah-TOH oh-LAHM ey-NAHV bah-goh-YEEM teets-PEY-nah hah-soh-re-REEM ah-yah-ROO-moo LAH-moh SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: בָּרְכוּ עַמִּים אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהַשְׁמִיעוּ קוֹל תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Bless our God, ye peoples, And make the voice of His praise to be heard;
tokens.transliteration: bah-re-KHOO ah-MEEM eh-loh-HEY-noo ve-hahsh-MEE-oo KOHL te-hee-lah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: הַשָּׂם נַפְשֵׁנוּ בַּחַיִּים וְלֹא־נָתַן לַמּוֹט רַגְלֵנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Who hath set our soul in life, And suffered not our foot to be moved,
tokens.transliteration: hah-SAHM nahf-sheh-NOO bah-khah-YEEM ve-loh nah-TAHN lah-MOHT rahg-LEH-noo

tokens.translation: For Thou, O God, hast tried us; Thou hast refined us, as silver is refined.
tokens.transliteration: kee ve-khahn-TAH-noo eh-loh-HEEM tse-rahf-TAH-noo keets-rahf KAH-sehf

tokens.translation: Thou didst bring us into the hold; Thou didst lay constraint upon our loins.

tokens.hebrew: הִרְכַּבְתָּ אֱנוֹשׁ לְרֹאשֵׁנוּ בָּאנוּ־בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּיִם וַתּוֹצִיאֵנוּ לָרְוָיָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; We went through fire and through water; But Thou didst bring us out unto abundance.
tokens.transliteration: heer-KAHV-tah eh-NOHSH le-roh-SHEH-noo bah-noo vah-EHSH oo-vah-MAH-yeem vah-toh-tsee-EH-noo lah-re-vah-YAH

tokens.hebrew: אָבוֹא בֵיתְךָ בְעוֹלוֹת אֲשַׁלֵּם לְךָ נְדָרָי׃
tokens.translation: I will come into Thy house with burnt-offerings, I will perform unto Thee my vows,
tokens.transliteration: ah-VOH vey-te-KHAH ve-oh-LOHT ah-shah-LEHM le-KHAH ne-dah-RAHY

tokens.translation: Which my lips have uttered, And my mouth hath spoken, when I was in distress.
tokens.transliteration: ah-shehr pah-TSOO se-fah-TAHY ve-dee-behr PEE bah-tsahr LEE

tokens.hebrew: עֹלוֹת מֵחִים אַעֲלֶה־לָּךְ עִם־קְטֹרֶת אֵילִים אֶעֱשֶׂה בָקָר עִם־עַתּוּדִים סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: I will offer unto Thee burnt-offerings of fatlings, With the sweet smoke of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah
tokens.transliteration: oh-LOHT meh-KHEEM ah-ah-leh LAHKH eem ke-TOH-reht ey-LEEM EH-eh-seh vah-KAHR eem ah-too-DEEM SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: לְכוּ־שִׁמְעוּ וַאֲסַפְּרָה כָּל־יִרְאֵי אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה לְנַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: Come, and hearken, all ye that fear God, And I will declare what He hath done for my soul.
tokens.transliteration: le-khoo sheem-OO vah-ah-sah-pe-RAH kohl yeer-EY eh-loh-HEEM ah-SHEHR ah-SAH le-nahf-SHEE

tokens.translation: I cried unto Him with my mouth, And He was extolled with my tongue.
tokens.transliteration: eh-LAHV pee kah-RAH-tee ve-roh-MAHM TAH-khaht le-shoh-NEE

tokens.hebrew: אָוֶן אִם־רָאִיתִי בְלִבִּי לֹא יִשְׁמַע אֲדֹנָי׃
tokens.translation: If I had regarded iniquity in my heart, The Lord would not hear;
tokens.transliteration: ah-VEHN eem rah-EE-tee ve-lee-BEE LOH yeesh-MAH ah-doh-NAHY

tokens.hebrew: אָכֵן שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים הִקְשִׁיב בְּקוֹל תְּפִלָּתִי׃
tokens.translation: But verily God hath heard; He hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
tokens.transliteration: ah-KHEHN shah-MAH eh-loh-HEEM heek-SHEEV be-KOHL te-fee-lah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים אֲשֶׁר לֹא־הֵסִיר תְּפִלָּתִי וְחַסְדּוֹ מֵאִתִּי׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be God, Who hath not turned away my prayer, nor His mercy from me.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ROOKH eh-loh-HEEM ah-SHEHR loh heh-SEER te-fee-lah-TEE ve-khahs-DOH meh-ee-TEE

title: Psalm 67
sefariaRef: Psalms 67
useCase: Blessing, harvest, and the nations Themes: provision, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm, a Song.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים יְחָנֵּנוּ וִיבָרְכֵנוּ יָאֵר פָּנָיו אִתָּנוּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: God be gracious unto us, and bless us; May He cause His face to shine toward us; Selah
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM ye-khah-NEH-noo vee-vah-re-KHEH-noo YAH-EHR pah-NAHV ee-TAH-noo SEH-lah

tokens.translation: That Thy way may be known upon earth, Thy salvation among all nations.
tokens.transliteration: lah-DAH-aht bah-AH-rehts dahr-KEH-khah be-khohl goh-YEEM ye-shoo-ah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
tokens.translation: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them. .
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DOO-khah ah-MEEM eh-loh-HEEM yoh-DOO-khah ah-MEEM koo-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂמְחוּ וִירַנְּנוּ לְאֻמִּים כִּי־תִשְׁפֹּט עַמִּים מִישׁוֹר וּלְאֻמִּים בָּאָרֶץ תַּנְחֵם סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy; For Thou wilt judge the peoples with equity, And lead the nations upon earth. Selah
tokens.transliteration: yee-se-me-KHOO vee-rah-ne-NOO le-oo-MEEM kee teesh-POHT ah-MEEM mee-SHOHR oo-le-oo-MEEM bah-AH-rehts tahn-KHEHM SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים אֱלֹהִים יוֹדוּךָ עַמִּים כֻּלָּם׃
tokens.translation: Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, O God; Let the peoples give thanks unto Thee, all of them.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DOO-khah ah-MEEM eh-loh-HEEM yoh-DOO-khah ah-MEEM koo-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: אֶרֶץ נָתְנָה יְבוּלָהּ יְבָרְכֵנוּ אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: The earth hath yielded her increase; May God, our own God, bless us.
tokens.transliteration: eh-REHTS nah-te-NAH ye-voo-LAHH ye-vah-re-KHEH-noo eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-HEY-noo

tokens.translation: May God bless us; And let all the ends of the earth fear Him.
tokens.transliteration: ye-vah-re-KHEH-noo eh-loh-HEEM ve-yee-re-OO oh-TOH kohl ahf-sey AH-rehts

title: Psalm 68
sefariaRef: Psalms 68
summary: Protection of the vulnerable and collective praise
useCase: Protection of the vulnerable and collective praise Themes: justice, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David, a Song.

tokens.hebrew: יָקוּם אֱלֹהִים יָפוּצוּ אוֹיְבָיו וְיָנוּסוּ מְשַׂנְאָיו מִפָּנָיו׃
tokens.translation: Let God arise, let His enemies be scattered; And let them that hate Him flee before Him.
tokens.transliteration: yah-KOOM eh-loh-HEEM yah-FOO-tsoo oh-ye-VAHV ve-yah-NOO-soo me-sahn-AHV mee-pah-NAHV

tokens.hebrew: כְּהִנְדֹּף עָשָׁן תִּנְדֹּף כְּהִמֵּס דּוֹנַג מִפְּנֵי־אֵשׁ יֹאבְדוּ רְשָׁעִים מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away; As wax melteth before the fire, So let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
tokens.transliteration: ke-heen-DOHF ah-SHAHN teen-DOHF ke-hee-MEHS doh-NAHG mee-pe-ney EHSH yoh-ve-DOO re-shah-EEM mee-pe-NEY eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: וְצַדִּיקִים יִשְׂמְחוּ יַעַלְצוּ לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהִים וְיָשִׂישׂוּ בְשִׂמְחָה׃
tokens.translation: But let the righteous be glad, let them exult before God; Yea, let them rejoice with gladness.
tokens.transliteration: ve-tsah-dee-KEEM yees-me-KHOO yah-ahl-TSOO leef-NEY eh-loh-HEEM ve-yah-SEE-soo ve-seem-KHAH

tokens.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ שְׁמוֹ סֹלּוּ לָרֹכֵב בָּעֲרָבוֹת בְּיָהּ שְׁמוֹ וְעִלְזוּ לְפָנָיו׃
tokens.translation: Sing unto God, sing praises to His name; Extol Him that rideth upon the skies, whose name is the LORD; And exult ye before Him.
tokens.transliteration: SHEE-roo leh-loh-HEEM zah-me-ROO she-MOH SOH-loo lah-roh-KHEHV bah-ah-rah-VOHT be-YAHH she-MOH ve-eel-ZOO le-fah-NAHV

tokens.hebrew: אֲבִי יְתוֹמִים וְדַיַּן אַלְמָנוֹת אֱלֹהִים בִּמְעוֹן קָדְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, Is God in His holy habitation.
tokens.transliteration: ah-VEE ye-toh-MEEM ve-dah-YAHN ahl-mah-NOHT eh-loh-HEEM beem-OHN kohd-SHOH

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים מוֹשִׁיב יְחִידִים בַּיְתָה מוֹצִיא אֲסִירִים בַּכּוֹשָׁרוֹת אַךְ סוֹרֲרִים שָׁכְנוּ צְחִיחָה׃
tokens.translation: God maketh the solitary to dwell in a house; He bringeth out the prisoners into prosperity; The rebellious dwell but in a parched land.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM moh-SHEEV ye-khee-DEEM BAHY-tah moh-TSEE ah-see-REEM bah-koh-shah-ROHT AHKH soh-rah-REEM shah-khe-NOO tse-khee-KHAH

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים בְּצֵאתְךָ לִפְנֵי עַמֶּךָ בְּצַעְדְּךָ בִישִׁימוֹן סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: O God, when Thou wentest forth before Thy people, When Thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM be-tseh-te-KHAH leef-NEY ah-MEH-khah be-tsah-de-KHAH vee-shee-MOHN SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אֶרֶץ רָעָשָׁה אַף־שָׁמַיִם נָטְפוּ מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים זֶה סִינַי מִפְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: The earth trembled, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God; Even yon Sinai trembled at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: EH-rehts rah-AH-shah ahf shah-MAH-yeem nah-te-FOO mee-pe-NEY eh-loh-HEEM ZEH see-NAHY mee-pe-NEY eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-HEY yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: גֶּשֶׁם נְדָבוֹת תָּנִיף אֱלֹהִים נַחֲלָתְךָ וְנִלְאָה אַתָּה כוֹנַנְתָּהּ׃
tokens.translation: A bounteous rain didst Thou pour down, O God; When Thine inheritance was weary, Thou didst confirm it.
tokens.transliteration: GEH-shehm ne-dah-VOHT tah-NEEF eh-loh-HEEM nah-khah-lah-te-KHAH ve-neel-AH ah-TAH khoh-nahn-TAHH

tokens.hebrew: חַיָּתְךָ יָשְׁבוּ־בָהּ תָּכִין בְּטוֹבָתְךָ לֶעָנִי אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Thy flock settled therein; Thou didst prepare in Thy goodness for the poor, O God.
tokens.transliteration: khah-yah-te-KHAH yah-she-voo VAHH TAH-KHEEN be-toh-vah-te-KHAH leh-ah-NEE eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.translation: The Lord giveth the word; The women that proclaim the tidings are a great host.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAHY yee-tehn OH-mehr hah-me-vah-se-ROHT tsah-VAH RAHV

tokens.hebrew: מַלְכֵי צְבָאוֹת יִדֹּדוּן יִדֹּדוּן וּנְוַת בַּיִת תְּחַלֵּק שָׁלָל׃
tokens.translation: Kings of armies flee, they flee; And she that tarrieth at home divideth the spoil.
tokens.transliteration: mahl-KHEY tse-vah-OHT yee-doh-DOON yee-doh-DOON oo-ne-vaht bah-YEET te-khah-LEHK shah-LAHL

tokens.hebrew: אִם־תִּשְׁכְּבוּן בֵּין שְׁפַתָּיִם כַּנְפֵי יוֹנָה נֶחְפָּה בַכֶּסֶף וְאֶבְרוֹתֶיהָ בִּירַקְרַק חָרוּץ׃
tokens.translation: When ye lie among the sheepfolds, The wings of the dove are covered with silver, And her pinions with the shimmer of gold. .
tokens.transliteration: eem teesh-ke-VOON BEYN she-fah-TAH-yeem kahn-FEY yoh-NAH nehkh-PAH vah-KEH-sehf ve-ehv-roh-TEY-hah bee-rahk-RAHK khah-ROOTS

tokens.hebrew: בְּפָרֵשׂ שַׁדַּי מְלָכִים בָּהּ תַּשְׁלֵג בְּצַלְמוֹן׃
tokens.translation: When the Almighty scattereth kings therein, It snoweth in Zalmon.
tokens.transliteration: be-fah-REHS shah-DAHY me-lah-KHEEM BAHH tahsh-LEHG be-tsahl-MOHN

tokens.translation: A mountain of God is the mountain of Bashan; A mountain of peaks is the mountain of Bashan.
tokens.transliteration: hahr eh-loh-HEEM hahr bah-SHAHN HAHR gahv-noo-NEEM hahr bah-SHAHN

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה תְּרַצְּדוּן הָרִים גַּבְנֻנִּים הָהָר חָמַד אֱלֹהִים לְשִׁבְתּוֹ אַף־יְהוָה יִשְׁכֹּן לָנֶצַח׃
tokens.translation: Why look ye askance, ye mountains of peaks, At the mountain which God hath desired for His abode? Yea, the LORD will dwell therein for ever.
tokens.transliteration: LAH-mah te-rah-tse-DOON hah-REEM gahv-noo-NEEM hah-HAHR khah-MAHD eh-loh-HEEM le-sheev-TOH ahf ah-doh-NAI yeesh-KOHN lah-NEH-tsahkh

tokens.hebrew: רֶכֶב אֱלֹהִים רִבֹּתַיִם אַלְפֵי שִׁנְאָן אֲדֹנָי בָם סִינַי בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: The chariots of God are myriads, even thousands upon thousands; The Lord is among them, as in Sinai, in holiness.
tokens.transliteration: REH-khehv eh-loh-HEEM ree-boh-TAH-yeem ahl-FEY sheen-AHN ah-doh-NAHY VAHM see-NAHY bah-KOH-dehsh

tokens.hebrew: עָלִיתָ לַמָּרוֹם שָׁבִיתָ שֶּׁבִי לָקַחְתָּ מַתָּנוֹת בָּאָדָם וְאַף סוֹרְרִים לִשְׁכֹּן יָהּ אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast ascended on high, Thou hast led captivity captive; Thou hast received gifts among men, Yea, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.
tokens.transliteration: ah-LEE-tah lah-mah-ROHM shah-VEE-tah SHEH-vee lah-KAHKH-tah mah-tah-NOHT bah-ah-DAHM ve-AHF soh-re-REEM leesh-KOHN YAHH eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַעֲמָס־לָנוּ הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵנוּ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be the Lord, day by day He beareth our burden, Even the God who is our salvation. Selah
tokens.transliteration: BAH-ROOKH ah-doh-NAHY YOHM YOHM yah-ah-mahs LAH-noo hah-EHL ye-shoo-ah-TEH-noo SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵל לָנוּ אֵל לְמוֹשָׁעוֹת וְלֵיהוִה אֲדֹנָי לַמָּוֶת תּוֹצָאוֹת׃
tokens.translation: God is unto us a God of deliverances; And unto GOD the Lord belong the issues of death.
tokens.transliteration: HAH-EHL lah-NOO EHL le-moh-shah-OHT ve-eh-loh-HEEM ah-doh-NAHY lah-MAH-veht toh-tsah-OHT

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ־אֱלֹהִים יִמְחַץ רֹאשׁ אֹיְבָיו קָדְקֹד שֵׂעָר מִתְהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲשָׁמָיו׃
tokens.translation: Surely God will smite through the head of His enemies, The hairy scalp of him that goeth about in his guiltiness.
tokens.transliteration: ahkh eh-loh-HEEM yeem-KHAHTS ROHSH oh-ye-VAHV kohd-KOHD seh-AHR meet-hah-LEHKH bah-ah-shah-MAHV

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר אֲדֹנָי מִבָּשָׁן אָשִׁיב אָשִׁיב מִמְּצֻלוֹת יָם׃
tokens.translation: The Lord said: 'I will bring back from Bashan, I will bring them back from the depths of the sea;
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR ah-doh-NAHY mee-bah-SHAHN ah-SHEEV ah-SHEEV mee-me-tsoo-LOHT YAHM

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן תִּמְחַץ רַגְלְךָ בְּדָם לְשׁוֹן כְּלָבֶיךָ מֵאֹיְבִים מִנֵּהוּ׃
tokens.translation: That thy foot may wade through blood, That the tongue of thy dogs may have its portion from thine enemies.'
tokens.transliteration: le-MAH-ahn tee-me-KHAHTS rahg-le-KHAH be-DAHM le-SHOHN ke-lah-VEY-khah meh-oh-ye-VEEM mee-NEH-hoo

tokens.hebrew: רָאוּ הֲלִיכוֹתֶיךָ אֱלֹהִים הֲלִיכוֹת אֵלִי מַלְכִּי בַקֹּדֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: They see Thy goings, O God, Even the goings of my God, my King, in holiness.
tokens.transliteration: rah-OO hah-lee-khoh-TEY-khah eh-loh-HEEM hah-lee-KHOHT eh-LEE mahl-KEE vah-KOH-dehsh

tokens.hebrew: קִדְּמוּ שָׁרִים אַחַר נֹגְנִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲלָמוֹת תּוֹפֵפוֹת׃
tokens.translation: The singers go before, the minstrels follow after, In the midst of damsels playing upon timbrels.
tokens.transliteration: kee-de-MOO shah-REEM ah-KHAHR noh-ge-NEEM be-TOHKH ah-lah-MOHT toh-feh-FOHT

tokens.hebrew: בְּמַקְהֵלוֹת בָּרְכוּ אֱלֹהִים יְהוָה מִמְּקוֹר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: 'Bless ye God in full assemblies, Even the Lord, ye that are from the fountain of Israel.'
tokens.transliteration: be-mahk-heh-LOHT bah-re-KHOO eh-loh-HEEM ah-doh-NAI mee-me-KOHR yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: שָׁם בִּנְיָמִן צָעִיר רֹדֵם שָׂרֵי יְהוּדָה רִגְמָתָם שָׂרֵי זְבֻלוּן שָׂרֵי נַפְתָּלִי׃
tokens.translation: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, The princes of Judah their council, The princes of Zebulun, the princes of Naphtali.
tokens.transliteration: SHAHM been-yah-MEEN tsah-EER roh-DEHM sah-REY ye-hoo-DAH reeg-mah-TAHM sah-REY ze-voo-LOON sah-REY nahf-tah-LEE

tokens.hebrew: צִוָּה אֱלֹהֶיךָ עֻזֶּךָ עוּזָּה אֱלֹהִים זוּ פָּעַלְתָּ לָּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Thy God hath commanded thy strength; Be strong, O God, Thou that hast wrought for us
tokens.transliteration: tsee-VAH eh-loh-HEY-khah oo-ZEH-khah oo-ZAH eh-loh-HEEM ZOO pah-AHL-tah LAH-noo

tokens.hebrew: מֵהֵיכָלֶךָ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִָם לְךָ יוֹבִילוּ מְלָכִים שָׁי׃
tokens.translation: Out of Thy temple at Jerusalem, Whither kings shall bring presents unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: meh-hey-khah-leh-KHAH ahl ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem le-KHAH yoh-VEE-loo me-lah-KHEEM SHAHY

tokens.hebrew: גְּעַר חַיַּת קָנֶה עֲדַת אַבִּירִים בְּעֶגְלֵי עַמִּים מִתְרַפֵּס בְּרַצֵּי־כָסֶף בִּזַּר עַמִּים קְרָבוֹת יֶחְפָּצוּ׃
tokens.translation: Rebuke the wild beast of the reeds, The multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples, Every one submitting himself with pieces of silver; He hath scattered the peoples that delight in war!
tokens.transliteration: ge-AHR khah-YAHT kah-NEH ah-DAHT ah-bee-REEM be-ehg-LEY ah-MEEM meet-rah-PEHS be-rah-tseh KHAH-sehf bee-ZAHR ah-MEEM ke-rah-VOHT yehkh-PAH-tsoo

tokens.hebrew: יֶאֱתָיוּ חַשְׁמַנִּים מִנִּי מִצְרָיִם כּוּשׁ תָּרִיץ יָדָיו לֵאלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Nobles shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall hasten to stretch out her hands unto God.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-eh-TAH-yoo khahsh-mah-NEEM mee-NEE meets-RAH-yeem KOOSH tah-REETS yah-DAHV leh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: מַמְלְכוֹת הָאָרֶץ שִׁירוּ לֵאלֹהִים זַמְּרוּ אֲדֹנָי סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah
tokens.transliteration: mahm-le-KHOHT hah-ah-REHTS SHEE-roo leh-loh-HEEM zah-me-ROO ah-doh-NAHY SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: לָרֹכֵב בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי־קֶדֶם הֵן יִתֵּן בְּקוֹלוֹ קוֹל עֹז׃
tokens.translation: To Him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which are of old; Lo, He uttereth His voice, a mighty voice.
tokens.transliteration: lah-roh-KHEHV beesh-MEY she-mey KEH-dehm HEHN yee-TEHN be-koh-LOH KOHL OHZ

tokens.hebrew: תְּנוּ עֹז לֵאלֹהִים עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל גַּאֲוָתוֹ וְעֻזּוֹ בַּשְּׁחָקִים׃
tokens.translation: Ascribe ye strength unto God; His majesty is over Israel, And His strength is in the skies.
tokens.transliteration: te-NOO OHZ leh-loh-HEEM ahl yees-rah-EHL gah-ah-vah-TOH ve-oo-ZOH bah-she-khah-KEEM

tokens.hebrew: נוֹרָא אֱלֹהִים מִמִּקְדָּשֶׁיךָ אֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא נֹתֵן עֹז וְתַעֲצֻמוֹת לָעָם בָּרוּךְ אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Awful is God out of thy holy places; The God of Israel, He giveth strength and power unto the people; Blessed be God.
tokens.transliteration: NOH-RAH eh-loh-HEEM mee-meek-dah-SHEY-khah EHL yees-rah-EHL HOO noh-TEHN OHZ ve-tah-ah-tsoo-MOHT lah-AHM bah-ROOKH eh-loh-HEEM

title: Psalm 69
sefariaRef: Psalms 69
summary: Deep distress and an appeal for rescue
useCase: Deep distress and an appeal for rescue Themes: wellness, protection, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. [A Psalm] of David.

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי אֱלֹהִים כִּי בָאוּ מַיִם עַד־נָפֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Save me, O God; For the waters are come in even unto the soul.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-shee-EH-nee eh-loh-HEEM KEE VAH-oo MAH-yeem ahd NAH-fehsh

tokens.hebrew: טָבַעְתִּי בִּיוֵן מְצוּלָה וְאֵין מָעֳמָד בָּאתִי בְמַעֲמַקֵּי־מַיִם וְשִׁבֹּלֶת שְׁטָפָתְנִי׃
tokens.translation: I am sunk in deep mire, where there is no standing; I am come into deep waters, and the flood overwhelmeth me.
tokens.transliteration: tah-VAH-tee bee-VEHN me-tsoo-LAH ve-EYN moh-oh-MAHD BAH-tee ve-mah-ah-mah-key mah-YEEM ve-shee-BOH-leht she-tah-FAH-te-nee

tokens.hebrew: יָגַעְתִּי בְקָרְאִי נִחַר גְּרוֹנִי כָּלוּ עֵינַי מְיַחֵל לֵאלֹהָי׃
tokens.translation: I am weary of my crying; my throat is dried; Mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
tokens.transliteration: yah-GAH-tee ve-kah-re-EE nee-KHAHR ge-roh-NEE kah-LOO ey-NAHY me-yah-KHEHL leh-loh-HAHY

tokens.hebrew: רַבּוּ מִשַּׂעֲרוֹת רֹאשִׁי שֹׂנְאַי חִנָּם עָצְמוּ מַצְמִיתַי אֹיְבַי שֶׁקֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא־גָזַלְתִּי אָז אָשִׁיב׃
tokens.translation: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head; They that would cut me off, being mine enemies wrongfully, are many; Should I restore that which I took not away?
tokens.transliteration: rah-BOO mee-sah-ah-ROHT roh-SHEE soh-ne-AHY khee-NAHM ah-tse-MOO mahts-mee-TAHY oh-ye-VAHY SHEH-kehr ah-SHEHR loh gah-ZAHL-tee AHZ ah-SHEEV

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ לְאִוַּלְתִּי וְאַשְׁמוֹתַי מִמְּךָ לֹא־נִכְחָדוּ׃
tokens.translation: O God, Thou knowest my folly; And my trespasses are not hid from Thee.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM ah-TAH yah-dah-TAH le-ee-vahl-TEE ve-ahsh-moh-TAHY mee-me-KHAH loh neekh-KHAH-doo

tokens.hebrew: אַל־יֵבֹשׁוּ בִי קֹוֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה צְבָאוֹת אַל־יִכָּלְמוּ בִי מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: Let not them that wait for Thee be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of hosts; Let not those that seek Thee be brought to confusion through me, O God of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: ahl yeh-VOH-shoo VEE koh-vey-KHAH ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT ahl yee-KAH-le-moo VEE me-vahk-SHEY-khah eh-loh-HEY yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־עָלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי חֶרְפָּה כִּסְּתָה כְלִמָּה פָנָי׃
tokens.translation: Because for Thy sake I have borne reproach; Confusion hath covered my face.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-ley-KHAH nah-SAH-tee khehr-PAH kee-se-TAH khe-lee-MAH fah-NAHY

tokens.hebrew: מוּזָר הָיִיתִי לְאֶחָי וְנָכְרִי לִבְנֵי אִמִּי׃
tokens.translation: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, And an alien unto my mother's children.
tokens.transliteration: moo-ZAHR hah-YEE-tee le-eh-KHAHY ve-nah-khe-REE leev-NEY ee-MEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־קִנְאַת בֵּיתְךָ אֲכָלָתְנִי וְחֶרְפּוֹת חוֹרְפֶיךָ נָפְלוּ עָלָי׃
tokens.translation: Because zeal for Thy house hath eaten me up, And the reproaches of them that reproach Thee are fallen upon me.
tokens.transliteration: kee keen-AHT bey-te-KHAH ah-khah-LAH-te-nee ve-khehr-POHT khoh-re-FEY-khah nah-fe-LOO ah-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: וָאֶבְכֶּה בַצּוֹם נַפְשִׁי וַתְּהִי לַחֲרָפוֹת לִי׃
tokens.translation: And I wept with my soul with fasting, And that became unto me a reproach.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ehv-KEH vah-TSOHM nahf-SHEE vah-te-HEE lah-khah-rah-FOHT LEE

tokens.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה לְבוּשִׁי שָׂק וָאֱהִי לָהֶם לְמָשָׁל׃
tokens.translation: I made sackcloth also my garment, And I became a byword unto them.
tokens.transliteration: vah-eh-te-NAH le-voo-SHEE SAHK vah-eh-HEE lah-HEHM le-mah-SHAHL

tokens.hebrew: יָשִׂיחוּ בִי יֹשְׁבֵי שָׁעַר וּנְגִינוֹת שׁוֹתֵי שֵׁכָר׃
tokens.translation: They that sit in the gate talk of me; And I am the song of the drunkards. .
tokens.transliteration: yah-SEE-khoo VEE YOH-she-vey SHAH-ahr oo-ne-gee-NOHT shoh-TEY sheh-KHAHR

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּתִי־לְךָ יְהוָה עֵת רָצוֹן אֱלֹהִים בְּרָב־חַסְדֶּךָ עֲנֵנִי בֶּאֱמֶת יִשְׁעֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, let my prayer be unto Thee, O LORD, in an acceptable time; O God, in the abundance of Thy mercy, Answer me with the truth of Thy salvation.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE te-fee-lah-tee le-KHAH ah-doh-NAI EHT rah-TSOHN eh-loh-HEEM be-rohv khahs-DEH-khah ah-NEH-nee beh-eh-MEHT yeesh-EH-khah

tokens.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי מִטִּיט וְאַל־אֶטְבָּעָה אִנָּצְלָה מִשֹּׂנְאַי וּמִמַּעֲמַקֵּי־מָיִם׃
tokens.translation: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink; Let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
tokens.transliteration: hah-tsee-LEH-nee mee-TEET ve-ahl eht-BAH-ah ee-nah-tse-LAH mee-soh-ne-AHY oo-mee-mah-ah-mah-key MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁטְפֵנִי שִׁבֹּלֶת מַיִם וְאַל־תִּבְלָעֵנִי מְצוּלָה וְאַל־תֶּאְטַר־עָלַי בְּאֵר פִּיהָ׃
tokens.translation: Let not the waterflood overwhelm me, Neither let the deep swallow me up; And let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
tokens.transliteration: ahl teesh-te-FEH-nee shee-BOH-leht mah-YEEM ve-ahl teev-lah-EH-nee me-tsoo-LAH ve-ahl teh-tahr ah-LAHY be-EHR PEE-hah

tokens.hebrew: עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדֶּךָ כְּרֹב רַחֲמֶיךָ פְּנֵה אֵלָי׃
tokens.translation: Answer me, O LORD, for Thy mercy is good; According to the multitude of Thy compassions turn Thou unto me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NEH-nee ah-doh-NAI kee TOHV khahs-DEH-khah ke-ROHV rah-khah-MEY-khah pe-NEH eh-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵעַבְדֶּךָ כִּי־צַר־לִי מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: And hide not Thy face from Thy servant; For I am in distress; answer me speedily.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl tahs-TEHR pah-ney-KHAH meh-ahv-DEH-khah kee tsahr LEE mah-HEHR ah-NEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: קָרְבָה אֶל־נַפְשִׁי גְאָלָהּ לְמַעַן אֹיְבַי פְּדֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it; Ransom me because of mine enemies.
tokens.transliteration: kah-re-VAH ehl nahf-SHEE ge-ah-LAHH le-MAH-ahn oh-ye-VAHY pe-DEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ חֶרְפָּתִי וּבָשְׁתִּי וּכְלִמָּתִי נֶגְדְּךָ כָּל־צוֹרְרָי׃
tokens.translation: Thou knowest my reproach, and my shame, and my confusion; Mine adversaries are all before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH yah-DAH-tah khehr-pah-TEE oo-vohsh-TEE oo-khe-lee-mah-TEE nehg-de-KHAH kohl tsoh-re-RAHY

tokens.hebrew: חֶרְפָּה שָׁבְרָה לִבִּי וָאָנוּשָׁה וָאֲקַוֶּה לָנוּד וָאַיִן וְלַמְנַחֲמִים וְלֹא מָצָאתִי׃
tokens.translation: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am sore sick; And I looked for some to show compassion, but there was none; And for comforters, but I found none.
tokens.transliteration: khehr-PAH shah-ve-RAH lee-BEE vah-ah-NOO-shah vah-ah-kah-VEH lah-NOOD vah-AH-yeen ve-lahm-nah-khah-MEEM ve-LOH mah-TSAH-tee

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ בְּבָרוּתִי רֹאשׁ וְלִצְמָאִי יַשְׁקוּנִי חֹמֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, they put poison into my food; And in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-te-NOO be-vah-roo-TEE ROHSH ve-leets-mah-EE yahsh-KOO-nee KHOH-mehts

tokens.translation: Let their table before them become a snare; And when they are in peace, let it become a trap.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee shool-khah-NAHM leef-ney-HEHM le-FAHKH ve-leesh-loh-MEEM le-moh-KEHSH

tokens.hebrew: תֶּחְשַׁכְנָה עֵינֵיהֶם מֵרְאוֹת וּמָתְנֵיהֶם תָּמִיד הַמְעַד׃
tokens.translation: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; And make their loins continually to totter.
tokens.transliteration: tehkh-SHAHKH-nah ey-ney-HEHM meh-re-OHT oo-moht-NEY-hehm tah-MEED hah-me-AHD

tokens.translation: Pour out Thine indignation upon them, And let the fierceness of Thine anger overtake them.
tokens.transliteration: she-fahkh ah-ley-HEHM zah-MEH-khah vah-khah-ROHN ah-pe-KHAH yah-see-GEHM

tokens.translation: Let their encampment be desolate; Let none dwell in their tents.
tokens.transliteration: te-hee tee-rah-TAHM ne-shah-MAH be-oh-hoh-ley-HEHM ahl ye-HEE yoh-SHEHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲשֶׁר־הִכִּיתָ רָדָפוּ וְאֶל־מַכְאוֹב חֲלָלֶיךָ יְסַפֵּרוּ׃
tokens.translation: For they persecute him whom Thou hast smitten; And they tell of the pain of those whom Thou hast wounded.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH ah-shehr hee-KEE-tah rah-DAH-foo ve-ehl mahkh-OHV khah-lah-LEY-khah ye-sah-PEH-roo

tokens.translation: Add iniquity unto their iniquity; And let them not come into Thy righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: te-nah ah-VOHN ahl ah-voh-NAHM ve-ahl yah-VOH-oo be-tseed-kah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: יִמָּחוּ מִסֵּפֶר חַיִּים וְעִם צַדִּיקִים אַל־יִכָּתֵבוּ׃
tokens.translation: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, And not be written with the righteous.
tokens.transliteration: yee-mah-KHOO mee-SEH-fehr khah-YEEM ve-EEM tsah-dee-KEEM ahl yee-kah-TEH-voo

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְכוֹאֵב יְשׁוּעָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים תְּשַׂגְּבֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: But I am afflicted and in pain; Let Thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-NEE ve-khoh-EHV ye-shoo-ah-te-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM te-sah-ge-VEH-nee

tokens.translation: I will praise the name of God with a song, And will magnify Him with thanksgiving. .
tokens.transliteration: ahhah-le-LAH shehm eh-loh-HEEM be-SHEER vah-ah-gah-de-LEH-noo ve-toh-DAH

tokens.hebrew: וְתִיטַב לַיהוָה מִשּׁוֹר פָּר מַקְרִן מַפְרִיס׃
tokens.translation: And it shall please the LORD better than a bullock That hath horns and hoofs.
tokens.transliteration: ve-tee-TAHV lah-ah-doh-NAI mee-SHOHR PAHR mahk-REEN mahf-REES

tokens.hebrew: רָאוּ עֲנָוִים יִשְׂמָחוּ דֹּרְשֵׁי אֱלֹהִים וִיחִי לְבַבְכֶם׃
tokens.translation: The humble shall see it, and be glad; Ye that seek after God, let your heart revive.
tokens.transliteration: rah-OO ah-nah-VEEM yees-MAH-khoo doh-re-SHEY eh-loh-HEEM vee-KHEE le-vahv-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־שֹׁמֵעַ אֶל־אֶבְיוֹנִים יְהוָה וְאֶת־אֲסִירָיו לֹא בָזָה׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD hearkeneth unto the needy, And despiseth not His prisoners.
tokens.transliteration: kee shoh-MEH-ah ehl ehv-yoh-NEEM ah-doh-NAI ve-eht ah-see-RAHV LOH vah-ZAH

tokens.hebrew: יְהַלְלוּהוּ שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יַמִּים וְכָל־רֹמֵשׂ בָּם׃
tokens.translation: Let heaven and earth praise Him, The seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hah-le-loo-HOO shah-MAH-yeem vah-AH-rehts yah-MEEM ve-khohl roh-MEHS BAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֱלֹהִים יוֹשִׁיעַ צִיּוֹן וְיִבְנֶה עָרֵי יְהוּדָה וְיָשְׁבוּ שָׁם וִירֵשׁוּהָ׃
tokens.translation: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah; And they shall abide there, and have it in possession.
tokens.transliteration: KEE eh-loh-HEEM yoh-SHEE-ah tsee-YOHN ve-yeev-NEH ah-REY ye-hoo-DAH ve-YAH-she-voo SHAHM vee-reh-SHOO-hah

tokens.hebrew: וְזֶרַע עֲבָדָיו יִנְחָלוּהָ וְאֹהֲבֵי שְׁמוֹ יִשְׁכְּנוּ־בָהּ׃
tokens.translation: The seed also of His servants shall inherit it; And they that love His name shall dwell therein.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ZEH-rah ah-vah-DAHV yeen-khah-LOO-hah ve-oh-hah-VEY she-MOH yeesh-ke-noo VAHH

title: Psalm 70
sefariaRef: Psalms 70
useCase: An urgent request for help Themes: protection, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David; to make memorial.
O God, to deliver me, O LORD, to help me, make haste.

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי נַפְשִׁי יִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר וְיִכָּלְמוּ חֲפֵצֵי רָעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Let them be ashamed and abashed That seek after my soul; Let them be turned backward and brought to confusion That delight in my hurt.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-VOH-shoo ve-yahkh-pe-ROO me-vahk-SHEY nahf-SHEE yee-SOH-goo ah-KHOHR ve-yee-kah-le-MOO khah-feh-TSEY rah-ah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: יָשׁוּבוּ עַל־עֵקֶב בָּשְׁתָּם הָאֹמְרִים הֶאָח הֶאָח׃
tokens.translation: Let them be turned back by reason of their shame That say: 'Aha, aha.'
tokens.transliteration: yah-shoo-VOO ahl EH-kehv bohsh-TAHM hah-oh-me-REEM heh-AHKH heh-AHKH

tokens.hebrew: יָשִׂישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל־מְבַקְשֶׁיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ תָמִיד יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים אֹהֲבֵי יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Let all those that seek Thee rejoice and be glad in Thee; And let such as love Thy salvation say continually: 'Let God be magnified.'
tokens.transliteration: yah-SEE-soo ve-yees-me-KHOO be-KHAH kahl me-vahk-SHEY-khah ve-yoh-me-ROO tah-MEED yeeg-DAHL eh-loh-HEEM oh-hah-VEY ye-shoo-ah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אֱלֹהִים חוּשָׁה־לִּי עֶזְרִי וּמְפַלְטִי אַתָּה יְהוָה אַל־תְּאַחַר׃
tokens.translation: But I am poor and needy; O God, make haste unto me; Thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, tarry not.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN eh-loh-HEEM khoo-SHAH LEE ehz-REE oo-me-fahl-TEE AH-tah ah-doh-NAI ahl te-ah-KHAHR
