title: Psalm 71
sefariaRef: Psalms 71
summary: Trust and dignity in old age
useCase: Trust and dignity in old age Themes: aging, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: In Thee, O LORD, have I taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed.
tokens.transliteration: be-khah ah-doh-NAI khah-SEE-tee ahl eh-VOH-shah le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תַּצִּילֵנִי וּתְפַלְּטֵנִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנְךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Deliver me in Thy righteousness, and rescue me; Incline Thine ear unto me, and save me.
tokens.transliteration: be-tseed-kah-te-KHAH tah-tsee-LEH-nee oo-te-fah-le-TEH-nee hah-teh eh-LAHY ohz-ne-KHAH ve-hoh-shee-EH-nee

tokens.hebrew: הֱיֵה לִי לְצוּר מָעוֹן לָבוֹא תָּמִיד צִוִּיתָ לְהוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כִּי־סַלְעִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אָתָּה׃
tokens.translation: Be Thou to me a sheltering rock, whereunto I may continually resort, Which Thou hast appointed to save me; For Thou art my rock and my fortress.
tokens.transliteration: heh-YEH LEE le-TSOOR mah-OHN lah-VOH tah-MEED tsee-VEE-tah le-hoh-shee-EH-nee kee sahl-EE oo-me-tsoo-dah-TEE AH-tah

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהַי פַּלְּטֵנִי מִיַּד רָשָׁע מִכַּף מְעַוֵּל וְחוֹמֵץ׃
tokens.translation: O my God, rescue me out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the grasp of the unrighteous and ruthless man.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HAHY pah-le-teh-NEE mee-YAHD rah-SHAH mee-KAHF me-ah-VEHL ve-khoh-mehts

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה תִקְוָתִי אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה מִבְטַחִי מִנְּעוּרָי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art my hope; O Lord GOD, my trust from my youth.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH teek-vah-TEE ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HEEM meev-tah-KHEE mee-ne-oo-RAHY

tokens.hebrew: עָלֶיךָ נִסְמַכְתִּי מִבֶּטֶן מִמְּעֵי אִמִּי אַתָּה גוֹזִי בְּךָ תְהִלָּתִי תָמִיד׃
tokens.translation: Upon Thee have I stayed myself from birth; Thou art he that took me out of my mother's womb; My praise is continually of Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-LEY-khah nees-MAHKH-tee mee-BEH-tehn mee-me-EY ee-MEE ah-TAH goh-ZEE be-KHAH te-hee-lah-TEE tah-MEED

tokens.translation: I am as a wonder unto many; But Thou art my strong refuge.
tokens.transliteration: ke-moh-FEHT hah-YEE-tee le-rah-BEEM ve-ah-TAH mah-khah-see OHZ

tokens.translation: My mouth shall be filled with Thy praise, And with Thy glory all the day. .
tokens.transliteration: yee-MAH-leh FEE te-hee-lah-TEH-khah kohl hah-YOHM teef-ahr-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Cast me not off in the time of old age; When my strength faileth, forsake me not.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tahsh-lee-kheh-NEE le-EHT zeek-NAH keekh-LOHT koh-KHEE ahl tah-ahz-VEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אָמְרוּ אוֹיְבַי לִי וְשֹׁמְרֵי נַפְשִׁי נוֹעֲצוּ יַחְדָּו׃
tokens.translation: For mine enemies speak concerning me, And they that watch for my soul take counsel together,
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-me-ROO oh-ye-VAHY LEE ve-shoh-me-REY nahf-SHEE noh-ah-TSOO yahkh-DAHV

tokens.hebrew: לֵאמֹר אֱלֹהִים עֲזָבוֹ רִדְפוּ וְתִפְשׂוּהוּ כִּי־אֵין מַצִּיל׃
tokens.translation: Saying: 'God hath forsaken him; Pursue and take him; for there is none to deliver.'
tokens.transliteration: leh-MOHR eh-loh-HEEM ah-zah-VOH ree-de-FOO ve-teef-SOO-hoo kee EYN mah-TSEEL

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים אַל־תִּרְחַק מִמֶּנִּי אֱלֹהַי לְעֶזְרָתִי חישה [חוּשָׁה׃]
tokens.translation: O God, be not far from me; O my God, make haste to help me.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM ahl teer-KHAHK mee-MEH-nee eh-loh-HAHY le-ehz-RAH-tee KHOO-shah

tokens.hebrew: יֵבֹשׁוּ יִכְלוּ שֹׂטְנֵי נַפְשִׁי יַעֲטוּ חֶרְפָּה וּכְלִמָּה מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: Let them be ashamed and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; Let them be covered with reproach and confusion that seek my hurt.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-VOH-shoo yeekh-LOO soh-te-NEY nahf-SHEE yah-ah-TOO khehr-PAH oo-khe-lee-MAH me-vahk-SHEY rah-ah-TEE

tokens.translation: But as for me, I will hope continually, And will praise Thee yet more and more.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE tah-MEED ah-yah-KHEHL ve-hoh-sahf-TEE ahl kohl te-hee-lah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: פִּי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקָתֶךָ כָּל־הַיּוֹם תְּשׁוּעָתֶךָ כִּי לֹא יָדַעְתִּי סְפֹרוֹת׃
tokens.translation: My mouth shall tell of Thy righteousness, And of Thy salvation all the day; For I know not the numbers thereof.
tokens.transliteration: PEE ye-sah-PEHR tseed-kah-TEH-khah kohl hah-YOHM te-shoo-ah-TEH-khah KEE LOH yah-DAH-tee se-foh-ROHT

tokens.hebrew: אָבוֹא בִּגְבֻרוֹת אֲדֹנָי יְהוִה אַזְכִּיר צִדְקָתְךָ לְבַדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: I will come with Thy mighty acts, O Lord GOD; I will make mention of Thy righteousness, even of Thine only.
tokens.transliteration: ah-VOH beeg-voo-ROHT ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HEEM ahz-KEER tseed-kah-te-KHAH le-vah-DEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אֱ‍לֹהִים לִמַּדְתַּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי וְעַד־הֵנָּה אַגִּיד נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: O God, Thou hast taught me from my youth; And until now do I declare Thy wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM lee-mahd-TAH-nee mee-ne-oo-RAHY ve-ahd heh-NAH ah-GEED neef-le-oh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: וְגַם עַד־זִקְנָה וְשֵׂיבָה אֱלֹהִים אַל־תַּעַזְבֵנִי עַד־אַגִּיד זְרוֹעֲךָ לְדוֹר לְכָל־יָבוֹא גְּבוּרָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: And even unto old age and hoary hairs, O God, forsake me not; Until I have declared Thy strength unto the next generation, Thy might to every one that is to come.
tokens.transliteration: ve-GAHM ahd zeek-NAH ve-sey-VAH eh-loh-HEEM ahl tah-ahz-VEH-nee ahd ah-GEED ze-roh-ah-KHAH le-DOHR le-khohl yah-VOH ge-voo-rah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: וְצִדְקָתְךָ אֱלֹהִים עַד־מָרוֹם אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂיתָ גְדֹלוֹת אֱלֹהִים מִי כָמוֹךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thy righteousness also, O God, which reacheth unto high heaven; Thou who hast done great things, O God, who is like unto Thee?
tokens.transliteration: ve-tseed-kah-te-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM ahd mah-ROHM ah-shehr ah-SEE-tah ge-doh-LOHT eh-loh-HEEM MEE khah-MOH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר הראיתנו [הִרְאִיתַנִי ] צָרוֹת רַבּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תָּשׁוּב תחיינו [תְּחַיֵּינִי] וּמִתְּהֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב תַּעֲלֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Thou, who hast made me to see many and sore troubles, Wilt quicken me again, and bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR heer-ee-TAH-nee tsah-ROHT rah-BOHT ve-rah-OHT tah-SHOOV te-khah-YEY-nee oo-mee-te-hoh-MOHT hah-AH-rehts tah-SHOOV tah-ah-LEH-nee

tokens.translation: Thou wilt increase my greatness, And turn and comfort me.

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־אֲנִי אוֹדְךָ בִכְלִי־נֶבֶל אֲמִתְּךָ אֱלֹהָי אֲזַמְּרָה לְךָ בְכִנּוֹר קְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: I also will give thanks unto Thee with the psaltery, Even unto Thy truth, O my God; I will sing praises unto Thee with the harp, O Thou Holy One of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: gahm ah-NEE oh-de-KHAH veekh-lee neh-VEHL ah-mee-te-KHAH eh-loh-HAHY ah-zah-me-RAH le-KHAH ve-khee-NOHR ke-DOHSH yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: תְּרַנֵּנָּה שְׂפָתַי כִּי אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ וְנַפְשִׁי אֲשֶׁר פָּדִיתָ׃
tokens.translation: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing praises unto Thee; And my soul, which Thou hast redeemed.
tokens.transliteration: te-rah-NEH-NAH se-fah-TAHY KEE ah-zah-me-rah LAHKH ve-nahf-SHEE ah-SHEHR pah-DEE-tah

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־לְשׁוֹנִי כָּל־הַיּוֹם תֶּהְגֶּה צִדְקָתֶךָ כִּי־בֹשׁוּ כִי־חָפְרוּ מְבַקְשֵׁי רָעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: My tongue also shall tell of Thy righteousness all the day; For they are ashamed, for they are abashed, that seek my hurt.
tokens.transliteration: gahm le-shoh-NEE kohl hah-YOHM teh-GEH tseed-kah-TEH-khah kee VOH-shoo khee khah-fe-ROO me-vahk-SHEY rah-ah-TEE

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 72
sefariaRef: Psalms 72
summary: Just leadership and care for the poor
useCase: Just leadership and care for the poor Themes: justice, community, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לִשְׁלֹמֹה אֱ‍לֹהִים מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לְמֶלֶךְ תֵּן וְצִדְקָתְךָ לְבֶן־מֶלֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of Solomon. Give the king Thy judgments, O God, and Thy righteousness unto the king's son;
tokens.transliteration: leesh-loh-MOHH eh-loh-HEEM meesh-pah-tey-KHAH le-MEH-lehkh TEHN ve-tseed-kah-te-KHAH le-vehn MEH-lehkh

tokens.translation: That he may judge Thy people with righteousness, and Thy poor with justice.

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂאוּ הָרִים שָׁלוֹם לָעָם וּגְבָעוֹת בִּצְדָקָה׃
tokens.translation: Let the mountains bear peace to the people, and the hills, through righteousness.
tokens.transliteration: yees-OO hah-REEM shah-LOHM lah-AHM oo-ge-vah-OHT beets-dah-KAH

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁפֹּט עֲ‍נִיֵּי־עָם יוֹשִׁיעַ לִבְנֵי אֶבְיוֹן וִידַכֵּא עוֹשֵׁק׃
tokens.translation: May he judge the poor of the people, and save the children of the needy, And crush the oppressor.
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-POHT ah-nee-yey AHM yoh-shee-AH leev-NEY ehv-YOHN vee-dah-KEH oh-SHEHK

tokens.hebrew: יִירָאוּךָ עִם־שָׁמֶשׁ וְלִפְנֵי יָרֵחַ דּוֹר דּוֹרִים׃
tokens.translation: They shall fear Thee while the sun endureth, and so long as the moon, throughout all generations.
tokens.transliteration: yee-rah-OO-khah eem SHAH-mehsh ve-leef-NEY yah-REH-ahkh DOHR doh-REEM

tokens.hebrew: יֵרֵד כְּמָטָר עַל־גֵּז כִּרְבִיבִים זַרְזִיף אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: May he come down like rain upon the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-REHD ke-mah-TAHR ahl GEHZ keer-vee-VEEM zahr-ZEEF AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: יִפְרַח־בְּיָמָיו צַדִּיק וְרֹב שָׁלוֹם עַד־בְּלִי יָרֵחַ׃
tokens.translation: In his days let the righteous flourish, and abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.
tokens.transliteration: yee-fe-rahkh be-yah-MAHV tsah-DEEK ve-ROHV shah-LOHM ahd be-LEE yah-REH-ahkh

tokens.translation: May he have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the River unto the ends of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-YEHRD mee-YAHM ahd YAHM oo-mee-nah-HAHR ahd ahf-sey AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: לְפָנָיו יִכְרְעוּ צִיִּים וְאֹיְבָיו עָפָר יְלַחֵכוּ׃
tokens.translation: Let them that dwell in the wilderness bow before him; and his enemies lick the dust.
tokens.transliteration: le-fah-NAHV yeekh-re-OO tsee-YEEM ve-oh-ye-VAHV ah-FAHR ye-lah-KHEH-khoo

tokens.hebrew: מַלְכֵי תַרְשִׁישׁ וְאִיִּים מִנְחָה יָשִׁיבוּ מַלְכֵי שְׁבָא וּסְבָא אֶשְׁכָּר יַקְרִיבוּ׃
tokens.translation: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute; the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
tokens.transliteration: mahl-KHEY tahr-SHEESH ve-ee-YEEM meen-KHAH yah-SHEE-voo mahl-KHEY she-VAH oo-se-VAH ehsh-KAHR yahk-REE-voo

tokens.translation: Yea, all kings shall prostrate themselves before him; All nations shall serve him.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeesh-tah-khah-voo LOH khohl me-lah-KHEEM kohl goh-YEEM yah-ahv-DOO-hoo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־יַצִּיל אֶבְיוֹן מְשַׁוֵּעַ וְעָנִי וְאֵין־עֹזֵר לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.
tokens.transliteration: kee yah-TSEEL ehv-YOHN me-shah-VEH-ah ve-ah-NEE ve-eyn oh-ZEHR LOH

tokens.hebrew: יָחֹס עַל־דַּל וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנַפְשׁוֹת אֶבְיוֹנִים יוֹשִׁיעַ׃
tokens.translation: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.
tokens.transliteration: yah-KHOHS ahl DAHL ve-ehv-YOHN ve-nahf-SHOHT ehv-yoh-NEEM yoh-SHEE-ah

tokens.hebrew: מִתּוֹךְ וּמֵחָמָס יִגְאַל נַפְשָׁם וְיֵיקַר דָּמָם בְּעֵינָיו׃
tokens.translation: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence, And precious will their blood be in his sight.
tokens.transliteration: mee-TOHKH oo-meh-khah-MAHS yeeg-AHL nahf-SHAHM ve-yey-KAHR dah-MAHM be-ey-NAHV

tokens.hebrew: וִיחִי וְיִתֶּן־לוֹ מִזְּהַב שְׁבָא וְיִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲדוֹ תָמִיד כָּל־הַיּוֹם יְבָרֲכֶנְהוּ׃
tokens.translation: That they may live, and that he may give them of the gold of Sheba, That they may pray for him continually, Yea, bless him all the day.
tokens.transliteration: vee-KHEE ve-yee-tehn LOH mee-ze-HAHV she-VAH ve-yeet-pah-LEHL bah-ah-DOH tah-MEED kohl hah-YOHM ye-vah-rahkheh-ne-HOO

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי פִסַּת־בַּר בָּאָרֶץ בְּרֹאשׁ הָרִים יִרְעַשׁ כַּלְּבָנוֹן פִּרְיוֹ וְיָצִיצוּ מֵעִיר כְּעֵשֶׂב הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: May he be as a rich cornfield in the land upon the top of the mountains; May his fruit rustle like Lebanon; And may they blossom out of the city like grass of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ye-HEE fee-saht BAHR bah-ah-REHTS be-ROHSH hah-REEM yeer-AHSH kah-le-vah-NOHN peer-YOH ve-yah-TSEE-tsoo meh-EER ke-EH-sehv hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי שְׁמוֹ לְעוֹלָם לִפְנֵי־שֶׁמֶשׁ ינין [יִנּוֹן] שְׁמוֹ וְיִתְבָּרְכוּ בוֹ כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְאַשְּׁרוּהוּ׃
tokens.translation: May his name endure for ever; May his name be continued as long as the sun; May men also bless themselves by him; May all nations call him happy.
tokens.transliteration: ye-HEE she-MOH le-oh-LAHM leef-ney sheh-MEHSH yee-NOHN she-MOH ve-yeet-BAH-re-khoo VOH kohl goh-YEEM ye-ah-she-ROO-hoo

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת לְבַדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things;
tokens.transliteration: bah-ROOKH ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEEM eh-loh-HEY yees-rah-EHL oh-SEH neef-lah-OHT le-vah-DOH

tokens.hebrew: וּבָרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹדוֹ לְעוֹלָם וְיִמָּלֵא כְבוֹדוֹ אֶת־כֹּל הָאָרֶץ אָמֵן וְאָמֵן׃
tokens.translation: And blessed be His glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with His glory. Amen, and Amen.
tokens.transliteration: oo-vah-ROOKH SHEHM ke-voh-DOH le-oh-LAHM ve-yee-mah-LEH khe-voh-DOH eht KOHL hah-AH-rehts ah-MEHN ve-ah-MEHN

tokens.translation: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

title: Psalm 73
sefariaRef: Psalms 73
useCase: Envy, prosperity, and regained perspective Themes: provision, wisdom. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אַךְ טוֹב לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֱלֹהִים לְבָרֵי לֵבָב׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, even to such as are pure in heart.
tokens.transliteration: meez-MOHR le-ah-SAHF AHKH TOHV le-yees-rah-EHL eh-loh-HEEM le-vah-REY leh-VAHV

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי כִּמְעַט נטוי [נָטָיוּ] רַגְלָי כְּאַיִן שפכה [שֻׁפְּכוּ] אֲשֻׁרָי׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE keem-AHT nah-TAH-yoo rahg-LAHY ke-AH-yeen shoo-pe-KHOO ah-shoo-RAHY

tokens.translation: For I was envious at the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: kee kee-neh-TEE bah-hoh-le-LEEM she-LOHM re-shah-EEM ehr-EH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵין חַרְצֻבּוֹת לְמוֹתָם וּבָרִיא אוּלָם׃
tokens.translation: For there are no pangs at their death, and their body is sound.
tokens.transliteration: KEE EYN khahr-tsoo-BOHT le-moh-TAHM oo-vah-REE oo-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: בַּעֲמַל אֱנוֹשׁ אֵינֵמוֹ וְעִם־אָדָם לֹא יְנֻגָּעוּ׃
tokens.translation: In the trouble of man they are not; neither are they plagued like men.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ah-MAHL eh-NOHSH ey-NEH-moh ve-eem ah-DAHM LOH ye-noo-GAH-oo

tokens.hebrew: לָכֵן עֲנָקַתְמוֹ גַאֲוָה יַעֲטָף־שִׁית חָמָס לָמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Therefore pride is as a chain about their neck; violence covereth them as a garment.
tokens.transliteration: lah-KHEHN ah-nah-KAHT-moh gah-ah-VAH yah-ah-tahf SHEET khah-MAHS LAH-moh

tokens.hebrew: יָצָא מֵחֵלֶב עֵינֵמוֹ עָבְרוּ מַשְׂכִּיּוֹת לֵבָב׃
tokens.translation: Their eyes stand forth from fatness; they are gone beyond the imaginations of their heart.
tokens.transliteration: yah-TSAH meh-KHEH-lehv ey-NEH-moh ah-ve-ROO mahs-kee-YOHT leh-VAHV

tokens.hebrew: יָמִיקוּ וִידַבְּרוּ בְרָע עֹשֶׁק מִמָּרוֹם יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
tokens.translation: They scoff, and in wickedness utter oppression; they speak as if there were none on high.
tokens.transliteration: yah-MEE-koo vee-dah-be-ROO ve-RAH OH-shehk mee-mah-ROHM ye-dah-BEH-roo

tokens.hebrew: שַׁתּוּ בַשָּׁמַיִם פִּיהֶם וּלְשׁוֹנָם תִּהֲלַךְ בָּאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: They have set their mouth against the heavens, And their tongue walketh through the earth.
tokens.transliteration: shah-TOO vah-shah-MAH-yeem pee-HEHM oo-le-shoh-NAHM tee-hah-LAHKH bah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: לָכֵן ישיב [יָשׁוּב] עַמּוֹ הֲלֹם וּמֵי מָלֵא יִמָּצוּ לָמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Therefore His people return hither; And waters of fullness are drained out by them.
tokens.transliteration: lah-KHEHN yah-SHOOV ah-MOH hah-LOHM oo-MEY mah-LEH yee-MAH-tsoo LAH-moh

tokens.hebrew: וְאָמְרוּ אֵיכָה יָדַע־אֵל וְיֵשׁ דֵּעָה בְעֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: And they say: 'How doth God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?'
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-me-ROO ey-KHAH yah-dah EHL ve-YEHSH deh-AH ve-ehl-YOHN

tokens.translation: Behold, such are the wicked; And they that are always at ease increase riches.
tokens.transliteration: hee-neh EH-leh re-shah-EEM ve-shahl-VEY oh-LAHM hees-goo KHAH-yeel

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ־רִיק זִכִּיתִי לְבָבִי וָאֶרְחַץ בְּנִקָּיוֹן כַּפָּי׃
tokens.translation: Surely in vain have I cleansed my heart, And washed my hands in innocency;
tokens.transliteration: ahkh REEK zee-KEE-tee le-vah-VEE vah-ehr-KHAHTS be-nee-kah-YOHN kah-PAHY

tokens.translation: For all the day have I been plagued, And my chastisement came every morning.
tokens.transliteration: vah-eh-HEE nah-goo-AH kohl hah-YOHM ve-toh-khahkh-TEE lah-be-kah-REEM

tokens.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי אֲסַפְּרָה כְמוֹ הִנֵּה דוֹר בָּנֶיךָ בָגָדְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: If I had said: 'I will speak thus', Behold, I had been faithless to the generation of Thy children.
tokens.transliteration: eem ah-mahr-TEE ah-sah-pe-RAH khe-MOH hee-NEH DOHR bah-NEY-khah vah-GAH-de-tee

tokens.hebrew: וָאֲחַשְּׁבָה לָדַעַת זֹאת עָמָל היא [הוּא] בְעֵינָי׃
tokens.translation: And when I pondered how I might know this, It was wearisome in mine eyes;
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-khah-she-VAH lah-DAH-aht ZOHT ah-MAHL HOO ve-ey-NAHY

tokens.translation: Until I entered into the sanctuary of God, And considered their end.
tokens.transliteration: ahd ah-VOH ehl meek-de-shey EHL ah-VEE-nah le-ah-khah-ree-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ בַּחֲלָקוֹת תָּשִׁית לָמוֹ הִפַּלְתָּם לְמַשּׁוּאוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Surely Thou settest them in slippery places; Thou hurlest them down to utter ruin.
tokens.transliteration: AHKH bah-khah-lah-KOHT tah-SHEET LAH-moh hee-pahl-TAHM le-mah-shoo-OHT

tokens.hebrew: אֵיךְ הָיוּ לְשַׁמָּה כְרָגַע סָפוּ תַמּוּ מִן־בַּלָּהוֹת׃
tokens.translation: How are they become a desolation in a moment! They are wholly consumed by terrors.
tokens.transliteration: EYKH hah-YOO le-shah-MAH khe-RAH-gah SAH-foo tah-MOO meen bah-lah-HOHT

tokens.hebrew: כַּחֲלוֹם מֵהָקִיץ אֲדֹנָי בָּעִיר צַלְמָם תִּבְזֶה׃
tokens.translation: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when Thou arousest Thyself, Thou wilt despise their semblance.
tokens.transliteration: kah-khah-LOHM meh-hah-KEETS ah-doh-NAHY bah-EER tsahl-MAHM teev-ZEH

tokens.translation: For my heart was in a ferment, And I was pricked in my reins. .

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי־בַעַר וְלֹא אֵדָע בְּהֵמוֹת הָיִיתִי עִמָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: But I was brutish, and ignorant; I was as a beast before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-nee vah-AHR ve-LOH eh-DAH be-heh-MOHT hah-YEE-tee ee-MAHKH

tokens.translation: Nevertheless I am continually with Thee; Thou holdest my right hand.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE tah-MEED ee-MAHKH ah-KHAHZ-tah be-yahd ye-mee-NEE

tokens.translation: Thou wilt guide me with Thy counsel, And afterward receive me with glory.
Whom have I in heaven but Thee? And beside Thee I desire none upon earth.
tokens.transliteration: mee LEE vah-shah-MAH-yeem ve-ee-me-KHAH loh khah-FAHTS-tee vah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: כָּלָה שְׁאֵרִי וּלְבָבִי צוּר־לְבָבִי וְחֶלְקִי אֱלֹהִים לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: My flesh and my heart faileth; But God is the rock of my heart and my portion for ever.
tokens.transliteration: kah-LAH she-eh-REE oo-le-vah-VEE tsoor le-vah-VEE ve-khehl-KEE eh-loh-HEEM le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה רְחֵקֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ הִצְמַתָּה כָּל־זוֹנֶה מִמֶּךָּ׃
tokens.translation: For, lo, they that go far from Thee shall perish; Thou dost destroy all them that go astray from Thee.
tokens.transliteration: kee hee-NEH re-kheh-KEY-khah yoh-VEH-doo heets-MAH-tah kohl zoh-NEH mee-MEH-kah

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי קִרֲבַת אֱלֹהִים לִי־טוֹב שַׁתִּי בַּאדֹנָי יְהֹוִה מַחְסִי לְסַפֵּר כָּל־מַלְאֲכוֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, the nearness of God is my good; I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, That I may tell of all Thy works.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE kee-rah-VAHT eh-loh-HEEM LEE TOHV shah-TEE bah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HEEM mahkh-SEE le-sah-PEHR kohl mahl-ah-khoh-TEY-khah

title: Psalm 74
sefariaRef: Psalms 74
useCase: Communal devastation and remembrance Themes: grief, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף לָמָה אֱלֹהִים זָנַחְתָּ לָנֶצַח יֶעְשַׁן אַפְּךָ בְּצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Maschil of Asaph. Why, O God, hast Thou cast us off for ever? Why doth Thine anger smoke against the flock of Thy pasture?
tokens.transliteration: mahs-KEEL le-ah-SAHF lah-MAH eh-loh-HEEM zah-NAHKH-tah lah-NEH-tsahkh yeh-SHAHN ah-pe-KHAH be-TSOHN mahr-ee-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: זְכֹר עֲדָתְךָ קָנִיתָ קֶּדֶם גָּאַלְתָּ שֵׁבֶט נַחֲלָתֶךָ הַר־צִיּוֹן זֶה שָׁכַנְתָּ בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast gotten of old, Which Thou hast redeemed to be the tribe of Thine inheritance; And mount Zion, wherein Thou hast dwelt.
tokens.transliteration: ze-KHOHR ah-dah-te-KHAH kah-NEE-tah KEH-dehm gah-ahl-TAH SHEH-veht nah-khah-lah-TEH-khah hahr tsee-YOHN ZEH shah-KHAHN-tah BOH

tokens.hebrew: הָרִימָה פְעָמֶיךָ לְמַשֻּׁאוֹת נֶצַח כָּל־הֵרַע אוֹיֵב בַּקֹּדֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Lift up Thy steps because of the perpetual ruins, Even all the evil that the enemy hath done in the sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: hah-REE-mah fe-ah-mey-KHAH le-mah-shoo-OHT NEH-tsahkh kohl heh-RAH oh-YEHV bah-KOH-dehsh

tokens.hebrew: שָׁאֲגוּ צֹרְרֶיךָ בְּקֶרֶב מוֹעֲדֶךָ שָׂמוּ אוֹתֹתָם אֹתוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Thine adversaries have roared in the midst of Thy meeting-place; They have set up their own signs for signs.
tokens.transliteration: shah-ah-GOO tsoh-re-rey-KHAH be-KEH-rehv moh-ah-DEH-khah SAH-moo oh-toh-TAHM oh-TOHT

tokens.translation: It seemed as when men wield upwards Axes in a thicket of trees.
tokens.transliteration: yee-vah-DAH ke-meh-VEE le-MAH-e-lah bee-sah-vahkh EHTS kahr-doo-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: ועת [וְעַתָּה] פִּתּוּחֶיהָ יָּחַד בְּכַשִּׁיל וְכֵילַפֹּת יַהֲלֹמוּן׃
tokens.translation: And now all the carved work thereof together They strike down with hatchet and hammers.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH pee-too-KHEY-hah YAH-khahd be-khah-SHEEL ve-khey-lah-POHT yah-hah-loh-MOON

tokens.hebrew: שִׁלְחוּ בָאֵשׁ מִקְדָּשֶׁךָ לָאָרֶץ חִלְּלוּ מִשְׁכַּן־שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: They have set Thy sanctuary on fire; They have profaned the dwelling-place of Thy name even to the ground.
tokens.transliteration: sheel-KHOO vah-EHSH meek-dah-SHEH-khah lah-AH-rehts khee-le-LOO mee-she-kahn she-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אָמְרוּ בְלִבָּם נִינָם יָחַד שָׂרְפוּ כָל־מוֹעֲדֵי־אֵל בָּאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: They said in their heart: 'Let us make havoc of them altogether'; They have burned up all the meeting-places of God in the land.
tokens.transliteration: ah-me-ROO ve-lee-BAHM nee-NAHM YAH-khahd sah-re-FOO khohl moh-ah-dey EHL bah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: אוֹתֹתֵינוּ לֹא רָאִינוּ אֵין־עוֹד נָבִיא וְלֹא־אִתָּנוּ יֹדֵעַ עַד־מָה׃
tokens.translation: We see not our signs; There is no more any prophet; Neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
tokens.transliteration: oh-toh-TEY-noo LOH rah-EE-noo eyn OHD nah-VEE ve-loh ee-TAH-noo yoh-DEH-ah ahd MAH

tokens.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי אֱלֹהִים יְחָרֶף צָר יְנָאֵץ אוֹיֵב שִׁמְךָ לָנֶצַח׃
tokens.translation: How long, O God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme Thy name for ever?
tokens.transliteration: ahd mah-TAHY eh-loh-HEEM ye-KHAH-rehf TSAHR ye-nah-EHTS oh-YEHV sheem-KHAH lah-NEH-tsahkh

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה תָשִׁיב יָדְךָ וִימִינֶךָ מִקֶּרֶב חוקך [חֵיקְךָ] כַלֵּה׃
tokens.translation: Why withdrawest Thou Thy hand, even Thy right hand? Draw it out of Thy bosom and consume them.
tokens.transliteration: LAH-mah tah-SHEEV yah-de-KHAH vee-mee-NEH-khah mee-KEH-rehv khey-ke-KHAH khah-LEH

tokens.hebrew: וֵאלֹהִים מַלְכִּי מִקֶּדֶם פֹּעֵל יְשׁוּעוֹת בְּקֶרֶב הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Yet God is my King of old, Working salvation in the midst of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: veh-loh-HEEM mahl-KEE mee-KEH-dehm poh-EHL ye-shoo-OHT be-KEH-rehv hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם שִׁבַּרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל־הַמָּיִם׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst break the sea in pieces by Thy strength; Thou didst shatter the heads of the sea-monsters in the waters.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH foh-RAHR-tah ve-oh-ze-KHAH YAHM shee-BAHR-tah rah-SHEY tah-nee-NEEM ahl hah-MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה רִצַּצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן תִּתְּנֶנּוּ מַאֲכָל לְעָם לְצִיִּים׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst crush the heads of leviathan, Thou gavest him to be food to the folk inhabiting the wilderness.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH ree-tsahts-TAH rah-SHEY leev-yah-TAHN tee-te-NEH-noo mah-ah-KHAHL le-AHM le-tsee-YEEM

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָחַל אַתָּה הוֹבַשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst cleave fountain and brook; Thou driedst up ever-flowing rivers.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH vah-kah-TAH mah-YAHN vah-NAH-khahl ah-TAH hoh-VAHSH-tah nah-hah-ROHT ey-TAHN

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יוֹם אַף־לְךָ לָיְלָה אַתָּה הֲכִינוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָׁמֶשׁ׃
tokens.translation: Thine is the day, Thine also the night; Thou hast established luminary and sun.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHAH YOHM ahf le-KHAH LAH-ye-lah ah-TAH hah-khee-NOH-tah mah-OHR vah-SHAH-mehsh

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הִצַּבְתָּ כָּל־גְּבוּלוֹת אָרֶץ קַיִץ וָחֹרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth; Thou hast made summer and winter.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH hee-tsahv-TAH kohl ge-voo-LOHT AH-rehts KAH-yeets vah-KHOH-rehf ah-TAH ye-tsahr-tahm

tokens.hebrew: זְכָר־זֹאת אוֹיֵב חֵרֵף יְהוָה וְעַם נָבָל נִאֲצוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Remember this, how the enemy hath reproached the LORD, And how a base people have blasphemed Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: ze-khahr ZOHT oh-YEHV kheh-REHF ah-doh-NAI ve-AHM nah-VAHL nee-ah-TSOO she-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּתֵּן לְחַיַּת נֶפֶשׁ תּוֹרֶךָ חַיַּת עֲנִיֶּיךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח לָנֶצַח׃
tokens.translation: O deliver not the soul of Thy turtle-dove unto the wild beast; Forget not the life of Thy poor for ever.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tee-TEHN le-khah-YAHT NEH-fehsh toh-REH-khah khah-YAHT ah-nee-YEY-khah ahl teesh-KAHKH lah-NEH-tsahkh

tokens.hebrew: הַבֵּט לַבְּרִית כִּי מָלְאוּ מַחֲשַׁכֵּי־אֶרֶץ נְאוֹת חָמָס׃
tokens.translation: Look upon the covenant; For the dark places of the land are full of the habitations of violence.
tokens.transliteration: hah-BEHT lah-be-REET KEE mah-le-OO mah-khah-shah-key eh-REHTS ne-OHT khah-MAHS

tokens.hebrew: אַל־יָשֹׁב דַּךְ נִכְלָם עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: O let not the oppressed turn back in confusion; Let the poor and needy praise Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: ahl yah-SHOHV DAHKH neekh-LAHM ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN ye-hah-le-LOO she-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים רִיבָה רִיבֶךָ זְכֹר חֶרְפָּתְךָ מִנִּי־נָבָל כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O God, plead Thine own cause; Remember Thy reproach all the day at the hand of the base man.
tokens.transliteration: koo-MAH eh-loh-HEEM ree-VAH ree-VEH-khah ze-KHOHR khehr-pah-te-KHAH mee-nee nah-VAHL kohl hah-YOHM

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּשְׁכַּח קוֹל צֹרְרֶיךָ שְׁאוֹן קָמֶיךָ עֹלֶה תָמִיד׃
tokens.translation: Forget not the voice of Thine adversaries, The tumult of those that rise up against Thee which ascendeth continually.
tokens.transliteration: ahl teesh-KAHKH KOHL tsoh-re-REY-khah she-OHN kah-MEY-khah oh-LEH tah-MEED

title: Psalm 75
sefariaRef: Psalms 75
useCase: Gratitude and just judgment Themes: gratitude, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; Al-tashheth. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl tahsh-KHEHT meez-MOHR le-ah-SAHF SHEER

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדִינוּ לְּךָ אֱ‍לֹהִים הוֹדִינוּ וְקָרוֹב שְׁמֶךָ סִפְּרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: We give thanks unto Thee, O God, We give thanks, and Thy name is near; Men tell of Thy wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-DEE-noo le-KHAH eh-loh-HEEM hoh-dee-NOO ve-kah-ROHV she-MEH-khah see-pe-ROO neef-le-oh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֶקַּח מוֹעֵד אֲנִי מֵישָׁרִים אֶשְׁפֹּט׃
tokens.translation: 'When I take the appointed time, I Myself will judge with equity.
tokens.transliteration: KEE eh-KAHKH moh-EHD ah-NEE mey-shah-REEM ehsh-POHT

tokens.hebrew: נְמֹגִים אֶרֶץ וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֶיהָ אָנֹכִי תִכַּנְתִּי עַמּוּדֶיהָ סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: When the earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved, I Myself establish the pillars of it.' Selah
tokens.transliteration: ne-moh-GEEM EH-rehts ve-khohl yoh-she-VEY-hah ah-noh-KHEE tee-KAHN-tee ah-moo-DEY-hah SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אָמַרְתִּי לַהוֹלְלִים אַל־תָּהֹלּוּ וְלָרְשָׁעִים אַל־תָּרִימוּ קָרֶן׃
tokens.translation: I say unto the arrogant 'Deal not arrogantly'; And to the wicked 'Lift not up the horn.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR-tee lah-hoh-le-LEEM ahl tah-HOH-loo ve-lah-re-shah-EEM ahl tah-REE-moo KAH-rehn

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תָּרִימוּ לַמָּרוֹם קַרְנְכֶם תְּדַבְּרוּ בְצַוָּאר עָתָק׃
tokens.translation: Lift not up your horn on high; Speak not insolence with a haughty neck.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tah-REE-moo lah-mah-ROHM kahr-ne-KHEHM te-dah-be-ROO ve-tsah-VAHR ah-TAHK

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא מִמּוֹצָא וּמִמַּעֲרָב וְלֹא מִמִּדְבַּר הָרִים׃
tokens.translation: For neither from the east, nor from the west, Nor yet from the wilderness, cometh lifting up.
tokens.transliteration: KEE LOH mee-moh-TSAH oo-mee-mah-ah-RAHV ve-LOH mee-meed-BAHR hah-REEM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אֱלֹהִים שֹׁפֵט זֶה יַשְׁפִּיל וְזֶה יָרִים׃
tokens.translation: For God is judge; He putteth down one, and lifteth up another.
tokens.transliteration: kee eh-loh-HEEM shoh-FEHT ZEH yahsh-PEEL ve-ZEH yah-REEM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כוֹס בְּיַד־יְהוָה וְיַיִן חָמַר מָלֵא מֶסֶךְ וַיַּגֵּר מִזֶּה אַךְ־שְׁמָרֶיהָ יִמְצוּ יִשְׁתּוּ כֹּל רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: For in the hand of the LORD there is a cup, with foaming wine, full of mixture, And He poureth out of the same; Surely the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall drain them, and drink them.
tokens.transliteration: KEE KHOHS be-yahd ah-doh-NAI ve-YAH-yeen khah-MAHR MAH-leh meh-SEHKH vah-yah-GEHR mee-ZEH ahkh she-mah-rey-HAH yeem-TSOO yeesh-TOO KOHL reesh-ey AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אַגִּיד לְעֹלָם אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE ah-GEED le-oh-LAHM ah-zah-me-RAH leh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל־קַרְנֵי רְשָׁעִים אֲגַדֵּעַ תְּרוֹמַמְנָה קַרְנוֹת צַדִּיק׃
tokens.translation: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; But the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl kahr-NEY re-shah-EEM ah-gah-DEH-ah te-roh-MAHM-nah kah-re-NOHT tsah-DEEK

title: Psalm 76
sefariaRef: Psalms 76
summary: Awe, judgment, and the ending of warfare
useCase: Awe, judgment, and the ending of warfare Themes: peace, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.

tokens.hebrew: נוֹדָע בִּיהוּדָה אֱלֹהִים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל גָּדוֹל שְׁמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: In Judah is God known; His name is great in Israel.
tokens.transliteration: noh-DAH bee-hoo-DAH eh-loh-HEEM be-yees-rah-EHL gah-DOHL she-MOH

tokens.translation: In Salem also is set His tabernacle, And His dwelling-place in Zion.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמָּה שִׁבַּר רִשְׁפֵי־קָשֶׁת מָגֵן וְחֶרֶב וּמִלְחָמָה סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: There He broke the fiery shafts of the bow; The shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
tokens.transliteration: shah-MAH shee-BAHR reesh-fey KAH-sheht mah-GEHN ve-KHEH-rehv oo-meel-khah-MAH SEH-lah

tokens.translation: Glorious art Thou and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְלוּ אַבִּירֵי לֵב נָמוּ שְׁנָתָם וְלֹא־מָצְאוּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל יְדֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: The stout-hearted are bereft of sense, they sleep their sleep; And none of the men of might have found their hands.
tokens.transliteration: ehsh-toh-le-LOO ah-BEE-rey LEHV nah-MOO she-nah-TAHM ve-loh mah-tse-OO khohl ahn-shey KHAH-yeel ye-dey-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: מִגַּעֲרָתְךָ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב נִרְדָּם וְרֶכֶב וָסוּס׃
tokens.translation: At Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, They are cast into a dead sleep, the riders also and the horses.
tokens.transliteration: mee-gah-ah-RAH-te-KHAH eh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV neer-DAHM ve-REH-khehv vah-SOOS

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נוֹרָא אַתָּה וּמִי־יַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ מֵאָז אַפֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou, even Thou, art terrible; And who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH NOH-rah AH-tah oo-mee yah-ah-MOHD le-fah-NEY-khah meh-AHZ ah-PEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: מִשָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַעְתָּ דִּין אֶרֶץ יָרְאָה וְשָׁקָטָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; The earth feared, and was still,
tokens.transliteration: mee-shah-mah-YEEM heesh-MAH-tah DEEN EH-rehts yah-re-AH ve-shah-KAH-tah

tokens.translation: When God arose to judgment, To save all the humble of the earth. Selah
tokens.transliteration: be-koom lah-meesh-PAHT eh-loh-HEEM le-hoh-SHEE-ah kohl ahn-vey EH-rehts SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־חֲמַת אָדָם תּוֹדֶךָּ שְׁאֵרִית חֵמֹת תַּחְגֹּר׃
tokens.translation: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee; The residue of wrath shalt Thou gird upon Thee.
tokens.transliteration: kee khah-MAHT ah-DAHM toh-DEH-kah she-eh-REET kheh-MOHT tahkh-GOHR

tokens.hebrew: נִדֲרוּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ לַיהוָה אֱ‍לֹהֵיכֶם כָּל־סְבִיבָיו יוֹבִילוּ שַׁי לַמּוֹרָא׃
tokens.translation: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God; Let all that are round about Him bring presents unto Him that is to be feared;
tokens.transliteration: nee-dah-ROO ve-shah-le-MOO lah-ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-KHEHM kohl se-vee-VAHV yoh-VEE-loo SHAHY lah-moh-RAH

tokens.translation: He minisheth the spirit of princes; He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: yeev-TSOHR ROO-ahkh ne-gee-DEEM noh-RAH le-mahl-khey AH-rehts

title: Psalm 77
sefariaRef: Psalms 77
useCase: Sleepless distress and recalling deliverance Themes: sleep, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; for Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.

tokens.hebrew: קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְאֶצְעָקָה קוֹלִי אֶל־אֱלֹהִים וְהַאֲזִין אֵלָי׃
tokens.translation: I will lift up my voice unto God, an cry; I will lift up my voice unto God, that He may give ear unto me.
tokens.transliteration: koh-LEE ehl eh-loh-HEEM ve-ehts-AH-kah koh-LEE ehl eh-loh-HEEM ve-hah-ah-ZEEN eh-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי אֲדֹנָי דָּרָשְׁתִּי יָדִי לַיְלָה נִגְּרָה וְלֹא תָפוּג מֵאֲנָה הִנָּחֵם נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: In the day of my trouble I seek the Lord; With my hand uplifted, [mine eye] streameth in the night without ceasing; My soul refuseth to be comforted.
tokens.transliteration: be-YOHM tsah-rah-TEE ah-doh-NAHY dah-RAH-she-tee yah-DEE LAHY-lah nee-ge-RAH ve-LOH tah-FOOG meh-ah-NAH hee-nah-KHEHM nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: אֶזְכְּרָה אֱלֹהִים וְאֶהֱמָיָה אָשִׂיחָה וְתִתְעַטֵּף רוּחִי סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: When I think thereon, O God, I must moan; When I muse thereon, my spirit fainteth. Selah .
tokens.transliteration: ehz-ke-RAH eh-loh-HEEM ve-eh-heh-mah-YAH ah-SEE-khah ve-teet-ah-TEHF roo-KHEE SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אָחַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרוֹת עֵינָי נִפְעַמְתִּי וְלֹא אֲדַבֵּר׃
tokens.translation: Thou holdest fast the lids of mine eyes; I am troubled, and cannot speak.
tokens.transliteration: ah-khahz-TAH she-moo-ROHT ey-NAHY neef-AHM-tee ve-LOH ah-dah-BEHR

tokens.translation: I have pondered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

tokens.hebrew: אֶזְכְּרָה נְגִינָתִי בַּלָּיְלָה עִם־לְבָבִי אָשִׂיחָה וַיְחַפֵּשׂ רוּחִי׃
tokens.translation: In the night I will call to remembrance my song; I will commune with mine own heart; And my spirit maketh diligent search
tokens.transliteration: eh-ze-ke-RAH ne-gee-nah-TEE bah-LAH-ye-lah eem le-vah-VEE ah-SEE-khah vah-ye-khah-PEHS roo-KHEE

tokens.hebrew: הַלְעוֹלָמִים יִזְנַח אֲדֹנָי וְלֹא־יֹסִיף לִרְצוֹת עוֹד׃
tokens.translation: 'Will the Lord cast off for ever? And will He be favourable no more?
tokens.transliteration: hah-le-oh-lah-MEEM yeez-NAHKH ah-doh-NAHY ve-loh yoh-SEEF leer-TSOHT OHD

tokens.hebrew: הֶאָפֵס לָנֶצַח חַסְדּוֹ גָּמַר אֹמֶר לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: Is His mercy clean gone for ever? Is His promise come to an end for evermore?
tokens.transliteration: heh-ah-FEHS lah-NEH-tsahkh khahs-DOH GAH-mahr oh-MEHR le-DOHR vah-DOHR

tokens.hebrew: הֲשָׁכַח חַנּוֹת אֵל אִם־קָפַץ בְּאַף רַחֲמָיו סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? Hath He in anger shut up his compassions?' Selah
tokens.transliteration: hah-shah-KHAHKH khah-NOHT EHL eem kah-FAHTS be-AHF rah-khah-MAHV SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמַר חַלּוֹתִי הִיא שְׁנוֹת יְמִין עֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: And I say 'This is my weakness, That the right hand of the Most High could change.
tokens.transliteration: vah-oh-MAHR khah-LOH-tee HEE she-NOHT ye-MEEN ehl-YOHN

tokens.translation: I will make mention of the deeds of the LORD; Yea, I will remember Thy wonders of old.
tokens.transliteration: ehz-KOHR mah-ahl-ley YAHH kee ehz-ke-RAH mee-KEH-dehm peel-EH-khah

tokens.translation: I will meditate also upon all Thy work, And muse on Thy doings.'

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים בַּקֹּדֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּךָ מִי־אֵל גָּדוֹל כֵּאלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: O God, Thy way is in holiness; Who is a great god like unto God?
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM bah-KOH-dehsh dahr-KEH-khah mee EHL gah-DOHL keh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הָאֵל עֹשֵׂה פֶלֶא הוֹדַעְתָּ בָעַמִּים עֻזֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou art the God that doest wonders; Thou hast made known Thy strength among the peoples.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH hah-EHL OH-seh FEH-leh hoh-DAH-tah vah-ah-MEEM oo-ZEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: גָּאַלְתָּ בִּזְרוֹעַ עַמֶּךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹב וְיוֹסֵף סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast with Thine arm redeemed Thy people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
tokens.transliteration: gah-AHL-tah beez-ROH-ah ah-MEH-khah be-ney yah-ah-KOHV ve-yoh-SEHF SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: רָאוּךָ מַּיִם אֱ‍לֹהִים רָאוּךָ מַּיִם יָחִילוּ אַף יִרְגְּזוּ תְהֹמוֹת׃
tokens.translation: The waters saw Thee, O God; The waters saw Thee, they were in pain; The depths also trembled.
tokens.transliteration: rah-OO-khah MAH-yeem eh-loh-HEEM rah-OO-khah MAH-yeem yah-KHEE-loo AHF yeer-ge-ZOO te-hoh-MOHT

tokens.hebrew: זֹרְמוּ מַיִם עָבוֹת קוֹל נָתְנוּ שְׁחָקִים אַף־חֲצָצֶיךָ יִתְהַלָּכוּ׃
tokens.translation: The clouds flooded forth waters; The skies sent out a sound; Thine arrows also went abroad.
tokens.transliteration: ZOH-re-moo MAH-yeem ah-VOHT KOHL nah-te-NOO she-khah-KEEM ahf khah-tsah-TSEY-khah yeet-hah-LAH-khoo

tokens.hebrew: קוֹל רַעַמְךָ בַּגַּלְגַּל הֵאִירוּ בְרָקִים תֵּבֵל רָגְזָה וַתִּרְעַשׁ הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: The voice of Thy thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lighted up the world; The earth trembled and shook.
tokens.transliteration: KOHL rah-ahm-KHAH bah-gahl-GAHL heh-EE-roo ve-rah-KEEM teh-VEHL rohg-ZAH vah-teer-AHSH hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: בַּיָּם דַּרְכֶּךָ ושביליך [וּשְׁבִילְךָ] בְּמַיִם רַבִּים וְעִקְּבוֹתֶיךָ לֹא נֹדָעוּ׃
tokens.translation: Thy way was in the sea, And Thy path in the great waters, And Thy footsteps were not known.
tokens.transliteration: bah-YAHM dahr-KEH-khah oo-she-vee-le-KHAH be-MAH-yeem rah-BEEM ve-ee-ke-voh-TEY-khah LOH noh-DAH-oo

tokens.translation: Thou didst lead Thy people like a flock, By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
tokens.transliteration: nah-KHEE-tah khah-TSOHN ah-MEH-khah be-yahd moh-SHEH ve-ah-hah-ROHN

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 78
sefariaRef: Psalms 78
summary: Teaching history to the next generation
useCase: Teaching history to the next generation Themes: learning, children, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מַשְׂכִּיל לְאָסָף הַאֲזִינָה עַמִּי תּוֹרָתִי הַטּוּ אָזְנְכֶם לְאִמְרֵי־פִי׃
tokens.translation: Maschil of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, to my teaching; Incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
tokens.transliteration: mahs-KEEL le-ah-SAHF hah-ah-ZEE-nah ah-MEE toh-rah-TEE hah-TOO ohz-ne-KHEHM le-eem-rey FEE

tokens.hebrew: אֶפְתְּחָה בְמָשָׁל פִּי אַבִּיעָה חִידוֹת מִנִּי־קֶדֶם׃
tokens.translation: I will open my mouth with a parable; I will utter dark sayings concerning days of old;
tokens.transliteration: ehf-te-KHAH ve-mah-SHAHL PEE ah-BEE-ah khee-DOHT mee-nee KEH-dehm

tokens.translation: That which we have heard and known, And our fathers have told us,
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR shah-mah-NOO vah-neh-dah-EHM vah-ah-voh-TEY-noo see-pe-roo LAH-noo

tokens.hebrew: לֹא נְכַחֵד מִבְּנֵיהֶם לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן מְסַפְּרִים תְּהִלּוֹת יְהוָה וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה׃
tokens.translation: We will not hide from their children, Telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, And His strength, and His wondrous works that He hath done. .
tokens.transliteration: LOH ne-khah-KHEHD mee-be-ney-HEHM le-DOHR ah-khah-ROHN me-sah-pe-REEM te-hee-LOHT ah-doh-NAI veh-eh-zoo-ZOH ve-neef-le-oh-TAHV ah-SHEHR ah-SAH

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם עֵדוּת בְּיַעֲקֹב וְתוֹרָה שָׂם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהוֹדִיעָם לִבְנֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: For He established a testimony in Jacob, And appointed a law in Israel, Which He commanded our fathers, That they should make them known to their children;
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAH-kehm eh-DOOT be-yah-ah-KOHV ve-toh-RAH SAHM be-yees-rah-EHL ah-SHEHR tsee-VAH eht ah-voh-TEY-noo le-hoh-dee-AHM leev-ney-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דּוֹר אַחֲרוֹן בָּנִים יִוָּלֵדוּ יָקֻמוּ וִיסַפְּרוּ לִבְנֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: That the generation to come might know them, even the children that should be born; Who should arise and tell them to their children,
tokens.transliteration: le-MAH-ahn yeh-de-OO DOHR ah-khah-ROHN bah-NEEM yee-vah-LEH-doo yah-KOO-moo vee-sah-pe-ROO leev-ney-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: וְיָשִׂימוּ בֵאלֹהִים כִּסְלָם וְלֹא יִשְׁכְּחוּ מַעַלְלֵי־אֵל וּמִצְוֺתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ׃
tokens.translation: That they might put their confidence in God, And not forget the works of God, But keep His commandments;
tokens.transliteration: ve-yah-SEE-moo veh-loh-HEEM kees-LAHM ve-LOH yeesh-ke-KHOO mah-ahl-ley EHL oo-meets-voh-TAHV yeen-TSOH-roo

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹא יִהְיוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם דּוֹר סוֹרֵר וּמֹרֶה דּוֹר לֹא־הֵכִין לִבּוֹ וְלֹא־נֶאֶמְנָה אֶת־אֵל רוּחוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And might not be as their fathers, A stubborn and rebellious generation; A generation that set not their heart aright, And whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
tokens.transliteration: ve-LOH yeeh-YOO kah-ah-voh-TAHM DOHR soh-REHR oo-moh-REH DOHR loh heh-KHEEN lee-BOH ve-loh neh-ehm-NAH eht EHL roo-KHOH

tokens.hebrew: בְּנֵי־אֶפְרַיִם נוֹשְׁקֵי רוֹמֵי־קָשֶׁת הָפְכוּ בְּיוֹם קְרָב׃
tokens.translation: The children of Ephraim were as archers handling the bow, That turned back in the day of battle.
tokens.transliteration: be-ney ehf-RAH-yeem noh-she-KEY roh-mey KAH-sheht hah-fe-KHOO be-YOHM ke-RAHV

tokens.hebrew: לֹא שָׁמְרוּ בְּרִית אֱלֹהִים וּבְתוֹרָתוֹ מֵאֲנוּ לָלֶכֶת׃
tokens.translation: They kept not the covenant of God, And refused to walk in His law;
tokens.transliteration: LOH shah-me-ROO be-REET eh-loh-HEEM oo-ve-toh-rah-TOH meh-ah-NOO lah-LEH-kheht

tokens.translation: And they forgot His doings, And His wondrous works that He had shown them.

tokens.hebrew: נֶגֶד אֲבוֹתָם עָשָׂה פֶלֶא בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם שְׂדֵה־צֹעַן׃
tokens.translation: Marvellous things did He in the sight of their fathers, In the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.
tokens.transliteration: NEH-gehd ah-voh-TAHM AH-sah FEH-leh be-EH-rehts meets-RAH-yeem se-deh TSOH-ahn

tokens.translation: He cleaved the sea, and caused them to pass through; And He made the waters to stand as a heap.
tokens.transliteration: BAH-kah YAHM vah-yah-ah-vee-REHM vah-yah-tsehv MAH-yeem ke-moh NEHD

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם בֶּעָנָן יוֹמָם וְכָל־הַלַּיְלָה בְּאוֹר אֵשׁ׃
tokens.translation: By day also He led them with a cloud, And all the night with a light of fire.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahn-KHEHM beh-ah-NAHN yoh-MAHM ve-khohl hah-LAHY-lah be-OHR EHSH

tokens.hebrew: יְבַקַּע צֻרִים בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיַּשְׁקְ כִּתְהֹמוֹת רַבָּה׃
tokens.translation: He cleaved rocks in the wilderness, And gave them drink abundantly as out of the great deep.
tokens.transliteration: ye-vah-KAH tsoo-REEM bah-meed-BAHR vah-YAHSHK keet-hoh-MOHT rah-BAH

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִא נוֹזְלִים מִסָּלַע וַיּוֹרֶד כַּנְּהָרוֹת מָיִם׃
tokens.translation: He brought streams also out of the rock, And caused waters to run down like rivers.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-TSEE noh-ze-LEEM mee-SAH-lah vah-YOH-rehd kah-ne-hah-ROHT MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹסִיפוּ עוֹד לַחֲטֹא־לוֹ לַמְרוֹת עֶלְיוֹן בַּצִּיָּה׃
tokens.translation: Yet went they on still to sin against Him, To rebel against the Most High in the desert.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-SEE-foo OHD lah-khah-toh LOH lah-me-ROHT ehl-YOHN bah-tsee-YAH

tokens.translation: And they tried God in their heart By asking food for their craving.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-nah-soo EHL beel-vah-VAHM lee-she-ahl OH-khehl le-nahf-SHAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבְּרוּ בֵּאלֹהִים אָמְרוּ הֲיוּכַל אֵל לַעֲרֹךְ שֻׁלְחָן בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
tokens.translation: Yea, they spoke against God; They said 'Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-dah-be-ROO beh-loh-HEEM ah-me-ROO hah-YOO-khahl EHL lah-ah-ROHKH shool-KHAHN bah-meed-BAHR

tokens.hebrew: הֵן הִכָּה־צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מַיִם וּנְחָלִים יִשְׁטֹפוּ הֲגַם־לֶחֶם יוּכַל תֵּת אִם־יָכִין שְׁאֵר לְעַמּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Behold, He smote the rock, that waters gushed out, And streams overflowed; Can He give bread also? Or will He provide flesh for His people?'
tokens.transliteration: HEHN hee-kah TSOOR vah-yah-ZOO-voo mah-YEEM oo-ne-khah-LEEM yeesh-TOH-foo hah-gahm leh-KHEHM YOO-khahl TEHT eem yah-KHEEN she-EHR le-ah-MOH

tokens.hebrew: לָכֵן שָׁמַע יְהוָה וַיִּתְעַבָּר וְאֵשׁ נִשְּׂקָה בְיַעֲקֹב וְגַם־אַף עָלָה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: Therefore the LORD heard, and was wroth; And a fire was kindled against Jacob, And anger also went up against Israel;
tokens.transliteration: lah-KHEHN shah-MAH ah-doh-NAI vah-yeet-ah-BAHR ve-EHSH nee-se-KAH ve-yah-ah-KOHV ve-gahm AHF ah-LAH ve-yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא הֶאֱמִינוּ בֵּאלֹהִים וְלֹא בָטְחוּ בִּישׁוּעָתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Because they believed not in God, And trusted not in His salvation.
tokens.transliteration: KEE LOH heh-eh-mee-NOO beh-loh-HEEM ve-LOH vah-te-KHOO bee-shoo-ah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: וַיְצַו שְׁחָקִים מִמָּעַל וְדַלְתֵי שָׁמַיִם פָּתָח׃
tokens.translation: And He commanded the skies above, And opened the doors of heaven;
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-TSAHV she-khah-KEEM mee-MAH-ahl ve-dahl-TEY shah-MAH-yeem pah-TAHKH

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם מָן לֶאֱכֹל וּדְגַן־שָׁמַיִם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And He caused manna to rain upon them for food, And gave them of the corn of heaven.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahm-TEHR ah-ley-HEHM MAHN leh-eh-KHOHL oo-de-gahn shah-MAH-yeem NAH-tahn LAH-moh

tokens.hebrew: לֶחֶם אַבִּירִים אָכַל אִישׁ צֵידָה שָׁלַח לָהֶם לָשֹׂבַע׃
tokens.translation: Man did eat the bread of the mighty; He sent them provisions to the full.
tokens.transliteration: LEH-khehm ah-bee-REEM AH-khahl EESH tsey-DAH shah-LAHKH lah-HEHM lah-SOH-vah

tokens.hebrew: יַסַּע קָדִים בַּשָּׁמָיִם וַיְנַהֵג בְּעֻזּוֹ תֵימָן׃
tokens.translation: He caused the east wind to set forth in heaven; And by His power He brought on the south wind.
tokens.transliteration: yah-SAH kah-DEEM bah-shah-MAH-yeem vah-ye-nah-HEHG be-oo-ZOH tey-MAHN

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּמְטֵר עֲלֵיהֶם כֶּעָפָר שְׁאֵר וּכְחוֹל יַמִּים עוֹף כָּנָף׃
tokens.translation: He caused flesh also to rain upon them as the dust, And winged fowl as the sand of the seas;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahm-TEHR ah-ley-HEHM keh-ah-FAHR she-EHR oo-khe-KHOHL yah-MEEM OHF kah-NAHF

tokens.translation: And He let it fall in the midst of their camp, Round about their dwellings.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאכְלוּ וַיִּשְׂבְּעוּ מְאֹד וְתַאֲוָתָם יָבִא לָהֶם׃
tokens.translation: So they did eat, and were well filled; And He gave them that which they craved.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-khe-LOO vah-yees-be-OO me-OHD ve-tah-ah-vah-TAHM yah-VEE lah-HEHM

tokens.translation: They were not estranged from their craving, Their food was yet in their mouths,
tokens.transliteration: loh zah-ROO mee-tah-ah-vah-TAHM OHD ohkh-LAHM be-fee-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: וְאַף אֱלֹהִים עָלָה בָהֶם וַיַּהֲרֹג בְּמִשְׁמַנֵּיהֶם וּבַחוּרֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל הִכְרִיעַ׃
tokens.translation: When the anger of God went up against them, And slew of the lustieth among them, And smote down the young men of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: ve-AHF eh-loh-HEEM ah-LAH vah-HEHM vah-yah-hah-ROHG be-meesh-mah-ney-HEHM oo-vah-khoo-REY yees-rah-EHL heekh-REE-ah

tokens.translation: For all this they sinned still, And believed not in His wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration: be-khohl ZOHT khah-te-oo OHD ve-loh heh-eh-MEE-noo be-neef-le-oh-TAHV

tokens.translation: Therefore He ended their days as a breath, And their years in terror.
When He slew them, then they would inquire after Him, And turn back and seek God earnestly.
tokens.transliteration: eem hah-rah-GAHM oo-de-rah-SHOO-hoo ve-SHAH-voo ve-shee-khah-roo EHL

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּזְכְּרוּ כִּי־אֱלֹהִים צוּרָם וְאֵל עֶלְיוֹן גֹּאֲלָם׃
tokens.translation: And they remembered that God was their Rock, And the Most High God their redeemer.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-ke-ROO kee eh-loh-HEEM tsoo-RAHM ve-EHL ehl-YOHN goh-ah-LAHM

tokens.translation: But they beguiled Him with their mouth, And lied unto Him with their tongue.

tokens.hebrew: וְלִבָּם לֹא־נָכוֹן עִמּוֹ וְלֹא נֶאֶמְנוּ בִּבְרִיתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For their heart was not stedfast with Him, Neither were they faithful in His covenant.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lee-BAHM loh nah-KHOHN ee-MOH ve-LOH neh-ehm-NOO beev-ree-TOH

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: But He, being full of compassion, forgiveth iniquity, and destroyeth not; Yea, many a time doth He turn His anger away, And doth not stir up all His wrath.
tokens.transliteration: ve-HOO rah-KHOOM ye-khah-PEHR ah-VOHN ve-loh yahsh-KHEET ve-heer-BAH le-hah-SHEEV ah-POH ve-loh yah-EER kohl khah-mah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר כִּי־בָשָׂר הֵמָּה רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב׃
tokens.translation: So He remembered that they were but flesh, A wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-KOHR kee vah-SAHR HEH-mah ROO-ahkh hoh-LEHKH ve-LOH yah-SHOOV

tokens.translation: How oft did they rebel against Him in the wilderness, And grieve Him in the desert!

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּשׁוּבוּ וַיְנַסּוּ אֵל וּקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל הִתְווּ׃
tokens.translation: And still again they tried God, And set bounds to the Holy One of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-SHOO-voo vah-ye-nah-SOO EHL oo-ke-DOHSH yees-rah-EHL heet-voo

tokens.translation: They remembered not His hand, Nor the day when He redeemed them from the adversary.
tokens.transliteration: loh zah-khe-ROO eht yah-DOH YOHM ah-shehr pah-DAHM mee-nee TSAHR

tokens.translation: How He set His signs in Egypt, And His wonders in the field of Zoan; .
tokens.transliteration: ah-shehr SAHM be-meets-rah-YEEM oh-toh-TAHV oo-moh-fe-TAHV bees-deh TSOH-ahn

tokens.translation: And turned their rivers into blood, So that they could not drink their streams.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-hah-FOHKH le-DAHM ye-oh-rey-HEHM ve-noh-ze-ley-HEHM bahl yeesh-tah-YOON

tokens.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח בָּהֶם עָרֹב וַיֹּאכְלֵם וּצְפַרְדֵּעַ וַתַּשְׁחִיתֵם׃
tokens.translation: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; And frogs, which destroyed them.
tokens.transliteration: ye-shah-LAHKH bah-HEHM ah-ROHV vah-yoh-khe-LEHM oo-tse-fahr-DEH-ah vah-tahsh-khee-TEHM

tokens.translation: He gave also their increase unto the caterpillar, And their labour unto the locust.
He destroyed their vines with hail, And their sycamore-trees with frost.
He gave over their cattle also to the hail, And their flocks to fiery bolts.

tokens.hebrew: יְשַׁלַּח־בָּם חֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ עֶבְרָה וָזַעַם וְצָרָה מִשְׁלַחַת מַלְאֲכֵי רָעִים׃
tokens.translation: He sent forth upon them the fierceness of His anger, Wrath, and indignation, and trouble, A sending of messengers of evil.
tokens.transliteration: ye-shah-lahkh BAHM khah-ROHN ah-POH ehv-RAH vah-ZAH-ahm ve-tsah-RAH meesh-LAH-khaht mahl-ah-KHEY rah-EEM

tokens.hebrew: יְפַלֵּס נָתִיב לְאַפּוֹ לֹא־חָשַׂךְ מִמָּוֶת נַפְשָׁם וְחַיָּתָם לַדֶּבֶר הִסְגִּיר׃
tokens.translation: He levelled a path for His anger; He spared not their soul from death, But gave their life over to the pestilence;
tokens.transliteration: ye-fah-LEHS nah-TEEV le-ah-POH loh khah-SAHKH mee-MAH-veht nahf-SHAHM ve-khah-yah-TAHM lah-DEH-vehr hees-GEER

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּמִצְרָיִם רֵאשִׁית אוֹנִים בְּאָהֳלֵי־חָם׃
tokens.translation: And smote all the first-born in Egypt, The first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAHKH kohl be-KHOHR be-meets-RAH-yeem reh-SHEET oh-NEEM be-oh-hoh-ley KHAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּסַּע כַּצֹּאן עַמּוֹ וַיְנַהֲגֵם כַּעֵדֶר בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
tokens.translation: But He made His own people to go forth like sheep, And guided them in the wilderness like a flock.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-SAH kah-TSOHN ah-MOH vah-ye-nah-hah-GEHM kah-EH-dehr bah-meed-BAHR

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּנְחֵם לָבֶטַח וְלֹא פָחָדוּ וְאֶת־אוֹיְבֵיהֶם כִּסָּה הַיָּם׃
tokens.translation: And He led them safely, and they feared not; But the sea overwhelmed their enemies.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahn-KHEHM lah-veh-TAHKH ve-LOH fah-KHAH-doo ve-eht oh-ye-vey-HEHM kee-SAH hah-YAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיְבִיאֵם אֶל־גְּבוּל קָדְשׁוֹ הַר־זֶה קָנְתָה יְמִינוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And He brought them to His holy border, To the mountain, which His right hand had gotten.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-vee-EHM ehl ge-VOOL kohd-SHOH hahr ZEH kah-ne-TAH ye-mee-NOH

tokens.hebrew: וַיְגָרֶשׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶם גּוֹיִם וַיַּפִּילֵם בְּחֶבֶל נַחֲלָה וַיַּשְׁכֵּן בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם שִׁבְטֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: He drove out the nations also before them, And allotted them for an inheritance by line, And made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-GAH-rehsh mee-pe-ney-HEHM goh-YEEM vah-yah-pee-LEHM be-KHEH-vehl nah-khah-LAH vah-yahsh-KEHN be-oh-hoh-ley-HEHM sheev-TEY yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: וַיְנַסּוּ וַיַּמְרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהִים עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵדוֹתָיו לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
tokens.translation: Yet they tried and provoked God, the Most High, And kept not His testimonies;
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-nah-SOO vah-yahm-ROO eht eh-loh-HEEM ehl-YOHN ve-eh-doh-TAHV LOH shah-MAH-roo

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּסֹּגוּ וַיִּבְגְּדוּ כַּאֲבוֹתָם נֶהְפְּכוּ כְּקֶשֶׁת רְמִיָּה׃
tokens.translation: But turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers; They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-SOH-goo vah-yeev-ge-DOO kah-ah-voh-TAHM neh-pe-KHOO ke-KEH-sheht re-mee-YAH

tokens.translation: For they provoked Him with their high places, And moved Him to jealousy with their graven images.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמַע אֱלֹהִים וַיִּתְעַבָּר וַיִּמְאַס מְאֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
tokens.translation: God heard, and was wroth, And He greatly abhorred Israel;
tokens.transliteration: shah-MAH eh-loh-HEEM vah-yeet-ah-BAHR vah-yeem-AHS me-OHD be-yees-rah-EHL

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּטֹּשׁ מִשְׁכַּן שִׁלוֹ אֹהֶל שִׁכֵּן בָּאָדָם׃
tokens.translation: And He forsook the tabernacle of Shiloh, The tent which He had made to dwell among men;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TOHSH meesh-KAHN shee-LOH oh-HEHL shee-KEHN bah-ah-DAHM

tokens.translation: And delivered His strength into captivity, And His glory into the adversary's hand.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TEHN lah-she-VEE oo-ZOH ve-teef-ahr-TOH ve-yahd TSAHR

tokens.translation: He gave His people over also unto the sword; And was wroth with His inheritance.
Fire devoured their young men; And their virgins had no marriage-song.
tokens.transliteration: bah-khoo-RAHV ah-khe-lah EHSH oo-ve-too-loh-TAHV LOH hoo-LAH-loo

tokens.hebrew: כֹּהֲנָיו בַּחֶרֶב נָפָלוּ וְאַלְמְנֹתָיו לֹא תִבְכֶּינָה׃
tokens.translation: Their priests fell by the sword; And their widows made no lamentation. .
tokens.transliteration: koh-hah-NAHV bah-KHEH-rehv nah-FAH-loo ve-ahl-me-noh-TAHV LOH teev-KEY-nah

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּקַץ כְּיָשֵׁן אֲדֹנָי כְּגִבּוֹר מִתְרוֹנֵן מִיָּיִן׃
tokens.translation: Then the Lord awaked as one asleep, Like a mighty man recovering from wine.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-KAHTS ke-yah-SHEHN ah-doh-NAHY ke-gee-BOHR meet-roh-NEHN mee-YAH-yeen

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּךְ־צָרָיו אָחוֹר חֶרְפַּת עוֹלָם נָתַן לָמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And He smote His adversaries backward; He put upon them a perpetual reproach.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahkh tsah-RAHV ah-KHOHR khehr-PAHT oh-LAHM NAH-tahn LAH-moh

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּמְאַס בְּאֹהֶל יוֹסֵף וּבְשֵׁבֶט אֶפְרַיִם לֹא בָחָר׃
tokens.translation: Moreover He abhorred the tent of Joseph, And chose not the tribe of Ephraim;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeem-AHS be-OH-hehl yoh-SEHF oo-ve-SHEH-veht ehf-RAH-yeem LOH vah-KHAHR

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר אֶת־שֵׁבֶט יְהוּדָה אֶת־הַר צִיּוֹן אֲשֶׁר אָהֵב׃
tokens.translation: But chose the tribe of Judah, The mount Zion which He loved.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeev-KHAHR eht SHEH-veht ye-hoo-DAH eht HAHR tsee-YOHN ah-SHEHR ah-HEHV

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן כְּמוֹ־רָמִים מִקְדָּשׁוֹ כְּאֶרֶץ יְסָדָהּ לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: And He built His sanctuary like the heights, Like the earth which He hath founded for ever.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YEE-vehn ke-moh rah-MEEM meek-dah-SHOH ke-EH-rehts ye-sah-DAHH le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּבְחַר בְּדָוִד עַבְדּוֹ וַיִּקָּחֵהוּ מִמִּכְלְאֹת צֹאן׃
tokens.translation: He chose David also His servant, And took him from the sheepfolds;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeev-KHAHR be-dah-VEED ahv-DOH vah-yee-kah-KHEH-hoo mee-meekh-le-OHT TSOHN

tokens.hebrew: מֵאַחַר עָלוֹת הֱבִיאוֹ לִרְעוֹת בְּיַעֲקֹב עַמּוֹ וּבְיִשְׂרָאֵל נַחֲלָתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: From following the ewes that give suck He brought him, To be shepherd over Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: meh-ah-KHAHR ah-LOHT heh-vee-OH leer-OHT be-yah-ah-KOHV ah-MOH oo-ve-yees-rah-EHL nah-khah-lah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּרְעֵם כְּתֹם לְבָבוֹ וּבִתְבוּנוֹת כַּפָּיו יַנְחֵם׃
tokens.translation: So he shepherded them according to the integrity of his heart; And lead them by the skilfulness of his hands.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeer-EHM ke-TOHM le-vah-VOH oo-veet-voo-NOHT kah-PAHV yahn-KHEHM

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 79
sefariaRef: Psalms 79
summary: Destruction, mourning, and appeal for mercy
useCase: Destruction, mourning, and appeal for mercy Themes: grief, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים בָּאוּ גוֹיִם בְּנַחֲלָתֶךָ טִמְּאוּ אֶת־הֵיכַל קָדְשֶׁךָ שָׂמוּ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם לְעִיִּים׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the heathen are come into Thine inheritance; They have defiled Thy holy temple; They have made Jerusalem into heaps.
tokens.transliteration: meez-MOHR le-ah-SAHF eh-loh-HEEM BAH-oo goh-YEEM be-nah-khah-lah-TEH-khah tee-me-OO eht hey-KHAHL kohd-SHEH-khah SAH-moo eht ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem le-ee-YEEM

tokens.hebrew: נָתְנוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת עֲבָדֶיךָ מַאֲכָל לְעוֹף הַשָּׁמָיִם בְּשַׂר חֲסִידֶיךָ לְחַיְתוֹ־אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: They have given the dead bodies of Thy servants to be food unto the fowls of the heaven, The flesh of Thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: nah-te-NOO eht neev-LAHT ah-vah-DEY-khah mah-ah-KHAHL le-OHF hah-shah-MAH-yeem be-SAHR khah-see-DEY-khah le-khahy-toh AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: שָׁפְכוּ דָמָם כַּמַּיִם סְבִיבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָם וְאֵין קוֹבֵר׃
tokens.translation: They have shed their blood like water Round about Jerusalem, with none to bury them.
tokens.transliteration: shah-fe-KHOO dah-MAHM kah-MAH-yeem se-vee-VOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem ve-EYN koh-VEHR

tokens.hebrew: הָיִינוּ חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ לַעַג וָקֶלֶס לִסְבִיבוֹתֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: We are become a taunt to our neighbours, A scorn and derision to them that are round about us.
tokens.transliteration: hah-YEE-noo khehr-PAH leesh-kheh-NEY-noo LAH-ahg vah-KEH-lehs lees-vee-voh-TEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תֶּאֱנַף לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ קִנְאָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou be angry for ever? How long will Thy jealousy burn like fire?
tokens.transliteration: ahd MAH ah-doh-NAI teh-eh-NAHF lah-NEH-tsahkh teev-AHR ke-moh EHSH keen-ah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל מַמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ׃
tokens.translation: Pour out Thy wrath upon the nations that know Thee not, And upon the kingdoms that call not upon Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: she-FOHKH khah-mah-te-KHAH ehl hah-goh-YEEM ah-SHEHR loh ye-dah-OO-khah ve-AHL mahm-lah-KHOHT ah-SHEHR be-sheem-KHAH LOH kah-RAH-oo

tokens.translation: For they have devoured Jacob, And laid waste his habitation.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ah-KHAHL eht yah-ah-KOHV ve-eht nah-VEH-hoo heh-SHAH-moo

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּזְכָּר־לָנוּ עֲוֺנֹת רִאשֹׁנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּמוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ כִּי דַלּוֹנוּ מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: Remember not against us the iniquities of our forefathers; Let Thy compassions speedily come to meet us; For we are brought very low.
tokens.transliteration: ahl teez-kahr lah-NOO ah-voh-NOHT ree-shoh-NEEM mah-HEHR ye-kah-de-MOO-noo rah-khah-MEY-khah KEE dah-LOH-noo me-OHD

tokens.hebrew: עָזְרֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶךָ וְהַצִּילֵנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵינוּ לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the sake of the glory of Thy name; And deliver us, and forgive our sins, for Thy name's sake.
tokens.transliteration: ah-ze-REH-noo eh-loh-HEY yeesh-EH-noo ahl de-VAHR ke-vohd she-MEH-khah ve-hah-tsee-LEH-noo ve-khah-PEHR ahl khah-toh-TEY-noo le-MAH-ahn she-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה יֹאמְרוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה אֱ‍לֹהֵיהֶם יִוָּדַע בגיים [בַּגּוֹיִם] לְעֵינֵינוּ נִקְמַת דַּם־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ׃
tokens.translation: Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is their God?' Let the avenging of Thy servants' blood that is shed Be made known among the nations in our sight. .
tokens.transliteration: LAH-mah yoh-me-ROO hah-goh-YEEM ah-YEH eh-loh-hey-HEHM yee-vah-DAH bah-goh-YEEM le-ey-NEY-noo neek-MAHT dahm ah-vah-DEY-khah hah-shah-FOOKH

tokens.hebrew: תָּבוֹא לְפָנֶיךָ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר כְּגֹדֶל זְרוֹעֲךָ הוֹתֵר בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
tokens.translation: Let the groaning of the prisoner come before Thee; According to the greatness of Thy power set free those that are appointed to death;
tokens.transliteration: TAH-VOH le-fah-ney-KHAH ehn-KAHT ah-SEER ke-GOH-dehl ze-roh-ah-KHAH hoh-TEHR be-NEY te-moo-TAH

tokens.hebrew: וְהָשֵׁב לִשְׁכֵנֵינוּ שִׁבְעָתַיִם אֶל־חֵיקָם חֶרְפָּתָם אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּךָ אֲדֹנָי׃
tokens.translation: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom Their reproach, wherewith they have reproached Thee, O Lord.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-SHEHV leesh-kheh-NEY-noo sheev-ah-tah-YEEM ehl khey-KAHM khehr-pah-TAHM ah-SHEHR kheh-re-FOO-khah ah-doh-NAHY

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַמְּךָ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתֶךָ נוֹדֶה לְּךָ לְעוֹלָם לְדֹר וָדֹר נְסַפֵּר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: So we that are Thy people and the flock of Thy pasture Will give Thee thanks for ever; We will tell of Thy praise to all generations.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NAHKH-noo ah-me-KHAH ve-TSOHN mahr-ee-teh-KHAH NOH-DEH le-KHAH le-oh-LAHM le-DOHR vah-DOHR ne-sah-PEHR te-hee-lah-TEH-khah

title: Psalm 80
sefariaRef: Psalms 80
summary: Restore us; the image of a devastated vine
useCase: Restore us; the image of a devastated vine Themes: community, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon Shoshannim. A testimony. A Psalm of Asaph.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ehl shoh-shah-NEEM eh-DOOT le-ah-SAHF meez-MOHR

tokens.hebrew: רֹעֵה יִשְׂרָאֵל הַאֲזִינָה נֹהֵג כַּצֹּאן יוֹסֵף יֹשֵׁב הַכְּרוּבִים הוֹפִיעָה׃
tokens.translation: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that art enthroned upon the cherubim, shine forth.
tokens.transliteration: roh-EH yees-rah-EHL hah-ah-ZEE-nah noh-HEHG kah-TSOHN yoh-SEHF yoh-SHEHV hah-ke-roo-VEEM hoh-FEE-ah

tokens.hebrew: לִפְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם וּבִנְיָמִן וּמְנַשֶּׁה עוֹרְרָה אֶת־גְּבוּרָתֶךָ וּלְכָה לִישֻׁעָתָה לָּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up Thy might, And come to save us.
tokens.transliteration: leef-NEY ehf-RAH-yeem oo-veen-yah-MEEN oo-me-nah-SHEH oh-re-RAH eht ge-voo-rah-TEH-khah oo-le-KHAH lee-shoo-AH-tah LAH-noo

tokens.translation: O God, restore us; And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת עַד־מָתַי עָשַׁנְתָּ בִּתְפִלַּת עַמֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD God of hosts, How long wilt Thou be angry against the prayer of Thy people?
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT ahd mah-TAHY ah-SHAHN-tah beet-fee-LAHT ah-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: הֶאֱכַלְתָּם לֶחֶם דִּמְעָה וַתַּשְׁקֵמוֹ בִּדְמָעוֹת שָׁלִישׁ׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.
tokens.transliteration: heh-eh-khahl-TAHM LEH-khehm deem-AH vah-tahsh-KEH-moh beed-mah-OHT shah-LEESH

tokens.translation: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours; And our enemies mock as they please.
tokens.transliteration: te-see-MEH-noo mah-DOHN leesh-kheh-NEY-noo ve-oh-ye-VEY-noo yeel-ah-goo LAH-moh

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
tokens.translation: O God of hosts, restore us; And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT hah-shee-VEH-noo ve-hah-EHR pah-NEY-khah ve-nee-vah-SHEH-ah

tokens.hebrew: גֶּפֶן מִמִּצְרַיִם תַּסִּיעַ תְּגָרֵשׁ גּוֹיִם וַתִּטָּעֶהָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst pluck up a vine out of Egypt; Thou didst drive out the nations, and didst plant it.
tokens.transliteration: geh-FEHN mee-meets-RAH-yeem tah-SEE-ah te-gah-REHSH goh-YEEM vah-tee-tah-EH-hah

tokens.translation: Thou didst clear a place before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.
tokens.transliteration: pee-NEE-tah le-fah-NEY-hah vah-tahsh-REHSH shoh-roh-SHEY-hah vah-te-mah-leh AH-rehts

tokens.translation: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the mighty cedars with the boughs thereof.
tokens.transliteration: kah-SOO hah-REEM tsee-LAHH vah-ah-nah-FEY-hah ah-re-zey EHL

tokens.translation: She sent out her branches unto the sea, And her shoots unto the River.
tokens.transliteration: te-shah-LAHKH ke-tsee-REH-hah ahd YAHM ve-ehl nah-HAHR yoh-ne-koh-TEY-hah

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה פָּרַצְתָּ גְדֵרֶיהָ וְאָרוּהָ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: Why hast Thou broken down her fences, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck her?
tokens.transliteration: lah-MAH pah-RAHTS-tah ge-deh-REY-hah ve-ah-ROO-hah kohl OH-ve-rey DAH-rehkh

tokens.hebrew: יְכַרְסְמֶנָּה חֲזִיר מִיָּעַר וְזִיז שָׂדַי יִרְעֶנָּה׃
tokens.translation: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, That which moveth in the field feedeth on it.
tokens.transliteration: ye-khahr-se-MEH-nah khah-ZEER mee-YAH-ahr ve-ZEEZ sah-DAHY yeer-EH-nah

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שׁוּב־נָא הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַיִם וּרְאֵה וּפְקֹד גֶּפֶן זֹאת׃
tokens.translation: O God of hosts, return, we beseech Thee; Look from heaven, and behold, and be mindful of this vine,
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT SHOOV NAH hah-BEHT mee-shah-MAH-yeem oo-re-EH oo-fe-KOHD GEH-fehn ZOHT

tokens.hebrew: וְכַנָּה אֲשֶׁר־נָטְעָה יְמִינֶךָ וְעַל־בֵּן אִמַּצְתָּה לָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: And of the stock which Thy right hand hath planted, And the branch that Thou madest strong for Thyself. .
tokens.transliteration: ve-khah-NAH ah-shehr nah-te-AH ye-mee-NEH-khah ve-ahl BEHN ee-MAHTS-tah LAHKH

tokens.hebrew: שְׂרֻפָה בָאֵשׁ כְּסוּחָה מִגַּעֲרַת פָּנֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ׃
tokens.translation: It is burned with fire, it is cut down; They perish at the rebuke of Thy countenance.
tokens.transliteration: se-roo-FAH vah-EHSH ke-soo-KHAH mee-gah-ah-RAHT pah-NEY-khah yoh-VEH-doo

tokens.hebrew: תְּהִי־יָדְךָ עַל־אִישׁ יְמִינֶךָ עַל־בֶּן־אָדָם אִמַּצְתָּ לָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: Let Thy hand be upon the man of Thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom Thou madest strong for Thyself.
tokens.transliteration: te-hee yah-de-KHAH ahl EESH ye-mee-NEH-khah ahl behn ah-DAHM ee-MAHTS-tah LAHKH

tokens.translation: So shall we not turn back from Thee; Quicken Thou us, and we will call upon Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: ve-loh nah-SOHG mee-MEH-kah te-khah-YEH-noo oo-ve-sheem-KHAH neek-RAH

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ הָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה׃
tokens.translation: O LORD God of hosts, restore us; Cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT hah-shee-VEH-noo hah-EHR pah-NEY-khah ve-nee-vah-SHEH-ah

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 81
sefariaRef: Psalms 81
useCase: Festival praise, listening, and provision Themes: festivals, provision. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. [A Psalm] of Asaph.

tokens.hebrew: הַרְנִינוּ לֵאלֹהִים עוּזֵּנוּ הָרִיעוּ לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: Sing aloud unto God our strength; shout unto the God of Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: hahr-nee-NOO leh-loh-HEEM oo-ZEH-noo hah-REE-oo leh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.translation: Take up the melody, and sound the timbrel, the sweet harp with the psaltery.
tokens.transliteration: se-oo zeem-RAH oo-te-noo TOHF kee-NOHR nah-EEM eem NAH-vehl

tokens.hebrew: תִּקְעוּ בַחֹדֶשׁ שׁוֹפָר בַּכֵּסֶה לְיוֹם חַגֵּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Blow the horn at the new moon, at the full moon for our feast-day.
tokens.transliteration: teek-OO vah-KHOH-dehsh shoh-FAHR bah-KEH-seh le-YOHM khah-GEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי חֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל הוּא מִשְׁפָּט לֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: KEE KHOHK le-yees-rah-EHL HOO meesh-PAHT leh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.hebrew: עֵדוּת בִּיהוֹסֵף שָׂמוֹ בְּצֵאתוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם שְׂפַת לֹא־יָדַעְתִּי אֶשְׁמָע׃
tokens.translation: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when He went forth against the land of Egypt. The speech of one that I knew not did I hear:
tokens.transliteration: EH-doot bee-hoh-SEHF sah-MOH be-tseh-TOH ahl EH-rehts meets-RAH-yeem se-FAHT loh yah-DAH-tee ehsh-MAH

tokens.hebrew: הֲסִירוֹתִי מִסֵּבֶל שִׁכְמוֹ כַּפָּיו מִדּוּד תַּעֲבֹרְנָה׃
tokens.translation: 'I removed his shoulder from the burden; His hands were freed from the basket.
tokens.transliteration: hah-see-ROH-tee mee-SEH-vehl sheekh-MOH kah-PAHV mee-DOOD tah-ah-VOH-re-nah

tokens.hebrew: בַּצָּרָה קָרָאתָ וָאֲחַלְּצֶךָּ אֶעֶנְךָ בְּסֵתֶר רַעַם אֶבְחָנְךָ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst call in trouble, and I rescued thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder; I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah
tokens.transliteration: bah-tsah-RAH kah-RAH-tah vah-ah-khah-le-TSEH-kah eh-ehn-KHAH be-SEH-tehr RAH-ahm ehv-khah-ne-KHAH ahl MEY me-ree-VAH SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: שְׁמַע עַמִּי וְאָעִידָה בָּךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל אִם־תִּשְׁמַע־לִי׃
tokens.translation: Hear, O My people, and I will admonish thee: O Israel, if thou wouldest hearken unto Me!
tokens.transliteration: she-MAH ah-MEE ve-ah-EE-dah BAHKH yees-rah-EHL eem tee-she-mah LEE

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־יִהְיֶה בְךָ אֵל זָר וְלֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְאֵל נֵכָר׃
tokens.translation: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any foreign god.
tokens.transliteration: loh yeeh-YEH ve-KHAH EHL ZAHR ve-LOH teesh-tah-khah-VEH le-EHL neh-KHAHR

tokens.hebrew: אָנֹכִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֶיךָ הַמַּעַלְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם הַרְחֶב־פִּיךָ וַאֲמַלְאֵהוּ׃
tokens.translation: I am the LORD thy God, who brought thee up out of the land of Egypt; open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
tokens.transliteration: ah-noh-KHEE ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY-khah hah-mah-ahl-KHAH meh-EH-rehts meets-RAH-yeem hahr-khehv pee-KHAH vah-ah-mahl-EH-hoo

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹא־שָׁמַע עַמִּי לְקוֹלִי וְיִשְׂרָאֵל לֹא־אָבָה לִי׃
tokens.translation: But My people hearkened not to My voice; And Israel would none of Me.
tokens.transliteration: ve-loh shah-MAH ah-MEE le-koh-LEE ve-yees-rah-EHL loh AH-vah LEE

tokens.translation: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their heart, That they might walk in their own counsels.

tokens.hebrew: לוּ עַמִּי שֹׁמֵעַ לִי יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּדְרָכַי יְהַלֵּכוּ׃
tokens.translation: Oh that My people would hearken unto Me, That Israel would walk in My ways!
tokens.transliteration: LOO ah-MEE shoh-MEH-ah LEE yees-rah-EHL beed-rah-KHAHY ye-hah-LEH-khoo

tokens.hebrew: כִּמְעַט אוֹיְבֵיהֶם אַכְנִיעַ וְעַל צָרֵיהֶם אָשִׁיב יָדִי׃
tokens.translation: I would soon subdue their enemies, And turn My hand against their adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: keem-AHT oh-ye-vey-HEHM ahkh-NEE-ah ve-AHL tsah-rey-HEHM ah-SHEEV yah-DEE

tokens.hebrew: מְשַׂנְאֵי יְהוָה יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לוֹ וִיהִי עִתָּם לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: The haters of the LORD should dwindle away before Him; And their punishment should endure for ever.
tokens.transliteration: me-sahn-EY ah-doh-NAI ye-khah-khah-shoo LOH vee-HEE ee-TAHM le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּאֲכִילֵהוּ מֵחֵלֶב חִטָּה וּמִצּוּר דְּבַשׁ אַשְׂבִּיעֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: They should also be fed with the fat of wheat; and with honey out of the rock would I satisfy thee.'
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-ah-khee-leh-HOO meh-KHEH-lehv khee-TAH oo-mee-TSOOR de-VAHSH ahs-bee-EH-khah

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 82
sefariaRef: Psalms 82
summary: Judgment and defense of the powerless
useCase: Judgment and defense of the powerless Themes: justice, caregiving. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִזְמוֹר לְאָסָף אֱ‍לֹהִים נִצָּב בַּעֲדַת־אֵל בְּקֶרֶב אֱלֹהִים יִשְׁפֹּט׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of God; in the midst of the judges He judgeth:
tokens.transliteration: meez-MOHR le-ah-SAHF eh-loh-HEEM nee-TSAHV bah-ah-daht EHL be-KEH-rehv eh-loh-HEEM yeesh-POHT

tokens.translation: 'How long will ye judge unjustly, and respect the persons of the wicked? Selah
tokens.transliteration: ahd mah-TAHY teesh-pe-too AH-vehl oo-fe-NEY re-shah-EEM tees-oo SEH-lah

tokens.translation: Judge the poor and fatherless; do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
tokens.transliteration: sheef-too DAHL ve-yah-TOHM ah-NEE vah-RAHSH hahts-DEE-koo

tokens.translation: Rescue the poor and needy; deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: pah-le-too DAHL ve-ehv-YOHN mee-YAHD re-shah-EEM hah-TSEE-loo

tokens.hebrew: לֹא יָדְעוּ וְלֹא יָבִינוּ בַּחֲשֵׁכָה יִתְהַלָּכוּ יִמּוֹטוּ כָּל־מוֹסְדֵי אָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: They know not, neither do they understand; they go about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are moved.
tokens.transliteration: LOH yah-de-OO ve-LOH yah-VEE-noo bah-khah-sheh-KHAH yeet-hah-LAH-khoo yee-MOH-too kohl MOH-se-dey AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: אֲ‍נִי־אָמַרְתִּי אֱלֹהִים אַתֶּם וּבְנֵי עֶלְיוֹן כֻּלְּכֶם׃
tokens.translation: I said: Ye are godlike beings, and all of you sons of the Most High.
tokens.transliteration: ah-nee ah-mahr-TEE eh-loh-HEEM ah-TEHM oo-ve-NEY ehl-YOHN koo-le-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: אָכֵן כְּאָדָם תְּמוּתוּן וּכְאַחַד הַשָּׂרִים תִּפֹּלוּ׃
tokens.translation: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-KHEHN ke-ah-DAHM te-moo-TOON oo-khe-ah-KHAHD hah-sah-REEM tee-POH-loo

tokens.hebrew: קוּמָה אֱלֹהִים שָׁפְטָה הָאָרֶץ כִּי־אַתָּה תִנְחַל בְּכָל־הַגּוֹיִם׃
tokens.translation: Arise, O God, judge the earth; for Thou shalt possess all the nations.
tokens.transliteration: koo-MAH eh-loh-HEEM shah-fe-TAH hah-AH-rehts kee ah-TAH teen-KHAHL be-khohl hah-goh-YEEM
