title: Psalm 83
sefariaRef: Psalms 83
useCase: An appeal amid collective danger Themes: protection, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Song, a Psalm of Asaph.
O God, keep not Thou silence; Hold not Thy peace, and be not still, O God.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM ahl doh-mee LAHKH ahl teh-kheh-RAHSH ve-ahl teesh-KOHT EHL

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הִנֵּה אוֹיְבֶיךָ יֶהֱמָיוּן וּמְשַׂנְאֶיךָ נָשְׂאוּ רֹאשׁ׃
tokens.translation: For, lo, Thine enemies are in an uproar; And they that hate Thee have lifted up the head.
tokens.transliteration: kee hee-NEH oh-ye-vey-KHAH yeh-heh-mah-YOON oo-me-sahn-EY-khah NAH-se-oo ROHSH

tokens.translation: They hold crafty converse against Thy people, And take counsel against Thy treasured ones.
tokens.transliteration: ahl ah-me-KHAH yah-ah-REE-moo SOHD ve-yeet-yah-ah-TSOO ahl tse-foo-NEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אָמְרוּ לְכוּ וְנַכְחִידֵם מִגּוֹי וְלֹא־יִזָּכֵר שֵׁם־יִשְׂרָאֵל עוֹד׃
tokens.translation: They have said: 'Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; That the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-me-ROO le-KHOO ve-nahkh-khee-DEHM mee-GOHY ve-loh yee-zah-KHEHR shehm yees-rah-EHL OHD

tokens.hebrew: כִּי נוֹעֲצוּ לֵב יַחְדָּו עָלֶיךָ בְּרִית יִכְרֹתוּ׃
tokens.translation: For they have consulted together with one consent; Against Thee do they make a covenant;
tokens.transliteration: KEE noh-ah-TSOO LEHV yahkh-DAHV ah-LEY-khah be-REET yeekh-ROH-too

tokens.translation: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

tokens.hebrew: גְּבָל וְעַמּוֹן וַעֲמָלֵק פְּלֶשֶׁת עִם־יֹשְׁבֵי צוֹר׃
tokens.translation: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;
tokens.transliteration: ge-VAHL ve-ah-MOHN vah-ah-mah-LEHK pe-LEH-sheht eem YOH-she-vey TSOHR

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־אַשּׁוּר נִלְוָה עִמָּם הָיוּ זְרוֹעַ לִבְנֵי־לוֹט סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Assyria also is joined with them; They have been an arm to the children of Lot. Selah
tokens.transliteration: gahm ah-SHOOR neel-VAH ee-MAHM HAH-YOO ze-ROH-ah leev-ney LOHT SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה־לָהֶם כְּמִדְיָן כְּסִיסְרָא כְיָבִין בְּנַחַל קִישׁוֹן׃
tokens.translation: Do Thou unto them as unto Midian; As to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook Kishon;
tokens.transliteration: ah-seh lah-HEHM ke-meed-YAHN ke-see-se-RAH khe-yah-VEEN be-NAH-khahl kee-SHOHN

tokens.translation: Who were destroyed at En-dor; They became as dung for the earth.
tokens.transliteration: neesh-me-DOO ve-eyn DOHR HAH-yoo doh-MEHN lah-ah-dah-MAH

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיתֵמוֹ נְדִיבֵמוֹ כְּעֹרֵב וְכִזְאֵב וּכְזֶבַח וּכְצַלְמֻנָּע כָּל־נְסִיכֵמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, And like Zebah and Zalmunna all their princes;
tokens.transliteration: shee-TEH-moh ne-dee-veh-MOH ke-oh-REHV ve-kheez-EHV oo-khe-ZEH-vahkh oo-khe-tsahl-moo-NAH kohl ne-see-KHEH-moh

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר אָמְרוּ נִירֲשָׁה לָּנוּ אֵת נְאוֹת אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: Who said: 'Let us take to ourselves in possession The habitations of God.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR ah-me-ROO NEE-rah-shah LAH-noo EHT ne-OHT eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.translation: O my God, make them like the whirling dust; As stubble before the wind.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HAHY shee-TEH-moh khah-gahl-GAHL ke-KAHSH leef-ney ROO-ahkh

tokens.translation: As the fire that burneth the forest, And as the flame that setteth the mountains ablaze;
tokens.transliteration: ke-EHSH teev-ahr YAH-ahr oo-khe-leh-hah-VAH te-lah-HEHT hah-REEM

tokens.translation: So pursue them with Thy tempest, And affright them with Thy storm.

tokens.hebrew: מַלֵּא פְנֵיהֶם קָלוֹן וִיבַקְשׁוּ שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Fill their faces with shame; That they may seek Thy name, O LORD.
tokens.transliteration: mah-LEH fe-ney-HEHM kah-LOHN vee-vahk-SHOO sheem-KHAH ah-doh-NAI

tokens.translation: Let them be ashamed and affrighted for ever; Yea, let them be abashed and perish;
tokens.transliteration: yeh-VOH-shoo ve-yee-bah-hah-LOO ah-dey AHD ve-yahkh-pe-ROO ve-yoh-VEH-doo

tokens.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־אַתָּה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה לְבַדֶּךָ עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: That they may know that it is Thou alone whose name is the LORD, The Most High over all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeh-de-OO kee ah-TAH sheem-KHAH ah-doh-NAI le-vah-DEH-khah ehl-YOHN ahl kohl hah-AH-rehts

title: Psalm 84
sefariaRef: Psalms 84
useCase: Longing for God's dwelling Themes: devotion, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl hah-gee-TEET leev-ney KOH-rahkh meez-MOHR

tokens.translation: How lovely are Thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!

tokens.hebrew: נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה נַפְשִׁי לְחַצְרוֹת יְהוָה לִבִּי וּבְשָׂרִי יְרַנְּנוּ אֶל אֵל־חָי׃
tokens.translation: My soul yearneth, yea, even pineth for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh sing for joy unto the living God.
tokens.transliteration: neekh-se-FAH ve-gahm kah-le-TAH nahf-SHEE le-khahts-ROHT ah-doh-NAI lee-BEE oo-ve-sah-REE ye-rah-ne-NOO EHL ehl KHAHY

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־צִפּוֹר מָצְאָה בַיִת וּדְרוֹר קֵן לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־שָׁתָה אֶפְרֹחֶיהָ אֶת־מִזְבְּחוֹתֶיךָ יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת מַלְכִּי וֵאלֹהָי׃
tokens.translation: Yea, the sparrow hath found a house, and the swallow a nest for herself, Where she may lay her young; Thine altars, O LORD of hosts, My King, and my God—
tokens.transliteration: gahm tsee-POHR MAH-tse-ah VAH-yeet oo-de-ROHR KEHN LAHH ah-shehr SHAH-tah ehf-roh-KHEY-hah eht meez-be-khoh-tey-KHAH ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-OHT mahl-KEE veh-loh-HAHY

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁבֵי בֵיתֶךָ עוֹד יְהַלְלוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: Happy are they that dwell in Thy house, they are ever praising Thee. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY yoh-she-VEY vey-TEH-khah OHD ye-hah-le-LOO-khah SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם עוֹז־לוֹ בָךְ מְסִלּוֹת בִּלְבָבָם׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the man whose strength is in Thee; in whose heart are the highways.
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY ah-DAHM ohz LOH VAHKH me-see-LOHT beel-vah-VAHM

tokens.hebrew: עֹבְרֵי בְּעֵמֶק הַבָּכָא מַעְיָן יְשִׁיתוּהוּ גַּם־בְּרָכוֹת יַעְטֶה מוֹרֶה׃
tokens.translation: Passing through the valley of Baca they make it a place of springs; yea, the early rain clotheth it with blessings.
tokens.transliteration: oh-ve-REY be-EH-mehk hah-bah-KHAH mah-YAHN ye-shee-TOO-hoo gahm be-rah-KHOHT yah-TEH moh-REH

tokens.hebrew: יֵלְכוּ מֵחַיִל אֶל־חָיִל יֵרָאֶה אֶל־אֱלֹהִים בְּצִיּוֹן׃
tokens.translation: They go from strength to strength, every one of them appeareth before God in Zion.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-le-KHOO meh-KHAH-yeel ehl KHAH-yeel yeh-rah-EH ehl eh-loh-HEEM be-tsee-YOHN

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים צְבָאוֹת שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEEM tse-vah-OHT sheem-AH te-fee-lah-TEE hah-ah-ZEE-nah eh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: מָגִנֵּנוּ רְאֵה אֱלֹהִים וְהַבֵּט פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of Thine anointed.
tokens.transliteration: mah-gee-neh-NOO re-EH eh-loh-HEEM ve-hah-BEHT pe-NEY me-shee-KHEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי טוֹב־יוֹם בַּחֲצֵרֶיךָ מֵאָלֶף בָּחַרְתִּי הִסְתּוֹפֵף בְּבֵית אֱלֹהַי מִדּוּר בְּאָהֳלֵי־רֶשַׁע׃
tokens.translation: For a day in Thy courts is better than a thousand; I had rather stand at the threshold of the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
tokens.transliteration: KEE tohv YOHM bah-khah-tseh-REY-khah meh-AH-lehf bah-KHAHR-tee hees-toh-FEHF be-VEYT eh-loh-HAHY mee-DOOR be-oh-hoh-ley REH-shah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן יְהוָה אֱלֹהִים חֵן וְכָבוֹד יִתֵּן יְהוָה לֹא יִמְנַע־טוֹב לַהֹלְכִים בְּתָמִים׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield; the LORD giveth grace and glory; No good thing will He withhold from them that walk uprightly.
tokens.transliteration: KEE SHEH-mehsh oo-mah-GEHN ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEEM KHEHN ve-khah-VOHD yee-TEHN ah-doh-NAI LOH yeem-nah TOHV lah-hoh-le-KHEEM be-tah-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵחַ בָּךְ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD of hosts, happy is the man that trusteth in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-OHT ah-she-REY ah-DAHM boh-TEH-ahkh BAHKH

title: Psalm 85
sefariaRef: Psalms 85
useCase: Restoration, mercy, truth, and peace Themes: peace, repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.

tokens.hebrew: רָצִיתָ יְהוָה אַרְצֶךָ שַׁבְתָּ שבות [שְׁבִית] יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: LORD, Thou hast been favourable unto Thy land, Thou hast turned the captivity of Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: rah-TSEE-tah ah-doh-NAI ahr-TSEH-khah shahv-TAH she-VEET yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.hebrew: נָשָׂאתָ עֲוֺן עַמֶּךָ כִּסִּיתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָם סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of Thy people, Thou hast pardoned all their sin. Selah .
tokens.transliteration: nah-sah-TAH ah-VOHN ah-MEH-khah kee-SEE-tah khohl khah-tah-TAHM SEH-lah

tokens.translation: Thou hast withdrawn all Thy wrath; Thou hast turned from the fierceness of Thine anger.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SAHF-tah khohl ehv-rah-TEH-khah heh-shee-VOH-tah meh-khah-ROHN ah-PEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: שׁוּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעֵנוּ וְהָפֵר כַּעַסְךָ עִמָּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Restore us, O God of our salvation, And cause Thine indignation toward us to cease.
tokens.transliteration: shoo-veh-NOO eh-loh-HEY yeesh-EH-noo ve-hah-FEHR kah-ahs-KHAH ee-MAH-noo

tokens.hebrew: הַלְעוֹלָם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּנוּ תִּמְשֹׁךְ אַפְּךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: Wilt Thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt Thou draw out Thine anger to all generations?
tokens.transliteration: hah-le-oh-LAHM teh-eh-nahf BAH-noo teem-SHOHKH ah-pe-KHAH le-DOHR vah-DOHR

tokens.translation: Wilt Thou not quicken us again, That Thy people may rejoice in Thee?
tokens.transliteration: hah-loh ah-TAH tah-SHOOV te-khah-YEH-noo ve-ah-me-KHAH yees-me-khoo VAHKH

tokens.translation: Show us Thy mercy, O LORD, And grant us Thy salvation.
tokens.transliteration: hahr-EH-noo ah-doh-NAI khahs-DEH-khah ve-yehsh-ah-KHAH tee-tehn LAH-noo

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׁמְעָה מַה־יְדַבֵּר הָאֵל יְהוָה כִּי יְדַבֵּר שָׁלוֹם אֶל־עַמּוֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָיו וְאַל־יָשׁוּבוּ לְכִסְלָה׃
tokens.translation: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; For He will speak peace unto His people, and to His saints; But let them not turn back to folly.
tokens.transliteration: ehsh-me-AH mahh ye-dah-BEHR hah-EHL ah-doh-NAI KEE ye-dah-BEHR shah-LOHM ehl ah-MOH ve-ehl khah-see-DAHV ve-ahl yah-SHOO-voo le-khees-LAH

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ קָרוֹב לִירֵאָיו יִשְׁעוֹ לִשְׁכֹּן כָּבוֹד בְּאַרְצֵנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Surely His salvation is nigh them that fear Him; That glory may dwell in our land.
tokens.transliteration: AHKH kah-ROHV lee-reh-AHV yeesh-OH leesh-KOHN kah-VOHD be-ahr-TSEH-noo

tokens.translation: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
tokens.transliteration: kheh-sehd veh-eh-MEHT neef-GAH-shoo TSEH-dehk ve-shah-LOHM nah-SHAH-koo

tokens.hebrew: אֱמֶת מֵאֶרֶץ תִּצְמָח וְצֶדֶק מִשָּׁמַיִם נִשְׁקָף׃
tokens.translation: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.
tokens.transliteration: eh-MEHT meh-EH-rehts teets-MAHKH ve-TSEH-dehk mee-shah-MAH-yeem neesh-KAHF

tokens.hebrew: גַּם־יְהוָה יִתֵּן הַטּוֹב וְאַרְצֵנוּ תִּתֵּן יְבוּלָהּ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, the LORD will give that which is good; And our land shall yield her produce.
tokens.transliteration: gahm ah-doh-NAI yee-TEHN hah-TOHV ve-ahr-TSEH-noo tee-TEHN ye-voo-LAHH

tokens.hebrew: צֶדֶק לְפָנָיו יְהַלֵּךְ וְיָשֵׂם לְדֶרֶךְ פְּעָמָיו׃
tokens.translation: Righteousness shall go before Him, And shall make His footsteps a way.
tokens.transliteration: tseh-DEHK le-fah-NAHV ye-hah-LEHKH ve-yah-SEHM le-DEH-rehkh pe-ah-MAHV

title: Psalm 86
sefariaRef: Psalms 86
summary: Mercy, guidance, and help in distress
useCase: Mercy, guidance, and help in distress Themes: wellness, wisdom, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְדָוִד הַטֵּה־יְהוָה אָזְנְךָ עֲנֵנִי כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנִי׃
tokens.translation: A Prayer of David. Incline Thine ear, O LORD, and answer me; For I am poor and needy.
tokens.transliteration: te-fee-LAH le-dah-VEED hah-teh ah-doh-NAI ohz-ne-KHAH ah-NEH-nee kee ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN AH-nee

tokens.hebrew: שָׁמְרָה נַפְשִׁי כִּי־חָסִיד אָנִי הוֹשַׁע עַבְדְּךָ אַתָּה אֱלֹהַי הַבּוֹטֵחַ אֵלֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Keep my soul, for I am godly; O Thou my God, save Thy servant that trusteth in Thee.
tokens.transliteration: shah-me-RAH nahf-SHEE kee khah-SEED AH-nee hoh-SHAH ahv-de-KHAH ah-TAH eh-loh-HAHY hah-boh-TEH-ahkh eh-LEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: חָנֵּנִי אֲדֹנָי כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֶקְרָא כָּל־הַיּוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Be gracious unto me, O Lord; For unto Thee do I cry all the day.
tokens.transliteration: khoh-NEH-nee ah-doh-NAHY KEE eh-LEY-khah ehk-RAH kohl hah-YOHM

tokens.hebrew: שַׂמֵּחַ נֶפֶשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי אֵלֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי נַפְשִׁי אֶשָּׂא׃
tokens.translation: Rejoice the soul of Thy servant; For unto Thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
tokens.transliteration: sah-meh-AHKH NEH-fehsh ahv-DEH-khah KEE eh-LEY-khah ah-doh-NAHY nahf-SHEE eh-SAH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶסֶד לְכָל־קֹרְאֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to pardon, And plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon Thee.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH ah-doh-NAHY TOHV ve-sah-LAHKH ve-rahv kheh-SEHD le-khohl koh-re-EY-khah

tokens.hebrew: הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה תְּפִלָּתִי וְהַקְשִׁיבָה בְּקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָי׃
tokens.translation: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; And attend unto the voice of my supplications.
tokens.transliteration: hah-ah-ZEE-nah ah-doh-NAI te-fee-lah-TEE ve-hahk-SHEE-vah be-KOHL tah-khah-noo-noh-TAHY

tokens.translation: In the day of my trouble I call upon Thee; For Thou wilt answer me.
There is none like unto Thee among the gods, O Lord, And there are no works like Thine.
tokens.transliteration: eyn kah-MOH-khah vah-eh-loh-HEEM ah-doh-NAHY ve-EYN ke-mah-ah-SEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־גּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ יָבוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶיךָ אֲדֹנָי וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: All nations whom Thou hast made shall come and prostrate themselves before Thee, O Lord; And they shall glorify Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: kohl goh-YEEM ah-SHEHR ah-SEE-tah yah-VOH-oo ve-yeesh-tah-khah-VOO le-fah-NEY-khah ah-doh-NAHY vee-khah-be-DOO leesh-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art great, and doest wondrous things; Thou art God alone.
tokens.transliteration: kee gah-DOHL ah-TAH ve-oh-SEH neef-lah-OHT ah-TAH eh-loh-HEEM le-vah-DEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דַּרְכֶּךָ אֲהַלֵּךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ יַחֵד לְבָבִי לְיִרְאָה שְׁמֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Teach me, O LORD, Thy way, that I may walk in Thy truth; Make one my heart to fear Thy name. .
tokens.transliteration: hoh-REH-nee ah-doh-NAI dahr-KEH-khah ah-hah-LEHKH bah-ah-mee-TEH-khah yah-KHEHD le-vah-VEE le-yeer-AH she-MEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדְךָ אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהַי בְּכָל־לְבָבִי וַאֲכַבְּדָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: I will thank Thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart; And I will glorify Thy name for evermore.
tokens.transliteration: oh-de-KHAH ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HAHY be-khohl le-vah-VEE vah-ah-khah-be-DAH sheem-KHAH le-oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־חַסְדְּךָ גָּדוֹל עָלָי וְהִצַּלְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׁאוֹל תַּחְתִּיָּה׃
tokens.translation: For great is Thy mercy toward me; And Thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest nether-world.
tokens.transliteration: kee khahs-de-KHAH gah-DOHL ah-LAHY ve-hee-TSAHL-tah nahf-SHEE mee-she-OHL tahkh-tee-YAH

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים זֵדִים קָמוּ־עָלַי וַעֲדַת עָרִיצִים בִּקְשׁוּ נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא שָׂמוּךָ לְנֶגְדָּם׃
tokens.translation: O God, the proud are risen up against me, And the company of violent men have sought after my soul, And have not set Thee before them.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM zeh-DEEM kah-moo ah-LAHY vah-ah-DAHT ah-ree-TSEEM beek-SHOO nahf-SHEE ve-LOH sah-MOO-khah le-nehg-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֵל־רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת׃
tokens.translation: But Thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH ah-doh-NAHY ehl rah-KHOOM ve-khah-NOON EH-rehkh ah-PAH-yeem ve-rahv KHEH-sehd veh-eh-MEHT

tokens.hebrew: פְּנֵה אֵלַי וְחָנֵּנִי תְּנָה־עֻזְּךָ לְעַבְדֶּךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעָה לְבֶן־אֲמָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: O turn unto me, and be gracious unto me; Give Thy strength unto Thy servant, And save the son of Thy handmaid.
tokens.transliteration: pe-NEH eh-LAHY ve-khoh-NEH-nee te-nah oo-ze-KHAH le-ahv-DEH-khah ve-hoh-SHEE-ah le-vehn ah-mah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: עֲשֵׂה־עִמִּי אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְיִרְאוּ שֹׂנְאַי וְיֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲזַרְתַּנִי וְנִחַמְתָּנִי׃
tokens.translation: Work in my behalf a sign for good; That they that hate me may see it, and be put to shame, Because Thou, LORD, hast helped me, and comforted me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-seh ee-MEE OHT le-toh-VAH ve-yeer-OO soh-ne-AHY ve-yeh-VOH-shoo kee ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI ah-zahr-TAH-nee ve-nee-khahm-TAH-nee

title: Psalm 87
sefariaRef: Psalms 87
useCase: Zion and belonging Themes: jerusalem, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm of the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.
tokens.transliteration: leev-ney koh-RAHKH meez-MOHR SHEER ye-soo-dah-TOH be-hahr-rey KOH-dehsh

tokens.hebrew: אֹהֵב יְהוָה שַׁעֲרֵי צִיּוֹן מִכֹּל מִשְׁכְּנוֹת יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
tokens.transliteration: oh-HEHV ah-doh-NAI shah-ah-REY tsee-YOHN mee-KOHL meesh-ke-NOHT yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.hebrew: נִכְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּר בָּךְ עִיר הָאֱלֹהִים סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: Glorious things are spoken of Thee, O city of God. Selah
tokens.transliteration: neekh-bah-DOHT me-doo-BAHR BAHKH EER hah-eh-loh-HEEM SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַזְכִּיר רַהַב וּבָבֶל לְיֹדְעָי הִנֵּה פְלֶשֶׁת וְצוֹר עִם־כּוּשׁ זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם׃
tokens.translation: 'I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon as among them that know Me; behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this one was born there.'
tokens.transliteration: ahz-KEER RAH-hahv oo-vah-VEHL le-yoh-de-AHY hee-NEH fe-LEH-sheht ve-TSOHR eem KOOSH ZEH yoo-lahd SHAHM

tokens.hebrew: וּלֲצִיּוֹן יֵאָמַר אִישׁ וְאִישׁ יֻלַּד־בָּהּ וְהוּא יְכוֹנְנֶהָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: But of Zion it shall be said: 'This man and that was born in her; And the Most High Himself doth establish her.'
tokens.transliteration: oo-lah-tsee-YOHN yeh-ah-MAHR EESH ve-EESH yoo-lahd BAHH ve-HOO ye-khoh-ne-NEH-hah ehl-YOHN

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה יִסְפֹּר בִּכְתוֹב עַמִּים זֶה יֻלַּד־שָׁם סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD shall count in the register of the peoples: 'This one was born there.' Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI yees-POHR beekh-TOHV ah-MEEM ZEH yoo-lahd SHAHM SEH-lah

tokens.translation: And whether they sing or dance, all my thoughts are in Thee.

title: Psalm 88
sefariaRef: Psalms 88
useCase: Unrelieved darkness and isolation Themes: wellness, grief, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁיר מִזְמוֹר לִבְנֵי קֹרַח לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מָחֲלַת לְעַנּוֹת מַשְׂכִּיל לְהֵימָן הָאֶזְרָחִי׃
tokens.translation: A Song, a Psalm of the sons of Korah; for the Leader; upon Mahalath Leannoth. Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.
tokens.transliteration: SHEER meez-MOHR leev-NEY KOH-rahkh lahm-nah-TSEH-ahkh ahl mah-khah-LAHT le-ah-NOHT mahs-KEEL le-hey-MAHN hah-ehz-rah-KHEE

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יְשׁוּעָתִי יוֹם־צָעַקְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, God of my salvation, What time I cry in the night before Thee,
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY ye-shoo-ah-TEE yohm tsah-AHK-tee vah-LAHY-lah nehg-DEH-khah

tokens.translation: Let my prayer come before Thee, Incline Thine ear unto my cry.
tokens.transliteration: tah-VOH le-fah-ney-KHAH te-fee-lah-TEE hah-teh ohz-ne-KHAH le-ree-nah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־שָׂבְעָה בְרָעוֹת נַפְשִׁי וְחַיַּי לִשְׁאוֹל הִגִּיעוּ׃
tokens.translation: For my soul is sated with troubles, And my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
tokens.transliteration: kee sah-ve-AH ve-rah-OHT nahf-SHEE ve-khah-YAHY leesh-OHL hee-GEE-oo

tokens.hebrew: נֶחְשַׁבְתִּי עִם־יוֹרְדֵי בוֹר הָיִיתִי כְּגֶבֶר אֵין־אֱיָל׃
tokens.translation: I am counted with them that go down into the pit; I am become as a man that hath no help;
tokens.transliteration: nehkh-shahv-TEE eem YOH-re-dey VOHR hah-YEE-tee ke-GEH-vehr eyn eh-YAHL

tokens.hebrew: בַּמֵּתִים חָפְשִׁי כְּמוֹ חֲלָלִים שֹׁכְבֵי קֶבֶר אֲשֶׁר לֹא זְכַרְתָּם עוֹד וְהֵמָּה מִיָּדְךָ נִגְזָרוּ׃
tokens.translation: Set apart among the dead, Like the slain that lie in the grave, Whom Thou rememberest no more; And they are cut off from Thy hand. .
tokens.transliteration: bah-meh-TEEM khohf-SHEE ke-MOH khah-lah-LEEM SHOH-khe-vey KEH-vehr ah-SHEHR LOH ze-khahr-TAHM OHD ve-HEH-mah mee-yah-de-KHAH neeg-ZAH-roo

tokens.translation: Thou hast laid me in the nether-most pit, In dark places, in the deeps.

tokens.hebrew: עָלַי סָמְכָה חֲמָתֶךָ וְכָל־מִשְׁבָּרֶיךָ עִנִּיתָ סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, And all Thy waves Thou pressest down. Selah
tokens.transliteration: ah-LAHY sah-me-KHAH khah-mah-TEH-khah ve-khohl meesh-bah-REY-khah ee-NEE-tah SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: הִרְחַקְתָּ מְיֻדָּעַי מִמֶּנִּי שַׁתַּנִי תוֹעֵבוֹת לָמוֹ כָּלֻא וְלֹא אֵצֵא׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast put mine acquaintance far from me; Thou hast made me an abomination unto them; I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.
tokens.transliteration: heer-KHAHK-tah me-yoo-dah-AHY mee-MEH-nee shah-TAH-nee toh-eh-VOHT LAH-moh kah-LOO ve-LOH eh-TSEH

tokens.hebrew: עֵינִי דָאֲבָה מִנִּי עֹנִי קְרָאתִיךָ יְהוָה בְּכָל־יוֹם שִׁטַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ כַפָּי׃
tokens.translation: Mine eye languisheth by reason of affliction; I have called upon Thee, O LORD, every day, I have spread forth my hands unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ey-NEE dah-ah-VAH mee-NEE OH-nee ke-rah-TEE-khah ah-doh-NAI be-khohl YOHM shee-TAHKH-tee eh-LEY-khah khah-PAHY

tokens.hebrew: הֲלַמֵּתִים תַּעֲשֶׂה־פֶּלֶא אִם־רְפָאִים יָקוּמוּ יוֹדוּךָ סֶּלָה׃
tokens.translation: Wilt Thou work wonders for the dead? Or shall the shades arise and give Thee thanks? Selah
tokens.transliteration: hah-lah-meh-TEEM tah-ah-seh PEH-leh eem re-fah-EEM yah-KOO-moo yoh-DOO-khah SEH-lah

tokens.translation: Shall Thy mercy be declared in the grave? Or Thy faithfulness in destruction?

tokens.hebrew: הֲיִוָּדַע בַּחֹשֶׁךְ פִּלְאֶךָ וְצִדְקָתְךָ בְּאֶרֶץ נְשִׁיָּה׃
tokens.translation: Shall Thy wonders be known in the dark? And Thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
tokens.transliteration: hah-yee-vah-DAH bah-KHOH-shehkh peel-EH-khah ve-tseed-kah-te-KHAH be-EH-rehts ne-shee-YAH

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה שִׁוַּעְתִּי וּבַבֹּקֶר תְּפִלָּתִי תְקַדְּמֶךָּ׃
tokens.translation: But as for me, unto Thee, O LORD, do I cry, And in the morning doth my prayer come to meet Thee.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE eh-LEY-khah ah-doh-NAI shee-VAH-tee oo-vah-BOH-kehr te-fee-lah-TEE te-kah-de-MEH-kah

tokens.hebrew: לָמָה יְהוָה תִּזְנַח נַפְשִׁי תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי׃
tokens.translation: LORD, why castest Thou off my soul? Why hidest Thou Thy face from me?
tokens.transliteration: lah-MAH ah-doh-NAI teez-NAHKH nahf-SHEE tahs-TEER pah-NEY-khah mee-MEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: עָנִי אֲנִי וְגֹוֵעַ מִנֹּעַר נָשָׂאתִי אֵמֶיךָ אָפוּנָה׃
tokens.translation: I am afflicted and at the point of death from my youth up; I have borne Thy terrors, I am distracted.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NEE ah-NEE ve-goh-VEH-ah mee-NOH-ahr nah-SAH-tee eh-MEY-khah ah-FOO-nah

tokens.translation: Thy fierce wrath is gone over me; Thy terrors have cut me off.

tokens.hebrew: סַבּוּנִי כַמַּיִם כָּל־הַיּוֹם הִקִּיפוּ עָלַי יָחַד׃
tokens.translation: They came round about me like water all the day; They compassed me about together.
tokens.transliteration: sah-BOO-nee khah-mah-YEEM kohl hah-YOHM hee-KEE-foo ah-LAHY YAH-khahd

tokens.hebrew: הִרְחַקְתָּ מִמֶּנִּי אֹהֵב וָרֵעַ מְיֻדָּעַי מַחְשָׁךְ׃
tokens.translation: Friend and companion hast Thou put far from me, And mine acquaintance into darkness.
tokens.transliteration: heer-KHAHK-tah mee-meh-NEE oh-HEHV vah-REH-ah me-yoo-dah-AHY mahkh-SHAHKH

title: Psalm 89
sefariaRef: Psalms 89
useCase: Covenant, praise, and disappointment Themes: community, hope, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.

tokens.hebrew: חַסְדֵי יְהוָה עוֹלָם אָשִׁירָה לְדֹר וָדֹר אוֹדִיעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ בְּפִי׃
tokens.translation: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever; To all generations will I make known Thy faithfulness with my mouth.
tokens.transliteration: khah-se-DEY ah-doh-NAI oh-LAHM ah-SHEE-rah le-DOHR vah-DOHR oh-DEE-ah eh-moo-nah-te-KHAH be-FEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אָמַרְתִּי עוֹלָם חֶסֶד יִבָּנֶה שָׁמַיִם תָּכִן אֱמוּנָתְךָ בָהֶם׃
tokens.translation: For I have said: 'For ever is mercy built; In the very heavens Thou dost establish Thy faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-MAHR-tee oh-LAHM KHEH-sehd yee-bah-NEH shah-MAH-yeem tah-KHEEN eh-moo-nah-te-KHAH vah-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: כָּרַתִּי בְרִית לִבְחִירִי נִשְׁבַּעְתִּי לְדָוִד עַבְדִּי׃
tokens.translation: I have made a covenant with My chosen, I have sworn unto David My servant:
tokens.transliteration: kah-RAH-tee ve-REET leev-khee-REE neesh-BAH-tee le-dah-VEED ahv-DEE

tokens.hebrew: עַד־עוֹלָם אָכִין זַרְעֶךָ וּבָנִיתִי לְדֹר־וָדוֹר כִּסְאֲךָ סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: For ever will I establish thy seed, And build up thy throne to all generations.' Selah
tokens.transliteration: ahd oh-LAHM ah-KHEEN zahr-EH-khah oo-vah-NEE-tee le-dohr vah-DOHR kees-ah-KHAH SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהוָה אַף־אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדֹשִׁים׃
tokens.translation: So shall the heavens praise Thy wonders, O LORD, Thy faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yoh-DOO shah-MAH-yeem peel-ah-KHAH ah-doh-NAI ahf eh-moo-nah-te-KHAH beek-HAHL ke-doh-SHEEM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מִי בַשַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהוָה יִדְמֶה לַיהוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים׃
tokens.translation: For who in the skies can be compared unto the LORD, Who among the sons of might can be likened unto the LORD,
tokens.transliteration: KEE MEE vah-shah-KHAHK yah-ah-ROHKH lah-ah-doh-NAI yeed-MEH lah-ah-doh-NAI beev-NEY eh-leem

tokens.hebrew: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד־קְדֹשִׁים רַבָּה וְנוֹרָא עַל־כָּל־סְבִיבָיו׃
tokens.translation: A God dreaded in the great council of the holy ones, And feared of all them that are about Him?
tokens.transliteration: EHL nah-ah-RAHTS be-sohd ke-doh-SHEEM rah-BAH ve-noh-RAH ahl kohl se-vee-VAHV

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת מִי־כָמוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: O LORD God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto Thee, O LORD? And Thy faithfulness is round about Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY tse-vah-OHT mee khah-MOH-khah khah-SEEN YAHH veh-eh-moo-nah-te-KHAH se-vee-voh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם׃
tokens.translation: Thou rulest the proud swelling of the sea; When the waves thereof arise, Thou stillest them.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH moh-SHEHL be-geh-OOT hah-YAHM be-SOH gah-LAHV ah-TAH te-shah-be-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה דִכִּאתָ כֶחָלָל רָהַב בִּזְרוֹעַ עֻזְּךָ פִּזַּרְתָּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou didst crush Rahab, as one that is slain; Thou didst scattered Thine enemies with the arm of Thy strength.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH dee-KEE-tah kheh-khah-LAHL RAH-hahv beez-ROH-ah oo-ze-KHAH pee-ZAHR-tah oh-ye-VEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ שָׁמַיִם אַף־לְךָ אָרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם׃
tokens.translation: Thine are the heavens, Thine also the earth; The world and the fulness thereof, Thou hast founded them.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHAH shah-mah-YEEM ahf le-KHAH AH-rehts teh-VEHL oo-me-loh-AHH ah-TAH ye-sahd-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: צָפוֹן וְיָמִין אַתָּה בְרָאתָם תָּבוֹר וְחֶרְמוֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: The north and the south, Thou hast created them; Tabor and Hermon rejoice in Thy name.
tokens.transliteration: tsah-FOHN ve-yah-MEEN ah-TAH ve-rah-TAHM tah-VOHR ve-khehr-MOHN be-sheem-KHAH ye-rah-NEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ זְרוֹעַ עִם־גְּבוּרָה תָּעֹז יָדְךָ תָּרוּם יְמִינֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thine is an arm with might; Strong is Thy hand, and exalted is Thy right hand.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHAH ze-roh-AH eem ge-voo-RAH tah-OHZ yah-de-KHAH tah-ROOM ye-mee-NEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶךָ חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Thy throne; Mercy and truth go before Thee.
tokens.transliteration: TSEH-dehk oo-meesh-PAHT me-KHOHN kees-EH-khah KHEH-sehd veh-eh-MEHT ye-kah-de-MOO fah-NEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם יוֹדְעֵי תְרוּעָה יְהוָה בְּאוֹר־פָּנֶיךָ יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the people that know the joyful shout; They walk, O LORD, in the light of Thy countenance.
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY hah-AHM yoh-de-EY te-roo-AH ah-doh-NAI be-ohr pah-NEY-khah ye-hah-leh-KHOON

tokens.translation: In Thy name do they rejoice all the day; And through Thy righteousness are they exalted.
tokens.transliteration: be-sheem-KHAH ye-gee-LOON kohl hah-YOHM oo-ve-tseed-kah-te-KHAH yah-ROO-moo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־תִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּמוֹ אָתָּה וּבִרְצֹנְךָ תרים [תָּרוּם] קַרְנֵנוּ׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art the glory of their strength; And in Thy favour our horn is exalted.
tokens.transliteration: kee teef-EH-reht oo-ZAH-moh AH-tah oo-veer-tsoh-ne-KHAH tah-ROOM kahr-NEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לַיהוָה מָגִנֵּנוּ וְלִקְדוֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵל מַלְכֵּנוּ׃
tokens.translation: For of the LORD is our shield; And the Holy One of Israel is our king.
tokens.transliteration: KEE lah-ah-doh-NAI mah-gee-NEH-noo ve-leek-DOHSH yees-rah-EHL mahl-KEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: אָז דִּבַּרְתָּ־בְחָזוֹן לַחֲסִידֶיךָ וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁוִּיתִי עֵזֶר עַל־גִּבּוֹר הֲרִימוֹתִי בָחוּר מֵעָם׃
tokens.translation: Then Thou spokest in vision to Thy godly ones, And saidst: 'I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
tokens.transliteration: AHZ dee-BAHR-tah ve-KHAH-zohn lah-khah-see-DEY-khah vah-TOH-mehr shee-VEE-tee eh-ZEHR ahl gee-BOHR hah-ree-MOH-tee vah-KHOOR meh-AHM

tokens.hebrew: מָצָאתִי דָּוִד עַבְדִּי בְּשֶׁמֶן קָדְשִׁי מְשַׁחְתִּיו׃
tokens.translation: I have found David My servant; With My holy oil have I anointed him;
tokens.transliteration: mah-tsah-TEE dah-VEED ahv-DEE be-SHEH-mehn kohd-SHEE me-shahkh-TEEV

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר יָדִי תִּכּוֹן עִמּוֹ אַף־זְרוֹעִי תְאַמְּצֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: With whom My hand shall be established; Mine arm also shall strengthen him.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR yah-DEE tee-KOHN ee-MOH ahf ze-roh-EE te-ah-me-TSEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־יַשִּׁא אוֹיֵב בּוֹ וּבֶן־עַוְלָה לֹא יְעַנֶּנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: The enemy shall not exact from him; Nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
tokens.transliteration: loh yah-SHEE oh-YEHV BOH oo-vehn ahv-LAH LOH ye-ah-NEH-noo

tokens.translation: And I will beat to pieces his adversaries before him, And smite them that hate him.

tokens.hebrew: וֶאֶמוּנָתִי וְחַסְדִּי עִמּוֹ וּבִשְׁמִי תָּרוּם קַרְנוֹ׃
tokens.translation: But My faithfulness and My mercy shall be with him; And through My name shall his horn be exalted.
tokens.transliteration: veh-eh-moo-nah-TEE ve-khahs-DEE ee-MOH oo-veesh-MEE tah-ROOM kahr-NOH

tokens.translation: I will set his hand also on the sea, And his right hand on the rivers.

tokens.hebrew: הוּא יִקְרָאֵנִי אָבִי אָתָּה אֵלִי וְצוּר יְשׁוּעָתִי׃
tokens.translation: He shall call unto Me: Thou art my Father, My God, and the rock of my salvation. .
tokens.transliteration: HOO yeek-rah-eh-NEE AH-vee AH-tah eh-LEE ve-TSOOR ye-shoo-ah-TEE

tokens.translation: I also will appoint him first-born, The highest of the kings of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ahf ah-NEE be-KHOHR eh-te-NEH-hoo ehl-YOHN le-mahl-khey AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: לְעוֹלָם אשמור־[אֶשְׁמָר־] לוֹ חַסְדִּי וּבְרִיתִי נֶאֱמֶנֶת לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For ever will I keep for him My mercy, And My covenant shall stand fast with him.
tokens.transliteration: le-oh-LAHM ehsh-mohr LOH khahs-DEE oo-ve-ree-TEE neh-eh-MEH-neht LOH

tokens.hebrew: וְשַׂמְתִּי לָעַד זַרְעוֹ וְכִסְאוֹ כִּימֵי שָׁמָיִם׃
tokens.translation: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, And his throne as the days of heaven.
tokens.transliteration: ve-sahm-TEE lah-AHD zahr-OH ve-khees-OH kee-MEY shah-MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: אִם־יַעַזְבוּ בָנָיו תּוֹרָתִי וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַי לֹא יֵלֵכוּן׃
tokens.translation: If his children forsake My law, And walk not in Mine ordinances; :
tokens.transliteration: eem yah-ahz-VOO vah-NAHV toh-rah-TEE oo-ve-meesh-pah-TAHY LOH yeh-leh-KHOON

tokens.translation: If they profane My statutes, And keep not My commandments;
tokens.transliteration: eem khoo-koh-TAHY ye-khah-LEH-loo oo-meets-voh-TAHY LOH yeesh-MOH-roo

tokens.translation: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, And their iniquity with strokes.
But My mercy will I not break off from him, Nor will I be false to My faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khahs-DEE loh ah-FEER meh-ee-MOH ve-loh ah-shah-KEHR beh-eh-moo-nah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־אֲחַלֵּל בְּרִיתִי וּמוֹצָא שְׂפָתַי לֹא אֲשַׁנֶּה׃
tokens.translation: My covenant will I not profane, Nor alter that which is gone out of My lips.
tokens.transliteration: loh ah-khah-LEHL be-ree-TEE oo-moh-TSAH se-fah-TAHY LOH ah-shah-NEH

tokens.translation: Once have I sworn by My holiness: Surely I will not be false unto David;
tokens.transliteration: ah-KHAHT neesh-BAH-tee ve-kohd-SHEE eem le-dah-VEED ah-khah-ZEHV

tokens.hebrew: זַרְעוֹ לְעוֹלָם יִהְיֶה וְכִסְאוֹ כַשֶּׁמֶשׁ נֶגְדִּי׃
tokens.translation: His seed shall endure for ever, And his throne as the sun before Me.
tokens.transliteration: zahr-OH le-oh-LAHM yeeh-YEH ve-khees-OH khah-SHEH-mehsh nehg-DEE

tokens.hebrew: כְּיָרֵחַ יִכּוֹן עוֹלָם וְעֵד בַּשַּׁחַק נֶאֱמָן סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: It shall be established for ever as the moon; And be stedfast as the witness in sky.' Selah
tokens.transliteration: ke-yah-reh-AHKH yee-KOHN oh-LAHM ve-EHD bah-SHAH-khahk neh-eh-MAHN SEH-lah

tokens.translation: But Thou hast cast off and rejected, Thou hast been wroth with Thine anointed.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH zah-nahkh-TAH vah-teem-AHS heet-ah-BAHR-tah eem me-shee-KHEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: נֵאַרְתָּה בְּרִית עַבְדֶּךָ חִלַּלְתָּ לָאָרֶץ נִזְרוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast abhorred the covenant of Thy servant; Thou hast profaned his crown even to the ground.
tokens.transliteration: neh-ahr-TAH be-REET ahv-DEH-khah khee-LAHL-tah lah-AH-rehts neez-ROH

tokens.translation: Thou hast broken down all his fences; Thou hast brought his strongholds to ruin.
tokens.transliteration: pah-RAHTS-tah khohl ge-deh-roh-TAHV SAHM-tah meev-tsah-RAHV me-khee-tah

tokens.hebrew: שַׁסֻּהוּ כָּל־עֹבְרֵי דָרֶךְ הָיָה חֶרְפָּה לִשְׁכֵנָיו׃
tokens.translation: All that pass by the way spoil him; He is become a taunt to his neighbours.
tokens.transliteration: shah-soo-HOO kohl OH-ve-rey DAH-rehkh hah-YAH khehr-PAH leesh-kheh-NAHV

tokens.translation: Thou hast exalted the right hand of his adversaries; Thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
tokens.transliteration: hah-ree-moh-TAH ye-MEEN tsah-RAHV hees-MAHKH-tah kohl oh-ye-VAHV

tokens.hebrew: אַף־תָּשִׁיב צוּר חַרְבּוֹ וְלֹא הֲקֵימֹתוֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָה׃
tokens.translation: Yea, Thou turnest back the edge of his sword, And hast not made him to stand in the battle.
tokens.transliteration: ahf tah-SHEEV TSOOR khahr-BOH ve-LOH hah-key-moh-TOH bah-meel-khah-MAH

tokens.translation: Thou hast made his brightness to cease, And cast his throne down to the ground.

tokens.hebrew: הִקְצַרְתָּ יְמֵי עֲלוּמָיו הֶעֱטִיתָ עָלָיו בּוּשָׁה סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: The days of his youth hast Thou shortened; Thou hast covered him with shame. Selah
tokens.transliteration: heek-tsahr-TAH ye-MEY ah-loo-MAHV heh-eh-TEE-tah ah-LAHV boo-SHAH SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: עַד־מָה יְהוָה תִּסָּתֵר לָנֶצַח תִּבְעַר כְּמוֹ־אֵשׁ חֲמָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou hide Thyself for ever? How long shall Thy wrath burn like fire?
tokens.transliteration: ahd MAH ah-doh-NAI tee-sah-TEHR lah-NEH-tsahkh teev-AHR ke-moh EHSH khah-mah-TEH-khah

tokens.translation: O remember how short my time is; For what vanity hast Thou created all the children of men!
tokens.transliteration: ze-khahr ah-NEE meh KHAH-lehd ahl mahh SHAHV bah-RAH-tah khohl be-ney ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: מִי גֶבֶר יִחְיֶה וְלֹא יִרְאֶה־מָּוֶת יְמַלֵּט נַפְשׁוֹ מִיַּד־שְׁאוֹל סֶלָה׃
tokens.translation: What man is he that liveth and shall not see death, That shall deliver his soul from the power of the grave? Selah
tokens.transliteration: MEE GEH-vehr yee-khe-YEH ve-LOH yeer-eh MAH-veht ye-mah-LEHT nahf-SHOH mee-yahd she-OHL SEH-lah

tokens.hebrew: אַיֵּה חֲסָדֶיךָ הָרִאשֹׁנִים אֲדֹנָי נִשְׁבַּעְתָּ לְדָוִד בֶּאֱמוּנָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Where are Thy former mercies, O Lord, Which Thou didst swear unto David in Thy faithfulness?
tokens.transliteration: ah-YEH khah-sah-DEY-khah hah-ree-shoh-NEEM ah-doh-NAHY neesh-BAH-tah le-dah-VEED beh-eh-moo-nah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: זְכֹר אֲדֹנָי חֶרְפַּת עֲבָדֶיךָ שְׂאֵתִי בְחֵיקִי כָּל־רַבִּים עַמִּים׃
tokens.translation: Remember, Lord, the taunt of Thy servants; How I do bear in my bosom [the taunt of] so many peoples;
tokens.transliteration: ze-KHOHR ah-doh-NAHY khehr-PAHT ah-vah-DEY-khah se-eh-TEE ve-khey-KEE kohl rah-BEEM ah-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ אוֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר חֵרְפוּ עִקְּבוֹת מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Wherewith Thine enemies have taunted, O LORD, Wherewith they have taunted the footsteps of Thine anointed.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR kheh-re-FOO oh-ye-VEY-khah ah-doh-NAI ah-SHEHR kheh-re-FOO ee-ke-VOHT me-shee-KHEH-khah

tokens.translation: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 90
sefariaRef: Psalms 90
summary: Mortality, wisdom, and the work of our hands
useCase: Mortality, wisdom, and the work of our hands Themes: opportunity, wisdom, aging, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְמֹשֶׁה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִים אֲ‍דֹנָי מָעוֹן אַתָּה הָיִיתָ לָּנוּ בְּדֹר וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, Thou hast been our dwelling-place in all generations.
tokens.transliteration: te-fee-LAH le-moh-SHEH eesh hah-eh-loh-HEEM ah-doh-NAHY mah-OHN ah-TAH hah-YEE-tah LAH-noo be-DOHR vah-DOHR

tokens.hebrew: בְּטֶרֶם הָרִים יֻלָּדוּ וַתְּחוֹלֵל אֶרֶץ וְתֵבֵל וּמֵעוֹלָם עַד־עוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל׃
tokens.translation: Before the mountains were brought forth, Or ever Thou hadst formed the earth and the world, Even from everlasting to everlasting, Thou art God.
tokens.transliteration: be-TEH-rehm hah-REEM yoo-LAH-doo vah-te-KHOH-lehl EH-rehts ve-teh-VEHL oo-meh-oh-LAHM ahd oh-LAHM ah-TAH EHL

tokens.hebrew: תָּשֵׁב אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא וַתֹּאמֶר שׁוּבוּ בְנֵי־אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Thou turnest man to contrition; And sayest: 'Return, ye children of men.'
tokens.transliteration: tah-SHEHV eh-NOHSH ahd dah-KAH vah-TOH-mehr SHOO-voo ve-ney ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֶלֶף שָׁנִים בְּעֵינֶיךָ כְּיוֹם אֶתְמוֹל כִּי יַעֲבֹר וְאַשְׁמוּרָה בַלָּיְלָה׃
tokens.translation: For a thousand years in Thy sight Are but as yesterday when it is past, And as a watch in the night.
tokens.transliteration: KEE EH-lehf shah-NEEM be-ey-NEY-khah ke-YOHM eht-MOHL KEE yah-ah-VOHR ve-ahsh-moo-RAH vah-LAH-ye-lah

tokens.hebrew: זְרַמְתָּם שֵׁנָה יִהְיוּ בַּבֹּקֶר כֶּחָצִיר יַחֲלֹף׃
tokens.translation: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are as a sleep; In the morning they are like grass which groweth up.
tokens.transliteration: ze-rahm-TAHM sheh-NAH yeeh-YOO bah-BOH-kehr keh-khah-TSEER yah-khah-LOHF

tokens.hebrew: בַּבֹּקֶר יָצִיץ וְחָלָף לָעֶרֶב יְמוֹלֵל וְיָבֵשׁ׃
tokens.translation: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; In the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
tokens.transliteration: bah-boh-KEHR yah-TSEETS ve-khah-LAHF lah-EH-rehv ye-moh-LEHL ve-yah-VEHSH

tokens.translation: For we are consumed in Thine anger, And by Thy wrath are we hurried away.

tokens.hebrew: שת [שַׁתָּה] עֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ לְנֶגְדֶּךָ עֲלֻמֵנוּ לִמְאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast set our iniquities before Thee, Our secret sins in the light of Thy countenance.
tokens.transliteration: shah-TAH ah-voh-noh-TEY-noo le-nehg-DEH-khah ah-loo-MEH-noo leem-OHR pah-NEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כָל־יָמֵינוּ פָּנוּ בְעֶבְרָתֶךָ כִּלִּינוּ שָׁנֵינוּ כְמוֹ־הֶגֶה׃
tokens.translation: For all our days are passed away in Thy wrath; We bring our years to an end as a tale that is told.
tokens.transliteration: KEE khohl yah-mey-NOO pah-NOO ve-ehv-rah-TEH-khah kee-LEE-noo shah-NEY-noo khe-moh HEH-geh

tokens.hebrew: יְמֵי־שְׁנוֹתֵינוּ בָהֶם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְאִם בִּגְבוּרֹת שְׁמוֹנִים שָׁנָה וְרָהְבָּם עָמָל וָאָוֶן כִּי־גָז חִישׁ וַנָּעֻפָה׃
tokens.translation: The days of our years are threescore years and ten, Or even by reason of strength fourscore years; Yet is their pride but travail and vanity; For it is speedily gone, and we fly away.
tokens.transliteration: ye-mey she-noh-TEY-noo vah-HEHM sheev-EEM shah-NAH ve-EEM beeg-voo-ROHT she-moh-NEEM shah-NAH ve-rah-he-BAHM ah-MAHL vah-AH-vehn kee GAHZ KHEESH vah-nah-OO-fah

tokens.translation: Who knoweth the power of Thine anger, And Thy wrath according to the fear that is due unto Thee?
tokens.transliteration: mee yoh-deh-AH OHZ ah-PEH-khah oo-khe-yeer-ah-te-KHAH ehv-rah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לִמְנוֹת יָמֵינוּ כֵּן הוֹדַע וְנָבִא לְבַב חָכְמָה׃
tokens.translation: So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
tokens.transliteration: leem-NOHT yah-mey-NOO KEHN hoh-DAH ve-nah-VEE le-VAHV khohkh-MAH

tokens.translation: Return, O LORD; how long? And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.
tokens.transliteration: shoo-VAH ah-doh-NAI ahd mah-TAHY ve-hee-nah-KHEHM ahl ah-vah-DEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: שַׂבְּעֵנוּ בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ וּנְרַנְּנָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בְּכָל־יָמֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: O satisfy us in the morning with Thy mercy; That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
tokens.transliteration: sah-be-EH-noo vah-BOH-kehr khahs-DEH-khah oo-ne-rah-ne-NAH ve-nees-me-KHAH be-khohl yah-MEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: שַׂמְּחֵנוּ כִּימוֹת עִנִּיתָנוּ שְׁנוֹת רָאִינוּ רָעָה׃
tokens.translation: Make us glad according to the days wherein Thou hast afflicted us, According to the years wherein we have seen evil.
tokens.transliteration: sah-me-kheh-NOO kee-MOHT ee-nee-TAH-noo she-NOHT rah-EE-noo rah-AH

tokens.translation: Let Thy work appear unto Thy servants, And Thy glory upon their children.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-rah-EH ehl ah-vah-DEY-khah foh-oh-LEH-khah vah-hah-dah-re-KHAH ahl be-ney-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: וִיהִי נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנָה עָלֵינוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ כּוֹנְנֵהוּ׃
tokens.translation: And let the graciousness of the Lord our God be upon us; Establish Thou also upon us the work of our hands; Yea, the work of our hands establish Thou it.
tokens.transliteration: vee-HEE NOH-ahm ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HEY-noo ah-LEY-noo oo-mah-ah-SEH yah-dey-NOO koh-ne-NAH ah-LEY-noo oo-mah-ah-SEH yah-DEY-noo koh-ne-NEH-hoo

title: Psalm 91
sefariaRef: Psalms 91
useCase: Shelter and protection Themes: protection, wellness, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יֹשֵׁב בְּסֵתֶר עֶלְיוֹן בְּצֵל שַׁדַּי יִתְלוֹנָן׃
tokens.translation: O thou that dwellest in the covert of the Most High, And abidest in the shadow of the Almighty;
tokens.transliteration: yoh-SHEHV be-SEH-tehr ehl-YOHN be-TSEHL shah-DAHY yeet-loh-NAHN

tokens.hebrew: אֹמַר לַיהוָה מַחְסִי וּמְצוּדָתִי אֱלֹהַי אֶבְטַח־בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: I will say of the LORD, who is my refuge and my fortress, My God, in whom I trust,
tokens.transliteration: oh-MAHR lah-ah-doh-NAI mahkh-SEE oo-me-tsoo-dah-TEE eh-loh-HAHY ehv-tahkh BOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הוּא יַצִּילְךָ מִפַּח יָקוּשׁ מִדֶּבֶר הַוּוֹת׃
tokens.translation: That He will deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, And from the noisome pestilence.
tokens.transliteration: KEE HOO yah-tsee-le-KHAH mee-PAHKH yah-KOOSH mee-DEH-vehr hah-VOHT

tokens.hebrew: בְּאֶבְרָתוֹ יָסֶךְ לָךְ וְתַחַת־כְּנָפָיו תֶּחְסֶה צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה אֲמִתּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He will cover thee with His pinions, And under His wings shalt thou take refuge; His truth is a shield and a buckler.
tokens.transliteration: be-ehv-rah-TOH YAH-sehkh LAHKH ve-tah-khaht ke-nah-FAHV tehkh-SEH tsee-NAH ve-soh-kheh-RAH ah-mee-TOH

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־תִירָא מִפַּחַד לָיְלָה מֵחֵץ יָעוּף יוֹמָם׃
tokens.translation: Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror by night, Nor of the arrow that flieth by day;
tokens.transliteration: loh tee-RAH mee-PAH-khahd LAH-ye-lah meh-KHEHTS yah-OOF yoh-MAHM

tokens.hebrew: מִדֶּבֶר בָּאֹפֶל יַהֲלֹךְ מִקֶּטֶב יָשׁוּד צָהֳרָיִם׃
tokens.translation: Of the pestilence that walketh in darkness, Nor of the destruction that wasteth at noonday.
tokens.transliteration: mee-deh-VEHR bah-OH-fehl yah-hah-LOHKH mee-KEH-tehv yah-SHOOD tsoh-hoh-RAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: יִפֹּל מִצִּדְּךָ אֶלֶף וּרְבָבָה מִימִינֶךָ אֵלֶיךָ לֹא יִגָּשׁ׃
tokens.translation: A thousand may fall at Thy side, And ten thousand at Thy right hand; It shall not come nigh thee.
tokens.transliteration: yee-POHL mee-tsee-de-KHAH EH-lehf oo-re-vah-VAH mee-mee-NEH-khah eh-LEY-khah LOH yee-GAHSH

tokens.hebrew: רַק בְּעֵינֶיךָ תַבִּיט וְשִׁלֻּמַת רְשָׁעִים תִּרְאֶה׃
tokens.translation: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold, And see the recompense of the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: RAHK be-ey-NEY-khah tah-BEET ve-shee-loo-MAHT re-shah-EEM teer-EH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה מַחְסִי עֶלְיוֹן שַׂמְתָּ מְעוֹנֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: For thou hast made the LORD who is my refuge, Even the Most High, thy habitation.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI mahkh-SEE ehl-YOHN SAHM-tah me-oh-NEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־תְאֻנֶּה אֵלֶיךָ רָעָה וְנֶגַע לֹא־יִקְרַב בְּאָהֳלֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: There shall no evil befall thee, Neither shall any plague come nigh thy tent.
tokens.transliteration: loh te-oo-NEH eh-LEY-khah rah-AH ve-NEH-gah loh yeek-RAHV be-oh-hoh-LEH-khah

tokens.translation: For He will give His angels charge over thee, To keep thee in all thy ways.
tokens.transliteration: KEE mahl-ah-KHAHV ye-tsah-veh LAHKH leesh-mah-re-KHAH be-khohl de-rah-KHEY-khah

tokens.translation: They shall bear thee upon their hands, Lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
tokens.transliteration: ahl kah-PAH-yeem yee-sah-OO-ne-khah pehn tee-GOHF bah-EH-vehn rahg-LEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: עַל־שַׁחַל וָפֶתֶן תִּדְרֹךְ תִּרְמֹס כְּפִיר וְתַנִּין׃
tokens.translation: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and asp; The young lion and the serpent shalt thou trample under feet.
tokens.transliteration: ahl SHAH-khahl vah-FEH-tehn teed-ROHKH teer-MOHS ke-FEER ve-tah-NEEN

tokens.hebrew: כִּי בִי חָשַׁק וַאֲפַלְּטֵהוּ אֲשַׂגְּבֵהוּ כִּי־יָדַע שְׁמִי׃
tokens.translation: 'Because he hath set his love upon Me, therefore will I deliver him; I will set him on high, because he hath known My name.
tokens.transliteration: KEE VEE khah-SHAHK vah-ah-fah-le-TEH-hoo ah-sah-ge-VEH-hoo kee yah-DAH she-MEE

tokens.hebrew: יִקְרָאֵנִי וְאֶעֱנֵהוּ עִמּוֹ־אָנֹכִי בְצָרָה אֲחַלְּצֵהוּ וַאֲכַבְּדֵהוּ׃
tokens.translation: He shall call upon Me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble; I will rescue him, and bring him to honour.
tokens.transliteration: yeek-rah-EH-nee ve-eh-eh-NEH-hoo ee-moh ah-noh-KHEE ve-tsah-RAH ah-khah-le-TSEH-hoo vah-ah-khah-be-DEH-hoo

tokens.translation: With long life will I satisfy him, And make Him to behold My salvation.'

title: Psalm 92
sefariaRef: Psalms 92
useCase: A Sabbath song of thanksgiving Themes: shabbat, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm, a Song. For the sabbath day.

tokens.hebrew: טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת לַיהוָה וּלְזַמֵּר לְשִׁמְךָ עֶלְיוֹן׃
tokens.translation: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the LORD, And to sing praises unto Thy name, O Most High;
tokens.transliteration: TOHV le-hoh-DOHT lah-ah-doh-NAI oo-le-zah-MEHR le-sheem-KHAH ehl-YOHN

tokens.translation: To declare Thy lovingkindness in the morning, And Thy faithfulness in the night seasons,
With an instrument of ten strings, and with the psaltery; With a solemn sound upon the harp.
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley ah-SOHR vah-ah-ley NAH-vehl ah-LEY hee-gah-YOHN be-khee-NOHR

tokens.hebrew: כִּי שִׂמַּחְתַּנִי יְהוָה בְּפָעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אֲרַנֵּן׃
tokens.translation: For Thou, LORD, hast made me glad through Thy work; I will exult in the works of Thy hands.
tokens.transliteration: KEE see-mahkh-TAH-nee ah-doh-NAI be-foh-oh-LEH-khah be-mah-ah-SEY yah-DEY-khah ah-rah-NEHN

tokens.hebrew: מַה־גָּדְלוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה מְאֹד עָמְקוּ מַחְשְׁבֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: How great are Thy works, O LORD! Thy thoughts are very deep.
tokens.transliteration: mahh gohd-LOO mah-ah-SEY-khah ah-doh-NAI me-OHD ah-me-KOO mahkh-she-voh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: אִישׁ־בַּעַר לֹא יֵדָע וּכְסִיל לֹא־יָבִין אֶת־זֹאת׃
tokens.translation: A brutish man knoweth not, Neither doth a fool understand this.
tokens.transliteration: eesh bah-AHR LOH yeh-DAH oo-khe-SEEL loh yah-VEEN eht ZOHT

tokens.hebrew: בִּפְרֹחַ רְשָׁעִים כְּמוֹ עֵשֶׂב וַיָּצִיצוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן לְהִשָּׁמְדָם עֲדֵי־עַד׃
tokens.translation: When the wicked spring up as the grass, And when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; It is that they may be destroyed for ever.
tokens.transliteration: beef-ROH-ahkh re-shah-EEM ke-MOH EH-sehv vah-yah-tsee-TSOO kohl POH-ah-ley AH-vehn le-hee-shah-me-DAHM ah-dey AHD

tokens.translation: But Thou, O LORD, art on high for evermore.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּי־הִנֵּה אֹיְבֶיךָ יֹאבֵדוּ יִתְפָּרְדוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: For, lo, Thine enemies, O LORD, For, lo, Thine enemies shall perish: All the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
tokens.transliteration: KEE hee-NEH oh-ye-VEY-khah ah-doh-NAI kee hee-NEH oh-ye-VEY-khah yoh-VEH-doo yeet-pah-re-DOO kohl POH-ah-ley AH-vehn

tokens.hebrew: וַתָּרֶם כִּרְאֵים קַרְנִי בַּלֹּתִי בְּשֶׁמֶן רַעֲנָן׃
tokens.translation: But my horn hast Thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox; I am anointed with rich oil.
tokens.transliteration: vah-TAH-rehm keer-EYM kahr-NEE bah-loh-TEE be-SHEH-mehn rah-ah-NAHN

tokens.hebrew: וַתַּבֵּט עֵינִי בְּשׁוּרָי בַּקָּמִים עָלַי מְרֵעִים תִּשְׁמַעְנָה אָזְנָי׃
tokens.translation: Mine eye also hath gazed on them that lie in wait for me, Mine ears have heard my desire of the evil-doers that rise up against me.
tokens.transliteration: vah-tah-BEHT ey-NEE be-shoo-RAHY bah-kah-MEEM ah-LAHY me-reh-EEM teesh-MAH-nah ohz-NAHY

tokens.hebrew: צַדִּיק כַּתָּמָר יִפְרָח כְּאֶרֶז בַּלְּבָנוֹן יִשְׂגֶּה׃
tokens.translation: The righteous shall flourish like the palm-tree; He shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: tsah-DEEK kah-tah-MAHR yeef-RAHKH ke-EH-rehz bah-le-vah-NOHN yees-GEH

tokens.hebrew: שְׁתוּלִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת אֱלֹהֵינוּ יַפְרִיחוּ׃
tokens.translation: Planted in the house of the LORD, They shall flourish in the courts of our God.
tokens.transliteration: she-too-LEEM be-VEYT ah-doh-NAI be-khahts-ROHT eh-loh-HEY-noo yahf-REE-khoo

tokens.hebrew: עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ׃
tokens.translation: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; They shall be full of sap and richness;
tokens.transliteration: OHD ye-noo-VOON be-sey-VAH de-sheh-NEEM ve-rah-ah-nah-NEEM yeeh-YOO

tokens.hebrew: לְהַגִּיד כִּי־יָשָׁר יְהוָה צוּרִי וְלֹא־עלתה [עַוְלָתָה] בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: To declare that the LORD is upright, My Rock, in whom there is no unrighteousness.
tokens.transliteration: le-hah-GEED kee yah-SHAHR ah-doh-NAI tsoo-REE ve-loh-ahv-LAH-tah BOH

title: Psalm 93
sefariaRef: Psalms 93
summary: Majesty and stability amid mighty waters
useCase: Majesty and stability amid mighty waters Themes: protection, devotion. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה מָלָךְ גֵּאוּת לָבֵשׁ לָבֵשׁ יְהוָה עֹז הִתְאַזָּר אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט׃
tokens.translation: The LORD reigneth; He is clothed in majesty; The LORD is clothed, He hath girded Himself with strength; Yea, the world is established, that it cannot be moved.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI mah-LAHKH geh-OOT lah-VEHSH lah-VEHSH ah-doh-NAI OHZ heet-ah-ZAHR ahf tee-KOHN teh-VEHL bahl tee-MOHT

tokens.translation: Thy throne is established of old; Thou art from everlasting.

tokens.hebrew: נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת יְהוָה נָשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת קוֹלָם יִשְׂאוּ נְהָרוֹת דָּכְיָם׃
tokens.translation: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, The floods have lifted up their voice; The floods lift up their roaring.
tokens.transliteration: nah-se-OO ne-hah-ROHT ah-doh-NAI nah-se-OO ne-hah-ROHT koh-LAHM yees-OO ne-hah-ROHT dohkh-YAHM

tokens.hebrew: מִקֹּלוֹת מַיִם רַבִּים אַדִּירִים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָם אַדִּיר בַּמָּרוֹם יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Above the voices of many waters, The mighty breakers of the sea, The LORD on high is mighty.
tokens.transliteration: mee-koh-LOHT MAH-yeem rah-BEEM ah-dee-REEM meesh-be-rey YAHM ah-DEER bah-mah-ROHM ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶאֶמְנוּ מְאֹד לְבֵיתְךָ נַאֲוָה־קֹדֶשׁ יְהוָה לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים׃
tokens.translation: Thy testimonies are very sure, Holiness becometh Thy house, O LORD, for evermore.
tokens.transliteration: eh-doh-TEY-khah neh-ehm-NOO me-OHD le-vey-te-KHAH nah-ah-vah KOH-dehsh ah-doh-NAI le-OH-rehkh yah-MEEM

title: Psalm 94
sefariaRef: Psalms 94
summary: Justice and comfort amid anxious thoughts
useCase: Justice and comfort amid anxious thoughts Themes: justice, wellness. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: O LORD, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.
tokens.transliteration: ehl ne-kah-MOHT ah-doh-NAI EHL ne-kah-MOHT hoh-FEE-yah

tokens.hebrew: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים׃
tokens.translation: Lift up Thyself, Thou Judge of the earth; Render to the proud their recompense.
tokens.transliteration: hee-nah-SEH shoh-FEHT hah-AH-rehts hah-SHEHV ge-MOOL ahl geh-EEM

tokens.hebrew: עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹזוּ׃
tokens.translation: LORD, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked exult?
tokens.transliteration: ahd mah-TAHY re-shah-EEM ah-doh-NAI ahd mah-TAHY re-shah-EEM yah-ah-LOH-zoo

tokens.hebrew: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: They gush out, they speak arrogancy; All the workers of iniquity bear themselves loftily.
tokens.transliteration: yah-BEE-oo ye-dah-be-ROO ah-TAHK yee-te-ah-me-ROO kohl POH-ah-ley AH-vehn

tokens.translation: They crush Thy people, O LORD, And afflict Thy heritage.
They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא יִרְאֶה־יָּהּ וְלֹא־יָבִין אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
tokens.translation: And they say: 'The LORD will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob give heed.'
tokens.transliteration: vah-YOH-me-ROO LOH yeer-eh YAHH ve-loh yah-VEEN eh-loh-HEY yah-ah-KOHV

tokens.hebrew: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּילוּ׃
tokens.translation: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye understand?
tokens.transliteration: bee-NOO boh-ah-REEM bah-AHM oo-khe-see-LEEM mah-TAHY tahs-KEE-loo

tokens.hebrew: הֲנֹטַע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִם־יֹצֵר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּיט׃
tokens.translation: He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?
tokens.transliteration: hah-NOH-tah oh-ZEHN hah-LOH yeesh-MAH eem YOH-tsehr ah-YEEN hah-LOH yah-BEET

tokens.hebrew: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּעַת׃
tokens.translation: He that instructeth nations, shall not He correct? Even He that teacheth man knowledge?
tokens.transliteration: hah-yoh-SEHR goh-YEEM hah-LOH yoh-KHEE-ahkh hah-me-lah-MEHD ah-DAHM DAH-aht

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי־הֵמָּה הָבֶל׃
tokens.translation: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI yoh-deh-AH mahkh-she-VOHT ah-DAHM kee HEH-mah HAH-vehl

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Happy is the man whom Thou instructest, O LORD, And teachest out of Thy law;
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY hah-GEH-vehr ah-shehr te-yah-se-REH-noo YAHH oo-mee-toh-rah-te-KHAH te-lah-me-DEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָׁחַת׃
tokens.translation: That Thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: le-hahsh-KEET LOH MEE-mey RAH AHD yee-kah-REH lah-rah-SHAH SHAH-khaht

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹב׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD will not cast off His people, Neither will He forsake His inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: KEE loh yee-TOHSH ah-doh-NAI ah-MOH ve-nah-khah-lah-TOH LOH yah-ah-ZOHV

tokens.translation: For right shall return unto justice, And all the upright in heart shall follow it.
tokens.transliteration: kee ahd tseh-DEHK yah-SHOOV meesh-PAHT ve-ah-khah-RAHV kohl yeesh-rey LEHV

tokens.hebrew: מִי־יָקוּם לִי עִם־מְרֵעִים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-KOOM LEE eem me-reh-EEM mee yeet-yah-TSEHV LEE eem POH-ah-ley AH-vehn

tokens.hebrew: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: Unless the LORD had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.
tokens.transliteration: loo-LEY ah-doh-NAI ehz-RAH-tah LEE keem-AHT shah-khe-NAH doo-MAH nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: If I say: 'My foot slippeth', Thy mercy, O LORD, holdeth me up.
tokens.transliteration: eem ah-mahr-TEE MAH-tah rahg-LEE khahs-de-KHAH ah-doh-NAI yees-ah-DEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: When my cares are many within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.
tokens.transliteration: be-ROHV sahr-ah-PAHY be-keer-BEE tahn-khoo-MEY-khah ye-shah-ahsh-OO nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: הַיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי־חֹק׃
tokens.translation: Shall the seat of wickedness have fellowship with Thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?
tokens.transliteration: hah-ye-khah-ve-re-KHAH kee-SEH hah-VOHT yoh-TSEHR ah-MAHL ah-ley KHOHK

tokens.hebrew: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִׁיעוּ׃
tokens.translation: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.
tokens.transliteration: yah-goh-DOO ahl NEH-fehsh tsah-DEEK ve-DAHM nah-KEE yahr-SHEE-oo

tokens.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִי׃
tokens.translation: But the LORD hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-HEE ah-doh-NAI LEE le-mees-GAHV veh-loh-HAHY le-TSOOR mahkh-SEE

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: And He hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own evil; The LORD our God will cut them off.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAH-shehv ah-ley-HEHM eht oh-NAHM oo-ve-rah-ah-TAHM yahts-mee-TEHM yahts-mee-TEHM ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY-noo

title: Psalm 95
sefariaRef: Psalms 95
useCase: Praise, worship, and listening Themes: devotion, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵנוּ׃
tokens.translation: O come, let us sing unto the LORD; Let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHOO ne-rah-ne-NAH lah-ah-doh-NAI nah-REE-ah le-TSOOR yeesh-EH-noo

tokens.hebrew: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַ לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, Let us shout for joy unto Him with psalms.
tokens.transliteration: ne-kah-de-MAH fah-NAHV be-toh-DAH beez-mee-ROHT nah-REE-ah LOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: For the LORD is a great God, And a great King above all gods;
tokens.transliteration: KEE EHL gah-DOHL ah-doh-NAI oo-MEH-lehkh gah-DOHL ahl kohl eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָרֶץ וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ׃
tokens.translation: In whose hand are the depths of the earth; The heights of the mountains are His also.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR be-yah-DOH mehkh-ke-rey AH-rehts ve-toh-ah-FOHT hah-REEM LOH

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָרוּ׃
tokens.translation: The sea is His, and He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.
tokens.transliteration: ah-shehr LOH hah-YAHM ve-HOO ah-SAH-hoo ve-yah-BEH-sheht yah-DAHV yah-TSAH-roo

tokens.hebrew: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה עֹשֵׂנוּ׃
tokens.translation: O come, let us bow down and bend the knee; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;
tokens.transliteration: boh-OO neesh-tah-khah-VEH ve-neekh-RAH-ah neev-re-KHAH lee-fe-ney ah-doh-NAI oh-SEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם אִם־בְּקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ׃
tokens.translation: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, and the flock of His hand. To-day, if ye would but hearken to His voice!
tokens.transliteration: KEE HOO eh-loh-HEY-noo vah-ah-NAHKH-noo AHM mahr-ee-TOH ve-TSOHN yah-DOH hah-YOHM eem be-koh-LOH teesh-MAH-oo

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
tokens.translation: 'Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;
tokens.transliteration: ahl tahk-SHOO le-vahv-KHEHM keem-ree-VAH ke-YOHM mah-SAH bah-meed-BAHR

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם־רָאוּ פָעֳלִי׃
tokens.translation: When your fathers tried Me, Proved Me, even though they saw My work.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR nee-soo-NEE ah-voh-tey-KHEHM be-khah-NOO-nee gahm rah-OO foh-oh-LEE

tokens.hebrew: אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָקוּט בְּדוֹר וָאֹמַר עַם תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם וְהֵם לֹא־יָדְעוּ דְרָכָי׃
tokens.translation: For forty years was I wearied with that generation, And said: It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known My ways;
tokens.transliteration: ahr-bah-EEM shah-NAH ah-KOOT be-DOHR vah-oh-MAHR AHM toh-EY leh-VAHV HEHM ve-HEHM loh yah-de-OO de-rah-KHAHY

tokens.translation: Wherefore I swore in My wrath, That they should not enter into My rest.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-shehr neesh-BAH-tee ve-ah-PEE eem ye-voh-OON ehl me-noo-khah-TEE

title: Psalm 96
sefariaRef: Psalms 96
summary: A new song and creation's rejoicing
useCase: A new song and creation's rejoicing Themes: nature, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: O sing unto the LORD a new song; Sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: SHEE-roo lah-ah-doh-NAI SHEER khah-DAHSH SHEE-roo lah-ah-doh-NAI kohl hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם־לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Sing unto the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim His salvation from day to day.
tokens.transliteration: SHEE-roo lah-ah-doh-NAI bah-rah-KHOO she-MOH bah-se-ROO mee-yohm le-YOHM ye-shoo-ah-TOH

tokens.translation: Declare His glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.
tokens.transliteration: sah-pe-ROO vah-goh-YEEM ke-voh-DOH be-khohl hah-ah-MEEM neef-le-oh-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד נוֹרָא הוּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
tokens.translation: For great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods. .
tokens.transliteration: KEE gah-DOHL ah-doh-NAI oo-me-hoo-LAHL me-OHD noh-RAH HOO ahl kohl eh-loh-HEEM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָׂה׃
tokens.translation: For all the gods of the peoples are things of nought; But the LORD made the heavens.
tokens.transliteration: KEE kohl eh-loh-HEY hah-ah-MEEM eh-lee-LEEM vah-ah-doh-NAI shah-MAH-yeem ah-SAH

tokens.translation: Honour and majesty are before Him; Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: hohd ve-hah-DAHR le-fah-NAHV OHZ ve-teef-EH-reht be-meek-dah-SHOH

tokens.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃
tokens.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto the LORD glory and strength.
tokens.transliteration: hah-VOO lah-ah-doh-NAI meesh-pe-KHOHT ah-MEEM hah-VOO lah-ah-doh-NAI kah-VOHD vah-OHZ

tokens.hebrew: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאוּ־מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: Ascribe unto the LORD the glory due unto His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.
tokens.transliteration: hah-VOO lah-ah-doh-NAI ke-VOHD she-MOH se-oo meen-KHAH oo-VOH-oo le-khahts-roh-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; Tremble before Him, all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: heesh-tah-khah-VOO lah-ah-doh-NAI be-hahd-raht KOH-dehsh KHEE-loo mee-pah-NAHV kohl hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: אִמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָךְ אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יָדִין עַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
tokens.translation: Say among the nations: 'The LORD reigneth.' The world also is established that it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
tokens.transliteration: eem-ROO vah-goh-YEEM ah-doh-NAI mah-LAHKH ahf tee-KOHN teh-VEHL bahl tee-MOHT yah-DEEN ah-MEEM be-mey-shah-REEM

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;
tokens.transliteration: yees-me-KHOO hah-shah-mah-YEEM ve-tah-GEHL hah-AH-rehts yee-re-AHM hah-YAHM oo-me-loh-OH

tokens.hebrew: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר׃
tokens.translation: Let the field exult; and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy;
tokens.transliteration: yah-ah-LOHZ sah-DAHY ve-khohl ah-shehr BOH AHZ ye-rah-ne-NOO kohl ah-tsey YAH-ahr

tokens.hebrew: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ׃

tokens.translation: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know no evil thing.
tokens.transliteration: leh-VAHV ee-KEHSH yah-SOOR mee-MEH-nee RAH LOH eh-DAH

tokens.hebrew: מלושני [מְלָשְׁנִי] בַסֵּתֶר רֵעֵהוּ אוֹתוֹ אַצְמִית גְּבַהּ־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב אֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃
tokens.translation: Whoso slandereth his neighbour in secret, him will I destroy; Whoso is haughty of eye and proud of heart, him will I not suffer.
tokens.transliteration: me-lah-she-NEE vah-SEH-tehr reh-eh-HOO oh-TOH ahts-MEET ge-vahh ey-nah-YEEM oo-re-KHAHV leh-VAHV oh-TOH LOH oo-KHAHL

tokens.hebrew: עֵינַי בְּנֶאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Mine eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a way of integrity, he shall minister unto me.
tokens.transliteration: ey-NAHY be-neh-ehm-ney eh-REHTS lah-SHEH-veht ee-mah-DEE hoh-LEHKH be-DEH-rehkh tah-MEEM HOO ye-shah-re-TEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־יֵשֵׁב בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה דֹּבֵר שְׁקָרִים לֹא־יִכּוֹן לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי׃
tokens.translation: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.
tokens.transliteration: loh yeh-SHEHV be-KEH-rehv bey-TEE oh-SEH re-mee-YAH doh-VEHR she-kah-REEM loh yee-KOHN le-NEH-gehd ey-NAHY

tokens.hebrew: לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לְהַכְרִית מֵעִיר־יְהוָה כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
tokens.translation: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: lah-be-kah-REEM ahts-MEET kohl reesh-ey AH-rehts le-hahkh-REET meh-eer ah-doh-NAI kohl POH-ah-ley AH-vehn

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 102
sefariaRef: Psalms 102
summary: The prayer of one overwhelmed by affliction
useCase: The prayer of one overwhelmed by affliction Themes: health, wellness, grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִי־יַעֲטֹף וְלִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחוֹ׃
tokens.translation: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he fainteth, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: te-fee-LAH le-ah-NEE khee yah-ah-TOHF ve-leef-NEY ah-doh-NAI yeesh-POHKH see-KHOH

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא׃
tokens.translation: O LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI sheem-AH te-fee-lah-TEE ve-shahv-ah-TEE eh-LEY-khah tah-VOH

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי בְּיוֹם צַר לִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנֶךָ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: Hide not Thy face from me in the day of my distress; incline Thine ear unto me; in the day when I call answer me speedily.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tahs-TEHR pah-NEY-khah mee-meh-NEE be-YOHM TSAHR LEE hah-teh eh-LAHY ohz-NEH-khah be-YOHM ehk-RAH mah-HEHR ah-NEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־כָלוּ בְעָשָׁן יָמָי וְעַצְמוֹתַי כְּמוֹ־קֵד נִחָרוּ׃
tokens.translation: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a hearth.
tokens.transliteration: kee khah-LOO ve-ah-SHAHN yah-MAHY ve-ahts-moh-TAHY ke-moh KEHD nee-KHAH-roo

tokens.hebrew: הוּכָּה־כָעֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַשׁ לִבִּי כִּי־שָׁכַחְתִּי מֵאֲכֹל לַחְמִי׃
tokens.translation: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; for I forget to eat my bread.
tokens.transliteration: hoo-kah khah-eh-SEHV vah-yee-VAHSH lee-BEE kee shah-KHAHKH-tee meh-ah-KHOHL lahkh-MEE

tokens.translation: By reason of the voice of my sighing My bones cleave to my flesh.

tokens.hebrew: דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי כְּכוֹס חֳרָבוֹת׃
tokens.translation: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.
tokens.transliteration: dah-mee-TEE leek-AHT meed-BAHR hah-YEE-tee ke-KHOHS khoh-rah-VOHT

tokens.translation: I watch, and am become like a sparrow that is alone upon the housetop.
tokens.transliteration: shah-KAHD-tee vah-eh-he-YEH ke-tsee-POHR boh-DEHD ahl GAHG

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חֵרְפוּנִי אוֹיְבָי מְהוֹלָלַי בִּי נִשְׁבָּעוּ׃
tokens.translation: Mine enemies taunt me all the day; they that are mad against me do curse by me.
tokens.transliteration: kohl hah-YOHM kheh-re-FOO-nee oh-ye-VAHY me-hoh-lah-LAHY BEE neesh-BAH-oo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־אֵפֶר כַּלֶּחֶם אָכָלְתִּי וְשִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָכְתִּי׃
tokens.translation: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
tokens.transliteration: kee eh-FEHR kah-LEH-khehm ah-KHAH-le-tee ve-shee-koo-VAHY beev-KHEE mah-SAH-khe-tee

tokens.translation: Because of Thine indignation and Thy wrath; for Thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.
tokens.transliteration: mee-pe-ney zah-ahm-KHAH ve-keets-PEH-khah KEE ne-sah-TAH-nee vah-tahsh-lee-KHEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי וַאֲנִי כָּעֵשֶׂב אִיבָשׁ׃
tokens.translation: My days are like a lengthening shadow; and I am withered like grass.
tokens.transliteration: yah-MAHY ke-TSEHL nah-TOOY vah-ah-NEE kah-EH-sehv ee-VAHSH

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב וְזִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
tokens.translation: But Thou, O LORD, sittest enthroned for ever; and Thy name is unto all generations.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI le-oh-LAHM teh-SHEHV ve-zeekh-re-KHAH le-DOHR vah-DOHR

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי־עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ כִּי־בָא מוֹעֵד׃
tokens.translation: Thou wilt arise, and have compassion upon Zion; for it is time to be gracious unto her, for the appointed time is come.
tokens.transliteration: ah-TAH tah-KOOM te-rah-KHEHM tsee-YOHN kee EHT le-kheh-ne-NAHH kee VAH moh-EHD

tokens.translation: For Thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust.
tokens.transliteration: kee rah-TSOO ah-vah-dey-KHAH eht ah-vah-NEY-hah ve-eht ah-fah-RAHH ye-khoh-NEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: וְיִירְאוּ גוֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory;
tokens.transliteration: ve-yee-re-OO goh-YEEM eht SHEHM ah-doh-NAI ve-khohl mahl-KHEY hah-AH-rehts eht ke-voh-DEH-khah

tokens.translation: When the LORD hath built up Zion, when He hath appeared in His glory;
tokens.transliteration: kee vah-NAH ah-doh-NAI tsee-YOHN neer-AH beekh-voh-DOH

tokens.translation: When He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.
tokens.transliteration: pah-NAH ehl te-fee-LAHT hah-ahr-AHR ve-loh vah-ZAH eht te-fee-lah-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: תִּכָּתֶב זֹאת לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן וְעַם נִבְרָא יְהַלֶּל־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: tee-KAH-tehv ZOHT le-DOHR ah-khah-ROHN ve-AHM neev-RAH ye-hah-lehl YAHH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׁקִיף מִמְּרוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הִבִּיט׃
tokens.translation: For He hath looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
tokens.transliteration: kee heesh-KEEF mee-me-ROHM kohd-SHOH ah-doh-NAI mee-shah-MAH-yeem ehl EH-rehts hee-BEET

tokens.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר לְפַתֵּחַ בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
tokens.translation: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;
tokens.transliteration: leesh-moh-AH ehn-KAHT ah-SEER le-fah-TEH-ahkh be-NEY te-moo-TAH

tokens.hebrew: לְסַפֵּר בְּצִיּוֹן שֵׁם יְהוָה וּתְהִלָּתוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
tokens.translation: That men may tell of the name of the LORD in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem; .
tokens.transliteration: le-sah-PEHR be-tsee-YOHN SHEHM ah-doh-NAI oo-te-hee-lah-TOH bee-roo-shah-LAH-eem

tokens.hebrew: בְּהִקָּבֵץ עַמִּים יַחְדָּו וּמַמְלָכוֹת לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: be-hee-kah-VEHTS ah-MEEM yahkh-DAHV oo-mahm-lah-KHOHT lah-ah-VOHD eht ah-doh-NAI

tokens.translation: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

tokens.hebrew: אֹמַר אֵלִי אַל־תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי בְּדוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: I say: 'O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days, Thou whose years endure throughout all generations.
tokens.transliteration: oh-MAHR eh-LEE ahl tah-ah-leh-NEE bah-khah-TSEE yah-MAHY be-DOHR doh-REEM she-noh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: לְפָנִים הָאָרֶץ יָסַדְתָּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ שָׁמָיִם׃
tokens.translation: Of old Thou didst lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of Thy hands.
tokens.transliteration: le-fah-NEEM hah-AH-rehts yah-SAHD-tah oo-mah-ah-SEH yah-DEY-khah shah-MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וְכֻלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם וְיַחֲלֹפוּ׃
tokens.translation: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt Thou change them, and they shall pass away;
tokens.transliteration: HEH-mah yoh-veh-DOO ve-ah-TAH tah-ah-MOHD ve-khoo-LAHM kah-BEH-gehd yeev-LOO kah-le-VOOSH tah-khah-lee-FEHM ve-yah-khah-LOH-foo

tokens.translation: But Thou art the selfsame, And Thy years shall have no end.
The children of Thy servants shall dwell securely, And their seed shall be established before Thee.'
tokens.transliteration: be-ney ah-vah-DEY-khah yeesh-KOH-noo ve-zahr-AHM le-fah-NEY-khah yee-KOHN
