title: Psalm 103
sefariaRef: Psalms 103
useCase: Compassion, forgiveness, and healing Themes: health, repentance, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְכָל־קְרָבַי אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED bah-rah-KHEE nahf-SHEE eht ah-doh-NAI ve-khohl ke-rah-VAHY eht SHEHM kohd-SHOH

tokens.translation: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits;
tokens.transliteration: bah-rah-KHEE nahf-SHEE eht ah-doh-NAI ve-ahl teesh-ke-KHEE kohl ge-moo-LAHV

tokens.translation: Who forgiveth all thine iniquity; Who healeth all Thy diseases;
tokens.transliteration: hah-soh-LEH-ahkh le-khohl ah-voh-NEH-khee hah-roh-FEH le-khohl tah-khah-loo-AH-ye-khee

tokens.hebrew: הַגּוֹאֵל מִשַּׁחַת חַיָּיְכִי הַמְעַטְּרֵכִי חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים׃
tokens.translation: Who redeemeth Thy life from the pit; Who encompasseth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
tokens.transliteration: hah-goh-EHL mee-SHAH-khaht khah-YAH-ye-khee hah-me-ah-te-REH-khee KHEH-sehd ve-rah-khah-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: הַמַּשְׂבִּיַע בַּטּוֹב עֶדְיֵךְ תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָיְכִי׃
tokens.translation: Who satisfieth thine old age with good things; So that Thy youth is renewed like the eagle.
tokens.transliteration: hah-mahs-BEE-yah bah-TOHV ehd-YEHKH teet-khah-DEHSH kah-NEH-shehr ne-oo-RAH-ye-khee

tokens.translation: The LORD executeth righteousness, And acts of justice for all that are oppressed.
tokens.transliteration: oh-SEH tse-dah-KOHT ah-doh-NAI oo-meesh-pah-TEEM le-khohl ah-shoo-KEEM

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: He made known His ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DEE-ah de-rah-KHAHV le-moh-SHEH leev-NEY yees-rah-EHL ah-lee-LOH-tahv

tokens.hebrew: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חָסֶד׃
tokens.translation: The LORD is full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
tokens.transliteration: rah-KHOOM ve-khah-NOON ah-doh-NAI EH-rehkh ah-PAH-yeem ve-rahv KHAH-sehd

tokens.translation: He will not always contend; Neither will He keep His anger for ever.
tokens.transliteration: loh lah-NEH-tsahkh yah-REEV ve-LOH le-oh-LAHM yee-TOHR

tokens.hebrew: לֹא כַחֲטָאֵינוּ עָשָׂה לָנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ גָּמַל עָלֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor requited us according to our iniquities.
tokens.transliteration: LOH khah-khah-tah-ey-NOO AH-sah LAH-noo ve-LOH khah-ah-voh-noh-TEY-noo gah-MAHL ah-LEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כִגְבֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ גָּבַר חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
tokens.translation: For as the heaven is high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.
tokens.transliteration: KEE kheeg-VOH-ahh shah-mah-YEEM ahl hah-AH-rehts gah-VAHR khahs-DOH ahl ye-reh-AHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּרְחֹק מִזְרָח מִמַּעֲרָב הִרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ׃
tokens.translation: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath He removed our transgressions from us.
tokens.transliteration: keer-KHOHK meez-RAHKH mee-mah-ah-RAHV hee-re-KHEEK mee-MEH-noo eht pe-shah-EY-noo

tokens.hebrew: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים רִחַם יְהוָה עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
tokens.translation: Like as a father hath compassion upon his children, So hath the LORD compassion upon them that fear Him. .
tokens.transliteration: ke-rah-KHEHM AHV ahl bah-NEEM ree-KHAHM ah-doh-NAI ahl ye-reh-AHV

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ׃
tokens.translation: For He knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.
tokens.transliteration: kee HOO yah-DAH yeets-REH-noo zah-KHOOR kee ah-FAHR ah-NAH-khe-noo

tokens.hebrew: אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּן יָצִיץ׃
tokens.translation: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
tokens.transliteration: eh-NOHSH keh-khah-TSEER yah-MAHV ke-TSEETS hah-sah-DEH KEHN yah-TSEETS

tokens.hebrew: כִּי רוּחַ עָבְרָה־בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקוֹמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof knoweth it no more.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ROO-ahkh ah-ve-rah BOH ve-ey-NEH-noo ve-loh yah-kee-REH-noo OHD me-koh-MOH

tokens.hebrew: וְחֶסֶד יְהוָה מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָיו וְצִדְקָתוֹ לִבְנֵי בָנִים׃
tokens.translation: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, And His righteousness unto children's children;
tokens.transliteration: ve-KHEH-sehd ah-doh-NAI meh-oh-LAHM ve-ahd oh-LAHM ahl ye-reh-AHV ve-tseed-kah-TOH leev-NEY vah-NEEM

tokens.translation: To such as keep His covenant, And to those that remember His precepts to do them.

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֵכִין כִּסְאוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה׃
tokens.translation: The LORD hath established His throne in the heavens; And His kingdom ruleth over all.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI bah-shah-mah-YEEM heh-KHEEN kees-OH oo-mahl-khoo-TOH bah-KOHL mah-SHAH-lah

tokens.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה מַלְאָכָיו גִּבֹּרֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל דְּבָרוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Bless the LORD, ye angels of His, Ye mighty in strength, that fulfil His word, Hearkening unto the voice of His word.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rah-KHOO ah-doh-NAI mahl-ah-KHAHV gee-BOH-rey khoh-AHKH oh-SEY de-vah-ROH leesh-MOH-ah be-KOHL de-vah-ROH

tokens.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־צְבָאָיו מְשָׁרְתָיו עֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Bless the LORD, all ye His hosts; Ye ministers of His, that do His pleasure.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rah-KHOO ah-doh-NAI kohl tse-vah-AHV me-shah-re-TAHV oh-SEY re-tsoh-NOH

tokens.hebrew: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו בְּכָל־מְקֹמוֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Bless the LORD, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion; Bless the LORD, O my soul.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rah-KHOO ah-doh-NAI kahl mah-ah-SAHV be-khohl me-koh-MOHT mehm-shahl-TOH bah-rah-KHEE nahf-SHEE eht ah-doh-NAI

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 104
sefariaRef: Psalms 104
useCase: Creation, living things, and sustenance Themes: nature, provision, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי גָּדַלְתָּ מְּאֹד הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָשְׁתָּ׃
tokens.translation: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, Thou art very great; Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rah-KHEE nahf-SHEE eht ah-doh-NAI ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HAHY gah-DAHL-tah me-OHD HOHD ve-hah-DAHR lah-VAH-she-tah

tokens.translation: Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment, who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;
tokens.transliteration: oh-teh OHR kah-sahl-MAH noh-TEH shah-MAH-yeem kahy-ree-AH

tokens.hebrew: הַמְקָרֶה בַמַּיִם עֲ‍לִיּוֹתָיו הַשָּׂם־עָבִים רְכוּבוֹ הַמְהַלֵּךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃
tokens.translation: Who layest the beams of Thine upper chambers in the waters, who makest the clouds Thy chariot, who walkest upon the wings of the wind;
tokens.transliteration: HAH-me-kah-reh vah-MAH-yeem ah-lee-yoh-TAHV hah-sahm ah-VEEM re-khoo-VOH hah-me-hah-LEHKH ahl kahn-fey ROO-ahkh

tokens.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת מְשָׁרְתָיו אֵשׁ לֹהֵט׃
tokens.translation: Who makest winds Thy messengers, the flaming fire Thy ministers.
tokens.transliteration: oh-SEH mahl-ah-KHAHV roo-KHOHT me-shah-re-TAHV EHSH loh-HEHT

tokens.translation: Who didst establish the earth upon its foundations, that it should not be moved for ever and ever;
tokens.transliteration: yah-sahd eh-REHTS ahl me-khoh-NEY-hah bahl tee-MOHT oh-LAHM vah-EHD

tokens.translation: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains.
tokens.transliteration: te-HOHM kah-le-VOOSH kee-see-TOH ahl hah-REEM yah-ahm-doo MAH-yeem

tokens.translation: At Thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of Thy thunder they hasted away—
tokens.transliteration: meen gah-ah-RAH-te-KHAH ye-noo-SOON meen KOHL rah-ahm-KHAH yeh-khah-feh-ZOON

tokens.hebrew: יַעֲלוּ הָרִים יֵרְדוּ בְקָעוֹת אֶל־מְקוֹם זֶה יָסַדְתָּ לָהֶם׃
tokens.translation: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down— Unto the place which Thou hadst founded for them;
tokens.transliteration: yah-ah-LOO hah-REEM yeh-re-DOO ve-kah-OHT ehl me-KOHM ZEH yah-SAHD-tah lah-HEHM

tokens.translation: Thou didst set a bound which they should not pass over, That they might not return to cover the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ge-vool sahm-TAH bahl yah-ah-voh-ROON bahl ye-shoo-VOON le-khah-SOHT hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: הַמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
tokens.translation: Who sendest forth springs into the valleys; They run between the mountains;
tokens.transliteration: hah-me-shah-LEH-ahkh mah-yah-NEEM bah-ne-khah-LEEM BEYN hah-REEM ye-hah-leh-KHOON

tokens.hebrew: יַשְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי יִשְׁבְּרוּ פְרָאִים צְמָאָם׃
tokens.translation: They give drink to every beast of the field, The wild asses quench their thirst. .
tokens.transliteration: yahsh-KOO kohl khahy-TOH sah-DAHY yeesh-be-ROO fe-rah-EEM tse-mah-AHM

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ־קוֹל׃
tokens.translation: Beside them dwell the fowl of the heaven, From among the branches they sing.
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley-HEHM ohf hah-shah-MAH-yeem yeesh-KOHN mee-BEYN oh-fah-YEEM yee-te-noo KOHL

tokens.hebrew: מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו מִפְּרִי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ תִּשְׂבַּע הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Who waterest the mountains from Thine upper chambers; The earth is full of the fruit of Thy works.
tokens.transliteration: mahsh-KEH hah-REEM meh-ah-lee-yoh-TAHV mee-pe-REE mah-ah-SEY-khah tees-BAH hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר לַבְּהֵמָה וְעֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַת הָאָדָם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Who causeth the grass to spring up for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; To bring forth bread out of the earth,
tokens.transliteration: mahts-MEE-ahkh khah-TSEER lah-be-heh-MAH ve-eh-SEHV lah-ah-voh-DAHT hah-ah-DAHM le-HOH-tsee leh-KHEHM meen hah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים מִשָּׁמֶן וְלֶחֶם לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד׃
tokens.translation: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, Making the face brighter than oil, And bread that stayeth man's heart.
tokens.transliteration: ve-YAH-yeen ye-sah-MAHKH le-vahv eh-NOHSH le-hahts-HEEL pah-NEEM mee-SHAH-mehn ve-LEH-khehm le-vahv eh-NOHSH yees-AHD

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵי יְהוָה אַרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָטָע׃
tokens.translation: The trees of the LORD have their fill, The cedars of Lebanon, which He hath planted;
tokens.transliteration: yees-be-OO ah-TSEY ah-doh-NAI ah-re-ZEY le-vah-NOHN ah-SHEHR nah-TAH

tokens.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ חֲסִידָה בְּרוֹשִׁים בֵּיתָהּ׃
tokens.translation: Wherein the birds make their nests; As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.
tokens.transliteration: ah-shehr SHAHM tsee-poh-REEM ye-kah-NEH-noo khah-see-DAH be-roh-SHEEM bey-TAHH

tokens.hebrew: הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַשְׁפַנִּים׃
tokens.translation: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.
tokens.transliteration: hah-REEM hah-ge-voh-HEEM lah-ye-eh-LEEM se-lah-EEM mahkh-SEH lah-she-fah-NEEM

tokens.hebrew: עָשָׂה יָרֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִים שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Who appointedst the moon for seasons; The sun knoweth his going down.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SAH yah-reh-AHKH le-moh-ah-DEEM sheh-MEHSH yah-DAH me-voh-OH

tokens.translation: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.
tokens.transliteration: tah-sheht khoh-SHEHKH VEE-hee LAH-ye-lah boh teer-MOHS kohl khahy-toh YAH-ahr

tokens.hebrew: הַכְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִים לַטָּרֶף וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵאֵל אָכְלָם׃
tokens.translation: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
tokens.transliteration: hah-ke-fee-REEM shoh-ah-GEEM lah-TAH-rehf oo-le-vah-KEHSH meh-EHL ohkh-LAHM

tokens.translation: The sun ariseth, they slink away, And couch in their dens.
tokens.transliteration: teez-RAHKH hah-sheh-MEHSH yeh-ah-seh-FOON ve-ehl me-oh-noh-TAHM yeer-bah-TSOON

tokens.translation: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labour until the evening.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-TSEH ah-DAHM le-foh-oh-LOH ve-lah-ah-VOH-dah-TOH ah-dey AH-rehv

tokens.hebrew: מָה־רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: How manifold are Thy works, O LORD! In wisdom hast Thou made them all; The earth is full of Thy creatures.
tokens.transliteration: mah rah-BOO mah-ah-SEY-khah ah-doh-NAI koo-LAHM be-khohkh-MAH ah-SEE-tah mah-le-AH hah-AH-rehts keen-yah-NEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: זֶה הַיָּם גָּדוֹל וּרְחַב יָדָיִם שָׁם־רֶמֶשׂ וְאֵין מִסְפָּר חַיּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת עִם־גְּדֹלוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Yonder sea, great and wide, Therein are creeping things innumerable, Living creatures, both small and great.
tokens.transliteration: ZEH hah-YAHM gah-DOHL oo-re-KHAHV yah-DAH-yeem shahm reh-MEHS ve-EYN mees-PAHR khah-YOHT ke-tah-NOHT eem ge-doh-LOHT

tokens.hebrew: שָׁם אֳנִיּוֹת יְהַלֵּכוּן לִוְיָתָן זֶה־יָצַרְתָּ לְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom Thou hast formed to sport therein.
tokens.transliteration: SHAHM oh-nee-YOHT ye-hah-leh-KHOON leev-yah-TAHN zeh yah-TSAHR-tah le-sah-khehk BOH

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּם אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּן לָתֵת אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: All of them wait for Thee, That Thou mayest give them their food in due season.
tokens.transliteration: koo-LAHM eh-LEY-khah ye-sah-beh-ROON lah-TEHT ohkh-LAHM be-ee-TOH

tokens.hebrew: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם יִלְקֹטוּן תִּפְתַּח יָדְךָ יִשְׂבְּעוּן טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: Thou givest it unto them, they gather it; Thou openest Thy hand, they are satisfied with good.
tokens.transliteration: tee-TEHN lah-HEHM yeel-koh-TOON teef-TAHKH yah-de-KHAH yees-be-OON TOHV

tokens.hebrew: תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ יִבָּהֵלוּן תֹּסֵף רוּחָם יִגְוָעוּן וְאֶל־עֲפָרָם יְשׁוּבוּן׃
tokens.translation: Thou hidest Thy face, they vanish; Thou withdrawest their breath, they perish, And return to their dust.
tokens.transliteration: tahs-TEER pah-ney-KHAH yee-bah-heh-LOON toh-SEHF roo-KHAHM yeeg-vah-OON ve-ehl ah-fah-RAHM ye-shoo-VOON

tokens.hebrew: תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵאוּן וּתְחַדֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אֲדָמָה׃
tokens.translation: Thou sendest forth Thy spirit, they are created; and Thou renewest the face of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: te-shah-LAHKH roo-khah-KHAH yee-bah-reh-OON oo-te-khah-DEHSH pe-NEY ah-dah-MAH

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו׃
tokens.translation: May the glory of the LORD endure for ever; let the LORD rejoice in His works!
tokens.transliteration: ye-HEE khe-VOHD ah-doh-NAI le-oh-LAHM yees-MAHKH ah-doh-NAI be-mah-ah-SAHV

tokens.hebrew: הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
tokens.translation: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.
tokens.transliteration: hah-mah-BEET lah-ah-REHTS vah-teer-AHD yee-GAH beh-hah-REEM ve-yeh-eh-SHAH-noo

tokens.hebrew: אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
tokens.translation: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEE-rah lah-ah-doh-NAI be-khah-YAHY ah-zah-me-RAH leh-loh-HAHY be-oh-DEE

tokens.hebrew: יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Let my musing be sweet unto Him; as for me, I will rejoice in the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: yeh-eh-RAHV ah-LAHV see-KHEE ah-noh-KHEE ehs-MAHKH bah-ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּרְשָׁעִים עוֹד אֵינָם בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: Let sinners cease out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: yee-TAH-moo khah-tah-EEM meen hah-AH-rehts oo-re-shah-EEM OHD ey-NAHM bah-rah-KHEE nahf-SHEE eht ah-doh-NAI hah-le-loo YAHH

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 105
sefariaRef: Psalms 105
useCase: Remembering the covenant and history Themes: community, gratitude. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: O give thanks unto the LORD, call upon His name; Make known His doings among the peoples.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI keer-OO beesh-MOH hoh-DEE-oo vah-ah-MEEM ah-lee-loh-TAHV

tokens.translation: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; Speak ye of all His marvellous works.
tokens.transliteration: shee-roo LOH zah-me-roo LOH see-KHOO be-khohl neef-le-oh-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: Glory ye in His holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: hee-te-hah-le-LOO be-SHEHM kohd-SHOH yees-MAHKH LEHV me-vahk-SHEY ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִיד׃
tokens.translation: Seek ye the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.
tokens.transliteration: deer-SHOO ah-doh-NAI ve-oo-ZOH bah-ke-SHOO fah-NAHV tah-MEED

tokens.translation: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;
tokens.transliteration: zeekh-ROO neef-le-oh-TAHV ah-shehr ah-SAH moh-fe-TAHV oo-meesh-pe-tey FEEV

tokens.hebrew: זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָיו׃
tokens.translation: O ye seed of Abraham His servant, Ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.
tokens.transliteration: zeh-RAH ahv-rah-HAHM ahv-DOH be-NEY yah-ah-KOHV be-khee-RAHV

tokens.translation: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: HOO ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY-noo be-khohl hah-AH-rehts meesh-pah-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃
tokens.translation: He hath remembered His covenant for ever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations;
tokens.transliteration: zah-KHAHR le-oh-LAHM be-ree-TOH dah-VAHR tsee-VAH le-EH-lehf DOHR

tokens.translation: [The covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath unto Isaac;
tokens.transliteration: ah-SHEHR kah-RAHT eht ahv-rah-HAHM oo-she-VOO-ah-TOH le-yees-KHAHK

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-ah-mee-DEH-hah le-yah-ah-KOHV le-KHOHK le-yees-rah-EHL be-REET oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת־אֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶם׃
tokens.translation: Saying: 'Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance.'
tokens.transliteration: leh-MOHR le-KHAH eh-TEHN eht eh-rehts ke-NAH-ahn kheh-VEHL nah-khah-laht-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: בִּהְיוֹתָם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּהּ׃
tokens.translation: When they were but a few men in number. Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,
tokens.transliteration: bee-he-yoh-TAHM me-TEY mees-PAHR keem-AHT ve-gah-REEM BAHH

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל־גּוֹי מִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל־עַם אַחֵר׃
tokens.translation: And when they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people,
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeet-hah-le-KHOO mee-GOHY ehl GOHY mee-mahm-lah-KHAH ehl AHM ah-KHEHR

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־הִנִּיחַ אָדָם לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִים׃
tokens.translation: He suffered no man to do them wrong, Yea, for their sake He reproved kings:
tokens.transliteration: loh hee-NEE-ahkh ah-DAHM le-ah-she-KAHM vah-YOH-khahkh ah-ley-HEHM me-lah-KHEEM

tokens.translation: 'Touch not Mine anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.'
tokens.transliteration: ahl tee-ge-OO veem-shee-KHAHY ve-leen-vee-AHY ahl tah-REH-oo

tokens.translation: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeek-RAH rah-AHV ahl hah-AH-rehts kahl mah-teh LEH-khehm shah-VAHR

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף׃
tokens.translation: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant;
tokens.transliteration: shah-LAHKH leef-ney-HEHM EESH le-EH-vehd neem-KAHR yoh-SEHF

tokens.hebrew: עִנּוּ בַכֶּבֶל רגליו [רַגְלוֹ] בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: His feet they hurt with fetters, His person was laid in iron;
tokens.transliteration: ee-NOO vah-KEH-vehl rahg-LOH bahr-ZEHL BAH-ah nahf-SHOH

tokens.translation: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD tested him.
tokens.transliteration: ahd EHT boh de-vah-ROH eem-RAHT ah-doh-NAI tse-rah-FAH-te-hoo

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ מֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ׃
tokens.translation: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of the peoples, and set him free.
tokens.transliteration: SHAH-lahkh meh-LEHKH vah-yah-tee-REH-hoo moh-SHEHL ah-MEEM vah-ye-fah-te-KHEH-hoo

tokens.translation: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions;
tokens.transliteration: sah-MOH ah-DOHN le-vey-TOH oo-moh-SHEHL be-khohl keen-yah-NOH

tokens.translation: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצְרָיִם וְיַעֲקֹב גָּר בְּאֶרֶץ־חָם׃
tokens.translation: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-VOH yees-rah-EHL meets-RAH-yeem ve-yah-ah-KOHV GAHR be-eh-rehts KHAHM

tokens.translation: And He increased His people greatly, And made them too mighty for their adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YEH-fehr eht ah-MOH me-OHD vah-yah-ah-tsee-meh-HOO mee-tsah-RAHV

tokens.hebrew: הָפַךְ לִבָּם לִשְׂנֹא עַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָיו׃
tokens.translation: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.
tokens.transliteration: hah-FAHKH lee-BAHM lees-NOH ah-MOH le-heet-nah-KEHL bah-ah-vah-DAHV

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ אַהֲרֹן אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.
tokens.transliteration: shah-LAHKH moh-SHEH ahv-DOH ah-hah-ROHN ah-SHEHR bah-khahr BOH

tokens.hebrew: שָׂמוּ־בָם דִּבְרֵי אֹתוֹתָיו וּמֹפְתִים בְּאֶרֶץ חָם׃
tokens.translation: They wrought among them His manifold signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.
tokens.transliteration: sah-moo VAHM deev-REY oh-toh-TAHV oo-moh-fe-TEEM be-EH-rehts KHAHM

tokens.translation: He sent darkness, and it was dark; And they rebelled not against His word.
tokens.transliteration: SHAH-lahkh khoh-SHEHKH vah-yahkh-SHEEKH ve-loh mah-ROO eh-de-vah-ROH

tokens.translation: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.
tokens.transliteration: hah-FAHKH eht mey-mey-HEHM le-DAHM vah-YAH-meht eht de-gah-TAHM

tokens.translation: Their land swarmed with frogs, In the chambers of their kings.
He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And gnats in all their borders.
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR vah-yah-VOH ah-ROHV kee-NEEM be-khohl ge-voo-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: נָתַן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶם בָּרָד אֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת בְּאַרְצָם׃
tokens.translation: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.
tokens.transliteration: nah-TAHN geesh-mey-HEHM bah-RAHD EHSH leh-hah-VOHT be-ahr-TSAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּךְ גַּפְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָם וַיְשַׁבֵּר עֵץ גְּבוּלָם׃
tokens.translation: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; And broke the trees of their borders.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAHKH gahf-NAHM oo-te-eh-nah-TAHM vah-ye-shah-BEHR EHTS ge-voo-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא אַרְבֶּה וְיֶלֶק וְאֵין מִסְפָּר׃
tokens.translation: He spoke, and the locust came, And the canker-worm without number,
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR vah-yah-VOH ahr-BEH ve-YEH-lehk ve-EYN mees-PAHR

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאכַל כָּל־עֵשֶׂב בְּאַרְצָם וַיֹּאכַל פְּרִי אַדְמָתָם׃
tokens.translation: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YOH-khahl kohl EH-sehv be-ahr-TSAHM vah-YOH-khahl pe-REE ahd-mah-TAHM

tokens.translation: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The first-fruits of all their strength.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAHKH kohl be-KHOHR be-ahr-TSAHM reh-SHEET le-khohl oh-NAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין בִּשְׁבָטָיו כּוֹשֵׁל׃
tokens.translation: And He brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was none that stumbled among His tribes.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-tsee-EHM be-KHEH-sehf ve-zah-HAHV ve-EYN beesh-vah-TAHV koh-SHEHL

tokens.hebrew: שָׂמַח מִצְרַיִם בְּצֵאתָם כִּי־נָפַל פַּחְדָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.
tokens.transliteration: sah-MAHKH meets-RAH-yeem be-tseh-TAHM kee nah-FAHL pahkh-DAHM ah-ley-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: פָּרַשׂ עָנָן לְמָסָךְ וְאֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָיְלָה׃
tokens.translation: He spread a cloud for a screen; And fire to give light in the night.
tokens.transliteration: pah-RAHS ah-NAHN le-mah-SAHKH ve-EHSH le-hah-EER LAH-ye-lah

tokens.hebrew: שָׁאַל וַיָּבֵא שְׂלָו וְלֶחֶם שָׁמַיִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵם׃
tokens.translation: They asked, and He brought quails, And gave them in plenty the bread of heaven.
tokens.transliteration: shah-AHL vah-yah-VEH se-LAHV ve-LEH-khehm shah-MAH-yeem yahs-bee-EHM

tokens.hebrew: פָּתַח צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מָיִם הָלְכוּ בַּצִּיּוֹת נָהָר׃
tokens.translation: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran, a river in the dry places.
tokens.transliteration: PAH-tahkh TSOOR vah-yah-ZOO-voo MAH-yeem hah-le-KHOO bah-tsee-YOHT nah-HAHR

tokens.translation: For He remembered His holy word Unto Abraham His servant;
tokens.transliteration: kee zah-KHAHR eht de-VAHR kohd-SHOH eht ahv-rah-HAHM ahv-DOH

tokens.translation: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with singing.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-TSEE ah-MOH ve-sah-SOHN be-ree-NAH eht be-khee-RAHV

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים יִירָשׁוּ׃
tokens.translation: And He gave them the lands of the nations, And they took the labour of the peoples in possession;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TEHN lah-HEHM ahr-TSOHT goh-YEEM vah-ah-MAHL le-oo-MEEM yee-RAH-shoo

tokens.hebrew: בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: That they might keep His statutes, And observe His laws. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ah-VOOR yeesh-me-ROO khoo-KAHV ve-toh-roh-TAHV yeen-TSOH-roo hah-le-loo YAHH

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 106
sefariaRef: Psalms 106
useCase: Collective confession and mercy Themes: repentance, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּיָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Hallelujah. O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: hah-le-loo-YAHH hoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI kee TOHV KEE le-oh-LAHM khahs-DOH

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Who can express the mighty acts of the LORD, or make all His praise to be heard?
tokens.transliteration: MEE ye-mah-LEHL ge-voo-ROHT ah-doh-NAI yahsh-MEE-ah kohl te-hee-lah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכָל־עֵת׃
tokens.translation: Happy are they that keep justice, that do righteousness at all times.
tokens.transliteration: ahsh-REY shoh-me-REY meesh-PAHT oh-SEH tse-dah-KAH ve-khohl EHT

tokens.hebrew: זָכְרֵנִי יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Remember me, O LORD, when Thou favourest Thy people; O think of me at Thy salvation;
tokens.transliteration: zah-khe-REH-nee ah-doh-NAI beer-TSOHN ah-MEH-khah pah-ke-DEH-nee bee-shoo-ah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: That I may behold the prosperity of Thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thine inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: leer-OHT be-toh-VAHT be-khee-REY-khah lees-moh-AHKH be-seem-KHAHT goh-YEH-khah le-heet-hah-LEHL eem nah-khah-lah-TEH-khah

tokens.translation: We have sinned with our fathers, we have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־הִשְׂכִּילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת־רֹב חֲסָדֶיךָ וַיַּמְרוּ עַל־יָם בְּיַם־סוּף׃
tokens.translation: Our fathers in Egypt gave no heed unto Thy wonders; they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies; but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
tokens.transliteration: ah-voh-TEY-noo ve-meets-RAH-yeem loh hees-KEE-loo neef-le-oh-TEY-khah LOH zah-khe-ROO eht ROHV khah-sah-DEY-khah vah-yahm-ROO ahl YAHM be-yahm SOOF

tokens.translation: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, that He might make His mighty power to be known.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-shee-EHM le-MAH-ahn she-MOH le-hoh-DEE-ah eht ge-voo-rah-TOH

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם־סוּף וַיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר׃
tokens.translation: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeeg-AHR be-yahm SOOF vah-yeh-kheh-RAHV vah-yoh-lee-KHEHM bah-te-hoh-MOHT kah-meed-BAHR

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵב׃
tokens.translation: And He saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-shee-EHM mee-YAHD soh-NEH vah-yeeg-ah-LEHM mee-YAHD oh-YEHV

tokens.hebrew: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר׃
tokens.translation: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-khah-soo MAH-yeem tsah-rey-HEHM eh-KHAHD meh-HEHM LOH noh-TAHR

tokens.translation: Then believed they His words; They sang His praise.
They soon forgot His works; They waited not for His counsel;
tokens.transliteration: mee-hah-ROO shah-khe-KHOO mah-ah-SAHV loh khee-KOO lah-ah-tsah-TOH

tokens.translation: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tried God in the desert.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeet-ah-VOO tah-ah-VAH bah-meed-BAHR vah-ye-nah-soo EHL bee-shee-MOHN

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָׁם׃
tokens.translation: And He gave them their request; But sent leanness into their soul.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TEHN lah-HEHM sheh-eh-lah-TAHM vah-ye-shah-LAHKH rah-ZOHN be-nahf-SHAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: They were jealous also of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron the holy one of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-kahn-OO le-moh-SHEH bah-mah-khah-NEH le-ah-hah-ROHN ke-DOHSH ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: תִּפְתַּח־אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל־עֲדַת אֲבִירָם׃
tokens.translation: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.
tokens.transliteration: teef-tahkh eh-REHTS vah-teev-LAH dah-TAHN vah-te-KHAHS ahl ah-DAHT ah-vee-RAHM

tokens.translation: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.
tokens.transliteration: vah-teev-ahr EHSH bah-ah-dah-TAHM leh-hah-VAH te-lah-HEHT re-shah-EEM

tokens.translation: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב׃
tokens.translation: Thus they exchanged their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-MEE-roo eht ke-voh-DAHM be-tahv-NEET SHOHR oh-KHEHL EH-sehv

tokens.hebrew: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָיִם׃
tokens.translation: They forgot God their saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt;
tokens.transliteration: shah-khe-KHOO EHL moh-shee-AHM oh-SEH ge-doh-LOHT be-meets-RAH-yeem

tokens.translation: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Terrible things by the Red Sea.
tokens.transliteration: neef-lah-OHT be-EH-rehts KHAHM noh-rah-OHT ahl yahm SOOF

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵהַשְׁחִית׃
tokens.translation: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach, To turn back His wrath, lest He should destroy them.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YOH-mehr le-hahsh-mee-DAHM loo-LEY moh-SHEH ve-khee-ROH ah-MAHD bah-PEH-rehts le-fah-NAHV le-hah-SHEEV khah-mah-TOH meh-hahsh-KHEET

tokens.translation: Moreover, they scorned the desirable land, They believed not His word;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeem-ah-SOO be-EH-rehts khehm-DAH loh heh-eh-MEE-noo leed-vah-ROH

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּרָגְנוּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה׃
tokens.translation: And they murmured in their tents, They hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeh-rah-ge-NOO ve-oh-hoh-ley-HEHM LOH shah-me-OO be-KOHL ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יָדוֹ לָהֶם לְהַפִּיל אוֹתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
tokens.translation: Therefore He swore concerning them, That He would overthrow them in the wilderness;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-SAH yah-DOH lah-HEHM le-hah-PEEL oh-TAHM bah-meed-BAHR

tokens.translation: And that He would cast out their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִים׃
tokens.translation: They joined themselves also unto Baal of Peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TSAH-me-DOO le-VAH-ahl pe-OHR vah-yoh-khe-LOO zeev-KHEY meh-TEEM

tokens.translation: Thus they provoked Him with their doings, And the plague broke in upon them.
Then stood up Phinehas, and wrought judgment, And so the plague was stayed.

tokens.hebrew: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד־עוֹלָם׃
tokens.translation: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for ever.
tokens.transliteration: vah-teh-KHAH-shehv LOH leets-dah-KAH le-DOHR vah-DOHR ahd oh-LAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם׃
tokens.translation: They angered Him also at the waters of Meribah, And it went ill with Moses because of them;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahk-tsee-FOO ahl MEY me-ree-VAH vah-YEH-rah le-moh-SHEH bah-ah-voo-RAHM

tokens.translation: For they embittered his spirit, And he spoke rashly with his lips.
tokens.transliteration: kee heem-ROO eht roo-KHOH vah-ye-vah-TEH bees-fah-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם׃
tokens.translation: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD commanded them;
tokens.transliteration: loh heesh-mee-DOO eht hah-ah-MEEM ah-SHEHR ah-MAHR ah-doh-NAI lah-HEHM

tokens.translation: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works;
And they served their idols, Which became a snare unto them;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-ahv-DOO eht ah-tsah-bey-HEHM vah-yeeh-YOO lah-HEHM le-moh-KEHSH

tokens.translation: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-be-KHOO eht be-ney-HEHM ve-eht be-noh-tey-HEHM lah-SHEH-deem

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם נָקִי דַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר זִבְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּי כְנָעַן וַתֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ בַּדָּמִים׃
tokens.translation: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-she-pe-KHOO DAHM nah-KEE dahm be-ney-HEHM oo-ve-noh-tey-HEHM ah-SHEHR zee-be-KHOO lah-ah-tsah-BEY khe-NAH-ahn vah-teh-kheh-NAHF hah-AH-rehts bah-dah-MEEM

tokens.translation: Thus were they defiled with their works, And went astray in their doings.
Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against His people, And He abhorred His inheritance.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-khahr AHF ah-doh-NAI be-ah-MOH vah-ye-tah-EHV eht nah-khah-lah-TOH

tokens.translation: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-te-NEHM be-yahd goh-YEEM vah-yeem-she-LOO vah-HEHM soh-ne-ey-HEHM

tokens.translation: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their hand.

tokens.hebrew: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם׃
tokens.translation: Many times did He deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And sank low through their iniquity.
tokens.transliteration: pe-ah-MEEM rah-BOHT yah-tsee-LEHM ve-heh-MAH yahm-ROO vah-ah-tsah-TAHM vah-yah-MOH-koo bah-ah-voh-NAHM

tokens.translation: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress, When He heard their cry;
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAHR bah-TSAHR lah-HEHM be-shah-me-OH eht ree-nah-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חסדו [חֲסָדָיו׃]
tokens.translation: And He remembered for them His covenant, And repented according to the multitude of His mercies.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-KOHR lah-HEHM be-ree-TOH vah-yee-nah-KHEHM ke-ROHV khah-sah-DAHV

tokens.translation: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yee-TEHN oh-TAHM le-rah-khah-MEEM leef-NEY kohl shoh-vey-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the nations, That we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, That we may triumph in Thy praise.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-shee-EH-noo ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY-noo ve-kah-be-tseh-NOO meen hah-goh-YEEM le-hoh-DOHT le-SHEHM kohd-SHEH-khah le-heesh-tah-BEH-ahkh beet-hee-lah-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם וְאָמַר כָּל־הָעָם אָמֵן הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting, and let all the people say: 'Amen.' Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: bah-ROOKH ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-HEY yees-rah-EHL meen HAH-oh-LAHM ve-AHD hah-oh-LAHM ve-ah-MAHR kohl hah-AHM ah-MEHN hah-le-loo YAHH

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Psalms 106

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: Psalm 107
sefariaRef: Psalms 107
useCase: Thanksgiving after distress and rescue Themes: gratitude, travel, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.'
tokens.transliteration: hoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI kee TOHV KEE le-oh-LAHM khahs-DOH

tokens.hebrew: יֹאמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָם מִיַּד־צָר׃
tokens.translation: So let the redeemed of the LORD say, Whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary;
tokens.transliteration: yoh-me-ROO ge-oo-LEY ah-doh-NAI ah-SHEHR ge-ah-LAHM mee-yahd TSAHR

tokens.hebrew: וּמֵאֲרָצוֹת קִבְּצָם מִמִּזְרָח וּמִמַּעֲרָב מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּם׃
tokens.translation: And gathered them out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the sea.
tokens.transliteration: oo-meh-ah-rah-TSOHT kee-be-TSAHM mee-meez-RAHKH oo-mee-mah-ah-RAHV mee-tsah-FOHN oo-mee-YAHM

tokens.hebrew: תָּעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימוֹן דָּרֶךְ עִיר מוֹשָׁב לֹא מָצָאוּ׃
tokens.translation: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.
tokens.transliteration: tah-OO vah-meed-BAHR bee-shee-MOHN DAH-rehkh EER moh-SHAHV LOH mah-TSAH-oo

tokens.translation: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.
tokens.transliteration: re-eh-VEEM gahm tse-meh-EEM nahf-SHAHM bah-HEHM teet-ah-TAHF

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יַצִּילֵם׃
tokens.translation: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeets-ah-KOO ehl ah-doh-NAI bah-TSAHR lah-HEHM mee-me-tsoo-koh-tey-HEHM yah-tsee-LEHM

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָלֶכֶת אֶל־עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
tokens.translation: And He led them by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-de-ree-KHEHM be-DEH-rehkh ye-shah-RAH lah-LEH-kheht ehl EER moh-SHAHV

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI khahs-DOH ve-neef-le-oh-TAHV leev-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־הִשְׂבִּיעַ נֶפֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה מִלֵּא־טוֹב׃
tokens.translation: For He hath satisfied the longing soul, And the hungry soul He hath filled with good.
tokens.transliteration: kee hees-bee-AH NEH-fehsh shoh-keh-KAH ve-NEH-fehsh re-eh-VAH mee-leh TOHV

tokens.hebrew: יֹשְׁבֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת אֲסִירֵי עֳנִי וּבַרְזֶל׃
tokens.translation: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron—
tokens.transliteration: yoh-she-VEY KHOH-shehkh ve-tsahl-MAH-veht ah-see-REY oh-NEE oo-vahr-ZEHL

tokens.translation: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High.
tokens.transliteration: kee heem-ROO eem-rey EHL vah-ah-TSAHT ehl-YOHN nah-AH-tsoo

tokens.hebrew: וַיַּכְנַע בֶּעָמָל לִבָּם כָּשְׁלוּ וְאֵין עֹזֵר׃
tokens.translation: Therefore He humbled their heart with travail, They stumbled, and there was none to help—
tokens.transliteration: vah-yahkh-NAH beh-ah-MAHL lee-BAHM kah-she-LOO ve-EYN oh-ZEHR

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
tokens.translation: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-ah-KOO ehl ah-doh-NAI bah-TSAHR lah-HEHM mee-me-tsoo-koh-tey-HEHM yoh-shee-EHM

tokens.translation: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their bands in sunder. .

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI khahs-DOH ve-neef-le-oh-TAHV leev-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־שִׁבַּר דַּלְתוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵי בַרְזֶל גִּדֵּעַ׃
tokens.translation: For He hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.
tokens.transliteration: kee shee-BAHR dahl-TOHT ne-KHOH-sheht oo-ve-ree-KHEY vahr-ZEHL gee-DEH-ah

tokens.translation: Crazed because of the way of their transgression, And afflicted because of their iniquities—

tokens.hebrew: כָּל־אֹכֶל תְּתַעֵב נַפְשָׁם וַיַּגִּיעוּ עַד־שַׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
tokens.translation: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near unto the gates of death—
tokens.transliteration: kohl oh-KHEHL te-tah-EHV nahf-SHAHM vah-yah-GEE-oo ahd SHAH-ah-rey MAH-veht

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
tokens.translation: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-ah-KOO ehl ah-doh-NAI bah-TSAHR lah-HEHM mee-me-tsoo-koh-tey-HEHM yoh-shee-EHM

tokens.translation: He sent His word, and healed them, And delivered them from their graves.

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI khahs-DOH ve-neef-le-oh-TAHV leev-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: וְיִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי תוֹדָה וִיסַפְּרוּ מַעֲשָׂיו בְּרִנָּה׃
tokens.translation: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with singing.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeez-be-KHOO zeev-KHEY toh-DAH vee-sah-pe-ROO mah-ah-SAHV be-ree-NAH

tokens.hebrew: יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה בְּמַיִם רַבִּים׃
tokens.translation: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters—
tokens.transliteration: yoh-re-DEY hah-YAHM boh-oh-nee-YOHT oh-SEY me-lah-KHAH be-MAH-yeem rah-BEEM

tokens.hebrew: הֵמָּה רָאוּ מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו בִּמְצוּלָה׃
tokens.translation: These saw the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep;
tokens.transliteration: HEH-mah rah-OO mah-ah-SEY ah-doh-NAI ve-neef-le-oh-TAHV beem-tsoo-LAH

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד רוּחַ סְעָרָה וַתְּרוֹמֵם גַּלָּיו׃
tokens.translation: For He commanded, and raised the stormy wind, Which lifted up the waves thereof;
tokens.transliteration: vah-YOH-mehr vah-yah-ah-MEHD ROO-ahkh se-ah-RAH vah-te-roh-MEHM gah-LAHV

tokens.hebrew: יַעֲלוּ שָׁמַיִם יֵרְדוּ תְהוֹמוֹת נַפְשָׁם בְּרָעָה תִתְמוֹגָג׃
tokens.translation: They mounted up to the heaven, they went down to the deeps; Their soul melted away because of trouble;
tokens.transliteration: yah-ah-LOO shah-mah-YEEM yeh-re-DOO te-hoh-MOHT nahf-SHAHM be-rah-AH teet-moh-GAHG

tokens.translation: They reeled to and fro, and staggered like a drunken man, And all their wisdom was swallowed up—
tokens.transliteration: yah-KHOH-goo ve-yah-noo-OO kah-shee-KOHR ve-khohl khohkh-mah-TAHM teet-bah-LAH

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם וּמִמְּצוּקֹתֵיהֶם יוֹצִיאֵם׃
tokens.translation: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeets-ah-KOO ehl ah-doh-NAI bah-TSAHR lah-HEHM oo-mee-me-tsoo-koh-tey-HEHM yoh-tsee-EHM

tokens.translation: He made the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof were still.
Then were they glad because they were quiet, And He led them unto their desired haven.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yees-me-KHOO khee yeesh-TOH-koo vah-yahn-KHEHM ehl me-KHOHZ khehf-TSAHM

tokens.hebrew: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!
tokens.transliteration: yoh-DOO lah-ah-doh-NAI khahs-DOH ve-neef-le-oh-TAHV leev-NEY ah-DAHM

tokens.translation: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the seat of the elders.
tokens.transliteration: vee-roh-me-moo-HOO beek-hahl AHM oo-ve-moh-SHAHV ze-keh-NEEM ye-hah-le-LOO-hoo

tokens.hebrew: יָשֵׂם נְהָרוֹת לְמִדְבָּר וּמֹצָאֵי מַיִם לְצִמָּאוֹן׃
tokens.translation: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;
tokens.transliteration: yah-SEHM ne-hah-ROHT le-meed-BAHR oo-moh-TSAH-ey mah-YEEM le-tsee-mah-OHN

tokens.hebrew: אֶרֶץ פְּרִי לִמְלֵחָה מֵרָעַת יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
tokens.translation: A fruitful land into a salt waste, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
tokens.transliteration: EH-rehts pe-REE leem-leh-KHAH meh-rah-AHT YOH-she-vey VAHH

tokens.hebrew: יָשֵׂם מִדְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמֹצָאֵי מָיִם׃
tokens.translation: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.
tokens.transliteration: yah-SEHM meed-BAHR lah-ah-gahm MAH-yeem ve-EH-rehts tsee-YAH le-moh-TSAH-ey MAH-yeem

tokens.hebrew: וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם רְעֵבִים וַיְכוֹנְנוּ עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
tokens.translation: And there He maketh the hungry to dwell, And they establish a city of habitation;
tokens.transliteration: vah-YOH-shehv SHAHM re-eh-VEEM vah-ye-khoh-ne-NOO EER moh-SHAHV

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּזְרְעוּ שָׂדוֹת וַיִּטְּעוּ כְרָמִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פְּרִי תְבוּאָה׃
tokens.translation: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, Which yield fruits of increase.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeez-re-OO sah-DOHT vah-yee-te-OO khe-rah-MEEM vah-yah-ah-SOO pe-REE te-VOO-ah

tokens.hebrew: וַיְבָרֲכֵם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד וּבְהֶמְתָּם לֹא יַמְעִיט׃
tokens.translation: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly, And suffereth not their cattle to decrease.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-vah-rah-KHEHM vah-yeer-BOO me-OHD oo-ve-hehm-TAHM LOH yahm-EET

tokens.translation: Again, they are minished and dwindle away Through oppression of evil and sorrow.

tokens.hebrew: שֹׁפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃
tokens.translation: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-FEHKH BOOZ ahl ne-dee-VEEM vah-yaht-EHM be-TOH-hoo loh DAH-rehkh

tokens.hebrew: וַיְשַׂגֵּב אֶבְיוֹן מֵעוֹנִי וַיָּשֶׂם כַּצֹּאן מִשְׁפָּחוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Yet setteth He the needy on high from affliction, And maketh his families like a flock.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-sah-GEHV ehv-YOHN meh-OH-nee vah-YAH-sehm kah-TSOHN meesh-pah-KHOHT

tokens.hebrew: יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל־עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃
tokens.translation: The upright see it, and are glad; And all iniquity stoppeth her mouth.
tokens.transliteration: yeer-OO ye-shah-REEM ve-yees-MAH-khoo ve-khohl ahv-LAH KAH-fe-tsah PEE-hah

tokens.translation: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, And let them consider the mercies of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: mee khah-KHAHM ve-yeesh-mohr EH-leh ve-yeet-boh-ne-NOO khah-se-DEY ah-doh-NAI

title: Psalm 108
sefariaRef: Psalms 108
useCase: Praise and communal hope Themes: gratitude, community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Song, a Psalm of David.

tokens.hebrew: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה אַף־כְּבוֹדִי׃
tokens.translation: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
tokens.transliteration: nah-KHOHN lee-BEE eh-loh-HEEM ah-SHEE-rah vah-ah-zah-me-RAH ahf ke-voh-DEE

tokens.translation: Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
tokens.transliteration: oh-de-KHAH vah-ah-MEEM ah-doh-NAI vah-ah-zah-mehr-KHAH bahl oo-MEEM

tokens.translation: For Thy mercy is great above the heavens, And Thy truth reacheth unto the skies.
tokens.transliteration: kee gah-DOHL meh-ahl shah-MAH-yeem khahs-DEH-khah ve-ahd she-khah-KEEM ah-mee-TEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים וְעַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
tokens.translation: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; And Thy glory be above all the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ROO-mah ahl shah-MAH-yeem eh-loh-HEEM ve-AHL kohl hah-AH-rehts ke-voh-DEH-khah

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.
tokens.transliteration: le-mah-AHN yeh-khah-le-TSOON ye-dee-DEY-khah hoh-SHEE-ah ye-mee-ne-KHAH vah-ah-NEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
tokens.translation: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEEM dee-BEHR be-kohd-SHOH eh-LOH-zah ah-khah-le-KAH she-KHEHM ve-EH-mehk soo-KOHT ah-mah-DEHD

tokens.hebrew: לִי גִלְעָד לִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
tokens.translation: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.
tokens.transliteration: LEE geel-AHD LEE me-nah-SHEH ve-ehf-rah-YEEM mah-OHZ roh-SHEE ye-hoo-DAH me-khoh-ke-KEE

tokens.hebrew: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עֲלֵי־פְלֶשֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָע׃
tokens.translation: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Over Philistia do I cry aloud.
tokens.transliteration: moh-AHV SEER rahkh-TSEE ahl eh-DOHM ahsh-LEEKH nah-ah-LEE ah-ley fe-LEH-sheht eht-roh-AH

tokens.hebrew: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מִבְצָר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
tokens.translation: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
tokens.transliteration: MEE yoh-vee-leh-NEE EER meev-TSAHR MEE nah-KHAH-nee ahd eh-DOHM

tokens.translation: Hast not Thou cast us off, O God? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts?
tokens.transliteration: hah-loh eh-loh-HEEM ze-nahkh-TAH-noo ve-loh teh-TSEH eh-loh-HEEM be-tseev-oh-TEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
tokens.transliteration: hah-vah LAH-noo ehz-RAHT mee-TSAHR ve-SHAHV te-shoo-AHT ah-DAHM

tokens.translation: Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.
tokens.transliteration: beh-loh-HEEM nah-ah-seh KHAH-yeel ve-HOO yah-VOOS tsah-REY-noo

title: Psalm 109
sefariaRef: Psalms 109
summary: Accusation and a plea for vindication
useCase: Accusation and a plea for vindication Themes: justice, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ׃
tokens.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, keep not silence;
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-tseh-AHKH le-dah-VEED meez-MOHR eh-loh-HEY te-hee-lah-TEE ahl teh-kheh-RAHSH

tokens.hebrew: כִּי פִי רָשָׁע וּפִי־מִרְמָה עָלַי פָּתָחוּ דִּבְּרוּ אִתִּי לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃
tokens.translation: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me; They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.
tokens.transliteration: KEE FEE rah-SHAH oo-fee meer-MAH ah-LAHY pah-TAH-khoo dee-be-ROO ee-TEE le-SHOHN SHAH-kehr

tokens.translation: They compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.
In return for my love they are my adversaries; But I am all prayer.

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלַי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה וְשִׂנְאָה תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִי׃
tokens.translation: And they have laid upon me evil for good, And hatred for my love:
tokens.transliteration: vah-yah-SEE-moo ah-LAHY rah-AH TAH-khaht toh-VAH ve-seen-AH TAH-khaht ah-hah-vah-TEE

tokens.hebrew: הַפְקֵד עָלָיו רָשָׁע וְשָׂטָן יַעֲמֹד עַל־יְמִינוֹ׃
tokens.translation: ’Set Thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.
tokens.transliteration: hahf-KEHD ah-LAHV rah-SHAH ve-sah-TAHN yah-ah-MOHD ahl ye-mee-NOH

tokens.hebrew: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ יֵצֵא רָשָׁע וּתְפִלָּתוֹ תִּהְיֶה לַחֲטָאָה׃
tokens.translation: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned; And let his prayer be turned into sin.
tokens.transliteration: be-hee-SHAH-fe-TOH yeh-TSEH rah-SHAH oo-te-fee-lah-TOH teeh-YEH lah-khah-tah-AH

tokens.translation: Let his days be few; Let another take his charge.
tokens.transliteration: yee-he-yoo yah-MAHV me-ah-TEEM pe-koo-dah-TOH yee-KAHKH ah-KHEHR

tokens.translation: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

tokens.hebrew: וְנוֹעַ יָנוּעוּ בָנָיו וְשִׁאֵלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶם׃
tokens.translation: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.
tokens.transliteration: ve-NOH-ah yah-NOO-oo vah-NAHV ve-shee-EH-loo ve-dah-re-SHOO meh-khohr-voh-tey-HEHM

tokens.hebrew: יְנַקֵּשׁ נוֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְיָבֹזּוּ זָרִים יְגִיעוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Let the creditor distrain all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labour.
tokens.transliteration: ye-nah-KEHSH noh-SHEH le-khohl ah-shehr LOH ve-yah-VOH-zoo zah-REEM ye-gee-OH

tokens.hebrew: אַל־יְהִי־לוֹ מֹשֵׁךְ חָסֶד וְאַל־יְהִי חוֹנֵן לִיתוֹמָיו׃
tokens.translation: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to be gracious unto his fatherless children.
tokens.transliteration: ahl ye-hee LOH moh-SHEHKH KHAH-sehd ve-ahl ye-HEE khoh-NEHN lee-toh-MAHV

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי־אַחֲרִיתוֹ לְהַכְרִית בְּדוֹר אַחֵר יִמַּח שְׁמָם׃
tokens.translation: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee ah-khah-ree-TOH le-hahkh-REET be-DOHR ah-KHEHR yee-MAHKH she-MAHM

tokens.hebrew: יִזָּכֵר עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָה וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ אַל־תִּמָּח׃
tokens.translation: Let the iniquity of his fathers be brought to remembrance unto the LORD; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
tokens.transliteration: yee-zah-KHEHR ah-VOHN ah-voh-TAHV ehl ah-doh-NAI ve-khah-TAHT ee-MOH ahl tee-MAHKH

tokens.hebrew: יִהְיוּ נֶגֶד־יְהוָה תָּמִיד וְיַכְרֵת מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
tokens.translation: Let them be before the LORD continually, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
tokens.transliteration: yeeh-YOO neh-gehd ah-doh-NAI tah-MEED ve-yahkh-REHT meh-EH-rehts zeekh-RAHM

tokens.hebrew: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא זָכַר עֲשׂוֹת חָסֶד וַיִּרְדֹּף אִישׁ־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵה לֵבָב לְמוֹתֵת׃
tokens.translation: Because that he remembered not to do kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart he was ready to slay.
tokens.transliteration: YAH-ahn ah-SHEHR LOH zah-KHAHR ah-SOHT KHAH-sehd vah-yeer-DOHF eesh ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN ve-neekh-EH leh-VAHV le-moh-TEHT

tokens.hebrew: וַיֶּאֱהַב קְלָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵהוּ וְלֹא־חָפֵץ בִּבְרָכָה וַתִּרְחַק מִמֶּנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it is far from him.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeh-eh-HAHV ke-lah-LAH vah-te-voh-EH-hoo ve-loh khah-FEHTS beev-rah-KHAH vah-teer-KHAHK mee-MEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְּמַדּוֹ וַתָּבֹא כַמַּיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְכַשֶּׁמֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו׃
tokens.translation: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his raiment, And it is come into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeel-BAHSH ke-lah-LAH ke-mah-DOH vah-tah-VOH khah-MAH-yeem be-keer-BOH ve-khah-SHEH-mehn be-ahts-moh-TAHV

tokens.hebrew: תְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבֶגֶד יַעְטֶה וּלְמֵזַח תָּמִיד יַחְגְּרֶהָ׃
tokens.translation: Let it be unto him as the garment which he putteth on, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.'
tokens.transliteration: te-hee LOH ke-VEH-gehd yah-TEH oo-le-MEH-zahkh tah-MEED yahkh-ge-REH-hah

tokens.hebrew: זֹאת פְּעֻלַּת שֹׂטְנַי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְהַדֹּבְרִים רָע עַל־נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: This would mine adversaries effect from the LORD, And they that speak evil against my soul.
tokens.transliteration: ZOHT pe-oo-LAHT soh-te-NAHY meh-EHT ah-doh-NAI ve-hah-doh-ve-REEM RAH ahl nahf-SHEE

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה יְהוִה אֲדֹנָי עֲ‍שֵׂה־אִתִּי לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃
tokens.translation: But Thou, O GOD the Lord, deal with me for Thy name's sake; Because Thy mercy is good, deliver Thou me.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH eh-loh-HEEM ah-doh-NAHY ah-seh ee-TEE le-MAH-ahn she-MEH-khah kee TOHV khahs-de-KHAH hah-tsee-LEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנֹכִי וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי׃
tokens.translation: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-NEE ve-ehv-YOHN ah-NOH-khee ve-lee-BEE khah-LAHL be-keer-BEE

tokens.translation: I am gone like the shadow when it lengtheneth; I am shaken off as the locust.

tokens.hebrew: בִּרְכַּי כָּשְׁלוּ מִצּוֹם וּבְשָׂרִי כָּחַשׁ מִשָּׁמֶן׃
tokens.translation: My knees totter through fasting; And my flesh is lean, and hath no fatness.
tokens.transliteration: beer-KAHY kah-she-LOO mee-TSOHM oo-ve-sah-REE kah-KHAHSH mee-SHAH-mehn

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה לָהֶם יִרְאוּנִי יְנִיעוּן רֹאשָׁם׃
tokens.translation: I am become also a taunt unto them; When they see me, they shake their head.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NEE hah-YEE-tee khehr-PAH lah-HEHM yeer-OO-nee ye-nee-OON roh-SHAHM

tokens.translation: Help me, O LORD my God; O save me according to Thy mercy;

tokens.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָדְךָ זֹּאת אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲשִׂיתָהּ׃
tokens.translation: That they may know that this is Thy hand; That Thou, LORD, hast done it.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeh-de-OO kee YAH-de-khah ZOHT ah-TAH ah-doh-NAI ah-see-TAHH

tokens.hebrew: יְקַלְלוּ־הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָח׃
tokens.translation: Let them curse, but bless Thou; When they arise, they shall be put to shame, but Thy servant shall rejoice.
tokens.transliteration: ye-kah-le-loo heh-MAH ve-ah-TAH te-vah-REHKH KAH-moo vah-yeh-VOH-shoo ve-ahv-de-KHAH yees-MAHKH

tokens.hebrew: יִלְבְּשׁוּ שׂוֹטְנַי כְּלִמָּה וְיַעֲטוּ כַמְעִיל בָּשְׁתָּם׃
tokens.translation: Mine adversaries shall be clothed with confusion, And shall put on their own shame as a robe.
tokens.transliteration: yeel-be-SHOO soh-te-NAHY ke-lee-MAH ve-yah-ah-TOO khahm-EEL bohsh-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּפִי וּבְתוֹךְ רַבִּים אֲהַלְלֶנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: I will give great thanks unto the LORD with my mouth; Yea, I will praise Him among the multitude;
tokens.transliteration: oh-DEH ah-doh-NAI me-OHD be-FEE oo-ve-TOHKH rah-BEEM ahhah-le-LEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשׁוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Because He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.
tokens.transliteration: kee yah-ah-MOHD lee-MEEN ehv-YOHN le-hoh-SHEE-ah mee-shoh-fe-TEY nahf-SHOH

title: Psalm 110
sefariaRef: Psalms 110
useCase: Kingship and victory Themes: community. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר נְאֻם יְהוָה לַאדֹנִי שֵׁב לִימִינִי עַד־אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: A Psalm of David. The LORD saith unto my lord: ‘Sit thou at My right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.'
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-VEED meez-MOHR ne-OOM ah-doh-NAI lah-doh-NEE SHEHV lee-mee-NEE ahd ah-SHEET oh-ye-VEY-khah hah-DOHM le-rahg-LEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: מַטֵּה־עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן רְדֵה בְּקֶרֶב אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: The rod of Thy strength the LORD will send out of Zion: 'Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.'
tokens.transliteration: mah-teh oo-ze-KHAH yeesh-LAHKH ah-doh-NAI mee-tsee-YOHN re-DEH be-KEH-rehv oh-ye-VEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: עַמְּךָ נְדָבֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ בְּהַדְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר לְךָ טַל יַלְדֻתֶיךָ׃
tokens.translation: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy warfare; in adornments of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, Thine is the dew of thy youth.
tokens.transliteration: ah-me-KHAH ne-dah-VOHT be-YOHM khey-LEH-khah be-hahd-rey koh-DEHSH meh-REH-khehm meesh-KHAHR le-KHAH TAHL yahl-doo-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם אַתָּה־כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל־דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק׃
tokens.translation: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent: 'Thou art a priest for ever After the manner of Melchizedek.'

title: Psalm 111
sefariaRef: Psalms 111
summary: Praise for divine works and wisdom
useCase: Praise for divine works and wisdom Themes: gratitude, wisdom. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָה׃

tokens.transliteration: HAH-le-loo YAHH oh-DEH ah-doh-NAI be-khohl leh-VAHV be-SOHD ye-shah-REEM ve-eh-DAH

tokens.translation: The works of the LORD are great, Sought out of all them that have delight therein.
tokens.transliteration: ge-doh-LEEM mah-ah-SEY ah-doh-NAI de-roo-SHEEM le-khohl khehf-tsey-HEHM

tokens.translation: His work is glory and majesty; And His righteousness endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: hohd ve-hah-DAHR poh-oh-LOH ve-tseed-kah-TOH oh-MEH-deht lah-AHD

tokens.hebrew: זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה׃

tokens.hebrew: טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He hath given food unto them that fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.
tokens.transliteration: teh-REHF nah-TAHN lee-reh-AHV yeez-KOHR le-oh-LAHM be-ree-TOH

tokens.hebrew: כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִם׃
tokens.translation: He hath declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.
tokens.transliteration: KOH-ahkh mah-ah-SAHV hee-GEED le-ah-MOH lah-TEHT lah-HEHM nah-khah-LAHT goh-YEEM

tokens.hebrew: מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָיו׃
tokens.translation: The works of His hands are truth and justice; All His precepts are sure.
tokens.transliteration: mah-ah-SEY yah-DAHV eh-MEHT oo-meesh-PAHT neh-eh-mah-NEEM kohl pee-koo-DAHV

tokens.hebrew: סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִם בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָׁר׃
tokens.translation: They are established for ever and ever, They are done in truth and uprightness.
tokens.transliteration: se-moo-KHEEM lah-AHD le-oh-LAHM ah-soo-YEEM beh-eh-MEHT ve-yah-SHAHR

tokens.hebrew: פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּה־לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ׃
tokens.translation: He hath sent redemption unto His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever; Holy and awful is His name.
tokens.transliteration: pe-DOOT shah-LAHKH le-ah-MOH tsee-vah le-oh-LAHM be-ree-TOH kah-DOHSH ve-noh-RAH she-MOH

tokens.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
tokens.translation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: reh-SHEET khohkh-MAH yeer-AHT ah-doh-NAI SEH-khehl TOHV le-khohl oh-sey-HEHM te-hee-lah-TOH oh-MEH-deht lah-AHD

title: Psalm 112

useCase: Generosity, integrity, and steadiness Themes: provision, justice. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אַשְׁרֵי־אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה בְּמִצְוֺתָיו חָפֵץ מְאֹד׃

tokens.hebrew: גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה זַרְעוֹ דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים יְבֹרָךְ׃

tokens.transliteration: gee-BOHR bah-ah-REHTS yeeh-YEH zahr-OH DOHR ye-shah-REEM ye-voh-RAHKH

tokens.translation: Wealth and riches are in his house; And his merit endureth for ever.
tokens.transliteration: hohn vah-OH-shehr be-vey-TOH ve-tseed-kah-TOH oh-MEH-deht lah-AHD

tokens.hebrew: זָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר לַיְשָׁרִים חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם וְצַדִּיק׃
tokens.translation: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, Gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
tokens.transliteration: zah-RAHKH bah-KHOH-shehkh OHR lahy-shah-REEM khah-NOON ve-rah-KHOOM ve-tsah-DEEK

tokens.hebrew: טוֹב־אִישׁ חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה יְכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּט׃
tokens.translation: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, That ordereth his affairs rightfully.
tokens.transliteration: tohv EESH khoh-NEHN oo-mahl-VEH ye-khahl-KEHL de-vah-RAHV be-meesh-PAHT

tokens.hebrew: כִּי־לְעוֹלָם לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְזֵכֶר עוֹלָם יִהְיֶה צַדִּיק׃
tokens.translation: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.
tokens.transliteration: kee le-oh-LAHM loh yee-MOHT le-ZEH-khehr oh-LAHM yeeh-YEH tsah-DEEK

tokens.hebrew: מִשְּׁמוּעָה רָעָה לֹא יִירָא נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטֻחַ בַּיהוָה׃

tokens.transliteration: mee-she-moo-AH rah-AH LOH yee-RAH nah-KHOHN lee-BOH bah-TOO-ahkh bah-ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: סָמוּךְ לִבּוֹ לֹא יִירָא עַד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶה בְצָרָיו׃

tokens.transliteration: sah-MOOKH lee-BOH LOH yee-RAH AHD ah-shehr yeer-EH ve-tsah-RAHV

tokens.hebrew: פִּזַּר נָתַן לָאֶבְיוֹנִים צִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד קַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בְּכָבוֹד׃
tokens.translation: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever; His horn shall be exalted in honour.
tokens.transliteration: pee-ZAHR nah-TAHN lah-ehv-yoh-NEEM tseed-kah-TOH oh-MEH-deht lah-AHD kahr-NOH tah-ROOM be-khah-VOHD

tokens.hebrew: רָשָׁע יִרְאֶה וְכָעָס שִׁנָּיו יַחֲרֹק וְנָמָס תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
tokens.translation: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.

title: Psalm 115

summary: Trust and blessing for the community
useCase: Trust and blessing for the community Themes: community, hope. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא לָנוּ יְהוָה לֹא לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ׃

tokens.hebrew: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃

tokens.hebrew: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן׃

tokens.hebrew: יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם׃
tokens.translation: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they with their throat. .

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃

tokens.hebrew: יְהוָה זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן׃
tokens.translation: The LORD hath been mindful of us, He will bless— He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ze-khah-RAH-noo ye-vah-REHKH ye-vah-REHKH eht BEYT yees-rah-EHL ye-vah-REHKH eht BEYT ah-hah-ROHN

tokens.translation: He will bless them that fear the LORD, Both small and great.
tokens.transliteration: ye-vah-REHKH yeer-EY ah-doh-NAI hah-ke-tah-NEEM eem hah-ge-doh-LEEM

tokens.translation: The LORD increase you more and more, You and your children.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-SEHF ah-doh-NAI ah-ley-KHEHM ah-ley-KHEHM ve-ahl be-ney-KHEHM

tokens.hebrew: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
tokens.translation: Blessed be ye of the LORD Who made heaven and earth.
tokens.transliteration: be-roo-KHEEM ah-TEHM lah-ah-doh-NAI oh-SEH shah-MAH-yeem vah-AH-rehts

tokens.hebrew: הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַיהוָה וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם׃
tokens.translation: The heavens are the heavens of the LORD; But the earth hath He given to the children of men.
tokens.transliteration: hah-shah-MAH-yeem shah-mah-YEEM lah-ah-doh-NAI ve-hah-AH-rehts nah-TAHN leev-ney ah-DAHM

tokens.hebrew: לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה׃
tokens.translation: The dead praise not the LORD, Neither any that go down into silence;
tokens.transliteration: LOH hah-meh-TEEM ye-hah-le-loo YAHH ve-LOH kohl yoh-re-DEY doo-MAH

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: But we will bless the LORD From this time forth and for ever. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-NAHKH-noo ne-vah-REHKH YAHH meh-ah-TAH ve-ahd oh-LAHM hah-le-loo YAHH

title: Psalm 116
sefariaRef: Psalms 116
useCase: Deliverance, gratitude, and vows Themes: gratitude, health. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: I love that the LORD should hear my voice and my supplications.
tokens.transliteration: ah-hahv-TEE kee yeesh-MAH ah-doh-NAI eht koh-LEE tah-khah-noo-NAHY

tokens.translation: Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon Him all my days.
tokens.transliteration: kee hee-TAH ohz-NOH LEE oo-ve-yah-MAHY ehk-RAH

tokens.hebrew: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא׃
tokens.translation: The cords of death compassed me, And the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.
tokens.transliteration: ah-fah-FOO-nee khehv-ley MAH-veht oo-me-tsah-REY she-OHL me-tsah-OO-nee tsah-RAH ve-yah-GOHN ehm-TSAH

tokens.hebrew: וּבְשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְהוָה מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי׃
tokens.translation: But I called upon the name of the LORD: 'I beseech thee, O LORD, deliver my soul.'
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-shehm ah-doh-NAI ehk-RAH ah-NAH ah-doh-NAI mah-le-TAH nahf-SHEE

tokens.translation: Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yea, our God is compassionate.

tokens.hebrew: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְהֹוָה דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-MEHR pe-tah-YEEM ah-doh-NAI dah-loh-TEE ve-LEE ye-hoh-SHEE-ah

tokens.hebrew: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּי־יְהוָה גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי׃
tokens.translation: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; For the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
tokens.transliteration: shoo-VEE nahf-SHEE leem-noo-KHAH-ye-khee kee ah-doh-NAI gah-MAHL ah-LAH-ye-khee

tokens.hebrew: כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּחִי׃
tokens.translation: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from stumbling.
tokens.transliteration: KEE khee-LAHTS-tah nahf-SHEE mee-MAH-veht eht ey-NEE meen deem-AH eht rahg-LEE mee-DEH-khee

tokens.translation: I shall walk before the LORD In the lands of the living.

tokens.hebrew: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד׃
tokens.translation: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'
tokens.transliteration: heh-eh-mahn-TEE KEE ah-dah-BEHR ah-NEE ah-NEE-tee me-OHD

tokens.translation: I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'
tokens.transliteration: ah-NEE ah-MAHR-tee ve-khah-fe-ZEE kahl hah-ah-DAHM koh-ZEHV

tokens.translation: How can I repay unto the LORD All His bountiful dealings toward me?
tokens.transliteration: mah ah-SHEEV lah-ah-doh-NAI kahl tahg-moo-LOH-hee ah-LAHY

tokens.translation: I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: kohs ye-shoo-OHT eh-SAH oo-ve-SHEHM ah-doh-NAI ehk-RAH

tokens.translation: My vows will I pay unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people.
tokens.transliteration: ne-dah-RAHY lah-ah-doh-NAI ah-shah-LEHM nehg-dah NAH le-khohl ah-MOH

tokens.translation: Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His saints.

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּה יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲ‍נִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי׃
tokens.translation: I beseech Thee, O LORD, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NAH ah-doh-NAI kee ah-NEE ahv-DEH-khah ah-nee ahv-de-KHAH behn ah-mah-TEH-khah pee-TAHKH-tah le-moh-seh-RAHY

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃
tokens.translation: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ehz-BAHKH ZEH-vahkh toh-DAH oo-ve-SHEHM ah-doh-NAI ehk-RAH

tokens.translation: I will pay my vows unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people;
tokens.transliteration: ne-dah-RAHY lah-ah-doh-NAI ah-shah-LEHM nehg-dah NAH le-khohl ah-MOH

tokens.hebrew: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה בְּתוֹכֵכִי יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: In the courts of the LORD’S house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: be-khahts-ROHT BEYT ah-doh-NAI be-toh-KHEH-khee ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem hah-le-loo YAHH

title: Psalm 117

tokens.translation: O praise the LORD, all ye nations; Laud Him, all ye peoples.
tokens.transliteration: hah-le-LOO eht ah-doh-NAI kohl goh-YEEM shah-be-KHOO-hoo kohl hah-oo-MEEM

tokens.hebrew: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
tokens.translation: For His mercy is great toward us; And the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Hallelujah.
tokens.transliteration: KEE gah-VAHR ah-LEY-noo khahs-DOH veh-eh-meht ah-doh-NAI le-oh-LAHM hah-le-loo YAHH
