summary: Second Blessing after Shema · Siddur Ashkenaz
useCase: Second Blessing after Shema · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַשְׁכִּיבֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ לְשָׁלוֹם וְהַעֲמִידֵֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ לְחַיִּים וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵֽינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ וְתַקְּ֒נֵֽנוּ בְּעֵצָה טוֹבָה מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ וְהָגֵן בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ וְהָסֵר מֵעָלֵֽינוּ אוֹיֵב דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב וְיָגוֹן וְהָסֵר שָׂטָן מִלְּ֒פָנֵֽינוּ וּמֵאַחֲרֵֽינוּ וּבְצֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵל שׁוֹמְ֒רֵֽנוּ וּמַצִּילֵֽנוּ אָֽתָּה כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה וּשְׁמוֹר צֵאתֵֽנוּ וּבוֹאֵֽנוּ לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם: וּפְרוֹשׂ עָלֵֽינוּ סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמֶךָ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַפּוֹרֵשׂ סֻכַּת שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל יְרוּשָׁלָֽיִם:
tokens.translation: Adonoy our God; make us lie down in peace, our King, raise us again to life Spread over us the shelter of Your peace, and direct us to better ourselves through Your good counsel; and deliver us for Your Name’s sake. Shield us, and remove from us enemies, pestilence, sword, famine and sorrow. Remove the adversary from before us and from behind us, and shelter us in the shadow of Your wings. For, Almighty, You are our Protector and Rescuer, For, Almighty You are a gracious and merciful King. Guard our going out and our coming in for life and peace for now forever. And spread over us the shelter of Your peace. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who spreads the shelter of peace over us and over all His people, Israel and over Jerusalem.

sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Half Kaddish
useCase: Half Kaddish · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא (אָמֵן) בְּעָלְ֒מָֽא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵֽלָּא מִן־כָּל־ (בעשי"ת לְעֵֽלָּא לְעֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) בִּרְכָתָֽא וְשִׁירָתָֽא תֻּשְׁבְּ֒חָתָֽא וְנֶחָמָתָֽא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָֽא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom. In your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein. May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He; above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.

title: Sanctity of the Day
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Sanctity of the Day
summary: Sanctity of the Day · Siddur Ashkenaz
useCase: Sanctity of the Day · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה קִדַּֽשְׁתָּ אֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי לִשְׁמֶךָ. תַּכְלִית מַעֲשֵׂה שָׁמַֽיִם וָאָֽרֶץ. וּבֵרַכְתּוֹ מִכָּל הַיָּמִים. וְקִדַּשְׁתּוֹ מִכָּל הַזְּ֒מַנִּים וְכֵן כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: You have sanctified the seventh day to Your Name, [it was] the purpose of making heaven and earth; and You blessed it above all days and You sanctified it above all seasons. And so it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah kee-dah-she-tah eht yohm hah-SHE-vee-ee leesh-meh-khah. tahkh-leet mah-ah-seh shah-mah-yeem vah-ah-rehts. oo-veh-rahkh-toh mee-kohl hah-yah-meem. ve-kee-dahsh-toh mee-kohl hah-ZE-mah-neem ve-khehn kah-toov be-toh-rah-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְהָאָֽרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה. וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה: וַיְבָֽרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ. כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: And the heavens and the earth were completed and [so were] all their hosts. And God completed by the seventh day His work which He had done, and He abstained on the seventh day, from all His work which He had done. And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it for on it He abstained from all His work which God had created to do.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-khoo-loo hah-shah-mah-yeem ve-hah-ah-rehts ve-khohl tse-vah-ahm: vah-ye-khahl eh-loh-heem bah-yohm hah-SHE-vee-ee me-lahkh-toh ah-shehr ah-sah. vah-yeesh-boht bah-yohm hah-SHE-vee-ee mee-kohl me-lahkh-toh ah-shehr ah-sah: vah-ye-vah-rehkh eh-loh-heem eht yohm hah-SHE-vee-ee vah-ye-kah-dehsh oh-toh. kee voh shah-vaht mee-kohl me-lahkh-toh ah-shehr bah-rah eh-loh-heem lah-ah-soht:

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ. קַדְּ֒שֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ שַׂבְּ֒עֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ. וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ. וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּ֒ךָ בֶּאֱמֶת. וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. וְיָנֽוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּ֒שֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת:
tokens.translation: Our God, and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest, sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden us with Your deliverance, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth. And give us as our inheritance, Adonoy our God, in love and in pleasure Your holy Shabbos; and may Israel rest thereon— the sanctifiers of Your Name. Blessed are You Adonoy, Sanctifier of Shabbos.

title: Temple Service

tokens.hebrew: רְצֵה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּעַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל וּבִתְפִלָּתָם וְהָשֵׁב אֶת הָעֲבוֹדָה לִדְבִיר בֵּיתֶֽךָ וְאִשֵּׁי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּתְפִלָּתָם בְּאַהֲבָה תְקַבֵּל בְּרָצוֹן וּתְהִי לְרָצוֹן תָּמִיד עֲבוֹדַת יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Be pleased, Adonoy, our God, with Your people, Israel, and their prayer; and restore the service to the Holy of Holies in Your abode, and the fire-offerings of Israel; and accept their prayer, lovingly and willingly. And may You always find pleasure with the service of Your people, Israel.

tokens.hebrew: בראש חדש ובחול המועד אומרים זה: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא וְיַגִּֽיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וּפִקְדוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ. וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ. וְזִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִיר קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל עַמְּ֒ךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶֽיךָ. לִפְלֵיטָה לְטוֹבָה לְחֵן וּלְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים לְחַיִּים וּלְשָׁלוֹם. בְּיוֹם לר"ח: רֹאשׁ הַחֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה: לפסח: חַג הַמַּצּוֹת הַזֶּה: לסכות: חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת הַזֶּה: זָכְרֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה. וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה. וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים. וּבִדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ. כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה:
tokens.translation: On regular weekdays continue, “And may our eyes”. On Rosh Chodesh and on Chol HaMoed, the following prayer is added: Our God and God of our fathers, may there ascend, come, and reach, appear, be desired, and heard, counted and recalled our remembrance and reckoning; the remembrance of our fathers; the remembrance of the Messiah the son of David, Your servant; the remembrance of Jerusalem, city of Your Sanctuary and the remembrance of Your entire people, the House of Israel, before You for survival, for well-being, for favor, kindliness, compassion, for life and peace on this day of the: Rosh Chodesh/Festival of Matzos/Festival of Sukkos. Remember us Adonoy, our God, on this day for well-being; be mindful of us on this day for blessing, and deliver us for life. In accord with the promise of deliverance and compassion, spare us and favor us, have compassion on us and deliver us; for our eyes are directed to You, because You are the Almighty Who is King, Gracious, and Merciful.

title: Peace
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Peace
useCase: Peace · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: peace, shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם רָב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמְּ֒ךָ תָּשִׂים לְעוֹלָם כִּי אַתָּה הוּא מֶֽלֶךְ אָדוֹן לְכָל־הַשָּׁלוֹם וְטוֹב בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ לְבָרֵךְ אֶת־עַמְּ֒ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּכָל־עֵת וּבְכָל־שָׁעָה בִּשְׁלוֹמֶֽךָ.
tokens.translation: Bestow abundant peace upon Israel, Your people, forever. For You are King, the Master of all peace. And may it be good in Your sight to bless us and to bless Your people Israel, at all times and at every moment with Your peace.

tokens.translation: During the Ten Days of Penitence continue here: May we be remembered and inscribed before You in the book of life, blessing, peace and abundant maintenance; we and all Your people, the House of Israel, for a good life and peace.

title: Concluding Passage
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Amidah, Concluding Passage
useCase: Concluding Passage · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְ֒רֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:
tokens.translation: May the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be acceptable before You, Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.
tokens.transliteration: yeeh-yoo le-rah-tsohn EEM-rey fee ve-hehg-yohn lee-bee le-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI tsoo-ree ve-goh-ah-lee:

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי נְצוֹר לְשׁוֹנִי מֵרָע וּשְׂפָתַי מִדַּבֵּר מִרְמָה. וְלִמְקַלְלַי נַפְשִׁי תִדּוֹם וְנַפְשִׁי כֶּעָפָר לַכֹּל תִּהְיֶה. פְּתַח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ וּבְמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ תִּרְדֹּף נַפְשִׁי. וְכֹל הַחוֹשְׁבִים עָלַי רָעָה מְהֵרָה הָפֵר עֲצָתָם וְקַלְקֵל מַחֲשַׁבְתָּם: עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן יְמִינֶֽךָ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ. לְמַֽעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶֽיךָ הוֹשִֽׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵֽנִי: יִהְיוּ לְרָצוֹן אִמְרֵי פִי וְהֶגְיוֹן לִבִּי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה צוּרִי וְגוֹאֲלִי:
tokens.translation: My God, guard my tongue from evil and my lips from speaking deceitfully. May my soul be unresponsive to those who curse me; and let my soul be like dust to all. Open my heart to Your Torah and let my soul pursue Your commandments. And all who plan evil against me, quickly annul their counsel and frustrate their intention. Act for the sake of Your right hand. Act for the sake of Your holiness. Act for the sake of Your Torah. In order that Your loved ones be released, deliver [with] Your right hand and answer me. May the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be acceptable before You Adonoy, my Rock and my Redeemer.

tokens.hebrew: עֹשֶׂה (בעשי"ת הַשָּׁלוֹם) שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: He Who makes peace in His high heavens may He make peace upon us and upon all Israel and say Amein.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁיִּבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בִּמְהֵרָה בְיָמֵֽינוּ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ: וְשָׁם נַעֲבָדְ֒ךָ בְּיִרְאָה כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת: וְעָרְ֒בָה לַיהוָֹה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָֽםִ כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמוֹנִיּוֹת:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God, and the God of our Fathers that the Holy Temple be rebuilt speedily in our days, and grant us our share in Your Torah. And there we will serve You reverently as in the days of old, and in earlier years. And let Adonoy be pleased with the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem as in the days of old and in earlier years.

title: Vay'chulu
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Vay'chulu
useCase: Vay'chulu · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: After the Shemoneh Esrei has been said, the entire congregation repeats וַיְכֻלּוּ, in testimony of our belief that God created heaven and earth. According to Halacha, when one is a witness, he must stand and declare his testimony aloud.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַֽיִם וְהָאָֽרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם: וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה. וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה: וַיְבָֽרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁ֒בִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ. כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר־בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: And the heavens and the earth were completed and [so were] all their hosts. And God completed by the seventh day His work which He had done, and He abstained on the seventh day, from all His work which He had done. And God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it for on it He abstained from all His work which God had created to do.

title: Me'ein Sheva
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Me'ein Sheva
useCase: Me'ein Sheva · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אין החזן מחזיר התפלה עצמה אבל חוזר מעין שבע משום י"ט שחל בשבת שא"א בו ויכולו. גם להוציא שאינו בקי. וצריך לאומרו בעמידה כעדות.
tokens.translation: The following prayer, בְּרָכָה מֵעֵין שֶׁבַע the abridged form of the seven blessings of the Maariv Shemoneh Esrei, is said only by the Chazzan. This prayer is not said if the first night of Passover occurs on Friday night. It is also not recited when prayers are held in the house of a bridegroom or in the house of a mourner. It is to be said only in a place that has been designated as a permanent place of prayer.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ אֱלֹהֵי אַבְרָהָם אֱלֹהֵי יִצְחָק וֵאלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא. אֵל עֶלְיוֹן קוֹנֵה שָׁמַֽיִם וָאָֽרֶץ:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God and God of our fathers, God of Abraham, God of Isaac, and God of Jacob; the Almighty, the Great, the Powerful, the Awesome, the most high Almighty, Possessor of heaven and earth.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo eh-loh-hey ahv-rah-hahm eh-loh-hey yeets-khahk veh-loh-hey yah-ah-kohv hah-ehl hah-gah-dohl hah-gee-bohr ve-hah-noh-rah. ehl ehl-yohn koh-neh shah-mah-yeem vah-ah-rehts:

tokens.hebrew: מעין ז' יאמרו הקהל בלי פתיחה וחתימה. וכן היחיד אומרו.
tokens.translation: The congregation may recite the following paragraph, which should then be repeated aloud and in its entirety by the Chazzan.

tokens.hebrew: מָגֵן אָבוֹת בִּדְבָרוֹ. מְחַיֵּה מֵתִים בְּמַאֲמָרוֹ. הָאֵל הַקָּדוֹשׁ (הַמֶּלֶךְ הַקָּדוֹשׁ) שֶׁאֵין כָּמֽוֹהוּ. הַמֵּנִֽיחַ לְעַמּוֹ בְּיוֹם שַׁבַּת קָדְשׁוֹ. כִּי בָם רָצָה לְהָנִֽיחַ לָהֶם. לְפָנָיו נַעֲבוֹד בְּיִרְאָה וָפַֽחַד. וְנוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ בְּכָל יוֹם תָּמִיד מֵעֵין הַבְּ֒רָכוֹת: אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת. אֲדוֹן הַשָּׁלוֹם. מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת וּמְבָרֵךְ שְׁבִיעִי. וּמֵנִֽיחַ בִּקְדֻשָּׁה לְעַם מְדֻשְּׁ֒נֵי עֹֽנֶג זֵֽכֶר לְמַעֲשֵׂה בְרֵאשִׁית:
tokens.translation: Shield of [our] fathers with His word, Resurrector of the dead with His utterance; the Almighty, the Holy One (Between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur, substitute:) the King, the Holy One) Who has no peer. He gives rest to His people on the day of His holy Shabbos for with them He was pleased to grant them rest. Before Him we will serve with fear and trepidation, and give thanks to His Name every day continuously, from the essence of the blessings. Almighty of thanksgiving, Master of peace, Sanctifier of the Shabbos, Who blesses the seventh day and grants rest in sanctity to a people sated with delight— in commemoration of the work of creation.
tokens.transliteration: mah-gehn ah-voht beed-vah-roh. me-khah-yeh meh-teem be-mah-ah-mah-roh. hah-ehl hah-kah-dohsh (hah-meh-lehkh hah-kah-dohsh) sheh-eyn kah-moh-hoo. hah-meh-nee-ahkh le-ah-moh be-yohm shah-baht kohd-shoh. kee vahm rah-tsah le-hah-nee-ahkh lah-hehm. le-fah-nahv nah-ah-vohd be-yeer-ah vah-fah-khahd. ve-noh-deh leesh-moh be-khohl yohm tah-meed meh-eyn hah-BE-rah-khoht: ehl hah-hoh-dah-oht. ah-dohn hah-shah-lohm. me-kah-dehsh hah-shah-baht oo-me-vah-rehkh she-vee-ee. oo-meh-nee-ahkh beek-doo-shah le-ahm me-doo-SHE-ney oh-nehg zeh-khehr le-mah-ah-seh ve-reh-sheet:

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ רְצֵה בִמְנוּחָתֵֽנוּ. קַדְּ֒שֵֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וְתֵן חֶלְקֵֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ שַׂבְּ֒עֵֽנוּ מִטּוּבֶֽךָ. וְשַׂמְּחֵנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ. וְטַהֵר לִבֵּֽנוּ לְעָבְדְּ֒ךָ בֶּאֱמֶת. וְהַנְחִילֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן שַׁבַּת קָדְשֶֽׁךָ. וְיָנֽוּחוּ בָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּ֒שֵׁי שְׁמֶֽךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה מְקַדֵּשׁ הַשַּׁבָּת:
tokens.translation: Our God, and God of our fathers, be pleased with our rest, sanctify us with Your commandments and give us our share in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden us with Your deliverance, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth. And give us as our inheritance, Adonoy our God, in love and in pleasure Your holy Shabbos; and may Israel rest thereon— the sanctifiers of Your Name. Blessed are You Adonoy, Sanctifier of Shabbos.

title: Kaddish Shalem
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Kaddish Shalem
useCase: Kaddish Shalem · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name

tokens.hebrew: בְּעָלְ֒מָֽא דִּי־בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom. In your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: be-ah-LE-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khohl beyt yees-rah-ehl bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא
tokens.translation: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah

tokens.hebrew: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
tokens.translation: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He;
tokens.transliteration: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah be-reekh hoo

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵֽלָּא מִן־כָּל־ (בעשי"ת לְעֵֽלָּא לְעֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) בִּרְכָתָֽא וְשִׁירָתָֽא תֻּשְׁבְּ֒חָתָֽא וְנֶחָמָתָֽא דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָֽא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: le-eh-lah meen kohl (vshyt" le-eh-lah le-eh-lah mee-kahl) beer-khah-tah ve-shee-rah-tah toosh-BE-khah-tah ve-neh-khah-mah-tah dah-ah-mee-rahn be-ah-LE-mah ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְ֒הוֹן וּבָעוּתְ֒הוֹן דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁ֒מַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be acceptance of the prayers and supplications of the entire House of Israel before their Father in heaven. And say, Amein.
tokens.transliteration: teet-kah-behl tse-loh-TE-hohn oo-vah-oo-TE-hohn de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl koh-dahm ah-voo-hohn dee VEESH-mah-yah ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָֽא רַבָּֽא מִן־שְׁמַיָּֽא וְחַיִּים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be abundant peace from heaven and life for us and for all Israel, —and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-lah-mah rah-bah meen she-mah-yah ve-khah-yeem ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.translation: He Who makes peace (Ten Days of Penitence: the peace) in His high heavens may He, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.

title: Aleinu
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Aleinu
useCase: Aleinu · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֺּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֺא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֺּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם: שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לָהֶֽבֶל וָרִיק וּמִתְפַּלְּ֒לִים אֶל אֵל לֹא יוֹשִֽׁיעַ, וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ כּוֹרְ֒עִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וּשְׁ֒כִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְ֒הֵי מְרוֹמִים, הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֶֽפֶס זוּלָתוֹ כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶֽךָ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֺהִים בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל וְעַל הָאָֽרֶץ מִתָּֽחַת אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning: that He has not made us like the nations of the lands, and has not positioned us like the families of the earth; that He has not assigned our portion like theirs, nor our lot like that of all their multitudes. For they prostrate themselves to vanity and nothingness, and pray to a god that cannot deliver. But we bow, prostrate ourselves, and offer thanks before the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed is He, Who spreads the heavens, and establishes the earth, and the seat of His glory is in heaven above, and the abode of His invincible might is in the loftiest heights. He is our God, there is nothing else. Our King is true, all else is insignificant, as it is written in His Torah: And You shall know this day and take into Your heart that Adonoy is God in the heavens above and upon the earth below; there is nothing else.
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley-noo le-shah-beh-ahkh lah-ah-dohn hah-kohl lah-teht ge-doo-lah le-yoh-tsehr be-reh-sheet sheh-loh ah-sah-noo ke-goh-yey hah-ah-rah-tsoht ve-loh sah-mah-noo ke-meesh-pe-khoht hah-ah-dah-mah sheh-loh sahm khehl-keh-noo kah-hehm ve-goh-rah-leh-noo ke-khahl hah-moh-nahm: sheh-hehm meesh-tah-khah-veem lah-heh-vehl vah-reek oo-meet-pah-LE-leem ehl ehl loh yoh-shee-ah, vah-ahnah-khe-noo koh-RE-eem oo-meesh-tah-khah-veem oo-moh-deem leef-ney meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-ME-lah-kheem hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo, sheh-hoo noh-teh shah-mah-yeem ve-yoh-sehd ah-rehts, oo-moh-shahv ye-kah-roh bah-shah-mah-yeem mee-mah-ahl, oo-SHE-khee-naht oo-zoh be-GOHV-hey me-roh-meem, hoo eh-loh-hey-noo eyn ohd, eh-meht mahl-keh-noo eh-fehs zoo-lah-toh kah-kah-toov be-toh-rah-toh ve-yah-dah-tah hah-yohm vah-hah-sheh-voh-tah ehl le-vah-veh-khah kee ah-doh-NAI hoo hah-eh-loh-heem bah-shah-mah-yeem mee-mah-ahl ve-ahl hah-ah-rehts mee-tah-khaht eyn ohd:

tokens.hebrew: עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶֽרֶת עֻזֶּֽךָ לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָֽרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁ֒מֶֽךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶֽיךָ כָּל רִשְׁ֒עֵי אָֽרֶץ, יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְ֒עוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁ֒בֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּֽרֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּֽלוּ, וְלִכְ֒בוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּֽנוּ, וִיקַבְּ֒לוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ, וְתִמְלֺךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הַמַּלְכוּת שֶׁלְּ֒ךָ הִיא וּלְעֽוֹלְ֒מֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ יְהֹוָה יִמְלֺךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד: וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: We therefore put our hope in You, Adonoy our God, to soon behold the glory of Your might in banishing idolatry from the earth, and the false gods will be utterly exterminated to perfect the world as the kingdom of Shadai. And all mankind will invoke Your Name, to turn back to You, all the wicked of the earth. They will realize and know, all the inhabitants of the world, that to You, every knee must bend, every tongue must swear [allegiance to You]. Before You, Adonoy, our God, they will bow and prostrate themselves, and to the glory of Your Name give honor. And they will all accept [upon themselves] the yoke of Your kingdom, and You will reign over them, soon, forever and ever. For the kingdom is Yours, and to all eternity You will reign in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: Adonoy will reign forever and ever. And it is said: And Adonoy will be King over the whole earth; on that day Adonoy will be One and His Name One.

title: LeDavid
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, LeDavid
useCase: LeDavid · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מנהג טוב לומר אחר כל תפלה מזמור לדוד ה׳‬ אורי וישעי. ובפרט מר״ח אלול עד הושענא רבא (מורה באצבע סי' לז).
tokens.translation: The following psalm (27) is recited at the conclusion of services, morning and evenings, from the first day of Elul, through Shemini Atzeres. Others say only until Hoasha’na Rabbah. The psalm voices our prayer that God will be our light on Rosh Hashana enabling us to repel the darkness of sin through true repentance, and that He will be our salvation on Yom Kippur, through His compassionate atonement of our sins.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְהֹוָה מָעוֹז חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד: בִּקְ֒רֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת בְּשָׂרִי צָרַי וְאֹיְ֒בַי לִי הֵֽמָּה כָשְׁ֒לוּ וְנָפָֽלוּ: אִם תַּחֲנֶה עָלַי מַחֲנֶה לֺא יִירָא לִבִּי אִם תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵֽחַ: אַחַת שָׁאַֽלְתִּי מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹֽעַם יְהֹוָה וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ: כִּי יִצְפְּ֒נֵֽנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה יַסְתִּרֵֽנִי בְּסֵֽתֶר אָהֳלוֹ בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְ֒מֵֽנִי: וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְ֒בַי סְבִיבוֹתָי וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה אָשִֽׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּ֒רָה לַיהוָֹה: שְׁמַע יְהֹוָה קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא וְחָנֵּֽנִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי: לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּ֒שׁוּ פָנָי אֶת פָּנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֲבַקֵּשׁ: אַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶֽיךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי אַל תַּט בְּאַף עַבְדֶּֽךָ עֶזְרָתִי הָיִֽיתָ אַל תִּטְּ֒שֵֽׁנִי וְאַל תַּעַזְבֵֽנִי אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׁעִי: כִּי אָבִי וְאִמִּי עֲזָבֽוּנִי וַיהוָֹה יַאַסְפֵֽנִי: הוֹרֵֽנִי יְהֹוָה דַּרְכֶּֽךָ וּנְחֵֽנִי בְּאֹֽרַח מִישׁוֹר לְמַֽעַן שׁוֹרְ֒רָי: אַל תִּתְּ֒נֵֽנִי בְּנֶֽפֶשׁ צָרָי כִּי קָֽמוּ בִי עֵֽדֵי שֶֽׁקֶר וִיפֵֽחַ חָמָס: לוּלֵא הֶאֱמַֽנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב יְהֹוָה בְּאֶֽרֶץ חַיִּים: קַוֵּה אֶל יְהֹוָה חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל יְהֹוָה:
tokens.translation: By David: Adonoy is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? Adonoy is the strength of my life, of whom shall I be afraid? When evildoers approach me to devour my flesh— my tormentors and my foes they stumble and fall. If an army should encamp against me, my heart would not fear; if war were to rise against me, in this I trust. One thing I request of Adonoy, [only] that shall I seek, that I may dwell in the House of Adonoy all the days of my life, to behold the pleasantness of Adonoy, and to meditate in His Sanctuary. For He will hide me in His Tabernacle on the day of distress, He will conceal me in the shelter of His Tent, upon a rock He will lift me. And now my head is raised high above my enemies around me; and I will offer in His Tent, sacrifices accompanied by trumpets of joy; I will sing and chant to Adonoy. Adonoy, hear my voice when I call; be gracious to me and answer me. Of You, my heart has said, Seek My Presence; Your Presence, Adonoy I will seek. Conceal not Your Presence from me, do not turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my help; neither cast me off nor abandon me, God of my deliverance. When my father and mother abandon me, Adonoy will gather me up. Adonoy, teach me Your way, and lead me in the path of uprightness, because of my watchers. Do not deliver me to the will of my tormentors, for false witnesses have risen against me, who breathe violence. Had I not believed that I would see the goodness of Adonoy in the land of living. Hope to Adonoy, be strong and He will give you courage; and hope to Adonoy.

title: Yigdal
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Yigdal
useCase: Yigdal · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: פיוט המיוסד על שלושה עשר עקרי האמונה. מיוחס לר' דניאל בן יהודה הרומי
tokens.translation: This hymn, written by Daniel ben Yehuda, who was a Dayan in Rome about 1300, is based on Maimonides' 13 principles of Judaism. According to Maimonides, failure to believe in a single one of these principles places one outside the pale of Judaism.
1) the existence of God

tokens.hebrew: יִגְדַּל אֱלֹהִים חַי וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח, נִמְצָא וְאֵין עֵת אֶל מְצִיאוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: Exalted is the living God, and praised He exists, and His existence transcends time.
tokens.transliteration: yeeg-dahl eh-loh-heem khahy ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh, neem-tsah ve-eyn eht ehl me-tsee-oo-toh:

tokens.translation: 2) God is One

tokens.hebrew: אֶחָד וְאֵין יָחִיד כְּיִחוּדוֹ, נֶעְלָם וְגַם אֵין סוֹף לְאַחְדּוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no unity like His, He is invisible, His unity is infinitive.
tokens.transliteration: eh-khahd ve-eyn yah-kheed ke-yee-khoo-doh, neh-lahm ve-gahm eyn sohf le-ahkh-doo-toh:

tokens.translation: 3) God is uncorporeal

tokens.hebrew: אֵין לוֹ דְמוּת הַגּוּף וְאֵינוֹ גוּף, לֹא נַעֲרֹךְ אֵלָיו קְדֻשָּׁתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is unlike the corporeal or even the non-corporeal, His holiness is beyond comparison.
tokens.transliteration: eyn loh de-moot hah-goof ve-ey-noh goof, loh nah-ah-rohkh eh-lahv ke-doo-shah-toh:

tokens.translation: 4) God is Eternal

tokens.hebrew: קַדְמוֹן לְכָל דָּבָר אֲשֶׁר נִבְרָא, רִאשׁוֹן וְאֵין רֵאשִׁית לְרֵאשִׁיתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He preceded every being that was created, He was First, and there was no genesis to His beginning.
tokens.transliteration: kahd-mohn le-khohl dah-vahr ah-shehr neev-rah, ree-shohn ve-eyn reh-sheet le-reh-shee-toh:

tokens.translation: 5) God alone must be worshipped

tokens.hebrew: הִנּוֹ אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם לְכָל נוֹצָר, יוֹרֶה גְדֻלָּתוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He is Master of the Universe to every creature, (all) proclaim His greatness and His majesty.
tokens.transliteration: hee-noh ah-dohn oh-lahm le-khohl noh-tsahr, yoh-reh ge-doo-lah-toh oo-mahl-khoo-toh:

tokens.translation: 6) Truth of Divine Prophecy

tokens.hebrew: שֶֽׁפַע נְבוּאָתוֹ נְתָנוֹ, אֶל אַנְשֵׁי סְגֻלָּתוֹ וְתִפְאַרְתּוֹ:
tokens.translation: The fullness of His prophecy, He bestowed on those He treasured, and in whom He gloried.
tokens.transliteration: sheh-fah ne-voo-ah-toh ne-tah-noh, ehl ahn-shey se-goo-lah-toh ve-teef-ahr-toh:

tokens.translation: 7) Moses was the greatest of all prophets

tokens.hebrew: לֹא קָם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל כְּמשֶׁה עוֹד, נָבִיא וּמַבִּיט אֶת תְּמוּנָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: There never arose in Israel another like Moses, a prophet who beheld God's image.
tokens.transliteration: loh kahm be-yees-rah-ehl ke-m-sheh ohd, nah-vee oo-mah-beet eht te-moo-nah-toh:

tokens.translation: 8) Divine revelation of the Torah

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת נָתַן לְעַמּוֹ אֵל, עַל יַד נְבִיאוֹ נֶאֱמַן בֵּיתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Torah of truth the Almighty gave to His people through His prophet, the trusted one of His house.
tokens.transliteration: toh-raht eh-meht nah-tahn le-ah-moh ehl, ahl yahd ne-vee-oh neh-eh-mahn bey-toh:

tokens.translation: 9) The Torah is immutable

tokens.hebrew: לֹא יַחֲלִיף הָאֵל וְלֹא יָמִיר דָּתוֹ, לְעוֹלָמִים לְזוּלָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Almighty will not exchange nor alter His Law. Never will He offer any alternative.
tokens.transliteration: loh yah-khah-leef hah-ehl ve-loh yah-meer dah-toh, le-oh-lah-meem le-zoo-lah-toh:

tokens.translation: 10) God knows the acts and thoughts of man

tokens.hebrew: צוֹפֶה וְיוֹדֵֽעַ סְתָרֵֽינוּ, מַבִּיט לְסוֹף דָּבָר בְּקַדְמָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He scrutinizes and knows our secrets. He beholds the end of a thing at its beginning.
tokens.transliteration: tsoh-feh ve-yoh-deh-ah se-tah-rey-noo, mah-beet le-sohf dah-vahr be-kahd-mah-toh:

tokens.translation: 11) Divine reward and punishment

tokens.hebrew: גּוֹמֵל לְאִישׁ חֶֽסֶד כְּמִפְעָלוֹ, נוֹתֵן לְרָשָׁע רָע כְּרִשְׁעָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He rewards man with kindness according to his deeds. He sends evil to the wicked according to his wickedness.
tokens.transliteration: goh-mehl le-eesh kheh-sehd ke-meef-ah-loh, noh-tehn le-rah-shah rah ke-reesh-ah-toh:

tokens.translation: 12) Belief in the coming of the Messiah

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַח לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין מְשִׁיחֵֽנוּ, לִפְדּוֹת מְחַכֵּי קֵץ יְשׁוּעָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: He will send our Messiah at the end of days, to redeem all who await His final deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-lahkh le-kehts hah-yah-meen me-shee-kheh-noo, leef-doht me-khah-key kehts ye-shoo-ah-toh:

tokens.translation: 13) Divine resurrection of the dead

tokens.hebrew: מֵתִים יְחַיֶּה אֵל בְּרֹב חַסְדּוֹ, בָּרוּךְ עֲדֵי עַד שֵׁם תְּהִלָּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: The Almighty will revive the dead because of His abundant kindness: Blessed forever is His praised Name.
tokens.transliteration: meh-teem ye-khah-yeh ehl be-rohv khahs-doh, bah-rookh ah-dey ahd shehm te-hee-lah-toh:

title: Adon Olam
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Maariv, Adon Olam
useCase: Adon Olam · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: ויאמר פיוט ״אדון עולם״ המדבר ביחוד השם והשגחתו:
tokens.translation: This hymn has been attributed to R' Shlomo ibn Gabirol who lived in Spain during the eleventh century. While praising God's omnipotence and providence, it clarifies the meaning of the name Adonoy so that before proceeding to pray, each worshiper understands the significance of the God he is addressing.

tokens.hebrew: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶֽרֶם כָּל יְצִיר נִבְרָא:
tokens.translation: Master of the Universe Who reigned before any creature was created.
tokens.transliteration: ah-dohn oh-lahm ah-shehr mah-lahkh, be-teh-rehm kohl ye-tseer neev-rah:

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶֽלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא:
tokens.translation: At the time when all was made by His will, then was His Name proclaimed King.
tokens.transliteration: le-eht nah-ah-sah ve-khehf-tsoh kohl, ah-zahy meh-lehkh she-moh neek-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְ֒לוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא:
tokens.translation: And after all things shall cease to be the Awesome One will reign alone.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-khah-rey KEEKH-loht hah-kohl, le-vah-doh yeem-lohkh noh-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה:
tokens.translation: He was, He is, and He shall be in glory.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo hah-yah ve-hoo hoh-veh, ve-hoo yeeh-yeh be-teef-ah-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁיל לוֹ לְהַחְבִּֽירָה:
tokens.translation: He is One, and there is no second to compare to Him, to associate [with Him].
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo eh-khahd ve-eyn sheh-nee, le-hah-me-sheel loh le-hahkh-bee-rah:

tokens.hebrew: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה:
tokens.translation: Without beginning, without end, power and dominion are His.
tokens.transliteration: be-lee reh-sheet be-lee tahkh-leet, ve-loh hah-ohz ve-hah-mees-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גּוֹאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּעֵת צָרָה:
tokens.translation: He is my God and my ever-living Redeemer, the Rock of my destiny in times of distress.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo eh-lee ve-khahy goh-ah-lee, ve-tsoor khehv-lee be-eht tsah-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹס לִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא:
tokens.translation: He is my flag and my refuge; He is the portion of my cup on the day I call.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo nee-see oo-mah-nohs lee, me-naht koh-see be-yohm ehk-rah:

tokens.hebrew: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִֽירָה:
tokens.translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit [both] when I sleep and when I awaken.
tokens.transliteration: be-yah-doh ahf-keed roo-khee, be-eht ee-shahn ve-ah-ee-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, יְהֹוָה לִי וְלֹא אִירָא:
tokens.translation: And with my spirit my body [too], Adonoy is with me, I shall not fear.
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem roo-khee ge-vee-yah-tee, ah-doh-NAI lee ve-loh ee-rah:

title: Blessing the Children
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Blessing the Children
useCase: Blessing the Children · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: family, shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מנהג ישראל לברך את הילדים בלילי שבת כשבאים מבית הכנסת:
tokens.translation: It has become a widely accepted custom for parents to bless their children on the eve of Shabbos. The placing of both hands upon the child's head when giving the blessing, symbolizes that the blessing is bestowed with fullness of spirit and heart.

tokens.hebrew: לבן יְשִׂימְךָ אֱלֹהִים כְּאֶפְרַיִם וְכִמְנַשֶּׁה: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָ: יִשָּׁא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
tokens.translation: For a boy: May God make you like Ephraim and Menashe. May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.
tokens.transliteration: lvn ye-see-me-khah eh-loh-heem ke-ehf-rah-yeem ve-kheem-nah-sheh: ye-vah-rehkh-khah ah-doh-NAI ve-yeesh-me-reh-khah: yah-ehr ah-doh-NAI pah-nahv eh-ley-khah vee-khoo-neh-khah: yee-shah ah-doh-NAI pah-nahv eh-ley-khah ve-yah-sehm le-khah shah-lohm:

tokens.hebrew: לבת יְשִׂימֵךְ אֱלֹהִים כְּשָׂרָה רִבְקָה רָחֵל וְלֵאָה. יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וִיחֻנֶּךָ: יִשָּׁא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
tokens.translation: For a girl: May God make you like Sorah, Rivkah, Rochel and Leah. May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.

title: Shalom Aleichem
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Shalom Aleichem
useCase: Shalom Aleichem · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: peace, shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: כשבא מבית הכנסת לביתו יאמר זה:
tokens.translation: Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Yehudah said: “Two angels accompany a man on the eve of Shabbos from the synagogue to his home, one good angel and one evil angel.” When the person arrives home to find the lights burning, the table set, and the bed made, the good angel exclaims, “May it be God's will that it be so next Shabbos.” But if not so, if the the house is dark and in disorder, the evil angel exclaims, “May it be God's will that it be so next Shabbos.” The good angel is compelled to answer Amein.—Maseches Shabbos 119b The custom of singing Sholom Aleichem, peace upon you, upon returning from the synagogue is based on the above Talmudic teaching. Since every Jew is accompanied home by these two angels, it is fitting that he welcome them into his home. Obviously, one should prepare for Shabbos in such manner to evoke the angels' best wishes.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם עֲלֵיכֶם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: ג"פ
tokens.translation: Peace upon you, angels of God's service, angels of the Most High, from the King of kings-of-kings, the Holy One, blessed is He.
tokens.transliteration: shah-lohm ah-ley-khehm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-reht mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-ME-lah-kheem hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo: gf"

tokens.hebrew: בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: ג"פ
tokens.translation: Come in peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High, from the King of kings-of-kings the Holy One, blessed is He.
tokens.transliteration: boh-ah-khehm le-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-ME-lah-kheem hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo: gf"

tokens.hebrew: בָּרְכוּנִי לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: ג"פ
tokens.translation: Bless me with peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High from the King of kings-of-kings the Holy One, blessed is He.
tokens.transliteration: bah-re-khoo-nee le-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-ME-lah-kheem hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo: gf"

tokens.hebrew: צֵאתְכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: ג"פ
tokens.translation: Go in peace, angels of peace, angels of the Most High from the King of kings-of-kings the Holy One, blessed is He.
tokens.transliteration: tseh-te-khehm le-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-ME-lah-kheem hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo: gf"

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מַלְאָכָיו יְצַוֶּה־לָּךְ לִשְׁמָרְךָ בְּכָל־דְּרָכֶֽיךָ: יְהֹוָה יִשְׁמָר־צֵאתְ֒ךָ וּבוֹאֶךָ. מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: For His angels He will command in your behalf, to guard you in all your ways. Adonoy will guard your going and coming from now, forever.

title: Eshet Chayil
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Eshet Chayil
useCase: Eshet Chayil · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֵֽשֶׁת־חַֽיִל מִי יִמְצָא וְרָחֹק מִפְּ֒נִינִים מִכְרָהּ:
tokens.translation: Whoever finds a valorous wife— far greater than that of pearls is her value.
tokens.transliteration: eh-sheht khah-yeel mee yeem-tsah ve-rah-khohk mee-PE-nee-neem meekh-rahh:

tokens.hebrew: בָּֽטַח בָּהּ לֵב בַּעְלָהּ וְשָׁלָל לֹא יֶחְסָר:
tokens.translation: The heart of her husband trusts in her, and he lacks no gain.
tokens.transliteration: bah-tahkh bahh lehv bah-lahh ve-shah-lahl loh yehkh-sahr:

tokens.hebrew: גְּמָלַֽתְהוּ טוֹב וְלֹא־רָע כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּֽיהָ:
tokens.translation: She repays him good and not evil all the days of her life.
tokens.transliteration: ge-mah-lah-te-hoo tohv ve-loh rah kohl ye-mey khah-yey-hah:

tokens.hebrew: דָּרְ֒שָׁה צֶֽמֶר וּפִשְׁתִּים וַתַּֽעַשׂ בְּחֵֽפֶץ כַּפֶּֽיהָ:
tokens.translation: She seeks wool and linen, and works them willingly with her hands.
tokens.transliteration: dah-RE-shah tseh-mehr oo-feesh-teem vah-tah-ahs be-kheh-fehts kah-pey-hah:

tokens.hebrew: הָיְ֒תָה כָּאֳנִיּוֹת סוֹחֵר מִמֶּרְחָק תָּבִיא לַחְמָהּ:
tokens.translation: She is like the merchant ships; from afar, she brings her food.
tokens.transliteration: hah-YE-tah koh-oh-nee-yoht soh-khehr mee-mehr-khahk tah-vee lahkh-mahh:

tokens.hebrew: וַתָּֽקָם בְּעוֹד לַֽיְלָה וַתִּתֵּן טֶֽרֶף לְבֵיתָהּ וְחֹק לְנַעֲרֹתֶֽיהָ:
tokens.translation: She rises while it is still night and gives food to her household, and tasks to her maids.
tokens.transliteration: vah-tah-kahm be-ohd lah-ye-lah vah-tee-tehn teh-rehf le-vey-tahh ve-khohk le-nah-ah-roh-tey-hah:

tokens.hebrew: זָמְ֒מָה שָׂדֶה וַתִּקָּחֵֽהוּ מִפְּ֒רִי כַפֶּֽיהָ נָֽטְ֒עָה כָּֽרֶם:
tokens.translation: She considers a field and buys it; from the fruit of her hand, she plants a vineyard.
tokens.transliteration: zah-ME-mah sah-deh vah-tee-kah-kheh-hoo mee-PE-ree khah-pey-hah nah-TE-ah kah-rehm:

tokens.translation: She girds herself with might and strengthens her arms.

tokens.hebrew: טָעֲמָה כִּי־טוֹב סַחְרָהּ לֹא־יִכְבֶּה בַּלַּֽיְלָה נֵרָהּ:
tokens.translation: She senses that her business is good, [so] her lamp is not extinguished at night.
tokens.transliteration: tah-ah-mah kee tohv sahkh-rahh loh yeekh-beh bah-lah-ye-lah neh-rahh:

tokens.hebrew: יָדֶֽיהָ שִׁלְּ֒חָה בַכִּישׁוֹר וְכַפֶּֽיהָ תָּֽמְ֒כוּ פָֽלֶךְ:
tokens.translation: She puts her hand to the spindle, and her palms support the distaff.
tokens.transliteration: yah-dey-hah shee-LE-khah vah-kee-shohr ve-khah-pey-hah tah-ME-khoo fah-lehkh:

tokens.hebrew: כַּפָּהּ פָּרְ֒שָׂה לֶעָנִי וְיָדֶֽיהָ שִׁלְּ֒חָה לָאֶבְיוֹן:
tokens.translation: Her palm she spreads out to the poor and her hands she extends to the needy.
tokens.transliteration: kah-pahh pah-RE-sah leh-ah-nee ve-yah-dey-hah shee-LE-khah lah-ehv-yohn:

tokens.hebrew: לֹא־תִירָא לְבֵיתָהּ מִשָּֽׁלֶג כִּי כָל־בֵּיתָהּ לָבֻשׁ שָׁנִים:
tokens.translation: She has no fear for her household because of snow, for her entire household is clothed with scarlet [wool].
tokens.transliteration: loh tee-rah le-vey-tahh mee-shah-lehg kee khohl bey-tahh lah-voosh shah-neem:

tokens.translation: Bedspreads, she makes herself fine linen and purple [wool] are her clothing.
tokens.transliteration: mahr-vah-deem ah-SE-tah LAHH shehsh ve-ahr-gah-mahn le-voo-shahh:

tokens.translation: Well-known at the gates is her husband as he sits among the elders of the land.
tokens.transliteration: noh-dah bah-SHE-ah-reem bah-lahh be-sheev-toh eem zeek-ney ah-rehts:

tokens.hebrew: סָדִין עָשְׂ֒תָה וַתִּמְכֹּר וַחֲגוֹר נָתְ֒נָה לַכְּנַעֲנִי:
tokens.translation: Garments she makes and sells them, and belts, she provides for the merchants.
tokens.transliteration: sah-deen ah-SE-tah vah-teem-kohr vah-khah-gohr nah-TE-nah lah-ke-nah-ah-nee:

tokens.translation: Strength and splendor are her clothing, and smilingly [she awaits her] last day.
tokens.transliteration: ohz ve-hah-dahr le-voo-shahh vah-tees-khahk le-yohm ah-khah-rohn:

tokens.translation: Her mouth she opens with wisdom, and the teaching of kindness is on her tongue.
tokens.transliteration: pee-hah pah-TE-khah ve-khohkh-mah ve-toh-raht kheh-sehd ahl le-shoh-nahh:

tokens.hebrew: צוֹפִיָּה הֲלִיכוֹת בֵּיתָהּ וְלֶֽחֶם עַצְלוּת לֹא תֹאכֵל:
tokens.translation: She anticipates the ways of her household, and the bread of idleness, she does not eat.
tokens.transliteration: tsoh-fee-yah hah-lee-khoht bey-tahh ve-leh-khehm ahts-loot loh toh-khehl:

tokens.translation: Her children rise and make her fortunate; her husband—and he praises her:

tokens.hebrew: רַבּוֹת בָּנוֹת עָֽשׂוּ חָֽיִל וְאַתְּ עָלִית עַל־כֻּלָּֽנָה:
tokens.translation: Many daughters have attained valor but you surpassed them all.
tokens.transliteration: rah-boht bah-noht ah-soo khah-yeel ve-aht ah-leet ahl koo-lah-nah:

tokens.hebrew: שֶֽׁקֶר הַחֵן וְהֶֽבֶל הַיֹּֽפִי אִשָּׁה יִרְאַת־יְהֹוָה הִיא תִתְהַלָּל:
tokens.translation: Favor is deceptive and beauty is vain; a God-fearing woman—she should be praised.
tokens.transliteration: sheh-kehr hah-khehn ve-heh-vehl hah-yoh-fee ee-shah yeer-aht ah-doh-NAI hee teet-hah-lahl:

tokens.hebrew: תְּנוּ־לָהּ מִפְּ֒רִי יָדֶֽיהָ וִיהַלְ֒לֽוּהָ בַשְּׁ֒עָרִים מַעֲשֶֽׂיהָ:
tokens.translation: Give her the fruit of her hand, and let her deeds praise her in the gates.
tokens.transliteration: te-noo lahh mee-PE-ree yah-dey-hah vee-hah-LE-loo-hah vah-SHE-ah-reem mah-ah-sey-hah:

title: Menucha VeSimcha
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Zemirot for Shabbat Evening, Menucha VeSimcha
useCase: Menucha VeSimcha · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Rest and joy, a light for the Jews.
It is a day of rest, a day of delights;
its preservers and its recallers— they bear witness
that in six [days], all was created: and it still exists.
Heavens above the skies, earth, and seas,
all the hosts of heaven high and exalted;
sea monsters, and man, and mighty beasts—
for with the letters yud and hey Adonoy, created worlds.
He is the One Who told His treasured people—
Be careful to sanctify it from arrival till departure—
the holy Sabbath, day of His delight,

tokens.hebrew: כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת אֵל מִכָּל מְלַאכְתּוֹ׃
tokens.translation: for on it the Almighty abstained from all His work.
tokens.transliteration: kee voh shah-vaht ehl mee-kohl me-lahkh-toh

tokens.translation: Through the command of the Sabbath the Almighty will strengthen you.
Arise, call out to Him—He will hasten to strengthen you—
[Recite] “Soul of all living,” and also “We proclaim Your might.”
Eat with joy, for He has already accepted you favorably.
With double loaves and a great Kiddush,
with abundant delicacies and generous spirit,
they will merit much good—those who delight in it
—with the coming of the Redeemer in the life in the World-to-Come.

title: Yah Ribon
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Zemirot for Shabbat Evening, Yah Ribon
useCase: Yah Ribon · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: God, Master of all worlds,
You are the King—the King of kings.
The work of Your might and Your wondrous deeds,
it is fitting to declare before You. refrain.

tokens.hebrew: יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:
tokens.translation: God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.
tokens.transliteration: yahh ree-bohn ah-lahm ve-ah-le-mah-yah. ahnt hoo mahl-kah meh-lehkh mahl-khah-yah:

tokens.translation: Praises I will present morning and night

tokens.hebrew: לָךְ אֱלָהָא קַדִּישָׁא. דִּי בְרָא כָּל נַפְשָׁא.
tokens.translation: to You, holy God Who created all life—
tokens.transliteration: lahkh eh-lah-hah kah-dee-shah. dee ve-rah kohl nahf-shah.

tokens.translation: holy angels and humans,
beasts of the field and birds of the sky.

tokens.hebrew: יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:
tokens.translation: God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.
tokens.transliteration: yahh ree-bohn ah-lahm ve-ah-le-mah-yah. ahnt hoo mahl-kah meh-lehkh mahl-khah-yah:

tokens.translation: Great are Your works and mighty—
You humble the haughty and straighten the bent;
were man to live a thousand years,
he could not recount Your might.

tokens.hebrew: יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:
tokens.translation: God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.
tokens.transliteration: yahh ree-bohn ah-lahm ve-ah-le-mah-yah. ahnt hoo mahl-kah meh-lehkh mahl-khah-yah:

tokens.translation: Almighty, to Whom belongs honor and greatness,
redeem Your sheep from the mouths of lions,
And bring Your people out of exile,
Your people, whom You chose from all peoples.

tokens.hebrew: יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:
tokens.translation: God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.
tokens.transliteration: yahh ree-bohn ah-lahm ve-ah-le-mah-yah. ahnt hoo mahl-kah meh-lehkh mahl-khah-yah:

tokens.translation: To Your Holy Temple return and to the Holy of Holies,

tokens.hebrew: אֲתַר דִּי בֵיהּ יֶחֱדוּן רוּחִין וְנַפְשִׁין.
tokens.translation: the place where they will rejoice—spirits and souls;
tokens.transliteration: ah-tahr dee veyh yeh-kheh-doon roo-kheen ve-nahf-sheen.

tokens.translation: and they will sing to You songs and praises
in Jerusalem, city of beauty.

tokens.hebrew: יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא. אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא:
tokens.translation: God, Master of all worlds, You are the King—the King of kings.
tokens.transliteration: yahh ree-bohn ah-lahm ve-ah-le-mah-yah. ahnt hoo mahl-kah meh-lehkh mahl-khah-yah:

title: Tzur Mishelo
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shabbat Evening, Zemirot for Shabbat Evening, Tzur Mishelo
useCase: Tzur Mishelo · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless Him my faithful ones.
We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food], according to the word of Adonoy.
He nourishes His world, our Shepherd our Father.
We have eaten His bread and His wine we drank.

tokens.hebrew: עַל כֵּן נוֹדֶה לִשְׁמוֹ וּנְהַלְּלוֹ בְּפִֽינוּ
tokens.translation: Therefore, we give thanks to His Name, and praise Him with our mouths—
tokens.transliteration: ahl kehn noh-deh leesh-moh oo-ne-hah-le-loh be-fee-noo

tokens.translation: saying and chanting: There is nothing so holy as Adonoy.

tokens.hebrew: צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃
tokens.translation: The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: tsoor mee-sheh-loh ah-khah-le-noo bah-re-khoo eh-moo-nahy sah-vah-e-noo ve-hoh-tah-re-noo keed-vahr ah-doh-NAI

tokens.translation: With song and sound of thanksgiving we will bless our God,

tokens.hebrew: עַל אֶֽרֶץ חֶמְדָּה טוֹבָה שֶׁהִנְחִיל לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ
tokens.translation: for the land so desirably good that He parceled out as a heritage to our fathers.
tokens.transliteration: ahl eh-rehts khehm-dah toh-vah sheh-heen-kheel lah-ah-voh-tey-noo

tokens.translation: [With] food and sustenance He satisfied our souls;
His kindliness overwhelmed us and Adonoy is truth.

tokens.hebrew: צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃
tokens.translation: The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: tsoor mee-sheh-loh ah-khah-le-noo bah-re-khoo eh-moo-nahy sah-vah-e-noo ve-hoh-tah-re-noo keed-vahr ah-doh-NAI

tokens.translation: Be compassionate with Your kindliness upon Your people; our Rock,

tokens.hebrew: עַל צִיּוֹן מִשְׁכַּן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ זְבוּל בֵּית תִּפְאַרְתֵּֽנוּ
tokens.translation: upon Zion, the dwelling-place of Your Glory, the Abode, home of our splendors.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tsee-yohn meesh-kahn ke-voh-deh-khah ze-vool beyt teef-ahr-teh-noo

tokens.translation: May the son of David, Your servant, come and redeem us
the breath of our life—the anointed of Adonoy.

tokens.hebrew: צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃
tokens.translation: The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: tsoor mee-sheh-loh ah-khah-le-noo bah-re-khoo eh-moo-nahy sah-vah-e-noo ve-hoh-tah-re-noo keed-vahr ah-doh-NAI

tokens.translation: May the Temple be rebuilt, the city of Zion filled,

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁם נָשִׁיר שִׁיר חָדָשׁ וּבִרְנָנָה נַעֲלֶה
tokens.translation: and there we will sing a new song, and with joyous singing we will come up.
tokens.transliteration: ve-shahm nah-sheer sheer khah-dahsh oo-veer-nah-nah nah-ah-leh

tokens.translation: The Merciful One, the Sanctified One, blessed and exalted,

tokens.hebrew: עַל כּוֹס יַֽיִן מָלֵא כְּבִרְכַּת יְהֹוָה׃
tokens.translation: over a full cup of wine, the bounty of Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: ahl kohs yah-yeen mah-leh ke-veer-kaht ah-doh-NAI

tokens.hebrew: צוּר מִשֶּׁלּוֹ אָכַֽלְנוּ בָּרְכוּ אֱמוּנַי שָׂבַֽעְנוּ וְהוֹתַֽרְנוּ כִּדְבַר יְהֹוָה׃
tokens.translation: The Rock—from His [store] we have eaten—Bless [Him] my faithful ones. We have satisfied ourselves and we have left over [some food] according to the word of Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: tsoor mee-sheh-loh ah-khah-le-noo bah-re-khoo eh-moo-nahy sah-vah-e-noo ve-hoh-tah-re-noo keed-vahr ah-doh-NAI

title: Yishtabach

useCase: Yishtabach · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ. הָאֵל הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדול וְהַקָּדושׁ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. כִּי לְךָ נָאֶה ה' אֱלהֵינוּ וֵאלהֵי אֲבותֵינוּ שִׁיר וּשְׁבָחָה. הַלֵּל וְזִמְרָה. עוז וּמֶמְשָׁלָה. נֶצַח גְּדֻלָּה וּגְבוּרָה. תְּהִלָּה וְתִפְאֶרֶת. קְדֻשָּׁה וּמַלְכוּת: בְּרָכות וְהודָאות מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עולָם: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה'. אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדול בַּתִּשְׁבָּחות אֵל הַהודָאות. אֲדון הַנִּפְלָאות. הַבּוחֵר בְּשִׁירֵי זִמְרָה. מֶלֶךְ אֵל חֵי הָעולָמִים:
tokens.translation: May your name be praised forever, O our king. Great and holy god-emperor over the heavens and the earth! For songs of praise are pleasant to you, O LORD our god and god of our forefathers, and hymns of exaltation, and power and sovereignty, great and powerful victory, awesome wonder, and holy kingship, and blessings and thanks, from now until forever. Blessed are you O LORD, great god-emperor of praises, god of thanks, master of wonders, who chose hymnal songs, king and living god of all the world.

useCase: Second Blessing before Shema · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אַהֲבָה רַבָּה אֲהַבְתָּנוּ ה' אֱלהֵינוּ. חֶמְלָה גְּדולָה וִיתֵרָה חָמַלְתָּ עָלֵינוּ: אָבִינוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ. בַּעֲבוּר אֲבותֵינוּ שֶׁבָּטְחוּ בְךָ. וַתְּלַמְּדֵם חֻקֵּי חַיִּים כֵּן תְּחָנֵּנוּ וּתְלַמְּדֵנוּ: אָבִינוּ הָאָב הָרַחֲמָן. הַמְרַחֵם. רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ. וְתֵן בְּלִבֵּנוּ לְהָבִין וּלְהַשכִּיל. לִשְׁמעַ. לִלְמד וּלְלַמֵּד. לִשְׁמר וְלַעֲשות וּלְקַיֵּם אֶת כָּל דִּבְרֵי תַלְמוּד תּורָתֶךָ בְּאַהֲבָה: וְהָאֵר עֵינֵינוּ בְּתורָתֶךָ. וְדַבֵּק לִבֵּנוּ בְּמִצְותֶיךָ. וְיַחֵד לְבָבֵנוּ לְאַהֲבָה וּלְיִרְאָה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ. וְלא נֵבושׁ לְעולָם וָעֶד: כִּי בְשֵׁם קָדְשְׁךָ הַגָּדול וְהַנּורָא בָּטָחְנוּ. נָגִילָה וְנִשמְחָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ: וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ לְשָׁלום מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְפות הָאָרֶץ. וְתולִיכֵנוּ קומְמִיּוּת לְאַרְצֵנוּ: כִּי אֵל פּועֵל יְשׁוּעות אָתָּה. וּבָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ מִכָּל עַם וְלָשׁון.וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדול סֶלָה בֶּאֱמֶת: לְהודות לְךָ וּלְיַחֶדְךָ בְּאַהֲבָה: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה ה'. הַבּוחֵר בְּעַמּו יִשרָאֵל בְּאַהֲבָה:
tokens.translation: (1) [With] great love You have loved us, Lord, our God; [with] great and abundant compassion have You had compassion upon us. Our Parent, our Sovereign — for the sake of our ancestors who trusted in You, and whom You taught laws of life, so [too] be gracious to us and teach us. Our Parent, merciful Parent, Who acts with compassion, have compassion on us and put into our hearts [comprehension] to understand and to discern, to listen, to learn and to teach, to keep, to practice, and to fulfill all the words of the teachings in Your Torah with love. And enlighten our eyes with Your Torah, and attach our hearts to Your mitzvot, and unify our hearts to love and revere Your Name; and may we never be embarrassed, for in Your holy Name— [which is] great and awe-inspiring— have we trusted; may we delight and rejoice in Your deliverance. Bring us in peace [wholeness] from the four corners of the earth; and lead us upright to our land. Because, You are the Almighty, Who performs acts of deliverance, and You have chosen us from among all peoples and languages, and You have brought us close to Your great Name in truth; to thank You and unify You with love. Blessed are You, Lord, Who chooses the people Israel with love.

title: Prayer for Israeli Soldiers
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shacharit, Communal Prayers, Prayer for Israeli Soldiers
summary: Prayer for Israeli Soldiers · Siddur Ashkenaz
useCase: Prayer for Israeli Soldiers · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: community, shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב
tokens.translation: May He who blessed our fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob
tokens.transliteration: mee sheh-beh-rahkh ah-voh-tey-noo ahv-rah-hahm yeets-khahk ve-yah-ah-kohv

tokens.hebrew: הוּא יְבָרֵךְ אֶת חַיָּלֵי צְבָא הֲגַנָּה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל
tokens.translation: bless the soldiers of the Israel Defense Forces,
tokens.transliteration: hoo ye-vah-rehkh eht khah-yah-ley tse-vah hah-gah-nah le-yees-rah-ehl

tokens.hebrew: הָעוֹמְדִים עַל מִשְׁמַר אַרְצֵנוּ וְעָרֵי אֱלֹהֵינוּ
tokens.translation: who are standing guard over our land and over the cities of our God,
tokens.transliteration: hah-oh-me-deem ahl meesh-mahr ahr-tseh-noo ve-ah-rey eh-loh-hey-noo

tokens.translation: from the border of Lebanon to the Wilderness of Egypt,

tokens.hebrew: וּמִן הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל עַד לְבוֹא הָעֲרָבָה בַּיַּבָּשָׁה בָּאֲוִיר וּבַיָּם
tokens.translation: and from the Great Sea to the Approach of the Aravah — on land, in the air, and in the sea.
tokens.transliteration: oo-meen hah-yahm hah-gah-dohl ahd le-voh hah-ah-rah-vah bah-yah-bah-shah bah-ah-veer oo-vah-yahm

tokens.hebrew: יִתֵּן ה' אֶת אוֹיְבֵינוּ הַקָּמִים עָלֵינוּ נִגָּפִים לִפְנֵיהֶם
tokens.translation: May the Lord give plagues before our enemies who arise against us.
tokens.transliteration: yee-tehn h' eht oh-ye-vey-noo hah-kah-meem ah-ley-noo nee-gah-feem leef-ney-hehm

tokens.hebrew: הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יִשְׁמֹר וְיַצִּיל אֶת חַיָלֵינוּ מִכָּל צָרָה וְצוּקָה וּמִכָּל נֶגַע וּמַחֲלָה
tokens.translation: May the Holy One, blessed be He, guard and rescue our soldiers from all trouble and distress, and from all affliction and illness;
tokens.transliteration: hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo yeesh-mohr ve-yah-tseel eht khah-yah-ley-noo mee-kohl tsah-rah ve-tsoo-kah oo-mee-kahl neh-gah oo-mah-khah-lah

tokens.hebrew: וְיִשְׁלַח בְּרָכָה וְהַצְלָחָה בְּכָל מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵיהֶם
tokens.translation: and may He grant blessing and success to all the acts of their hands.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeesh-lahkh be-rah-khah ve-hahts-lah-khah be-khohl mah-ah-seh ye-dey-hehm

tokens.hebrew: יַדְבֵּר שׂוֹנְאֵינוּ תַּחְתֵּיהֶם וִיעַטְרֵם בְּכֶתֶר יְשׁוּעָה וּבְעֲטֶרֶת נִצָּחוֹן
tokens.translation: May He crush beneath them those who hate us and crown our soldiers with the crown of salvation and with the crown of victory.
tokens.transliteration: yahd-behr soh-ne-ey-noo tahkh-tey-hehm vee-aht-rehm be-kheh-tehr ye-shoo-ah oo-ve-ah-teh-reht nee-tsah-khohn

tokens.translation: And may the verse be fulfilled through them:

tokens.hebrew: כִּי ה' אֱלֹהֵיכֶם הַהֹלֵךְ עִמָּכֶם לְהִלָּחֵם לָכֶם עִם אֹיְבֵיכֶם לְהוֹשִׁיעַ אֶתְכֶם
tokens.translation: For it is the Lord, your God, who walks with you to fight for you against your enemies to save you (Deuteronomy 20:4).
tokens.transliteration: kee h' eh-loh-hey-khehm hah-hoh-lehkh ee-mah-khehm le-hee-lah-khehm lah-khehm eem oh-ye-vey-khehm le-hoh-shee-ah eht-khehm

tokens.translation: And let us say, Amen.

title: Prayer for Those Being Held in Captivity
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Shabbat, Shacharit, Communal Prayers, Prayer for Those Being Held in Captivity
summary: Prayer for Those Being Held in Captivity · Siddur Ashkenaz
useCase: Prayer for Those Being Held in Captivity · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: protection, shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי שֶׁבֵּרַךְ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן דָּוִד וּשְׁלֹמֹה, הוּא יְבָרֵךְ וְיִשְׁמֹר וְיִנְצֹר אֶת כָּל הַחֲטוּפִים, הַשְּׁבוּיִים וְהַנֶּעֱדָרִים בְּתוֹךְ שְׁאָר אֲחֵינוּ בֵּית יִשְֹרָאֵל הַנְּתוּנִים בְּצָרָה וּבְשִׁבְיָה. בַּעֲבוּר שֶׁהַקָּהָל מִתְפַּלֵּל בַּעֲבוּרָם, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא יִמָּלֵא רַחֲמִים עֲלֵיהֶם, וְיוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת, וּמוֹסְרוֹתֵיהֶם יְנַתֵּק, וּמִמְּצוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם, וִישִׁיבֵם מְהֵרָה לְחֵיק מִשְׁפְּחוֹתֵיהֶם. יוֹדוּ לַה' חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם. וִיקֻיַּם בָּהֶם מִקְרָא שֶׁכָּתוּב: וּפְדוּיֵי ה' יְשׁוּבוּן וּבָאוּ צִיּוֹן בְּרִנָּה וְשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם עַל רֹאשָׁם. שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה יַשִּׂיגוּ וְנָסוּ יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה. וְנֹאמַר אָמֵן.
tokens.translation: May the One who blessed Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Joseph, Moses, Aaron, David and Solomon bless, watch and guard those missing from the Israel Defense Forces and the captives, among others of our brethren of the House of Israel that are situated in distress and in captivity. On account of the congregation's praying for them, may the Holy One, blessed be He, grant mercy upon them, take them out from darkness and gloom, break their chains, redeem them from their ordeals and return them quickly to the comfort of their families. "Let them praise the Lord for His kindness, and His wondrous deeds for the children of man" (Psalms 107:8). And through them, let the verse (Isaiah 35:10) be fulfilled, "And the Lord’s ransomed shall return, and come with shouting to Zion, crowned with joy everlasting; they shall attain joy and gladness, while sorrow and sighing flee." And let us say, Amen!

title: Entering the Sukkah
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Festivals, Sukkot, Prayers in the Sukkah, Entering the Sukkah
useCase: Entering the Sukkah · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הֲרֵינִי מוּכָן וּמְזוּמָן לְקַיֵּים מִצְוַת סֻכָּה כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוַּנִי הַבּורֵא יִתְבָּרַךְ שְׁמו בַּסֻּכּות תֵּשְׁבוּ שִׁבְעַת יָמִים כָּל הָאֶזְרָח בְּיִשרָאֵל יֵשְׁבוּ בַּסֻּכּות:
tokens.translation: Behold, I am ready and prepared to fulfill the commandment of the sukkah (hut), as the Creator, may his Name be blessed, commanded me - as is written (Leviticus 23:43-44), "You shall live in huts seven days; all citizens in Israel shall live in huts.
tokens.transliteration: hah-rey-nee moo-khahn oo-me-zoo-mahn le-kah-yeym meets-vaht soo-kah kah-ah-shehr tsee-vah-nee hah-b-v-reh yeet-bah-rahkh shmv bah-sookvt teh-she-voo sheev-aht yah-meem kohl hah-ehz-rahkh be-yee-sh-rah-ehl yeh-she-voo bah-sookvt:

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ דרתֵיכֶם כִּי בַסֻּכּות הושַׁבְתִּי אֶת בְּנֵי יִשרָאֵל בְּהוצִיאִי אותָם מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם:
tokens.translation: In order that future generations may know that I made the Israelite people live in huts when I brought them out of the land of Egypt."
tokens.transliteration: le-mah-ahn yeh-de-oo d-r-tey-khehm kee vah-sookvt h-v-shahv-tee eht be-ney yee-sh-rah-ehl be-h-v-tsee-ee -v-tahm meh-eh-rehts meets-rah-yeem:

title: Hanerot Hallalu
sefariaRef: Siddur Ashkenaz, Festivals, Chanukah, Service for Lighting Chanukah Candles, Hanerot Hallalu
useCase: Hanerot Hallalu · Siddur Ashkenaz Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הַנֵּרוֹת הַלָּלוּ שֶׁאָנוּ מַדְלִיקִין, עַל הַנִּסִּים וְעַל הַנִּפְלָאוֹת וְעַל הַתְּשׁוּעוֹת וְעַל הַמִּלְחָמוֹת, שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם בַּזְּמַן הַזֶּה, עַל יְדֵי כֹּהֲנֶיךָ הַקְּדוֹשִׁים. וְכָל שְׁמוֹנַת יְמֵי הַחֲנֻכָּה הַנֵּרוֹת הַלָּלוּ קֹדֶשׁ הֵם וְאֵין לָנוּ רְשׁוּת לְהִשְׁתַּמֵּשׁ בָּהֶם, אֶלָּא לִרְאוֹתָם בִּלְבָד, כְּדֵי לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל עַל נִסֶּיךָ וְעַל נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ וְעַל יְשׁוּעָתֶךָ.
tokens.translation: We kindle these lights on account of the miracles, the deliverances and the wonders which thou didst work for our fathers, by means of thy holy priests. During all the eight days of Chanukah these lights are sacred, neither is it permitted us to make any profane use of them; but we are only to look at them, in order that we may give thanks unto thy name for thy miracles, thy deliverances and thy wonders.
tokens.transliteration: hah-neh-roht hah-lah-loo sheh-ah-noo mahd-lee-keen, ahl hah-nee-seem ve-ahl hah-neef-lah-oht ve-ahl hah-te-shoo-oht ve-ahl hah-meel-khah-moht, sheh-ah-see-tah lah-ah-voh-tey-noo bah-yah-meem hah-hehm bah-ze-mahn hah-zeh, ahl ye-dey koh-hah-ney-khah hah-ke-doh-sheem. ve-khohl she-moh-naht ye-mey hah-khah-noo-kah hah-neh-roht hah-lah-loo koh-dehsh hehm ve-eyn lah-noo re-shoot le-heesh-tah-mehsh bah-hehm, eh-lah leer-oh-tahm beel-vahd, ke-dey le-hoh-doht oo-le-hah-lehl le-sheem-khah hah-gah-dohl ahl nee-sey-khah ve-ahl neef-le-oh-tey-khah ve-ahl ye-shoo-ah-teh-khah.

title: Modeh Ani
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Upon Arising, Modeh Ani
useCase: Modeh Ani · Siddur Sefard Themes: gratitude, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מיד כשיעור משנתו, בעודו על משכבו, יאמר:
tokens.translation: Upon waking in the morning, even before washing your hands, say:

tokens.hebrew: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ מֶֽלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶׁהֶחֱזַֽרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: I give thanks to You living and everlasting King for You have restored my soul with mercy. Great is Your faithfulness.
tokens.transliteration: moh-deh ah-nee le-fah-ney-khah meh-lehkh khahy ve-kah-yahm sheh-heh-khehzah-re-tah bee neesh-mah-tee be-khehm-lah, rah-bah eh-moo-nah-teh-khah:

tokens.translation: After washing your hands, say:

tokens.hebrew: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהֹוָה, שֵֽׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל עֹשֵׂיהֶם, תְּהִלָּתוֹ עוֹמֶֽדֶת לָעַד: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: The beginning of wisdom is fear of Adonoy, good understanding to all who perform [His commandments], His praise endures forever. Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: reh-sheet khohkh-mah yeer-aht ah-doh-NAI, seh-khehl tohv le-khohl oh-sey-hehm, te-hee-lah-toh oh-meh-deht lah-ahd: bah-rookh shehm ke-vohd mahl-khoo-toh le-oh-lahm vah-ehd:

tokens.translation: Before putting on your tallis katan say:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּ֒שָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּנוּ עַל מִצְוַת צִיצִית:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning the mitzva of tzitzis (fringes).
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo meh-lehkh hah-oh-lahm ah-shehr kee-DE-shah-noo be-meets-voh-tahv ve-tsee-vah-noo ahl meets-vaht tsee-tseet:

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי שֶׁתְּ֒הֵא חֲשׁוּבָה מִצְוַת צִיצִית לְפָנֶֽיךָ כְּאִלּוּ קִיַּמְתִּֽיהָ בְּכָל פְּרָטֶֽיהָ וְדִקְדּוּקֶֽיהָ וְכַוָּנוֹתֶֽיהָ וְתַרְיַ"ג מִצְווֹת הַתְּ֒לוּיוֹת בָּהּ, אָמֵן סֶלָה:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will Adonoy, my God, and God of my fathers, to consider [my fulfillment of] the mitzva of tzitzis before You as though I had fulfilled it in every detail, accurately and with full intent, and the 613 commandments that depend on it. Amein, Selah.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee rah-tsohn mee-LE-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hahy veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tahy sheh-TE-heh khah-shoo-vah meets-vaht tsee-tseet le-fah-ney-khah ke-ee-loo kee-yahm-tee-hah be-khohl pe-rah-tey-hah ve-deek-doo-key-hah ve-khah-vah-noh-tey-hah ve-tahr-yahg" meets-voht hah-TE-loo-yoht bahh, ah-mehn seh-lah:
