title: Tachanun
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Shacharit, Tachanun
useCase: Tachanun · Siddur Sefard Themes: repentance, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בר"ח וחולו של מועד וחנוכה אומרים כאן הלל לאחר חזרת הש"ץ. בת"צ אומרים סליחות. בימים שאין אומרים בהם תחנון יאמר הש"ץ חצי קדיש.
tokens.translation: On Rosh Chodesh, Chol HaMoed, and Chanukah, Hallel is recited. On Fast Days (Monday—Thursday—Monday, Tenth of Teves, Fast of Esther, Seventeenth of Tamuz) Selichos are recited. On days when Tachanun is omitted (see below) the chazzan continues with Half Kaddish. (14 and 15 Adar Rishon in a leap year); the entire month of Nissan; Pesach Sheini (14 Iyar); Lag BaOmer; 1-8 Sivan; 9 and 15 Av; and 29 Elul. When Tachanun is omitted on these days, it is also omitted at the preceding Mincha (afternoon service). Tachanun is also omitted in the presence of a bridegroom, in the house of a mourner during the week of mourning, and on the occasion of a circumcision if the father, the sandak or the mohel is present.

tokens.hebrew: טעם נכון למה נתקן הוידוי בלשון רבים כי היה צריך לומר אשמתי בגדתי וכו'. אך העניין הוא שמלבד מה שנענש האדם על חטאיו גם הוא נענש על חברו מטעם הערבות כי כל ישראל הם גוף אחד כלול מאיברים רבים. אם כן לזה ראוי לאדם שיתוודה בלשון רבים כדי שיתוודה גם על חברו. (שער הכונות)
tokens.translation: The worshipper recites the Tachanun in a sitting position, while resting his brow on his arm. During the morning service, when the hand-tefillin is on the left arm, he leans his brow on his right arm, but at the Mincha service he leans his brow on his left arm. This "falling on one's face" symbolizes complete submission to God and the committing of our destinies into His hands. It is mentioned in the Talmud (Maseches Megillah 22b), and originates with Moses, who "Fell down before God" (Deuteronomy 9:18) and was followed by Joshua, who "Fell on the earth upon his face before the Ark of God" (Joshua 7:6)

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּֽתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל־תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּ֒חִנָּתֵֽנוּ שֶׁאֵין אָֽנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְשֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֺא חָטָֽאנוּ אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before you and do not ignore our supplication. For we are not so brazen-faced and stiff-necked to say to you, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, We are righteous and have not sinned. But, indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo tah-voh le-fah-ney-khah te-fee-lah-teh-noo, ve-ahl teet-ah-lahm mee-TE-khee-nah-teh-noo sheh-eyn ah-noo ah-zey fah-neem oo-ke-shey oh-rehf loh-mahr le-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo tsah-dee-keem ahnah-khe-noo ve-loh khah-tah-noo ah-vahl ahnah-khe-noo vah-ah-voh-tey-noo khah-tah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָשַֽׁמְנוּ. בָּגַֽדְנוּ. גָּזַֽלְנוּ. דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹּֽפִי. הֶעֱוִֽינוּ. וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ. זַֽדְנוּ. חָמַֽסְנוּ. טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר. יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּֽבְנוּ. לַֽצְנוּ. מָרַֽדְנוּ. נִאַֽצְנוּ. סָרַֽרְנוּ. עָוִֽינוּ. פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ. צָרַֽרְנוּ. קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף. רָשַֽׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַֽתְנוּ. תִּעַֽבְנוּ. תָּעִֽינוּ. תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ:
tokens.translation: We have trespassed [against God and man, and we are devastated by our guilt]; We have betrayed [God and man, we have been ungrateful for the good done to us]; We have stolen; We have slandered. We have caused others to sin; We have caused others to commit sins for which they are called רְשָׁעִים, wicked; We have sinned with malicious intent; We have forcibly taken other's possessions even though we paid for them; We have added falsehood upon falsehood; we have joined with evil individuals or groups. We have given harmful advice; We have deceived; We have mocked; We have rebelled against God and His Torah; We have caused God to be angry with us; We have turned away from God's Torah; We have sinned deliberately; We have been negligent in our performance of the commandments; We have caused our friends grief; We have been stiff-necked, refusing to admit that the cause of our suffering is our own sins. We have committed sins for which we are called רָשָׁע [raising a hand to hit someone]. We have committed sins which are the result of moral corruption; We have committed sins which the Torah refers to as abominations; We have gone astray; We have led others astray.
tokens.transliteration: ah-shah-me-noo. bah-gah-de-noo. gah-zah-le-noo. dee-bah-re-noo doh-fee. heh-eh-vee-noo. ve-heer-shah-e-noo. zah-de-noo. khah-mah-se-noo. tah-fah-le-noo sheh-kehr. yah-ah-tse-noo rah. kee-zah-ve-noo. lah-tse-noo. mah-rah-de-noo. neeah-tse-noo. sah-rah-re-noo. ah-vee-noo. pah-shah-e-noo. tsah-rah-re-noo. kee-shee-noo oh-rehf. rah-shah-e-noo. sheekhah-te-noo. teeah-ve-noo. tah-ee-noo. tee-tah-e-noo:

tokens.hebrew: סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֺא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:
tokens.translation: We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and we have gained nothing from it. And You are the Righteous One in all [punishment] that has come upon us; for You have acted truthfully and we have acted wickedly.
tokens.transliteration: sah-re-noo mee-meets-voh-tey-khah oo-mee-meesh-pah-tey-khah hah-toh-veem ve-loh shah-vah lah-noo. ve-ah-tah tsah-deek ahl kohl hah-bah ah-ley-noo. kee eh-meht ah-see-tah vah-ahnah-khe-noo heer-shah-e-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אֵל אֶֽרֶךְ־אַפַּֽיִם אַתָּה. וּבַֽעַל הָרַחֲמִים נִקְרֵֽאתָ. וְדֶֽרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה הוֹרֵֽיתָ: גְּדֻלַּת רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ. תִּזְכֺּר הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל־יוֹם לְזֶֽרַע יְדִידֶֽיךָ: תֵּֽפֶן אֵלֵֽינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים. כִּי אַתָּה הוּא בַּֽעַל הָרַחֲמִים: בְּתַחֲנוּן וּבִתְ֒פִלָּה פָּנֶֽיךָ נְקַדֵּם. כְּהוֹדַֽעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּֽדֶם: מֵחֲרוֹן אַפְּ֒ךָ שׁוּב. כְּמוֹ בְּתוֹרָתְ֒ךָ כָּתוּב: וּבְ֒צֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ נֶחֱסֶה וְנִתְלוֹנָן. כְּיוֹם וַיֵֽרֶד יְהֺוָה בֶּעָנָן: תַּעֲבֺר עַל־פֶּֽשַׁע וְתִמְחֶה אָשָׁם. כְּיוֹם וַַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם: תַּאֲזִין שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ וְתַקְשִׁיב מֶֽנוּ מַאֲמַר. כְּיוֹם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה, וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:
tokens.translation: You are Almighty, Slow to anger, Lord of Mercy, You are called, and the way of repentance, You have taught us. The greatness of Your mercy and kindness, remember this day and every day for the descendants of Your loved ones. Turn to us with compassion for You are the Lord of Mercy. With supplication and prayer we approach Your Presence, as You made know to [Moses,] the modest one of old. From Your fierce anger turn, as it is written in Your Torah: In the shadow of Your wings, may we be sheltered and lodged, as on the day [of which it is said:] When Adonoy descended in the cloud. Remove [our] transgression, and blot out [our] iniquity, as on the day [of which it is said:] And He stood with him there. Give ear to our cry and listen to our speech, as on the day [of which it is said:] And He proclaimed in the Name, Adonoy And there it is said:
tokens.transliteration: ehl eh-rehkh ah-pah-yeem ah-tah. oo-vah-ahl hah-rah-khah-meem neek-reh-tah. ve-deh-rehkh te-shoo-vah hoh-rey-tah: ge-doo-laht rah-khah-mey-khah vah-khah-sah-dey-khah. teez-kohr hah-yohm oo-ve-khohl yohm le-zeh-rah ye-dee-dey-khah: teh-fehn eh-ley-noo be-rah-khah-meem. kee ah-tah hoo bah-ahl hah-rah-khah-meem: be-tah-khah-noon oo-VEET-fee-lah pah-ney-khah ne-kah-dehm. ke-hoh-dah-e-tah leh-ah-nahv mee-keh-dehm: meh-khah-rohn ah-PE-khah shoov. ke-moh be-toh-rah-TE-khah kah-toov: oo-VE-tsehl ke-nah-fey-khah neh-kheh-seh ve-neet-loh-nahn. ke-yohm vah-yeh-rehd ah-doh-NAI beh-ah-nahn: tah-ah-vohr ahl peh-shah ve-teem-kheh ah-shahm. ke-yohm vahah-yeet-yah-tsehv ee-moh shahm: tah-ah-zeen shahv-ah-teh-noo ve-tahk-sheev meh-noo mah-ah-mahr. ke-yohm vah-yeek-rah ve-shehm ah-doh-NAI, ve-shahm neh-eh-mahr:

tokens.translation: Congregation and Chazzan:
And Adonoy passed before him [Moses] and proclaimed:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֺוָה יְהֺוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵר חֶֽסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶֽשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, Adonoy, Almighty, Merciful, Gracious, Slow to Anger, and Abundant in Kindness and Truth. Keeper of kindness for thousands of generations, Endurer of iniquity and transgression, and sin, and Acquitter of those who repent.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ah-doh-NAI ehl rah-khoom ve-khah-noon eh-rehkh ah-pah-yeem ve-rahv kheh-sehd veh-eh-meht: noh-tsehr kheh-sehd lah-ah-lah-feem noh-seh ah-vohn vah-feh-shah ve-khah-tah-ah ve-nah-keh:

tokens.hebrew: וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנֵֽנוּ וּלְ֒חַטָּאתֵֽנוּ וּנְ֒חַלְתָּֽנוּ: סְלַח־לָֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כִּי־חָטָֽאנוּ. מְחַל־לָֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כִּי־פָשָֽׁעְנוּ: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֺנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד לְכָל־קוֹרְ֒אֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: And pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for Your inheritance. Pardon us, our Father, for we have sinned, forgive us, our King, for we have transgressed. For You, my Master, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You.
tokens.transliteration: ve-sah-lahkh-tah lah-ah-voh-neh-noo oo-LE-khah-tah-teh-noo oo-NE-khahl-tah-noo: se-lahkh lah-noo ah-vee-noo kee khah-tah-noo. me-khahl lah-noo mahl-keh-noo kee fah-shah-e-noo: kee ah-tah ah-doh-nahy tohv ve-sah-lahkh ve-rahv kheh-sehd le-khohl koh-RE-ey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: כשנופל על פניו יש נוהגים להטות על צד ימין משום דכתיב שויתי ה' לנגדי תמיד. ויש נוהגים להטות על צד שמאל משום דהסבת שמאל שמה הסבה הלכך באותו צד שהוא נראה כבן מלך צריך ליכנע לפני המקום. וכבר נהגו ליפול בשחרית על צד ימין ובמנחה על צד שמאל.
tokens.translation: The following supplication is recited while resting your brow on your arm.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּֽאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־גָּד צַר־לִי מְאֹד נִפְּ֒לָה־נָּא בְיַד־יְהֹוָה כִּי־רַבִּים רַחֲמָיו וּבְ֒יַד־אָדָם אַל־אֶפֹּֽלָה:
tokens.translation: And David said to Gad (II Samuel 24:14), I am greatly distressed; let us fall into the hand of Adonoy for His mercies are great, but into the hand of man let me not fall."
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-mehr dah-veed ehl gahd tsahr lee me-ohd nee-PE-lah NAH ve-yahd ah-doh-NAI kee rah-beem rah-khah-mahv oo-VE-yahd ah-DAHM ahl eh-poh-lah:

tokens.hebrew: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן חָטָֽאתִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה מָלֵא רַחֲמִים רַחֵם עָלַי וְקַבֵּל תַּחֲנוּנָי:
tokens.translation: Merciful and gracious One, I have sinned before You; Adonoy, full of mercy, have compassion upon me and accept my supplications.
tokens.transliteration: rah-khoom ve-khah-noon khah-tah-tee le-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI mah-leh rah-khah-meem rah-khehm ah-lahy ve-kah-behl tah-khah-noo-nahy:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אַל־בְּאַפְּ֒ךָ תוֹכִיחֵֽנִי וְאַל־בַּחֲמָתְ֒ךָ תְיַסְּ֒רֵֽנִי: חָנֵּֽנִי יְהֹוָה כִּי אֻמְלַל אָֽנִי רְפָאֵֽנִי יְהֹוָה כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ עֲצָמָי: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה עַד־מָתָי: שׁוּבָה יְהֹוָה חַלְּ֒צָה נַפְשִׁי הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי לְמַֽעַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּֽוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁ֒אוֹל מִי־יוֹדֶה לָּךְ: יָגַֽעְתִּי־בְּאַנְחָתִי אַשְׂחֶה בְכָל־לַֽיְלָה מִטָּתִי בְּדִמְעָתִי עַרְשִׂי אַמְסֶה: עָשְׁ֒שָׁה מִכַּֽעַס עֵינִי עָתְ֒קָה בְּכָל־צוֹרְ֒רָי: סֽוּרוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי כָּל־פֹּֽעֲלֵי אָוֶן כִּי־שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה קוֹל בִּכְיִי: שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה תְּחִנָּתִי יְהֹוָה תְּפִלָּתִי יִקָּח: יֵבֽשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ מְאֹד כָּל־אֹיְ֒בָי יָשֻֽׁבוּ יֵבֽשׁוּ רָֽגַע:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, do not rebuke me with Your anger, nor chastise me with Your rage. Be gracious unto me, Adonoy, for I am desolate, heal me Adonoy, for my bones are terrified. My soul, [too,] is utterly terrified, and You Adonoy, how long? Return Adonoy, free my soul, deliver me for the sake of Your lovingkindness. For in death there is no mention of You; in the lower world who will thank You. I am worn out with my sighing, every night I cause my bed to float; with my tears, I melt my couch. My eye is dimmed from anger, it has aged because of my tormentors. Depart from me, all you evildoers, for Adonoy has heard the voice of my weeping. Adonoy has heard my supplication, Adonoy will (also) accept my prayer. Ashamed and utterly terrified will all my foes be, they will return and be instantaneously ashamed.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ahl be-ah-PE-khah toh-khee-kheh-nee ve-ahl bah-khah-mah-TE-khah te-yah-SE-reh-nee: khah-neh-nee ah-doh-NAI kee oom-lahl ah-nee re-fah-eh-nee ah-doh-NAI kee neev-hah-loo ah-tsah-mahy: ve-nahf-shee neev-hah-lah me-ohd ve-ah-tah ah-doh-NAI ahd mah-tahy: shoo-vah ah-doh-NAI khah-LE-tsah nahf-shee hoh-shee-eh-nee le-mah-ahn khahs-deh-khah: kee eyn bah-mah-veht zeekh-reh-khah BEESH-ohl mee yoh-deh lahkh: yah-gah-e-tee be-ahn-khah-tee ahs-kheh ve-khohl lah-ye-lah mee-tah-tee be-deem-ah-tee ahr-see ahm-seh: ah-SHE-shah mee-kah-ahs ey-nee ah-TE-kah be-khohl tsoh-RE-rahy: soo-roo mee-meh-nee kohl poh-ah-ley ah-vehn kee shah-mah ah-doh-NAI kohl beekh-yee: shah-mah ah-doh-NAI te-khee-nah-tee ah-doh-NAI te-fee-lah-tee yee-kahkh: yeh-v-shoo ve-yee-bah-hah-loo me-ohd kohl oh-YE-vahy yah-shoo-voo yeh-v-shoo rah-gah:

title: Avinu Malkeinu
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Shacharit, Avinu Malkeinu
useCase: Avinu Malkeinu · Siddur Sefard Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בתענית ציבור ובעשי"ת אומרים כאן אבינו מלכנו. גודל מעלת אבינו מלכנו הובא בספרים. ויסדה רבי עקיבא. ונתקן כנגד ברכות אמצעיות דתפלת י"ח דחול. ולפי שיש בו מעין י"ח אין אומרים בשבת.
tokens.translation: During the Ten Days of Penitence, Avinu Malkeinu is recited here during Shacharis—the morning service, and Mincha—the afternoon service. It is also said by some congregations on public Fast Days. The number of petitions in this prayer varies with custom, but in our rite, Avinu Malkeinu consists of 44 petitions. Since many of them are similar to the petitions of Shemoneh Esrei, Avinu Malkeinu is never recited on Shabbos, when the petitions of Shemoneh Esrei are also omitted. This unique and moving prayer is recorded as having been recited by Rabbi Akiva. The Talmud (Maseches Taanis 25b) relates that Rabbi Eliezer once stepped down before the Ark and recited the 24 benedictions for fast days and his prayers were not answered. Rabbi Akiva stepped down after him and exclaimed, "Our Father, our King, we have no king except You. Our Father, our King, for Your sake have mercy on us," and rain fell.
Our Father, our King! we have sinned before You.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:
tokens.translation: Our Father our King! we have no King except You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo eyn lah-noo meh-lehkh eh-lah ah-tah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! deal with us [kindly] for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh ee-mah-noo le-mah-ahn she-meh-khah:

tokens.translation: During the Ten Days of Penitence, say:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חַדֵּשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! renew for us a good year.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-dehsh ah-ley-noo shah-nah toh-vah:

tokens.translation: On public fast-days, say:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בָּרֵךְ עָלֵֽינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! bless us with a good year.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo bah-rehkh ah-ley-noo shah-nah toh-vah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בַּטֵּל מֵעָלֵֽינוּ כָּל גְּזֵרוֹת קָשׁוֹת:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! annul all harsh decrees concerning us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo bah-tehl meh-ah-ley-noo kohl ge-zeh-roht kah-shoht:

tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! annul the designs of those who hate us.
Our Father, our King! thwart the plans of our enemies.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה כָּל צַר וּמַשְׂטִין מֵעָלֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! rid us of every oppressor and adversary.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-leh kohl tsahr oo-mahs-teen meh-ah-ley-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְתוֹם פִּיּוֹת מַשְׂטִינֵֽנוּ וּמְ֒קַטְרִיגֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! seal the mouths of our adversaries and accusers.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo se-tohm pee-yoht mahs-tee-neh-noo oo-ME-kaht-ree-geh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב וּשְׁ֒בִי וּמַשְׁחִית וְעָוֹן וּשְׁ֒מַד מִבְּ֒נֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! remove pestilence, sword, famine, captivity, destruction, [the burden of] iniquity and religious persecution from the members of Your covenant.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-leh deh-vehr ve-kheh-rehv ve-rah-ahv oo-SHE-vee oo-mahsh-kheet ve-ah-vohn oo-SHE-mahd mee-BE-ney ve-ree-teh-khah:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! withhold the plague from Your inheritance.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְלַח וּמְ֒חַל לְכָל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! forgive and pardon all our iniquities.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo se-lahkh oo-ME-khahl le-khohl ah-voh-noh-tey-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! blot out and remove our transgressions and sins from before Your eyes.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo me-kheh ve-hah-ah-vehr pe-shah-ey-noo ve-khah-toh-tey-noo mee-neh-gehd ey-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחוֹק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים כָּל שִׁטְ֒רֵי חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! erase in Your abundant mercy all records of our liabilities.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo me-khohk be-rah-khah-mey-khah hah-rah-beem kohl SHEET-rey khoh-voh-tey-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַחֲזִירֵֽנוּ בִּתְ֒שׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! bring us back in wholehearted repentance before You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo hah-khah-zee-reh-noo BEET-shoo-vah she-leh-mah le-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ שְׁלַח רְפוּאָה שְׁלֵמָה לְחוֹלֵי עַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! send complete healing to the sick among Your people.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo she-lahkh re-foo-ah she-leh-mah le-khoh-ley ah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ קְרַע רֹֽעַ גְּזַר דִּינֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! tear up the evil [parts] of our sentence.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ke-rah roh-ah ge-zahr dee-neh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְ֒רֵֽנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! remember us favorably before You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo zah-KHE-reh-noo be-zee-kah-rohn tohv le-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.translation: The following five prayers are said during the Ten Days of Penitence.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים טוֹבִים:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of the Good Life.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr khah-yeem toh-veem:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר גְּאֻלָּה וִישׁוּעָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Redemption and Deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr ge-oo-lah vee-shoo-ah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר פַּרְנָסָה וְכַלְכָּלָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Maintenance and Sustenance.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr pahr-nah-sah ve-khahl-kah-lah:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Merits.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר סְלִיחָה וּמְ֒חִילָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Pardon and Forgiveness.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr se-lee-khah oo-ME-khee-lah:

tokens.translation: The following five prayers are said on public fast-days.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for a good life.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for redemption and deliverance.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for maintenance and sustenance.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for merit.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for pardon and forgiveness.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַצְמַח לָֽנוּ יְשׁוּעָה בְּקָרוֹב:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! cause deliverance to spring forth for us soon.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo hahts-mahkh lah-noo ye-shoo-ah be-kah-rohv:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הָרֵם קֶֽרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! raise up the might of Your people Israel.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo hah-rehm keh-rehn yees-rah-ehl ah-meh-khah:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! raise up the might of Your anointed.
Our Father, Our King! fill our hands with Your blessings.
Our Father, Our King! fill our storehouses with abundance.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! hear our voice, spare us and have compassion upon us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo she-mah koh-leh-noo khoos ve-rah-khehm ah-ley-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ קַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְ֒רָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! accept our prayer with compassion and favor.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-behl be-rah-khah-meem oo-VE-rah-tsohn eht te-fee-lah-teh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ פְּתַח שַׁעֲרֵי שָׁמַֽיִם לִתְ֒פִלָּתֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! open the gates of heaven to our prayer.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo pe-tahkh shah-ah-rey shah-mah-yeem LEET-fee-lah-teh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכוֹר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָֽחְנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! remember, that we are dust.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo zah-khohr kee ah-fahr ah-nah-khe-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ נָא אַל תְּשִׁיבֵֽנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! Please do not turn us away empty-handed from You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo nah ahl te-shee-veh-noo rey-kahm mee-LE-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תְּהֵא הַשָּׁעָה הַזֹּאת שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים וְעֵת רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! let this hour be an hour of compassion and a time of favor before You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo te-heh hah-shah-ah hah-zoht she-aht rah-khah-meem ve-eht rah-tsohn mee-LE-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חֲמוֹל עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל עוֹלָלֵֽינוּ וְטַפֵּֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! have compassion upon us, and upon our children and infants.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-mohl ah-ley-noo ve-ahl oh-lah-ley-noo ve-tah-peh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן הֲרוּגִים עַל שֵׁם קָדְשֶֽׁךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of those who were slain for Your holy Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn hah-roo-geem ahl shehm kohd-sheh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן טְבוּחִים עַל יִחוּדֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of those who were slaughtered for [proclaiming] Your Unity.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn te-voo-kheem ahl yee-khoo-deh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן בָּאֵי בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּֽיִם עַל קִדּוּשׁ שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of those who went through fire and water for the sanctification of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn bah-ey vah-ehsh oo-vah-mah-yeem ahl kee-doosh she-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ נְקוֹם לְעֵינֵֽינוּ נִקְ֒מַת דַּם עֲבָדֶֽיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! avenge before our eyes the spilled blood of Your servants.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ne-kohm le-ey-ney-noo NEEK-maht dahm ah-vah-dey-khah hah-shah-fookh:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְ֒ךָ אִם לֺא לְמַעֲנֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for Your sake if not for ours.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-AHN-khah eem loh le-mah-ah-neh-noo:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for Your sake and deliver us.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of Your great mercy.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn rah-khah-mey-khah hah-rah-beem:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of Your great, mighty, and awesome Name which is proclaimed upon us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn sheem-khah hah-gah-dohl hah-gee-bohr ve-hah-noh-rah sheh-neek-rah ah-ley-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! favor us and answer us for we have no accomplishments; deal with us charitably and kindly with us and deliver us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-neh-noo vah-ah-neh-noo kee eyn bah-noo mah-ah-seem ah-seh ee-mah-noo tse-dah-kah vah-kheh-sehd ve-hoh-shee-eh-noo:

title: For Monday & Thursday
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Shacharit, For Monday & Thursday
useCase: For Monday & Thursday · Siddur Sefard Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בשני וחמישי יאמר והוא רחום. בשאר ימים שאומרים בהם תחנון יאמר שומר ישראל.
tokens.translation: The following prayers are added on Mondays and Thursday. On other days, continue "Guardian of Israel. . .":

tokens.hebrew: נוהגים להרבות בתחנונים בשני וחמישי משום דאמרינן במדרש דמרע"ה עלה בחמישי לקבל לוחות אחרונות וירד בשני. ואומרים והוא רחום. ויש במדרש דג' זקנים תקנוהו. שתפשם מלך אחד ונתנם בג' ספינות בלא מנהיג. ושלחם לים ונתפזרו למרחקים. ולמקום שבאו הציר להם מאד ועמדו בתפלה וכל אחד יסד מקצת. ובכל חלק י"ח שמות כנגד תפלת י"ח. וימת אותו מלך שהציר להם בתחלואים רעים. ושלחו תפלתם בכל תפוצות ישראל לאמרה בשני וחמישי (ע"פ מחזור מכל השנה)
tokens.translation: This group of somber plaints, known as the "long Vehu Rachum" is recited in the morning service on Mondays and Thursdays, except on days when Tachanun is omitted. The origin of these seven prayers is shrouded in legend. It has been suggested that they were composed during the terrible persecutions at the hands of the Goths in seventh-century Spain. It has been said, "Whoever can read this ‘long Vehu Rachum' prayer without emotion has lost all feeling for what is great and noble." Despite all the repetition in these cries for forgiveness, mercy, help, and protection, the effect is not tiring; because here it is not merely an individual soul, but the soul of an entire people that utters these laments and supplications, that gives voice to this woe of nearly two thousand years. Moses ascended Mount Sinai to receive the Second Tablets on the fifth day of the week, and he returned to the people on the second day of the week, bringing them the new tablets as a security for the Divine covenant and as confirmation of God's atonement for their transgression. Ever since, the second and fifth day of each week, Monday and Thursday, have been days of summons to the Jewish people to assemble anew before God and to reaffirm their sincere "return" to the Law of God. Our regular service is therefore augmented on these days by these additional supplications.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֹא־יָעִיר כָּל־חֲמָתוֹ: אַתָּה יְהֹוָה לֺא תִכְלָא רַחֲמֶֽיךָ מִמֶּֽנּוּ חַסְדְּ֒ךָ וַאֲמִתְּ֒ךָ תָּמִיד יִצְ֒רֽוּנוּ: הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וְקַבְּ֒צֵֽנוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִם לְהוֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶֽׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּֽחַ בִּתְ֒הִלָּתֶֽךָ: אִם־עֲוֺנוֹת תִּשְׁמָר־יָהּ אֲדֹנָי מִי יַעֲמֹד: כִּי־עִמְּ֒ךָ הַסְּ֒לִיחָה לְמַֽעַן תִּוָּרֵא: לֺא כַחֲטָאֵֽינוּ תַּעֲשֶׂה־לָּֽנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵֽינוּ תִּגְמֹל עָלֵֽינוּ: אִם־עֲוֺנֵֽינוּ עָֽנוּ בָֽנוּ יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: זְכָר־רַחֲמֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵֽמָּה: יַעֲנֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם צָרָה יְשַׂגְּ֒בֵֽנוּ שֵׁם אֱלֺהֵי יַעֲקֹב: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵֽנוּ: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה כְּרוֹב רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: אֲדוֹנֵֽינוּ אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ שְׁמַע קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ וּזְ֒כָר־לָֽנוּ אֶת־בְּרִית אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: And He, the merciful One, will atone iniquity, and will not destroy, He frequently withdraws His anger, and does not arouse all His rage. You, Adonoy, do not withhold Your mercy from us; may Your kindness and truth always protect us. Deliver us, Adonoy, our God, and gather us from among the nations to give thanks to Your holy Name to be extolled in Your praise. If You, God, should preserve iniquities, my Master, who could survive? But with You there is forgiveness, [in order] that You may be feared. Do not deal with us according to our sins nor repay us according to our iniquities. If our iniquities testify against us, Adonoy, act [mercifully] for Your Name's sake. Remember Your mercies Adonoy, and Your kindnesses, for they are from the beginning of the world. Adonoy will answer us on the day of distress, the Name of the God of Jacob will fortify us. Adonoy, deliver [us]; the King will answer us on the day we call. Our Father, our King, favor us and answer us, for we have no [good] deeds; deal charitably with us according to Your abundant mercy and deliver us for the sake of Your Name. Our Master, our God, heed our supplications; and remember unto us the covenant of our fathers, and deliver us for Your Name's sake.

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵֽאתָ אֶת־עַמְּ֒ךָ מֵאֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַֽיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וַתַּֽעַשׂ־לְךָ שֵׁם כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה חָטָֽאנוּ רָשָֽׁעְנוּ: אֲדֹנָי כְּכָל־צִדְ֒קֹתֶֽיךָ יָֽשָׁב־נָא אַפְּ֒ךָ וַחֲמָתְ֒ךָ מֵעִירְ֒ךָ יְרוּשָׁלַֽםִ הַר־קָדְשֶֽׁךָ כִּי בַחֲטָאֵֽינוּ וּבַעֲוֺנוֹת אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ יְרוּשָׁלַֽםִ וְעַמְּ֒ךָ לְחֶרְפָּה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵֽינוּ: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תַּחֲנוּנָיו וְהָאֵר פָּנֶֽיךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁ֒ךָ הַשָּׁמֵם לְמַֽעַן אֲדֹנָי:
tokens.translation: And now, my Master, our God, who brought out Your people, from the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and made for Yourself a name to this day;' we have sinned, we have acted wickedly. My Master, with all Your righteousness turn away Your anger and Your rage from Your city, Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are [held] in contempt by all who surround us. And now, listen our God, to the prayers of Your servant and to his supplications; and let Your radiant countenance shine upon Your desolate Sanctuary for Your sake, my Master.

tokens.hebrew: הַטֵּה אֱלֺהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשְׁ֒מָע פְּקַח עֵינֶֽיךָ וּרְ֒אֵה שֹׁמְ֒מוֹתֵֽינוּ וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלֶֽיהָ כִּי לֺא עַל־צִדְ֒קֹתֵֽינוּ אֲנַֽחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵֽינוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ כִּי עַל־רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים: אֲדֹנָי שְׁמָֽעָה אֲדֹנָי סְלָֽחָה אֲדֹנָי הַקְשִֽׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל־תְּאַחַר: לְמַעַנְ֒ךָ אֱלֺהַי כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־עִירְ֒ךָ וְעַל־עַמֶּֽךָ: אָבִֽינוּ אָב הָרַחֲמָן הַרְאֵֽנוּ אוֹת לְטוֹבָה וְקַבֵּץ נְפוּצוֹתֵֽינוּ מֵאַרְבַּע כַּנְ֒פוֹת הָאָֽרֶץ: יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְ֒עוּ כָּל־הַגּוֹיִם כִּי אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ: וְעַתָּה יְהֹוָה אָבִֽינוּ אָֽתָּה אֲנַֽחְנוּ הַחֹֽמֶר וְאַתָּה יֹצְ֒רֵֽנוּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדְ֒ךָ כֻּלָּֽנוּ: הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ צוּרֵֽנוּ וְגוֹאֲלֵֽנוּ: חֽוּסָה יְהֹוָה עַל־עַמֶּֽךָ וְאַל־תִּתֵּן נַחֲלָתְ֒ךָ לְחֶרְפָּה לִמְשָׁל־בָּם גּוֹיִם: לָֽמָּה יֹאמְ֒רוּ בָעַמִּים אַיֵּה (נָא) אֱלֺהֵיהֶם: יָדַֽעְנוּ יְהֺוָה כִּי חָטָֽאנוּ וְאֵין מִי יַעֲמֹד בַּעֲדֵֽנוּ אֶלָּא שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל יַעֲמָד־לָֽנוּ בְּעֵת צָרָה: יָדַֽעְנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים צְדָקָה עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים כֵּן תְּרַחֵם יְהֹוָה עָלֵֽינוּ וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: חֲמוֹל עַל עַמֶּֽךָ רַחֵם עַל נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ חֽוּסָה־נָּא כְּרוֹב רַחֲמֶֽיךָ חָנֵּֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַצְּ֒דָקָה עֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת בְּכָל עֵת:
tokens.translation: Incline Your ear, my God, and hear; open Your eyes and behold our desolate places and the city which is called by Your Name, for it is not on account of our righteousness that we let fall our supplications before You, but because of Your great mercy. My Master, hear! my Master, forgive! my Master, listen and take action, do not delay! For Your sake, my God, for Your Name is proclaimed over Your city and Your people. Our Father, merciful Father, show us a sign for good and gather our dispersed [people] from the four corners of the earth, [so that] all nations will recognize and know that You, Adonoy, are our God. And now, Adonoy, You are our Father; we are the clay and You are our Former; and we are all the work of Your hand. Deliver us, for Your Name's sake our Father, our King, our Rock and our Redeemer. Adonoy, spare Your people, and let not Your heritage be [an object] of contempt for nations to rule over. Why should they say among the peoples, Where is their God? Adonoy, we know that we have sinned, and there is none to stand up in our behalf; let Your great Name, then, stand up for us at the time of distress. We know that we have no [good] deeds, [therefore] deal charitably with us for Your Name's sake. As a father has compassion on his children, so do You have compassion on us, Adonoy, and [therefore] deliver us for Your Name's sake. Have pity on Your people, have compassion on Your heritage, spare us with Your great mercy; favor us. our King, and answer us, for righteousness is Yours, Adonoy, Who performs wonders at all times.

tokens.hebrew: הַבֶּט־נָא רַחֶם־נָא וְהוֹשִֽׁיעָה־נָא צֹאן מַרְעִיתֶֽךָ וְאַל יִמְשָׁל־בָּֽנוּ קֶֽצֶף כִּי לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַיְ֒שׁוּעָה: בְּךָ תוֹחַלְתֵּֽנוּ אֱלֽוֹהַּ סְלִיחוֹת אָנָּא סְלַח־נָא כִּי אֵל טוֹב וְסַלָּח אָֽתָּה:
tokens.translation: Look, we beseech You, speedily have compassion and deliver the sheep of Your pasture; let wrath not prevail over us, for, Adonoy, deliverance is Yours. Our hope rests with You, God of forgiveness; please forgive [us], for You Almighty, are good, and forgiving.
tokens.transliteration: hah-beht nah rah-khehm nah ve-hoh-shee-ah nah tsohn mahr-ee-teh-khah ve-ahl yeem-shahl bah-noo keh-tsehf kee le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-YE-shoo-ah: be-khah toh-khahl-teh-noo eh-loh-ahh se-lee-khoht ah-nah se-lahkh nah kee ehl tohv ve-sah-lahkh ah-tah:

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּא מֶֽלֶךְ חַנוּן וְרַחוּם זְכוֹר וְהַבֵּט לִבְ֒רִית בֵּין הַבְּ֒תָרִים וְתֵרָאֶה לְפָנֶֽיךָ עֲקֵדַת יָחִיד וּלְ֒מַֽעַן יִשְׂרָאֵל אָבִֽינוּ: אַל־תַּעַזְ֒בֵֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ וְאַל־תִּטְּ֒שֵֽׁנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ וְאַל־תִּשְׁכָּחֵֽנוּ יוֹצְ֒רֵֽנוּ וְאַל־תַּֽעַשׁ עִמָּֽנוּ כָּלָה בְּגָלוּתֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה:
tokens.translation: We beseech You, gracious and compassionate King, remember and look to the Covenant between the divided pieces, and let appear before You the binding [upon the Altar] of the only son, and for the sake of Israel, our father. Do not abandon us our father, do not cast us off our King, do not forget us our Creator, and do not bring destruction upon us in our exile for You are the Almighty who is King, gracious and merciful.

tokens.hebrew: אֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ אֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ אֵל אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וְרַב חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ וְרַחֲמֵֽנוּ בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים מֵרַֽעַשׁ וּמֵרֺֽגֶז הַצִּילֵֽנוּ: זְכֺר לַעֲבָדֶֽיךָ לְאַבְרָהָם לְיִצְחָק וּלְ֒יַעֲקֹב אַל־תֵּֽפֶן אֶל־קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה וְאֶל־רִשְׁעוֹ וְאֶל־חַטָּאתוֹ: שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּֽךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּֽךָ: וְהָסֵר מִמֶּֽנּוּ מַכַּת הַמָּֽוֶת כִּי רַחוּם אָֽתָּה: כִּי כֵן דַּרְכֶּֽךָ עֹשֶׂה חֶֽסֶד חִנָּם בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר: חֽוּסָה יְהֹוָה עַל־עַמֶּֽךָ וְהַצִּילֵֽנוּ מִזַּעְמֶֽךָ: וְהָסֵר מִמֶּֽנּוּ מַכַּת הַמַּגֵּפָה וּגְ֒זֵרָה קָשָׁה כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל: לְךָ אֲדֹנָי הַצְּ֒דָקָה וְלָֽנוּ בּֽשֶׁת הַפָּנִים: מַה־נִּתְאוֹנֵן וּמַה־נֹּאמַר מַה־נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה־נִּצְטַּדָּק: נַחְפְּשָׂה דְרָכֵֽינוּ וְנַחְקֺֽרָה וְנָשֽׁוּבָה אֵלֶֽיךָ כִּי יְמִינְ֒ךָ פְשׁוּטָה לְקַבֵּל שָׁבִים: אָֽנָּא יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה נָּא אָֽנָּא יְהֹוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָא: אָֽנָּא יְהֹוָה עֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ: לְךָ יְהֹוָה חִכִּֽינוּ לְךָ יְהֹוָה קִוִּינוּ לְךָ יְהֹוָה נְיַחֵל אַל תֶּחֱשֶׁה וּתְ֒עַנֵּֽנוּ כִּי נָאֲמוּ גוֹיִם אָבְ֒דָה תִקְוָתָם: כָּל־בֶּֽרֶךְ לְךָ תִכְרַע וְכָל־קוֹמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ לְבַד תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה:
tokens.translation: There is none like You, gracious and merciful Adonoy, our God; there is none like You, Almighty, slow to anger, abundant in kindliness and truth. Deliver us, and have mercy on us with Your great mercy, save us from storm and rage. Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not consider the stubbornness of this people, their wickedness, and their sinfulness. Turn from Your fierce anger and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil [intended] for Your people. Remove from us the scourge of death, for You are merciful; for such is Your way— to bestow undeserved kindness in every generation. Spare Your people, Adonoy, and save us from Your wrath; remove from us the scourge of plague, and harsh decree, for You are the Guardian of Israel. Righteousness is Yours, my Master, while shame is ours. How can we complain? What can we say? What can we speak? and how can we justify ourselves? Let us search into our ways and examine them, and return to You; for Your right hand is extended to receive those who repent. We beseech You Adonoy!—deliver us. We beseech You Adonoy!—grant us success; We beseech You Adonoy! — answer us on the day we call. For You, Adonoy, we have waited, For You, Adonoy, we have hoped, For You, Adonoy, we yearn. Do not be silent, and do not allow us to be tormented; for the nations have said, "Their hope is lost." Let every knee bend to You and all who stand erect prostrate themselves before You

tokens.hebrew: הַפּוֹתֵֽחַ יָד בִּתְ֒שׁוּבָה לְקַבֵּל פּוֹשְׁ֒עִים וְחַטָּאִים נִבְהֲלָה נַפְשֵֽׁנוּ מֵרוֹב עִצְּ֒בוֹנֵֽנוּ אַל־תִּשְׁכָּחֵֽנוּ נֶֽצַח קֽוּמָה וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ: אַל־תִּשְׁפּוֹךְ חֲרוֹנְ֒ךָ עָלֵֽינוּ כִּי אֲנַֽחְנוּ עַמְּ֒ךָ בְּנֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ: אֵל הַבִּֽיטָה דַּל כְּבוֹדֵֽנוּ בַּגּוֹיִם וְשִׁקְּ֒צֽוּנוּ כְּטֻמְאַת הַנִּדָּה: עַד־מָתַי עֻזְּ֒ךָ בַּשְּׁ֒בִי וְתִפְאַרְתְּ֒ךָ בְּיַד־צָר: עוֹרְ֒רָה גְבוּרָתְ֒ךָ וְהוֹשִׁעֵֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: אַל־יִמְעֲטוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּלָאוֹתֵֽינוּ: מַהֵר יְקַדְּ֒מֽוּנוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ בְּעֵת צָרוֹתֵֽינוּ, לֺא לְמַעֲנֵֽנוּ אֶלָּא לְמַעַנְ֒ךָ פְעַל, וְאַל תַּשְׁחִית אֶת־זֵֽכֶר שְׁאֵרִיתֵֽנוּ, כִּי לְךָ מְיַחֲלוֹת עֵינֵֽינוּ כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה: וּזְ֒כוֹר עֵדוּתֵֽנוּ בְּכָל־יוֹם תָּמִיד אוֹמְ֒רִים פַּעֲמַֽיִם בְּאַהֲבָה: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: You Who opens Your hand to [accept] repentance, to receive transgressors and sinners: our soul is terrified from our great sorrow— forget us not forever; arise and deliver us. Do not pour out Your wrath upon us, for we are Your people, the children of Your covenant. Almighty, look! Our glory has sunk low among the nations, and they abominate us like the impurity of the nidah. How long will Your strength be in captivity, and Your glory, in the hand of the foe? Arouse Your might and deliver us for the sake of Your Name, let our sufferings not seem trivial to You. May Your mercy come swiftly toward us in time of our distress; not for our sake, but do it for Your sake, and do not obliterate the remembrance of our remnant, for our eyes look hopefully to You, for You are the Almighty Who is King, Gracious, and Merciful. Remember our testimony every day we proclaim twice a day with love: Hear Israel, Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One.

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּֽךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Israel, turn from Your fierce anger, and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil intended for Your people.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey yees-rah-ehl shoov meh-khah-rohn ah-peh-khah ve-hee-nah-khehm ahl hah-rah-ah le-ah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: הַבֵּט מִשָּׁמַֽיִם וּרְ֒אֵה כִּי הָיִֽינוּ לַֽעַג וָקֶֽלֶס בַּגּוֹיִם: נֶחְשַֽׁבְנוּ כַּצֹּאן לָטֶֽבַח יוּבָל, לַהֲרוֹג וּלְ֒אַבֵּד וּלְ֒מַכָּה וּלְ֒חֶרְפָּה: וּבְכָל־זֹאת שִׁמְךָ לֺא שָׁכָֽחְנוּ נָא אַל־תִּשְׁכָּחֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Look from heaven and behold that we have become [an object] of scorn and derision among the nations; we are considered as the sheep led to the slaughter to be slain and destroyed, tortured and humiliated. And yet despite all this, we have not forgotten Your Name; please, do not forget us.
tokens.transliteration: hah-beht mee-shah-mah-yeem oo-RE-eh kee hah-yee-noo lah-ahg vah-keh-lehs bah-goh-yeem: nehkh-shah-ve-noo kah-tsohn lah-teh-vahkh yoo-vahl, lah-hah-rohg oo-LE-ah-behd oo-LE-mah-kah oo-LE-khehr-pah: oo-ve-khohl zoht sheem-khah loh shah-khah-khe-noo nah ahl teesh-kah-kheh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּֽךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Israel, turn from Your fierce anger, and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil intended for Your people.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey yees-rah-ehl shoov meh-khah-rohn ah-peh-khah ve-hee-nah-khehm ahl hah-rah-ah le-ah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: זָרִים אוֹמְ֒רִים אֵין תּוֹחֶֽלֶת וְתִקְוָה: חוֹן אוֹם לְשִׁמְךָ מְקַוֶּה: טָהוֹר, יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ קָרְ֒בָה, יָגַֽעְנוּ וְלֺא הֽוּנַח־לָֽנוּ: רַחֲמֶֽיךָ יִכְבְּ֒שׁוּ אֶת־כַּעַסְ֒ךָ מֵעָלֵֽינוּ: אָנָּא שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹנְ֒ךָ וְרַחֵם סְגֻלָּה אֲשֶׁר בָּחָֽרְתָּ:
tokens.translation: Strangers say: there is no hope or expectation [for us.] Be gracious to the people who place their hope in Your Name. Pure One, bring our deliverance near; we are weary and no relief is granted us. May Your mercy suppress Your anger from us. We beseech You, turn from Your anger, and have compassion on the treasured people whom You have chosen.

tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Israel, turn from Your fierce anger, and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil intended for Your people.

tokens.hebrew: חֽוּסָה יְהֹוָה עָלֵֽינוּ בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ, וְאַל תִּתְּ֒נֵֽנוּ בִּידֵי אַכְזָרִים: לָֽמָּה יֹאמְ֒רוּ הַגּוֹיִם אַיֵּה־נָא אֱלֺהֵיהֶם לְמַעַנְ֒ךָ עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ חֶֽסֶד וְאַל תְּאַחַר: אָנָּא שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹנְ֒ךָ וְרַחֵם סְגֻלָּה אֲשֶׁר בָּחָֽרְתָּ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, in Your mercy, spare us, do not discard us in the hands of cruel foes. Why should the nations say: Where now is their God? For Your sake, deal kindly with us and do not delay. We beseech You, turn from Your anger, and have compassion on the treasured people whom You have chosen.

tokens.hebrew: קוֹלֵֽנוּ תִשְׁמַע וְתָחוֹן וְאַל־תִּטְּ֒שֵֽׁנוּ בְּיַד אֹיְ֒בֵֽינוּ לִמְחוֹת אֶת־שְׁמֵֽנוּ: זְכוֹר אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, כְּכוֹכְ֒בֵי הַשָּׁמַֽיִם אַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעֲכֶם וְעַתָּה נִשְׁאַֽרְנוּ מְעַט מֵהַרְבֵּה: וּבְכָל־זֹאת שִׁמְךָ לֺא שָׁכָֽחְנוּ נָא אַל תִּשְׁכָּחֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Hear our voice and be gracious, do not cast us off into the hands of our enemies to obliterate our name. Remember what You have sworn to our fathers: Like the stars of the heavens will I multiply your descendants, and now, we are left only a few out of many. And yet despite all this, we have not forgotten Your Name; please, do not forget us.

tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Israel, turn from Your fierce anger, and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil intended for Your people.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey yees-rah-ehl shoov meh-khah-rohn ah-peh-khah ve-hee-nah-khehm ahl hah-rah-ah le-ah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: עָזְ֒רֵֽנוּ אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶֽךָ וְהַצִּילֵֽנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Help us, God of our deliverance for the sake of the glory of Your Name; save us and atone our sins for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-ZE-reh-noo eh-loh-hey yeesh-eh-noo ahl de-vahr ke-vohd she-meh-khah ve-hah-tsee-leh-noo ve-khah-pehr ahl khah-toh-tey-noo le-mah-ahn she-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל שׁוּב מֵחֲרוֹן אַפֶּֽךָ וְהִנָּחֵם עַל־הָרָעָה לְעַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Israel, turn from Your fierce anger, and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil intended for Your people.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey yees-rah-ehl shoov meh-khah-rohn ah-peh-khah ve-hee-nah-khehm ahl hah-rah-ah le-ah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַל יֹאבַד יִשְׂרָאֵל הָאֹמְ֒רִים שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: Guardian of Israel, guard the remnant of Israel, and let not Israel perish, who say, "Hear Israel."

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר גּוֹי אֶחָד שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית עַם אֶחָד וְאַל יֹאבַד גּוֹי אֶחָד הַמְ֒יַחֲדִים שִׁמְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: Guardian of the unique nation, guard the remnant of the unique people, and let not the unique nation perish, who proclaim the Oneness of Your Name, [saying:] Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-mehr gohy eh-khahd she-mohr she-eh-reet ahm eh-khahd ve-ahl yoh-vahd gohy eh-khahd hah-ME-yah-khah-deem sheem-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo ah-doh-NAI eh-khahd:

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר גּוֹי קָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית עַם קָדוֹשׁ וְאַל יֹאבַד גּוֹי קָדוֹשׁ הַמְ֒שַׁלְּ֒שִׁים בְּשָׁלשׁ קְדֻשּׁוֹת לְקָדוֹשׁ:
tokens.translation: Guardian of the holy nation, guard the remnant of the holy people and let not the holy nation perish who repeat the threefold sanctification to the Holy One.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-mehr gohy kah-dohsh she-mohr she-eh-reet ahm kah-dohsh ve-ahl yoh-vahd gohy kah-dohsh hah-ME-shah-LE-sheem be-shahlsh ke-doo-shoht le-kah-dohsh:

tokens.hebrew: מִתְרַצֶּה בְּרַחֲמִים וּמִתְפַּיֵּס בְּתַחֲנוּנִים הִתְרַצֶּה וְהִתְפַּיֵּס לְדוֹר עָנִי כִּי אֵין עוֹזֵר: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: You Who are appeased by pleas for mercy, and conciliated by supplications, be appeased and conciliated to an afflicted generation, for there is none else to help. Our Father, our King! be gracious to us and answer us for we have no [good] deeds, deal with us charitably and kindly and deliver us.
tokens.transliteration: meet-rah-tseh be-rah-khah-meem oo-meet-pah-yehs be-tah-khah-noo-neem heet-rah-tseh ve-heet-pah-yehs le-dohr ah-nee kee eyn oh-zehr: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-neh-noo vah-ah-neh-noo kee eyn bah-noo mah-ah-seem ah-seh ee-mah-noo tse-dah-kah vah-kheh-sehd ve-hoh-shee-eh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ לֺא נֵדַע מַה נַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי עָלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵֽמָּה: יְהִי חַסְדְּ֒ךָ יְהֹוָה עָלֵֽינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַֽלְנוּ לָךְ: אַל תִּזְכָּר לָֽנוּ עֲוֹנוֹת רִאשׁוֹנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּ֒מֽוּנוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ כִּי דַלּֽוֹנוּ מְאֹד: עֶזְרֵֽנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַֽיִם וְאָֽרֶץ: חָנֵּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה חָנֵּֽנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַֽעְנוּ בוּז: בְּרֺֽגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר: בְּרֹֽגֶז עַקֵדָה תִּזְכּוֹר, בְּרֹֽגֶז תְּמִימוֹת תִּזְכּוֹר: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ: כִּי הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵֽנוּ זָכוּר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָֽחְנוּ: עָזְ֒רֵֽנוּ אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶֽךָ וְהַצִּילֵֽנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: As for us, we know not what to do; but our eyes are upon You. Remember Your mercies, Adonoy, and kindnesses for they are from the beginning of the world. Adonoy! may Your kindness be upon us, as we have waited for You. Remember not the sins of our ancestors; let Your mercy come swiftly toward us, for we have been brought very low. Help us for the Name of Adonoy Creator of Heaven and earth. Be gracious to us, Adonoy, be gracious to us for we are saturated with humiliation. [Even] in anger remember to have compassion. [Even] in anger remember the binding of Isaac. Even in anger remember the uprightness of Jacob Adonoy deliver [us] the King will answer us on the day we call. For He knows of what we are made; He is mindful that we are but dust. Help us, God of our deliverance, for the sake of the glory of Your Name; save us and atone our sins, for the sake of Your Name.

tokens.translation: The Chazzan recites the Half Kaddish

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְ֒מָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ וְיַצְמַח פּוּרְקָנֵהּ וִיקָרֵב (קֵץ) מְשִׁיחֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom bring forth His redemption and hasten the coming if His Messiah in your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-gah-dahl ve-yeet-kah-dahsh she-meh rah-bah be-ah-LE-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh ve-yahts-mahkh poo-re-kah-neh vee-kah-rehv (kehts) me-shee-kheh be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl, bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא:
tokens.translation: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא
tokens.translation: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He;
tokens.transliteration: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah, be-reekh hoo

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵֽלָּא (בעשי"ת וּלְ֒עֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) מִן כָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: le-eh-lah (vshyt" oo-LE-eh-lah mee-kahl) meen kohl beer-khah-tah ve-shee-rah-tah, toosh-be-khah-tah ve-neh-kheh-mah-tah, dah-ah-mee-rahn be-ah-LE-mah, ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: אשרי ובא לציון. כשמכריזים דבר יש להכריז קודם שיתחיל החזן אשרי (מגן אברהם סי' קלב)
tokens.translation: On days when the Torah is not read continue with Ashrei.

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁ֒בֵי בֵיתֶֽךָ עוֹד יְהַלְ֒לֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּֽכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְהֹוָה אֱלֺהָיו: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ וַאֲבָרְ֒כָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרְ֒כֶֽךָ וַאֲהַלְ֒לָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְ֒דֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵֽקֶר: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְ֒בוּרֹתֶֽיךָ יַגִּֽידוּ: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶֽךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְ֒אֹתֶֽיךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְ֒אוֹתֶֽיךָ יֹאמֵֽרוּ וּגְ֒דֻלָּתְ֒ךָ אֲסַפְּ֒רֶֽנָּה: זֵֽכֶר רַב־טוּבְ֒ךָ יַבִּֽיעוּ וְצִדְ֒קָתְ֒ךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וּגְ֒דָל־חָֽסֶד: טוֹב־יְהֹוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו: יוֹדֽוּךָ יְהֹוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶֽיךָ יְבָרְ֒כֽוּכָה: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְ֒ךָ יֹאמֵֽרוּ וּגְ֒בוּרָתְ֒ךָ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ: לְהוֹדִֽיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְ֒בוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ: מַלְכוּתְ֒ךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּ֒ךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדֹר: סוֹמֵךְ יְהֹוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְ֒לִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּ֒פוּפִים: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶֽיךָ יְשַׂבֵּֽרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ: פּוֹתֵֽחַ אֶת־יָדֶֽךָ וּמַשְׂבִּֽיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן: צַדִּיק יְהֹוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו: קָרוֹב יְהֹוָה לְכָל־קֹרְ֒אָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻֽהוּ בֶאֱמֶת: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם: שׁוֹמֵר יְהֹוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְ֒שָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד: תְּהִלַּת יְהֹוָה יְדַבֶּר פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְ֒לוּיָהּ:
tokens.translation: Fortunate are those who dwell in Your house; may they continue to praise You, Selah. Fortunate is the people whose lot is thus; Fortunate is the people for whom Adonoy is their God. A praise by David! I will exalt You, my God, the King, and bless Your Name forever and ever. Every day I will bless You and extol Your Name forever and ever. Adonoy is great and highly extolled, and His greatness is unfathomable. One generation to another will praise Your works and Your mighty acts they will declare. The splendor of Your glorious majesty, and the words of Your wonders I will speak. Of Your awesome might, they will speak, and Your greatness I will recount. Mention of Your bountifulness they will express, and in Your righteousness joyfully exult. Adonoy is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and great in kindliness. Adonoy is good to all, His mercy encompasses all His works. All Your works will thank You, Adonoy, and Your pious ones will bless You. Of the honor of Your kingship, they will speak and Your might they will declare. To reveal to men His mighty acts, and the glorious splendor of His kingship. Your kingship is the kingship for all times, and Your dominion is in every generation. Adonoy supports all the fallen, and straightens all the bent. The eyes of all look expectantly to You, and You give them their food at its proper time. You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living being. Adonoy is just in all His ways, and benevolent in all His deeds. Adonoy is near to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth. The will of those who fear Him He fulfills; He hears their cry and delivers them. Adonoy watches over all those who love Him, and will destroy all the wicked. Praise of Adonoy, my mouth will declare, and all flesh will bless His holy Name forever and ever. And we will bless God from now on forever. Praise God.

tokens.hebrew: אלו ימים שאין אומרים בהם למנצח ואל ארך אפים. ר"ח חנוכה ופורים ערב פסח וערב יו"כ ותשעה באב. והוא הדין ביום י"ד וט"ו באדר ראשון. גם אין אומרים אותם בבית האבל דכללא הוא דאא"א ולמנצח דינם שוה. (דה"ח)
tokens.translation: Psalm 20 is omitted on the following days: Rosh Chodesh, the day before Yom Kippur, Chanukah, both days of Purim, the day before Passover, the intermediate days of the Festivals (Chol HaMoed), and Tisha b'Av. It is also omitted when prayers are recited in the house of a mourner, the entire month of Nisssan, Pesach Sheni (14th of Iyar) Lag-b'omer, from Rosh Codesh Sivan through the twelfth of the month i.e., 5 days after Shavuoth, the Fifteenth of av, from Erev Yom Kippur until the end of Tishre, the Fifteenth of Shevat, when there is a circumcision in the Synagogue, or when a bride groom during the seven days of his wedding celebration is present.

tokens.hebrew: מה שתקנו לאומרו בסוף התפלה מפני שאומר במדרש תלים אמר ר' שמעון בר אבא אתה מוצא י"ח מזמורים מראש הספר ועד פסוק זה ואשרי האיש ולמה רגשו גוים חד הוא כנגד י"ח ברכות שאדם מתפלל בכל יום. אדם אומר לחבירו תתעני צלותך כך דוד המלך לאחר ששר י"ח שירות ותושבחות אמר יענך ה' ביום צרה והכי איתא בירושלמי. ובשבתות ובימים טובים אין אומרים אותו מפני שהוא מזמור של תחנה וגם הוא מתחיל יענך ה' ביום צרה ושבתות וימים טובים אינם ימי צרה אלא ימי שמחה. (אבודרהם)
tokens.translation: According to Rabbi S.R. Hirsch, this psalm is addressed to David by the people of Israel. It is a testimonial of trust that the people have in the Divinely-appointed king, who is accustomed to victory and triumph. At the same time, it proclaims the eternal truth that the victories which our king wins for our people are to be attributed not to his bravery, nor to his sword, nor to his soldiers, but solely to his relationship with God, His Sanctuary, and His Law.

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּֽחַ מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד: יַעַנְ֒ךָ יְהֹוָה בְּיוֹם צָרָה יְשַׂגֶּבְ֒ךָ שֵׁם אֱלֺהֵי יַעֲקֹב: יִשְׁלַח עֶזְרְךָ מִקֹּֽדֶשׁ וּמִצִּיּוֹן יִסְעָדֶֽךָּ: יִזְכֹּר כָּל מִנְחֹתֶֽיךָ וְעוֹלָתְ֒ךָ יְדַשְּׁ֒נֶה סֶּֽלָה: יִתֶּן לְךָ כִלְ֒בָבֶֽךָ וְכָל עֲצָתְ֒ךָ יְמַלֵּא: נְרַנְּ֒נָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ וּבְ֒שֵׁם אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ נִדְגֹּל יְמַלֵּא יְהֹוָה כָּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ: עַתָּה יָדַֽעְתִּי כִּי הוֹשִֽׁיעַ יְהֹוָה מְשִׁיחוֹ יַעֲנֵֽהוּ מִשְּׁ֒מֵי קָדְשׁוֹ בִּגְ֒בוּרוֹת יֵֽשַׁע יְמִינוֹ: אֵֽלֶּה בָרֶֽכֶב וְאֵֽלֶּה בַסּוּסִים וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ נַזְכִּיר: הֵֽמָּה כָּרְ֒עוּ וְנָפָֽלוּ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ קַֽמְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָד: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: To Him Who grants victory, a Psalm of David May Adonoy answer you on the day of distress; May the Name of Jacob's God fortify you. May He send your help from the Sanctuary, and support you from Zion. May He remember all your meal-offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifices, Selah. May He grant you what your heart desires, and fulfill all your plans. We will sing at Your deliverance, and in the Name of our God, raise our banners; May Adonoy fulfill all your wishes. Now I know that Adonoy has delivered His anointed one, He will answer him from His holy heavens with the mighty deliverance of His right hand. Some [rely] upon chariots and some upon horses, but as for us, upon the Name of Adonoy, our God, we call. They have bowed down and fallen, but we have risen and stand firm. Adonoy, deliver [us], the King will answer us on the day we call.
tokens.transliteration: lahm-nah-tseh-ahkh meez-mohr le-dah-veed: yah-AHN-khah ah-doh-NAI be-yohm tsah-rah ye-sah-GEHV-khah shehm eh-loh-hey yah-ah-kohv: yeesh-lahkh ehz-re-khah mee-koh-dehsh oo-mee-tsee-yohn yees-ah-deh-kah: yeez-kohr kohl meen-khoh-tey-khah ve-oh-lah-TE-khah ye-dah-SHE-neh seh-lah: yee-tehn le-khah KHEEL-vah-veh-khah ve-khohl ah-tsah-TE-khah ye-mah-leh: ne-rah-NE-nah bee-shoo-ah-teh-khah oo-VE-shehm eh-loh-hey-noo need-gohl ye-mah-leh ah-doh-NAI kohl meesh-ah-loh-tey-khah: ah-tah yah-dah-e-tee kee hoh-shee-ah ah-doh-NAI me-shee-khoh yah-ah-neh-hoo mee-SHE-mey kohd-shoh BEEG-voo-roht yeh-shah ye-mee-noh: eh-leh vah-reh-khehv ve-eh-leh vah-soo-seem vah-ahnah-khe-noo be-shehm ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo nahz-keer: heh-mah kah-RE-oo ve-nah-fah-loo vah-ahnah-khe-noo kah-me-noo vah-neet-oh-dahd: ah-doh-NAI hoh-shee-ah hah-meh-lehkh yah-ah-neh-noo ve-yohm kah-re-eh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: מה שתקנו סדר קדושה בסוף התפלה בעבור עמי הארץ המאחרים לבא לתפלה שלא יפסידו שמיעת הקדושה. דאמרינן בשלהי סוטה אמאי קאי עלמא אסדרא דקדושה ואיהא שמיה רבה דאגדתא. ולכך תקנו לתרגם סדר קדושה זה כדי שיבינו עמי הארץ שאין מכירים לדבר בלשון הקדש אלא בלשון תרגום שהיו רגילין לדבר בו באותו זמן. (אבודרהם)
tokens.translation: This portion, known as Kedushas d'Sidra, was introduced at the conclusion of the morning service to accomodate those who came to the synagogue too late to hear the Kedushah in Shemoneh Esrei. The Talmud (Maseches Sotah 49a) declares that the world is preserved solely by virtue of this Kedushah, and by the virtue of our answering, "May His great Name," which is part of the Kaddish recited following the study of the Aggadah. Because of its importance, a vernacular translation in Aramaic was added, so that even those ignorant of Hebrew would understand the sacred words.

tokens.hebrew: וּבָא לְצִיּוֹן גּוֹאֵל וּלְ֒שָׁבֵי פֶֽשַׁע בְּיַעֲקֹב נְאֻם יְהֹוָה: וַאֲנִי זֹאת בְּרִיתִי אֹתָם אָמַר יְהֹוָה רוּחִי אֲשֶׁר עָלֶֽיךָ וּדְ֒בָרַי אֲשֶׁר שַֽׂמְתִּי בְּפִֽיךָ לֺא יָמֽוּשׁוּ מִפִּֽיךָ וּמִפִּי זַרְעֲךָ וּמִפִּי זֶֽרַע זַרְעֲךָ אָמַר יְהֹוָה מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: The Redeemer shall come to Zion and to those of Jacob who repent from sin, says Adonoy. As for Me, this is My covenant with them, said Adonoy: My spirit which is upon you, and My words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your children, nor from the mouth of your children's children, said Adonoy— from now to eternity.
tokens.transliteration: oo-vah le-tsee-yohn goh-ehl oo-LE-shah-vey feh-shah be-yah-ah-kohv ne-oom ah-doh-NAI: vah-ah-nee zoht be-ree-tee oh-tahm ah-mahr ah-doh-NAI roo-khee ah-shehr ah-ley-khah oo-DE-vah-rahy ah-shehr sah-me-tee be-fee-khah loh yah-moo-shoo mee-pee-khah oo-mee-pee zahr-ah-khah oo-mee-pee zeh-rah zahr-ah-khah ah-mahr ah-doh-NAI meh-ah-tah ve-ahd oh-lahm:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל: וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל זֶה וְאָמַר קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת מְלֺא כָל הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ:
tokens.translation: (This next section is the actual Kedushah d'Sidra) And You, Holy One, are enthroned upon the praises of Israel. And [the angels] call one to another and say: Holy, holy, holy is Adonoy of Hosts: the fullness of all the earth is His glory."
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-tah kah-dohsh yoh-shehv te-hee-loht yees-rah-ehl: ve-kah-rah zeh ehl zeh ve-ah-mahr kah-dohsh kah-dohsh kah-dohsh ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht me-loh khohl hah-ah-rehts ke-voh-doh:

tokens.hebrew: וּמְ֒קַבְּ֒לִין דֵּין מִן דֵּין וְאָמְ֒רִין קַדִּישׁ בִּשְׁ֒מֵי מְרוֹמָא עִלָּאָה בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ קַדִּישׁ עַל אַרְעָא עוֹבַד גְּבוּרְתֵּהּ קַדִּישׁ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת, מַלְיָא כָל אַרְעָא זִיו יְקָרֵהּ:
tokens.translation: And they receive [sanction] one from another, and say, Holy in the highest heights of heaven, the abode of His Divine Presence; holy upon earth, the work of His mighty power; holy forever and to all eternity— is Adonoy of hosts; the whole earth is filled with the radiance of His glory.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ME-kah-BE-leen deyn meen deyn ve-ah-ME-reen kah-deesh BEESH-mey me-roh-mah ee-lah-ah beyt she-khee-ne-teh kah-deesh ahl ahr-ah oh-vahd ge-voo-re-teh kah-deesh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht, mahl-yah khohl ahr-ah zeev ye-kah-reh:

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּשָּׂאֵֽנִי רֽוּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַע אַחֲרַי קוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה מִמְּ֒קוֹמוֹ:
tokens.translation: And a wind lifted me; and I heard behind me the sound of a great rushing; Blessed is the glory of Adonoy from His place.
tokens.transliteration: vah-tee-sah-eh-nee roo-ahkh vah-ehsh-mah ah-khah-rahy kohl rah-ahsh gah-dohl bah-rookh ke-vohd ah-doh-NAI mee-ME-koh-moh:

tokens.hebrew: וּנְ֒טָלַתְנִי רוּחָא וּשְׁמָעִית בַּתְרַי קָל זִֽיעַ סַגִּיא דִּמְ֒שַׁבְּ֒חִין וְאָמְ֒רִין בְּרִיךְ יְקָרָא דַיהוָֹה מֵאֲתַר בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ:
tokens.translation: And a wind lifted me and I heard behind me a sound of a great rushing of those who uttered praises and said, ‘Blessed is the glory of Adonoy from the place, the abode of His Divine Presence.
tokens.transliteration: oo-NE-tah-laht-nee roo-khah oo-she-mah-eet baht-rahy kahl zee-ah sah-gee DEEM-shah-BE-kheen ve-ah-ME-reen be-reekh ye-kah-rah dah-ah-doh-NAI meh-ah-tahr beyt she-khee-ne-teh:

tokens.translation: Adonoy will reign forever and ever.

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה מַלְכוּתֵהּ קָאֵים לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, His kingdom is established forever and to all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI mahl-khoo-teh kah-eym le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שָׁמְ֒רָה זֹאת לְעֹלָם לְיֵֽצֶר מַחְשְׁ֒בוֹת לְבַב עַמֶּֽךָ וְהָכֵן לְבָבָם אֵלֶֽיךָ: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֹן וְלֺא יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֺא יָעִיר כָּל חֲמָתוֹ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶֽסֶד לְכָל קֹרְ֒אֶֽיךָ: צִדְ֒קָתְ֒ךָ צֶֽדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְ֒ךָ אֱמֶת: תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב חֶֽסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מִֽימֵי קֶֽדֶם: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַעֲמָס לָֽנוּ הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּֽנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָֽנוּ אֱלֺהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּךְ: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep this forever as the intention of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts to You. And He, the merciful One, atones iniquity and does not destroy; He frequently withdraws His anger and does not arouse all His rage. For You, my Master, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You. Your righteousness is everlasting and Your Torah is truth. You will grant truth to Jacob, kindliness to Abraham, as You have sworn to our fathers from the days of old. Blessed is my Master day by day; He loads us [with blessings], the Almighty Who is our deliverance, forever. Adonoy of Hosts is with us a stronghold for us is the God of Jacob, Selah. Adonoy of Hosts, fortunate is the man who trusts in You. Adonoy, deliver [us]; the King will answer us on the day we call.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey ahv-rah-hahm yeets-khahk ve-yees-rah-ehl ah-voh-tey-noo shah-ME-rah zoht le-oh-lahm le-yeh-tsehr mahkh-SHE-voht le-vahv ah-meh-khah ve-hah-khehn le-vah-vahm eh-ley-khah: ve-hoo rah-khoom ye-khah-pehr ah-vohn ve-loh yahsh-kheet ve-heer-bah le-hah-sheev ah-poh ve-loh yah-eer kohl khah-mah-toh: kee ah-tah ah-doh-nahy tohv ve-sah-lahkh ve-rahv kheh-sehd le-khohl koh-RE-ey-khah: TSEED-kah-TE-khah tseh-dehk le-oh-lahm ve-toh-rah-TE-khah eh-meht: tee-tehn eh-meht le-yah-ah-kohv kheh-sehd le-ahv-rah-hahm ah-shehr neesh-bah-e-tah lah-ah-voh-tey-noo mee-mey keh-dehm: bah-rookh ah-doh-nahy yohm yohm yah-ah-mahs lah-noo hah-ehl ye-shoo-ah-teh-noo seh-lah: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht ee-mah-noo mees-gahv lah-noo eh-loh-hey yah-ah-kohv seh-lah: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht ahsh-rey ah-dahm boh-teh-ahkh bahkh: ah-doh-NAI hoh-shee-ah hah-meh-lehkh yah-ah-neh-noo ve-yohm kah-re-eh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ שֶׁבְּ֒רָאָֽנוּ לִכְ֒בוֹדוֹ וְהִבְדִּילָֽנוּ מִן הַתּוֹעִים וְנָֽתַן לָֽנוּ תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת וְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם נָטַע בְּתוֹכֵֽנוּ הוּא יִפְתַּח לִבֵּֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתוֹ וְיָשֵׂם בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ אַהֲבָתוֹ וְיִרְאָתוֹ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנוֹ וּלְ֒עָבְ֒דוֹ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם לְמַֽעַן לֺא נִיגַע לָרִיק וְלֺא נֵלֵד לַבֶּהָלָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed is He, our God, Who created us for His glory, and set us apart from those who go astray; and gave us the Torah of truth, and eternal life He implanted within us. May He open our heart to His Torah, and instill in our heart love and awe of Him, to do His will and serve Him with a perfect heart, so that we shall not labor in vain nor bring forth that which causes dismay.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh hoo eh-loh-hey-noo sheh-BE-rah-ah-noo LEEKH-voh-doh ve-heev-dee-lah-noo meen hah-toh-eem ve-nah-tahn lah-noo toh-raht eh-meht ve-khah-yey oh-lahm nah-tah be-toh-kheh-noo hoo yeef-tahkh lee-beh-noo be-toh-rah-toh ve-yah-sehm be-lee-beh-noo ah-hah-vah-toh ve-yeer-ah-toh ve-lah-ah-soht re-tsoh-noh oo-LE-ah-VE-doh be-leh-vahv shah-lehm le-mah-ahn loh nee-gah lah-reek ve-loh neh-lehd lah-beh-hah-lah:

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שֶׁנִּשְׁמֹר חֻקֶּֽיךָ בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְנִזְכֶּה וְנִחְיֶה וְנִרְאֶה וְנִירַשׁ טוֹבָה וּבְ֒רָכָה לִשְׁ֒נֵי יְמוֹת הַמָּשִֽׁיחַ וּלְ֒חַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא: לְמַֽעַן יְזַמֶּרְ֒ךָ כָבוֹד וְלֺא יִדֹּם יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהַי לְעוֹלָם אוֹדֶֽךָּ: בָּרוּךְ הַגֶּֽבֶר אֲשֶׁר יִבְטַח בַּיהוָֹה וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה מִבְטַחוֹ: בִּטְ֒חוּ בַיהוָֹה עֲדֵי עַד כִּי בְּיָהּ יְהֹוָה צוּר עוֹלָמִים: וְיִבְטְחוּ בְךָ יוֹדְ֒עֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ כִּי לֺא עָזַֽבְתָּ דֹרְ֒שֶֽׁיךָ יְהֹוָה: יְהֹוָה חָפֵץ לְמַֽעַן צִדְקוֹ יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר:
tokens.translation: May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, that we keep Your statutes in this world, and [thus] be privileged to live and behold, and to inherit the goodness and blessing of the Messianic days, and in the life of the World to Come. In order that my soul sing to You and not be stilled; Adonoy, my God, forever will I thank You. Blessed is the man who trusts in Adonoy, so that Adonoy is his security. Trust in Adonoy until the end of days, for in God, Adonoy, is the strength of the worlds. And they will trust in You— those who know your Name, for You have never forsaken those who seek You, Adonoy. Adonoy desired, for the sake of His righteousness, to make the Torah great and to glorify it.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee rah-tsohn mee-LE-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo sheh-neesh-mohr khoo-key-khah bah-oh-lahm hah-zeh ve-neez-keh ve-neekh-yeh ve-neer-eh ve-nee-rahsh toh-vah oo-VE-rah-khah LEESH-ney ye-moht hah-mah-shee-ahkh oo-LE-khah-yey hah-oh-lahm hah-bah: le-mah-ahn ye-zah-MEHR-khah khah-vohd ve-loh yee-dohm ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hahy le-oh-lahm oh-deh-kah: bah-rookh hah-geh-vehr ah-shehr yeev-tahkh bah-ah-doh-NAI ve-hah-yah ah-doh-NAI meev-tah-khoh: BEET-khoo vah-ah-doh-NAI ah-dey ahd kee be-yahh ah-doh-NAI tsoor oh-lah-meem: ve-yeev-te-khoo ve-khah yoh-DE-ey she-meh-khah kee loh ah-zah-ve-tah doh-RE-shey-khah ah-doh-NAI: ah-doh-NAI khah-fehts le-mah-ahn tseed-koh yahg-deel toh-rah ve-yah-deer:

tokens.hebrew: (יְהֺוָה אֲדוֹנֵֽינוּ, מָה אַדִּיר שִׁמְךָ בְּכָל הָאָֽרֶץ: חִזְ֒קוּ וְיַאֲמֵץ לְבַבְ֒כֶם כָּל הַמְ֒יַחֲלִים לַיהֹוָה:)
tokens.translation: (Adonoy, our Master, how mighty is Your Name over all the earth. Be strong and take courage, all who wait for Adonoy.)
tokens.transliteration: (ah-doh-NAI ah-doh-ney-noo, mah ah-deer sheem-khah be-khohl hah-ah-rehts: KHEEZ-koo ve-yah-ah-mehts le-VAHV-khehm kohl hah-ME-yah-khah-leem lah-ah-doh-NAI)

tokens.hebrew: כל ימות השנה כשאין מוסף אומר הש"ץ קדיש תתקבל אחר ובא לציון. אבל כשיש מוסף אומר הש"ץ רק חצי קדיש על סדר קדושה ומתפללין מוסף. ובר"ח חולצין התפילין קודם תפלת מוסף.
tokens.translation: On Rosh Chodesh the Chazzan recites the half-Kaddish, the Tefillin are then removed and the congregation says the Musaf Amidah; and on Chol Hamoed the Chazzan recites the half-Kaddish, and the congregation says the Mussaf Amidah. On regular weekdays the Chazzan recites the following Kaddish:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְ֒מָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ וְיַצְמַח פּוּרְ֒קָנֵהּ וִיקָרֵב (קֵץ) מְשִׁיחֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom bring forth His redemption and hasten the coming if His Messiah in your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-gah-dahl ve-yeet-kah-dahsh she-meh rah-bah be-ah-LE-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh ve-yahts-mahkh poo-RE-kah-neh vee-kah-rehv (kehts) me-shee-kheh be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl, bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא:
tokens.translation: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵֽלָּא (בעשי"ת וּלְ֒עֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) מִן כָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן,
tokens.translation: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He; above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah, be-reekh hoo le-eh-lah (vshyt" oo-LE-eh-lah mee-kahl) meen kohl beer-khah-tah ve-shee-rah-tah, toosh-be-khah-tah ve-neh-kheh-mah-tah, dah-ah-mee-rahn be-ah-LE-mah, ve-eem-roo ah-mehn,

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְ֒הוֹן וּבָעוּתְ֒הוֹן דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁ֒מַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be acceptance of the prayers and supplications of the entire House of Israel before their Father in heaven. And say, Amein.
tokens.transliteration: teet-kah-behl tse-loh-TE-hohn oo-vah-oo-TE-hohn de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl koh-dahm ah-voo-hohn dee VEESH-mah-yah ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא וְחַיִּים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be abundant peace from heaven and life for us and for all Israel, —and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-lah-mah rah-bah meen she-mah-yah ve-khah-yeem ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם (בעשי"ת הַשָּׁלוֹם) בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
tokens.translation: He Who makes peace (Ten Days of Penitence: the peace) in His high heavens may He, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.
tokens.transliteration: oh-seh shah-lohm (vshyt" hah-shah-lohm) beem-roh-mahv hoo yah-ah-seh shah-lohm ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn

tokens.hebrew: בשני ובחמישי ושאר ימים שמוציאין ספר תורה אומרים יהללו כשמחזירים הס"ת למקומו. ואומר החזן:
tokens.translation: On Mondays, Thursdays and other days when the Torah is read, as the Sefer Torah is returned to the Ark the Chazzan takes the Torah and says:

tokens.hebrew: יְהַלְ֒לוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהֹוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ:
tokens.translation: They will praise the Name of Adonoy for His Name alone is exalted.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hah-LE-loo eht shehm ah-doh-NAI kee nees-gahv she-moh le-vah-doh:

tokens.translation: Chazzan and congregation:

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶֽרֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם: וַיָּֽרֶם קֶֽרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרֹבוֹ הַלְ֒לוּיָהּ:
tokens.translation: His majesty is over the earth and the skies. He will raise the might of His people, [which is] praise for all His pious ones, for the children of Israel, the people near to Him. Praise God.
tokens.transliteration: hoh-doh ahl eh-rehts ve-shah-mah-yeem: vah-yah-rehm keh-rehn le-ah-moh te-hee-lah le-khohl khah-see-dahv leev-ney yees-rah-ehl ahm ke-roh-voh hah-LE-loo-yahh:

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר לַיהוָֹה הָאָֽרֶץ וּמְ֒לוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֽשְׁ֒בֵי בָהּ: כִּי־הוּא עַל־יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ וְעַל־נְהָרוֹת יְכוֹנְ֒נֶֽהָ: מִי־יַעֲלֶה בְהַר־יְהֹוָה וּמִי יָקוּם בִּמְ֒קוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ: נְקִי כַפַּֽיִם וּבַר־לֵבָב אֲשֶׁר לֺא־נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֺא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה: יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה וּצְ֒דָקָה מֵאֱלֺהֵי יִשְׁעוֹ: זֶה דּוֹר דּוֹרְ֒שָׁיו מְבַקְ֒שֵׁי פָנֶֽיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂ֒אוּ פִּתְ֒חֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי זֶה מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהֹוָה עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר יְהֹוָה גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂ֒אוּ פִּתְ֒חֵי עוֹלָם וְיָבוֹא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: מִי הוּא זֶה מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶֽלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶֽלָה:
tokens.translation: A psalm of David: the earth is Adonoy's and the fullness thereof, the inhabited world and those who dwell in it. For He founded it upon the seas, and established it upon rivers. Who may ascend the mountain of Adonoy, and who may stand in the place of His holiness? The clean of hands and the pure of heart, who has not borne My soul in vain, and has not sworn deceitfully. He will bear Adonoy's blessing and righteousness from the God of his deliverance. This is the generation of those who seek Him, and seekers of Your Presence, [God of] Jacob, selah. Lift up your heads, gates, and be uplifted [you] entranceways to eternity, so that the King of Glory may enter. Who is this King of Glory? Adonoy, strong and mighty; Adonoy, the Mighty One in battle. Lift up your heads, gates, and lift, entranceways to eternity, so that the King of Glory may enter. Who is He, this King of Glory? Adonoy of hosts, He is the King of Glory, selah.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-veed meez-mohr lah-ah-doh-NAI hah-ah-rehts oo-ME-loh-ahh teh-vehl ve-YSHE-vey vahh: kee hoo ahl yah-meem ye-sah-dahh ve-ahl ne-hah-roht ye-khoh-NE-neh-hah: mee yah-ah-leh ve-hahr ah-doh-NAI oo-mee yah-koom BEEM-kohm kohd-shoh: ne-kee khah-pah-yeem oo-vahr leh-vahv ah-shehr loh nah-sah lah-shahv nahf-shee ve-loh neesh-bah le-meer-mah: yee-sah ve-rah-khah meh-eht ah-doh-NAI oo-TSE-dah-kah meh-eh-loh-hey yeesh-oh: zeh dohr doh-RE-shahv me-VAHK-shey fah-ney-khah yah-ah-kohv seh-lah: se-oo she-ah-reem rah-shey-khehm ve-hee-nah-SE-oo PEET-khey oh-lahm ve-yah-voh meh-lehkh hah-kah-vohd: mee zeh meh-lehkh hah-kah-vohd ah-doh-NAI ee-zooz ve-gee-bohr ah-doh-NAI gee-bohr meel-khah-mah: se-oo she-ah-reem rah-shey-khehm oo-SE-oo PEET-khey oh-lahm ve-yah-voh meh-lehkh hah-kah-vohd: mee hoo zeh meh-lehkh hah-kah-vohd ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht hoo meh-lehkh hah-kah-vohd seh-lah:

tokens.hebrew: בשעת הכנסת ס"ת להיכל אומרים זה:
tokens.translation: As the Torah is returned to the Ark the following is said:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְ֒נֻחֹה יֹאמַר שׁוּבָה יְהֹוָה רִבְ֒בוֹת אַלְ֒פֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל: קוּמָה יְהֹוָה לִמְ֒נוּחָתֶֽךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּֽךָ: כֹּהֲנֶֽיךָ יִלְבְּ֒שׁוּ צֶֽדֶק וַחֲסִידֶֽיךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּֽךָ אַל תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ: כִּי לֶֽקַח טוֹב נָתַֽתִּי לָכֶם תּוֹרָתִי אַל תַּעֲזֹֽבוּ: עֵץ חַיִּים הִיא לַמַּחֲזִיקִים בָּהּ וְתוֹמְ֒כֶֽיהָ מְאֻשָּׁר: דְּרָכֶֽיהָ דַּרְ֒כֵי נֹֽעַם וְכָל נְתִיבוֹתֶֽיהָ שָׁלוֹם: הֲשִׁיבֵֽנוּ יְהֹוָה אֵלֶֽיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵֽינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם:
tokens.translation: And when it rested, he would say: Return, Adonoy, to the myriads and thousands of Israel. Arise, Adonoy unto Your resting place, You and the Ark of Your strength. Let Your priests clothe themselves in righteousness, and let Your devoted ones sing in joy. For the sake of David, Your servant, do not reject Your anointed. For I have given you good instruction, do not forsake My Torah. It is a tree of life to those who grasp it, and those who support it are fortunate. Its ways are ways of pleasantness and all its paths are peace. Cause us to return to you, Adonoy, and we shall return; renew our days as of old.

tokens.hebrew: נהגו לומר בכל ימי השבוע השיר שהיו הלוים אומרים במקדש. ומקורו במס' סופרים (מס' סופרים י"ח, א) לפיכך נהגו העם לומר מזמורים בעונתן. דתנינן תמן (תמיד פ"ז מ"ד) השיר שהיו הלוים אומרים בביהמ"ק וכו'. שכל המזכיר פסוק בעונתו מעלה עליו כאילו בונה מזבח חדש ומקריב עליו קרבן. ע"כ. (עץ יוסף)
tokens.translation: The custom of reciting a different psalm each day of the week originated in the Temple. The Mishnah (Maseches Tamid 7:4) describes the psalms which were chanted by the Levites each day during the service.
On Sunday:
