tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה הוּא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ שֶׁהִקְטִֽירוּ אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֶת קְטֹֽרֶת הַסַּמִּים בִּזְמַן שֶׁבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הָיָה קַיָּם כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתָ אוֹתָם עַל יְדֵי משֶׁה נְבִיאֶֽךָ כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: You are Adonoy, our God, before Whom our fathers burned the incense of spices when the Holy Temple was standing, as You commanded them by the hand of Moses Your prophet, as it is written in Your Torah:
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah hoo ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo sheh-heek-tee-roo ah-voh-tey-noo le-fah-ney-khah eht ke-toh-reht hah-sah-meem beez-mahn sheh-beyt hah-meek-dahsh hah-yah kah-yahm kah-ah-shehr tsee-vee-tah oh-tahm ahl ye-dey m-sheh ne-vee-eh-khah kah-kah-toov be-toh-rah-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּֽאמֶר יְהֹוָה אֶל־משֶׁה קַח־לְךָ סַמִּים נָטָף וּשְׁחֵֽלֶת וְחֶלְבְּנָה סַמִּים וּלְבֹנָה זַכָּה בַּד בְּבַד יִהְיֶה: וְעָשִֽׂיתָ אֹתָהּ קְטֹֽרֶת רֹֽקַח מַעֲשֵׂה רוֹקֵֽחַ מְמֻלָּח טָהוֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ: וְשָׁחַקְתָּ מִמֶּֽנָּה הָדֵק וְנָתַתָּה מִמֶּֽנָּה לִפְנֵי הָעֵדֻת בְּאֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵד אֲשֶׁר אִוָּעֵד לְךָ שָֽׁמָּה קֹֽדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים תִּהְיֶה לָכֶם: וְנֶאֱמַר
tokens.translation: (Exodus 30:34-36) And Adonoy said to Moses, Take for yourself spices— stacte, onycha, and galbanum— spices, and pure frankincense, [they] shall be in equal weights. You will make it into incense, a compound mixed by a compounder, salted, undefiled, and holy. You will pulverize some of it very fine, and place it before the [Ark of] Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you; it will be to you holy of holies." It is also written:
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-mehr ah-doh-NAI ehl m-sheh kahkh le-khah sah-meem nah-tahf oo-she-kheh-leht ve-khehl-be-nah sah-meem oo-le-voh-nah zah-kah bahd be-vahd yeeh-yeh: ve-ah-see-tah oh-tahh ke-toh-reht roh-kahkh mah-ah-seh roh-keh-ahkh me-moo-lahkh tah-hohr koh-dehsh: ve-shah-khahk-tah mee-meh-nah hah-dehk ve-nah-tah-tah mee-meh-nah leef-ney hah-eh-doot be-oh-hehl moh-ehd ah-shehr ee-vah-ehd le-khah shah-mah koh-dehsh kah-dah-sheem teeh-yeh lah-khehm: ve-neh-eh-mahr

tokens.hebrew: וְהִקְטִיר עָלָיו אַהֲרֹן קְטֹֽרֶת סַמִּים בַּבֹּֽקֶר בַּבֹּֽקֶר בְּהֵיטִיבוֹ אֶת־הַנֵּרֹת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה: וּבְהַעֲלֹת אַהֲרֹן אֶת־הַנֵּרֹת בֵּין הָֽעַרְבַּֽיִם יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה קְטֹֽרֶת תָּמִיד לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶם:
tokens.translation: (Exodus 30:7-8) And Aaron shall burn upon it [the Altar] incense of spices every morning; when he cleans the lamps he will burn it. And when Aaron lights the lamps in the afternoon, he will burn it; a constant incense-offering before Adonoy throughout your generations.
tokens.transliteration: ve-heek-teer ah-lahv ah-hah-rohn ke-toh-reht sah-meem bah-boh-kehr bah-boh-kehr be-hey-tee-voh eht hah-neh-roht yahk-tee-reh-nah: oo-ve-hah-ah-loht ah-hah-rohn eht hah-neh-roht beyn hah-ahr-bah-yeem yahk-tee-reh-nah ke-toh-reht tah-meed leef-ney ah-doh-NAI le-doh-roh-tey-khehm:

tokens.hebrew: תָּנוּ רַבָּנָן פִּטּוּם הַקְּ֒טֹֽרֶת כֵּיצַד שְׁלֹש מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁמוֹנָה מָנִים הָיוּ בָהּ, שְׁלֹש מֵאוֹת וְשִׁשִּׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה כְּמִנְיַן יְמוֹת הַחַמָּה מָנֶה לְכָל יוֹם, פְּרַס בַּשַּׁחֲרִית וּפְרַס בֵּין הָעַרְבָּֽיִם, וּשְׁלשָׁה מָנִים יְתֵרִים שֶׁמֵּהֶם מַכְנִיס כֹּהֵן גָּדוֹל מְלֹא חָפְנָיו בְּיוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, וּמַחֲזִירָן לְמַכְתֶּֽשֶׁת בְּעֶֽרֶב יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, וְשׁוֹחֲקָן יָפֶה יָפֶה כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּ֒הֵא דַקָּה מִן הַדַּקָּה, וְאַחַד עָשָׂר סַמָּנִים הָֽיוּ בָהּ, וְאֵֽלּוּ הֵן הַצֳּרִי וְהַצִּפֹּֽרֶן הַחֶלְבְּנָה וְהַלְּ֒בוֹנָה מִשְׁקַל שִׁבְעִים שִׁבְעִים מָנֶה, מוֹר וּקְצִיעָה שִׁבֹּֽלֶת נֵרְדְּ וְכַרְכֹּם מִשְׁקַל שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר שִׁשָּׁה עָשָׂר מָנֶה, הַקּשְׁטְ שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר וְקִלּוּפָה שְׁלשָׁה וְקִנָּמוֹן תִּשְׁעָה, בֹּרִית כַּרְשִׁינָה תִּשְׁעָה קַבִּין, יֵין קַפְרִיסִין סְאִין תְּלָתָא וְקַבִּין תְּלָתָא, וְאִם אֵין לוֹ יֵין קַפְרִיסִין מֵבִיא חֲמַר חִוַּרְיָן עַתִּיק, מֶֽלַח סְדוֹמִית רֹֽבַע הַקָּב, מַעֲלֶה עָשָׁן כָּל שֶׁהוּא, רַבִּי נָתָן הַבַּבְלִי אוֹמֵר אַף כִּפַּת הַיַּרְדֵּן כָּל שֶׁהוּא, וְאִם נָֽתַן בָּהּ דְּבַשׁ פְּסָלָהּ וְאִם חִסַּר אַחַת מִכָּל סַמָּנֶֽיהָ חַיָּב מִיתָה:
tokens.translation: (Maseches Kreisos 6a; Jerusalem Talmud, Maseches Yoma 4:5) The Rabbis taught: How was the incense compounded? Three hundred and sixty-eight manim were comprised therein, three hundred and sixty-five corresponding to the number of days in the solar year, one maneh for each day— half in the morning and half in the afternoon. From the three remaining manim the Kohein Gadol brought two handfuls [into the Holy of Holies] on Yom Kippur; [for which purpose] they were put back into the mortar on the eve of Yom Kippur, and ground [again] very thoroughly, in order to make them very fine. Eleven kinds of spices were used for it. They were: 1) balm, 2) onycha, 3) galbanum, 4) frankincense— by weight, seventy maneh of each; 5) myrrh, 6) cassia, 7) spikenard and 8) saffron— in weight sixteen maneh of each; 9) twelve maneh of costus, 10) three of aromatic bark, and 11) nine of cinnamon. [Also used in the incense compound were:] Nine kabin of Carshina lye, Cyprus wine [measuring] three s'in and three kabin— if he had no Cyprus wine, he could use strong white wine— a fourth of a kab of Sodom salt, and a minute quantity of maaleh ashan. Rabbi Nosson of Babylonia says, Jordan amber was added of a minute quantity, and if one added honey, it (the incense) became unfit; and if one omitted any of its spices he was liable to the death penalty."
tokens.transliteration: tah-noo rah-bah-nahn pee-toom hah-KE-toh-reht key-tsahd she-lohsh meh-oht ve-shee-sheem oo-she-moh-nah mah-neem hah-yoo vahh, she-lohsh meh-oht ve-shee-sheem vah-khah-mee-shah ke-meen-yahn ye-moht hah-khah-mah mah-neh le-khohl yohm, pe-rahs bah-shah-khah-reet oo-fe-rahs beyn hah-ahr-bah-yeem, oo-she-l-shah mah-neem ye-teh-reem sheh-meh-hehm mahkh-nees koh-hehn gah-dohl me-loh khohf-nahv be-yohm hah-kee-poo-reem, oo-mah-khah-zee-rahn le-mahkh-teh-sheht be-eh-rehv yohm hah-kee-poo-reem, ve-shoh-khah-kahn yah-feh yah-feh ke-dey sheh-TE-heh dah-kah meen hah-dah-kah, ve-ah-khahd ah-sahr sah-mah-neem hah-yoo vahh, ve-eh-loo hehn hah-tsoh-ree ve-hah-tsee-poh-rehn hah-khehl-be-nah ve-hah-LE-voh-nah meesh-kahl sheev-eem sheev-eem mah-neh, mohr oo-ke-tsee-ah shee-boh-leht nehrd ve-khahr-kohm meesh-kahl shee-shah ah-sahr shee-shah ah-sahr mah-neh, hahksht she-neym ah-sahr ve-kee-loo-fah she-l-shah ve-kee-nah-mohn teesh-ah, boh-reet kahr-shee-nah teesh-ah kah-been, yeyn kahf-ree-seen se-een te-lah-tah ve-kah-been te-lah-tah, ve-eem eyn loh yeyn kahf-ree-seen meh-vee khah-mahr khee-vahr-yahn ah-teek, meh-lahkh se-doh-meet roh-vah hah-kahv, mah-ah-leh ah-shahn kohl sheh-hoo, rah-bee nah-tahn hah-bahv-lee oh-mehr ahf kee-paht hah-yahr-dehn kohl sheh-hoo, ve-eem nah-tahn bahh de-vahsh pe-sah-lahh ve-eem khee-sahr ah-khaht mee-kohl sah-mah-ney-hah khah-yahv mee-tah:

tokens.hebrew: רַבָּן שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן גַּמְלִיאֵל אוֹמֵר הַצֳּרִי אֵינוֹ אֶלָּא שְׂרָף הַנּוֹטֵף מֵעֲצֵי הַקְּ֒טָף, בֹּרִית כַּרְשִׁינָה שֶׁשָׁפִין בָּה אֶת הַצִפֹּרֶן כִּדֵי שֶׁתְּ֒הֵא נָאָה יֵין קַפְרִיסִין שֶׁשׁוֹרִין בּוֹ אֶת הַצִפֹּרֶן כְּדֵי שֶׁתְּ֒הֵא עַזָּה, וַהֲלֹא מֵי רַגְלַֽיִם יָפִין לָהּ אֶלָּא שֶׁאֵין מַכְנִיסִין מֵי רַגְלַֽיִם בַּמִּקְדָּשׁ מִפְּנֵי הַכָּבוֹד:
tokens.translation: Rabbi Shimon ben Gamliel says: The balm is nothing but sap which drips from the balsam tree. the lye of Carshina was used for rubbing the onycha in order to refine its appearance. The Cyprus wine was used to soak the onycha to give it a pungent odor. Though the water of Raglayim was well suited for that purpose, they did not bring the water of Raglayim into the Temple because it would be disrespectful.
tokens.transliteration: rah-bahn sheem-ohn behn gahm-lee-ehl oh-mehr hah-tsoh-ree ey-noh eh-lah se-rahf hah-noh-tehf meh-ah-tsey hah-KE-tahf, boh-reet kahr-shee-nah sheh-shah-feen bah eht hah-tsee-poh-rehn kee-dey sheh-TE-heh nah-ah yeyn kahf-ree-seen sheh-shoh-reen boh eht hah-tsee-poh-rehn ke-dey sheh-TE-heh ah-zah, vah-hah-loh mey rahg-lah-yeem yah-feen lahh eh-lah sheh-eyn mahkh-nee-seen mey rahg-lah-yeem bah-meek-dahsh mee-pe-ney hah-kah-vohd:

tokens.hebrew: תַּנְיָא רַבִּי נָתָן אוֹמֵר כְּשֶׁהוּא שׁוֹחֵק אוֹמֵר הָדֵק הֵיטֵב הֵיטֵב הָדֵק מִפְּ֒נֵי שֶׁהַקּוֹל יָפֶה לַבְּ֒שָׂמִים, פִּטְּ֒מָהּ לַחֲצָאִין כְּשֵׁרָה לִשְׁלִישׁ וְלִרְבִֽיעַ לֹא שָׁמַֽעְנוּ: אָמַר רַבִּי יְהוּדָה זֶה הַכְּ֒לָל אִם כְּמִדָּתָהּ כְּשֵׁרָה לַחֲצָאִין וְאִם חִסַּר אַחַת מִכָּל סַמָּנֶֽיהָ חַיָּב מִיתָה:
tokens.translation: It was taught in a Boraysa: Rabbi Nosson says, While [the Kohein] ground [the incense] he would say, ‘Hodeik heiteiv, heiteiv hodeik,' because the sound is good for the spices. If half the quantity of incense was prepared it was acceptable, but if only a third or a fourth [of it was prepared] we have not heard [whether it was acceptable."] Rabbi Yehuda said, This is the general rule: If [it was prepared with all its ingredients] in the correct proportion, it is acceptable even if only half was prepared; but if he left out any of its spices, he was liable for the death penalty.
tokens.transliteration: tahn-yah rah-bee nah-tahn oh-mehr ke-sheh-hoo shoh-khehk oh-mehr hah-dehk hey-tehv hey-tehv hah-dehk mee-PE-ney sheh-hah-kohl yah-feh lah-BE-sah-meem, pee-TE-mahh lah-khah-tsah-een ke-sheh-rah leesh-leesh ve-leer-vee-ah loh shah-mah-e-noo: ah-mahr rah-bee ye-hoo-dah zeh hah-KE-lahl eem ke-mee-dah-tahh ke-sheh-rah lah-khah-tsah-een ve-eem khee-sahr ah-khaht mee-kohl sah-mah-ney-hah khah-yahv mee-tah:

tokens.hebrew: תַּנְיָא בַּר קַפָּרָא אוֹמֵר אַחַת לְשִׁשִּׁים אוֹ לְשִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה הָיְ֒תָה בָאָה שֶׁל שִׁירַֽיִם לַחֲצָאִין: וְעוֹד תָּנֵי בַּר קַפָּרָא אִלּוּ הָיָה נוֹתֵן בָּהּ קוֹרְ֒טוֹב שֶׁל דְּבַשׁ אֵין אָדָם יָכוֹל לַעֲמֹד מִפְּ֒נֵי רֵיחָהּ וְלָֽמָּה אֵין מְעָרְ֒בִין בָּהּ דְּבַשׁ מִפְּ֒נֵי שֶׁהַתּוֹרָה אָמְ֒רָה כִּי כָל־שְׂאֹר וְכָל־דְּבַשׁ לֹא־תַקְטִֽירוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ אִשֶּׁה לַיהוָֹה:
tokens.translation: It was taught in a Boraysa: Bar Kappara says, Once in sixty or seventy years the accumulated surplus was sufficient to provide half [the yearly quantity of incense."] Bar Kappara also taught, If he would have put into it a minute quantity of honey, no one could have withstood [resisted] the scent. Why was no honey mixed with it? Because the Torah says, (Leviticus 2:11) For any leaven or honey, do not burn from them, [as] a fire-offering to Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: tahn-yah bahr kah-pah-rah oh-mehr ah-khaht le-shee-sheem oh le-sheev-eem shah-nah hah-YE-tah vah-ah shehl shee-rah-yeem lah-khah-tsah-een: ve-ohd tah-ney bahr kah-pah-rah ee-loo hah-yah noh-tehn bahh koh-RE-tohv shehl de-vahsh eyn ah-dahm yah-khohl lah-ah-mohd mee-PE-ney rey-khahh ve-lah-mah eyn me-ah-RE-veen bahh de-vahsh mee-PE-ney sheh-hah-toh-rah ah-ME-rah kee khohl se-ohr ve-khohl de-vahsh loh tahk-tee-roo mee-meh-noo ee-sheh lah-ah-doh-NAI:

tokens.translation: Recite each of these verses three times:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּֽנוּ מִשְׂגַּב־לָֽנוּ אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּךְ: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם־קָרְאֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy of Hosts is with us, a stronghold for us is the God of Jacob, Selah! Adonoy of Hosts, fortunate is the man who trusts in You. Adonoy, deliver [us]! The King will answer us on the day we call.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht ee-mah-noo mees-gahv lah-noo eh-loh-hey yah-ah-kohv seh-lah: ah-doh-NAI tse-vah-oht ahsh-rey ah-dahm boh-teh-ahkh bahkh: ah-doh-NAI hoh-shee-ah hah-meh-lehkh yah-ah-neh-noo ve-yohm kah-re-eh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה סֵֽתֶר לִי מִצַּר תִּצְּ֒רֵֽנִי רָנֵּי פַלֵּט תְּסוֹבְ֒בֵֽנִי סֶֽלָה: וְעָרְ֒בָה לַיהוָֹה מִנְחַת יְהוּדָה וִירוּשָׁלָֽםִ כִּימֵי עוֹלָם וּכְשָׁנִים קַדְמֹנִיּוֹת:
tokens.translation: You are my shelter; from distress You preserve me; with glad song of rescue, You envelop me, Selah! Let Adonoy be pleased with the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem, as in the days of old and in earlier years.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah seh-tehr lee mee-tsahr tee-TSE-reh-nee rah-ney fah-leht te-soh-VE-veh-nee seh-lah: ve-ah-RE-vah lah-ah-doh-NAI meen-khaht ye-hoo-dah vee-roo-shah-lah-mee kee-mey oh-lahm oo-khe-shah-neem kahd-moh-nee-yoht:

tokens.hebrew: ואח"כ יאמר תפלת רבי נחוניא בן הקנה:
tokens.translation: The following is the prayer of Rabbi Nechunya ben Hakanah:

tokens.hebrew: אָֽנָּא בְּכֹֽחַ גְּדֻלַּת יְמִינְ֒ךָ תַּתִּיר צְרוּרָה:
tokens.translation: Please, by the force of Your great right hand, release the bound one.
tokens.transliteration: ah-nah be-khoh-ahkh ge-doo-laht ye-mee-NE-khah tah-teer tse-roo-rah:

tokens.hebrew: קַבֵּל רִנַּת עַמְּ֒ךָ שַׂגְּ֒בֵֽנוּ טַהֲרֵֽנוּ נוֹרָא:
tokens.translation: Accept the prayer of Your people; strengthen us, purify us, Awesome One!
tokens.transliteration: kah-behl ree-naht ah-ME-khah sah-GE-veh-noo tah-hah-reh-noo noh-rah:

tokens.hebrew: נָא גִבּוֹר דּוֹרְ֒שֵׁי יִחוּדְ֒ךָ כְּבָבַת שָׁמְ֒רֵם:
tokens.translation: Please! Mighty One, those who seek Your Unity, preserve them like the pupil [of Your eye].
tokens.transliteration: nah gee-bohr doh-RE-shey yee-khoo-DE-khah ke-vah-vaht shah-ME-rehm:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרְ֒כֵם טַהֲרֵם רַחֲמֵם צִדְקָתְ֒ךָ תָּמִיד גָּמְ֒לֵם:
tokens.translation: Bless them, purify them, have compassion on them; Your benevolent righteousness [may You] always bestow upon them.
tokens.transliteration: bah-RE-khehm tah-hah-rehm rah-khah-mehm tseed-kah-TE-khah tah-meed gah-ME-lehm:

tokens.hebrew: חֲסִין קָדוֹשׁ בְּרֹב טוּבְ֒ךָ נַהֵל עֲדָתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Mighty, Holy One, in Your abundant goodness, lead Your community.
tokens.transliteration: khah-seen kah-dohsh be-rohv too-VE-khah nah-hehl ah-dah-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: יָחִיד גֵּאֶה לְעַמְּ֒ךָ פְּנֵה, זוֹכְ֒רֵי קְדֻשָּׁתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Unique One, Exalted, turn to Your people who are mindful of Your holiness.
tokens.transliteration: yah-kheed geh-eh le-ah-ME-khah pe-neh, zoh-KHE-rey ke-doo-shah-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ קַבֵּל וּשְׁמַע צַעֲקָתֵֽנוּ יוֹדֵֽעַ תַּעֲלוּמוֹת:
tokens.translation: Accept our prayer and hear our cry, [You] Who knows hidden thoughts.
tokens.transliteration: shahv-ah-teh-noo kah-behl oo-she-mah tsah-ah-kah-teh-noo yoh-deh-ah tah-ah-loo-moht:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
tokens.translation: Blessed [is His] Name, Whose glorious kingdom is forever and ever.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh shehm ke-vohd mahl-khoo-toh le-oh-lahm vah-ehd:

tokens.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי יוֹשְׁ֒בֵי בֵיתֶֽךָ עוֹד יְהַלְ֒לֽוּךָ סֶּֽלָה: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּֽכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיְהֹוָה אֱלֹהָיו: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּֽלֶךְ וַאֲבָרְ֒כָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרְ֒כֶֽךָ וַאֲהַלְ֒לָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְ֒דֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵֽקֶר: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְ֒בוּרֹתֶֽיךָ יַגִּֽידוּ: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶֽךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְ֒אֹתֶֽיךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְ֒אֹתֶֽיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְ֒דֻלָּתְ֒ךָ אֲסַפְּ֒רֶֽנָּה: זֵֽכֶר רַב־טוּבְ֒ךָ יַבִּֽיעוּ וְצִדְ֒קָתְ֒ךָ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהֹוָה אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וּגְ֒דָל־חָֽסֶד: טוֹב־יְהֹוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו: יוֹדֽוּךָ יְהֹוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶֽיךָ יְבָרְ֒כֽוּכָה: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְ֒ךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְ֒בוּרָתְ֒ךָ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ: לְהוֹדִֽיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְ֒בוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ: מַלְכוּתְ֒ךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשַׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדֹר: סוֹמֵךְ יְהֹוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְ֒לִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּ֒פוּפִים: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶֽיךָ יְשַׂבֵּֽרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ: פּוֹתֵֽחַ אֶת־יָדֶֽךָ וּמַשְׂבִּֽיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן: צַדִּיק יְהֹוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו: קָרוֹב יְהֹוָה לְכָל־קֹרְ֒אָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻֽהוּ בֶאֱמֶת: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם: שׁוֹמֵר יְהֹוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְ֒שָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד: תְּהִלַּת יְהֹוָה יְדַבֶּר פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד: וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְ֒לוּיָהּ:
tokens.translation: Fortunate are those who dwell in Your house; may they continue to praise You, Selah. Fortunate is the people whose lot is thus; fortunate is the people for whom Adonoy is their God. A praise by David! I will exalt You, my God, the King, and bless Your Name forever and ever. Every day I will bless You and extol Your Name forever and ever. Adonoy is great and highly extolled, and His greatness is unfathomable. One generation to another will praise Your works, and Your mighty acts they will declare. The splendor of Your glorious majesty, and the words of Your wonders I will speak. Of Your awesome might, they will speak, and Your greatness I will recount. Mention of Your bountifulness they will express, and in Your righteousness joyfully exult. Adonoy is gracious and merciful, slow to anger and great in kindliness. Adonoy is good to all, His mercy encompasses all His works. All Your works will thank You, Adonoy, and Your pious ones will bless You. Of the honor of Your kingship, they will speak, and Your might they will declare. To reveal to men His mighty acts, and the glorious splendor of His kingship. Your kingship is the kingship for all times, and Your dominion is in every generation. Adonoy supports all the fallen, and straightens all the bent. The eyes of all look expectantly to You, and You give them their food at its proper time. You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living being. Adonoy is just in all His ways and benevolent in all His deeds. Adonoy is near to all who call upon Him, to all who call upon Him in truth. The will of those who fear Him, He fulfills; He hears their cry and delivers them. Adonoy watches over all those who love Him, and will destroy all the wicked. Praise of Adonoy, my mouth will declare and all flesh will bless His holy Name forever and ever. And we will bless God from now forever. Praise God.

ne-vah-rehkh yahh meh-ah-tah ve-ahd oh-lahm hah-LE-loo-yahh:

tokens.translation: The Chazzan recites the following half-Kaddish

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְ֒מָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ וְיַצְמַח פּוּרְקָנֵהּ וִיקָרֵב (קֵץ) מְשִׁיחֵהּ. בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom bring forth His redemption and hasten the coming of His Mashiach. In your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-gah-dahl ve-yeet-kah-dahsh she-meh rah-bah be-ah-LE-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh ve-yahts-mahkh poo-re-kah-neh vee-kah-rehv (kehts) me-shee-kheh. be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl, bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא:
tokens.translation: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא
tokens.translation: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He;
tokens.transliteration: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah, be-reekh hoo

tokens.hebrew: לְעֵֽלָּא (בעשי"ת וּלְעֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) מִן כָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.

title: Tachanun
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Mincha, Tachanun
useCase: Tachanun · Siddur Sefard Themes: repentance, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אין נופלין על פניהם בבית האבל או בבית הכנסת שמלין בו התינוק או שבעל ברית או סנדק והמוהל מתפללין שם, ולא כשיש שם חתן כל ז' ימי המשתה, ולא בט"ו באב, ובט"ו בשבט, ר"ח, חנוכה, פורים קטן, ופורים גדול ב' ימים, ול"ג בעומר, ועיו"כ וערב ראש השנה, ולא בכל חודש ניסן ולא בתשעה באב, ומערב יום הכיפורים עד אחר ראש חודש חשון, ומתחלת ר"ח סיון עד י"ג סיון, וכל אלו הימים אין אומרים במנחה שלפניהם זולת עיו"כ וער"ה שאומרים במנחה שלפניהם. (מדה"ח):
tokens.translation: On days when Tachanun is omitted (see below) the chazzan continues with Kaddish. (14 and 15 Adar Rishon in a leap year); the entire month of Nissan; Pesach Sheini (14 Iyar); Lag BaOmer; 1-8 Sivan; 9 and 15 Av; and 29 Elul. When Tachanun is omitted on these days, it is also omitted at the preceding Mincha (afternoon service). Tachanun is also omitted in the presence of a bridegroom, in the house of a mourner during the week of mourning, and on the occasion of a circumcision if the father, the sandak or the mohel is present. The worshipper recites the Tachanun in a sitting position, while resting his brow on his arm. During the morning service, when the hand-tefillin is on the left arm, he leans his brow on his right arm, but at the Mincha service he leans his brow on his left arm. This "falling on one's face" symbolizes complete submission to God and the committing of our destinies into His hands. It is mentioned in the Talmud (Maseches Megillah 22b), and originates with Moses, who "Fell down before God" (Deuteronomy 9:18) and was followed by Joshua, who "Fell on the earth upon his face before the Ark of God" (Joshua 7:6)

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ תָּבֹא לְפָנֶֽיךָ תְּפִלָּֽתֵֽנוּ, וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם מִתְּ֒חִנָּתֵֽנוּ שֶׁאֵין אָֽנוּ עַזֵּי פָנִים וּקְ֒שֵׁי עֹֽרֶף לוֹמַר לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֺהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ צַדִּיקִים אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְלֺא חָטָֽאנוּ אֲבָל אֲנַֽחְנוּ וַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ חָטָֽאנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before you and do not ignore our supplication. For we are not so brazen-faced and stiff-necked to say to you, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, We are righteous and have not sined. But, indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo tah-voh le-fah-ney-khah te-fee-lah-teh-noo, ve-ahl teet-ah-lahm mee-TE-khee-nah-teh-noo sheh-eyn ah-noo ah-zey fah-neem oo-KE-shey oh-rehf loh-mahr le-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo tsah-dee-keem ahnah-khe-noo ve-loh khah-tah-noo ah-vahl ahnah-khe-noo vah-ah-voh-tey-noo khah-tah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָשַֽׁמְנוּ. בָּגַֽדְנוּ. גָּזַֽלְנוּ. דִּבַּֽרְנוּ דֹּֽפִי. הֶעֱוִֽינוּ. וְהִרְשַֽׁעְנוּ. זַֽדְנוּ. חָמַֽסְנוּ. טָפַֽלְנוּ שֶֽׁקֶר. יָעַֽצְנוּ רָע. כִּזַּֽבְנוּ. לַֽצְנוּ. מָרַֽדְנוּ. נִאַֽצְנוּ. סָרַֽרְנוּ. עָוִֽינוּ. פָּשַֽׁעְנוּ. צָרַֽרְנוּ. קִשִּֽׁינוּ עֹֽרֶף. רָשַֽׁעְנוּ. שִׁחַֽתְנוּ. תִּעַֽבְנוּ. תָּעִֽינוּ. תִּעְתָּֽעְנוּ:
tokens.translation: We have trespassed [against God and man, and we are devastated by our guilt]; We have betrayed [God and man, we have been ungrateful for the good done to us]; We have stolen; We have slandered. We have caused others to sin; We have caused others to commit sins for which they are called רְשָׁעִים, wicked; We have sinned with malicious intent; We have forcibly taken other's possessions even though we paid for them; We have added falsehood upon falsehood; we have joined with evil individuals or groups. We have given harmful advice; We have deceived; We have mocked; We have rebelled against God and His Torah; We have caused God to be angry with us; We have turned away from God's Torah; We have sinned deliberately; We have been negligent in our performance of the commandments; We have caused our friends grief; We have been stiff-necked, refusing to admit that the cause of our suffering is our own sins. We have committed sins for which we are called רָשָׁע [raising a hand to hit someone]. We have committed sins which are the result of moral corruption; We have committed sins which the Torah refers to as abominations; We have gone astray; We have led others astray.
tokens.transliteration: ah-shah-me-noo. bah-gah-de-noo. gah-zah-le-noo. dee-bah-re-noo doh-fee. heh-eh-vee-noo. ve-heer-shah-e-noo. zah-de-noo. khah-mah-se-noo. tah-fah-le-noo sheh-kehr. yah-ah-tse-noo rah. kee-zah-ve-noo. lah-tse-noo. mah-rah-de-noo. neeah-tse-noo. sah-rah-re-noo. ah-vee-noo. pah-shah-e-noo. tsah-rah-re-noo. kee-shee-noo oh-rehf. rah-shah-e-noo. sheekhah-te-noo. teeah-ve-noo. tah-ee-noo. tee-tah-e-noo:

tokens.hebrew: סַֽרְנוּ מִמִּצְוֹתֶֽיךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶֽיךָ הַטּוֹבִים וְלֺא שָֽׁוָה לָֽנוּ. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלֵֽינוּ. כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִֽׂיתָ וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ:
tokens.translation: We have turned away from Your commandments and from Your good laws, and we have gained nothing from it. And You are the Righteous One in all [punishment] that has come upon us; for You have acted truthfully and we have acted wickedly.
tokens.transliteration: sah-re-noo mee-meets-voh-tey-khah oo-mee-meesh-pah-tey-khah hah-toh-veem ve-loh shah-vah lah-noo. ve-ah-tah tsah-deek ahl kohl hah-bah ah-ley-noo. kee eh-meht ah-see-tah vah-ahnah-khe-noo heer-shah-e-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אֵל אֶֽרֶךְ־אַפַּֽיִם אַתָּה. וּבַֽעַל הָרַחֲמִים נִקְרֵֽאתָ. וְדֶֽרֶךְ תְּשׁוּבָה הוֹרֵֽיתָ: גְּדֻלַּת רַחֲמֶֽיךָ וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ. תִּזְכֺּר הַיּוֹם וּבְכָל־יוֹם לְזֶֽרַע יְדִידֶֽיךָ: תֵּֽפֶן אֵלֵֽינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים. כִּי אַתָּה הוּא בַּֽעַל הָרַחֲמִים: בְּתַחֲנוּן וּבִתְ֒פִלָּה פָּנֶֽיךָ נְקַדֵּם. כְּהוֹדַֽעְתָּ לֶעָנָיו מִקֶּֽדֶם: מֵחֲרוֹן אַפְּ֒ךָ שׁוּב. כְּמוֹ בְּתוֹרָתְ֒ךָ כָּתוּב: וּבְ֒צֵל כְּנָפֶֽיךָ נֶחֱסֶה וְנִתְלוֹנָן. כְּיוֹם וַיֵֽרֶד יְהֺוָה בֶּעָנָן: תַּעֲבֺר עַל־פֶּֽשַׁע וְתִמְחֶה אָשָׁם. כְּיוֹם וַַיִּתְיַצֵּב עִמּוֹ שָׁם: תַּאֲזִין שַׁוְעָתֵֽנוּ וְתַקְשִׁיב מֶֽנוּ מַאֲמַר. כְּיוֹם וַיִּקְרָא בְשֵׁם יְהֹוָה, וְשָׁם נֶאֱמַר:
tokens.translation: You are Almighty, Slow to anger, Lord of Mercy, You are called, and the way of repentance, You have taught us. The greatness of Your mercy and kindness, remember this day and every day for the descendants of Your loved ones. Turn to us with compassion for You are the Lord of Mercy. With supplication and prayer we approach Your Presence, as You made know to [Moses,] the modest one of old. From Your fierce anger turn, as it is written in Your Torah: In the shadow of Your wings, may we be sheltered and lodged, as on the day [of which it is said:] When Adonoy descended in the cloud. Remove [our] transgression, and blot out [our] iniquity, as on the day [of which it is said:] And He stood with him there. Give ear to our cry and listen to our speech, as on the day [of which it is said:] And He proclaimed in the Name, Adonoy And there it is said:
tokens.transliteration: ehl eh-rehkh ah-pah-yeem ah-tah. oo-vah-ahl hah-rah-khah-meem neek-reh-tah. ve-deh-rehkh te-shoo-vah hoh-rey-tah: ge-doo-laht rah-khah-mey-khah vah-khah-sah-dey-khah. teez-kohr hah-yohm oo-ve-khohl yohm le-zeh-rah ye-dee-dey-khah: teh-fehn eh-ley-noo be-rah-khah-meem. kee ah-tah hoo bah-ahl hah-rah-khah-meem: be-tah-khah-noon oo-VEET-fee-lah pah-ney-khah ne-kah-dehm. ke-hoh-dah-e-tah leh-ah-nahv mee-keh-dehm: meh-khah-rohn ah-PE-khah shoov. ke-moh be-toh-rah-TE-khah kah-toov: oo-VE-tsehl ke-nah-fey-khah neh-kheh-seh ve-neet-loh-nahn. ke-yohm vah-yeh-rehd ah-doh-NAI beh-ah-nahn: tah-ah-vohr ahl peh-shah ve-teem-kheh ah-shahm. ke-yohm vahah-yeet-yah-tsehv ee-moh shahm: tah-ah-zeen shahv-ah-teh-noo ve-tahk-sheev meh-noo mah-ah-mahr. ke-yohm vah-yeek-rah ve-shehm ah-doh-NAI, ve-shahm neh-eh-mahr:

tokens.translation: Congregation and Chazzan:
And Adonoy passed before him [Moses] and proclaimed:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֺוָה יְהֺוָה אֵל רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן אֶֽרֶךְ אַפַּֽיִם וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד וֶאֱמֶת: נֹצֵר חֶֽסֶד לָאֲלָפִים נֹשֵׂא עָוֹן וָפֶֽשַׁע וְחַטָּאָה וְנַקֵּה: וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲוֺנֵֽנוּ וּלְ֒חַטָּאתֵֽנוּ וּנְ֒חַלְתָּֽנוּ: סְלַח־לָֽנוּ אָבִֽינוּ כִּי־חָטָֽאנוּ. מְחַל־לָֽנוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כִּי־פָשָֽׁעְנוּ: כִּי־אַתָּה אֲדֺנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב־חֶֽסֶד לְכָל־קוֹרְ֒אֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, Adonoy, Almighty, Merciful, Gracious, Slow to Anger, and Abundant in Kindness and Truth. Keeper of kindness for thousands of generations, Endurer of iniquity and transgression, and sin, and Acquitter of those who repent. And pardon our iniquity and our sin, and take us for Your inheritance. Pardon us, our Father, for we have sinned, forgive us, our King, for we have transgressed. For You, my Master, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ah-doh-NAI ehl rah-khoom ve-khah-noon eh-rehkh ah-pah-yeem ve-rahv kheh-sehd veh-eh-meht: noh-tsehr kheh-sehd lah-ah-lah-feem noh-seh ah-vohn vah-feh-shah ve-khah-tah-ah ve-nah-keh: ve-sah-lahkh-tah lah-ah-voh-neh-noo oo-LE-khah-tah-teh-noo oo-NE-khahl-tah-noo: se-lahkh lah-noo ah-vee-noo kee khah-tah-noo. me-khahl lah-noo mahl-keh-noo kee fah-shah-e-noo: kee ah-tah ah-doh-nahy tohv ve-sah-lahkh ve-rahv kheh-sehd le-khohl koh-RE-ey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: כשנופל על פניו יש נוהגים להטות על צד ימין משום דכתיב שויתי ה' לנגדי תמיד. ויש נוהגים להטות על צד שמאל משום דהסבת שמאל שמה הסבה הלכך באותו צד שהוא נראה כבן מלך צריך ליכנע לפני המקום. וכבר נהגו ליפול בשחרית על צד ימין ובמנחה על צד שמאל.
tokens.translation: The following supplication is recited while resting your brow on your arm.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּֽאמֶר דָּוִד אֶל־גָּד צַר־לִי מְאֹד נִפְּ֒לָה־נָּא בְיַד־יְהֹוָה כִּי־רַבִּים רַחֲמָיו וּבְ֒יַד־אָדָם אַל־אֶפֹּֽלָה:
tokens.translation: And David said to Gad (II Samuel 24:14), I am greatly distressed; let us fall into the hand of Adonoy for His mercies are great, but into the hand of man let me not fall.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-mehr dah-veed ehl gahd tsahr lee me-ohd nee-PE-lah NAH ve-yahd ah-doh-NAI kee rah-beem rah-khah-mahv oo-VE-yahd ah-DAHM ahl eh-poh-lah:

tokens.hebrew: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן חָטָֽאתִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה מָלֵא רַחֲמִים רַחֵם עָלַי וְקַבֵּל תַּחֲנוּנָי:
tokens.translation: Merciful and gracious One, I have sinned before You; Adonoy, full of mercy, have compassion upon me and accept my supplications.
tokens.transliteration: rah-khoom ve-khah-noon khah-tah-tee le-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI mah-leh rah-khah-meem rah-khehm ah-lahy ve-kah-behl tah-khah-noo-nahy:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אַל־בְּאַפְּ֒ךָ תוֹכִיחֵֽנִי וְאַל־בַּחֲמָתְ֒ךָ תְיַסְּ֒רֵֽנִי: חָנֵּֽנִי יְהֹוָה כִּי אֻמְלַל אָֽנִי רְפָאֵֽנִי יְהֹוָה כִּי נִבְהֲלוּ עֲצָמָי: וְנַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָה מְאֹד וְאַתָּה יְהֹוָה עַד־מָתָי: שׁוּבָה יְהֹוָה חַלְּ֒צָה נַפְשִׁי הוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי לְמַֽעַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ: כִּי אֵין בַּמָּֽוֶת זִכְרֶךָ בִּשְׁ֒אוֹל מִי־יוֹדֶה לָּךְ: יָגַֽעְתִּי־בְּאַנְחָתִי אַשְׂחֶה בְכָל־לַֽיְלָה מִטָּתִי בְּדִמְעָתִי עַרְשִׂי אַמְסֶה: עָשְׁ֒שָׁה מִכַּֽעַס עֵינִי עָתְ֒קָה בְּכָל־צוֹרְ֒רָי: סֽוּרוּ מִמֶּֽנִּי כָּל־פֹּֽעֲלֵי אָוֶן כִּי־שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה קוֹל בִּכְיִי: שָׁמַע יְהֹוָה תְּחִנָּתִי יְהֹוָה תְּפִלָּתִי יִקָּח: יֵבֽשׁוּ וְיִבָּהֲלוּ מְאֹד כָּל־אֹיְ֒בָי יָשֻֽׁבוּ יֵבֽשׁוּ רָֽגַע:
tokens.translation: Adonoy, do not rebuke me with Your anger, nor chastise me with Your rage. Be gracious unto me, Adonoy, for I am desolate, heal me Adonoy, for my bones are terrified. My soul, [too,] is utterly terrified, and You Adonoy, how long? Return Adonoy, free my soul, deliver me for the sake of Your lovingkindness. For in death there is no mention of You; in the lower world who will thank You. I am worn out with my sighing, every night I cause my bed to float; with my tears, I melt my couch. My eye is dimmed from anger, it has aged because of my tormentors. Depart from me, all you evildoers, for Adonoy has heard the voice of my weeping. Adonoy has heard my supplication, Adonoy will (also) accept my prayer. Ashamed and utterly terrified will all my foes be, they will return and be instantaneously ashamed.
tokens.transliteration: ah-doh-NAI ahl be-ah-PE-khah toh-khee-kheh-nee ve-ahl bah-khah-mah-TE-khah te-yah-SE-reh-nee: khah-neh-nee ah-doh-NAI kee oom-lahl ah-nee re-fah-eh-nee ah-doh-NAI kee neev-hah-loo ah-tsah-mahy: ve-nahf-shee neev-hah-lah me-ohd ve-ah-tah ah-doh-NAI ahd mah-tahy: shoo-vah ah-doh-NAI khah-LE-tsah nahf-shee hoh-shee-eh-nee le-mah-ahn khahs-deh-khah: kee eyn bah-mah-veht zeekh-reh-khah BEESH-ohl mee yoh-deh lahkh: yah-gah-e-tee be-ahn-khah-tee ahs-kheh ve-khohl lah-ye-lah mee-tah-tee be-deem-ah-tee ahr-see ahm-seh: ah-SHE-shah mee-kah-ahs ey-nee ah-TE-kah be-khohl tsoh-RE-rahy: soo-roo mee-meh-nee kohl poh-ah-ley ah-vehn kee shah-mah ah-doh-NAI kohl beekh-yee: shah-mah ah-doh-NAI te-khee-nah-tee ah-doh-NAI te-fee-lah-tee yee-kahkh: yeh-v-shoo ve-yee-bah-hah-loo me-ohd kohl oh-YE-vahy yah-shoo-voo yeh-v-shoo rah-gah:

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאַל יֹאבַד יִשְׂרָאֵל הָאֹמְ֒רִים שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: Guardian of Israel, guard the remnant of Israel, and let not Israel perish, who say, "Hear Israel."
tokens.transliteration: shoh-mehr yees-rah-ehl she-mohr she-eh-reet yees-rah-ehl ve-ahl yoh-vahd yees-rah-ehl hah-oh-ME-reem she-mah yees-rah-ehl:

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר גּוֹי אֶחָד שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית עַם אֶחָד וְאַל יֹאבַד גּוֹי אֶחָד הַמְ֒יַחֲדִים שִׁמְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ יְהֹוָה אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: Guardian of the unique nation, guard the remnant of the unique people, and let not the unique nation perish, who proclaim the Oneness of Your Name, [saying:] Adonoy is our God, Adonoy is One.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-mehr gohy eh-khahd she-mohr she-eh-reet ahm eh-khahd ve-ahl yoh-vahd gohy eh-khahd hah-ME-yah-khah-deem sheem-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo ah-doh-NAI eh-khahd:

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹמֵר גּוֹי קָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹר שְׁאֵרִית עַם קָדוֹשׁ וְאַל יֹאבַד גּוֹי קָדוֹשׁ הַמְ֒שַׁלְּ֒שִׁים בְּשָׁלשׁ קְדֻשּׁוֹת לְקָדוֹשׁ:
tokens.translation: Guardian of the holy nation, guard the remnant of the holy people and let not the holy nation perish who repeat the threefold sanctification to the Holy One.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-mehr gohy kah-dohsh she-mohr she-eh-reet ahm kah-dohsh ve-ahl yoh-vahd gohy kah-dohsh hah-ME-shah-LE-sheem be-shahlsh ke-doo-shoht le-kah-dohsh:

tokens.hebrew: מִתְרַצֶּה בְּרַחֲמִים וּמִתְפַּיֵּס בְּתַחֲנוּנִים הִתְרַצֶּה וְהִתְפַּיֵּס לְדוֹר עָנִי כִּי אֵין עוֹזֵר: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: You Who are appeased by pleas for mercy, and conciliated by supplications, be appeased and conciliated to an afflicted generation, for there is none else to help. Our Father, our King! be gracious to us and answer us for we have no [good] deeds, deal with us charitably and kindly and deliver us.
tokens.transliteration: meet-rah-tseh be-rah-khah-meem oo-meet-pah-yehs be-tah-khah-noo-neem heet-rah-tseh ve-heet-pah-yehs le-dohr ah-nee kee eyn oh-zehr: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-neh-noo vah-ah-neh-noo kee eyn bah-noo mah-ah-seem ah-seh ee-mah-noo tse-dah-kah vah-kheh-sehd ve-hoh-shee-eh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ לֺא נֵדַע מַה נַּעֲשֶׂה כִּי עָלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶֽיךָ כִּי מֵעוֹלָם הֵֽמָּה: יְהִי חַסְדְּ֒ךָ יְהֹוָה עָלֵֽינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִחַֽלְנוּ לָךְ: אַל תִּזְכָּר לָֽנוּ עֲוֹנוֹת רִאשׁוֹנִים מַהֵר יְקַדְּ֒מֽוּנוּ רַחֲמֶֽיךָ כִּי דַלּֽוֹנוּ מְאֹד: עֶזְרֵֽנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהֹוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַֽיִם וְאָֽרֶץ: חָנֵּֽנוּ יְהֹוָה חָנֵּֽנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַֽעְנוּ בוּז: בְּרֺֽגֶז רַחֵם תִּזְכּוֹר: בְּרֹֽגֶז עַקֵדָה תִּזְכּוֹר, בְּרֹֽגֶז תְּמִימוֹת תִּזְכּוֹר: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה, הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ: כִּי הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵֽנוּ זָכוּר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָֽחְנוּ: עָזְ֒רֵֽנוּ אֱלֺהֵי יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ עַל־דְּבַר כְּבוֹד־שְׁמֶֽךָ וְהַצִּילֵֽנוּ וְכַפֵּר עַל־חַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: As for us, we know not what to do; but our eyes are upon You. Remember Your mercies, Adonoy, and kindnesses for they are from the beginning of the world. Adonoy! may Your kindness be upon us, as we have waited for You. Remember not the sins of our ancestors; let Your mercy come swiftly toward us, for we have been brought very low. Help us for the Name of Adonoy Creator of Heaven and earth. Be gracious to us, Adonoy, be gracious to us for we are saturated with humiliation. [Even] in anger remember to have compassion. [Even] in anger remember the binding of Isaac. Even in anger remember the uprightness of Jacob Adonoy deliver [us] the King will answer us on the day we call. For He knows of what we are made; He is mindful that we are but dust. Help us, God of our deliverance, for the sake of the glory of Your Name; save us and atone our sins, for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ahnah-khe-noo loh neh-dah mahh nah-ah-seh kee ah-ley-khah ey-ney-noo: ze-khohr rah-khah-mey-khah ah-doh-NAI vah-khah-sah-dey-khah kee meh-oh-lahm heh-mah: ye-hee khahs-DE-khah ah-doh-NAI ah-ley-noo kah-ah-shehr yeekhah-le-noo lahkh: ahl teez-kahr lah-noo ah-voh-noht ree-shoh-neem mah-hehr ye-kah-DE-moo-noo rah-khah-mey-khah kee dah-loh-noo me-ohd: ehz-reh-noo be-shehm ah-doh-NAI oh-seh shah-mah-yeem ve-ah-rehts: khah-neh-noo ah-doh-NAI khah-neh-noo kee rahv sah-vah-e-noo vooz: be-roh-gehz rah-khehm teez-kohr: be-roh-gehz ah-keh-dah teez-kohr, be-roh-gehz te-mee-moht teez-kohr: ah-doh-NAI hoh-shee-ah, hah-meh-lehkh yah-ah-neh-noo ve-yohm kah-re-eh-noo: kee hoo yah-dah yeets-reh-noo zah-khoor kee ah-fahr ah-nah-khe-noo: ah-ZE-reh-noo eh-loh-hey yeesh-eh-noo ahl de-vahr ke-vohd she-meh-khah ve-hah-tsee-leh-noo ve-khah-pehr ahl khah-toh-tey-noo le-mah-ahn she-meh-khah:

tokens.translation: The Chazzan recites the following Kaddish

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְ֒מָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ וְיַצְמַח פּוּרְ֒קָנֵהּ וִיקָרֵב (קֵץ) מְשִׁיחֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom bring forth His redemption and hasten the coming of His Mashiach in your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-gah-dahl ve-yeet-kah-dahsh she-meh rah-bah be-ah-LE-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh ve-yahts-mahkh poo-RE-kah-neh vee-kah-rehv (kehts) me-shee-kheh be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl, bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא:
tokens.translation: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵֽלָּא (בעשי"ת וּלְ֒עֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) מִן כָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He; above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah, be-reekh hoo le-eh-lah (vshyt" oo-LE-eh-lah mee-kahl) meen kohl beer-khah-tah ve-shee-rah-tah, toosh-be-khah-tah ve-neh-kheh-mah-tah, dah-ah-mee-rahn be-ah-LE-mah, ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְקַבֵּל צְלוֹתְ֒הוֹן וּבָעוּתְ֒הוֹן דְּכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל קֳדָם אֲבוּהוֹן דִּי בִשְׁ֒מַיָּא וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be acceptance of the prayers and supplications of the entire House of Israel before their Father in heaven. And say, Amein.
tokens.transliteration: teet-kah-behl tse-loh-TE-hohn oo-vah-oo-TE-hohn de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl koh-dahm ah-voo-hohn dee VEESH-mah-yah ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא וְחַיִּים טוֹבִים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be abundant peace from heaven and good life for us and for all Israel, —and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-lah-mah rah-bah meen she-mah-yah ve-khah-yeem toh-veem ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם (בעשי"ת הַשָּׁלוֹם) בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
tokens.translation: He Who makes peace (Ten Days of Penitence: the peace) in His high heavens may He, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amein.
tokens.transliteration: oh-seh shah-lohm (vshyt" hah-shah-lohm) beem-roh-mahv hoo yah-ah-seh shah-lohm ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn

tokens.hebrew: עָלֵֽינוּ לְשַׁבֵּֽחַ לַאֲדוֹן הַכֹּל לָתֵת גְּדֻלָּה לְיוֹצֵר בְּרֵאשִׁית שֶׁלֹּא עָשָֽׂנוּ כְּגוֹיֵי הָאֲרָצוֹת וְלֹא שָׂמָֽנוּ כְּמִשְׁפְּחוֹת הָאֲדָמָה שֶׁלֹּא שָׂם חֶלְקֵֽנוּ כָּהֶם וְגוֹרָלֵֽנוּ כְּכָל הֲמוֹנָם: שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לָהֶֽבֶל וָרִיק וּמִתְפַּלְּ֒לִים אֶל אֵל לֹא יוֹשִֽׁיעַ, וַאֲנַֽחְנוּ כּוֹרְ֒עִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים וּמוֹדִים לִפְנֵי מֶֽלֶךְ מַלְ֒כֵי הַמְּ֒לָכִים הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, שֶׁהוּא נוֹטֶה שָׁמַֽיִם וְיוֹסֵד אָֽרֶץ, וּמוֹשַׁב יְקָרוֹ בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל, וּשְׁ֒כִינַת עֻזּוֹ בְּגָבְ֒הֵי מְרוֹמִים, הוּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֵין עוֹד, אֱמֶת מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֶֽפֶס זוּלָתוֹ כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתוֹ וְיָדַעְתָּ הַיּוֹם וַהֲשֵׁבֹתָ אֶל לְבָבֶֽךָ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם מִמַּֽעַל וְעַל הָאָֽרֶץ מִתָּֽחַת אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise the Master of all, to ascribe greatness to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning: that He has not made us like the nations of the lands, and has not positioned us like the families of the earth; that He has not assigned our portion like theirs, nor our lot like that of all their multitudes. For they prostrate themselves to vanity and nothingness, and pray to a god that cannot deliver. But we bow, prostrate ourselves, and offer thanks before the Supreme King of Kings, the Holy One blessed is He, Who spreads the heavens, and establishes the earth, and the seat of His glory is in heaven above, and the abode of His invincible might is in the loftiest heights. He is our God, there is nothing else. Our King is true, all else is insignificant, as it is written in His Torah: “And You shall know this day and take into Your heart that Adonoy is God in the heavens above and upon the earth below; there is nothing else.”
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley-noo le-shah-beh-ahkh lah-ah-dohn hah-kohl lah-teht ge-doo-lah le-yoh-tsehr be-reh-sheet sheh-loh ah-sah-noo ke-goh-yey hah-ah-rah-tsoht ve-loh sah-mah-noo ke-meesh-pe-khoht hah-ah-dah-mah sheh-loh sahm khehl-keh-noo kah-hehm ve-goh-rah-leh-noo ke-khahl hah-moh-nahm: sheh-hehm meesh-tah-khah-veem lah-heh-vehl vah-reek oo-meet-pah-LE-leem ehl ehl loh yoh-shee-ah, vah-ahnah-khe-noo koh-RE-eem oo-meesh-tah-khah-veem oo-moh-deem leef-ney meh-lehkh MAHL-khey hah-ME-lah-kheem hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo, sheh-hoo noh-teh shah-mah-yeem ve-yoh-sehd ah-rehts, oo-moh-shahv ye-kah-roh bah-shah-mah-yeem mee-mah-ahl, oo-SHE-khee-naht oo-zoh be-GOHV-hey me-roh-meem, hoo eh-loh-hey-noo eyn ohd, eh-meht mahl-keh-noo eh-fehs zoo-lah-toh kah-kah-toov be-toh-rah-toh ve-yah-dah-tah hah-yohm vah-hah-sheh-voh-tah ehl le-vah-veh-khah kee ah-doh-NAI hoo hah-eh-loh-heem bah-shah-mah-yeem mee-mah-ahl ve-ahl hah-ah-rehts mee-tah-khaht eyn ohd:

tokens.hebrew: (וְ)עַל כֵּן נְקַוֶּה לְךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ לִרְאוֹת מְהֵרָה בְּתִפְאֶֽרֶת עֻזֶּֽךָ לְהַעֲבִיר גִּלּוּלִים מִן הָאָֽרֶץ וְהָאֱלִילִים כָּרוֹת יִכָּרֵתוּן לְתַקֵּן עוֹלָם בְּמַלְכוּת שַׁדַּי וְכָל בְּנֵי בָשָׂר יִקְרְאוּ בִשְׁ֒מֶֽךָ, לְהַפְנוֹת אֵלֶֽיךָ כָּל רִשְׁ֒עֵי אָֽרֶץ, יַכִּֽירוּ וְיֵדְ֒עוּ כָּל יוֹשְׁ֒בֵי תֵבֵל כִּי לְךָ תִכְרַע כָּל בֶּֽרֶךְ תִּשָּׁבַע כָּל לָשׁוֹן: לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ יִכְרְעוּ וְיִפֹּֽלוּ, וְלִכְ֒בוֹד שִׁמְךָ יְקָר יִתֵּֽנוּ, וִיקַבְּ֒לוּ כֻלָּם אֶת עֹל מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ, וְתִמְלֹךְ עֲלֵיהֶם מְהֵרָה לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד, כִּי הַמַּלְ֒כוּת שֶׁלְּ֒ךָ הִיא וּלְ֒עֽוֹלְ֒מֵי עַד תִּמְלוֹךְ בְּכָבוֹד, כַּכָּתוּב בְּתוֹרָתֶֽךָ יְהֹוָה יִמְלֹךְ לְעֹלָם וָעֶד: וְנֶאֱמַר וְהָיָה יְהֹוָה לְמֶֽלֶךְ עַל כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא יִהְיֶה יְהֹוָה אֶחָד וּשְׁמוֹ אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: We therefore put our hope in You, Adonoy our God, to soon behold the glory of Your might in banishing idolatry from the earth, and the false gods will be utterly exterminated to perfect the world as the kingdom of Shadai. And all mankind will invoke Your Name, to turn back to You, all the wicked of the earth. They will realize and know, all the inhabitants of the world, that to You, every knee must bend, every tongue must swear [allegiance to You]. Before You, Adonoy, our God, they will bow and prostrate themselves, and to the glory of Your Name give honor. And they will all accept [upon themselves] the yoke of Your kingdom, and You will reign over them, soon, forever and ever. For the kingdom is Yours, and to all eternity You will reign in glory, as it is written in Your Torah: “Adonoy will reign forever and ever.” And it is said: “And Adonoy will be King over the whole earth; on that day Adonoy will be One and His Name One.”
tokens.transliteration: (ve-ahl) kehn ne-kah-veh le-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo leer-oht me-heh-rah be-teef-eh-reht oo-zeh-khah le-hah-ah-veer gee-loo-leem meen hah-ah-rehts ve-hah-eh-lee-leem kah-roht yee-kah-reh-toon le-tah-kehn oh-lahm be-mahl-khoot shah-dahy ve-khohl be-ney vah-sahr yeek-re-oo VEESH-meh-khah, le-hahf-noht eh-ley-khah kohl REESH-ey ah-rehts, yah-kee-roo ve-yeh-DE-oo kohl yoh-SHE-vey teh-vehl kee le-khah teekh-rah kohl beh-rehkh tee-shah-vah kohl lah-shohn: le-fah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo yeekh-re-oo ve-yee-poh-loo, ve-LEEKH-vohd sheem-khah ye-kahr yee-teh-noo, vee-kah-BE-loo khoo-lahm eht ohl mahl-khoo-teh-khah, ve-teem-lohkh ah-ley-hehm me-heh-rah le-oh-lahm vah-ehd, kee hah-MAHL-khoot sheh-LE-khah hee oo-LE-oh-LE-mey ahd teem-lohkh be-khah-vohd, kah-kah-toov be-toh-rah-teh-khah ah-doh-NAI yeem-lohkh le-oh-lahm vah-ehd: ve-neh-eh-mahr ve-hah-yah ah-doh-NAI le-meh-lehkh ahl kohl hah-ah-rehts bah-yohm hah-hoo yeeh-yeh ah-doh-NAI eh-khahd oo-she-moh eh-khahd:

tokens.hebrew: אַל תִּירָא מִפַּֽחַד פִּתְאֹם וּמִשֹּׁאַת רְשָׁעִים כִּי תָבֹא: עֻֽצוּ עֵצָה וְתֻפָר דַּבְּ֒רוּ דָבָר וְלֹא יָקוּם כִּי עִמָּֽנוּ אֵל: וְעַד זִקְנָה אֲנִי הוּא וְעַד שֵׂיבָה אֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל: אֲנִי עָשִֽׂיתִי וַאֲנִי אֶשָּׂא וַאֲנִי אֶסְבֹּל וַאֲמַלֵּט:
tokens.translation: Do not fear sudden terror nor the destruction of the wicked when it comes. Take counsel together and it will be foiled speak the word and it will not stand for God is with us. To your old age I am [with you], to your older years I will sustain you, I have made you, and I will carry you, I will sustain you and save you.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tee-rah mee-pah-khahd peet-ohm oo-mee-shoh-aht re-shah-eem kee tah-voh: oo-tsoo eh-tsah ve-too-fahr dah-BE-roo dah-vahr ve-loh yah-koom kee ee-mah-noo ehl: ve-ahd zeek-nah ah-nee hoo ve-ahd sey-vah ah-nee ehs-bohl: ah-nee ah-see-tee vah-ah-nee eh-sah vah-ah-nee ehs-bohl vah-ah-mah-leht:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְ֒מָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ וְיַצְמַח פּוּרְ֒קָנֵהּ וִיקָרֵב (קֵץ) מְשִׁיחֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will and may He rule His kingdom bring forth His redemption and hasten the coming of His Mashiach in your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Israel, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-gah-dahl ve-yeet-kah-dahsh she-meh rah-bah be-ah-LE-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh ve-yahts-mahkh poo-RE-kah-neh vee-kah-rehv (kehts) me-shee-kheh be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl, bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְ֒מֵי עָלְ֒מַיָּא:
tokens.translation: May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-LE-mey ah-LE-mah-yah:

tokens.hebrew: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵֽלָּא (בעשי"ת וּלְ֒עֵֽלָּא מִכָּל) מִן כָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְ֒מָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He; above (Ten Days of Penitence: far above) all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah, be-reekh hoo le-eh-lah (vshyt" oo-LE-eh-lah mee-kahl) meen kohl beer-khah-tah ve-shee-rah-tah, toosh-be-khah-tah ve-neh-kheh-mah-tah, dah-ah-mee-rahn be-ah-LE-mah, ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא וְחַיִּים טוֹבִים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: May there be abundant peace from heaven and good life for us and for all Israel, —and say Amein.
tokens.transliteration: ye-heh she-lah-mah rah-bah meen she-mah-yah ve-khah-yeem toh-veem ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:

tokens.hebrew: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם (בעשי"ת הַשָּׁלוֹם) בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
tokens.translation: He Who makes peace (Ten Days of Penitence: the peace) in His high heavens may He, make peace for us and for all Israel, and say, Amen.
tokens.transliteration: oh-seh shah-lohm (vshyt" hah-shah-lohm) beem-roh-mahv hoo yah-ah-seh shah-lohm ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn

tokens.hebrew: מנהג טוב לומר אחר כל תפלה מזמור לדוד ה׳‬ אורי וישעי. ובפרט מר״ח אלול עד הושענא רבא (מורה באצבע סי' לז).
tokens.translation: The following is recited here by some congregations from the first day of Elul, through Shemini Atzeres. Others recite it at the end of the Maariv (Evening) Service.

tokens.hebrew: לְדָוִד יְהֹוָה אוֹרִי וְיִשְׁעִי מִמִּי אִירָא יְהֹוָה מָעוֹז חַיַּי מִמִּי אֶפְחָד: בִּקְ֒רֹב עָלַי מְרֵעִים לֶאֱכֹל אֶת בְּשָׂרִי צָרַי וְאֹיְ֒בַי לִי הֵֽמָּה כָשְׁ֒לוּ וְנָפָֽלוּ: אִם תַּחֲנֶה עָלַי מַחֲנֶה לֹא יִירָא לִבִּי אִם תָּקוּם עָלַי מִלְחָמָה בְּזֹאת אֲנִי בוֹטֵֽחַ: אַחַת שָׁאַֽלְתִּי מֵאֵת יְהֹוָה אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹֽעַם יְהֹוָה וּלְ֒בַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ: כִּי יִצְפְּ֒נֵֽנִי בְּסֻכֹּה בְּיוֹם רָעָה יַסְתִּרֵֽנִי בְּסֵֽתֶר אָהֳלוֹ בְּצוּר יְרוֹמְ֒מֵֽנִי: וְעַתָּה יָרוּם רֹאשִׁי עַל אֹיְ֒בַי סְבִיבוֹתָי וְאֶזְבְּחָה בְאָהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵי תְרוּעָה אָשִֽׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּ֒רָה לַיהֹוָה: שְׁמַע יְהֹוָה קוֹלִי אֶקְרָא וְחָנֵּֽנִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי: לְךָ אָמַר לִבִּי בַּקְּ֒שׁוּ פָנָי אֶת פָּנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֲבַקֵּשׁ: אַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶֽיךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי אַל תַּט בְּאַף עַבְדֶּֽךָ עֶזְרָתִי הָיִֽיתָ אַל תִּטְּ֒שֵֽׁנִי וְאַל תַּעַזְ֒בֵֽנִי אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי: כִּי אָבִי וְאִמִּי עֲזָבֽוּנִי וַיהֹוָה יַאַסְ֒פֵֽנִי: הוֹרֵֽנִי יְהֹוָה דַּרְכֶּֽךָ וּנְ֒חֵֽנִי בְּאֹֽרַח מִישׁוֹר לְמַֽעַן שׁוֹרְ֒רָי: אַל תִּתְּ֒נֵֽנִי בְּנֶֽפֶשׁ צָרָי כִּי קָֽמוּ בִי עֵֽדֵי שֶֽׁקֶר וִיפֵֽחַ חָמָס: לוּלֵא הֶאֱמַֽנְתִּי לִרְאוֹת בְּטוּב יְהֹוָה בְּאֶֽרֶץ חַיִּים: קַוֵּה אֶל יְהֹוָה חֲזַק וְיַאֲמֵץ לִבֶּךָ וְקַוֵּה אֶל יְהֹוָה:
tokens.translation: By David: Adonoy is my light and my salvation, whom shall I fear? Adonoy is the strength of my life, of whom shall I be afraid? When evildoers approach me to devour my flesh— my tormentors and my foes they stumble and fall. If an army should encamp against me, my heart would not fear; if war were to rise against me, in this I trust. One thing I request of Adonoy, [only] that shall I seek, that I may dwell in the House of Adonoy all the days of my life, to behold the pleasantness of Adonoy, and to meditate in His Sanctuary. For He will hide me in His Tabernacle on the day of distress, He will conceal me in the shelter of His Tent, upon a rock He will lift me. And now my head is raised high above my enemies around me; and I will offer in His Tent, sacrifices accompanied by trumpets of joy; I will sing and chant to Adonoy. Adonoy, hear my voice when I call; be gracious to me and answer me. Of You, my heart has said, “Seek My Presence”; Your Presence, Adonoy I will seek. Conceal not Your Presence from me, do not turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my help; neither cast me off nor abandon me, God of my deliverance. When my father and mother abandon me, Adonoy will gather me up. Adonoy, teach me Your way, and lead me in the path of uprightness, because of my watchers. Do not deliver me to the will of my tormentors, for false witnesses have risen against me, who breathe violence. Had I not believed that I would see the goodness of Adonoy in the land of living. Hope to Adonoy, be strong and He will give you courage; and hope to Adonoy.
tokens.transliteration: le-dah-veed ah-doh-NAI oh-ree ve-yeesh-ee mee-mee ee-rah ah-doh-NAI mah-ohz khah-yahy mee-mee ehf-khahd: BEEK-rohv ah-lahy me-reh-eem leh-eh-khohl eht be-sah-ree tsah-rahy ve-oh-YE-vahy lee heh-mah khah-SHE-loo ve-nah-fah-loo: eem tah-khah-neh ah-lahy mah-khah-neh loh yee-rah lee-bee eem tah-koom ah-lahy meel-khah-mah be-zoht ah-nee voh-teh-ahkh: ah-khaht shah-ah-le-tee meh-eht ah-doh-NAI oh-tahh ah-vah-kehsh sheev-tee be-veyt ah-doh-NAI kohl ye-mey khah-yahy lah-khah-zoht be-noh-ahm ah-doh-NAI oo-LE-vah-kehr be-hey-khah-loh: kee yeets-PE-neh-nee be-soo-kohh be-yohm rah-ah yahs-tee-reh-nee be-seh-tehr oh-hoh-loh be-tsoor ye-roh-ME-meh-nee: ve-ah-tah yah-room roh-shee ahl oh-YE-vahy se-vee-voh-tahy ve-ehz-be-khah ve-oh-hoh-loh zeev-khey te-roo-ah ah-shee-rah vah-ah-zah-ME-rah lah-ah-doh-NAI: she-mah ah-doh-NAI koh-lee ehk-rah ve-khah-neh-nee vah-ah-neh-nee: le-khah ah-mahr lee-bee bah-KE-shoo fah-nahy eht pah-ney-khah ah-doh-NAI ah-vah-kehsh: ahl tahs-tehr pah-ney-khah mee-meh-nee ahl taht be-ahf ahv-deh-khah ehz-rah-tee hah-yee-tah ahl tee-TE-sheh-nee ve-ahl tah-AHZ-veh-nee eh-loh-hey yeesh-ee: kee ah-vee ve-ee-mee ah-zah-voo-nee vah-ah-doh-NAI yah-AHS-feh-nee: hoh-reh-nee ah-doh-NAI dahr-keh-khah oo-NE-kheh-nee be-oh-rahkh mee-shohr le-mah-ahn shoh-RE-rahy: ahl tee-TE-neh-nee be-neh-fehsh tsah-rahy kee kah-moo vee eh-dey sheh-kehr vee-feh-ahkh khah-mahs: loo-leh heh-ehmah-ne-tee leer-oht be-toov ah-doh-NAI be-eh-rehts khah-yeem: kah-veh ehl ah-doh-NAI khah-zahk ve-yah-ah-mehts lee-beh-khah ve-kah-veh ehl ah-doh-NAI:

tokens.translation: Mourner's Kaddish is said here:

tokens.hebrew: בבית האבל בבוקר אחר שיר של יום ואחר מנחה בימים שיש בהם תחנון אומרים זה:
tokens.translation: It is customary to recite this psalm (49) in the house of a mourner during the week of mourning, following the morning and evening services. On weekdays when Tachanun is not said Psalm 16 (page 218) is substituted. This psalm, the final hymn of the psalms set down by the sons of Korach has significance for all mankind. Its message is that man must utilize all his material and physical resources to enhance his spiritual existence so that when his soul survives the body's brief stay on earth it can ascend to immortality. If man fails to recognize his purpose in life and instead regards the acquisition of material wealth the primary aim of life, he forfeits his hope of immortality, and his existence will not continue beyond the grave.—S.R. Hirsch

tokens.hebrew: לַמְנַצֵּֽחַ לִבְנֵי קֹֽרַח מִזְמוֹר: שִׁמְ֒עוּ זֹאת כָּל־הָעַמִּים הַאֲזִֽינוּ כָּל יֽשְׁ֒בֵי חָֽלֶד: גַּם בְּנֵי אָדָם גַּם בְּנֵי אִישׁ יַֽחַד עָשִׁיר וְאֶבְיוֹן: פִּי יְדַבֵּר חָכְמוֹת וְהָגוּת לִבִּי תְבוּנוֹת: אַטֶּה לְמָשָׁל אָזְנִי אֶפְתַּח בְּכִנּוֹר חִידָתִי: לָֽמָּה אִירָא בִּֽימֵי רָע עֲוֹן עֲקֵבַי יְסוּבֵּֽנִי: הַבֹּטְ֒חִים עַל חֵילָם וּבְ֒רֹב עָשְׁרָם יִתְהַלָּֽלוּ: אָח לֺא פָדֹה יִפְדֶּה אִישׁ לֺא יִתֵּן לֵאלֺהִים כָּפְרוֹ: וְיֵקַר פִּדְיוֹן נַפְשָׁם וְחָדַל לְעוֹלָם: וִיחִי עוֹד לָנֶֽצַח לֺא יִרְאֶה הַשָּֽׁחַת: כִּי יִרְאֶה חֲכָמִים יָמֽוּתוּ יַֽחַד כְּסִיל וָבַֽעַר יֹאבֵֽדוּ וְעָזְ֒בוּ לַאֲחֵרִים חֵילָם: קִרְבָּם בָּתֵּֽימוֹ לְעוֹלָם מִשְׁכְּ֒נֹתָם לְדוֹר וָדֹר קָרְ֒אוּ בִשְׁמוֹתָם עֲלֵי אֲדָמוֹת: וְאָדָם בִּיקָר בַּל־יָלִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּ֒הֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ: זֶה דַרְכָּם כֶּֽסֶל לָֽמוֹ וְאַחֲרֵיהֶם בְּפִיהֶם יִרְצוּ סֶֽלָה: כַּצֹּאן לִשְׁ֒אוֹל שַׁתּוּ מָֽוֶת יִרְעֵם וַיִּרְדּוּ בָם יְשָׁרִים לַבֹּֽקֶר וְצוּרָם לְבַלּוֹת שְׁאוֹל מִזְּ֒בֻל לוֹ: אַךְ־אֱלֺהִים יִפְדֶּה נַפְשִׁי מִיַּד שְׁאוֹל כִּי יִקָּחֵֽנִי סֶֽלָה: אַל־תִּירָא כִּי־יַעֲשִׁר אִישׁ כִּי־יִרְבֶּה כְּבוֹד בֵּיתוֹ: כִּי לֺא בְמוֹתוֹ יִקַּח הַכֹּל לֺא־יֵרֵד אַחֲרָיו כְּבוֹדוֹ: כִּי־נַפְשׁוֹ בְּחַיָּיו יְבָרֵךְ וְיוֹדֻֽךָ כִּי־תֵיטִיב לָךְ: תָּבוֹא עַד־דּוֹר אֲבוֹתָיו עַד־נֵֽצַח לֺא יִרְאוּ אוֹר: אָדָם בִּיקָר וְלֺא־יָבִין נִמְשַׁל כַּבְּ֒הֵמוֹת נִדְמוּ:
tokens.translation: To Him Who grants victory, a psalm by the sons of Korach. Hear this all peoples, listen all inhabitants of the decaying world! Sons of Adam and sons of men, rich and poor together. My mouth shall speak wisdom, and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding. I will incline my ear to a parable, I will begin to solve, to the accompaniment of a harp, my riddle. Why should I fear in the days of evil? The iniquity I trod upon surrounds me. Those who trust in their wealth and take pride in their great riches. A man will not redeem his brother neither can he give to God his ransom. The redemption of their soul is too costly and it shall cease to be forever. Shall he then live forever, shall he never see the grave? For he sees that wise men die, the fools and senseless perish equally and leave their wealth to others. Their inner thoughts are that their houses [will last] forever, their homes for generation after generation; (for) they have proclaimed their names throughout the lands. But man does not endure in his splendor, he is likened to the silenced animals. This is their way— their folly remains with them, and [yet] their descendants take pleasure in their speech, Selah. Like sheep—they are destined for the grave; death shall be their shepherd, and the upright shall dominate them at morning, their form will be consumed in the grave; [it will not remain] their dwelling-place. But God will redeem my soul from the [grasp of] the grave, for He will take me [to Himself] Selah. Fear not when a man grows rich, when the glory of his house is increased. For when he dies, he shall carry nothing away, his glory will not descend after him. Because while he lived, he blessed his soul. (saying): they will praise you because you have done well for yourself. He will join the generation of his fathers, they shall not see light, for all eternity. Man with [all] his splendor, [but] without understanding is likened to the silenced animals.

title: Avinu Malkeinu
sefariaRef: Siddur Sefard, Weekday Mincha, Avinu Malkeinu
useCase: Avinu Malkeinu · Siddur Sefard Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בתענית ציבור ובעשי"ת אומרים כאן אבינו מלכנו. גודל מעלת אבינו מלכנו הובא בספרים. ויסדה רבי עקיבא. ונתקן כנגד ברכות אמצעיות דתפלת י"ח דחול. ולפי שיש בו מעין י"ח אין אומרים בשבת.
tokens.translation: During the Ten Days of Penitence, Avinu Malkeinu is recited here during Shacharis—the morning service, and Mincha—the afternoon service. It is also said by some congregations on public Fast Days. The number of petitions in this prayer varies with custom, but in our rite, Avinu Malkeinu consists of 44 petitions. Since many of them are similar to the petitions of Shemoneh Esrei, Avinu Malkeinu is never recited on Shabbos, when the petitions of Shemoneh Esrei are also omitted. This unique and moving prayer is recorded as having been recited by Rabbi Akiva. The Talmud (Maseches Taanis 25b) relates that Rabbi Eliezer once stepped down before the Ark and recited the 24 benedictions for fast days and his prayers were not answered. Rabbi Akiva stepped down after him and exclaimed, "Our Father, our King, we have no king except You. Our Father, our King, for Your sake have mercy on us," and rain fell.
Our Father, our King! we have sinned before You.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ אֵין לָֽנוּ מֶֽלֶךְ אֶלָּא אָֽתָּה:
tokens.translation: Our Father our King! we have no King except You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo eyn lah-noo meh-lehkh eh-lah ah-tah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! deal with us [kindly] for the sake of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh ee-mah-noo le-mah-ahn she-meh-khah:

tokens.translation: During the Ten Days of Penitence, say:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חַדֵּשׁ עָלֵֽינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! renew for us a good year.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-dehsh ah-ley-noo shah-nah toh-vah:

tokens.translation: On public fast-days, say:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בָּרֵךְ עָלֵֽינוּ שָׁנָה טוֹבָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! bless us with a good year.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo bah-rehkh ah-ley-noo shah-nah toh-vah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ בַּטֵּל מֵעָלֵֽינוּ כָּל גְּזֵרוֹת קָשׁוֹת:
tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! annul all harsh decrees concerning us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo bah-tehl meh-ah-ley-noo kohl ge-zeh-roht kah-shoht:

tokens.translation: Our Father, our King! annul the designs of those who hate us.
Our Father, our King! thwart the plans of our enemies.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה כָּל צַר וּמַשְׂטִין מֵעָלֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! rid us of every oppressor and adversary.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-leh kohl tsahr oo-mahs-teen meh-ah-ley-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְתוֹם פִּיּוֹת מַשְׂטִינֵֽנוּ וּמְ֒קַטְרִיגֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! seal the mouths of our adversaries and accusers.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo se-tohm pee-yoht mahs-tee-neh-noo oo-ME-kaht-ree-geh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כַּלֵּה דֶּֽבֶר וְחֶֽרֶב וְרָעָב וּשְׁ֒בִי וּמַשְׁחִית וְעָוֹן וּשְׁ֒מַד מִבְּ֒נֵי בְרִיתֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! remove pestilence, sword, famine, captivity, destruction, [the burden of] iniquity and religious persecution from the members of Your covenant.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-leh deh-vehr ve-kheh-rehv ve-rah-ahv oo-SHE-vee oo-mahsh-kheet ve-ah-vohn oo-SHE-mahd mee-BE-ney ve-ree-teh-khah:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! withhold the plague from Your inheritance.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ סְלַח וּמְ֒חַל לְכָל עֲוֹנוֹתֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! forgive and pardon all our iniquities.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo se-lahkh oo-ME-khahl le-khohl ah-voh-noh-tey-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחֵה וְהַעֲבֵר פְּשָׁעֵֽינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵֽינוּ מִנֶּֽגֶד עֵינֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! blot out and remove our transgressions and sins from before Your eyes.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo me-kheh ve-hah-ah-vehr pe-shah-ey-noo ve-khah-toh-tey-noo mee-neh-gehd ey-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ מְחוֹק בְּרַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים כָּל שִׁטְ֒רֵי חוֹבוֹתֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! erase in Your abundant mercy all records of our liabilities.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo me-khohk be-rah-khah-mey-khah hah-rah-beem kohl SHEET-rey khoh-voh-tey-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַחֲזִירֵֽנוּ בִּתְ֒שׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! bring us back in wholehearted repentance before You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo hah-khah-zee-reh-noo BEET-shoo-vah she-leh-mah le-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ שְׁלַח רְפוּאָה שְׁלֵמָה לְחוֹלֵי עַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! send complete healing to the sick among Your people.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo she-lahkh re-foo-ah she-leh-mah le-khoh-ley ah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ קְרַע רֹֽעַ גְּזַר דִּינֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! tear up the evil [parts] of our sentence.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ke-rah roh-ah ge-zahr dee-neh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכְ֒רֵֽנוּ בְּזִכָּרוֹן טוֹב לְפָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! remember us favorably before You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo zah-KHE-reh-noo be-zee-kah-rohn tohv le-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.translation: The following five prayers are said during the Ten Days of Penitence.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר חַיִּים טוֹבִים:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of the Good Life.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr khah-yeem toh-veem:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר גְּאֻלָּה וִישׁוּעָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Redemption and Deliverance.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr ge-oo-lah vee-shoo-ah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר פַּרְנָסָה וְכַלְכָּלָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Maintenance and Sustenance.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr pahr-nah-sah ve-khahl-kah-lah:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Merits.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ כָּתְ֒בֵֽנוּ בְּסֵֽפֶר סְלִיחָה וּמְ֒חִילָה:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! inscribe us in the Book of Pardon and Forgiveness.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-TE-veh-noo be-seh-fehr se-lee-khah oo-ME-khee-lah:

tokens.translation: The following five prayers are said on public fast-days.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for a good life.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for redemption and deliverance.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for maintenance and sustenance.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for merit.
Our Father, Our King! remember us for pardon and forgiveness.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הַצְמַח לָֽנוּ יְשׁוּעָה בְּקָרוֹב:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! cause deliverance to spring forth for us soon.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo hahts-mahkh lah-noo ye-shoo-ah be-kah-rohv:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ הָרֵם קֶֽרֶן יִשְׂרָאֵל עַמֶּֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! raise up the might of Your people Israel.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo hah-rehm keh-rehn yees-rah-ehl ah-meh-khah:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! raise up the might of Your anointed.
Our Father, Our King! fill our hands with Your blessings.
Our Father, Our King! fill our storehouses with abundance.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ שְׁמַע קוֹלֵֽנוּ חוּס וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! hear our voice, spare us and have compassion upon us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo she-mah koh-leh-noo khoos ve-rah-khehm ah-ley-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ קַבֵּל בְּרַחֲמִים וּבְ֒רָצוֹן אֶת תְּפִלָּתֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! accept our prayer with compassion and favor.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo kah-behl be-rah-khah-meem oo-VE-rah-tsohn eht te-fee-lah-teh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ פְּתַח שַׁעֲרֵי שָׁמַֽיִם לִתְ֒פִלָּתֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! open the gates of heaven to our prayer.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo pe-tahkh shah-ah-rey shah-mah-yeem LEET-fee-lah-teh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ זָכוֹר כִּי עָפָר אֲנָֽחְנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! remember, that we are dust.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo zah-khohr kee ah-fahr ah-nah-khe-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ נָא אַל תְּשִׁיבֵֽנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! Please do not turn us away empty-handed from You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo nah ahl te-shee-veh-noo rey-kahm mee-LE-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ תְּהֵא הַשָּׁעָה הַזֹּאת שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים וְעֵת רָצוֹן מִלְּ֒פָנֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! let this hour be an hour of compassion and a time of favor before You.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo te-heh hah-shah-ah hah-zoht she-aht rah-khah-meem ve-eht rah-tsohn mee-LE-fah-ney-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חֲמוֹל עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל עוֹלָלֵֽינוּ וְטַפֵּֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! have compassion upon us, and upon our children and infants.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-mohl ah-ley-noo ve-ahl oh-lah-ley-noo ve-tah-peh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן הֲרוּגִים עַל שֵׁם קָדְשֶֽׁךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of those who were slain for Your holy Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn hah-roo-geem ahl shehm kohd-sheh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן טְבוּחִים עַל יִחוּדֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of those who were slaughtered for [proclaiming] Your Unity.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn te-voo-kheem ahl yee-khoo-deh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן בָּאֵי בָאֵשׁ וּבַמַּֽיִם עַל קִדּוּשׁ שְׁמֶֽךָ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of those who went through fire and water for the sanctification of Your Name.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn bah-ey vah-ehsh oo-vah-mah-yeem ahl kee-doosh she-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ נְקוֹם לְעֵינֵֽינוּ נִקְ֒מַת דַּם עֲבָדֶֽיךָ הַשָּׁפוּךְ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! avenge before our eyes the spilled blood of Your servants.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ne-kohm le-ey-ney-noo NEEK-maht dahm ah-vah-dey-khah hah-shah-fookh:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַעַנְ֒ךָ אִם לֺא לְמַעֲנֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for Your sake if not for ours.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-AHN-khah eem loh le-mah-ah-neh-noo:

tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for Your sake and deliver us.

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן רַחֲמֶֽיךָ הָרַבִּים:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of Your great mercy.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn rah-khah-mey-khah hah-rah-beem:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא שֶׁנִּקְרָא עָלֵֽינוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! do it for the sake of Your great, mighty, and awesome Name which is proclaimed upon us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo ah-seh le-mah-ahn sheem-khah hah-gah-dohl hah-gee-bohr ve-hah-noh-rah sheh-neek-rah ah-ley-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אָבִֽינוּ מַלְכֵּֽנוּ חָנֵּֽנוּ וַעֲנֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵין בָּֽנוּ מַעֲשִׂים עֲשֵׂה עִמָּֽנוּ צְדָקָה וָחֶֽסֶד וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our Father, Our King! favor us and answer us for we have no accomplishments; deal with us charitably and kindly with us and deliver us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vee-noo mahl-keh-noo khah-neh-noo vah-ah-neh-noo kee eyn bah-noo mah-ah-seem ah-seh ee-mah-noo tse-dah-kah vah-kheh-sehd ve-hoh-shee-eh-noo:
