tokens.transliteration: ke-hoh-shah-tah eh-leem be-lood ee-mahkh. be-tseh-te-khah le-yeh-shah ah-mahkh. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah gohy veh-loh-heem. de-roo-sheem le-yeh-shah eh-loh-heem. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah hah-mohn tseev-oht. ve-ee-mahm mahl-ah-khey tse-vah-oht. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah zah-keem mee-beyt ah-vah-deem. khah-noon be-yah-dahm mah-ah-vee-deem. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah te-voo-eem be-tsool ge-zah-reem. ye-kah-re-khah ee-mahm mah-ah-vee-reem. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah kah-nah me-shoh-reh-reht vah-yoh-shah. le-goh-khahh me-tsoo-yeh-neht vah-yee-vah-shah. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah mah-ah-mahr ve-hoh-tseh-tee eht-khehm. nah-koov ve-hoo-tseh-tee ee-te-khehm. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah soh-ve-vey meez-beh-ahkh. oh-me-sey ah-rah-vah le-hah-keef meez-beh-ahkh. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah peel-ey ah-rohn ke-hoof-shah. tsee-ehr pe-leh-sheht bah-khah-rohn ahf ve-noh-shah. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah ke-hee-loht bah-veh-lah shah-lahkh-tah. rah-khoom le-mah-ah-nahm shoo-lahkh-tah. kehn hoh-shah nah: ke-hoh-shah-tah she-voot sheev-tey yah-ah-kohv. tah-shoov ve-tah-sheev she-voot oh-hoh-ley yah-ah-kohv ve-hoh-shee-ah nah. ke-hoh-shah-tah shoh-me-rey meets-voht ve-khoh-khey ye-shoo-oht ehl le-moh-shah-oht. ve-hoh-shee-ah nah: ah-nee vah-hoh hoh-shee-ah nah:

tokens.hebrew: הוֹשִׁיעָה אֶת עַמֶּךָ וּבָרֵךְ אֶת נַחֲלָתֶךָ וּרְעֵם וְנַשְּׂאֵם עַד הָעוֹלָם: וְיִהְיוּ דְּבָרַי אֵלֶּה אֲשֶׁר הִתְחַנַּנְתִּי לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה קְרוֹבִים אֶל יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ יוֹמָם וָלָיְלָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מִשְׁפַּט עַבְדּוֹ וּמִשְׁפַּט עַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל דְּבַר יוֹם בְּיוֹמוֹ: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ כִּי יְהֹוָה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים אֵין עוֹד:
tokens.translation: Deliver and bless Your people; tend them and sustain them forever (Psalms 28:9). And may these words of mine, which I have offered in supplication before the Lord, be close to the Lord our God day and night, that He may provide for His servant and for His people Israel, according to each day’s needs. In order that all the peoples of the earth may know that the Lord alone is God, there is no other (I Kings 8:59-60).
tokens.transliteration: hoh-shee-ah eht ah-meh-khah oo-vah-rehkh eht nah-khah-lah-teh-khah oo-re-ehm ve-nah-se-ehm ahd hah-oh-lahm: ve-yeeh-yoo de-vah-rahy eh-leh ah-shehr heet-khah-nahn-tee leef-ney ah-doh-NAI ke-roh-veem ehl ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo yoh-mahm vah-lah-ye-lah lah-ah-soht meesh-paht ahv-doh oo-meesh-paht ah-moh yees-rah-ehl de-vahr yohm be-yoh-moh: le-mah-ahn dah-aht kohl ah-mey hah-ah-rehts kee ah-doh-NAI hoo hah-eh-loh-heem eyn ohd:

tokens.hebrew: קדיש שלם, שיר של יום, לדוד, קריאת התורה, אשרי ובא לציון, מוסף, קוה ועלינו:
tokens.translation: Full Kaddish, the Song of the Day, Le'David (Psalms 27), Reading of the Torah, Ashrei, Uva Letzion, the additional prayer, Kaveh and Aleinu.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.1
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: The song of songs which is Shlomo's.

tokens.hebrew: יִשָּׁקֵ֨נִי֙ מִנְּשִׁיק֣וֹת פִּ֔יהוּ כִּֽי־טוֹבִ֥ים דֹּדֶ֖יךָ מִיָּֽיִן:
tokens.translation: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth, for your love is dearer than wine.
tokens.transliteration: yee-shah-KEH-nee mee-ne-shee-KOHT PEE-hoo kee toh-VEEM doh-DEY-khah mee-yah-yeen:

tokens.hebrew: לְרֵ֨יחַ֙ שְׁמָנֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִ֔ים שֶׁ֖מֶן תּוּרַ֣ק שְׁמֶ֑ךָ עַל־כֵּ֖ן עֲלָמ֥וֹת אֲהֵבֽוּךָ:
tokens.translation: Like the fragrance of good oils, your name is like flowing oil; therefore young maidens love you.
tokens.transliteration: le-REY-ahkh she-mah-NEY-khah toh-VEEM SHEH-mehn too-RAHK she-MEH-khah ahl KEHN ah-lah-MOHT ah-heh-voo-khah:

tokens.hebrew: מָשְׁכֵ֖נִי אַֽחֲרֶ֣יךָ נָר֑וּצָה הֱבִיאַ֨נִי הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ חֲדָרָ֗יו נָגִ֤ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ נַזְכִּ֤ירָה דֹדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן מֵֽישָׁרִ֖ים אֲהֵבֽוּךָ:
tokens.translation: Draw me, we will run after you; the king has brought me into his chambers, we will be glad and rejoice in you, we recall your love more than wine, they love you sincerely.
tokens.transliteration: mah-she-KHEH-nee ah-khah-REY-khah nah-ROO-tsah heh-vee-AH-nee hah-MEH-lehkh khah-dah-RAHV nah-GEE-lah ve-nees-me-KHAH BAHKH nahz-KEE-rah doh-DEY-khah mee-YAH-yeen mey-shah-REEM ah-heh-voo-khah:

tokens.hebrew: שְׁחוֹרָ֤ה אֲנִי֙ וְֽנָאוָ֔ה בְּנ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כְּאָֽהֳלֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר כִּֽירִיע֖וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה:
tokens.translation: I am black, but comely, daughters of Jerusalem; like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Shlomo.
tokens.transliteration: she-khoh-RAH ah-NEE ve-nah-VAH be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem ke-oh-hoh-LEY keh-DAHR kee-ree-OHT she-loh-mohh:

tokens.hebrew: אַל־תִּרְאֻ֨נִי֙ שֶֽׁאֲנִ֣י שְׁחַרְחֹ֔רֶת שֶׁשְּׁזָפַ֖תְנִי הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ בְּנֵ֧י אִמִּ֣י נִֽחֲרוּ־בִ֗י שָׂמֻ֨נִי֙ נֹֽטֵרָ֣ה אֶת־הַכְּרָמִ֔ים כַּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לֹ֥א נָטָֽרְתִּי:
tokens.translation: Do not look upon me [with contempt] that I am so black, for the sun has tanned me; my mother's sons were incensed against me, they made me keeper of the vineyards, [but] my own vineyard I did not watch.
tokens.transliteration: ahl teer-OO-nee sheh-ah-NEE she-khahr-KHOH-reht sheh-she-zah-FAHT-nee hah-SHAH-mehsh be-NEY ee-MEE nee-khah-roo VEE sah-MOO-nee noh-teh-RAH eht hah-ke-rah-MEEM kahr-MEE sheh-LEE LOH nah-tah-re-tee:

tokens.hebrew: הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י שֶׁ֤אָֽהֲבָה֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֵיכָ֣ה תִרְעֶ֔ה אֵיכָ֖ה תַּרְבִּ֣יץ בַּֽצָּֽהֳרָ֑יִם שַׁלָּמָ֤ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ כְּעֹ֣טְיָ֔ה עַ֖ל עֶדְרֵ֥י חֲבֵרֶֽיךָ:
tokens.translation: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where do you graze your flock where do you rest your flock at noon; for why should I flit about around the flocks of your companions?
tokens.transliteration: hah-GEE-dah LEE SHEH-ah-hah-VAH nahf-SHEE ey-KHAH teer-EH ey-KHAH tahr-BEETS bah-tsoh-hoh-RAH-yeem shah-lah-MAH eh-he-YEH ke-OH-te-YAH AHL ehd-REY khah-veh-rey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אִם־לֹ֤א תֵֽדְעִי֙ לָ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים צְֽאִי־לָ֞ךְ בְּעִקְבֵ֣י הַצֹּ֗אן וּרְעִי֙ אֶת־גְּדִיֹּתַ֔יִךְ עַ֖ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת הָֽרֹעִֽים:
tokens.translation: If you do not know [you who are the] fairest of women; go forth in the footsteps of the sheep and pasture your kids near the dwellings of the shepherds.
tokens.transliteration: eem LOH teh-de-EE LAHKH hah-yah-FAH bah-nah-SHEEM tse-ee LAHKH be-eek-VEY hah-TSOHN oo-re-EE eht ge-dee-yoh-TAH-yeekh AHL meesh-ke-NOHT hah-roh-eem:

tokens.translation: To steeds in the chariots of Pharaoh I have likened you, my beloved.
Your cheeks are comely with rows of gems your neck with [pearl] necklaces.

tokens.hebrew: תּוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ נַֽעֲשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ עִ֖ם נְקֻדּ֥וֹת הַכָּֽסֶף:
tokens.translation: Circlets of gold we will make for you with spangles of silver.
tokens.transliteration: toh-REY zah-HAHV nah-ah-seh LAHKH EEM ne-koo-DOHT hah-kah-sehf:

tokens.translation: While the king was at his table, my spikenard gave out its fragrance.
tokens.transliteration: ahd SHEH-hah-MEH-lehkh beem-see-BOH neer-DEE nah-TAHN rey-khoh:

tokens.hebrew: צְר֨וֹר הַמֹּ֤ר | דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י בֵּ֥ין שָׁדַ֖י יָלִֽין:
tokens.translation: A bundle of myrrh is my beloved to me, between my breasts he shall lie.
tokens.transliteration: tse-ROHR hah-MOHR | doh-DEE LEE BEYN shah-DAHY yah-leen:

tokens.hebrew: אֶשְׁכֹּ֨ל הַכֹּ֤פֶר | דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י בְּכַרְמֵ֖י עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי:
tokens.translation: A cluster of henna is my beloved to me in the vineyards of En-gedi.
tokens.transliteration: ehsh-KOHL hah-KOH-fehr | doh-DEE LEE be-khahr-MEY EYN geh-dee:

tokens.hebrew: הִנָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ יָפָ֖ה עֵינַ֥יִךְ יוֹנִֽים:
tokens.translation: Behold you are beautiful, my beloved, behold you are beautiful; your eyes are like doves.
tokens.transliteration: hee-NAHKH yah-FAH rah-yah-TEE hee-NAHKH yah-FAH ey-NAH-yeekh yoh-neem:

tokens.hebrew: הִנְּךָ֨ יָפֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ אַ֣ף נָעִ֔ים אַף־עַרְשֵׂ֖נוּ רַֽעֲנָנָֽה:
tokens.translation: You are handsome, my beloved, most handsome; indeed our bed is fresh.
tokens.transliteration: hee-ne-KHAH yah-FEH doh-DEE AHF nah-EEM ahf ahr-SEH-noo rah-ah-nah-nah:

tokens.translation: The beams of our houses are cedars, our panels are cypresses.

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.2
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: I am a rose of Sharon a rose of the valleys.

tokens.hebrew: כְּשֽׁוֹשַׁנָּה֙ בֵּ֣ין הַֽחוֹחִ֔ים כֵּ֥ן רַעְיָתִ֖י בֵּ֥ין הַבָּנֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: As a rose among the thorns, so is my beloved among the daughters.
tokens.transliteration: ke-shoh-shah-NAH BEYN hah-khoh-KHEEM KEHN rah-yah-TEE BEYN hah-bah-noht:

tokens.hebrew: כְּתַפּ֨וּחַ֙ בַּֽעֲצֵ֣י הַיַּ֔עַר כֵּ֥ן דּוֹדִ֖י בֵּ֣ין הַבָּנִ֑ים בְּצִלֹּו֙ חִמַּ֣דְתִּי וְיָשַׁ֔בְתִּי וּפִרְי֖וֹ מָת֥וֹק לְחִכִּֽי:
tokens.translation: As an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my beloved among the sons; in its shade I delighted and sat, and its fruit was sweet to my palate.
tokens.transliteration: ke-tah-POO-ahkh bah-ah-TSEY hah-YAH-ahr KEHN doh-DEE BEYN hah-bah-NEEM be-tsee-LOH khee-MAHD-tee ve-yah-SHAHV-tee oo-feer-YOH mah-TOHK le-khee-kee:

tokens.hebrew: הֱבִיאַ֨נִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַיָּ֔יִן וְדִגְל֥וֹ עָלַ֖י אַֽהֲבָֽה:
tokens.translation: He brought me to the banqueting-house, and his banner is raised over me in love.
tokens.transliteration: heh-vee-AH-nee ehl BEYT hah-YAH-yeen ve-deeg-LOH ah-LAHY ah-hah-vah:

tokens.hebrew: סַמְּכ֨וּנִי֙ בָּֽאֲשִׁישׁ֔וֹת רַפְּד֖וּנִי בַּתַּפּוּחִ֑ים כִּֽי־חוֹלַ֥ת אַֽהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי:
tokens.translation: Sustain me with dainty cakes refresh my bed with [the scent of] apples; for I am lovesick.
tokens.transliteration: sah-me-KHOO-nee bah-ah-shee-SHOHT rah-pe-DOO-nee bah-tah-poo-KHEEM kee khoh-LAHT ah-hah-VAH ah-nee:

tokens.translation: His left hand was under my head and his right would embrace me.

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֨םִ֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָדֶ֑ה אִם־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וְֽאִם־תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem by the gazelles and the does of the field; that you do not cause hatred nor disturb this love while it still pleases.
tokens.transliteration: heesh-BAH-tee eht-KHEHM be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-mee beets-vah-OHT OH be-ahy-LOHT hah-shah-DEH eem tah-EE-roo | ve-eem te-oh-re-ROO eht hah-ah-hah-VAH AHD sheh-tehkh-pahts:

tokens.hebrew: ק֣וֹל דּוֹדִ֔י הִנֵּה־זֶ֖ה בָּ֑א מְדַלֵּג֙ עַל־הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים מְקַפֵּ֖ץ עַל־הַגְּבָעֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: The voice of my beloved! Behold he comes; leaping over the mountains, skipping over the hills.
tokens.transliteration: KOHL doh-DEE hee-neh ZEH BAH me-dah-LEHG ahl HEH-hah-REEM me-kah-PEHTS ahl hah-ge-vah-oht:

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹמֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ לִצְבִ֔י א֖וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֑ים הִנֵּה־זֶ֤ה עוֹמֵד֙ אַחַ֣ר כָּתְלֵ֔נוּ מַשְׁגִּ֨יחַ֙ מִן־הַֽחַלֹּנ֔וֹת מֵצִ֖יץ מִן־הַֽחֲרַכִּֽים:
tokens.translation: My beloved resembles a gazelle or a young hart; behold, he stands behind our wall, observing through the windows peering through the lattices.
tokens.transliteration: doh-MEH doh-DEE leets-VEE OH le-OH-fehr hah-ah-yah-LEEM hee-neh ZEH oh-MEHD ah-KHAHR kah-te-LEH-noo mahsh-GEE-ahkh meen hah-khah-loh-NOHT meh-TSEETS meen hah-khah-rah-keem:

tokens.hebrew: עָנָ֥ה דוֹדִ֖י וְאָ֣מַר לִ֑י ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ רַעְיָתִ֥י יָֽפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: My beloved spoke and said to me, “Rise up, my beloved, my fair one, and go forth.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NAH doh-DEE ve-AH-mahr LEE KOO-mee LAHKH rah-yah-TEE yah-fah-TEE oo-le-khee lahkh:

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֥ה הַסְּתָ֖יּו עָבָ֑ר הַגֶּ֕שֶׁם חָלַ֖ף הָלַ֥ךְ לֽוֹ:
tokens.translation: For behold, the winter is past, the rain is over, and gone.
tokens.transliteration: kee hee-NEH hah-se-TAHYV ah-VAHR hah-GEH-shehm khah-LAHF hah-LAHKH loh:

tokens.hebrew: הַנִּצָּנִים֙ נִרְא֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ עֵ֥ת הַזָּמִ֖יר הִגִּ֑יעַ וְק֥וֹל הַתּ֖וֹר נִשְׁמַ֥ע בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: The blossoms have appeared on the land, the time of singing has come; and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
tokens.transliteration: hah-nee-tsah-NEEM neer-OO vah-AH-rehts EHT hah-zah-MEER hee-GEE-ah ve-KOHL hah-TOHR neesh-MAH be-ahr-tseh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: הַתְּאֵנָה֙ חָֽנְטָ֣ה פַגֶּ֔יהָ וְהַגְּפָנִ֥ים | סְמָדַ֖ר נָ֣תְנוּ רֵ֑יחַ ק֥וּמִי לָ֛ךְ֯ רַעְיָתִ֥י יָֽפָתִ֖י וּלְכִי־לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: The fig tree has produced its green figs, and the grapevines tender grapes give out their fragrance; arise my beloved, my fair one, and go forth.
tokens.transliteration: hah-te-eh-NAH khah-ne-TAH fah-GEY-hah ve-hah-ge-fah-NEEM | se-mah-DAHR NAH-te-noo REY-ahkh KOO-mee LAHKH rah-yah-TEE yah-fah-TEE oo-le-khee lahkh:

tokens.hebrew: יֽוֹנָתִ֞י בְּחַגְוֵ֣י הַסֶּ֗לַע בְּסֵ֨תֶר֙ הַמַּדְרֵגָ֔ה הַרְאִ֨ינִי֙ אֶת־מַרְאַ֔יִךְ הַשְׁמִיעִ֖נִי אֶת־קוֹלֵ֑ךְ כִּֽי־קוֹלֵ֥ךְ עָרֵ֖ב וּמַרְאֵ֥יךְ נָאוֶֽה:
tokens.translation: My dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the concealment of the cliff, show me your countenance, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet and your countenance is comely.
tokens.transliteration: yoh-nah-TEE be-khahg-VEY hah-SEH-lah be-SEH-tehr hah-mahd-reh-GAH hahr-EE-nee eht mahr-AH-yeekh hahsh-mee-EE-nee eht koh-LEHKH kee koh-LEHKH ah-REHV oo-mahr-EYKH nah-veh:

tokens.hebrew: אֶֽחֱזוּ־לָ֨נוּ֙ שֽׁוּעָלִ֔ים שֻֽׁעָלִ֥ים קְטַנִּ֖ים מְחַבְּלִ֣ים כְּרָמִ֑ים וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ סְמָדַֽר:
tokens.translation: Seize for us the foxes, little foxes that destroy vineyards [for] our vineyards are with tender grapes.”
tokens.transliteration: eh-kheh-zoo LAH-noo shoo-ah-LEEM shoo-ah-LEEM ke-tah-NEEM me-khah-be-LEEM ke-rah-MEEM oo-khe-rah-MEY-noo se-mah-dahr:

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹדִ֥י לִי֙ וַֽאֲנִ֣י ל֔וֹ הָֽרֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: My beloved is mine, and I am his, who pastures among the roses.
tokens.transliteration: doh-DEE LEE vah-ah-NEE LOH hah-roh-EH bah-shoh-shah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים סֹב֩ דְּמֵֽה־לְךָ֨ דוֹדִ֜י לִצְבִ֗י א֛וֹ לְעֹ֥פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֖ים עַל־הָ֥רֵי בָֽתֶר:
tokens.translation: Until the sun spreads and the shadows flee; you turned away, my beloved, and became like a gazelle or a young hart on distant mountains.
tokens.transliteration: AHD sheh-yah-FOO-ahkh hah-YOHM ve-NAH-soo hah-tse-lah-LEEM SOHV de-meh le-KHAH doh-DEE leets-VEE OH le-OH-fehr hah-ah-yah-LEEM ahl HAH-rey vah-tehr:

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.3
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: עַל־מִשְׁכָּבִי֙ בַּלֵּיל֔וֹת בִּקַּ֕שְׁתִּי אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו:
tokens.translation: On my bed at night, I sought him whom my soul loves; I sought him but did not find him.
tokens.transliteration: ahl meesh-kah-VEE bah-ley-LOHT bee-KAHSH-tee EHT sheh-ah-hah-VAH nahf-SHEE bee-kahsh-TEEV ve-LOH me-tsah-teev:

tokens.hebrew: אָק֨וּמָה נָּ֜א וַֽאֲסֽוֹבְבָ֣ה בָעִ֗יר בַּשְּׁוָקִים֙ וּבָ֣רְחֹב֔וֹת אֲבַקְשָׁ֕ה אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א מְצָאתִֽיו:
tokens.translation: I will rise now and roam through the city, in the market places and in the streets, I will seek him whom my soul loves; I sought him but did not find him.
tokens.transliteration: ah-KOO-mah NAH vah-ah-soh-ve-VAH vah-EER bah-she-vah-KEEM oo-VAH-re-khoh-VOHT ah-vahk-SHAH EHT sheh-ah-hah-VAH nahf-SHEE bee-kahsh-TEEV ve-LOH me-tsah-teev:

tokens.hebrew: מְצָא֨וּנִי֙ הַשֹּׁ֣מְרִ֔ים הַסֹּֽבְבִ֖ים בָּעִ֑יר אֵ֛ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י רְאִיתֶֽם:
tokens.translation: The watchmen found me those who circle about the city; him whom my soul loves, have you seen him?
tokens.transliteration: me-tsah-OO-nee hah-SHOH-me-REEM hah-soh-ve-VEEM bah-EER EHT sheh-ah-hah-VAH nahf-SHEE re-ee-tehm:

tokens.hebrew: כִּמְעַט֙ שֶֽׁעָבַ֣רְתִּי מֵהֶ֔ם עַ֣ד שֶׁמָּצָ֔אתִי אֵ֥ת שֶׁאָֽהֲבָ֖ה נַפְשִׁ֑י אֲחַזְתִּיו֙ וְלֹ֣א אַרְפֶּ֔נּוּ עַד־שֶׁ֤הֲבֵיאתִיו֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית אִמִּ֔י וְאֶל־חֶ֖דֶר הֽוֹרָתִֽי:
tokens.translation: Scarcely had I departed from them, when I found him whom my soul loves; I grasped him and would not let him go until I brought him to my mother's house and to the chamber of her who conceived me.
tokens.transliteration: keem-AHT sheh-ah-VAHR-tee meh-HEHM AHD sheh-mah-TSAH-tee EHT sheh-ah-hah-VAH nahf-SHEE ah-khahz-TEEV ve-LOH ahr-PEH-noo ahd SHEH-hah-veh--TEEV ehl BEYT ee-MEE ve-ehl KHEH-dehr hoh-rah-tee:

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בְּנ֤וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֨םִ֙ בִּצְבָא֔וֹת א֖וֹ בְּאַיְל֣וֹת הַשָדֶ֑ה אִם־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וְֽאִם־תְּעֽוֹרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem by the gazelles and the does of the field; that you do not cause hatred nor disturb this love while it still pleases.
tokens.transliteration: heesh-BAH-tee eht-KHEHM be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-mee beets-vah-OHT OH be-ahy-LOHT hah-shah-DEH eem tah-EE-roo | ve-eem te-oh-re-ROO eht hah-ah-hah-VAH AHD sheh-tehkh-pahts:

tokens.hebrew: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר כְּתִֽימְר֖וֹת עָשָׁ֑ן מְקֻטֶּ֤רֶת מֹר֙ וּלְבוֹנָ֔ה מִכֹּ֖ל אַבְקַ֥ת רוֹכֵֽל:
tokens.translation: Who is this ascending from the desert, with palm-like pillars of smoke; in a cloud of myrrh and frankincense, of all the powders of the perfume seller?
tokens.transliteration: MEE ZOHT oh-LAH meen hah-meed-BAHR ke-tee-me-ROHT ah-SHAHN me-koo-TEH-reht MOHR oo-le-voh-NAH mee-KOHL ahv-KAHT roh-khehl:

tokens.hebrew: הִנֵּ֗ה מִטָּתוֹ שֶׁלִּשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים גִּבֹּרִ֖ים סָבִ֣יב לָ֑הּ מִגִּבֹּרֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל:
tokens.translation: Behold the bed of Shlomo, sixty mighty men are around it; of the mighty men of Israel.
tokens.transliteration: hee-NEH mee-tah-toh sheh-leesh-loh-MOHH shee-SHEEM gee-boh-REEM sah-VEEV LAHH mee-gee-boh-REY yees-rah-ehl:

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּם֙ אֲחֻ֣זֵי חֶ֔רֶב מְלֻמְּדֵ֖י מִלְחָמָ֑ה אִ֤ישׁ חַרְבּוֹ עַל־יְרֵכ֔וֹ מִפַּ֖חַד בַּלֵּילֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: All of them holding swords, skilled in battle; each with his sword at his side for fear of the nights.
tokens.transliteration: koo-LAHM ah-KHOO-zey KHEH-rehv me-loo-me-DEY meel-khah-MAH EESH khahr-boh ahl ye-reh-KHOH mee-PAH-khahd bah-ley-loht:

tokens.hebrew: אַפִּרְי֗וֹן עָ֤שָׂה לוֹ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה מֵֽעֲצֵ֖י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן:
tokens.translation: A canopy has King Shlomo made of the wood of Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: ah-peer-YOHN AH-sah loh hah-MEH-lehkh she-loh-MOHH meh-ah-TSEY hah-le-vah-nohn:

tokens.hebrew: עַמּוּדָיו֙ עָ֣שָׂה כֶ֔סֶף רְפִֽידָת֣וֹ זָהָ֔ב מֶרְכָּב֖וֹ אַרְגָּמָ֑ן תּוֹכוֹ רָצ֣וּף אַֽהֲבָ֔ה מִבְּנ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָֽםִ:
tokens.translation: Its pillars he made of silver, its covering of gold, its curtain of purple wool; its interior bedecked with love from the daughters of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: ah-moo-DAHV AH-sah KHEH-sehf re-fee-dah-TOH zah-HAHV mehr-kah-VOH ahr-gah-MAHN toh-khoh rah-TSOOF ah-hah-VAH mee-be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-lah-mee:

tokens.hebrew: צְאֶ֧ינָה | וּֽרְאֶ֛ינָה בְּנ֥וֹת צִיּ֖וֹן בַּמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בָּֽעֲטָרָ֗ה שֶֽׁעִטְּרָה־לּ֤וֹ אִמּוֹ בְּי֣וֹם חֲתֻנָּת֔וֹ וּבְי֖וֹם שִׂמְחַ֥ת לִבּֽוֹ:
tokens.translation: Go forth and gaze, daughters of Zion, upon King Shlomo; upon the crown with which his mother adorned him on the day of his wedding, and on the day his heart rejoiced.
tokens.transliteration: tse-EY-nah | oo-re-EY-nah be-NOHT tsee-YOHN bah-MEH-lehkh she-loh-MOHH bah-ah-tah-RAH sheh-ee-te-rah LOH ee-moh be-YOHM khah-too-nah-TOH oo-ve-YOHM seem-KHAHT lee-boh:

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.4
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הִנָּ֨ךְ יָפָ֤ה רַעְיָתִי֙ הִנָּ֣ךְ יָפָ֔ה עֵינַ֣יִךְ יוֹנִ֔ים מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵ֑ךְ שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּֽלְשׁ֖וּ מֵהַ֥ר גִּלְעָֽד:
tokens.translation: Behold you are beautiful, my beloved, behold you are beautiful, your eyes are like doves from within your kerchief; your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Mount Gilead.
tokens.transliteration: hee-NAHKH yah-FAH rah-yah-TEE hee-NAHKH yah-FAH ey-NAH-yeekh yoh-NEEM mee-BAH-ahd le-tsah-mah-TEHKH sah-REHKH ke-EH-dehr hah-ee-ZEEM sheh-gah-le-SHOO meh-HAHR geel-ahd:

tokens.hebrew: שִׁנַּ֨יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הַקְּצוּב֔וֹת שֶֽׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָֽרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם:
tokens.translation: Your teeth are like a counted flock which have come up from the washing; all of which are perfect and none are blemished among them.
tokens.transliteration: shee-NAH-yeekh ke-EH-dehr hah-ke-tsoo-VOHT sheh-ah-LOO meen hah-rahkh-TSAH sheh-koo-LAHM maht-ee-MOHT ve-shah-koo-LAH EYN bah-hehm:

tokens.hebrew: כְּח֤וּט הַשָּׁנִי֙ שִׂפְתוֹתַ֔יִךְ וּמִדְבָּרֵ֖ךְ נָאוֶ֑ה כְּפֶ֤לַח הָֽרִמּוֹן֙ רַקָּתֵ֔ךְ מִבַּ֖עַד לְצַמָּתֵֽךְ:
tokens.translation: Like a scarlet thread are your lips, and your speech is comely; like a slice of pomegranate are your cheeks from within your kerchief.
tokens.transliteration: ke-KHOOT hah-shah-NEE seef-toh-TAH-yeekh oo-meed-bah-REHKH nah-VEH ke-FEH-lahkh hah-ree-MOHN rah-kah-TEHKH mee-BAH-ahd le-tsah-mah-tehkh:

tokens.hebrew: כְּמִגְדַּ֤ל דָּוִיד֙ צַוָּארֵ֔ךְ בָּנ֖וּי לְתַלְפִּיּ֑וֹת אֶ֤לֶף הַמָּגֵן֙ תָּל֣וּי עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל שִׁלְטֵ֥י הַגִּבֹּרִֽים:
tokens.translation: Your neck is like the Tower of David, built as a model of beauty; a thousand shields are hung upon it, all the quivers of the mighty.
tokens.transliteration: ke-meeg-DAHL dah-VEED tsah-vah-REHKH bah-NOOY le-tahl-pee-YOHT EH-lehf hah-mah-GEHN tah-LOOY ah-LAHV KOHL sheel-TEY hah-gee-boh-reem:

tokens.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תְּאוֹמֵ֣י צְבִיָּ֑ה הָֽרֹעִ֖ים בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: Your bosom is like two fawns, twins of a gazelle who pasture among the roses.
tokens.transliteration: she-NEY shah-DAH-yeekh keesh-NEY oh-fah-REEM te-oh-MEY tse-vee-YAH hah-roh-EEM bah-shoh-shah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: עַ֤ד שֶׁיָּפ֨וּחַ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְנָ֖סוּ הַצְּלָלִ֑ים אֵ֤לֶךְ לִי֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר הַמּ֔וֹר וְאֶל־גִּבְעַ֖ת הַלְּבוֹנָֽה:
tokens.translation: Until the sun spreads and the shadows flee; I will go to Mount Moriah and to the hill of frankincense.
tokens.transliteration: AHD sheh-yah-FOO-ahkh hah-YOHM ve-NAH-soo hah-tse-lah-LEEM EH-lehkh LEE ehl HAHR hah-MOHR ve-ehl geev-AHT hah-le-voh-nah:

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י וּמ֖וּם אֵ֥ין בָּֽךְ:
tokens.translation: You are completely beautiful, my beloved, and are without blemish.
tokens.transliteration: koo-LAHKH yah-FAH rah-yah-TEE oo-MOOM EYN bahkh:

tokens.hebrew: אִתִּ֤י מִלְּבָנוֹן֙ כַּלָּ֔ה אִתִּ֖י מִלְּבָנ֣וֹן תָּב֑וֹאִי תָּשׁ֣וּרִי | מֵרֹ֣אשׁ אֲמָנָ֗ה מֵרֹ֤אשׁ שְׂנִיר֙ וְחֶרְמ֔וֹן מִמְּעֹנ֣וֹת אֲרָי֔וֹת מֵהַֽרְרֵ֖י נְמֵרִֽים:
tokens.translation: With me [will you come] from Lebanon O bride, with me from Lebanon will you come; you will look from the peak of Amana, from the peaks of Senir of Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of leopards.
tokens.transliteration: ee-TEE mee-le-vah-NOHN kah-LAH ee-TEE mee-le-vah-NOHN tah-VOH-ee tah-SHOO-ree | meh-ROHSH ah-mah-NAH meh-ROHSH se-NEER ve-khehr-MOHN mee-me-oh-NOHT ah-rah-YOHT meh-hah-re-REY ne-meh-reem:

tokens.hebrew: לִבַּבְתִּ֖נִי אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה לִבַּבְתִּ֨נִי֙ בְּאַחַ֣תּ מֵֽעֵינַ֔יִךְ בְּאַחַ֥ד עֲנָ֖ק מִצַּוְּרֹנָֽיִךְ:
tokens.translation: You captured my heart, my sister, O bride; you captured my heart with but one of your eyes, with one necklace of your necklaces.
tokens.transliteration: lee-bahv-TEE-nee ah-khoh-TEE khah-LAH lee-bahv-TEE-nee be-ah-KHAHT meh-ey-NAH-yeekh be-ah-KHAHD ah-NAHK mee-tsah-ve-roh-nah-yeekh:

tokens.hebrew: מַה־יָּפ֥וּ דֹדַ֖יִךְ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה מַה־טֹּ֤בוּ דֹדַ֙יִךְ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן וְרֵ֥יחַ שְׁמָנַ֖יִךְ מִכָּל־בְּשָׂמִֽים:
tokens.translation: How beautiful is your love my sister, O bride; how superior is your love to wine, and the fragrance of your oils to all perfumes.
tokens.transliteration: mahh yah-FOO doh-DAH-yeekh ah-khoh-TEE khah-LAH mahh TOH-voo doh-DAH-yeekh mee-YAH-yeen ve-REY-ahkh she-mah-NAH-yeekh mee-kohl be-sah-meem:

tokens.hebrew: נֹ֛פֶת תִּטֹּ֥פְנָה שִׂפְתוֹתַ֖יִךְ כַּלָּ֑ה דְּבַ֤שׁ וְחָלָב֙ תַּ֣חַת לְשׁוֹנֵ֔ךְ וְרֵ֥יחַ שַׂלְמֹתַ֖יִךְ כְּרֵ֥יחַ לְבָנֽוֹן:
tokens.translation: Your lips drip flowing honey, O bride; honey and milk are under your tongue, and the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: NOH-feht tee-TOH-fe-nah seef-toh-TAH-yeekh kah-LAH de-VAHSH ve-khah-LAHV TAH-khaht le-shoh-NEHKH ve-REY-ahkh sahl-moh-TAH-yeekh ke-REY-ahkh le-vah-nohn:

tokens.hebrew: גַּ֥ן | נָע֖וּל אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּ֑ה גַּ֥ל נָע֖וּל מַעְיָ֥ן חָתֽוּם:
tokens.translation: A locked garden is my sister, O bride; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
tokens.transliteration: GAHN | nah-OOL ah-khoh-TEE khah-LAH GAHL nah-OOL mah-YAHN khah-toom:

tokens.hebrew: שְׁלָחַ֨יִךְ֙ פַּרְדֵּ֣ס רִמּוֹנִ֔ים עִ֖ם פְּרִ֣י מְגָדִ֑ים כְּפָרִ֖ים עִם־נְרָדִֽים:
tokens.translation: Your arid fields are a pomegranate orchard with luscious fruits; henna with spikenard.
tokens.transliteration: she-lah-KHAH-yeekh pahr-DEHS ree-moh-NEEM EEM pe-REE me-gah-DEEM ke-fah-REEM eem ne-rah-deem:

tokens.hebrew: נֵ֣רְדְּ | וְכַרְכֹּ֗ם קָנֶה֙ וְקִנָּמ֔וֹן עִ֖ם כָּל־עֲצֵ֣י לְבוֹנָ֑ה ֚מֹר וַֽאֲהָל֔וֹת עִ֖ם כָּל־רָאשֵׁ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים:
tokens.translation: Spikenard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with all the trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes with all the major spices.
tokens.transliteration: NEHRD | ve-khahr-KOHM kah-NEH ve-kee-nah-MOHN EEM kohl ah-TSEY le-voh-NAH -mohr vah-ah-hah-LOHT EEM kohl rah-SHEY ve-sah-meem:

tokens.hebrew: מַעְיַ֣ן גַּנִּ֔ים בְּאֵ֖ר מַ֣יִם חַיִּ֑ים וְֽנֹזְלִ֖ים מִן־לְבָנֽוֹן:
tokens.translation: You are a garden spring, a well of living waters; and flowing streams from Lebanon.
tokens.transliteration: mah-YAHN gah-NEEM be-EHR MAH-yeem khah-YEEM ve-noh-ze-LEEM meen le-vah-nohn:

tokens.hebrew: ע֤וּרִי צָפוֹן֙ וּב֣וֹאִי תֵימָ֔ן הָפִ֥יחִי גַנִּ֖י יִזְּל֣וּ בְשָׂמָ֑יו יָבֹ֤א דוֹדִי֙ לְגַנּ֔וֹ וְיֹאכַ֖ל פְּרִ֥י מְגָדָֽיו:
tokens.translation: Awake, wind from the north and come, wind from the south, blow upon my garden so that its fragrance may flow; let my beloved come to his garden, and eat its luscious fruit.
tokens.transliteration: OO-ree tsah-FOHN oo-VOH-ee tey-MAHN hah-FEE-khee gah-NEE yee-ze-LOO ve-sah-MAHV yah-VOH doh-DEE le-gah-NOH ve-yoh-KHAHL pe-REE me-gah-dahv:

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.5
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּ֣אתִי לְגַנִּי֘ אֲחֹתִ֣י כַלָּה֒ אָרִ֤יתִי מוֹרִי֙ עִם־בְּשָׂמִ֔י אָכַ֤לְתִּי יַעְרִי֙ עִם־דִּבְשִׁ֔י שָׁתִ֥יתִי יֵינִ֖י עִם־חֲלָבִ֑י אִכְל֣וּ רֵעִ֔ים שְׁת֥וּ וְשִׁכְר֖וּ דּוֹדִֽים:
tokens.translation: I have come to my garden, my sister, O bride, I have gathered my myrrh with my spice, I have eaten my sugar cane with my honey, I have drunk my wine with my milk; eat [my] friends, drink and become intoxicated, [my] beloved ones.
tokens.transliteration: BAH-tee le-gah-NEE ah-khoh-TEE khah-LAH ah-REE-tee moh-REE eem be-sah-MEE ah-KHAHL-tee yah-REE eem deev-SHEE shah-TEE-tee yey-NEE eem khah-lah-VEE eekh-LOO reh-EEM she-TOO ve-sheekh-ROO doh-deem:

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֥י יְשֵׁנָ֖ה וְלִבִּ֣י עֵ֑ר ק֣וֹל | דּוֹדִ֣י דוֹפֵ֗ק פִּתְחִי־לִ֞י אֲחֹתִ֤י רַעְיָתִי֙ יֽוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י שֶׁרֹֹּאשִׁי֙ נִמְלָא־טָ֔ל קְוֻצּוֹתַ֖י רְסִ֥יסֵי לָֽיְלָה:
tokens.translation: I slept but my heart was awake; a sound! my beloved knocks, open for me, my sister, my love, my dove, my perfection, for my head is drenched [as though] with dew, my sidelocks drip with the rains of night.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NEE ye-sheh-NAH ve-lee-BEE EHR KOHL | doh-DEE doh-FEHK peet-khee LEE ah-khoh-TEE rah-yah-TEE yoh-nah-TEE tah-mah-TEE sheh-rohoh-SHEE neem-lah TAHL ke-voo-tsoh-TAHY re-SEE-sey lah-ye-lah:

tokens.hebrew: פָּשַׁ֨טְתִּי֙ אֶת־כֻּתָּנְתִּ֔י אֵיכָ֖כָה אֶלְבָּשֶׁ֑נָּה רָחַ֥צְתִּי אֶת־רַגְלַ֖י אֵיכָ֥כָה אֲטַנְּפֵֽם:
tokens.translation: I have removed my robe, how can I put it on? I have washed my feet, how can I soil them?
tokens.transliteration: pah-SHAHT-tee eht koo-tah-ne-TEE ey-KHAH-khah ehl-bah-SHEH-nah rah-KHAHTS-tee eht rahg-LAHY ey-KHAH-khah ah-tah-ne-fehm:

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹדִ֗י שָׁלַ֤ח יָדוֹ מִן־הַח֔וֹר וּמֵעַ֖י הָמ֥וּ עָלָֽיו:
tokens.translation: My beloved sent forth his hand from the portal, and my innards longed for him.
tokens.transliteration: doh-DEE shah-LAHKH yah-doh meen hah-KHOHR oo-meh-AHY hah-MOO ah-lahv:

tokens.hebrew: קַ֥מְתִּי אֲנִ֖י לִפְתֹּ֣חַ לְדוֹדִ֑י וְיָדַ֣י נָֽטְפוּ־מ֗וֹר וְאֶצְבְּעֹתַי֙ מ֣וֹר עֹבֵ֔ר עַ֖ל כַּפּ֥וֹת הַמַּנְעֽוּל:
tokens.translation: I arose to open for my beloved; and my hands dripped myrrh, and my fingers flowed with myrrh from the handles of the lock.
tokens.transliteration: KAHM-tee ah-NEE leef-TOH-ahkh le-doh-DEE ve-yah-DAHY nah-te-foo MOHR ve-ehts-be-oh-TAHY MOHR oh-VEHR AHL kah-POHT hah-mahn-ool:

tokens.hebrew: פָּתַ֤חְתִּי אֲנִי֙ לְדוֹדִ֔י וְדוֹדִ֖י חָמַ֣ק עָבָ֑ר נַפְשִׁי֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה בְדַבְּר֔וֹ בִּקַּשְׁתִּ֨יהוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מְצָאתִ֔יהוּ קְרָאתִ֖יו וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽנִי:
tokens.translation: I opened for my beloved, but my beloved had vanished and gone; my soul departed as he spoke, I sought him but could not find him, I called him but he would not answer.
tokens.transliteration: pah-TAHKH-tee ah-NEE le-doh-DEE ve-doh-DEE khah-MAHK ah-VAHR nahf-SHEE yah-tse-AH ve-dah-be-ROH bee-kahsh-TEE-hoo ve-LOH me-tsah-TEE-hoo ke-rah-TEEV ve-LOH ah-nah-nee:

tokens.hebrew: מְצָאֻ֧נִי הַשֹּֽׁמְרִ֛ים הַסֹּֽבְבִ֥ים בָּעִ֖יר הִכּ֣וּנִי פְצָע֑וּנִי נָֽשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־רְדִידִי֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י שֹֽׁמְרֵ֖י הַֽחֹמֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: The watchmen found me, those who go about the city, they struck me, they wounded me; they stripped my ornament from me, [even] the guards of the wall.
tokens.transliteration: me-tsah-OO-nee hah-shoh-me-REEM hah-soh-ve-VEEM bah-EER hee-KOO-nee fe-tsah-OO-nee nah-se-OO eht re-dee-DEE meh-ah-LAHY shoh-me-REY hah-khoh-moht:

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָ֑םִ אִֽם־תִּמְצְאוּ֙ אֶת־דּוֹדִ֔י מַה־תַּגִּ֣ידוּ ל֔וֹ שֶֽׁחוֹלַ֥ת אַֽהֲבָ֖ה אָֽנִי:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath, daughters of Jerusalem; when you find my beloved, what will you tell him? that I am lovesick [for him.]
tokens.transliteration: heesh-BAH-tee eht-KHEHM be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-mee eem teem-tse-OO eht doh-DEE mahh tah-GEE-doo LOH sheh-khoh-LAHT ah-hah-VAH ah-nee:

tokens.hebrew: מַה־דּוֹדֵ֣ךְ מִדּ֔וֹד הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים מַה־דּוֹדֵ֣ךְ מִדּ֔וֹד שֶׁכָּ֖כָה הִשְׁבַּעְתָּֽנוּ:
tokens.translation: With what does your beloved excel another beloved, most beautiful among women? With what does your beloved excel another beloved, that you bind us under oath?
tokens.transliteration: mahh doh-DEHKH mee-DOHD hah-yah-FAH bah-nah-SHEEM mahh doh-DEHKH mee-DOHD sheh-KAH-khah heesh-bah-tah-noo:

tokens.translation: My beloved is pure white and ruddy, surrounded by myriads.

tokens.hebrew: רֹאשׁ֖וֹ כֶּ֣תֶם פָּ֑ז קְוֻצּוֹתָיו֙ תַּלְתַּלִּ֔ים שְׁחֹר֖וֹת כָּֽעוֹרֵֽב:
tokens.translation: His head is [like] finest gold, his locks hang, they are raven-black.
tokens.transliteration: roh-SHOH KEH-tehm PAHZ ke-voo-tsoh-TAHV tahl-tah-LEEM she-khoh-ROHT kah-oh-rehv:

tokens.hebrew: עֵינָ֕יו כְּיוֹנִ֖ים עַל־אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֑יִם רֹֽחֲצוֹת֙ בֶּֽחָלָ֔ב יֽשְׁב֖וֹת עַל־מִלֵּֽאת:
tokens.translation: His eyes are like doves upon brooks of water; bathed in milk, well set in their fullness.
tokens.transliteration: ey-NAHV ke-yoh-NEEM ahl ah-FEE-key MAH-yeem roh-khah-TSOHT beh-khah-LAHV yshe-VOHT ahl mee-leht:

tokens.hebrew: לְחָיָו֙ כַּֽעֲרוּגַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔שֶׂם מִגְדְּל֖וֹת מֶרְקָחִ֑ים שִׂפְתוֹתָיו֙ שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּ֔ים נֹֽטְפ֖וֹת מ֥וֹר עֹבֵֽר:
tokens.translation: His cheeks are like a bed of spice, like towers of perfumes; his lips are like roses, dripping [with] flowing myrrh.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah-YAHV kah-ah-roo-GAHT hah-BOH-sehm meeg-de-LOHT mehr-kah-KHEEM seef-toh-TAHV shoh-shah-NEEM noh-te-FOHT MOHR oh-vehr:

tokens.hebrew: יָדָיו֙ גְּלִילֵ֣י זָהָ֔ב מְמֻלָּאִ֖ים בַּתַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ מֵעָיו֙ עֶ֣שֶׁת שֵׁ֔ן מְעֻלֶּ֖פֶת סַפִּירִֽים:
tokens.translation: His hands are like rolls of gold studded with precious gems; his innards sparkle like ivory, overlaid with sapphires.
tokens.transliteration: yah-DAHV ge-lee-LEY zah-HAHV me-moo-lah-EEM bah-tahr-SHEESH meh-AHV EH-sheht SHEHN me-oo-LEH-feht sah-pee-reem:

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹקָיו֙ עַמּ֣וּדֵי שֵׁ֔שׁ מְיֻסָּדִ֖ים עַל־אַדְנֵי־פָ֑ז מַרְאֵ֨הוּ֙ כַּלְּבָנ֔וֹן בָּח֖וּר כָּֽאֲרָזִֽים:
tokens.translation: His legs are like pillars of marble set in sockets of fine gold; his appearance is like Lebanon chosen like the cedars.
tokens.transliteration: shoh-KAHV ah-MOO-dey SHEHSH me-yoo-sah-DEEM ahl ahd-ney FAHZ mahr-EH-hoo kah-le-vah-NOHN bah-KHOOR kah-ah-rah-zeem:

tokens.hebrew: חִכּוֹ מַֽמְתַקִּ֔ים וְכֻלּ֖וֹ מַֽחֲמַדִּ֑ים זֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ וְזֶ֣ה רֵעִ֔י בְּנ֖וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלָֽםִ:
tokens.translation: [The words of] his palate are sweet, and he is all delight; this is my beloved, and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: khee-koh mah-me-tah-KEEM ve-khoo-LOH mah-khah-mah-DEEM ZEH doh-DEE ve-ZEH reh-EE be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-lah-mee:

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.6
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: ֚אָנָה הָלַ֣ךְ דּוֹדֵ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים ֚אָנָה פָּנָ֣ה דוֹדֵ֔ךְ וּנְבַקְשֶׁ֖נּוּ עִמָּֽךְ:
tokens.translation: Where has your beloved gone O fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned that we may seek him with you?
tokens.transliteration: -ah-nah hah-LAHKH doh-DEHKH hah-yah-FAH bah-nah-SHEEM -ah-nah pah-NAH doh-DEHKH oo-ne-vahk-SHEH-noo ee-mahkh:

tokens.hebrew: דּוֹדִי֙ יָרַ֣ד לְגַנּ֔וֹ לַֽעֲרֻג֖וֹת הַבֹּ֑שֶׂם לִרְעוֹת֙ בַּגַּנִּ֔ים וְלִלְקֹ֖ט שֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices; to graze in the gardens and to gather roses.
tokens.transliteration: doh-DEE yah-RAHD le-gah-NOH lah-ah-roo-GOHT hah-BOH-sehm leer-OHT bah-gah-NEEM ve-leel-KOHT shoh-shah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִ֤י לְדוֹדִי֙ וְדוֹדִ֣י לִ֔י הָֽרוֹעֶ֖ה בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: I am my beloved's and my beloved is mine, who grazes among the roses.
tokens.transliteration: ah-NEE le-doh-DEE ve-doh-DEE LEE hah-roh-EH bah-shoh-shah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: יָפָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ רַעְיָתִי֙ כְּתִרְצָ֔ה נָאוָ֖ה כִּירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: You are beautiful, my beloved, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, awesome as the hosts [of angels].
tokens.transliteration: yah-FAH AHT rah-yah-TEE ke-teer-TSAH nah-VAH kee-roo-shah-LAH-eem ah-yoo-MAH kah-need-gah-loht:

tokens.hebrew: הָסֵ֤בִּי עֵינַ֨יִךְ֙ מִנֶּגְדִּ֔י שֶׁ֥הֵ֖ם הִרְהִיבֻ֑נִי שַׂעְרֵךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽעִזִּ֔ים שֶׁגָּֽלְשׁ֖וּ מִן־הַגִּלְעָֽד:
tokens.translation: Turn your eyes away from me, for they made me haughty; your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Mount Gilead.
tokens.transliteration: hah-SEH-bee ey-NAH-yeekh mee-nehg-DEE SHEH-HEHM heer-hee-VOO-nee sah-REHKH ke-EH-dehr hah-ee-ZEEM sheh-gah-le-SHOO meen hah-geel-ahd:

tokens.hebrew: שִׁנַּ֨יִךְ֙ כְּעֵ֣דֶר הָֽרְחֵלִ֔ים שֶֽׁעָל֖וּ מִן־הָֽרַחְצָ֑ה שֶׁכֻּלָּם֙ מַתְאִימ֔וֹת וְשַׁכֻּלָ֖ה אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם:
tokens.translation: Your teeth are like a counted flock which have come up from the washing; all of which are perfect and none are blemished among them.
tokens.transliteration: shee-NAH-yeekh ke-EH-dehr hah-re-kheh-LEEM sheh-ah-LOO meen hah-rahkh-TSAH sheh-koo-LAHM maht-ee-MOHT ve-shah-koo-LAH EYN bah-hehm:

tokens.translation: Like a slice of pomegranate are your cheeks from within your kerchief.

tokens.hebrew: שִׁשִּׁ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ מְלָכ֔וֹת וּשְׁמֹנִ֖ים פִּֽילַגְשִׁ֑ים וַֽעֲלָמ֖וֹת אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר:
tokens.translation: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and young maidens without number.
tokens.transliteration: shee-SHEEM HEH-mah me-lah-KHOHT oo-she-moh-NEEM pee-lahg-SHEEM vah-ah-lah-MOHT EYN mees-pahr:

tokens.hebrew: אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ יֽוֹנָתִ֣י תַמָּתִ֔י אַחַ֥ת הִיא֙ לְאִמָּ֔הּ בָּרָ֥ה הִ֖יא לְיֽוֹלַדְתָּ֑הּ רָא֤וּהָ בָנוֹת֙ וַֽיְאַשְּׁר֔וּהָ מְלָכ֥וֹת וּפִֽילַגְשִׁ֖ים וַֽיְהַֽלְלֽוּהָ:
tokens.translation: But she is unique, my dove, my perfect one, she is unique to her mother, she is pure to her who begot her; daughters saw her and acclaimed her, queens and concubines, and they praised her.
tokens.transliteration: ah-KHAHT HEE yoh-nah-TEE tah-mah-TEE ah-KHAHT HEE le-ee-MAHH bah-RAH HEE le-yoh-lahd-TAHH rah-OO-hah vah-NOHT vah-ye-ah-she-ROO-hah me-lah-KHOHT oo-fee-lahg-SHEEM vah-ye-hah-le-loo-hah:

tokens.hebrew: מִי־זֹ֥את הַנִּשְׁקָפָ֖ה כְּמוֹ־שָׁ֑חַר יָפָ֣ה כַלְּבָנָ֗ה בָּרָה֙ כַּֽחַמָּ֔ה אֲיֻמָּ֖ה כַּנִּדְגָּלֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: Who is this that gazes down like the [breaking] dawn, beautiful as the moon, bright as the sun, awesome as the hosts [of angels]?
tokens.transliteration: mee ZOHT hah-neesh-kah-FAH ke-moh SHAH-khahr yah-FAH khah-le-vah-NAH bah-RAH kah-khah-MAH ah-yoo-MAH kah-need-gah-loht:

tokens.hebrew: אֶל־גִּנַּ֤ת אֱגוֹז֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי לִרְא֖וֹת בְּאִבֵּ֣י הַנָּ֑חַל לִרְאוֹת֙ הֲפָֽרְחָ֣ה הַגֶּ֔פֶן הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָֽרִמֹּנִֽים:
tokens.translation: I went down to the garden of nuts, to see the moist plants of the valley; to see whether the vine had blossomed, if the pomegranates had sprouted.
tokens.transliteration: ehl gee-NAHT eh-GOHZ yah-RAHD-tee leer-OHT be-ee-BEY hah-NAH-khahl leer-OHT hah-fah-re-KHAH hah-GEH-fehn heh-NEH-tsoo hah-ree-moh-neem:

tokens.hebrew: לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי נַפְשִׁ֣י שָׂמַ֔תְנִי מַרְכְּב֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י נָדִֽיב:
tokens.translation: I did not know, my soul set me like chariots of a noble people.
tokens.transliteration: LOH yah-DAH-tee nahf-SHEE sah-MAHT-nee mahr-ke-VOHT ah-MEE nah-deev:

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.6

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.7
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שׁ֤וּבִי שׁ֨וּבִי֙ הַשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית שׁ֥וּבִי שׁ֖וּבִי וְנֶֽחֱזֶה־בָּ֑ךְ מַֽה־תֶּֽחֱזוּ֙ בַּשּׁ֣וּלַמִּ֔ית כִּמְחֹלַ֖ת הַֽמַּֽחֲנָֽיִם:
tokens.translation: Turn back, turn back [you] perfect one, turn back, turn back, that we may observe you; what can you see [offer] the perfect one that equals the encirclement of the camps?
tokens.transliteration: SHOO-vee SHOO-vee hah-SHOO-lah-MEET SHOO-vee SHOO-vee ve-neh-kheh-zeh BAHKH mahh teh-kheh-ZOO bah-SHOO-lah-MEET keem-khoh-LAHT hah-mah-khah-nah-yeem:

tokens.hebrew: מַה־יָּפ֧וּ פְעָמַ֛יִךְ בַּנְּעָלִ֖ים בַּת־נָדִ֑יב חַמּוּקֵ֣י יְרֵכַ֔יִךְ כְּמ֣וֹ חֲלָאִ֔ים מַֽעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֥י אָמָּֽן:
tokens.translation: How fair were your feet in sandals, O daughter of nobles; the roundness of your flanks, are like jewels, the work of a craftsman.
tokens.transliteration: mahh yah-FOO fe-ah-MAH-yeekh bah-ne-ah-LEEM baht nah-DEEV khah-moo-KEY ye-reh-KHAH-yeekh ke-MOH khah-lah-EEM mah-ah-SEH ye-DEY ah-mahn:

tokens.hebrew: שָׁרְרֵךְ֙ אַגַּ֣ן הַסַּ֔הַר אַל־יֶחְסַ֖ר הַמָּ֑זֶג בִּטְנֵךְ֙ עֲרֵמַ֣ת חִטִּ֔ים סוּגָ֖ה בַּשּֽׁוֹשַׁנִּֽים:
tokens.translation: Your navel is like a round bowl, which lacks not for mixed wines; your stomach is like a heap of wheat, hedged about with roses.
tokens.transliteration: shah-re-REHKH ah-GAHN hah-SAH-hahr ahl yehkh-SAHR hah-MAH-zehg beet-NEHKH ah-reh-MAHT khee-TEEM soo-GAH bah-shoh-shah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֥י שָׁדַ֛יִךְ כִּשְׁנֵ֥י עֳפָרִ֖ים תָּֽאֳמֵ֥י צְבִיָּֽה:
tokens.translation: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
tokens.transliteration: she-NEY shah-DAH-yeekh keesh-NEY oh-fah-REEM toh-oh-MEY tse-vee-yah:

tokens.hebrew: צַוָּארֵ֖ךְ כְּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַשֵּׁ֑ן עֵינַ֜יִךְ בְּרֵכ֣וֹת בְּחֶשְׁבּ֗וֹן עַל־שַׁ֨עַר֙ בַּת־רַבִּ֔ים אַפֵּךְ֙ כְּמִגְדַּ֣ל הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן צוֹפֶ֖ה פְּנֵ֥י דַמָּֽשֶׂק:
tokens.translation: Your neck is like an ivory tower; your eyes are like pools in Heshbon, at the gate of the populated city, your face is like a tower of Lebanon looking out as far as Damascus.
tokens.transliteration: tsah-vah-REHKH ke-meeg-DAHL hah-SHEHN ey-NAH-yeekh be-reh-KHOHT be-khehsh-BOHN ahl SHAH-ahr baht rah-BEEM ah-PEHKH ke-meeg-DAHL hah-le-vah-NOHN tsoh-FEH pe-NEY dah-mah-sehk:

tokens.hebrew: רֹאשֵׁ֤ךְ עָלַ֨יִךְ֙ כַּכַּרְמֶ֔ל וְדַלַּ֥ת רֹאשֵׁ֖ךְ כָּֽאַרְגָּמָ֑ן מֶ֖לֶךְ אָס֥וּר בָּֽרְהָטִֽים:
tokens.translation: That which is upon your head is like Mount Carmel, and the braid of your head is like [royal] purple wool; your King is bound in its tresses.
tokens.transliteration: roh-SHEHKH ah-LAH-yeekh kah-kahr-MEHL ve-dah-LAHT roh-SHEHKH kah-ahr-gah-MAHN MEH-lehkh ah-SOOR bah-re-hah-teem:

tokens.translation: How beautiful and pleasant are you; a love with delights.
tokens.transliteration: mahh yah-FEET oo-mahh nah-AHMT ah-hah-VAH bah-tah-ah-noo-geem:

tokens.hebrew: זֹ֤את קֽוֹמָתֵךְ֙ דָּֽמְתָ֣ה לְתָמָ֔ר וְשָׁדַ֖יִךְ לְאַשְׁכֹּלֽוֹת:
tokens.translation: Such is your stature, likened to a [stately] palm tree; and your bosom is like clusters.
tokens.transliteration: ZOHT koh-mah-TEHKH dah-me-TAH le-tah-MAHR ve-shah-DAH-yeekh le-ahsh-koh-loht:

tokens.hebrew: אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ אֶֽעֱלֶ֣ה בְתָמָ֔ר אֹֽחֲזָ֖ה בְּסַנְסִנָּ֑יו וְיִֽהְיוּ־נָ֤א שָׁדַ֙יִךְ֙ כְּאֶשְׁכְּל֣וֹת הַגֶּ֔פֶן וְרֵ֥יחַ אַפֵּ֖ךְ כַּתַּפּוּחִֽים:
tokens.translation: I said, I will ascend the palm tree, I will grasp its branches; and now, let your bosom remain like clusters of the vine, and the fragrance of your face like apples.
tokens.transliteration: ah-MAHR-tee eh-eh-LEH ve-tah-MAHR oh-khah-ZAH be-sahn-see-NAHV ve-yee-he-yoo NAH shah-DAH-yeekh ke-ehsh-ke-LOHT hah-GEH-fehn ve-REY-ahkh ah-PEHKH kah-tah-poo-kheem:

tokens.hebrew: וְחִכֵּ֕ךְ כְּיֵ֥ין הַטּ֛וֹב הוֹלֵ֥ךְ לְדוֹדִ֖י לְמֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים דּוֹבֵ֖ב שִׂפְתֵ֥י יְשֵׁנִֽים:
tokens.translation: And let your speech be like good wine; it flows for my beloved in sincerity, causing the lips of sleepers to murmur.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khee-KEHKH ke-YEYN hah-TOHV hoh-LEHKH le-doh-DEE le-mey-shah-REEM doh-VEHV seef-TEY ye-sheh-neem:

tokens.translation: I am my beloved's and he longs for me.

tokens.hebrew: לְכָ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ נֵצֵ֣א הַשָדֶ֔ה נָלִ֖ינָה בַּכְּפָרִֽים:
tokens.translation: Come, my beloved, let us go out to the field, let us lodge in the villages.
tokens.transliteration: le-KHAH doh-DEE neh-TSEH hah-shah-DEH nah-LEE-nah bah-ke-fah-reem:

tokens.hebrew: נַשְׁכִּ֨ימָה֙ לַכְּרָמִ֔ים נִרְאֶ֞ה אִם־פָּֽרְחָ֤ה הַגֶּ֨פֶן֨ פִּתַּ֣ח הַסְּמָדַ֔ר הֵנֵ֖צוּ הָֽרִמּוֹנִ֑ים שָׁ֛ם אֶתֵּ֥ן אֶת־דֹּדַ֖י לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: Let us rise early for the vineyards, let us see if the vine has blossomed, if the tender grapes have appeared, if the pomegranates are in bloom; there I will give my love to you.
tokens.transliteration: nahsh-KEE-mah lah-ke-rah-MEEM neer-EH eem pah-re-KHAH hah-GEH-FEHN pee-TAHKH hah-se-mah-DAHR heh-NEH-tsoo hah-ree-moh-NEEM SHAHM eh-TEHN eht doh-DAHY lahkh:

tokens.hebrew: הַדּֽוּדָאִ֣ים נָֽתְנוּ־רֵ֗יחַ וְעַל־פְּתָחֵ֨ינוּ֙ כָּל־מְגָדִ֔ים חֲדָשִׁ֖ים גַּם־יְשָׁנִ֑ים דּוֹדִ֖י צָפַ֥נְתִּי לָֽךְ:
tokens.translation: The baskets emit fragrance, and at our door are all luscious fruits, both new and old; my beloved, I have kept them for you.
tokens.transliteration: hah-doo-dah-EEM nah-te-noo REY-ahkh ve-ahl pe-tah-KHEY-noo kohl me-gah-DEEM khah-dah-SHEEM gahm ye-shah-NEEM doh-DEE tsah-FAHN-tee lahkh:

title: Song of Songs
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Song of Songs.8
summary: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Song of Songs · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִ֤י יִתֶּנְךָ֙ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֔י יוֹנֵ֖ק שְׁדֵ֣י אִמִּ֑י אֶֽמְצָֽאֲךָ֤ בַחוּץ֙ אֶשָּׁ֣קְךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹֽא־יָבֻ֥זוּ לִֽי:
tokens.translation: If only you were a brother to me, who had nursed at my mother's bosom; when I would find you outside I would kiss you, and no one would scorn me.
tokens.transliteration: MEE yee-tehn-KHAH ke-AHKH LEE yoh-NEHK she-DEY ee-MEE eh-me-tsah-ah-KHAH vah-KHOOTS eh-SHAH-ke-KHAH GAHM loh yah-VOO-zoo lee:

tokens.hebrew: אֶנְהָֽגְךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ֛ אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖י תְּלַמְּדֵ֑נִי אַשְׁקְךָ֙ מִיַּ֣יִן הָרֶ֔קַח מֵֽעֲסִ֖יס רִמֹּנִֽי:
tokens.translation: I would lead you, I would bring you to my mother's house that you should teach me; I would give you spiced wine to drink, of the nectar of my pomegranate.
tokens.transliteration: ehn-hah-ge-KHAH ah-vee-ah-KHAH ehl BEYT ee-MEE te-lah-me-DEH-nee ahsh-ke-KHAH mee-YAH-yeen hah-REH-kahkh meh-ah-SEES ree-moh-nee:

tokens.translation: His left hand is under my head and his right hand embraces me.

tokens.hebrew: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מַה־תָּעִ֧ירוּ | וּֽמַה־תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת־הָאַֽהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד־שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ:
tokens.translation: I bind you under oath daughters of Jerusalem why should you cause hatred or disturb [this] love while it still pleases?
tokens.transliteration: heesh-BAH-tee eht-KHEHM be-NOHT ye-roo-shah-LAH-eem mahh tah-EE-roo | oo-mahh te-oh-re-ROO eht hah-ah-hah-VAH AHD sheh-tehkh-PAHTS:

tokens.hebrew: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר מִתְרַפֶּ֖קֶת עַל־דּוֹדָ֑הּ תַּ֤חַת הַתַּפּ֨וּחַ֙ עֽוֹרַרְתִּ֔יךָ ֚שָׁמָּה חִבְּלָֽתְךָ֣ אִמֶּ֔ךָ שָׁ֖מָּה חִבְּלָ֥ה יְלָדַֽתְךָ:
tokens.translation: Who is she that rises from the desert, clinging to her beloved? beneath the apple tree I aroused you, there your mother had birth pains there she who bore you suffered.
tokens.transliteration: MEE ZOHT oh-LAH meen hah-meed-BAHR meet-rah-PEH-keht ahl doh-DAHH TAH-khaht hah-tah-POO-ahkh oh-rahr-TEE-khah -shah-mah khee-be-lah-te-KHAH ee-MEH-khah SHAH-mah khee-be-LAH ye-lah-dah-te-khah:

tokens.hebrew: שִׂימֵ֨נִי כַֽחוֹתָ֜ם עַל־לִבֶּ֗ךָ כַּֽחוֹתָם֙ עַל־זְרוֹעֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־עַזָּ֤ה כַמָּ֨וֶת֙ אַֽהֲבָ֔ה קָשָׁ֥ה כִשְׁא֖וֹל קִנְאָ֑ה רְשָׁפֶ֕יהָ רִשְׁפֵּ֕י אֵ֖שׁ שַׁלְהֶֽבֶתְיָֽה:
tokens.translation: Set me as a seal upon your heart as a seal upon your arm, for love is as strong as death, jealousy is as harsh as the grave; its flashes are flashes of fire from the flame of God.
tokens.transliteration: see-MEH-nee khah-khoh-TAHM ahl lee-BEH-khah kah-khoh-TAHM ahl ze-roh-EH-khah kee ah-ZAH khah-MAH-veht ah-hah-VAH kah-SHAH kheesh-OHL keen-AH re-shah-FEY-hah reesh-PEY EHSH shahl-heh-veht-yah:

tokens.translation: Many waters cannot quench the love, and rivers cannot drown it; if a man would give all the wealth of his house for love they would surely scorn him.

tokens.translation: We have a little sister but she has no bosom; what shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?

tokens.translation: If she be a wall we will build upon her a fortress of silver, if she be a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar.

tokens.translation: I am a wall and my bosom is like towers; therefore I am in his eyes as one who found peace.

tokens.translation: My vineyard is before me; the thousand are yours, Shlomo, and two hundred are for those who guard its fruit.

tokens.translation: You who sit in the gardens, companions listen to your voice, let me hear [your voice].

title: Psalm 107
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Mincha Service for Erev Shabbos, Psalm 107
useCase: Psalm 107 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Give thanks to Adonoy, for He is good,
for His kindness endures forever.
Let those redeemed by Adonoy say it,
those He redeemed
from the adversary's hand.
And from the lands He gathered them,
from the east and from the west,
from the north and from the south.
They wandered in the wilderness,
in a path of desolation;
an inhabited city they did not find.
Hungry, also thirsty
their soul fainted within them.
Then they cried out to Adonoy
in their distress;
from their anguish He rescued them.
And He led them in a straight path,
that they might go to an inhabited city.
Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
and for His wonders to the children of man.
For He satisfied the longing soul,
and the hungry soul He filled with good.
Those who sit in darkness
and in the shadow of death,
bound in affliction and iron.
For they defied the words of the Almighty,
and the counsel of the Most High
they scorned.
And He humbled their heart with hard labor,
they stumbled and there was none to help.
Then they cried out to Adonoy
in their distress;
from their anguish He delivered them.
He brought them out from darkness
and from the shadow of death,
and their shackles He broke.
Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
and for His wonders to the children of man.
For He has broken the gates of bronze,
and the bars of iron He has cut asunder.
They are fools—
because of the way of their transgression
and their iniquities,
they cause their own affliction.
Their soul abhors all food,
and they drew near to the gates of death.
Then they cried out to Adonoy
in their distress;
from their anguish He delivered them.
He sends His word and heals them,
and delivers them from their destruction.
Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
and for His wonders to the children of man.
And let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving,
and declare His works with singing.
Those who go down to the sea in ships,
that do work in mighty waters.
They saw the works of Adonoy,
and His wonders in the deep.
He spoke and raised the stormwind,
and lifted up its waves.
They rise to the heavens,
they descend to the depths,
their soul melts away because of trouble.
They reel and stagger like a drunkard,
and all their skills are swallowed up [useless].
Then they cried out to Adonoy
in their distress,
from their anguish He rescued them.
He turned the storm into calmness,
and their waves were stilled.
They rejoiced
because the waves were quieted,
and He led them to their desired border.
Let them thank Adonoy for His kindness,
and for His wonders to the children of man.
Let them exalt Him
in an assembly of people,
and at a sitting of elders, praise Him.
He turns rivers into a wilderness,
and springs of water into an arid place.
A fruitful land into a salt waste,
because of the wickedness of its inhabitants.
He turns a wilderness into a pool of water,
and a dry land into springs of water.
And He made the hungry settle there,
and they established an inhabited city.
And they sowed fields and planted vineyards,
which yielded fruit for harvest.
And He blessed them
and they multiplied greatly,
and their cattle, He did not diminish.
And they were reduced in numbers
and brought low,
from oppression, calamity, and sorrow.
He pours contempt upon nobles,
and causes them to wander in the wasteland
where there is no path.
And He lifted up the needy from affliction,
and he established families like a flock.
The upright will see it and rejoice,
and all iniquity will shut its mouth.
Whoever is wise, let him note these things,
and they will understand
the kindnesses of Adonoy.

title: Aleinu
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Mincha Service for Erev Shabbos, Aleinu
useCase: Aleinu · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise
the Master of all,
to ascribe greatness
to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning:
that He has not made us
like the nations of the lands,
and has not positioned us
like the families of the earth;
that He has not assigned
our portion like theirs,
nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
For they prostrate themselves
to vanity and nothingness,
and pray to a god that cannot deliver.
But we bow, prostrate ourselves,
and offer thanks
before the Supreme King of Kings,
the Holy One blessed is He,
Who spreads the heavens,
and establishes the earth,
and the seat of His glory is in heaven above,
and the abode of His invincible might
is in the loftiest heights.
He is our God, there is nothing else.
Our King is true,
all else is insignificant,
as it is written in His Torah:
“And You shall know this day
and take into Your heart
that Adonoy is God
in the heavens above
and upon the earth below;
there is nothing else.”
We therefore put our hope in You,
Adonoy our God,
to soon behold the glory of Your might
in banishing idolatry from the earth,
and the false gods will be utterly exterminated
to perfect the world
as the kingdom of Shadai.
And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
to turn back to You,
all the wicked of the earth.
They will realize and know,
all the inhabitants of the world,
that to You, every knee must bend,
every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
Before You, Adonoy, our God,
they will bow and prostrate themselves,
and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
And they will all accept [upon themselves]
the yoke of Your kingdom,
and You will reign over them, soon,
forever and ever.
For the kingdom is Yours,
and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
And it is said:
“And Adonoy will be King
over the whole earth;
on that day Adonoy will be One
and His Name One.”
Do not fear sudden terror
nor the destruction of the wicked
when it comes.
Take counsel together and it will be foiled
speak the word and it will not stand
for God is with us.
To your old age I am [with you],
to your older years I will sustain you,
I have made you, and I will carry you,
I will sustain you and save you.

title: Psalm 95
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 95
useCase: Psalm 95 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Come, let us sing to Adonoy;
let us sound the shofar
to the Rock of our deliverance.
Let us greet His Presence
with thanksgiving,
with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him.
For a great Almighty is Adonoy
and a great King over all gods.
For in His hands are the depths of the earth,
and the heights of the mountains are His;
For the sea is His, and He made it,
and the dry land, His hands formed.
Come, let us prostrate ourselves and bow;
let us kneel
before Adonoy, our Maker.
For He is our God
and we are the people of His pasture,
and the flock of His hand,
[even] today if you will heed His voice.
Do not harden your heart as at Merivah,
as on the day of Massah in the desert.
When your fathers tested Me,
they tried Me,
though they had seen My work.
Forty years I quarreled with that generation;
and I said,
“They are a people of erring hearts,
and they did not know my ways.”
Therefore I swore in My anger,
“They shall not enter My resting place.”

title: Psalm 96
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 96
useCase: Psalm 96 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Sing to Adonoy a new song
Sing to Adonoy
all the [inhabitants of] earth.
Sing to Adonoy, bless His Name,
proclaim His deliverance from day to day.
Recount His glory among the nations,
His wonders among all the peoples.
For Adonoy is great and most extolled;
He is awesome above all gods.
For all the gods of the nations
are idols,
whereas Adonoy made the heavens.
Beauty and splendor are before Him,
strength and glory are in His Sanctuary.
Ascribe to Adonoy—families of peoples—
—ascribe to Adonoy honor and might!
Ascribe to Adonoy the honor due His Name,
bring an offering
and come to His courtyards.
Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
in the splendor of holiness;
tremble before Him
all (peoples of) the earth!
Declare among the nations,
“Adonoy reigns!”
for He established the world
so that it cannot be moved,
He will judge the peoples with uprightness.
The heavens will rejoice,
the earth will exult,
the sea and its fullness will roar.
The field and all that is in it will jubilate,
then
all the trees of the forest will sing for joy.
Before Adonoy when He comes—
when He comes to judge the earth;
He will judge mankind with justice,
and peoples with His truth.

title: Psalm 97
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 97
useCase: Psalm 97 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: When Adonoy
is [universally accepted as] King
the earth will exult;
the multitudes of islands will rejoice.
Clouds and dense darkness surround Him;
righteousness and justice
are the foundations of His throne.
Fire will go before Him
to surround and burn His antagonists.
His lightning illuminates
the inhabited world,
the earth sees and trembles.
The mountains melt like wax
before Adonoy,
before the Master of all the earth.
The heavens will declare His righteousness
and all the peoples will behold His glory.
Humiliated will be
all who serve graven images,
who are proud of idols;
before Him all gods will bow.
Zion will hear and rejoice,
and the daughters [cities] of Judah will exult
because of Your judgments, Adonoy.
For You, Adonoy, are most high
over all the earth;
You are greatly exalted above all gods.
Lovers of Adonoy, hate evil!
He preserves the souls of His pious ones;
from the hand of the wicked, He saves them.
Light is sown for the righteous,
and for the upright in heart—joy.
Rejoice, righteous ones, in Adonoy,
and give thanks to His holy Name.

title: Psalm 98
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 98
useCase: Psalm 98 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm.
Sing to Adonoy, a new song
for He has performed wonders;
His right hand effected deliverance for Him
[as did] His holy arm.
Adonoy has made known His deliverance,
before the eyes of the nations
He has revealed His justice.
He remembered His kindliness
and faithfulness
to the House of Israel;
all the ends of the earth have seen
the deliverance of our God.
Raise your voice unto Adonoy
all [inhabitants of] the earth!
burst forth into exultation,
sing, and play music!
Play to Adonoy with a harp,
with harp and the sound of music.
With trumpets and the sound of the shofar
raise your voices before the King, Adonoy.
The sea and its fullness, will roar with joy!
[also] the world
and those who dwell therein.
Rivers will clap hands,
together, mountains will sing.
Before Adonoy
when He comes to judge the earth;
He will judge mankind with righteousness
and peoples with uprightness.

title: Psalm 29
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 29
useCase: Psalm 29 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm of David.
Ascribe to Adonoy—
you sons of the mighty —
ascribe to Adonoy glory and might.
Ascribe to Adonoy the glory due His Name,
prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
in the splendor of holiness.
Adonoy's voice is upon the waters.
Almighty of glory thunders,
Adonoy is upon [the] many waters.
The voice of Adonoy is in power,
the voice of Adonoy is in beauty.
The voice of Adonoy breaks cedars,
Adonoy shatters
the cedars of Lebanon.
He makes them leap like a calf,
Lebanon and Sirion like unicorns.
The voice of Adonoy
hews out flames of fire.
The voice of Adonoy
makes the desert tremble,
Adonoy makes tremble the desert of Kadesh.
The voice of Adonoy causes hinds to calve,
and strips the forests bare;
and in His Sanctuary
all proclaim [His] glory.
Adonoy sat enthroned (even) at the flood
Adonoy is enthroned as King forever.
Adonoy will give strength to His people;
Adonoy will bless His people with peace.
Please, by the force of
Your great right hand,
release the bound one.
Accept the prayer of Your people;
strengthen us, purify us, Awesome One!
Please! Mighty One,
those who seek Your Unity,
preserve them like the pupil [of Your eye].
Bless them, purify them;
the compassion of
Your benevolent righteousness
[may You] always bestow upon them.
Mighty, Holy One,
in Your abundant goodness,
lead Your community.
Unique One, Exalted, turn to Your people
who are mindful of Your holiness.
Accept our prayer and hear our cry,
[You] Who knows hidden thoughts.
Blessed [is His] Name,
Whose glorious kingdom
is forever and ever.

title: Psalm 92
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 92
useCase: Psalm 92 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm, a song for the Shabbos day.
It is good to thank Adonoy,
and sing praise to Your Name, Most High.
To relate Your kindliness in the morning,
and Your faithfulness in the nights.
Upon a ten-stringed instrument and lute,
in meditation upon the harp.
For You have given me joy, Adonoy,
with Your deeds,
at the work of Your hands I sing joyously.
How great are Your works, Adonoy;
how infinitely profound are Your thoughts.
An empty-headed man cannot know,
nor does a fool understand this:
When the wicked bloom like grass,
and all the evildoers blossom—
it is so that they may be destroyed forever.
But You will remain on high forever
Adonoy.
For behold, Your enemies, Adonoy;
For behold, Your enemies shall perish;
dispersed shall be all evildoers.
You uplifted my horn like that of a unicorn;
I am saturated with fresh oil.
My eye has seen [the defeat of]
those who spy on me;
of the wicked who rise against me,
my ears have heard [that they are doomed].
The righteous will blossom like a date palm,
like a cedar in Lebanon, he will grow tall.
Planted in the House of Adonoy,
in the courtyards of our God
they will blossom.
They will still be fruitful in old age;
they will be full of sap and freshness.
To declare that Adonoy is upright;
He is my Stronghold;
in Whom there is no injustice.

title: Psalm 93
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Kabbalas Shabbos, Psalm 93
useCase: Psalm 93 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Adonoy had begun His reign
He has clothed Himself with majesty;
Adonoy has clothed Himself,
He has girded Himself with strength.
He has firmly established the world
so that it cannot be moved.
Your throne stands firm from of old,
You are from eternity.
The rivers have raised—Adonoy—
the rivers have raised their voice,
the rivers raise their raging waves.
More than the sound of many waters,
mightier than the breakers of the sea
Mighty on high, are You, Adonoy.
Your testimonies are extremely faithful,
holiness is becoming to Your House,
Adonoy—for the length of days.

tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise
the Master of all,
to ascribe greatness
to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning:
that He has not made us
like the nations of the lands,
and has not positioned us
like the families of the earth;
that He has not assigned
our portion like theirs,
nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
For they prostrate themselves
to vanity and nothingness,
and pray to a god that cannot deliver.
But we bow, prostrate ourselves,
and offer thanks
before the Supreme King of Kings,
the Holy One blessed is He,
Who spreads the heavens,
and establishes the earth,
and the seat of His glory is in heaven above,
and the abode of His invincible might
is in the loftiest heights.
He is our God, there is nothing else.
Our King is true,
all else is insignificant,
as it is written in His Torah:
“And You shall know this day
and take into Your heart
that Adonoy is God
in the heavens above
and upon the earth below;
there is nothing else.”
We therefore put our hope in You,
Adonoy our God,
to soon behold the glory of Your might
in banishing idolatry from the earth,
and the false gods
will be utterly exterminated
to perfect the world
as the kingdom of Shadai.
And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
to turn back to You,
all the wicked of the earth.
They will realize and know,
all the inhabitants of the world,
that to You, every knee must bend,
every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
Before You, Adonoy, our God,
they will bow and prostrate themselves,
and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
And they will all accept [upon themselves]
the yoke of Your kingdom,
and You will reign over them, soon,
forever and ever.
For the kingdom is Yours,
and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
And it is said:
“And Adonoy will be King
over the whole earth;
on that day Adonoy will be One
and His Name One.”
Do not fear sudden terror
nor the destruction of the wicked
when it comes.
Take counsel together and it will be foiled
speak the word and it will not stand
for God is with us.
To your old age I am [with you],
to your older years I will sustain you,
I have made you, and I will carry you,
I will sustain you and save you.

tokens.translation: Whoever sanctifies the seventh day
as befits it,
Whoever preserves the Sabbath properly
so as not to desecrate it—
his reward is very great,
commensurate with his actions;
each man in his camp,
each man with his banner.
Lovers of Adonoy, who yearn
for the building of the Temple—
on the Sabbath day be happy and rejoice,
as if receiving the gift of God's inheritance.
Also raise your hands in holiness
and say to the Almighty:
“Blessed is Adonoy
Who granted rest
to His people Israel.”
Seekers of Adonoy,
seed of Avrohom, His beloved,
who delay departing from the Sabbath
and rush to welcome it;
who rejoice in preserving it
and to place its eiruv
“This is the day Adonoy has made
let us exult and rejoice in it.”
Remember the Torah of Moses,
which states the Sabbath commandment
engraved for the seventh day
like a bride adorned amid her friends.
Pure ones inherit it and sanctify it
with the words, “All that He had made” —
“And God completed by the seventh day,
His work that He had done.”
It is a holy day,
from arrival till departure;
all the seed of Jacob honor it
according to the King's word and decree—
to rest on it and to rejoice
with the pleasure of food and drink—
“The entire congregation of Israel
will do it.”
Extend Your kindness
to those who know You,
Almighty, jealous and vengeful.
Those who keep the seventh day,
“Recall” and “Preserve,” to fulfill,
grant them joy with rebuilt Jerusalem;
and with the light of Your countenance,
make them radiant.
“Let them be sated
from the abundance of Your House,
and from the stream of Your delights
give them drink.”
Help those who abstain on the seventh day—
from plowing and harvesting,
[may You help them] always.
Those who walk on it with short strides
and feast on it [eating three meals]
in order to bless [You] three times—
may their righteousness shine
like the light of the seven days.
“Adonoy, God of Israel,
[grant] perfect love
Adonoy, God of Israel
[grant] eternal deliverance.”

tokens.translation: 1. Blessed are You, Adonoy,
our God, King of the verse
Who created everything for His glory.
2. Blessed are You, Adonoy,
our God, King of the verse
Former of man.
3. Blessed are You, Adonoy,
our God, King of the Universe
Who formed man (Adam) in His image,
in the image of His likeness;
and fashioned for him out of his very self
a building (a wife: Eve) for eternity.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Former of Man.
4. May the barren one be happy and exult
with the ingathering of her children
into her midst with joy.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who gladdens Zion through her children.
5. Grant abundant joy
to these beloved companions,
as You gladdened Your created being
in the Garden of Eden of old.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who gladdens groom and bride.
6. Blessed are You, Adonoy,
our God, King of the Universe,
Who created happiness and joy,
groom and bride, exultation, song,
pleasure, delight, love, brotherhood,
peace and companionship.
Soon, Adonoy, our God, may there be heard
in the cities of Judah
and in the streets of Jerusalem
the sound of happiness and the sound of joy,
the sound of the groom
and sound of the bride,
the sound of grooms' jubilation
from their chupah,
and of the youths from their feasts of song.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who gladdens the groom with the bride.
7. Blessed are You, Adonoy,
our God, King of the Universe
Who creates the fruit of the vine.

tokens.translation: Blessed13 are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe,
Who sanctified us with His commandments
and commanded us
concerning the washing of hands.
Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe,
Who formed man with wisdom
and created within him openings
and hollows.
It is obvious and known
in the presence of Your glorious throne
that if one of them were ruptured,
or if one of them were blocked,
it would be impossible to exist
and stand in Your Presence
even for a short while.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who heals all flesh
and performs wonders.
My God!
the soul which You bestowed in me is pure;
You created it, You formed it,
You breathed it into me
and You preserve it within me.
You will eventually take it from me,
and restore it in me in the time to come.
So long as the soul is within me
I give thanks to You, Adonoy my God,
and God of my fathers,
Lord of all creatures,
Master of all souls.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who restores souls
to dead bodies.

useCase: Blessings of the Torah · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: learning, shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe,
Who sanctified us with His commandments
and commanded us
to be engrossed in the words of Torah.
Adonoy our God, please make pleasant
the words of Your Torah in our mouths
and in the mouths of Your people Israel.
And may we and our descendants
and the descendants of Your people
the House of Israel,
all be perceivers of Your Name
and students of Your Torah for its own sake.
Blessed are You, Adonoy
Who teaches Torah to His people, Israel.
Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe
Who chose us from among all the peoples
and gave us His Torah.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Giver of the Torah!
And Adonoy spoke to Moses, saying,

tokens.hebrew: דַבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר
tokens.translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying,
tokens.transliteration: dah-behr ehl ah-hah-rohn ve-ehl bah-nahv leh-mohr

tokens.translation: thus shall you bless the Children of Israel,
say to them:
May Adonoy bless you and guard you.
May Adonoy shine
His countenance upon you
and be gracious unto you.
May Adonoy turn
His countenance toward you
and grant you peace.
And they shall set My Name
upon the Children of Israel,
and I shall bless them.
These are precepts
for which no fixed measure is prescribed:
[leaving] the corner [of a field unharvested],
[the offering of] the first fruits,
the appearance-offering,
[performing] deeds of kindness,
and the study of Torah.
These are precepts,
the fruits of which man enjoys
in this world,
[while] the principal [reward]
is preserved for him in the World-to-Come.
They are:
honoring father and mother,
[performing] deeds of kindness,
early attendance in the House of Study
morning and evening,
providing hospitality to guests,
visiting the sick,
participating in making a wedding,
accompanying the dead [to the grave],
concentrating on the meaning of prayers,
making peace between fellow men
and between husband and wife—
and the study of Torah is equal to them all.

title: Psalm 92
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, The Morning Prayers, Psalm 92
useCase: Psalm 92 · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: A Psalm, a song for the Shabbos day.
It is good to thank Adonoy,
and sing praise to Your Name, Most High.
To relate Your kindliness in the morning,
and Your faithfulness in the nights.
Upon a ten-stringed instrument and lute,
in meditation upon the harp.
For You have given me joy, Adonoy,
with Your deeds,
at the work of Your hands I sing joyously.
How great are Your works, Adonoy;
how infinitely profound are Your thoughts.
An empty-headed man cannot know,
nor does a fool understand this:
When the wicked bloom like grass,
and all the evildoers blossom—
it is so that they may be destroyed forever.
But You will remain on high forever
Adonoy.
For behold, Your enemies, Adonoy;
For behold, Your enemies shall perish;
dispersed shall be all evildoers.
You uplifted my horn like that of a unicorn;
I am saturated with fresh oil.
My eye has seen [the defeat of]
those who spy on me;
of the wicked who rise against me,
my ears have heard [that they are doomed].
The righteous will blossom like a date palm,
like a cedar in Lebanon, he will grow tall.
Planted in the House of Adonoy,
in the courtyards of our God
they will blossom.
They will still be fruitful in old age;
they will be full of sap and freshness.
To declare that Adonoy is upright;
He is my Stronghold;
in Whom there is no injustice.

before any creature was created.

then was His Name proclaimed King.

He was, He is,

tokens.translation: Blessed is my Master day by day.
He will load us with deliverance
and redemption,
and in His Name we shall exult all day,
and by His deliverance,
we will raise our head to the heights—
For He is the [source of] strength for the poor,
and a refuge for the needy.
The tribes of Yah
bear witness to [the purity of] Israel.
In their distress He feels distress,
[as they were] burdened and enslaved.
By a sapphire brick,
He showed them the might of [His] love;
And revealed Himself to lift them
from the depths of the pit and dungeon.
“For with Adonoy is kindliness,
and with Him, is abundant redemption.”
How precious is His kindliness,
with His shadow to shield them!
Into exile in Babylon,
was He sent for their sake;
when ships were sent down [to carry them away]
He included Himself among them;
and He made them [objects of] compassion
before their captors—

tokens.hebrew: כִּי לֹא יִטּשׁ יְהֹוָה אֶת עַמּוֹ.
tokens.translation: “For Adonoy will not forsake His people
tokens.transliteration: kee loh yeetsh ah-doh-NAI eht ah-moh.

tokens.translation: for the sake of His great Name.”
In Elam He placed His throne
to save His loved ones;
to remove from there
the strongholds of those
who rebelled against Him.
From beneath the sword
He redeemed His servants.
The power of His people, He will exalt,
praise for all His pious ones.
“For though He afflicts,
He is compassionate, according to His mercy
and His abundant kindliness.”
The he-goat, [so] great was its might,
that the (vision of the) four [horns]
ascended to His ennobled ones?
In their hearts they intended
to destroy His cherished ones;
[but] through His priests
He destroyed those who rose against Him.
“The kindlinesses of Adonoy
have never ended,
for His mercies are inexhaustible.”
I was handed over to Edom—
into the hands of my quarrelsome brothers
who daily
filled their bellies from my wealth.
His help is with me
to support my pillars;
and You have not abandoned me
all the days of my times.
“For my Master will not cast [me] away forever.”
When He comes from Edom
with bloodied clothes
having slain in Botzrah
and executed traitors—
the splashing of their lifeblood
having reddened His garments.
With His great power,
He will diminish
the [haughty] spirit of princes—
“Afflicting them with His harsh wind
on the day of the East Wind.”
On seeing that it is so,
Edom's guardian angel
will think that Botzrah
is a refuge like Betzer.
That an angel,
like a man, is protected within it,
and that the premeditated [killer]
like the unpremeditated [killer]
is held in the refuge.
“Love Adonoy, all His pious ones,
the faithful ones whom He preserves.”
May the Rock command His kindliness
His communities to gather;
from the four winds
unto Him to be gathered.
And upon the mountain
exalted above all mountains
to grant us rest;
and with us, He will return;
the banished ones He will gather.
“He will bring back,” is not said
but “He will return and gather.”
Blessed is our God
Who has done good with us;
according to His mercy,
and abundant kindliness,
He did great things for us.
These things and similar ones
may He increase for us,
to magnify His great Name,
powerful, and awesome
which is pronounced upon us.
Blessed is He, our God
Who created us for His glory
to extol Him, to praise Him;
and to recount His majesty.
Of all peoples,
His kindliness has been powerful over us.
Therefore, with [our] whole heart,
and with [our] whole soul,
and with all [our] possessions,
we proclaim Him King, and declare His Unity.
May the Possessor of peace
grant us blessing and peace,
—from left (north) and from right (south)
peace upon Israel.
The merciful One,
He will bless His people with peace,
and they will merit to see
children and grandchildren
occupying themselves with Torah
and with commandments,
[bringing] peace upon Israel.
Advisor, Almighty, Powerful One,
Eternal Father, Prince of peace.

useCase: Ashrei · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Fortunate are those who dwell
in Your house;
may they continue to praise You, selah.
Fortunate is the people whose lot is thus;
fortunate is the people
for whom Adonoy is their God.
A praise by David!
I will exalt You, my God, the King,
and bless Your Name forever and ever.
Every day I will bless You
and extol Your Name forever and ever.
Adonoy is great and highly extolled,
and His greatness is unfathomable.
One generation to another
will praise Your works
and Your mighty acts they will declare.
The splendor of Your glorious majesty,
and the words of Your wonders I will speak.
Of Your awesome might, they will speak
and Your greatness I will recount.
Mention of Your bountifulness
they will express,
and in Your righteousness joyfully exult.
Adonoy is gracious and compassionate,
slow to anger and great in kindliness.
Adonoy is good to all,
His mercy encompasses all His works.
All Your works will thank You, Adonoy,
and Your pious ones will bless You.
Of the honor of Your kingship,
they will speak
and Your might they will declare.
To reveal to men His mighty acts,
and the glorious splendor of His kingship.
Your kingship is the kingship for all times,
and Your dominion is in every generation.
Adonoy supports all the fallen,
and straightens all the bent.
The eyes of all look expectantly to You,
and You give them
their food at its proper time.
You open Your hand
and satisfy the desire of every living being.
Adonoy is just in all His ways
and benevolent in all His deeds.
Adonoy is near to all who call upon Him,
to all who call upon Him in truth.
The will of those who fear Him He fulfills;
He hears their cry and delivers them.
Adonoy watches over all those who love Him,
and will destroy all the wicked.
Praise of Adonoy, my mouth will declare,
and all flesh will bless
His holy Name forever and ever.
And we will bless God
from now on forever.
Praise God.
