title: Aleinu
sefariaRef: Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear, Mincha Service for Shabbos and Yom Tov, Aleinu
useCase: Aleinu · Shabbat Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: shabbat, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: It is our obligation to praise
the Master of all,
to ascribe greatness
to the Creator of the [world in the] beginning:
that He has not made us
like the nations of the lands,
and has not positioned us
like the families of the earth;
that He has not assigned
our portion like theirs,
nor our lot like that of all their multitudes.
For they prostrate themselves
to vanity and nothingness,
and pray to a god that cannot deliver.
But we bow, prostrate ourselves,
and offer thanks
before the Supreme King of kings,
the Holy One blessed is He,
Who spreads the heavens,
and establishes the earth,
and the Seat of His glory is in heaven above,
and the abode of His invincible might
is in the loftiest heights.
He is our God, there is nothing else.
Our King is true,
all else is insignificant,
as it is written in His Torah:
“And you shall know this day
and take into your heart
that Adonoy is God
in the heavens above
and upon the earth below;
there is nothing else.”
We therefore put our hope in You,
Adonoy our God,
to soon behold the glory of Your might
in banishing idolatry from the earth
and the false gods
will be utterly exterminated
to perfect the world
as the kingdom of Shadai.
And all mankind will invoke Your Name,
to turn back to You,
all the wicked of the earth.
They will realize and know,
all the inhabitants of the world,
that to You, every knee must bend,
every tongue must swear [allegiance to You].
Before You, Adonoy, our God,
they will bow and prostrate themselves,
and to the glory of Your Name give honor.
And they will all accept [upon themselves]
the yoke of Your kingdom,
and You will reign over them, soon,
forever and ever.
For the kingdom is Yours,
and to all eternity You will reign in glory,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“Adonoy will reign forever and ever.”
And it is said:
“And Adonoy will be King
over the whole earth;
on that day Adonoy will be One
and His Name One.”
Do not fear sudden terror
nor the destruction of the wicked
when it comes.
Take counsel together and it will be foiled
speak the word and it will not stand
for God is with us.
To your old age I am [with you],
to your older years I will sustain you,
I have made you, and I will carry you,
I will sustain you and save you.

title: Blessings Upon Arising
sefariaRef: Weekday Siddur Sefard Linear, The Morning Prayers, Blessings Upon Arising
summary: Blessings Upon Arising · Weekday Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Blessings Upon Arising · Weekday Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe,
Who sanctified us with His commandments
and commanded us
concerning the washing of hands.
Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe,
Who formed man with wisdom
and created within him openings
and hollows.
It is obvious and known
in the presence of Your glorious throne
that if one of them were ruptured,
or if one of them were blocked,
it would be impossible to exist
and stand in Your Presence
even for a short while.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who heals all flesh
and performs wonders.
My God!
the soul which You bestowed in me is pure;
You created it, You formed it,
You breathed it into me
and You preserve it within me.
You will eventually take it from me,
and restore it in me in the time to come.
So long as the soul is within me
I give thanks to You, Adonoy my God,
and God of my fathers,
Lord of all creatures,
Master of all souls.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Who restores souls
to dead bodies.

title: Blessings of the Torah
sefariaRef: Weekday Siddur Sefard Linear, The Morning Prayers, Blessings of the Torah
summary: Blessings of the Torah · Weekday Siddur Sefard Linear
useCase: Blessings of the Torah · Weekday Siddur Sefard Linear Themes: learning, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe,
Who sanctified us with His commandments
and commanded us
to be engrossed in the words of Torah.
Adonoy our God, please make pleasant
the words of Your Torah in our mouths
and in the mouths of Your people Israel.
And may we and our descendants
and the descendants of Your people
the House of Israel,
all be perceivers of Your Name
and students of Your Torah for its own sake.
Blessed are You, Adonoy
Who teaches Torah to His people, Israel.
Blessed are You, Adonoy
our God, King of the Universe
Who chose us from among all the peoples
and gave us His Torah.
Blessed are You, Adonoy,
Giver of the Torah!
And Adonoy spoke to Moses, saying,

tokens.hebrew: דַבֵּר אֶל אַהֲרֹן וְאֶל בָּנָיו לֵאמֹר
tokens.translation: Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying,
tokens.transliteration: dah-behr ehl ah-hah-rohn ve-ehl bah-nahv leh-mohr

tokens.translation: thus shall you bless the Children of Israel,
say to them:
May Adonoy bless you and guard you.
May Adonoy shine
His countenance upon you
and be gracious unto you.
May Adonoy turn
His countenance toward you
and grant you peace.
And they shall set My Name
upon the Children of Israel,
and I shall bless them.
These are precepts
for which no fixed measure is prescribed:
[leaving] the corner [of a field unharvested],
[the offering of] the first fruits,
the appearance-offering,
[performing] deeds of kindness,
and the study of Torah.
These are precepts,
the fruits of which man enjoys
in this world,
[while] the principal [reward]
is preserved for him in the World-to-Come.
They are:
honoring father and mother,
[performing] deeds of kindness,
early attendance in the House of Study
morning and evening,
providing hospitality to guests,
visiting the sick,
participating in making a wedding,
accompanying the dead [to the grave],
concentrating on the meaning of prayers,
making peace between fellow men
and between husband and wife—
and the study of Torah is equal to them all.

useCase: Kadesh · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: We pour the first cup. The matsot are covered
Make Kiddush
On Shabbat, begin here:

tokens.hebrew: וַיְהִי־עֶרֶב וַיְהִי־בֹקֶר יוֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁי. וַיְכֻלּוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ וְכָל־צְבָאָם. וַיְכַל אֱלֹהִים בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיִּשְׁבֹּת בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה. וַיְבָרֶךְ אֱלֹהִים אֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי וַיְקַדֵּשׁ אוֹתוֹ כִּי בוֹ שָׁבַת מִכָּל־מְלַאכְתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים לַעֲשׂוֹת.
tokens.translation: And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day. And the heaven and the earth were finished, and all their host. And on the seventh day God finished His work which He had done; and He rested on the seventh day from all His work which He had done. And God blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it; because He rested on it from all of His work which God created in doing (Genesis 1:31-2:3).
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-hee eh-rehv vah-ye-hee voh-kehr yohm hah-shee-shee. vah-ye-khoo-loo hah-shah-mah-yeem ve-hah-ah-rehts ve-khohl tse-vah-ahm. vah-ye-khahl eh-loh-heem bah-yohm hah-she-vee-ee me-lahkh-toh ah-shehr ah-sah vah-yeesh-boht bah-yohm hah-she-vee-ee mee-kohl me-lahkh-toh ah-shehr ah-sah. vah-ye-vah-rehkh eh-loh-heem eht yohm hah-she-vee-ee vah-ye-kah-dehsh oh-toh kee voh shah-vaht mee-kohl me-lahkh-toh ah-shehr bah-rah eh-loh-heem lah-ah-soht.

tokens.translation: On weekdays, begin here:

tokens.hebrew: סַבְרִי מָרָנָן וְרַבָּנָן וְרַבּוֹתַי. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא פְּרִי הַגָּפֶן.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the fruit of the vine.
tokens.transliteration: sahv-ree mah-rah-nahn ve-rah-bah-nahn ve-rah-boh-tahy. bah-rookh ah-tah ye-yah, eh-loh-hey-noo meh-lehkh hah-oh-lahm, boh-reh pe-ree hah-gah-fehn.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר בָּנוּ מִכָּל־עָם וְרוֹמְמָנוּ מִכָּל־לָשׁוֹן וְקִדְּשָׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו. וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה (לשבת: שַׁבָּתוֹת לִמְנוּחָה וּ)מוֹעֲדִים לְשִׂמְחָה, חַגִּים וּזְמַנִּים לְשָׂשׂוֹן, (לשבת: אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה וְ)אֶת יוֹם חַג הַמַּצּוֹת הַזֶּה זְמַן חֵרוּתֵנוּ, (לשבת: בְּאַהֲבָה) מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ זֵכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָיִם. כִּי בָנוּ בָחַרְתָּ וְאוֹתָנוּ קִדַּשְׁתָּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, (לשבת: וְשַׁבָּת) וּמוֹעֲדֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ (לשבת: בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן) בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׂשׂוֹן הִנְחַלְתָּנוּ.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who has chosen us from all peoples and has raised us above all tongues and has sanctified us with His commandments. And You have given us, Lord our God, [Sabbaths for rest], appointed times for happiness, holidays and special times for joy, [this Sabbath day, and] this Festival of Matsot, our season of freedom [in love] a holy convocation in memory of the Exodus from Egypt. For You have chosen us and sanctified us above all peoples. In Your gracious love, You granted us Your [holy Sabbath, and] special times for happiness and joy.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ (לשבת: הַשַׁבָּת וְ)יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזְּמַנִּים.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, O Lord, who sanctifies [the Sabbath,] Israel, and the appointed times.

tokens.translation: On Saturday night add the following two paragraphs:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, בּוֹרֵא מְאוֹרֵי הָאֵשׁ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, הַמַּבְדִיל בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְחֹל, בֵּין אוֹר לְחשֶׁךְ, בֵּין יִשְׂרָאֵל לָעַמִּים, בֵּין יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי לְשֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה. בֵּין קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת לִקְדֻשַּׁת יוֹם טוֹב הִבְדַּלְתָּ, וְאֶת־יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה קִדַּשְׁתָּ. הִבְדַּלְתָּ וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת־עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתֶךָ.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who creates the light of the fire. Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who distinguishes between the holy and the profane, between light and darkness, between Israel and the nations, between the seventh day and the six working days. You have distinguished between the holiness of the Sabbath and the holiness of the Festival, and You have sanctified the seventh day above the six working days. You have distinguished and sanctified Your people Israel with Your holiness.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, הַמַּבְדִיל בֵּין קֹדֶשׁ לְקֹדֶשׁ.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, O Lord, who distinguishes between the holy and the holy.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ye-yah, hah-mahv-deel beyn koh-dehsh le-koh-dehsh.

title: Ha Lachma Anya
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Ha Lachma Anya
useCase: Ha Lachma Anya · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: The Recitation [of the exodus story]

tokens.hebrew: מגלה את המצות, מגביה את הקערה ואומר בקול רם:
tokens.translation: The leader uncovers the matsot, raises the Seder plate, and says out loud:

tokens.hebrew: הָא לַחְמָא עַנְיָא דִּי אֲכָלוּ אַבְהָתָנָא בְּאַרְעָא דְמִצְרָיִם. כָּל דִכְפִין יֵיתֵי וְיֵיכֹל, כָּל דִצְרִיךְ יֵיתֵי וְיִפְסַח. הָשַּׁתָּא הָכָא, לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בְּאַרְעָא דְיִשְׂרָאֵל. הָשַּׁתָּא עַבְדֵי, לְשָׁנָה הַבָּאָה בְּנֵי חוֹרִין.
tokens.translation: This is the bread of destitution that our ancestors ate in the land of Egypt. Anyone who is famished should come and eat, anyone who is in need should come and partake of the Pesach sacrifice. Now we are here, next year we will be in the land of Israel; this year we are slaves, next year we will be free people.

title: Four Questions
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Four Questions
useCase: Four Questions · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מסיר את הקערה מעל השולחן. מוזגין כוס שני. הבן שואל:
tokens.translation: He removes the plate from the table. We pour a second cup of wine. The son then asks:

tokens.hebrew: מַה נִּשְׁתַּנָּה הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה מִכָּל הַלֵּילוֹת? שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אָנוּ אוֹכְלִין חָמֵץ וּמַצָּה, הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה – כֻּלּוֹ מַצָּה. שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אָנוּ אוֹכְלִין שְׁאָר יְרָקוֹת – הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה (כֻּלּוֹ) מָרוֹר. שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אֵין אָנוּ מַטְבִּילִין אֲפִילוּ פַּעַם אֶחָת – הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה שְׁתֵּי פְעָמִים. שֶׁבְּכָל הַלֵּילוֹת אָנוּ אוֹכְלִין בֵּין יוֹשְׁבִין וּבֵין מְסֻבִּין – הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה כֻּלָּנוּ מְסֻבִּין.
tokens.translation: What differentiates this night from all [other] nights? On all [other] nights we eat chamets and matsa; this night, only matsa? On all [other] nights we eat other vegetables; tonight (only) marror. On all [other] nights, we don't dip [our food], even one time; tonight [we dip it] twice. On [all] other nights, we eat either sitting or reclining; tonight we all recline.
tokens.transliteration: mahh neesh-tah-nah hah-lahy-lah hah-zeh mee-kohl hah-ley-loht? sheh-be-khahl hah-ley-loht ah-noo oh-khe-leen khah-mehts oo-mah-tsah, hah-lahy-lah hah-zeh – koo-loh mah-tsah. sheh-be-khahl hah-ley-loht ah-noo oh-khe-leen she-ahr ye-rah-koht – hah-lahy-lah hah-zeh (koo-loh) mah-rohr. sheh-be-khahl hah-ley-loht eyn ah-noo maht-bee-leen ah-fee-loo pah-ahm eh-khaht – hah-lahy-lah hah-zeh she-tey fe-ah-meem. sheh-be-khahl hah-ley-loht ah-noo oh-khe-leen beyn yoh-she-veen oo-veyn me-soo-been – hah-lahy-lah hah-zeh koo-lah-noo me-soo-been.

title: Story of the Five Rabbis
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Story of the Five Rabbis
summary: Story of the Five Rabbis · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: Story of the Five Rabbis · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מַעֲשֶׂה בְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר וְרַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ וְרַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה וְרַבִּי עֲקִיבָא וְרַבִּי טַרְפוֹן שֶׁהָיוּ מְסֻבִּין בִּבְנֵי־בְרַק וְהָיוּ מְסַפְּרִים בִּיצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם כָּל־אוֹתוֹ הַלַּיְלָה, עַד שֶׁבָּאוּ תַלְמִידֵיהֶם וְאָמְרוּ לָהֶם רַבּוֹתֵינוּ הִגִּיעַ זְמַן קְרִיאַת שְׁמַע שֶׁל שַׁחֲרִית.
tokens.translation: It happened once [on Pesach] that Rabbi Eliezer, Rabbi Yehoshua, Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah, Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Tarfon were reclining in Bnei Brak and were telling the story of the exodus from Egypt that whole night, until their students came and said to them, "The time of [reciting] the morning Shema has arrived."
tokens.transliteration: mah-ah-seh ve-rah-bee eh-lee-eh-zehr ve-rah-bee ye-hoh-shoo-ah ve-rah-bee ehl-ah-zahr behn ah-zahr-yah ve-rah-bee ah-kee-vah ve-rah-bee tahr-fohn sheh-hah-yoo me-soo-been beev-ney ve-rahk ve-hah-yoo me-sah-pe-reem bee-tsee-aht meets-rah-yeem kohl oh-toh hah-lahy-lah, ahd sheh-bah-oo tahl-mee-dey-hehm ve-ah-me-roo lah-hehm rah-boh-tey-noo hee-gee-ah ze-mahn ke-ree-aht she-mah shehl shah-khah-reet.

tokens.hebrew: אָמַר רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן־עֲזַרְיָה הֲרֵי אֲנִי כְּבֶן שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה וְלֹא זָכִיתִי שֶׁתֵּאָמֵר יְצִיאַת מִצְרַיִם בַּלֵּילוֹת עַד שֶׁדְּרָשָׁהּ בֶּן זוֹמָא, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, לְמַעַן תִּזְכֹּר אֶת יוֹם צֵאתְךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ. יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ הַיָּמִים. כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ הַלֵּילוֹת. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ הָעוֹלָם הַזֶּה. כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ לְהָבִיא לִימוֹת הַמָּשִׁיחַ:
tokens.translation: Rabbi Elazar ben Azariah said, "Behold I am like a man of seventy years and I have not merited [to understand why] the exodus from Egypt should be said at night until Ben Zoma explicated it, as it is stated (Deuteronomy 16:3), 'In order that you remember the day of your going out from the land of Egypt all the days of your life;' 'the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked during] the days, 'all the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked also during] the nights." But the Sages say, "'the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked in] this world, 'all the days of your life' [indicates that the remembrance be invoked also] in the days of the Messiah."
tokens.transliteration: ah-mahr rah-bee ehl-ah-zahr behn ah-zahr-yah hah-rey ah-nee ke-vehn sheev-eem shah-nah ve-loh zah-khee-tee sheh-teh-ah-mehr ye-tsee-aht meets-rah-yeem bah-ley-loht ahd sheh-de-rah-shahh behn zoh-mah, sheh-neh-eh-mahr, le-mah-ahn teez-kohr eht yohm tseh-te-khah meh-eh-rehts meets-rah-yeem kohl ye-mey khah-yey-khah. ye-mey khah-yey-khah hah-yah-meem. kohl ye-mey khah-yey-khah hah-ley-loht. vah-khah-khah-meem oh-me-reem ye-mey khah-yey-khah hah-oh-lahm hah-zeh. kohl ye-mey khah-yey-khah le-hah-vee lee-moht hah-mah-shee-ahkh:

title: The Four Sons
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, The Four Sons
useCase: The Four Sons · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ הַמָּקוֹם, בָּרוּךְ הוּא, בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל, בָּרוּךְ הוּא. כְּנֶגֶד אַרְבָּעָה בָנִים דִּבְּרָה תוֹרָה: אֶחָד חָכָם, וְאֶחָד רָשָׁע, וְאֶחָד תָּם, וְאֶחָד שֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ לִשְׁאוֹל.
tokens.translation: Blessed be the Place [of all], Blessed be He; Blessed be the One who Gave the Torah to His people Israel, Blessed be He. Corresponding to four sons did the Torah speak; one [who is] wise, one [who is] evil, one who is innocent and one who doesn't know to ask.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh hah-mah-kohm, bah-rookh hoo, bah-rookh sheh-nah-tahn toh-rah le-ah-moh yees-rah-ehl, bah-rookh hoo. ke-neh-gehd ahr-bah-ah vah-neem dee-be-rah toh-rah: eh-khahd khah-khahm, ve-eh-khahd rah-shah, ve-eh-khahd tahm, ve-eh-khahd sheh-ey-noh yoh-deh-ah leesh-ohl.

tokens.hebrew: חָכָם מָה הוּא אוֹמֵר? מָה הָעֵדוֹת וְהַחֻקִּים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶתְכֶם. וְאַף אַתָּה אֱמוֹר לוֹ כְּהִלְכוֹת הַפֶּסַח: אֵין מַפְטִירִין אַחַר הַפֶּסַח אֲפִיקוֹמָן:
tokens.translation: What does the wise [son] say? "'What are these testimonies, statutes and judgments that the Lord our God commanded you?' (Deuteronomy 6:20)" And accordingly you will say to him, as per the laws of the Pesach sacrifice, "We may not eat an afikoman [a dessert or other foods eaten after the meal] after [we are finished eating] the Pesach sacrifice (Mishnah Pesachim 10:8)."
tokens.transliteration: khah-khahm mah hoo oh-mehr? mah hah-eh-doht ve-hah-khoo-keem ve-hah-meesh-pah-teem ah-shehr tsee-vah ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo eht-khehm. ve-ahf ah-tah eh-mohr loh ke-heel-khoht hah-peh-sahkh: eyn mahf-tee-reen ah-khahr hah-peh-sahkh ah-fee-koh-mahn:

tokens.hebrew: רָשָׁע מָה הוּא אוֹמֵר? מָה הָעֲבוֹדָה הַזּאֹת לָכֶם. לָכֶם – וְלֹא לוֹ. וּלְפִי שֶׁהוֹצִיא אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִן הַכְּלָל כָּפַר בְּעִקָּר. וְאַף אַתָּה הַקְהֵה אֶת שִׁנָּיו וֶאֱמוֹר לוֹ: "בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְיָ לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם". לִי וְלֹא־לוֹ. אִלּוּ הָיָה שָׁם, לֹא הָיָה נִגְאָל:
tokens.translation: What does the evil [son] say? "'What is this worship to you?' (Exodus 12:26)" 'To you' and not 'to him.' And since he excluded himself from the collective, he denied a principle [of the Jewish faith]. And accordingly, you will blunt his teeth and say to him, "'For the sake of this, did the Lord do [this] for me in my going out of Egypt' (Exodus 13:8)." 'For me' and not 'for him.' If he had been there, he would not have been saved.
tokens.transliteration: rah-shah mah hoo oh-mehr? mah hah-ah-voh-dah hah-z-oht lah-khehm. lah-khehm – ve-loh loh. oo-le-fee sheh-hoh-tsee eht ahts-moh meen hah-ke-lahl kah-fahr be-ee-kahr. ve-ahf ah-tah hahk-heh eht shee-nahv veh-eh-mohr loh: "bah-ah-voor zeh ah-sah ye-yah lee be-tseh-tee mee-meets-rah-yeem". lee ve-loh loh. ee-loo hah-yah shahm, loh hah-yah neeg-ahl:

tokens.hebrew: תָּם מָה הוּא אוֹמֵר? מַה זּאֹת. וְאָמַרְתָּ אֵלָיו "בְּחוֹזֶק יָד הוֹצִיאָנוּ יְיָ מִמִּצְרַיִם מִבֵּית עֲבָדִים".
tokens.translation: What does the innocent [son] say? "'What is this?' (Exodus 13:14)" And you will say to him, "'With the strength of [His] hand did the Lord take us out from Egypt, from the house of slaves' (Exodus 13:14).'"
tokens.transliteration: tahm mah hoo oh-mehr? mahh z-oht. ve-ah-mahr-tah eh-lahv "be-khoh-zehk yahd hoh-tsee-ah-noo ye-yah mee-meets-rah-yeem mee-beyt ah-vah-deem".

tokens.hebrew: וְשֶׁאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ לִשְׁאוֹל – אַתְּ פְּתַח לוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר, וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר, בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְיָ לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרָיִם.
tokens.translation: And [regarding] the one who doesn't know to ask, you will open [the conversation] for him. As it is stated (Exodus 13:8), "And you will speak to your son on that day saying, for the sake of this, did the Lord do [this] for me in my going out of Egypt."
tokens.transliteration: ve-sheh-ey-noh yoh-deh-ah leesh-ohl – aht pe-tahkh loh, sheh-neh-eh-mahr, ve-hee-gahd-tah le-veen-khah bah-yohm hah-hoo leh-mohr, bah-ah-voor zeh ah-sah ye-yah lee be-tseh-tee mee-meets-rah-yeem.

tokens.hebrew: יָכוֹל מֵראשׁ חֹדֶשׁ? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא. אִי בַיּוֹם הַהוּא יָכוֹל מִבְּעוֹד יוֹם? תַּלְמוּד לוֹמַר בַּעֲבוּר זֶה – בַּעֲבוּר זֶה לֹא אָמַרְתִּי, אֶלָּא בְּשָׁעָה שֶׁיֵּשׁ מַצָּה וּמָרוֹר מֻנָּחִים לְפָנֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: It could be from Rosh Chodesh [that one would have to discuss the Exodus. However] we learn [otherwise, since] it is stated, "on that day." If it is [written] "on that day," it could be from while it is still day [before the night of the fifteenth of Nissan. However] we learn [otherwise, since] it is stated, "for the sake of this." I didn't say 'for the sake of this' except [that it be observed] when [this] matsa and maror are resting in front of you [meaning, on the night of the fifteenth].
tokens.transliteration: yah-khohl mehrsh khoh-dehsh? tahl-mood loh-mahr bah-yohm hah-hoo. ee vah-yohm hah-hoo yah-khohl mee-be-ohd yohm? tahl-mood loh-mahr bah-ah-voor zeh – bah-ah-voor zeh loh ah-mahr-tee, eh-lah be-shah-ah sheh-yehsh mah-tsah oo-mah-rohr moo-nah-kheem le-fah-ney-khah.

title: In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers
summary: In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: In the Beginning Our Fathers Were Idol Worshipers · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.
aliases: מתחילה עובדי עבודה זרה היו אבותינו

tokens.hebrew: מִתְּחִלָּה עוֹבְדֵי עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה הָיוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, וְעַכְשָׁיו קֵרְבָנוּ הַמָּקוֹם לַעֲבוֹדָתוֹ, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיֹאמֶר יְהוֹשֻעַ אֶל־כָּל־הָעָם, כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל, בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר יָשְׁבוּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם מֵעוֹלָם, תֶּרַח אֲבִי אַבְרָהָם וַאֲבִי נָחוֹר, וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֱלֹהִים אֲחֵרִים.
tokens.translation: From the beginning, our ancestors were idol worshipers. And now, the Place [of all] has brought us close to His worship, as it is stated (Joshua 24:2-4), "Yehoshua said to the whole people, so said the Lord, God of Israel, 'Over the river did your ancestors dwell from always, Terach the father of Avraham and the father of Nachor, and they worshiped other gods.
tokens.transliteration: mee-te-khee-lah oh-ve-dey ah-voh-dah zah-rah hah-yoo ah-voh-tey-noo, ve-ahkh-shahv keh-re-vah-noo hah-mah-kohm lah-ah-voh-dah-toh, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: vah-yoh-mehr ye-hoh-shoo-ah ehl kohl hah-ahm, kohh ah-mahr ye-yah eh-loh-hey yees-rah-ehl, be-eh-vehr hah-nah-hahr yah-she-voo ah-voh-tey-khehm meh-oh-lahm, teh-rahkh ah-vee ahv-rah-hahm vah-ah-vee nah-khohr, vah-yah-ahv-doo eh-loh-heem ah-kheh-reem.

tokens.hebrew: וָאֶקַּח אֶת־אֲבִיכֶם אֶת־אַבְרָהָם מֵעֵבֶר הַנָּהָר וָאוֹלֵךְ אוֹתוֹ בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן, וָאַרְבֶּה אֶת־זַרְעוֹ וָאֶתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־יִצְחָק. וָאֶתֵּן לְיִצְחָק אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־עֵשָׂו, וָאֶתֵּן לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־הַר שֵּׂעִיר לָרֶשֶׁת אוֹתוֹ, וְיַעֲקֹב וּבָנָיו יָרְדוּ מִצְרָיִם.
tokens.translation: And I took your father, Avraham, from over the river and I made him walk in all the land of Canaan and I increased his seed and I gave him Yitschak. And I gave to Yitschak, Ya'akov and Esav; and I gave to Esav, Mount Seir [in order that he] inherit it; and Yaakov and his sons went down to Egypt.'"
tokens.transliteration: vah-eh-kahkh eht ah-vee-khehm eht ahv-rah-hahm meh-eh-vehr hah-nah-hahr vah-oh-lehkh oh-toh be-khohl eh-rehts ke-nah-ahn, vah-ahr-beh eht zahr-oh vah-eh-tehn loh eht yeets-khahk. vah-eh-tehn le-yeets-khahk eht yah-ah-kohv ve-eht eh-sahv, vah-eh-tehn le-eh-sahv eht hahr seh-eer lah-reh-sheht oh-toh, ve-yah-ah-kohv oo-vah-nahv yah-re-doo meets-rah-yeem.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ שׁוֹמֵר הַבְטָחָתוֹ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל, בָּרוּךְ הוּא. שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא חִשַּׁב אֶת־הַקֵּץ, לַעֲשׂוֹת כְּמוֹ שֶּׁאָמַר לְאַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ בִּבְרִית בֵּין הַבְּתָרִים, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיֹּאמֶר לְאַבְרָם, יָדֹעַ תֵּדַע כִּי־גֵר יִהְיֶה זַרְעֲךָ בְּאֶרֶץ לֹא לָהֶם, וַעֲבָדוּם וְעִנּוּ אֹתָם אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה. וְגַם אֶת־הַגּוֹי אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹדוּ דָּן אָנֹכִי וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן יֵצְאוּ בִּרְכֻשׁ גָּדוֹל.
tokens.translation: Blessed be the One who keeps His promise to Israel, blessed be He; since the Holy One, blessed be He, calculated the end [of the exile,] to do as He said to Avraham, our father, in the Covenant between the Pieces, as it is stated (Genesis 15:13-14), "And He said to Avram, 'you should surely know that your seed will be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and they will enslave them and afflict them four hundred years. And also that nation for which they shall toil will I judge, and afterwards they will go out with much property.'"
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh shoh-mehr hahv-tah-khah-toh le-yees-rah-ehl, bah-rookh hoo. sheh-hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo khee-shahv eht hah-kehts, lah-ah-soht ke-moh sheh-ah-mahr le-ahv-rah-hahm ah-vee-noo beev-reet beyn hah-be-tah-reem, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: vah-yoh-mehr le-ahv-rahm, yah-doh-ah teh-dah kee gehr yeeh-yeh zahr-ah-khah be-eh-rehts loh lah-hehm, vah-ah-vah-doom ve-ee-noo oh-tahm ahr-bah meh-oht shah-nah. ve-gahm eht hah-gohy ah-shehr yah-ah-voh-doo dahn ah-noh-khee ve-ah-khah-rey khehn yeh-tse-oo beer-khoosh gah-dohl.

tokens.hebrew: מכסה המצה ומגביה את הכוס בידו, ואומר:
tokens.translation: He covers the matsa and lifts up the cup and says:

tokens.hebrew: וְהִיא שֶׁעָמְדָה לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְלָנוּ. שֶׁלֹּא אֶחָד בִּלְבַד עָמַד עָלֵינוּ לְכַלּוֹתֵנוּ, אֶלָּא שֶׁבְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר עוֹמְדִים עָלֵינוּ לְכַלוֹתֵנוּ, וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא מַצִּילֵנוּ מִיָּדָם.
tokens.translation: And it is this that has stood for our ancestors and for us; since it is not [only] one [person or nation] that has stood [against] us to destroy us, but rather in each generation, they stand [against] us to destroy us, but the Holy One, blessed be He, rescues us from their hand.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hee sheh-ah-me-dah lah-ah-voh-tey-noo ve-lah-noo. sheh-loh eh-khahd beel-vahd ah-mahd ah-ley-noo le-khah-loh-teh-noo, eh-lah sheh-be-khahl dohr vah-dohr oh-me-deem ah-ley-noo le-khah-loh-teh-noo, ve-hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo mah-tsee-leh-noo mee-yah-dahm.

tokens.translation: How many degrees of good did the Place [of all bestow] upon us!

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם וְלֹא עָשָׂה בָהֶם שְׁפָטִים, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had taken us out of Egypt and not made judgements on them; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo hoh-tsee-ah-noo mee-meets-rah-yeem ve-loh ah-sah vah-hehm she-fah-teem, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ עָשָׂה בָהֶם שְׁפָטִים, וְלֹא עָשָׂה בֵאלֹהֵיהֶם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had made judgments on them and had not made [them] on their gods; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo ah-sah vah-hehm she-fah-teem, ve-loh ah-sah veh-loh-hey-hehm, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ עָשָׂה בֵאלֹהֵיהֶם, וְלֹא הָרַג אֶת־בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had made [them] on their gods and had not killed their firstborn; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo ah-sah veh-loh-hey-hehm, ve-loh hah-rahg eht be-khoh-rey-hehm, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הָרַג אֶת־בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם וְלֹא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־מָמוֹנָם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had killed their firstborn and had not given us their money; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo hah-rahg eht be-khoh-rey-hehm ve-loh nah-tahn lah-noo eht mah-moh-nahm, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־מָמוֹנָם וְלֹא קָרַע לָנוּ אֶת־הַיָּם, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had given us their money and had not split the Sea for us; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo nah-tahn lah-noo eht mah-moh-nahm ve-loh kah-rah lah-noo eht hah-yahm, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ קָרַע לָנוּ אֶת־הַיָּם וְלֹא הֶעֱבִירָנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ בֶּחָרָבָה, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had split the Sea for us and had not taken us through it on dry land; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo kah-rah lah-noo eht hah-yahm ve-loh heh-eh-vee-rah-noo ve-toh-khoh beh-khah-rah-vah, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הֶעֱבִירָנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ בֶּחָרָבָה וְלֹא שִׁקַּע צָרֵנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had taken us through it on dry land and had not pushed down our enemies in [the Sea]; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo heh-eh-vee-rah-noo ve-toh-khoh beh-khah-rah-vah ve-loh shee-kah tsah-reh-noo ve-toh-khoh dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ שִׁקַּע צָרֵנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ וְלֹא סִפֵּק צָרְכֵּנוּ בַּמִדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had pushed down our enemies in [the Sea] and had not supplied our needs in the wilderness for forty years; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo shee-kah tsah-reh-noo ve-toh-khoh ve-loh see-pehk tsohr-keh-noo bah-meed-bahr ahr-bah-eem shah-nah dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ סִפֵּק צָרְכֵּנוּ בַּמִּדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה וְלֹא הֶאֱכִילָנוּ אֶת־הַמָּן דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had supplied our needs in the wilderness for forty years and had not fed us the manna; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo see-pehk tsohr-keh-noo bah-meed-bahr ahr-bah-eem shah-nah ve-loh heh-eh-khee-lah-noo eht hah-mahn dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הֶאֱכִילָנוּ אֶת־הַמָּן וְלֹא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had fed us the manna and had not given us the Shabbat; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo heh-eh-khee-lah-noo eht hah-mahn ve-loh nah-tahn lah-noo eht hah-shah-baht, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת, וְלֹא קֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had given us the Shabbat and had not brought us close to Mount Sinai; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo nah-tahn lah-noo eht hah-shah-baht, ve-loh keh-re-vah-noo leef-ney hahr see-nahy, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ קֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, וְלא נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה. דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had brought us close to Mount Sinai and had not given us the Torah; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo keh-re-vah-noo leef-ney hahr see-nahy, vel nah-tahn lah-noo eht hah-toh-rah. dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ נָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה וְלֹא הִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had given us the Torah and had not brought us into the land of Israel; [it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo nah-tahn lah-noo eht hah-toh-rah ve-loh heekh-nee-sah-noo le-eh-rehts yees-rah-ehl, dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ הִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְלֹא בָנָה לָּנוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה דַּיֵּנוּ.
tokens.translation: If He had brought us into the land of Israel and had not built us the 'Chosen House' [the Temple; it would have been] enough for us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo heekh-nee-sah-noo le-eh-rehts yees-rah-ehl ve-loh vah-nah lah-noo eht beyt hah-be-khee-rah dah-yeh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: עַל אַחַת, כַּמָה וְכַמָה, טוֹבָה כְפוּלָה וּמְכֻפֶּלֶת לַמָּקוֹם עָלֵינוּ: שֶׁהוֹצִיאָנוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם, וְעָשָׂה בָהֶם שְׁפָטִים, וְעָשָׂה בֵאלֹהֵיהֶם, וְהָרַג אֶת־בְּכוֹרֵיהֶם, וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־מָמוֹנָם, וְקָרַע לָנוּ אֶת־הַיָּם, וְהֶעֱבִירָנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ בֶּחָרָבָה, וְשִׁקַּע צָרֵנוּ בְתוֹכוֹ, וְסִפֵּק צָרְכֵּנוּ בַּמִדְבָּר אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה, וְהֶאֱכִילָנוּ אֶת־הַמָּן, וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּת, וְקֵרְבָנוּ לִפְנֵי הַר סִינַי, וְנָתַן לָנוּ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָה, וְהִכְנִיסָנוּ לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל, וּבָנָה לָּנוּ אֶת־בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה לְכַפֵּר עַל־כָּל־עֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ.
tokens.translation: How much more so is the good that is doubled and quadrupled that the Place [of all bestowed] upon us [enough for us]; since he took us out of Egypt, and made judgments with them, and made [them] with their gods, and killed their firstborn, and gave us their money, and split the Sea for us, and brought us through it on dry land, and pushed down our enemies in [the Sea], and supplied our needs in the wilderness for forty years, and fed us the manna, and gave us the Shabbat, and brought us close to Mount Sinai, and gave us the Torah, and brought us into the land of Israel and built us the 'Chosen House' [the Temple] to atone upon all of our sins.
tokens.transliteration: ahl ah-khaht, kah-mah ve-khah-mah, toh-vah khe-foo-lah oo-me-khoo-peh-leht lah-mah-kohm ah-ley-noo: sheh-hoh-tsee-ah-noo mee-meets-rah-yeem, ve-ah-sah vah-hehm she-fah-teem, ve-ah-sah veh-loh-hey-hehm, ve-hah-rahg eht be-khoh-rey-hehm, ve-nah-tahn lah-noo eht mah-moh-nahm, ve-kah-rah lah-noo eht hah-yahm, ve-heh-eh-vee-rah-noo ve-toh-khoh beh-khah-rah-vah, ve-shee-kah tsah-reh-noo ve-toh-khoh, ve-see-pehk tsohr-keh-noo bah-meed-bahr ahr-bah-eem shah-nah, ve-heh-eh-khee-lah-noo eht hah-mahn, ve-nah-tahn lah-noo eht hah-shah-baht, ve-keh-re-vah-noo leef-ney hahr see-nahy, ve-nah-tahn lah-noo eht hah-toh-rah, ve-heekh-nee-sah-noo le-eh-rehts yees-rah-ehl, oo-vah-nah lah-noo eht beyt hah-be-khee-rah le-khah-pehr ahl kohl ah-voh-noh-tey-noo.

title: Rabban Gamliel's Three Things
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, Rabban Gamliel's Three Things
summary: Rabban Gamliel's Three Things · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: Rabban Gamliel's Three Things · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: רַבָּן גַּמְלִיאֵל הָיָה אוֹמֵר: כָּל שֶׁלֹּא אָמַר שְׁלֹשָׁה דְּבָרִים אֵלּוּ בַּפֶּסַח, לֹא יָצָא יְדֵי חוֹבָתוֹ, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן: פֶּסַח, מַצָּה, וּמָרוֹר.
tokens.translation: Rabban Gamliel was accustomed to say, Anyone who has not said these three things on Pesach has not fulfilled his obligation, and these are them: the Pesach sacrifice, matsa and marror.
tokens.transliteration: rah-bahn gahm-lee-ehl hah-yah oh-mehr: kohl sheh-loh ah-mahr she-loh-shah de-vah-reem eh-loo bah-peh-sahkh, loh yah-tsah ye-dey khoh-vah-toh, ve-eh-loo hehn: peh-sahkh, mah-tsah, oo-mah-rohr.

tokens.hebrew: פֶּסַח שֶׁהָיוּ אֲבוֹתֵינוּ אוֹכְלִים בִּזְמַן שֶׁבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הָיָה קַיָּם, עַל שׁוּם מָה? עַל שׁוּם שֶׁפָּסַח הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עַל בָּתֵּי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם זֶבַח־פֶּסַח הוּא לַייָ, אֲשֶׁר פָּסַח עַל־בָּתֵּי בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּמִצְרַיִם בְּנָגְפּוֹ אֶת־מִצְרַיִם, וְאֶת־בָּתֵּינוּ הִצִּיל, וַיִּקֹּד הָעָם וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ.
tokens.translation: The Pesach [passover] sacrifice that our ancestors were accustomed to eating when the Temple existed, for the sake of what [was it]? For the sake [to commemorate] that the Holy One, blessed be He, passed over the homes of our ancestors in Egypt, as it is stated (Exodus 12:27); "And you shall say: 'It is the passover sacrifice to the Lord, for that He passed over the homes of the Children of Israel in Egypt, when He smote the Egyptians, and our homes he saved.’ And the people bowed the head and bowed."
tokens.transliteration: peh-sahkh sheh-hah-yoo ah-voh-tey-noo oh-khe-leem beez-mahn sheh-beyt hah-meek-dahsh hah-yah kah-yahm, ahl shoom mah? ahl shoom sheh-pah-sahkh hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo ahl bah-tey ah-voh-tey-noo be-meets-rah-yeem, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: vah-ah-mahr-tehm zeh-vahkh peh-sahkh hoo lah-y-yah, ah-shehr pah-sahkh ahl bah-tey ve-ney yees-rah-ehl be-meets-rah-yeem be-nah-ge-poh eht meets-rah-yeem, ve-eht bah-tey-noo hee-tseel, vah-yee-kohd hah-ahm vah-yeesh-tah-khah-voo.

tokens.hebrew: אוחז המצה בידו ומראה אותה למסובין:
tokens.translation: He holds the matsa in his hand and shows it to the others there.

tokens.hebrew: מַצָּה זוֹ שֶׁאָנוּ אוֹכְלִים, עַל שׁוּם מַה? עַל שׁוּם שֶׁלֹּא הִסְפִּיק בְּצֵקָם שֶׁל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ לְהַחֲמִיץ עַד שֶׁנִּגְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם מֶלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, וּגְאָלָם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיֹּאפוּ אֶת־הַבָּצֵק אֲשֶׁר הוֹצִיאוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם עֻגֹת מַצּוֹת, כִּי לֹא חָמֵץ, כִּי גֹרְשׁוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם וְלֹא יָכְלוּ לְהִתְמַהְמֵהַּ, וְגַם־צֵדָה לֹא־עָשׂוּ לָהֶם.
tokens.translation: This matsa that we are eating, for the sake of what [is it]? For the sake [to commemorate] that our ancestors' dough was not yet able to rise, before the King of the kings of kings, the Holy One, blessed be He, revealed [Himself] to them and redeemed them, as it is stated (Exodus 12:39); "And they baked the dough which they brought out of Egypt into matsa cakes, since it did not rise; because they were expelled from Egypt, and could not tarry, neither had they made for themselves provisions."
tokens.transliteration: mah-tsah zoh sheh-ah-noo oh-khe-leem, ahl shoom mahh? ahl shoom sheh-loh hees-peek be-tseh-kahm shehl ah-voh-tey-noo le-hah-khah-meets ahd sheh-neeg-lah ah-ley-hehm meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-me-lah-kheem, hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo, oo-ge-ah-lahm, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: vah-yoh-foo eht hah-bah-tsehk ah-shehr hoh-tsee-oo mee-meets-rah-yeem oo-goht mah-tsoht, kee loh khah-mehts, kee goh-re-shoo mee-meets-rah-yeem ve-loh yah-khe-loo le-heet-mahh-meh-ahh, ve-gahm tseh-dah loh ah-soo lah-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: אוחז המרור בידו ומראה אותו למסובין:
tokens.translation: He holds the marror in his hand and shows it to the others there.

tokens.hebrew: מָרוֹר זֶה שֶׁאָנוּ אוֹכְלִים, עַל שׁוּם מַה? עַל שׁוּם שֶׁמֵּרְרוּ הַמִּצְרִים אֶת־חַיֵּי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּמִצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וַיְמָרְרוּ אֶת־חַיֵּיהם בַּעֲבֹדָה קָשָה, בְּחֹמֶר וּבִלְבֵנִים וּבְכָל־עֲבֹדָה בַּשָּׂדֶה אֶת כָּל עֲבֹדָתָם אֲשֶׁר־עָבְדוּ בָהֶם בְּפָרֶךְ.
tokens.translation: This marror [bitter greens] that we are eating, for the sake of what [is it]? For the sake [to commemorate] that the Egyptians embittered the lives of our ancestors in Egypt, as it is stated (Exodus 1:14); "And they made their lives bitter with hard service, in mortar and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field; in all their service, wherein they made them serve with rigor."
tokens.transliteration: mah-rohr zeh sheh-ah-noo oh-khe-leem, ahl shoom mahh? ahl shoom sheh-meh-re-roo hah-meets-reem eht khah-yey ah-voh-tey-noo be-meets-rah-yeem, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: vah-ye-mah-re-roo eht khah-yeyhm bah-ah-voh-dah kah-shah, be-khoh-mehr oo-veel-veh-neem oo-ve-khohl ah-voh-dah bah-sah-deh eht kohl ah-voh-dah-tahm ah-shehr ah-ve-doo vah-hehm be-fah-rehkh.

tokens.hebrew: בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר חַיָּב אָדָם לִרְאוֹת אֶת־עַצְמוֹ כְּאִלּוּ הוּא יָצָא מִמִּצְרַיִם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְהִגַּדְתָּ לְבִנְךָ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא לֵאמֹר, בַּעֲבוּר זֶה עָשָׂה יְיָ לִי בְּצֵאתִי מִמִּצְרַיִם. לֹא אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בִּלְבַד גָּאַל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא, אֶלָּא אַף אוֹתָנוּ גָּאַל עִמָּהֶם, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר: וְאוֹתָנוּ הוֹצִיא מִשָּׁם, לְמַעַן הָבִיא אוֹתָנוּ, לָתֶת לָנוּ אֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַאֲבֹתֵינוּ.
tokens.translation: In each and every generation, a person is obligated to see himself as if he left Egypt, as it is stated (Exodus 13:8); "And you shall explain to your son on that day: For the sake of this, did the Lord do [this] for me in my going out of Egypt." Not only our ancestors did the Holy One, blessed be He, redeem, but rather also us [together] with them did He redeem, as it is stated (Deuteronomy 6:23); "And He took us out from there, in order to bring us in, to give us the land which He swore unto our fathers."
tokens.transliteration: be-khohl dohr vah-dohr khah-yahv ah-dahm leer-oht eht ahts-moh ke-ee-loo hoo yah-tsah mee-meets-rah-yeem, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: ve-hee-gahd-tah le-veen-khah bah-yohm hah-hoo leh-mohr, bah-ah-voor zeh ah-sah ye-yah lee be-tseh-tee mee-meets-rah-yeem. loh eht ah-voh-tey-noo beel-vahd gah-ahl hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo, eh-lah ahf oh-tah-noo gah-ahl ee-mah-hehm, sheh-neh-eh-mahr: ve-oh-tah-noo hoh-tsee mee-shahm, le-mah-ahn hah-vee oh-tah-noo, lah-teht lah-noo eht hah-ah-rehts ah-shehr neesh-bah lah-ah-voh-tey-noo.

title: First Half of Hallel
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Magid, First Half of Hallel
summary: First Half of Hallel · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: First Half of Hallel · Pesach Haggadah Themes: festivals. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יאחז הכוס בידו ויכסה המצות ויאמר:
tokens.translation: He holds the cup in his hand and and he covers the matsa and says:

tokens.hebrew: לְפִיכָךְ אֲנַחְנוּ חַיָּבִים לְהוֹדוֹת, לְהַלֵּל, לְשַׁבֵּחַ, לְפָאֵר, לְרוֹמֵם, לְהַדֵּר, לְבָרֵךְ, לְעַלֵּה, וּלְקַלֵּס לְמִי שֶׁעָשָׂה לַאֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְלָנוּ אֶת־כָּל־הַנִסִּים הָאֵלּוּ: הוֹצִיאָנוּ מֵעַבְדוּת לְחֵרוּת, מִיָּגוֹן לְשִׂמְחָה, וּמֵאֵבֶל לְיוֹם טוֹב, וּמֵאֲפֵלָה לְאוֹר גָּדוֹל, וּמִשִּׁעְבּוּד לִגְאֻלָּה. וְנֹאמַר לְפָנָיו שִׁירָה חֲדָשָׁה: הַלְלוּ יָהּ.
tokens.translation: Therefore we are obligated to thank, praise, laud, glorify, exalt, lavish, bless, raise high, and acclaim He who made all these miracles for our ancestors and for us: He brought us out from slavery to freedom, from sorrow to joy, from mourning to [celebration of] a festival, from darkness to great light, and from servitude to redemption. And let us say a new song before Him, Halleluyah!
tokens.transliteration: le-fee-khahkh ah-nahkh-noo khah-yah-veem le-hoh-doht, le-hah-lehl, le-shah-beh-ahkh, le-fah-ehr, le-roh-mehm, le-hah-dehr, le-vah-rehkh, le-ah-leh, oo-le-kah-lehs le-mee sheh-ah-sah lah-ah-voh-tey-noo ve-lah-noo eht kohl hah-nee-seem hah-eh-loo: hoh-tsee-ah-noo meh-ahv-doot le-kheh-root, mee-yah-gohn le-seem-khah, oo-meh-eh-vehl le-yohm tohv, oo-meh-ah-feh-lah le-ohr gah-dohl, oo-mee-shee-bood leeg-oo-lah. ve-noh-mahr le-fah-nahv shee-rah khah-dah-shah: hah-le-loo yahh.

tokens.hebrew: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְיָ, הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְיָ. יְהִי שֵׁם יְיָ מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם. מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁמֶשׁ עַד־מְבוֹאוֹ מְהֻלָּל שֵׁם יְיָ. רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְיָ, עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ. מִי כַּייָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ הַמַּגְבִּיהִי לָשָׁבֶת. הַמַּשְׁפִּילִי לִרְאוֹת בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל, מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן. לְהוֹשִׁיבִי עִם־נְדִיבִים, עִם נְדִיבֵי עַמּוֹ. מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת, אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה, הַלְלוּ־יָהּ.
tokens.translation: Halleluyah! Praise, servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord. May the Name of the Lord be blessed from now and forever. From the rising of the sun in the East to its setting, the name of the Lord is praised. Above all nations is the Lord, His honor is above the heavens. Who is like the Lord, our God, Who sits on high; Who looks down upon the heavens and the earth? He brings up the poor out of the dirt; from the refuse piles, He raises the destitute. To seat him with the nobles, with the nobles of his people. He seats a barren woman in a home, a happy mother of children. Halleluyah! (Psalms 113)
tokens.transliteration: hah-le-loo yahh hah-le-loo ahv-dey ye-yah, hah-le-loo eht shehm ye-yah. ye-hee shehm ye-yah me-voh-rahkh meh-ah-tah ve-ahd oh-lahm. mee-meez-rahkh sheh-mehsh ahd me-voh-oh me-hoo-lahl shehm ye-yah. rahm ahl kohl goh-yeem ye-yah, ahl hah-shah-mah-yeem ke-voh-doh. mee kah-y-yah eh-loh-hey-noo hah-mahg-bee-hee lah-shah-veht. hah-mahsh-pee-lee leer-oht bah-shah-mah-yeem oo-vah-ah-rehts. me-kee-mee meh-ah-fahr dahl, meh-ahsh-poht yah-reem ehv-yohn. le-hoh-shee-vee eem ne-dee-veem, eem ne-dee-vey ah-moh. moh-shee-vee ah-keh-reht hah-bah-yeet, ehm hah-bah-neem se-meh-khah, hah-le-loo yahh.

tokens.hebrew: בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרַיִם, בֵּית יַעֲקֹב מֵעַם לֹעֵז. הָיְתָה יְהוּדָה לְקָדְשׁוֹ, יִשְׂרָאֵל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָיו. הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס, הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחוֹר. הֶהָרִים רָקְדוּ כְאֵילִים, גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי צֹאן. מַה־לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס, הַיַּרְדֵּן – תִּסֹּב לְאָחוֹר. הֶהָרִים – תִּרְקְדוּ כְאֵילִים, גְּבָעוֹת כִּבְנֵי־צֹאן. מִלְּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ, מִלְּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב. הַהֹפְכִי הַצּוּר אֲגַם־מָיִם, חַלָּמִיש לְמַעְיְנוֹ־מָיִם.
tokens.translation: In Israel's going out from Egypt, the house of Ya'akov from a people of foreign speech. Yehudah became His -holy one, Israel, His dominion. The Sea saw and fled, the Jordan turned to the rear. The mountains danced like rams, the hills like young sheep. What is happening to you, O Sea, that you are fleeing, O Jordan that you turn to the rear; O mountains that you dance like rams, O hills like young sheep? From before the Master, tremble O earth, from before the Lord of Ya'akov. He who turns the boulder into a pond of water, the flint into a spring of water. (Psalms 114)

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ מֶלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם, אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָנוּ וְגָאַל אֶת־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ מִמִּצְרַיִם, וְהִגִּיעָנוּ הַלַּיְלָה הַזֶּה לֶאֱכָל־בּוֹ מַצָּה וּמָרוֹר. כֵּן יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ יַגִּיעֵנוּ לְמוֹעֲדִים וְלִרְגָלִים אֲחֵרִים הַבָּאִים לִקְרָאתֵנוּ לְשָׁלוֹם, שְׂמֵחִים בְּבִנְיַן עִירֶךָ וְשָׂשִׂים בַּעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ. וְנֹאכַל שָׁם מִן הַזְּבָחִים וּמִן הַפְּסָחִים אֲשֶׁר יַגִּיעַ דָּמָם עַל קִיר מִזְבַּחֲךָ לְרָצוֹן, וְנוֹדֶה לְךָ שִׁיר חָדָש עַל גְּאֻלָּתֵנוּ וְעַל פְּדוּת נַפְשֵׁנוּ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, גָּאַל יִשְׂרָאֵל.
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who redeemed us and redeemed our ancestors from Egypt, and brought us on this night to eat matsa and marror; so too, Lord our God, and God of our ancestors, bring us to other appointed times and holidays that will come to greet us in peace, joyful in the building of Your city and happy in Your worship; that we shall eat there from the offerings and from the Pesach sacrifices, the blood of which shall reach the wall of Your altar for favor, and we shall thank You with a new song upon our redemption and upon the restoration of our souls. Blessed are you, Lord, who redeemed Israel.

tokens.hebrew: מוזגים כוס של אליהו ופותחים את הדלת:
tokens.translation: We pour the cup of Eliyahu and open the door.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁפֹךְ חֲמָתְךָ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְדָעוּךָ וְעַל־מַמְלָכוֹת אֲשֶׁר בְּשִׁמְךָ לֹא קָרָאוּ. כִּי אָכַל אֶת־יַעֲקֹב וְאֶת־נָוֵהוּ הֵשַׁמּוּ. שְׁפָךְ־עֲלֵיהֶם זַעֲמֶךָ וַחֲרוֹן אַפְּךָ יַשִּׂיגֵם. תִּרְדֹף בְּאַף וְתַשְׁמִידֵם מִתַּחַת שְׁמֵי יְיָ.
tokens.translation: Pour your wrath upon the nations that did not know You and upon the kingdoms that did not call upon Your Name! Since they have consumed Ya'akov and laid waste his habitation (Psalms 79:6-7). Pour out Your fury upon them and the fierceness of Your anger shall reach them (Psalms 69:25)! You shall pursue them with anger and eradicate them from under the skies of the Lord (Lamentations 3:66).

title: Songs of Praise and Thanks
sefariaRef: Pesach Haggadah, Hallel, Songs of Praise and Thanks
summary: Songs of Praise and Thanks · Pesach Haggadah
useCase: Songs of Praise and Thanks · Pesach Haggadah Themes: gratitude, festivals, devotion. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: הוֹדוּ לַייָ כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. הוֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְעֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְרוֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. אֶת־הַיָּרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלַּיְלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְמַכֵּה מִצְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וַיּוֹצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְגֹזֵר־יַם סוּף לִגְזָרִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וְהֶעֱבִיר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹכוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם־סוּף כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְמוֹלִיךְ עַמּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְמַכֵּה מְלָכִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וַיַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִים אַדִּירִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וָנָתַן אַרְצָם לְנַחֲלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. שֶׁבְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָכַר לָנוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. וַיִפְרְקֵנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ. הוֹדוּ לְאֵל הַשָּׁמַיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ.
tokens.translation: Thank the Lord, since He is good, since His kindness is forever. Thank the Power of powers since His kindness is forever. To the Master of masters, since His kindness is forever. To the One who alone does wondrously great deeds, since His kindness is forever. To the one who made the Heavens with discernment, since His kindness is forever. To the One who spread the earth over the waters, since His kindness is forever. To the One who made great lights, since His kindness is forever. The sun to rule in the day, since His kindness is forever. The moon and the stars to rule in the night, since His kindness is forever. To the One that smote Egypt through their firstborn, since His kindness is forever. And He took Israel out from among them, since His kindness is forever. With a strong hand and an outstretched forearm, since His kindness is forever. To the One who cut up the Reed Sea into strips, since His kindness is forever. And He made Israel to pass through it, since His kindness is forever. And He jolted Pharaoh and his troop in the Reed Sea, since His kindness is forever. To the One who led his people in the wilderness, since His kindness is forever. To the One who smote great kings, since His kindness is forever. And he killed mighty kings, since His kindness is forever. Sichon, king of the Amorite, since His kindness is forever. And Og, king of the Bashan, since His kindness is forever. And he gave their land as an inheritance, since His kindness is forever. An inheritance for Israel, His servant, since His kindness is forever. That in our lowliness, He remembered us, since His kindness is forever. And he delivered us from our adversaries, since His kindness is forever. He gives bread to all flesh, since His kindness is forever. Thank the Power of the heavens, since His kindness is forever. (Psalms 136)
tokens.transliteration: hoh-doo lah-y-yah kee tohv kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. hoh-doo leh-loh-hey hah-eh-loh-heem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. hoh-doo lah-ah-doh-ney hah-ah-doh-neem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-oh-seh neef-lah-oht ge-doh-loht le-vah-doh kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-oh-seh hah-shah-mah-yeem beet-voo-nah kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-roh-kah hah-ah-rehts ahl hah-mah-yeem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-oh-seh oh-reem ge-doh-leem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. eht hah-sheh-mehsh le-mehm-sheh-leht bah-yohm kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. eht hah-yah-reh-ahkh ve-khoh-khah-veem le-mehm-she-loht bah-lahy-lah kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-mah-keh meets-rah-yeem beev-khoh-rey-hehm kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. vah-yoh-tseh yees-rah-ehl mee-toh-khahm kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. be-yahd khah-zah-kah oo-veez-roh-ah ne-too-yah kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-goh-zehr yahm soof leeg-zah-reem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. ve-heh-eh-veer yees-rah-ehl be-toh-khoh kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. ve-nee-ehr pahr-ohh ve-khey-loh ve-yahm soof kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-moh-leekh ah-moh bah-meed-bahr kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-mah-keh me-lah-kheem ge-doh-leem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. vah-yah-hah-rohg me-lah-kheem ah-dee-reem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. le-see-khohn meh-lehkh hah-eh-moh-ree kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. oo-le-ohg meh-lehkh hah-bah-shahn kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. vah-nah-tahn ahr-tsahm le-nah-khah-lah kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. nah-khah-lah le-yees-rah-ehl ahv-doh kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. sheh-be-sheef-leh-noo zah-khahr lah-noo kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. vah-yeef-re-keh-noo mee-tsah-rey-noo kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. noh-tehn leh-khehm le-khohl bah-sahr kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh. hoh-doo le-ehl hah-shah-mah-yeem kee le-oh-lahm khahs-doh.

tokens.hebrew: נִשְׁמַת כָּל חַי תְּבָרֵךְ אֶת שִׁמְךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְרוּחַ כָּל בָּשָׂר תְּפָאֵר וּתְרוֹמֵם זִכְרְךָ, מַלְכֵּנוּ, תָּמִיד. מִן הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם אַתָּה אֵל, וּמִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ גּוֹאֵל וּמוֹשִיעַ, פּוֹדֶה וּמַצִּיל וּמְפַרְנֵס וּמְרַחֵם בְּכָל עֵת צָרָה וְצוּקָה. אֵין לָנוּ מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּא אַתָּה. אֱלֹהֵי הָרִאשׁוֹנִים וְהָאַחֲרוֹנִים, אֱלוֹהַּ כָּל בְּרִיּוֹת, אֲדוֹן כָּל תּוֹלָדוֹת, הַמְּהֻלָּל בְּרֹב הַתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת, הַמְּנַהֵג עוֹלָמוֹ בְּחֶסֶד וּבְרִיּוֹתָיו בְּרַחֲמִים. וַייָ לֹא יָנוּם וְלא יִישָׁן – הַמְּעוֹרֵר יְשֵׁנִים וְהַמֵּקִיץ נִרְדָּמִים, וְהַמֵּשִׂיחַ אִלְּמִים וְהַמַּתִּיר אֲסוּרִים וְהַסּוֹמֵךְ נוֹפְלִים וְהַזּוֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים. לְךָ לְבַדְּךָ אֲנַחְנוּ מוֹדִים.
tokens.translation: The soul of every living being shall bless Your Name, Lord our God; the spirit of all flesh shall glorify and exalt Your remembrance always, our King. From the world and until the world, You are the Power, and other than You we have no king, redeemer, or savior, restorer, rescuer, provider, and merciful one in every time of distress and anguish; we have no king, besides You! God of the first ones and the last ones, God of all creatures, Master of all Generations, Who is praised through a multitude of praises, Who guides His world with kindness and His creatures with mercy. The Lord neither slumbers nor sleeps. He who rouses the sleepers and awakens the dozers; He who makes the mute speak, and frees the captives, and supports the falling, and straightens the bent. We thank You alone.
tokens.transliteration: neesh-maht kohl khahy te-vah-rehkh eht sheem-khah, ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo, ve-roo-ahkh kohl bah-sahr te-fah-ehr oo-te-roh-mehm zeekh-re-khah, mahl-keh-noo, tah-meed. meen hah-oh-lahm ve-ahd hah-oh-lahm ah-tah ehl, oo-mee-bahl-ah-dey-khah eyn lah-noo meh-lehkh goh-ehl oo-moh-shee-ah, poh-deh oo-mah-tseel oo-me-fahr-nehs oo-me-rah-khehm be-khohl eht tsah-rah ve-tsoo-kah. eyn lah-noo meh-lehkh eh-lah ah-tah. eh-loh-hey hah-ree-shoh-neem ve-hah-ah-khah-roh-neem, eh-loh-ahh kohl be-ree-yoht, ah-dohn kohl toh-lah-doht, hah-me-hoo-lahl be-rohv hah-teesh-bah-khoht, hah-me-nah-hehg oh-lah-moh be-kheh-sehd oo-ve-ree-yoh-tahv be-rah-khah-meem. vah-y-yah loh yah-noom vel yee-shahn – hah-me-oh-rehr ye-sheh-neem ve-hah-meh-keets neer-dah-meem, ve-hah-meh-see-ahkh ee-le-meem ve-hah-mah-teer ah-soo-reem ve-hah-soh-mehkh noh-fe-leem ve-hah-zoh-kehf ke-foo-feem. le-khah le-vah-de-khah ah-nahkh-noo moh-deem.

tokens.hebrew: אִלּוּ פִינוּ מָלֵא שִׁירָה כַיָּם, וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה כֲּהַמוֹן גַּלָּיו, וְשִׂפְתוֹתֵינוּ שֶׁבַח כְּמֶרְחֲבֵי רָקִיעַ, וְעֵינֵינוּ מְאִירוֹת כַּשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְכַיָּרֵחַ, וְיָדֵינוּ פְרוּשׂות כְּנִשְׁרֵי שָׁמַיִם, וְרַגְלֵינוּ קַלּוֹת כָּאַיָּלוֹת – אֵין אֲנַחְנוּ מַסְפִּיקִים לְהוֹדוֹת לְךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, וּלְבָרֵךְ אֶת שִׁמְךָ עַל אַחַת מֵאֶלֶף, אַלְפֵי אֲלָפִים וְרִבֵּי רְבָבוֹת פְּעָמִים הַטּוֹבוֹת שֶׁעָשִׂיתָ עִם אֲבוֹתֵינוּ וְעִמָּנוּ. מִמִּצְרַים גְּאַלְתָּנוּ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וּמִבֵּית עֲבָדִים פְּדִיתָנוּ, בְּרָעָב זַנְתָּנוּ וּבְשָׂבָע כִּלְכַּלְתָּנוּ, מֵחֶרֶב הִצַּלְתָּנוּ וּמִדֶּבֶר מִלַּטְתָּנוּ, וּמֵחֳלָיִם רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים דִּלִּיתָנוּ.
tokens.translation: Were our mouth as full of song as the sea, and our tongue as full of joyous song as its multitude of waves, and our lips as full of praise as the breadth of the heavens, and our eyes as sparkling as the sun and the moon, and our hands as outspread as the eagles of the sky and our feet as swift as deers - we still could not thank You sufficiently, Lord our God and God of our ancestors, and to bless Your Name for one thousandth of the thousand of thousands of thousands, and myriad myriads, of goodnesses that You performed for our ancestors and for us. From Egypt, Lord our God, did you redeem us and from the house of slaves you restored us. In famine You nourished us, and in plenty you sustained us. From the sword you saved us, and from plague you spared us; and from severe and enduring diseases you delivered us.
tokens.transliteration: ee-loo fee-noo mah-leh shee-rah khah-yahm, oo-le-shoh-neh-noo ree-nah kah-hah-mohn gah-lahv, ve-seef-toh-tey-noo sheh-vahkh ke-mehr-khah-vey rah-kee-ah, ve-ey-ney-noo me-ee-roht kah-sheh-mehsh ve-khah-yah-reh-ahkh, ve-yah-dey-noo fe-roosvt ke-neesh-rey shah-mah-yeem, ve-rahg-ley-noo kah-loht kah-ah-yah-loht – eyn ah-nahkh-noo mahs-pee-keem le-hoh-doht le-khah, ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo, oo-le-vah-rehkh eht sheem-khah ahl ah-khaht meh-eh-lehf, ahl-fey ah-lah-feem ve-ree-bey re-vah-voht pe-ah-meem hah-toh-voht sheh-ah-see-tah eem ah-voh-tey-noo ve-ee-mah-noo. mee-meets-rahym ge-ahl-tah-noo, ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo, oo-mee-beyt ah-vah-deem pe-dee-tah-noo, be-rah-ahv zahn-tah-noo oo-ve-sah-vah keel-kahl-tah-noo, meh-kheh-rehv hee-tsahl-tah-noo oo-mee-deh-vehr mee-laht-tah-noo, oo-meh-khoh-lah-yeem rah-eem ve-neh-eh-mah-neem dee-lee-tah-noo.

tokens.hebrew: עַד הֵנָּה עֲזָרוּנוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ וְלֹא עֲזָבוּנוּ חֲסָדֶיךָ, וְאַל תִּטְּשֵׁנוּ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ, לָנֶצַח. עַל כֵּן אֵבָרִים שֶׁפִּלַּגְתָּ בָּנוּ וְרוּחַ וּנְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּפַחְתָּ בְּאַפֵּינוּ וְלָשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר שַׂמְתָּ בְּפִינוּ – הֵן הֵם יוֹדוּ וִיבָרְכוּ וִישַׁבְּחוּ וִיפָאֲרוּ וִירוֹמְמוּ וְיַעֲרִיצוּ וְיַקְדִּישׁוּ וְיַמְלִיכוּ אֶת שִׁמְךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ. כִּי כָל פֶּה לְךָ יוֹדֶה, וְכָל לָשׁוֹן לְךָ תִּשָּׁבַע, וְכָל בֶּרֶךְ לְךָ תִכְרַע, וְכָל קוֹמָה לְפָנֶיךָ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה, וְכָל לְבָבוֹת יִירָאוּךָ, וְכָל קֶרֶב וּכְלָיּוֹת יְזַמֵּרוּ לִשְמֶךָ. כַּדָּבָר שֶׁכָּתוּב, כָּל עַצְמֹתַי תֹּאמַרְנָה, יְיָ מִי כָמוֹךָ מַצִּיל עָנִי מֵחָזָק מִמֶּנוּ, וְעָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן מִגֹּזְלוֹ. מִי יִדְמֶה לָּךְ וּמִי יִשְׁוֶה לָּךְ וּמִי יַעֲרֹךְ לָךְ הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל, הַגִּבּוֹר וְהַנּוֹרָא, אֵל עֶלְיוֹן, קֹנֵה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ. נְהַלֶּלְךָ וּנְשַׁבֵּחֲךָ וּנְפָאֶרְךָ וּנְבָרֵךְ אֶת שֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ, כָּאָמוּר: לְדָוִד, בָּרְכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְיָ וְכָל־קְרָבַי אֶת שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ. הָאֵל בְּתַעֲצֻמוֹת עֻזֶּךָ, הַגָּדוֹל בִּכְבוֹד שְׁמֶךָ, הַגִּבּוֹר לָנֶצַח וְהַנּוֹרָא בְּנוֹרְאוֹתֶיךָ, הַמֶּלֶךְ הַיּוֹשֵׁב עַל כִּסֵּא רָם וְנִשָׂא. שׁוֹכֵן עַד מָרוֹם וְקָדוֹשׁ שְׁמוֹ. וְכָתוּב: רַנְּנוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּייָ, לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה. בְּפִי יְשָׁרִים תִּתְהַלָּל, וּבְדִבְרֵי צַדִּיקִים תִּתְבָּרַךְ, וּבִלְשׁוֹן חֲסִידִים תִּתְרוֹמָם, וּבְקֶרֶב קְדוֹשִׁים תִּתְקַדָּשׁ.
tokens.translation: Until now Your mercy has helped us, and Your kindness has not forsaken us; and do not abandon us, Lord our God, forever. Therefore, the limbs that You set within us and the spirit and soul that You breathed into our nostrils, and the tongue that You placed in our mouth - verily, they shall thank and bless and praise and glorify, and exalt and revere, and sanctify and coronate Your name, our King. For every mouth shall offer thanks to You; and every tongue shall swear allegiance to You; and every knee shall bend to You; and every upright one shall prostrate himself before You; all hearts shall fear You; and all innermost feelings and thoughts shall sing praises to Your name, as the matter is written (Psalms 35:10), "All my bones shall say, ‘Lord, who is like You? You save the poor man from one who is stronger than he, the poor and destitute from the one who would rob him.'" Who is similar to You and who is equal to You and who can be compared to You, O great, strong and awesome Power, O highest Power, Creator of the heavens and the earth. We shall praise and extol and glorify and bless Your holy name, as it is stated (Psalms 103:1), " [A Psalm] of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul; and all that is within me, His holy name." The Power, in Your powerful boldness; the Great, in the glory of Your name; the Strong One forever; the King who sits on His high and elevated throne. He who dwells always; lofty and holy is His name. And as it is written (Psalms 33:10), "Sing joyfully to the Lord, righteous ones, praise is beautiful from the upright." By the mouth of the upright You shall be praised; By the lips of the righteous shall You be blessed; By the tongue of the devout shall You be exalted; And among the holy shall You be sanctified.
tokens.transliteration: ahd heh-nah ah-zah-roo-noo rah-khah-mey-khah ve-loh ah-zah-voo-noo khah-sah-dey-khah, ve-ahl tee-te-sheh-noo, ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo, lah-neh-tsahkh. ahl kehn eh-vah-reem sheh-pee-lahg-tah bah-noo ve-roo-ahkh oo-ne-shah-mah sheh-nah-fahkh-tah be-ah-pey-noo ve-lah-shohn ah-shehr sahm-tah be-fee-noo – hehn hehm yoh-doo vee-vah-re-khoo vee-shah-be-khoo vee-fah-ah-roo vee-roh-me-moo ve-yah-ah-ree-tsoo ve-yahk-dee-shoo ve-yahm-lee-khoo eht sheem-khah mahl-keh-noo. kee khohl peh le-khah yoh-deh, ve-khohl lah-shohn le-khah tee-shah-vah, ve-khohl beh-rehkh le-khah teekh-rah, ve-khohl koh-mah le-fah-ney-khah teesh-tah-khah-veh, ve-khohl le-vah-voht yee-rah-oo-khah, ve-khohl keh-rehv oo-khe-lah-yoht ye-zah-meh-roo leesh-meh-khah. kah-dah-vahr sheh-kah-toov, kohl ahts-moh-tahy toh-mahr-nah, ye-yah mee khah-moh-khah mah-tseel ah-nee meh-khah-zahk mee-meh-noo, ve-ah-nee ve-ehv-yohn mee-goh-ze-loh. mee yeed-meh lahkh oo-mee yeesh-veh lahkh oo-mee yah-ah-rohkh lahkh hah-ehl hah-gah-dohl, hah-gee-bohr ve-hah-noh-rah, ehl ehl-yohn, koh-neh shah-mah-yeem vah-ah-rehts. ne-hah-lehl-khah oo-ne-shah-beh-khah-khah oo-ne-fah-ehr-khah oo-ne-vah-rehkh eht shehm kohd-sheh-khah, kah-ah-moor: le-dah-veed, bah-re-khee nahf-shee eht ye-yah ve-khohl ke-rah-vahy eht shehm kohd-shoh. hah-ehl be-tah-ah-tsoo-moht oo-zeh-khah, hah-gah-dohl beekh-vohd she-meh-khah, hah-gee-bohr lah-neh-tsahkh ve-hah-noh-rah be-noh-re-oh-tey-khah, hah-meh-lehkh hah-yoh-shehv ahl kee-seh rahm ve-nee-sah. shoh-khehn ahd mah-rohm ve-kah-dohsh she-moh. ve-khah-toov: rah-ne-noo tsah-dee-keem bah-y-yah, lahy-shah-reem nah-vah te-hee-lah. be-fee ye-shah-reem teet-hah-lahl, oo-ve-deev-rey tsah-dee-keem teet-bah-rahkh, oo-veel-shohn khah-see-deem teet-roh-mahm, oo-ve-keh-rehv ke-doh-sheem teet-kah-dahsh.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְמַקְהֲלוֹת רִבְבוֹת עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִנָּה יִתְפָּאֵר שִׁמְךָ, מַלְכֵּנוּ, בְּכָל דּוֹר וָדוֹר, שֶׁכֵּן חוֹבַת כָּל הַיְצוּרִים לְפָנֶיךָ, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, לְהוֹדוֹת לְהַלֵּל לְשַׁבֵּחַ, לְפָאֵר לְרוֹמֵם לְהַדֵּר לְבָרֵךְ, לְעַלֵּה וּלְקַלֵּס עַל כָּל דִּבְרֵי שִׁירוֹת וְתִשְׁבְּחוֹת דָּוִד בֶּן יִשַׁי עַבְדְּךָ מְשִׁיחֶךָ.
tokens.translation: And in the assemblies of the myriads of Your people, the House of Israel, in joyous song will Your name be glorified, our King, in each and every generation; as it is the duty of all creatures, before You, Lord our God, and God of our ancestors, to thank, to praise, to extol, to glorify, to exalt, to lavish, to bless, to raise high and to acclaim - beyond the words of the songs and praises of David, the son of Yishai, Your servant, Your anointed one.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-mahk-hah-loht reev-voht ah-me-khah beyt yees-rah-ehl be-ree-nah yeet-pah-ehr sheem-khah, mahl-keh-noo, be-khohl dohr vah-dohr, sheh-kehn khoh-vaht kohl hah-ye-tsoo-reem le-fah-ney-khah, ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo, le-hoh-doht le-hah-lehl le-shah-beh-ahkh, le-fah-ehr le-roh-mehm le-hah-dehr le-vah-rehkh, le-ah-leh oo-le-kah-lehs ahl kohl deev-rey shee-roht ve-teesh-be-khoht dah-veed behn yee-shahy ahv-de-khah me-shee-kheh-khah.

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁתַּבַּח שִׁמְךָ לָעַד מַלְכֵּנוּ, הָאֵל הַמֶלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ, כִּי לְךָ נָאֶה, יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, שִׁיר וּשְׁבָחָה, הַלֵּל וְזִמְרָה, עֹז וּמֶמְשָׁלָה, נֶצַח, גְּדֻלָּה וּגְבוּרָה, תְּהִלָּה וְתִפְאֶרֶת, קְדֻשָּׁה וּמַלְכוּת, בְּרָכוֹת וְהוֹדָאוֹת מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, אֵל מֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל בַּתִּשְׁבָּחוֹת, אֵל הַהוֹדָאוֹת, אֲדוֹן הַנִפְלָאוֹת, הַבּוֹחֵר בְּשִׁירֵי זִמְרָה, מֶלֶךְ אֵל חֵי הָעוֹלָמִים.
tokens.translation: May Your name be praised forever, our King, the Power, the Great and holy King - in the heavens and in the earth. Since for You it is pleasant - O Lord our God and God of our ancestors - song and lauding, praise and hymn, boldness and dominion, triumph, greatness and strength, psalm and splendor, holiness and kingship, blessings and thanksgivings, from now and forever. Blessed are You Lord, Power, King exalted through laudings, Power of thanksgivings, Master of Wonders, who chooses the songs of hymn - King, Power of the life of the worlds.
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-tah-bahkh sheem-khah lah-ahd mahl-keh-noo, hah-ehl hah-meh-lehkh hah-gah-dohl ve-hah-kah-dohsh bah-shah-mah-yeem oo-vah-ah-rehts, kee le-khah nah-eh, ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo, sheer oo-she-vah-khah, hah-lehl ve-zeem-rah, ohz oo-mehm-shah-lah, neh-tsahkh, ge-doo-lah oo-ge-voo-rah, te-hee-lah ve-teef-eh-reht, ke-doo-shah oo-mahl-khoot, be-rah-khoht ve-hoh-dah-oht meh-ah-tah ve-ahd oh-lahm. bah-rookh ah-tah ye-yah, ehl meh-lehkh gah-dohl bah-teesh-bah-khoht, ehl hah-hoh-dah-oht, ah-dohn hah-neef-lah-oht, hah-boh-khehr be-shee-rey zeem-rah, meh-lehkh ehl khey hah-oh-lah-meem.

tokens.hebrew: חֲסַל סִדּוּר פֶּסַח כְּהִלְכָתוֹ, כְּכָל מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וְחֻקָּתוֹ. כַּאֲשֶׁר זָכִינוּ לְסַדֵּר אוֹתוֹ כֵּן נִזְכֶּה לַעֲשׂוֹתוֹ. זָךְ שׁוֹכֵן מְעוֹנָה, קוֹמֵם קְהַל עֲדַת מִי מָנָה. בְּקָרוֹב נַהֵל נִטְעֵי כַנָּה פְּדוּיִם לְצִיּוֹן בְּרִנָּה.
tokens.translation: Completed is the Seder of Pesach according to its law, according to all its judgement and statute. Bring close, lead the plantings of the sapling, redeemed, to Zion in joy.

tokens.translation: Since for Him it is pleasant, for Him it is suited.

tokens.hebrew: אַדִּיר בִּמְלוּכָה, בָּחוּר כַּהֲלָכָה, גְּדוּדָיו יֹאמְרוּ לוֹ: לְךָ וּלְךָ, לְךָ כִּי לְךָ, לְךָ אַף לְךָ, לְךָ יְיָ הַמַּמְלָכָה, כִּי לוֹ נָאֶה, כִּי לוֹ יָאֶה.
tokens.translation: Mighty in rulership, properly chosen, his troops shall say to Him, "Yours and Yours, Yours since it is Yours, Yours and even Yours, Yours, Lord is the kingdom; since for Him it is pleasant, for Him it is suited."

tokens.hebrew: אַדִּיר הוּא יִבְנֶה בֵיתוֹ בְּקָרוֹב. בִּמְהֵרָה, בִּמְהֵרָה, בְּיָמֵינוּ בְּקָרוֹב. אֵל בְּנֵה, אֵל בְּנֵה, בְּנֵה בֵיתְךָ בְּקָרוֹב.

tokens.hebrew: אֶחָד מִי יוֹדֵעַ? אֶחָד אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. שְׁנַיִם מִי יוֹדֵעַ? שְׁנַיִם אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית. אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. שְׁלֹשָׁה מִי יוֹדֵעַ? שְׁלֹשָׁה אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: שְׁלֹשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. אַרְבַּע מִי יוֹדֵעַ? אַרְבַּע אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: אַרְבַּע אִמָּהוֹת, שְׁלשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. חֲמִשָּׁה מִי יוֹדֵעַ? חֲמִשָּׁה אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה, אַרְבַּע אִמָּהוֹת, שְׁלשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. שִׁשָּׂה מִי יוֹדֵעַ? שִׁשָּׂה אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: שִׁשָּׁה סִדְרֵי מִשְׁנָה, חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה, אַרְבַּע אִמָּהוֹת, שְׁלֹשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. שִׁבְעָה מִי יוֹדֵעַ? שִׁבְעָה אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: שִׁבְעָה יְמֵי שַׁבָּתָא, שִׁשָּׁה סִדְרֵי מִשְׁנָה, חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה, אַרְבַּע אִמָּהוֹת, שְׁלשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. שְׁמוֹנָה מִי יוֹדֵעַ? שְׁמוֹנָה אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: שְׁמוֹנָה יְמֵי מִילָה, שִׁבְעָה יְמֵי שַׁבָּתָא, שִׁשָּׁה סִדְרֵי מִשְׁנָה, חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה, אַרְבַּע אִמָּהוֹת, שְׁלשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. תִּשְׁעָה מִי יוֹדֵעַ? אַחַד עָשָׂר אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ: אַחַד עָשָׂר כּוֹכְבַיָּא, עֲשָׂרָה דִבְּרַיָא, תִּשְׁעָה יַרְחֵי לֵדָה, שְׁמוֹנָה יְמֵי מִילָה, שִׁבְעָה יְמֵי שַׁבָּתָא, שִׁשָּׁה סִדְרֵי מִשְׁנָה, חֲמִשָּׁה חוּמְשֵׁי תוֹרָה, אַרְבַּע אִמָּהוֹת, שְׁלשָׁה אָבוֹת, שְׁנֵי לֻחוֹת הַבְּרִית, אֶחָד אֱלֹהֵינוּ שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ. שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר מִי יוֹדֵעַ? tokens.translation: Who knows one? I know one: One is our God in the heavens and the earth. Who knows two? I know three: three are the fathers, two are the tablets of the covenant, One is our God in the heavens and the earth. Who knows four? I know four: four are the mothers, three are the fathers, two are the tablets of the covenant, One is our God in the heavens and the earth. Who knows five? I know five: five are the books of the Torah, four are the mothers, three are the fathers, two are the tablets of the covenant, One is our God in the heavens and the earth. Who knows six? tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּֽנוּ עַל נְטִילַת יָדָֽיִם:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning the washing of hands.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo meh-lehkh hah-oh-lahm ah-shehr kee-de-shah-noo be-meets-voh-tahv ve-tsee-vah-noo ahl ne-tee-laht yah-dah-yeem:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר יָצַר אֶת הָאָדָם בְּחָכְמָה וּבָֽרָא בוֹ נְקָבִים נְקָבִים חֲלוּלִים חֲלוּלִים גָּלוּי וְיָדֽוּעַ לִפְנֵי כִסֵּא כְבוֹדֶֽךָ שֶׁאִם יִפָּתֵֽחַ אֶחָד מֵהֶם אוֹ יִסָּתֵם אֶחָד מֵהֶם אִי אֶפְשַׁר לְהִתְקַיֵּם וְלַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲפִילוּ שָׁעָה אֶחָת. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה רוֹפֵא כָל בָּשָׂר וּמַפְלִיא לַעֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God, King of the Universe, Who formed man with wisdom and created within him openings and hollows. It is obvious and known in the presence of Your glorious throne that if one of them were ruptured, or if one of them were blocked, it would be impossible to exist and stand in Your Presence even for a short while. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who heals all flesh and performs wonders.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo meh-lehkh hah-oh-lahm ah-shehr yah-tsahr eht hah-ah-dahm be-khohkh-mah oo-vah-rah voh ne-kah-veem ne-kah-veem khah-loo-leem khah-loo-leem gah-looy ve-yah-doo-ah leef-ney khee-seh khe-voh-deh-khah sheh-eem yee-pah-teh-ahkh eh-khahd meh-hehm oh yee-sah-tehm eh-khahd meh-hehm ee ehf-shahr le-heet-kah-yehm ve-lah-ah-mohd le-fah-ney-khah ah-fee-loo shah-ah eh-khaht. bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI roh-feh khohl bah-sahr oo-mahf-lee lah-ah-soht:

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי, נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַֽתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא אַתָּה בְרָאתָהּ אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּהּ אַתָּה נְפַחְתָּהּ בִּי וְאַתָּה מְשַׁמְּרָהּ בְּקִרְבִּי וְאַתָּה עָתִיד לִטְּלָהּ מִמֶּֽנִּי וּלְהַחֲזִירָהּ בִּי לֶעָתִיד לָבֹא, כָּל זְמַן שֶׁהַנְּשָׁמָה בְקִרְבִּי מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהַי וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי רִבּוֹן כָּל הַמַּעֲשִׂים אֲדוֹן כָּל הַנְּשָׁמוֹת: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמַּחֲזִיר נְשָׁמוֹת לִפְגָרִים מֵתִים:
tokens.translation: My God! the soul which You bestowed in me is pure; You created it, You formed it, You breathed it into me and You preserve it within me. You will eventually take it from me, and restore it in me in the time to come. So long as the soul is within me I give thanks to You, Adonoy my God, and God of my fathers, Lord of all creatures, Master of all souls. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Who restores souls to dead bodies.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר קִדְּשָֽׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתָיו וְצִוָּֽנוּ לַעֲסֹק בְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy, our God, King of the Universe, Who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us to be engrossed in the words of Torah.
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo meh-lehkh hah-oh-lahm ah-shehr kee-de-shah-noo be-meets-voh-tahv ve-tsee-vah-noo lah-ah-sohk be-deev-rey toh-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְהַעֲרֶב נָא יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָתְךָ בְּפִֽינוּ וּבְפִי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְנִהְיֶה אֲנַֽחְנוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵֽינוּ וְצֶאֱצָאֵי עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל כֻּלָּֽנוּ יוֹדְעֵי שְׁמֶֽךָ וְלוֹמְדֵי תוֹרָתֶֽךָ לִשְׁמָהּ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה הַמְלַמֵּד תּוֹרָה לְעַמּוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל:
tokens.translation: Adonoy our God, please make pleasant the words of Your Torah in our mouths and in the mouths of Your people Yisrael. And may we and our descendants and the descendants of Your people the House of Yisrael, all be perceivers of Your Name and students of Your Torah for its own sake. Blessed are You, Adonoy Who teaches Torah to His people, Yisrael.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-ah-rehv nah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo eht deev-rey toh-rah-te-khah be-fee-noo oo-ve-fee ah-me-khah beyt yees-rah-ehl ve-neeh-yeh ahnah-khe-noo ve-tseh-eh-tsah-ey-noo ve-tseh-eh-tsah-ey ah-me-khah beyt yees-rah-ehl koo-lah-noo yoh-de-ey she-meh-khah ve-loh-me-dey toh-rah-teh-khah leesh-mahh: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI hah-me-lah-mehd toh-rah le-ah-moh yees-rah-ehl:

tokens.hebrew: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ מֶֽלֶךְ הָעוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר בָּֽחַר בָּֽנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים וְנָֽתַן לָֽנוּ אֶת תּוֹרָתוֹ: בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְהֹוָה נוֹתֵן הַתּוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: Blessed are You, Adonoy our God, King of the Universe Who chose us from among all the peoples and gave us His Torah. Blessed are You, Adonoy, Giver of the Torah!
tokens.transliteration: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI eh-loh-hey-noo meh-lehkh hah-oh-lahm ah-shehr bah-khahr bah-noo mee-kohl hah-ah-meem ve-nah-tahn lah-noo eht toh-rah-toh: bah-rookh ah-tah ah-doh-NAI noh-tehn hah-toh-rah:

tokens.hebrew: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהֹוָה וְיִשְׁמְרֶֽךָ: יָאֵר יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶֽיךָ וִיחֻנֶּֽךָּ: יִשָּׂא יְהֹוָה פָּנָיו אֵלֶֽיךָ וְיָשֵׂם לְךָ שָׁלוֹם:
tokens.translation: May Adonoy bless you and guard you. May Adonoy shine His countenance upon you and be gracious unto you. May Adonoy turn His countenance toward you and grant you peace.
tokens.transliteration: ye-vah-rehkh-khah ah-doh-NAI ve-yeesh-me-reh-khah: yah-ehr ah-doh-NAI pah-nahv eh-ley-khah vee-khoo-neh-kah: yee-sah ah-doh-NAI pah-nahv eh-ley-khah ve-yah-sehm le-khah shah-lohm:

tokens.hebrew: אֵֽלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאֵין לָהֶם שִׁעוּר הַפֵּאָה וְהַבִּכּוּרִים וְהָרְאָיוֹן וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה:
tokens.translation: These are precepts for which no fixed measure is prescribed: [leaving] the corner [of a field unharvested], [the offering of] the first fruits, the appearance-offering, [performing] deeds of kindness, and the study of Torah.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loo de-vah-reem sheh-eyn lah-hehm shee-oor hah-peh-ah ve-hah-bee-koo-reem ve-hah-re-ah-yohn oo-ge-mee-loot khah-sah-deem ve-tahl-mood toh-rah:

tokens.hebrew: אֵֽלּוּ דְבָרִים שֶׁאָדָם אוֹכֵל פֵּרוֹתֵיהֶם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְהַקֶּֽרֶן קַיֶּֽמֶת לוֹ לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא, וְאֵֽלּוּ הֵן כִּבּוּד אָב וָאֵם וּגְמִילוּת חֲסָדִים וְהַשְׁכָּמַת בֵּית הַמִּדְרָשׁ שַׁחֲרִית וְעַרְבִית וְהַכְנָסַת אוֹרְחִים וּבִקּוּר חוֹלִים וְהַכְנָסַת כַּלָּה וּלְוָיַת הַמֵּת וְעִיּוּן תְּפִלָּה וַהֲבָאַת שָׁלוֹם בֵּין אָדָם לַחֲבֵרוֹ וְתַלְמוּד תּוֹרָה כְּנֶֽגֶד כֻּלָּם:
tokens.translation: These are precepts, the fruits of which man enjoys in this world, [while] the principal [reward] is preserved for him in the World-to-Come. They are: honoring father and mother, [performing] deeds of kindness, early attendance in the House of Study morning and evening, providing hospitality to guests, visiting the sick, participating in making a wedding, accompanying the dead [to the grave], concentrating on the meaning of prayers, making peace between fellow men and the study of Torah is equal to them all.

title: Mourner's Kaddish
sefariaRef: Machzor Rosh Hashanah Ashkenaz, The Morning Prayers, Mourner's Kaddish
summary: Mourner's Kaddish · Machzor Rosh Hashanah Ashkenaz
useCase: Mourner's Kaddish · Machzor Rosh Hashanah Ashkenaz Themes: grief, festivals, devotion, daily. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יִתְגַּדַּל וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְמָא דִּי בְרָא כִרְעוּתֵהּ וְיַמְלִיךְ מַלְכוּתֵהּ בְּחַיֵּיכוֹן וּבְיוֹמֵיכוֹן וּבְחַיֵּי דְכָל בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל, בַּעֲגָלָא וּבִזְמַן קָרִיב וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן: יְהֵא שְׁמֵהּ רַבָּא מְבָרַךְ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא: יִתְבָּרַךְ וְיִשְׁתַּבַּח וְיִתְפָּאַר וְיִתְרוֹמַם וְיִתְנַשֵּׂא וְיִתְהַדָּר וְיִתְעַלֶּה וְיִתְהַלָּל שְׁמֵהּ דְקוּדְשָׁא, בְּרִיךְ הוּא לְעֵֽלָּא וּלְעֵֽלָּא מִכָּל בִּרְכָתָא וְשִׁירָתָא, תֻּשְׁבְּחָתָא וְנֶחֱמָתָא, דַּאֲמִירָן בְּעָלְמָא, וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן: יְהֵא שְׁלָמָא רַבָּא מִן שְׁמַיָּא וְחַיִּים עָלֵֽינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן: עוֹשֶׂה הַשָּׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן:
tokens.translation: Exalted and sanctified be His great Name in the world which He created according to His will; and may He rule His Kingdom in your lifetime and in your days, and in the lifetime of the entire House of Yisrael, speedily and in the near future— and say Amein. May His great Name be blessed forever and for all eternity. Blessed and praised, glorified, and exalted and uplifted, honored and elevated and extolled be the Name of the Holy One, blessed is He; far above all the blessings and hymns, praises and consolations which we utter in the world—and say Amein. May there be abundant peace from heaven and life for us and for all Yisrael, —and say Amein. He Who makes the peace in His high heavens may He, make peace for us and or all Yisrael, and say, Amein.
tokens.transliteration: yeet-gah-dahl ve-yeet-kah-dahsh she-meh rah-bah be-ah-le-mah dee ve-rah kheer-oo-teh ve-yahm-leekh mahl-khoo-teh be-khah-yey-khohn oo-ve-yoh-mey-khohn oo-ve-khah-yey de-khahl beyt yees-rah-ehl, bah-ah-gah-lah oo-veez-mahn kah-reev ve-eem-roo ah-mehn: ye-heh she-meh rah-bah me-vah-rahkh le-ah-lahm oo-le-ah-le-mey ah-le-mah-yah: yeet-bah-rahkh ve-yeesh-tah-bahkh ve-yeet-pah-ahr ve-yeet-roh-mahm ve-yeet-nah-seh ve-yeet-hah-dahr ve-yeet-ah-leh ve-yeet-hah-lahl she-meh de-koo-de-shah, be-reekh hoo le-eh-lah oo-le-eh-lah mee-kohl beer-khah-tah ve-shee-rah-tah, toosh-be-khah-tah ve-neh-kheh-mah-tah, dah-ah-mee-rahn be-ah-le-mah, ve-eem-roo ah-mehn: ye-heh she-lah-mah rah-bah meen she-mah-yah ve-khah-yeem ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn: oh-seh hah-shah-lohm beem-roh-mahv hoo yah-ah-seh shah-lohm ah-ley-noo ve-ahl kohl yees-rah-ehl ve-eem-roo ah-mehn:
