tokens.hebrew: לְךָ אֲדֹנָי הַצְּדָקָה וְלָנוּ בֹּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים. מַה־נִּתְאוֹנֵן וּמַה־נֹּאמַר. מַה־נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה נִּצְטַדָּק: נַחְפְּשָׂה דְּרָכֵינוּ וְנַחְקֹרָה וְנָשׁוּבָה אֵלֶיךָ. כִּי יְמִינְךָ פְּשׁוּטָה לְקַבֵּל שָׁבִים: לֹא־בְחֶסֶד וְלֹא־בְמַעֲשִׂים בָּאנוּ לְפָנֶיךָ. כְּדַלִּים וּכְרָשִׁים דָּפַקְנוּ דְּלָתֶיךָ: דְּלָתֶיךָ דָּפַקְנוּ רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן. נָא אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ רֵיקָם מִלְּפָנֶיךָ: מִלְּפָנֶיךָ מַלְכֵּנוּ רֵיקָם אַל־תְּשִׁיבֵנוּ. כִּי אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ תְּפִלָּה:
tokens.translation: Righteousness is Yours, Adonoy while shame is ours. How can we complain? What can we say? What can we speak? And how can we justify ourselves? Let us search into our ways and examine them, and return to You; for Your right hand is extended to receive those who repent. Not with virtue nor with good deeds do we come before You, but like the poor and needy we knock at Your door. At Your door, do we knock, Merciful and Gracious One. Please do not turn us away empty-handed from Your Presence. From Your Presence our King turn us not away empty-handed; for You hear [our] prayers.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-nahy hah-tse-dah-kah ve-lah-noo boh-sheht hah-pah-neem. mahh neet-oh-nehn oo-mahh noh-mahr. mahh ne-dah-behr oo-mahh neets-tah-dahk: nahkh-pe-sah de-rah-khey-noo ve-nahkh-koh-rah ve-nah-shoo-vah eh-ley-khah. kee ye-mee-ne-khah pe-shoo-tah le-kah-behl shah-veem: loh ve-kheh-sehd ve-loh ve-mah-ah-seem bah-noo le-fah-ney-khah. ke-dah-leem oo-khe-rah-sheem dah-fahk-noo de-lah-tey-khah: de-lah-tey-khah dah-fahk-noo rah-khoom ve-khah-noon. nah ahl te-shee-veh-noo rey-kahm mee-le-fah-ney-khah: mee-le-fah-ney-khah mahl-keh-noo rey-kahm ahl te-shee-veh-noo. kee ah-tah shoh-meh-ah te-fee-lah:

tokens.hebrew: שֹׁמֵֽעַ תְּפִלָּה, עָדֶֽיךָ כָּל בָּשָׂר יָבֹֽאוּ: יָבוֹא כָל בָּשָׂר לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֹת לְפָנֶיךָ יְהֹוָה: יָבֽוֹאוּ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְפָנֶֽיךָ אֲדֹנָי, וִיכַבְּדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ: בֹּֽאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה. נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי יְהֹוָה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ: בֹּֽאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה, חֲצֵרוֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה. הֽוֹדוּ לוֹ בָּרְכוּ שְׁמוֹ: וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּרֹב חַסְדְּךָ נָבוֹא בֵיתֶֽךָ. נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל־קָדְשְׁךָ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ: הִנֵּה בָּרְכוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה כָּל עַבְדֵי יְהֹוָה הָעוֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהֹוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת: שְׂאוּ יְדֵיכֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ, וּבָרְכוּ אֶת יְהֹוָה: נָבוֹאָה לְמִשְׁכְּנוֹתָיו, נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו: רוֹמְמוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו. קָדוֹשׁ הוּא: רוֹמְמוּ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ, וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ. כִּי קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהֹוָה בְּהַדְרַת קֹֽדֶשׁ, חִֽילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל הָאָֽרֶץ: נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ, וְנוֹדֶה אֶת שְׁמֶךָ עַל חַסְדְךָ וְעַל אֲמִתֶּֽךָ. כִּי הִגְדַּֽלְתָּ עַל כָּל שִׁמְךָ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ: יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵי צְבָאוֹת, מִי כָמֽוֹךָ חֲסִין יָהּ. וֶאֱמוּנָתְךָ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ: כִּי מִי בַשַּֽׁחַק יַעֲרֹךְ לַיהֹוָה, יִדְמֶה לַיהֹוָה בִּבְנֵי אֵלִים: כִּי גָדוֹל אַתָּה וְעֹשֶׂה נִפְלָאוֹת, אַתָּה אֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶּֽךָ: כִּי גָדוֹל מֵעַל שָׁמַֽיִם חַסְדֶּֽךָ, וְעַד שְׁחָקִים אֲמִתֶּֽךָ: גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵֽקֶר: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד, נוֹרָא הוּא עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה, וּמֶֽלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל כָּל אֱלֹהִים: אֲשֶׁר מִי אֵל בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ, אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽיךָ: מִי לֹא יִרָאֲךָ מֶֽלֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם, כִּי לְךָ יָאָֽתָה. כִּי בְכָל חַכְמֵי הַגּוֹיִם וּבְכָל מַלְכוּתָם, מֵאֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ: מֵאֵין כָּמֽוֹךָ יְהֹוָה. גָּדוֹל אַתָּה, וְגָדוֹל שִׁמְךָ בִּגְבוּרָה: לְךָ זְרֽוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָה. תָּעֹז יָדְךָ, תָּרוּם יְמִינֶֽךָ: לְךָ יוֹם אַף לְךָ לָֽיְלָה. אַתָּה הֲכִינֽוֹתָ מָאוֹר וָשָֽׁמֶשׁ: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי אָֽרֶץ, וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהֹוָה, יַשְׁמִֽיעַ כָּל תְּהִלָּתוֹ: לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת וְהַנֵּֽצַח וְהַהוֹד, כִּי כֹּל בַּשָּׁמַֽיִם וּבָאָֽרֶץ. לְךָ יְהֹוָה הַמַּמְלְכָה, וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ: לְךָ שָׁמַֽיִם, אַף לְךָ אָֽרֶץ תֵּבֵל וּמְלֹאָהּ אַתָּה יְסַדְתָּם: אַתָּה הִצַּֽבְתָּ כָּל גְּבוּלוֹת אָֽרֶץ. קַֽיִץ וָחֹֽרֶף אַתָּה יְצַרְתָּם: אַתָּה רִצַּֽצְתָּ רָאשֵׁי לִוְיָתָן, תִּתְּנֶֽנוּ מַאֲכָל לְעַם לְצִיִּים: אַתָּה בָקַעְתָּ מַעְיָן וָנָֽחַל, אַתָּה הוֹבַֽשְׁתָּ נַהֲרוֹת אֵיתָן: אַתָּה פוֹרַרְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ יָם, שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ רָאשֵׁי תַנִּינִים עַל הַמָּֽיִם: אַתָּה מוֹשֵׁל בְּגֵאוּת הַיָּם, בְּשׂוֹא גַלָּיו אַתָּה תְשַׁבְּחֵם: גָּדוֹל יְהֹוָה וּמְהֻלָל מְאֹד, בְּעִיר אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ הַר קָדְשׁוֹ: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל ישֵׁב הַכְּרֻבִים, אַתָּה הוּא הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַדֶֽךָ: אֵל נַעֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדוֹשִׁים רַבָּה, וְנוֹרָא עַל כָּל סְבִיבָיו: וְיוֹדוּ שָׁמַֽיִם פִּלְאֲךָ יְהֹוָה, אַף אֱמוּנָתְךָ בִּקְהַל קְדשִׁים: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהֹוָה, נָרִֽיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה, בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִֽיעַ לוֹ: צֶֽדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאֶֽךָ, חֶסֶד וֶאֱמֶת יְקַדְּמוּ פָנֶֽיךָ: אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד, בְּבֵית אֱלֹהִים נְהַלֵּךְ בְּרָֽגֶשׁ: אֲשֶׁר לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָֽׂהוּ, וְיַבֶּֽשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָֽרוּ: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ נֶֽפֶשׁ כָּל חָי, וְרֽוּחַ כָּל בְּשַׂר אִישׁ: הַנְּשָׁמָה לָךְ, וְהַגּוּף פָּעֳלָךָ חוּסָה עַל עֲמָלָךְ: הַנְּשָׁמָה לָךְ, וְהַגּוּף שֶׁלָּךְ. יְהֹוָה עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: אָֽתָאנוּ עַל שִׁמְךָ. יְהֹוָה, עֲשֵׂה לְמַֽעַן שְׁמֶֽךָ: בַּעֲבוּר כְבוֹד שִׁמְךָ, כִּי אֵל חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם שְׁמֶֽךָ: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ יְהֹוָה. וְסָלַחְתָּ לַעֲו‍ֹנֵֽנוּ, כִּי רַב הוּא:
tokens.translation: You Who hears prayer, unto You does all flesh come. All flesh shall come to prostrate themselves before You, Adonoy. They will come and prostrate themselves before You, my Master and they will give honor to Your Name. Come let us prostrate ourselves and bow; let us kneel before Adonoy, our Maker. Enter His gates with thanksgiving, His courtyards with praise, give thanks to Him, bless His Name. As for us, through Your abundant kindness we will enter Your House; we will prostrate ourselves toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You. Behold, bless Adonoy— all [you] servants of Adonoy, who stand in the House of Adonoy in the night. Lift your hands to the Sanctuary and bless Adonoy. Let us come to His Dwelling Places, let us prostrate ourselves at His footstool. Exalt Adonoy, our God, and prostrate yourselves at His footstool, Holy is He! Exalt Adonoy, our God and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain, for Adonoy our God is holy. Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy in the splendor of holiness, tremble before Him all [peoples of] the earth. We will prostrate ourselves toward Your Holy Sanctuary, and give thanks to Your Name for Your kindness and for Your truth; for You have magnified Your word far beyond Your Name. Adonoy, God of Hosts, who is like You, a mighty God; and Your faithfulness is round about You. For who in the skies can be compared to Adonoy, who can be likened to Adonoy among the sons of the mighty? For You are great and do wondrous things; You alone are God. For great beyond the heavens is Your kindness, and until the skies is Your truth. Great is Adonoy and highly extolled, and His greatness is unfathomable. For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled, and awesome is He above all gods. For a great Almighty is Adonoy and a great King over all gods. For who is so mighty in heaven or on earth that can duplicate Your works and Your power. Who would not fear You, King of nations? For to You it is fitting; for among all the wise ones of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You. There is none like You, Adonoy great are You, and great is Your Name in might. Yours is an arm with might strong is Your hand, exalted is Your right hand. Yours is the day, also Yours is the night, You established [the] luminary and [the] sun. For in His hands are the depths of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are His. Who can recount the mighty deeds of Adonoy, or cause to be heard all His praise? Yours Adonoy is the greatness, the might, the glory, the victory and the beauty, for all that is in heaven and on earth [is Yours]; Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom, and You are uplifted over all rulers. Yours are the heavens, also Yours is the earth, the inhabited world and its fullness; You have founded them. You set all the borders of the earth, summer and winter, You formed them. You crushed the heads of Leviathan, You gave him as food to the people of legions. You split open the fountain and brook, You dried up mighty rivers. You crumbled the sea with Your strength; You shattered the heads of sea monsters upon the waters. You rule over the majesty of the sea; when it raises its waves, You still them. Great is Adonoy and highly extolled in the city of our God, the mountain of His Sanctuary. Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel, enthroned upon the cherubim You alone are God. The Almighty is revered in the great council of the holy ones and is awe inspiring over all that are about Him. And the heavens will praise Your wonders, Adonoy, and Your faithfulness [will be praised] in the assembly of holy ones. Come let us sing to Adonoy, let us sound the shofar to the Rock of our deliverance. Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving, with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him. Righteousness and justice are the foundations of Your throne, kindness and truth precede Your Presence. For together let us take sweet counsel; into the House of God let us walk with the throngs. For the sea is His, and He made it; and the dry land, His hands formed. For in His hand is the soul of every living thing, and the spirit of all human flesh. The soul is Yours, and the body is Your doing, have pity on Your work. The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours, Adonoy! Act [on our behalf] for the sake of Your Name. We have come [relying] on Your Name, Adonoy! Act [on our behalf] for the sake of Your Name. For the sake of the glory of Your Name, for gracious and merciful Almighty is Your Name, For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy, pardon our iniquity, for it is great.

title: First Day
sefariaRef: Selichot Nusach Lita Linear, First Day.2
summary: First Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear
useCase: First Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear Themes: repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Righteousness is Yours, Adonoy
while shame is ours.
How can we complain?
What can we say?
What can we speak?
And how can we justify ourselves?
Let us search into our ways and examine them,
and return to You;
for Your right hand is extended
to receive those who repent.
Not with virtue nor with good deeds
do we come before You,
but like the poor and needy
we knock at Your door.
At Your door, do we knock,
Merciful and Gracious One.
Please do not turn us away empty-handed
from Your Presence.
From Your Presence our King
turn us not away empty-handed;
for You hear [our] prayers.
You Who hears prayer,
unto You does all flesh come.
All flesh shall come
to prostrate themselves before You, Adonoy.
They will come and prostrate themselves
before You, my Master
and they will give honor to Your Name.
Come let us prostrate ourselves and bow;
let us kneel before Adonoy, our Maker.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving,
His courtyards with praise,
give thanks to Him, bless His Name.
As for us, through Your abundant kindness
we will enter Your House;
we will prostrate ourselves
toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You.
Behold, bless Adonoy—
all [you] servants of Adonoy,
who stand in the House of Adonoy
in the night.
Lift your hands to the Sanctuary
and bless Adonoy.
Let us come to His Dwelling Places,
let us prostrate ourselves at His footstool.
Exalt Adonoy, our God,
and prostrate yourselves at His footstool,
Holy is He!
Exalt Adonoy, our God
and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain,
for Adonoy our God is holy.
Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
in the splendor of holiness,
tremble before Him all [peoples of] the earth.
We will prostrate ourselves
toward Your Holy Sanctuary,
and give thanks to Your Name
for Your kindness and for Your truth;
for You have magnified
Your word far beyond Your Name.
Adonoy, God of Hosts,
who is like You, a mighty God;
and Your faithfulness is round about You.
For who in the skies
can be compared to Adonoy,
who can be likened to Adonoy
among the sons of the mighty?
For You are great
and do wondrous things;
You alone are God.
For great beyond the heavens
is Your kindness,
and until the skies is Your truth.
Great is Adonoy and highly extolled,
and His greatness is unfathomable.
For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled,
and awesome is He above all gods.
For a great Almighty is Adonoy
and a great King over all gods.
For who is so mighty in heaven or on earth
that can duplicate Your works
and Your power.
Who would not fear You, King of nations?
For to You it is fitting;
for among all the wise ones of the nations,
and in all their kingdoms,
there is none like You.
There is none like You, Adonoy
great are You,
and great is Your Name in might.
Yours is an arm with might
strong is Your hand, exalted is Your right hand.
Yours is the day, also Yours is the night,
You established [the] luminary and [the] sun.
For in His hands are the depths of the earth,
and the heights of the mountains are His.
Who can recount the mighty deeds of Adonoy,
or cause to be heard all His praise?
Yours Adonoy
is the greatness, the might, the glory,
the victory and the beauty,
for all that is in heaven and on earth [is Yours];
Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom,
and You are uplifted over all rulers.
Yours are the heavens,
also Yours is the earth,
the inhabited world and its fullness;
You have founded them.
You set all the borders of the earth,
summer and winter, You formed them.
You crushed the heads of Leviathan,
You gave him as food to the people of legions.
You split open the fountain and brook,
You dried up mighty rivers.
You crumbled the sea with Your strength;
You shattered the heads of sea monsters
upon the waters.
You rule over the majesty of the sea;
when it raises its waves, You still them.
Great is Adonoy and highly extolled
in the city of our God,
the mountain of His Sanctuary.
Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel,
enthroned upon the cherubim
You alone are God.
The Almighty is revered
in the great council of the holy ones
and is awe inspiring
over all that are about Him.
And the heavens will praise Your wonders,
Adonoy,
and Your faithfulness [will be praised]
in the assembly of holy ones.
Come let us sing to Adonoy,
let us sound the shofar
to the Rock of our deliverance.
Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving,
with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him.
Righteousness and justice
are the foundations of Your throne,
kindness and truth precede Your Presence.
For together let us take sweet counsel;
into the House of God
let us walk with the throngs.
For the sea is His, and He made it;
and the dry land, His hands formed.
For in His hand
is the soul of every living thing,
and the spirit of all human flesh.
The soul is Yours,
and the body is Your doing,
have pity on Your work.
The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours,
Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
for the sake of Your Name.
We have come [relying] on Your Name,
Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
for the sake of Your Name.
For the sake of the glory of Your Name,
for gracious and merciful Almighty
is Your Name,
For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy,
pardon our iniquity, for it is great.
Pardon us our Father,
because of our great foolishness,
we have sinned.
Forgive us our King,
for our iniquity is great.

title: First Day

useCase: First Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear Themes: repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Remember not the sins of our ancestors;
let Your compassion come swiftly toward us,
for we have been brought very low.
The sins of our youth and our transgressions,
remember not;
with Your kindliness remember us
for the sake of Your goodness, Adonoy.
Remember Your mercies, Adonoy,
and kindlinesses
for they are from the beginning of the world.
Remember us Adonoy
with favor for Your people
recall us with Your deliverance.
Remember Your congregation
which You have acquired of old,
You have redeemed the tribe
of Your inheritance,
this mountain of Zion where You have dwelled.
Remember, Adonoy, the affection of Jerusalem,
the love of Zion, forget not until eternity.
Remember, Adonoy,
to the sons of Edom, the day of Jerusalem,
[it was they] who said,
“Raze it, raze it to its very foundations.”
You will arise
and have compassion on Zion,
for it is time to be gracious to her,
for the appointed time has come.
Remember Abraham, Isaac, Israel,
Your servants,
to whom You swore by Your very Self,
and You said to them:
“I will multiply your seed
as the stars of the heavens;
and all this land that I have promised,
I will give to your descendants,
and they will inherit it forever.”
Remember Your servants,
Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob;

tokens.hebrew: אַל תֵּֽפֶן אֶל קְשִׁי הָעָם הַזֶּה
tokens.translation: do not regard the stubborness of this people,
tokens.transliteration: ahl teh-fehn ehl ke-shee hah-ahm hah-zeh

tokens.translation: or their wickedness, or their sin.
Do not, we beseech You
place upon us this sin,
wherein we have acted foolishly and sinned.
We have sinned, our Rock;
pardon us our Creator.
Remember to us the covenant of the Patriarchs,
as You promised,
“And I will remember my covenant with Jacob,
and also my covenant with Isaac,
and also my covenant with Abraham
will I remember,”
and the land I will remember.
Remember to us the covenant of the ancestors,
as You promised,
“And I will remember for their sake,
the covenant with their ancestors,
whom I brought out
of the land of Egypt,
in the sight of the nations;
to be their God
I am Adonoy.”
Do unto us as You promised,
“And yet for all that,
when they are in the land of their enemies,
I will not reject them
and I will not abhor them, to destroy them,
to annul My covenant with them;
for I am Adonoy, their God.”
Be accessible to us when we seek You,
as it is written:
“And from there
you will seek Adonoy, your God,
and you will find Him;
if you search after Him
with all your heart
and with all your soul.”
Open our hearts
to love Your Name,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“And Adonoy, your God will open your heart,
and the heart of your descendants,
to love Adonoy, your God,
with all your heart,
and with all your soul,
that you may live.”
Sprinkle clean water upon us,
and cleanse us, as it is written:
“And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
and you will be clean;
from all your defilements,
and from all your idols,
I will cleanse you.”
Sweep aside our transgressions
as a thick cloud and as a mist,
as You have promised:
“I have swept away like a thick cloud
your transgressions,
and like a mist, your sins;
return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
as You promised:
“I, I [alone] am He
Who blots out your transgressions
for My own sake;
and your sins, I will not recall.”
Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
as it is written:
“Come now, let us reason together,
says Adonoy,
though your sins be as scarlet,
they shall be as white as snow;
though they be red as crimson,
they shall become [white] as wool.”
Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
as it is written:
“For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
your God;
He will not abandon you or destroy you,
and He will not forget
the covenant of your fathers
which He swore to them.”
Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
“If your dispersed
are in the farthermost part of heaven,
from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
and from there He will take you.”
Bring back our captivity
and have compassion on us,
as it is written:
“And Adonoy, your God will return
your captivity and have compassion on you;
and He will again gather you
from [among] all the peoples,
where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
Bring us to Your holy mountain,
and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
as it is written:
“And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
will be accepted with favor on My Altar,
for My House,
will be called a House of Prayer
for all peoples.”

title: First Day
sefariaRef: Selichot Nusach Lita Linear, First Day.9
summary: First Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear
useCase: First Day · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear Themes: repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Merciful Almighty is Your Name,
Gracious Almighty is Your Name.
Upon us is Your Name called,
Adonoy! act [now] for the sake of Your Name.
Act for the sake of Your truth.
Act for the sake of Your covenant.
Act for the sake of Your greatness and glory.
Act for the sake of Your Law.
Act for the sake of Your glorious majesty.
Act for the sake of Your congregation.
Act for the sake of Your memorial.
Act for the sake of Your kindliness.
Act for the sake of Your goodness.
Act for the sake of Your Unity.
Act for the sake of Your honor.
Act for the sake of Your teaching.
Act for the sake of Your kingship.
Act for the sake of Your eternity.
Act for the sake of Your counsel.
Act for the sake of Your strength.
Act for the sake of Your magnificence.
Act for the sake of Your righteousness.
Act for the sake of Your holiness.
Act for the sake of Your abundant mercy.
Act for the sake of Your Divine Presence.
Act for the sake of Your praise.
Act for the sake of Your beloved ones,
who repose in the dust.
Act for the sake of Abraham, Isaac,
and Jacob.
Act for the sake of Moses and Aaron.
Act for the sake of David and Solomon.
Act for the sake of Jerusalem,
city of Your holiness.
Act for the sake of Zion,
Dwelling Place of Your honor.
Act for the sake of the desolation
of Your Habitation.
Act for the sake of the destruction
of Your Altar.
Act for the sake of the blood
of Your servants that was spilled.
Act for the sake of those who were slain
to sanctify Your holy Name.
Act for the sake of those who were slaughtered
for [proclaiming] Your Oneness.
Act for the sake of those
who went through fire and water
to sanctify Your Name.
Act for the sake of nursing-infants
who have never sinned.
Act for the sake of weaned-children
who have never transgressed.
Act
for the sake of “Yeshiva”-children.
Act for Your sake and not ours.
Act for Your sake and deliver us.
Answer us, Adonoy, answer us!
Answer us, our God, answer us!
Answer us, our Father, answer us.
Answer us, our Creator, answer us.
Answer us, our Redeemer, answer us.
Answer us, our Seeker, answer us.
Answer us, faithful Almighty, answer us.
Answer us, steadfast and benevolent One,
answer us.
Answer us, pure and upright One, answer us.
Answer us, living and permanent One,
answer us.
Answer us, good and beneficent One,
answer us.
Answer us, Knower of our inclination,
answer us.
Answer us, Suppressor of Anger, answer us.
Answer us, One enrobed in righteousness,
answer us.
Answer us, Supreme King of kings, answer us.
Answer us, awesome and exalted One,
answer us.
Answer us, Pardoner and Forgiver, answer us.
Answer us, You Who answer in time of distress,
answer us.
Answer us, Redeemer and Saver, answer us.
Answer us, just and upright One, answer us.
Answer us,
He Who is near to those who call upon Him,
answer us.
Answer us, merciful and gracious One,
answer us.
Answer us, You Who listen to the needy,
answer us.
Answer us, Supporter of the innocent,
answer us.
Answer us, God of our fathers, answer us.
Answer us, God of Abraham, answer us.
Answer us, Fear of Isaac, answer us.
Answer us, Mighty One of Jacob, answer us.
Answer us, Helper of the Tribes, answer us.
Answer us, Stronghold of the Matriarchs,
answer us.
Answer us, Whom it is hard to provoke,
answer us.
Answer us, You Who are easily reconciled,
answer us.
Answer us, You Who answer at a favorable time,
answer us.
Answer us, Father of orphans, answer us.
Answer us, [Protective] Judge of widows,
answer us.
He Who answered our father Abraham
on Mount Moriah, He will answer us.
He Who answered Isaac, his son,
when he was bound on the altar,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Jacob in Beth El,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Joseph
in prison,
He will answer us.
He Who answered our ancestors at
the Reed Sea,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Moses at Horeb,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Aaron with the incense pan,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Pinchos
when he rose from among the congregation,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Joshua at Gilgal,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Samuel at Mizpah,
He will answer us.
He Who answered David,
and Solomon, his son, in Jerusalem,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Elijah on Mount Carmel,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Elisha in Jericho,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Jonah
in the belly of the whale,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Hezekiah,
King of Judah, in his illness,
He will answer us.
He Who answered
Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah
in the midst of the fiery furnace,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Daniel
in the lions’ den,
He will answer us.
He Who answered Mordecai and Esther
in Shushan, the capital [city of Persia],
He will answer us.
He Who answered Ezra in captivity,
He will answer us.
He Who answered
all the righteous, the pious,
the perfect and the upright,
He will answer us.
May the Merciful One, Who answers the poor,
answer us.
May the Merciful One
Who answers the broken-hearted,
answer us.
May the Merciful One
Who answers the broken in spirit,
answer us.
Merciful One, answer us;
Merciful One, have pity;
Merciful One, redeem, Merciful One, save,
Merciful One, have compassion on us,
now, speedily, and very soon.
And David said to Gad (II Samuel 24:14),
“I am greatly distressed;
let us fall into the hand of Adonoy
for His mercies are great,
but into the hand of man let me not fall.
Merciful and gracious One
I have sinned before You;
Adonoy, full of mercy,
have compassion upon me
and accept my supplications.
Adonoy, do not rebuke me with Your anger,
nor chastise me with Your rage.
Be gracious unto me, Adonoy,
for I am desolate,
help me Adonoy, for my bones are terrified.
My soul, too, is utterly terrified,
and You Adonoy, how long?
Return Adonoy, free my soul,
deliver me for the sake of Your lovingkindness.
For in death there is no mention of You;
in the lower world who will thank You.
I am worn out with my sighing,
every night I cause my bed to float;
with my tears, I melt my couch.
My eye is dimmed from anger,
it has aged because of my tormentors.
Depart from me, all you evildoers,
for Adonoy has heard the voice of my weeping.
Adonoy has heard my supplication,
Adonoy will (also) accept my prayer.
Ashamed and utterly terrified
will all my foes be,
they will return
and be instantaneously ashamed.

tokens.transliteration: ahl teh-fehn ehl ke-shee hah-ahm hah-zeh

tokens.translation: or their wickedness, or their sin.
Do not, we beseech You
place upon us this sin,
wherein we have acted foolishly and sinned.
We have sinned, our Rock;
pardon us our Creator.
Remember to us the covenant of the Patriarchs,
as You promised,
“And I will remember my covenant with Jacob,
and also my covenant with Isaac,
and also my covenant with Abraham
will I remember,”
and the land I will remember.
Remember to us the covenant of the ancestors,
as You promised,
“And I will remember for their sake,
the covenant with their ancestors,
whom I brought out
of the land of Egypt,
in the sight of the nations;
to be their God
I am Adonoy.”
Do unto us as You promised,
“And yet for all that,
when they are in the land of their enemies,
I will not reject them
and I will not abhor them, to destroy them,
to annul My covenant with them;
for I am Adonoy, their God.”
Be accessible to us when we seek You,
as it is written:
“And from there
you will seek Adonoy, your God,
and you will find Him;
if you search after Him
with all your heart
and with all your soul.”
Open our hearts
to love Your Name,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“And Adonoy, your God will open your heart,
and the heart of your descendants,
to love Adonoy, your God,
with all your heart,
and with all your soul,
that you may live.”
Sprinkle clean water upon us,
and cleanse us, as it is written:
“And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
and you will be clean;
from all your defilements,
and from all your idols,
I will cleanse you.”
Sweep aside our transgressions
as a thick cloud and as a mist,
as You have promised:
“I have swept away like a thick cloud
your transgressions,
and like a mist, your sins;
return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
as You promised:
“I, I [alone] am He
Who blots out your transgressions
for My own sake;
and your sins, I will not recall.”
Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
as it is written:
“Come now, let us reason together,
says Adonoy,
though your sins be as scarlet,
they shall be as white as snow;
though they be red as crimson,
they shall become [white] as wool.”
Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
as it is written:
“For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
your God;
He will not abandon you or destroy you,
and He will not forget
the covenant of your fathers
which He swore to them.”
Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
“If your dispersed
are in the farthermost part of heaven,
from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
and from there He will take you.”
Bring back our captivity
and have compassion on us,
as it is written:
“And Adonoy, your God will return
your captivity and have compassion on you;
and He will again gather you
from [among] all the peoples,
where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
Bring us to Your holy mountain,
and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
as it is written:
“And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
will be accepted with favor on My Altar,
for My House,
will be called a House of Prayer
for all peoples.”

tokens.translation: Hear, Israel,
Adonoy is our God,
Adonoy is one.
Our King! We come before You
with the power of Your Unity,
for we have nothing [else]
with which to greet You
but with [our acceptance of] Your Kingdom
and [recognition] of Your deeds.
Therefore, with the whole heart
we will express Your Unity.
We will express Your Unity together,
old and young.
Please erase our writs of guilt,
and inscribe in the Book of Life
our remembrance,
and decree now
that our years be for good.
Hear, Israel,
Adonoy is our God,
Adonoy is one.
The chosen [nation] that You redeemed
with trial, tests and miracles
in Your Name they find protection
and the Sh’ma they read with blessings.
These [nations] with chariots
and others with horses.
But, we, [however]
trust in the Name of Adonoy, our God.
We carry [the Name of God]
with fear, trepidation, and trembling.
Strengthen them against the nations
and support them,
as promised in Your holy word:
“They will kneel and fall
and we will rise and be strengthened.
Hear, Israel,
Adonoy is our God,
Adonoy is one.
The Inside Services have come to an end
[so, too, the Service of] the goats of atonement.
And the priest is no more
to placate the anger [of God],
and we have been left
like the heart of a woman
who is in fear of her labor pains,
we depend on that which was said:
“Adonoy will answer you
on the day of distress.”
When affliction comes to Jacob,
this one [the righteous] says:
“I am for Adonoy” without deceit
and the other one [the unrighteous]
proclaim that they are of Jacob,
and they all depend on the promise
that the God of Jacob [will redeem them].
Hear, Israel,
Adonoy is our God,
Adonoy is one.
We are called by Your name
[You Who are] abundant in deeds.
Turn towards us to our cries
and accept our prayers.
And remove from us our evil deeds
You the Holy One
Who sits [awaiting] praises [of Israel].
You Who awaits praises!
Awaken those who slumber
in darkness amongst the nations.
Redeem them and cleanse them of their stains,
Almighty, King
Who sits on the throne of compassion.
Do unto us as You promised,
“And yet for all that,
when they are in the land of their enemies,
I will not reject them
and I will not abhor them, to destroy them,
to annul My covenant with them;
for I am Adonoy, their God.”
Be accessible to us when we seek You,
as it is written:
“And from there
you will seek Adonoy, your God,
and you will find Him;
if you search after Him
with all your heart
and with all your soul.”
Open our hearts
to love Your Name,
as it is written in Your Torah:
“And Adonoy, your God will open your heart,
and the heart of your descendants,
to love Adonoy, your God,
with all your heart,
and with all your soul,
that you may live.”
Sprinkle clean water upon us,
and cleanse us, as it is written:
“And I will sprinkle clean water upon you,
and you will be clean;
from all your defilements,
and from all your idols,
I will cleanse you.”
Sweep aside our transgressions
as a thick cloud and as a mist,
as You have promised:
“I have swept away like a thick cloud
your transgressions,
and like a mist, your sins;
return to Me, for I have redeemed You.”
Blot out our transgressions for Your sake,
as You promised:
“I, I [alone] am He
Who blots out your transgressions
for My own sake;
and your sins, I will not recall.”
Make our sins as white as snow or wool,
as it is written:
“Come now, let us reason together,
says Adonoy,
though your sins be as scarlet,
they shall be as white as snow;
though they be red as crimson,
they shall become [white] as wool.”
Have compassion on us and do not destroy us,
as it is written:
“For an Almighty of mercy is Adonoy,
your God;
He will not abandon you or destroy you,
and He will not forget
the covenant of your fathers
which He swore to them.”
Gather our dispersed ones, as it is written:
“If your dispersed
are in the farthermost part of heaven,
from there Adonoy, your God will gather you,
and from there He will take you.”

and have compassion on us,
as it is written:
“And Adonoy, your God will return
your captivity and have compassion on you;
and He will again gather you
from [among] all the peoples,
where Adonoy, your God has scattered you.”
Bring us to Your holy mountain,
and make us joyful in Your House of Prayer,
as it is written:
“And I will bring them to My holy mountain,
and make them joyful in My House of Prayer;
their burnt-offerings and sacrifices
will be accepted with favor on My Altar,

will be called a House of Prayer

title: Fast of Gedaliah
sefariaRef: Selichot Nusach Lita Linear, Fast of Gedaliah.2
summary: Fast of Gedaliah · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear
useCase: Fast of Gedaliah · Selichot Nusach Lita Linear Themes: repentance. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Righteousness is Yours, Adonoy
while shame is ours.
How can we complain?
What can we say?
What can we speak?
And how can we justify ourselves?
Let us search into our ways and examine them,
and return to You;
for Your right hand is extended
to receive those who repent.
Not with virtue nor with good deeds
do we come before You,
but like the poor and needy
we knock at Your door.
At Your door, do we knock,
Merciful and Gracious One.
Please do not turn us away empty-handed
from Your Presence.
From Your Presence our King
turn us not away empty-handed;
for You hear [our] prayers.
You Who hears prayer,
unto You does all flesh come.
All flesh shall come
to prostrate themselves before You, Adonoy.
They will come and prostrate themselves
before You, my Master
and they will give honor to Your Name.
Come let us prostrate ourselves and bow;
let us kneel before Adonoy, our Maker.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving,
His courtyards with praise,
give thanks to Him, bless His Name.
As for us, through Your abundant kindness
we will enter Your House;
we will prostrate ourselves
toward Your Holy Sanctuary in awe of You.
Behold, bless Adonoy—
all [you] servants of Adonoy,
who stand in the House of Adonoy
in the night.
Lift your hands to the Sanctuary
and bless Adonoy.
Let us come to His Dwelling Places,
let us prostrate ourselves at His footstool.
Exalt Adonoy, our God,
and prostrate yourselves at His footstool,
Holy is He!
Exalt Adonoy, our God
and prostrate yourselves at His holy mountain,
for Adonoy our God is holy.
Prostrate yourselves before Adonoy
in the splendor of holiness,
tremble before Him all [peoples of] the earth.
We will prostrate ourselves
toward Your Holy Sanctuary,
and give thanks to Your Name
for Your kindness and for Your truth;
for You have magnified
Your word far beyond Your Name.
Adonoy, God of Hosts,
who is like You, a mighty God;
and Your faithfulness is round about You.
For who in the skies
can be compared to Adonoy,
who can be likened to Adonoy
among the sons of the mighty?
For You are great
and do wondrous things;
You alone are God.
For great beyond the heavens
is Your kindness,
and until the skies is Your truth.
Great is Adonoy and highly extolled,
and His greatness is unfathomable.
For great is Adonoy and most highly extolled,
and awesome is He above all gods.
For a great Almighty is Adonoy
and a great King over all gods.
For who is so mighty in heaven or on earth
that can duplicate Your works
and Your power.
Who would not fear You, King of nations?
For to You it is fitting;
for among all the wise ones of the nations,
and in all their kingdoms,
there is none like You.
There is none like You, Adonoy
great are You,
and great is Your Name in might.
Yours is an arm with might
strong is Your hand, exalted is Your right hand.
Yours is the day, also Yours is the night,
You established [the] luminary and [the] sun.
For in His hands are the depths of the earth,
and the heights of the mountains are His.
Who can recount the mighty deeds of Adonoy,
or cause to be heard all His praise?
Yours Adonoy
is the greatness, the might, the glory,
the victory and the beauty,
for all that is in heaven and on earth [is Yours];
Yours Adonoy, is the kingdom,
and You are uplifted over all rulers.
Yours are the heavens,
also Yours is the earth,
the inhabited world and its fullness;
You have founded them.
You set all the borders of the earth,
summer and winter, You formed them.
You crushed the heads of Leviathan,
You gave him as food to the people of legions.
You split open the fountain and brook,
You dried up mighty rivers.
You crumbled the sea with Your strength;
You shattered the heads of sea monsters
upon the waters.
You rule over the majesty of the sea;
when it raises its waves, You still them.
Great is Adonoy and highly extolled
in the city of our God,
the mountain of His Sanctuary.
Adonoy of Hosts, God of Israel,
enthroned upon the cherubim
You alone are God.
The Almighty is revered
in the great council of the holy ones
and is awe inspiring
over all that are about Him.
And the heavens will praise Your wonders,
Adonoy,
and Your faithfulness [will be praised]
in the assembly of holy ones.
Come let us sing to Adonoy,
let us sound the shofar
to the Rock of our deliverance.
Let us greet His Presence with thanksgiving,
with hymns let us raise our voices unto Him.
Righteousness and justice
are the foundations of Your throne,
kindness and truth precede Your Presence.
For together let us take sweet counsel;
into the House of God
let us walk with the throngs.
For the sea is His, and He made it;
and the dry land, His hands formed.
For in His hand
is the soul of every living thing,
and the spirit of all human flesh.
The soul is Yours,
and the body is Your doing,
have pity on Your work.
The soul is Yours, and the body is Yours,
Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
for the sake of Your Name.
We have come [relying] on Your Name,
Adonoy! Act [on our behalf]
for the sake of Your Name.
For the sake of the glory of Your Name,
for gracious and merciful Almighty
is Your Name,
For the sake of Your Name, Adonoy,
pardon our iniquity, for it is great.
Pardon us our Father,
because of our great foolishness,
we have sinned.
Forgive us our King,
for our iniquity is great.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.1
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: בִּתְפִלָּתִי יִסְכָּן־גָּבֶר. כִּי בָהּ יִלְמַד יֹשֶׁר וּזְכוּת:
tokens.translation: May this my prayer aid mankind The path of right and worth to find;
tokens.transliteration: beet-fee-lah-tee yees-kahn gah-vehr. kee vahh yeel-mahd yoh-shehr oo-ze-khoot:

tokens.hebrew: סִפַּרְתִּי בָהּ פִּלְאֵי אֵל חַי בִּקְצָרָה אַךְ לֹא בַאֲרִיכוּת:
tokens.translation: The living God, His wondrous ways, Herein inspire my song of praise.
tokens.transliteration: see-pahr-tee vahh peel-ey ehl khahy beek-tsah-rah ahkh loh vah-ah-ree-khoot:

tokens.hebrew: שַׂמְתִּיהָ עַל רֹאשׁ מַהֲלָלַי. וּקְרָאתִיהָ כֶּתֶר מַלְכוּת:
tokens.translation: Nor is the theme at undue length set down, Of all my hymns behold "The Royal Crown."
tokens.transliteration: sahm-tee-hah ahl rohsh mah-hah-lah-lahy. oo-ke-rah-tee-hah keh-tehr mahl-khoot:

tokens.translation: Wonderful are thy works, as my soul overwhelmingly knoweth.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יְיָ הַגְּדֻלָּה וְהַגְּבוּרָה וְהַתִּפְאֶרֶת וְהַנֵּצַח וְהַהוֹד.
tokens.translation: Thine, O Lord, are the greatness and the might, the beauty, the triumph, and the splendour.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ye-yah hah-ge-doo-lah ve-hah-ge-voo-rah ve-hah-teef-eh-reht ve-hah-neh-tsahkh ve-hah-hohd.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יְיָ הַמַּמְלָכָה וְהַמִּתְנַשֵּׂא לְכֹל לְרֹאשׁ וְהָעֹשֶׁר וְהַכָּבוֹד:
tokens.translation: Thine, O Lord, is the Kingdom, and Thou art exalted as head over all. Thine are all riches and honour:
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ye-yah hah-mahm-lah-khah ve-hah-meet-nah-seh le-khohl le-rohsh ve-hah-oh-shehr ve-hah-kah-vohd:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ בְּרוּאֵי מַעְלָה וּמַטָּה יָעִידוּ כִּי הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד:
tokens.translation: Thine the creatures of the heights and depths. They bear witness that they perish, while Thou endurest.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah be-roo-ey mah-lah oo-mah-tah yah-ee-doo kee heh-mah yoh-veh-doo ve-ah-tah tah-ah-mohd:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַגְּבוּרָה אֲשֶׁר בְּסוֹדָהּ נִלְאוּ רַעְיוֹנֵינוּ לַעֲמֹד. כִּי עָצַמְתָּ מִמֶּנּוּ מְאֹד:
tokens.translation: Thine is the might in whose mystery our thoughts can find no stay, so far art Thou beyond us.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah hah-ge-voo-rah ah-shehr be-soh-dahh neel-oo rah-yoh-ney-noo lah-ah-mohd. kee ah-tsahm-tah mee-meh-noo me-ohd:

tokens.translation: In Thee is the veiled retreat of power, the secret and the foundation.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַשֵּׁם הַנֶּעְלָם מִמְּתֵי חָכְמָה. וְהַכֹּחַ הַסּוֹבֵל הָעוֹלָם עַל בְּלִימָה. וְהַיְכֹלֶת לְהוֹצִיא לָאוֹר כָּל תַּעֲלוּמָה:
tokens.translation: Thine is the name concealed from the sages, The force that sustaineth the world on naught, And that can bring to light every hidden thing.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah hah-shehm hah-neh-lahm mee-me-tey khohkh-mah. ve-hah-koh-ahkh hah-soh-vehl hah-oh-lahm ahl be-lee-mah. ve-hah-ye-khoh-leht le-hoh-tsee lah-ohr kohl tah-ah-loo-mah:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַחֶסֶד אֲשֶׁר גָּבַר עַל בְּרוּאֶיךָ. וְהַטּוֹב הַצָּפוּן לִירֵאֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: Thine is the loving-kindness that ruleth over all Thy creatures, And the good treasured up for those who fear Thee.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah hah-kheh-sehd ah-shehr gah-vahr ahl be-roo-ey-khah. ve-hah-tohv hah-tsah-foon lee-reh-ey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַסּוֹדוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא יְכִילֵם שֵׂכֶל וְרַעְיוֹן. וְהַחַיִּים אֲשֶׁר לֹא יִשְׁלַט עֲלֵיהֶם כִּלָּיוֹן. וְהַכִּסֵּא הַנַּעֲלֶה עַל כָּל עֶלְיוֹן. וְהַנָּוֶה הַנִּסְתָּר בְּרוּם חֶבְיוֹן:
tokens.translation: Thine are the mysteries that transcend understanding and thought. Thine is the life over which extinction holdeth no sway, And Thy throne is exalted above every sovereignty, And Thy habitation hidden in the shrouded height.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah hah-soh-doht ah-shehr loh ye-khee-lehm seh-khehl ve-rah-yohn. ve-hah-khah-yeem ah-shehr loh yeesh-laht ah-ley-hehm kee-lah-yohn. ve-hah-kee-seh hah-nah-ah-leh ahl kohl ehl-yohn. ve-hah-nah-veh hah-nees-tahr be-room khehv-yohn:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַמְּצִיאוּת אֲשֶׁר מִצֵּל מְאוֹרוֹ נִהְיָה כָּל הֹוֶה. אֲשֶׁר אָמַרְנוּ בְּצִלּוֹ נִחְיֶה:
tokens.translation: Thine is the existence from the shadow of whose light every being was created, Of which we say, in His shadow we live.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah hah-me-tsee-oot ah-shehr mee-tsehl me-oh-roh neeh-yah kohl hoh-veh. ah-shehr ah-mahr-noo be-tsee-loh neekh-yeh:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ שְׁנֵי הָעוֹלָמִים אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ בֵּינֵיהֶם גְּבוּל. הָרִאשׁוֹן לְמַעֲשִׂים וְהַשֵּׁנִי לִגְמוּל:
tokens.translation: Thine are the two worlds between which Thou hast set a boundary, The first for deeds and the second for reward.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah she-ney hah-oh-lah-meem ah-shehr nah-tah-tah bey-ney-hehm ge-vool. hah-ree-shohn le-mah-ah-seem ve-hah-sheh-nee leeg-mool:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ הַגְּמוּל אֲשֶׁר גָּנַזְתָּ לַצַּדִּיקִים וַתַּעֲלִימֵהוּ. וַתֵּרֶא אוֹתוֹ כִּי טוֹב הוּא וַתִּצְפְּנֵהוּ:
tokens.translation: Thine is the reward which Thou for the righteous hast stored up and hidden, Yea, Thou sawest it was goodly and didst hide it.
tokens.transliteration: le-khah hah-ge-mool ah-shehr gah-nahz-tah lah-tsah-dee-keem vah-tah-ah-lee-meh-hoo. vah-teh-reh oh-toh kee tohv hoo vah-teets-pe-neh-hoo:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. רֹאשׁ כָּל מִנְיָן. וִיסוֹד כָּל בִּנְיָן:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, the first of every number, and the foundation of every structure,
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-khahd. rohsh kohl meen-yahn. vee-sohd kohl been-yahn:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וּבְסוֹד אַחְדוּתְךָ חַכְמֵי לֵב יִתְמָהוּ. כִּי לֹא יָדְעוּ מַה הוּא:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, and at the mystery of Thy Oneness the wise of heart are struck dumb, For they know not what it is.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-khahd. oo-ve-sohd ahkh-doo-te-khah khahkh-mey lehv yeet-mah-hoo. kee loh yah-de-oo mahh hoo:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וְאַחְדוּתְךָ לֹא יִגְרַע וְלֹא יוֹסִיף. לֹא יֶחְסַר וְלֹא יַעְדִּיף:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, and Thy Oneness can neither be increased nor lessened, It lacketh naught, nor doth aught remain over.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-khahd. ve-ahkh-doo-te-khah loh yeeg-rah ve-loh yoh-seef. loh yehkh-sahr ve-loh yah-deef:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וְלֹא כְּאֶחָד הַקָּנוּי וְהַמָּנוּי. כִּי לֹא יַשִּׂיגְךָ רִבּוּי וְשִׁנּוּי. לֹא תֹאַר וְלֹא כִנּוּי:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, but not like a unit to be grasped or counted, For number and change cannot reach Thee. Thou art not to be visioned, nor to be figured thus or thus.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-khahd. ve-loh ke-eh-khahd hah-kah-nooy ve-hah-mah-nooy. kee loh yah-see-ge-khah ree-booy ve-shee-nooy. loh toh-ahr ve-loh khee-nooy:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. וְלָשׂוּם לְךָ חֹק וּגְבוּל נִלְאָה הֶגְיוֹנִי. עַל כֵּן אָמַרְתִּי אֶשְׁמְרָה דְרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, but to put to Thee bound or circumference my imagination would fail me. Therefore I have said I will guard my ways lest I sin with the tongue.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-khahd. ve-lah-soom le-khah khohk oo-ge-vool neel-ah hehg-yoh-nee. ahl kehn ah-mahr-tee ehsh-me-rah de-rah-khahy meh-khah-toh veel-shoh-nee:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֶחָד. גָבַהְתָּ וְנַעֲלֵיתָ מִשְּׁפוֹל וּמִנְּפוֹל. וְאִילוֹ הָאֶחָד שֶׁיִּפּוֹל:
tokens.translation: Thou art One, Thou art high and exalted beyond abasement or falling, "For how should the One fall?"
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-khahd. gah-vahh-tah ve-nah-ah-ley-tah mee-she-fohl oo-mee-ne-fohl. ve-ee-loh hah-eh-khahd sheh-yee-pohl:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. וְלֹא יַשִּׂיגְךָ שֵׁמַע אֹזֶן וְלֹא רְאוּת עָיִן. וְלֹא יִשְׁלַט בְּךָ אֵיךְ וְלָמָּה וְאָיִן:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, but hearing of ear cannot reach Thee, or vision of eye, Nor shall the How have sway over Thee, nor the Wherefore and Whence.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah neem-tsah. ve-loh yah-see-ge-khah sheh-mah oh-zehn ve-loh re-oot ah-yeen. ve-loh yeesh-laht be-khah eykh ve-lah-mah ve-ah-yeen:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. אֲבָל לְעַצְמְךָ וְאֵין לְאַחֵר עִמָּךְ:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, but for Thyself and for none other with Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah neem-tsah. ah-vahl le-ahts-me-khah ve-eyn le-ah-khehr ee-mahkh:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. וּבְטֶרֶם הֱיוֹת כָּל זְמַן הָיִיתָ. וּבְלִי מָקוֹם חָנִיתָ:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, and before Time began Thou wast, And without place Thou didst abide.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah neem-tsah. oo-ve-teh-rehm heh-yoht kohl ze-mahn hah-yee-tah. oo-ve-lee mah-kohm khah-nee-tah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה נִמְצָא. וְסוֹדְךָ נֶעְלָם וּמִי יַשִּׂיגֶנּוּ. עָמוֹק עָמוֹק מִי יִמְצָאֶנּוּ:
tokens.translation: Thou existest, and Thy secret is hidden and who shall attain to it? So deep, so deep, who can discover it?
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah neem-tsah. ve-soh-de-khah neh-lahm oo-mee yah-see-geh-noo. ah-mohk ah-mohk mee yeem-tsah-eh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְלֹא מִזְּמָן קָבוּע. וְלֹא מֵעֵת יָדוּעַ:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, but not from any restricted season nor from any known period.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khahy. ve-loh mee-ze-mahn kah-voo. ve-loh meh-eht yah-doo-ah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְלֹא בְנֶפֶשׁ וּנְשָׁמָה כִּי אַתָּה נְשָׁמָה לִנְשָׁמָה:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, but not through breath and soul, for Thou art soul of the soul.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khahy. ve-loh ve-neh-fehsh oo-ne-shah-mah kee ah-tah ne-shah-mah leen-shah-mah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְלֹא כְּחַיֵּי אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה. וְסוֹפוֹ עָשׁ וְרִמָּה:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, but not with the life of man, which is like unto vanity and its end the moth and the worm.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khahy. ve-loh ke-khah-yey ah-dahm lah-heh-vehl dah-mah. ve-soh-foh ahsh ve-ree-mah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חַי. וְהַמַּגִּיעַ לְסוֹדְךָ יִמְצָא תַּעֲנוּג עוֹלָם. וְאָכַל וָחַי לְעוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: Thou livest, and he who layeth hold of Thy secret shall find eternal delight: "He shall eat and live for ever."
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khahy. ve-hah-mah-gee-ah le-soh-de-khah yeem-tsah tah-ah-noog oh-lahm. ve-ah-khahl vah-khahy le-oh-lahm:

tokens.translation: Thou art great, and compared with Thy greatness all greatness is humbled and all excess diminished.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah gah-dohl. oo-mool ge-doo-lah-te-khah kohl ge-doo-lah neekh-nah-aht. ve-khohl yeet-rohn meeg-rah-aht:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר. וְאֵין בְּכָל יְצִירוֹתֶיךָ וּבְרִיּוֹתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּכִגְבוּרוֹתֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty and there is none among all Thou hast formed and created who can emulate Thy deeds and Thy power.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah gee-bohr. ve-eyn be-khohl ye-tsee-roh-tey-khah oo-ve-ree-yoh-tey-khah ah-shehr yah-ah-seh khe-mah-ah-sey-khah oo-kheeg-voo-roh-tey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר וּלְךָ הַגְּבוּרָה הַגְּמוּרָה. אֲשֶׁר אֵין לָהּ שִׁנּוּי וּתְמוּרָה:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty, and Thine is the completed power beyond change or alteration.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah gee-bohr oo-le-khah hah-ge-voo-rah hah-ge-moo-rah. ah-shehr eyn lahh shee-nooy oo-te-moo-rah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִבּוֹר. וּמֵרֹב גַּאֲוָתְךָ תִּמְחֹל בְּעֵת זַעְפֶּךָ. וְתַאֲרִיךְ לְחַטָּאִים אַפֶּךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty, and from the abundance of Thy might dost Thou pardon in the time of Thy wrath And forbearest long with sinners.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah gee-bohr. oo-meh-rohv gah-ah-vah-te-khah teem-khohl be-eht zah-peh-khah. ve-tah-ah-reekh le-khah-tah-eem ah-peh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה גִּבּוֹר. וְרַחֲמֶיךָ עַל כָּל בְּרוּאֶיךָ כֻלָּם. הֵמָּה הַגִּבּוֹרִים אֲשֶׁר מֵעוֹלָם:
tokens.translation: Thou art mighty, and Thy mercies are upon all Thy creatures, yea upon all of them. These are the mighty deeds which are from eternity.

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אוֹר עֶלְיוֹן וְעֵינֵי כָל נֶפֶשׁ זַכָּה יִרְאוּךָ. וְעֵינֵי עֲוֹנִים מֵעֵינֶיהָ יַעְלִימוּךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art Light celestial, and the eyes of the pure shall behold Thee But the clouds of sin shall veil Thee from the eyes of the sinners.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah ohr ehl-yohn ve-ey-ney khohl neh-fehsh zah-kah yeer-oo-khah. ve-ey-ney ah-voh-neem meh-ey-ney-hah yah-lee-moo-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אוֹר נֶעְלָם בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה וְנִגְלֶה בָּעוֹלָם הַנִּרְאֶה. בְּהַר יְיָ יֵרָאֶה:
tokens.translation: Thou art Light, hidden in this world but to be revealed in the visible world on high. "On the mount of the Lord shall it be seen."
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah ohr neh-lahm bah-oh-lahm hah-zeh ve-neeg-leh bah-oh-lahm hah-neer-eh. be-hahr ye-yah yeh-rah-eh:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אוֹר עוֹלָם. וְעֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל לְךָ תִּכְסוֹף וְתִשְׁתָּאֶה. אֶפֶס קָצֵהוּ תִרְאֶה וְכֻלּוֹ לֹא תִרְאֶה:
tokens.translation: Light Eternal art Thou, and the eye of the intellect longeth and yearneth for Thee. "Yet only a part shall it see, the whole it shall not behold."
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah ohr oh-lahm. ve-eyn hah-seh-khehl le-khah teekh-sohf ve-teesh-tah-eh. eh-fehs kah-tseh-hoo teer-eh ve-khoo-loh loh teer-eh:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים וַאֲדוֹנֵי הָאֲדוֹנִים. שַׁלִּיט בָּעֶלְיוֹנִים וּבַתַּחְתּוֹנִים:
tokens.translation: Thou art the God of Gods, and the Lord of Lords, Ruler of beings celestial and terrestrial,
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-loh-hey hah-eh-loh-heem vah-ah-doh-ney hah-ah-doh-neem. shah-leet bah-ehl-yoh-neem oo-vah-tahkh-toh-neem:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ. וְכָל הַבְּרוּאִים עֵדֶיךָ. וּבִכְבוֹד זֶה הַשֵּׁם נִתְחַיֵּב כָּל נִבְרָא לְעָבְדֶּךָ:
tokens.translation: For all creatures are Thy witnesses And by the glory of this Thy name, every creature is bound to Thy service.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-loh-ahh. ve-khohl hah-be-roo-eem eh-dey-khah. oo-veekh-vohd zeh hah-shehm neet-khah-yehv kohl neev-rah le-ah-ve-deh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ. וְכָל הַיְצוּרִים עֲבָדֶיךָ וְעוֹבְדֶיךָ. וְלֹא יֶחְסַר כְּבוֹדֶךָ. בִּגְלַל עוֹבְדֵי בִלְעָדֶיךָ. כִּי כַוָּנַת כֻּלָּם לְהַגִּיעַ עָדֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art God, and all things formed are Thy servants and worshippers. Yet is not Thy glory diminished by reason of those that worship aught beside Thee, For the yearning of them all is to draw nigh Thee,
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-loh-ahh. ve-khohl hah-ye-tsoo-reem ah-vah-dey-khah ve-oh-ve-dey-khah. ve-loh yehkh-sahr ke-voh-deh-khah. beeg-lahl oh-ve-dey veel-ah-dey-khah. kee khah-vah-naht koo-lahm le-hah-gee-ah ah-dey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל הֵם כְּעִוְרִים. מְגַמַּת פְּנֵיהֶם דֶּרֶךְ הַמֶּלֶךְ. וְתָעוּ מִן הַדָּרֶךְ:
tokens.translation: But they are like the blind, Setting their faces forward on the King's highway, Yet still wandering from the path.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vahl hehm ke-eev-reem. me-gah-maht pe-ney-hehm deh-rehkh hah-meh-lehkh. ve-tah-oo meen hah-dah-rehkh:

tokens.hebrew: זֶה טָבַע בִּבְאֵר שָׁחַת. וְזֶה נָפַל אֶל פָּחַת:
tokens.translation: One sinketh into the well of a pit And another falleth into a snare,
tokens.transliteration: zeh tah-vah beev-ehr shah-khaht. ve-zeh nah-fahl ehl pah-khaht:

tokens.hebrew: וְכֻלָּם חָשְׁבוּ כִּי לְחֶפְצָם נָגָעוּ. וְהֵם לָרִיק יָגָעוּ:
tokens.translation: But all imagine they have reached their desire, Albeit they have suffered in vain.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khoo-lahm khah-she-voo kee le-khehf-tsahm nah-gah-oo. ve-hehm lah-reek yah-gah-oo:

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ עֲבָדֶיךָ הֵם כְּפִקְחִים. הַהוֹלְכִים דֶּרֶךְ נְכוֹחִים:
tokens.translation: But Thy servants are as those walking clear-eyed in the straight path,
tokens.transliteration: ahkh ah-vah-dey-khah hehm ke-feek-kheem. hah-hoh-le-kheem deh-rehkh ne-khoh-kheem:

tokens.hebrew: לֹא סָרוּ יָמִין וּשְׂמֹאל מִן הַדֶּרֶךְ. עַד בּוֹאָם לַחֲצַר בֵּית הַמֶּלֶךְ:
tokens.translation: Turning neither to the right nor the left Till they come to the court of the King's palace.
tokens.transliteration: loh sah-roo yah-meen oo-se-mohl meen hah-deh-rehkh. ahd boh-ahm lah-khah-tsahr beyt hah-meh-lehkh:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ סוֹמֵךְ הַיְצוּרִים בֵּאלָהוּתֶךָ. וְסוֹעֵד הַבְּרוּאִים בְּאַחְדוּתֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art God, by Thy Godhead sustaining all that hath been formed, And upholding in Thy Unity all creatures.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-loh-ahh soh-mehkh hah-ye-tsoo-reem beh-lah-hoo-teh-khah. ve-soh-ehd hah-be-roo-eem be-ahkh-doo-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ. וְאֵין הַפְרֵשׁ בֵּין אֱלָהוּתְךָ וְאַחְדוּתֶךָ. וְקַדְמוּתְךָ וּמְצִיאוּתֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art God, and there is no distinction 'twixt Thy Godhead and Thy Unity, Thy pre-existence and Thy existence,
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah eh-loh-ahh. ve-eyn hahf-rehsh beyn eh-lah-hoo-te-khah ve-ahkh-doo-teh-khah. ve-kahd-moo-te-khah oo-me-tsee-oo-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: כִּי הַכֹּל סוֹד אֶחָד. וְאִם יִשְׁתַּנֶּה שֵׁם כָּל אֶחָד. הַכֹּל הוֹלֵךְ אֶל מָקוֹם אֶחָד:
tokens.translation: For 'tis all one mystery. And although the name of each be different, "Yet they are all proceeding to one place."
tokens.transliteration: kee hah-kohl sohd eh-khahd. ve-eem yeesh-tah-neh shehm kohl eh-khahd. hah-kohl hoh-lehkh ehl mah-kohm eh-khahd:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. וְהַחָכְמָה מְקוֹר חַיִּים מִמְּךָ נוֹבָעַת. וְחָכְמָתְךָ נִבְעַר כָּל אָדָם מִדָּעַת:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise. And wisdom is the fount of life and from Thee it welleth, And by the side of Thy wisdom all human knowledge turneth to folly.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khah-khahm. ve-hah-khohkh-mah me-kohr khah-yeem mee-me-khah noh-vah-aht. ve-khohkh-mah-te-khah neev-ahr kohl ah-dahm mee-dah-aht:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. קַדְמוֹן לְכָל קַדְמוֹן. וְהַחָכְמָה הָיְתָה אֶצְלְךָ אָמוֹן:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise, more ancient than all primal things, And wisdom was the nursling at Thy side.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khah-khahm. kahd-mohn le-khohl kahd-mohn. ve-hah-khohkh-mah hah-ye-tah ehts-le-khah ah-mohn:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. וְלֹא לָמַדְתָּ מִבַּלְעָדֶיךָ. וְלֹא קָנִיתָ חָכְמָה מִזּוּלָתֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise, and Thou hast not learnt from any beside Thee, Nor acquired wisdom from any save Thyself.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khah-khahm. ve-loh lah-mahd-tah mee-bahl-ah-dey-khah. ve-loh kah-nee-tah khohkh-mah mee-zoo-lah-teh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה חָכָם. וּמֵחָכְמָתְךָ אָצַלְתָּ חֵפֶץ מְזֻמָּן. כְּפוֹעֵל וְאֻמָּן:
tokens.translation: Thou art wise, and from Thy wisdom Thou hast set apart Thy appointed purpose, Like a craftsman and an artist
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah khah-khahm. oo-meh-khohkh-mah-te-khah ah-tsahl-tah kheh-fehts me-zoo-mahn. ke-foh-ehl ve-oo-mahn:

tokens.hebrew: לִמְשֹׁךְ מֶשֶׁךְ הַיֵּשׁ מִן הָאַיִן. כְּהִמָּשֵׁךְ הָאוֹר הַיּוֹצֵא מִן הָעַיִן:
tokens.translation: To draw up the films of Being from Nothingness As light is drawn that darteth from the eye:
tokens.transliteration: leem-shohkh meh-shehkh hah-yehsh meen hah-ah-yeen. ke-hee-mah-shehkh hah-ohr hah-yoh-tseh meen hah-ah-yeen:

tokens.hebrew: וְשׁוֹאֵב מִמְּקוֹר הָאוֹר מִבְּלִי דְלִי. וּפוֹעֵל הַכֹּל בְּלִי כֶלִי:
tokens.translation: Without bucket from the fountain of light hath Thy workman drawn it up, And without tool hath he wrought,
tokens.transliteration: ve-shoh-ehv mee-me-kohr hah-ohr mee-be-lee de-lee. oo-foh-ehl hah-kohl be-lee kheh-lee:

tokens.translation: Hewing, graving, cleansing, refining,

tokens.hebrew: וְקָרָא אֶל הָאַיִן וְנִבְקַע. וְאֶל הַיֵּשׁ וְנִתְקַע. וְאֶל הָעוֹלָם וְנִרְקַע:
tokens.translation: Calling unto the void and it was cleft, And unto existence and it was urged, And to the universe and it was spread out;
tokens.transliteration: ve-kah-rah ehl hah-ah-yeen ve-neev-kah. ve-ehl hah-yehsh ve-neet-kah. ve-ehl hah-oh-lahm ve-neer-kah:

tokens.hebrew: וְתִכֵּן שְׁחָקִים בַּזֶּרֶת. וְיָדוֹ אֹהֶל הַגַּלְגַּלִּים מְחַבֶּרֶת:
tokens.translation: Establishing the clouds of the heavens And with his hand joining together the pavilions of the spheres,
tokens.transliteration: ve-tee-kehn she-khah-keem bah-zeh-reht. ve-yah-doh oh-hehl hah-gahl-gah-leem me-khah-beh-reht:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְלֻלְּאוֹת הַיְכֹלֶת יְרִיעוֹת הַבְּרִיאוֹת קוֹשָׁרֶת. וְכֹחָהּ נוֹגַעַת עַל שְׂפַת הַיְרִיעָה הַבְּרִיאָה הַחִיצוֹנָה הַקִּיצוֹנָה בְּמַחְבָּרֶת:
tokens.translation: And fastening with the loops of power the tent-folds of creation, For the might of his hand extendeth to the uttermost borders, "Linking the uttermost ends."
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-loo-le-oht hah-ye-khoh-leht ye-ree-oht hah-be-ree-oht koh-shah-reht. ve-khoh-khahh noh-gah-aht ahl se-faht hah-ye-ree-ah hah-be-ree-ah hah-khee-tsoh-nah hah-kee-tsoh-nah be-mahkh-bah-reht:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹתֶיךָ. בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ כַּדּוּר הָאָרֶץ נֶחְלָק לִשְׁנַיִם. חֶצְיוֹ יַבָּשָׁה וְחֶצְיוֹ מָיִם:
tokens.translation: Who shall utter Thy mighty deeds, For Thou madest a division of the ball of the earth into twain, half dry land, half water,
tokens.transliteration: mee ye-mah-lehl ge-voo-roh-tey-khah. bah-ah-soh-te-khah kah-door hah-ah-rehts nehkh-lahk leesh-nah-yeem. khehts-yoh yah-bah-shah ve-khehts-yoh mah-yeem:

tokens.hebrew: וְהִקַּפְתָּ עַל הַמַּיִם גַּלְגַּל הָרוּחַ. סוֹבֵב סוֹבֵב הוֹלֵךְ הָרוּחַ. וְעַל סְבִיבוֹתָיו יָנוּחַ.
tokens.translation: And didst surround the water with the sphere of air, In which the wind turneth and turneth in its going, And resteth in its circuits,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hee-kahf-tah ahl hah-mah-yeem gahl-gahl hah-roo-ahkh. soh-vehv soh-vehv hoh-lehkh hah-roo-ahkh. ve-ahl se-vee-voh-tahv yah-noo-ahkh.

tokens.translation: And didst encompass the air with the sphere of fire,

tokens.hebrew: וְהַיְסוֹדוֹת הָאֵלֶּה אַרְבָּעְתָּם. לָהֶם יְסוֹד אֶחָד וּמוֹצָאָם אֶחָד.
tokens.translation: And the foundations of these four elements are but one foundation, And their sources one,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-ye-soh-doht hah-eh-leh ahr-bah-e-tahm. lah-hehm ye-sohd eh-khahd oo-moh-tsah-ahm eh-khahd.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנּוּ יוֹצְאִים וּמִתְחַדְּשִׁים. וּמִשָּׁם יִפָּרֵד וְהָיָה לְאַרְבָּעָה רָאשִׁים:
tokens.translation: And from it they issue and are renewed, "And from thence was it separated and became four heads."
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-meh-noo yoh-tse-eem oo-meet-khah-de-sheem. oo-mee-shahm yee-pah-rehd ve-hah-yah le-ahr-bah-ah rah-sheem:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְחַוֶּה גְדֻלָּתֶךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל הָאֵשׁ גַּלְגַּל הָרָקִיעַ וּבוֹ הַיָּרֵחַ. וּמִזִּיו הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ שׁוֹאֵף וְזוֹרֵחַ.
tokens.translation: Who can declare Thy greatness? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of fire with the sphere of the firmament, Wherein is the Moon, Which by the splendour of the Sun raceth up, panting and shining,
tokens.transliteration: mee ye-khah-veh ge-doo-lah-teh-khah. be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl hah-ehsh gahl-gahl hah-rah-kee-ah oo-voh hah-yah-reh-ahkh. oo-mee-zeev hah-sheh-mehsh shoh-ehf ve-zoh-reh-ahkh.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְתִשְׁעָה וְעֶשְׂרִים יוֹם יִסּוֹב גַּלְגַּלּוֹ. וְיַעֲלֶה דֶרֶךְ גְּבוּלוֹ:
tokens.translation: And in nine and twenty days fulfilleth her revolving And then remounteth her bounded circuit.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-teesh-ah ve-ehs-reem yohm yee-sohv gahl-gah-loh. ve-yah-ah-leh deh-rehkh ge-voo-loh:

tokens.hebrew: וְסוֹדֶיהָ מֵהֶם פְּשׁוּטִים וּמֵהֶם עֲמוּקִים. וְגוּפוֹ פָּחוּת מִגּוּף הָאָרֶץ כְּחֵלֶק מִתִּשְׁעָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים חֲלָקִים.
tokens.translation: Of her secrets some lie unveiled and some are unsearchable, And her body is to the body of the earth As one part is to thirty-nine parts,
tokens.transliteration: ve-soh-dey-hah meh-hehm pe-shoo-teem oo-meh-hehm ah-moo-keem. ve-goo-foh pah-khoot mee-goof hah-ah-rehts ke-kheh-lehk mee-teesh-ah oo-she-loh-sheem khah-lah-keem.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא מְעוֹרֵר מִדֵּי חֹדֶשׁ בְּחָדְשׁוֹ עוֹלָם וְקוֹרוֹתָיו. וְטוֹבוֹתָיו וְרָעוֹתָיו. בִּרְצוֹן הַבּוֹרֵא אוֹתוֹ. לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרוֹתָיו:
tokens.translation: And from month to month she stirreth up the world and its chances, And its good and evil happenings, According to the will of her Creator, ''To make known to the sons of men His mighty deeds."
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo me-oh-rehr mee-dey khoh-dehsh be-khohd-shoh oh-lahm ve-koh-roh-tahv. ve-toh-voh-tahv ve-rah-oh-tahv. beer-tsohn hah-boh-reh oh-toh. le-hoh-dee-ah leev-ney hah-ah-dahm ge-voo-roh-tahv:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.12
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַזְכִּיר תְּהִלָּתֶךָ. בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ הַיָּרֵחַ רֹאשׁ לְחֶשְׁבּוֹן מוֹעֲדִים וּזְמַנִּים. וּתְקוּפוֹת וְאוֹתוֹת לְיָמִים וְשָׁנִים:
tokens.translation: Who shall tell Thy praises? For Thou madest the Moon the chief source whereby to calculate Appointed times and seasons, And cycles and signs for the days and the years.
tokens.transliteration: mee yahz-keer te-hee-lah-teh-khah. bah-ah-soh-te-khah hah-yah-reh-ahkh rohsh le-khehsh-bohn moh-ah-deem oo-ze-mah-neem. oo-te-koo-foht ve-oh-toht le-yah-meem ve-shah-neem:

tokens.translation: Her rule is in the night, Until the coming of the fixed hour

tokens.hebrew: וְתֶחְשַׁךְ יִפְעָתוֹ. וְיִתְכַּסֶּה מַעֲטֵה קַדְרוּתוֹ. כִּי מִמְּאוֹר הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אוֹרָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: When her brightness shall be darkened And she shall clothe herself with the mantle of gloom.
tokens.transliteration: ve-tehkh-shahkh yeef-ah-toh. ve-yeet-kah-seh mah-ah-teh kahd-roo-toh. kee mee-me-ohr hah-sheh-mehsh oh-rah-toh:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְלֵיל אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר אִם יַעַמְדוּ עַל קַו הַתְּלִי שְׁנֵיהֶם. וְיַפְרִיד בֵּינֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: For from the light of the Sun is her light, And should it hap on the night of the fourteenth that both of them stand On the line of the Dragon, So that it cometh between them,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-leyl ahr-bah-ah ah-sahr eem yah-ahm-doo ahl kahv hah-te-lee she-ney-hehm. ve-yahf-reed bey-ney-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: אָז הַיָּרֵחַ לֹא יָהֵל אוֹרוֹ. וְיִדְעַךְ נֵרוֹ:
tokens.translation: Then the Moon shall not convey her light, And her illumination shall be extinguished,
tokens.transliteration: ahz hah-yah-reh-ahkh loh yah-hehl oh-roh. ve-yeed-ahkh neh-roh:

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן דַּעַת כָּל עַמֵּי הָאָרֶץ. כִּי הֵם בְּרוּאֵי מַעְלָה. וְאִם הֵם יְקָרִים. עֲלֵיהֶם שׁוֹפֵט לְהַשְׁפִּיל וּלְהָרִים:
tokens.translation: To the end that all the peoples of the earth shall know That they are the creatures of the Most High, And however splendid they be There is a Judge above them to humble and exalt.
tokens.transliteration: le-mah-ahn dah-aht kohl ah-mey hah-ah-rehts. kee hehm be-roo-ey mah-lah. ve-eem hehm ye-kah-reem. ah-ley-hehm shoh-feht le-hahsh-peel oo-le-hah-reem:

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ יִחְיֶה אַחֲרֵי נָפְלוֹ. וְיָאִיר אַחֲרֵי אָפְלוֹ.
tokens.translation: Nathless she shall live again after her fall And shall be resplendent again after her darkness,
tokens.transliteration: ahkh yeekh-yeh ah-khah-rey nah-fe-loh. ve-yah-eer ah-khah-rey ah-fe-loh.

tokens.translation: And when she is in conjunction with the Sun at the end of the month,

tokens.hebrew: אִם יִהְיֶה תְּלִי בֵּינֵיהֶם. וְעַל קַו אֶחָד יַעַמְדוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: If the Dragon shall be between them, And both shall stand upon one line,
tokens.transliteration: eem yeeh-yeh te-lee bey-ney-hehm. ve-ahl kahv eh-khahd yah-ahm-doo she-ney-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: אָז יַעֲמֹד הַיָּרֵחַ לִפְנֵי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כְּעָב שְׁחוֹרָה. וְיַסְתִּיר מֵעֵין כָּל רֹאֶיהָ מְאוֹרָהּ.
tokens.translation: Then the Moon shall stand before the Sun like a projecting blackness And shall hide the light thereof from the sight of all beholders,
tokens.transliteration: ahz yah-ah-mohd hah-yah-reh-ahkh leef-ney hah-sheh-mehsh ke-ahv she-khoh-rah. ve-yahs-teer meh-eyn kohl roh-ey-hah me-oh-rahh.

tokens.hebrew: לְמַעַן יֵדְעוּ כָּל רֹאֶיהָ כִּי אֵין הַמַּלְכוּת לִצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם וַחֲיָלֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: In order that all who behold may know That the sovereignty is not with the hosts and legions of heaven
tokens.transliteration: le-mah-ahn yeh-de-oo kohl roh-ey-hah kee eyn hah-mahl-khoot leets-vah hah-shah-mah-yeem vah-khah-yah-ley-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל יֵשׁ אָדוֹן עֲלֵיהֶם. מַחֲשִׁיךְ מְאוֹרֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: But that there is a Master over them, Obscuring and irradiating,
tokens.transliteration: ah-vahl yehsh ah-dohn ah-ley-hehm. mah-khah-sheekh me-oh-rey-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי גָּבוֹהַּ מֵעַל גָּבוֹהַּ שֹׁמֵר וּגְבֹהִים עֲלֵיהֶם. וְהַחוֹשְׁבִים כִּי הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ אֱלֹהֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: For height behind height He keepeth, yea, and the heights beyond them, And they that imagine the Sun is their god
tokens.transliteration: kee gah-voh-ahh meh-ahl gah-voh-ahh shoh-mehr oo-ge-voh-heem ah-ley-hehm. ve-hah-khoh-she-veem kee hah-sheh-mehsh eh-loh-hey-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: בָּעֵת הַזֹּאת יֵבוֹשׁוּ מִמַּחְשְׁבוֹתֵיהֶם. וְיִבָּחֲנוּ דִּבְרֵיהֶם.
tokens.translation: At such time shall be ashamed of their imaginings, For their words are then tested,
tokens.transliteration: bah-eht hah-zoht yeh-voh-shoo mee-mahkh-she-voh-tey-hehm. ve-yee-bah-khah-noo deev-rey-hehm.

tokens.hebrew: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי יַד יְיָ עָשְׂתָה זֹאת וְאֵין לַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יְכֹלֶת. וְהַמַּחֲשִׁיךְ אוֹרָהּ לְבַדּוֹ הַמֶּמְשֶׁלֶת.
tokens.translation: And they shall know 'tis the hand of the Lord hath done this And that the Sun hath no power And His alone is the rule who can darken its light,
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeh-de-oo kee yahd ye-yah ah-se-tah zoht ve-eyn lah-sheh-mehsh ye-khoh-leht. ve-hah-mah-khah-sheekh oh-rahh le-vah-doh hah-mehm-sheh-leht.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הַשּׂוֹלֵחַ אֵלֶיהָ עֶבֶד מֵעֲבָדֶיהָ גְּמוּל חֲסָדֶיהָ. לְהַסְתִּיר אוֹרָהּ. וְלִכְרוֹת מִפְלַצְתָּהּ וַיְסִירֶהָ מִגְּבִירָה:
tokens.translation: Sending to it a slave of its slaves, A beneficiary of its own kindly glow, To becloud its radiance, To cut off the abominable idolising thereof, ''And let the Sun be removed from sovereignty.''
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo hah-soh-leh-ahkh eh-ley-hah eh-vehd meh-ah-vah-dey-hah ge-mool khah-sah-dey-hah. le-hahs-teer oh-rahh. ve-leekh-roht meef-lahts-tahh vah-ye-see-reh-hah mee-ge-vee-rah:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.13
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְסַפֵּר צִדְקוֹתֶיךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל רְקִיעַ הַיָּרֵחַ גַּלְגַּל שֵׁנִי בְּאֵין יוֹצֵאת וָפֶרֶץ.
tokens.translation: Who shall declare Thy righteousness? For Thou hast compassed the firmament of the moon with a second sphere Without deviation or infraction,
tokens.transliteration: mee ye-sah-pehr tseed-koh-tey-khah. be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl re-kee-ah hah-yah-reh-ahkh gahl-gahl sheh-nee be-eyn yoh-tseht vah-feh-rehts.

tokens.hebrew: וּבוֹ כּוֹכָב וְהוּא הַנִּקְרָא כּוֹכָב וּמִדָּתוֹ כְּחֵלֶק מִשְּׁנַיִם וְעֶשְׂרִים אֶלֶף מִן הָאָרֶץ.
tokens.translation: And within it is a star called Mercury, And its measure to the earth is like one to twenty-two thousand.
tokens.transliteration: oo-voh koh-khahv ve-hoo hah-neek-rah koh-khahv oo-mee-dah-toh ke-kheh-lehk mee-she-nah-yeem ve-ehs-reem eh-lehf meen hah-ah-rehts.

tokens.translation: And it completeth its turbulent course in ten months

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא מְעוֹרֵר בָּעוֹלָם רִיבוֹת וּמְדָנִים. וְאֵיבוֹת וּרְנָנִים:
tokens.translation: And is the stirrer up in the world of strifes and contentions And enmities and cries of complaint,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo me-oh-rehr bah-oh-lahm ree-voht oo-me-dah-neem. ve-ey-voht oo-re-nah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: וְנוֹתֵן כֹּחַ לַעֲשׂוֹת חַיִל וְלִצְבּוֹר הוֹן. וְלִכְנוֹס עֹשֶׁר וּמָמוֹן.
tokens.translation: And it giveth the force to obtain power and to heap up wealth, To gather riches and to lay up abundance,
tokens.transliteration: ve-noh-tehn koh-ahkh lah-ah-soht khah-yeel ve-leets-bohr hohn. ve-leekh-nohs oh-shehr oo-mah-mohn.

tokens.hebrew: בְּמִצְוַת הַבּוֹרֵא אוֹתוֹ לְשָׁרְתוֹ כְּעֶבֶד לִפְנֵי אָדוֹן:
tokens.translation: According to the command of Him who created it to be His minister As a servant before a master.
tokens.transliteration: be-meets-vaht hah-boh-reh oh-toh le-shah-re-toh ke-eh-vehd leef-ney ah-dohn:

tokens.translation: And it is the star of prudence and wisdom,

tokens.hebrew: נוֹתֵן לִפְתָאיִם עָרְמָה. לְנַעַר דַּעַת וּמְזִמָּה:
tokens.translation: "Giving subtlety to the simple And to the young man knowledge and discretion."
tokens.transliteration: noh-tehn leef-tah-yeem ah-re-mah. le-nah-ahr dah-aht oo-me-zee-mah:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָבִין סוֹדוֹתֶיךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל הַשֵּׁנִי גַּלְגַּל הַשְּׁלִישִׁי וּבוֹ נֹגַהּ כִּגְבֶרֶת בֵּין חֲיָּלֶיהָ. וְכַכַּלָּה תַּעְדֶּה כֵלֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: Who shall understand Thy mysteries? For thou hast encompassed the second sphere with a third sphere, And therein a brightness (Venus) like a queen amid her hosts, And her garments adorned like a bride's,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-veen soh-doh-tey-khah. be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl hah-sheh-nee gahl-gahl hah-she-lee-shee oo-voh noh-gahh keeg-veh-reht beyn khah-yah-ley-hah. ve-khah-kah-lah tah-deh kheh-ley-hah:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְעַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ תִּסֹּב גְּלִילֶיהָ. וְגוּפָהּ כְּחֵלֶק מִשִּׁבְעָה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים מִן הָאָרֶץ לְיוֹדְעֵי סוֹדָהּ וּמַשְׂכִּילֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: And in eleven months she fulfilleth her circuit, And her body to that of the earth is as one to thirty and seven, To those who know her secret and understand her.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-ahsh-tey ah-sahr khoh-dehsh tee-sohv ge-lee-ley-hah. ve-goo-fahh ke-kheh-lehk mee-sheev-ah oo-she-loh-sheem meen hah-ah-rehts le-yoh-de-ey soh-dahh oo-mahs-kee-ley-hah:

tokens.translation: And she reneweth in the world, by the will of her Creator,
Peace and prosperity, dancing and delight,
And songs and shouts of joy, And the love-cries of bride and bridegroom on their canopies.

tokens.hebrew: וְהִיא מְקַשֶּׁרֶת פְּרִי תְנוּבוֹת וּשְׁאָר הַצְּמָחִים. מִמֶּגֶד תְּבוּאוֹת שָׁמֶשׁ. וּמִמֶּגֶד גֶּרֶשׁ יְרָחִים:
tokens.translation: And it is she conspireth the ripening of fruit And other vegetation, "From the precious things of the fruits of the sun, And from the precious things of the yield of the moons."
tokens.transliteration: ve-hee me-kah-sheh-reht pe-ree te-noo-voht oo-she-ahr hah-tse-mah-kheem. mee-meh-gehd te-voo-oht shah-mehsh. oo-mee-meh-gehd geh-rehsh ye-rah-kheem:

translationVersions.versionTitle: Selected Religious Poems of Solomon Ibn Gabirol, trans. Israel Zangwill. JPS, Philadelphia, 1923

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.15
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַשְׂכִּיל סוֹדְךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל נֹגַהּ גַּלְגַּל רְבִיעִי וּבוֹ הַחַמָּה.
tokens.translation: Who shall understand Thy secret? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of this shining one With a fourth sphere, wherein is the Sun
tokens.transliteration: mee yahs-keel soh-de-khah be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl noh-gahh gahl-gahl re-vee-ee oo-voh hah-khah-mah.

tokens.translation: That completeth his circuit in a perfect year.

tokens.hebrew: וְגוּפָהּ גָּדוֹל מִגּוּף הָאָרֶץ מֵאָה וְשִׁבְעִים פַּעַם בְּמוֹפְתֵי שֵׂכֶל וּמְזִמָּה.
tokens.translation: And his body is one hundred and seventy times greater than that of the earth, According to indications and devisings of intellect.
tokens.transliteration: ve-goo-fahh gah-dohl mee-goof hah-ah-rehts meh-ah ve-sheev-eem pah-ahm be-moh-fe-tey seh-khehl oo-me-zee-mah.

tokens.hebrew: וְהִיא חוֹלֶקֶת לְכָל כּוֹכְבֵי שָׁמַיִם וְנוֹתֶנֶת תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים וְהוֹד וּמַלְכוּת וְאֵימָה.
tokens.translation: And he is the apportioner of light to all the stars of the heavens, And giveth to kings salvation And majesty, dominion and awe,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hee khoh-leh-keht le-khohl koh-khe-vey shah-mah-yeem ve-noh-teh-neht te-shoo-ah lah-me-lah-kheem ve-hohd oo-mahl-khoot ve-ey-mah.

tokens.hebrew: וּמְחַדֶּשֶׁת נִפְלָאוֹת בָּעוֹלָם אִם לְשָׁלוֹם וְאִם לַמִּלְחָמָה.
tokens.translation: And reneweth marvels on the earth, Whether for war or for peace,
tokens.transliteration: oo-me-khah-deh-sheht neef-lah-oht bah-oh-lahm eem le-shah-lohm ve-eem lah-meel-khah-mah.

tokens.hebrew: וְעוֹקֶרֶת מַלְכֻיוֹת וְתַחְתָּם אֲחֵרוֹת מְקִימָה וּמְרִימָה.
tokens.translation: And rooteth up kingdoms, And establisheth and exalteth others in their stead
tokens.transliteration: ve-oh-keh-reht mahl-khoo-yoht ve-tahkh-tahm ah-kheh-roht me-kee-mah oo-me-ree-mah.

tokens.hebrew: וְלָהּ יְכֹלֶת לְהַשְׁפִּיל וּלְהָרִים בְּיָד רָמָה.
tokens.translation: And hath power to abase and uplift with a high hand,
tokens.transliteration: ve-lahh ye-khoh-leht le-hahsh-peel oo-le-hah-reem be-yahd rah-mah.

tokens.translation: But all according to the will of the Creator who created him in wisdom.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְכָל יוֹם וָיוֹם תִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְמַלְכָּהּ וּבֵית נְתִיבוֹת נִצָּבָה.
tokens.translation: Every day he prostrateth himself before the King, And taketh his stand in the house of his course,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-khohl yohm vah-yohm teesh-tah-khah-veh le-mahl-kahh oo-veyt ne-tee-voht nee-tsah-vah.

tokens.hebrew: וּבַשַּׁחַר תָּרִים רֹאשׁ וְתִקּוֹד לָעֶרֶב בְּמַעֲרָבָה.
tokens.translation: And at dawn he raiseth his head And boweth towards the west in the evening.
tokens.transliteration: oo-vah-shah-khahr tah-reem rohsh ve-tee-kohd lah-eh-rehv be-mah-ah-rah-vah.

tokens.hebrew: בָּעֶרֶב הִיא בָאָה וּבַבֹּקֶר הִיא שָׁבָה:
tokens.translation: "In the evening he goeth down and in the morning he returneth."
tokens.transliteration: bah-eh-rehv hee vah-ah oo-vah-boh-kehr hee shah-vah:
