translationVersions.versionTitle: Selected Religious Poems of Solomon Ibn Gabirol, trans. Israel Zangwill. JPS, Philadelphia, 1923

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.16
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָכִיל גְּדֻלָּתְךָ בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ אוֹתָהּ לִמְנוֹת בָּהּ יָמִים וְשָׁנִים. וְעִתִּים מְזֻמָּנִים.
tokens.translation: Who can grasp Thy greatness? For Thou hast appointed the Sun for the computing Of days and of years, and appointed periods,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-kheel ge-doo-lah-te-khah bah-ah-soh-te-khah oh-tahh leem-noht bahh yah-meem ve-shah-neem. ve-ee-teem me-zoo-mah-neem.

tokens.hebrew: וּלְהַצְמִיחַ בָּהּ עֵץ עֹשֶׂה פְּרִי וּמַעֲדַנּוֹת כִּימָה וּמוֹשְׁכוֹת כְּסִיל דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים:
tokens.translation: And to make the fruit-tree to burgeon, And, under the sweet influence of the Pleiades and the bands of Orion, The green shoots luxuriant.
tokens.transliteration: oo-le-hahts-mee-ahkh bahh ehts oh-seh pe-ree oo-mah-ah-dah-noht kee-mah oo-moh-she-khoht ke-seel de-sheh-neem ve-rah-ah-nah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים הוֹלֶכֶת לִפְאַת צָפוֹן לְחַמֵּם הָאַוֵּר וְהַמַּיִם וְהָעֵצִים וְהָאֲבָנִים:
tokens.translation: Six months he journeyeth towards the north to warm the air, And the waters, the woods, and the rocks,
tokens.transliteration: ve-shee-shah khoh-dah-sheem hoh-leh-kheht leef-aht tsah-fohn le-khah-mehm hah-ah-vehr ve-hah-mah-yeem ve-hah-eh-tseem ve-hah-ah-vah-neem:

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי קִרְבָתָהּ לַצָּפוֹן יִגְדְּלוּ הַיָּמִים וְיַאֲרִיכוּ הַזְּמַנִּים.
tokens.translation: And as he draweth nigh to the north, The days grow longer and the seasons wax,
tokens.transliteration: oo-khe-fee keer-vah-tahh lah-tsah-fohn yeeg-de-loo hah-yah-meem ve-yah-ah-ree-khoo hah-ze-mah-neem.

tokens.hebrew: עַד יִמָּצֵא מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִגְדַּל יוֹמוֹ עַד הֱיוֹתוֹ שִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים בְּמוֹפְתִים נֶאֱמָנִים.
tokens.translation: Till there is found a place where the day is so lengthened That it lasteth six months, According to confirmed indications,
tokens.transliteration: ahd yee-mah-tseh mah-kohm ah-shehr yeeg-dahl yoh-moh ahd heh-yoh-toh shee-shah khoh-dah-sheem be-moh-fe-teem neh-eh-mah-neem.

tokens.hebrew: וְשִׁשָּׁה חֳדָשִׁים הוֹלֶכֶת לִפְאַת דָּרוֹם בְּמַעְגָּלִים נְתוּנִים.
tokens.translation: And six months he journeyeth towards the south In his appointed courses
tokens.transliteration: ve-shee-shah khoh-dah-sheem hoh-leh-kheht leef-aht dah-rohm be-mah-gah-leem ne-too-neem.

tokens.hebrew: עַד יִמָּצֵא מָקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יִגְדַּל לֵילוֹ עַד הֱיוֹתוֹ שִׁשָּׁה חָדֳשִׁים לְפִי מִבְחַן הַבּוֹחֲנִים.
tokens.translation: Till there is found a place where the night is so lengthened That it lasteth six months, According to the proof of searchers.
tokens.transliteration: ahd yee-mah-tseh mah-kohm ah-shehr yeeg-dahl ley-loh ahd heh-yoh-toh shee-shah khoh-doh-sheem le-fee meev-khahn hah-boh-khah-neem.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִמֶּנָּה יִוָּדְעוּ קְצַת דַּרְכֵי בוֹרְאָהּ שֶׁמֶץ מִגְּבוּרוֹתָיו. וֶעֱזוּזוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו.
tokens.translation: And from this may be known a fringe of the ways of the Creator, A whisper of His mighty powers, Of His strength and His wondrous works.
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-meh-nah yee-vah-de-oo ke-tsaht dahr-khey voh-re-ahh sheh-mehts mee-ge-voo-roh-tahv. veh-eh-zoo-zoh ve-neef-le-oh-tahv.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מִגְּדֻלַּת הָעֲבָדִים גְּדֻלַּת הָאָדוֹן נוֹדַעַת. לְכָל יוֹדְעֵי דָּעַת:
tokens.translation: As from the greatness of servants May the greatness of the master be known By all men of understanding,
tokens.transliteration: kee mee-ge-doo-laht hah-ah-vah-deem ge-doo-laht hah-ah-dohn noh-dah-aht. le-khohl yoh-de-ey dah-aht:

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל הָעֶבֶד יִגָּלֶה תֹקֶף הָאָדוֹן וּכְבוֹדוֹ. וְכָל טוּב אֲדֹנָיו בְּיָדוֹ:
tokens.translation: So through the ministering Sun is revealed The grandeur and glory of the Lord, "For all the goods of his Master are delivered into his hands."
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl hah-eh-vehd yee-gah-leh toh-kehf hah-ah-dohn oo-khe-voh-doh. ve-khohl toov ah-doh-nahv be-yah-doh:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.17
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַכִּיר אוֹתוֹתֶיךָ. בְּהַקִּיפְךָ אוֹתָהּ לְהַעֲנִיק אוֹר. לְכוֹכְבֵי מַעְלָה וּמַטָּה גַּם לַלְּבָנָה. וְאִם תַּחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמוֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת לְבָנָה.
tokens.translation: Who can grasp Thy wonders? For Thou hast appointed him to furnish light to the stars Of high or low degree, And to the Moon, "If that white bright spot stays in its place"
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-keer oh-toh-tey-khah. be-hah-kee-fe-khah oh-tahh le-hah-ah-neek ohr. le-khoh-khe-vey mah-lah oo-mah-tah gahm lah-le-vah-nah. ve-eem tahkh-tey-hah tah-ah-mohd hah-bah-heh-reht le-vah-nah.

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי אֲשֶׁר יִרְחַק מִמֶּנָּה הַיָּרֵחַ. מִזִּיוָהּ לוֹקֵחַ.
tokens.translation: And according as she moves away to stand opposite the Sun,
tokens.transliteration: oo-khe-fee ah-shehr yeer-khahk mee-meh-nah hah-yah-reh-ahkh. mee-zee-vahh loh-keh-ahkh.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי בְרַחֲקוֹ יִקְרַב לַעֲמוֹד נָכְחָהּ. וִיקַבֵּל זָרְחָהּ.
tokens.translation: She receiveth his shining
tokens.transliteration: kee ve-rah-khah-koh yeek-rahv lah-ah-mohd nah-khe-khahh. vee-kah-behl zah-re-khahh.

tokens.hebrew: עַד יְמַלֵּא אוֹרוֹ בְּעָמְדוֹ לְפָנֶיהָ. וְהֵאִיר אֶל עֵבֶר פָּנֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: Until his light is at the full when she stands before him, And it irradiates her whole face.
tokens.transliteration: ahd ye-mah-leh oh-roh be-ah-me-doh le-fah-ney-hah. ve-heh-eer ehl eh-vehr pah-ney-hah:

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַב אַחַר חֲצִי הַחֹדֶשׁ אֵלֶיהָ. הוּא נוֹטֶה מֵעָלֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: And when that she draws nigh in the latter half of the month, And declineth from him
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl ah-shehr yeek-rahv ah-khahr khah-tsee hah-khoh-dehsh eh-ley-hah. hoo noh-teh meh-ah-ley-hah.

tokens.translation: And is far from standing opposite him And proceedeth to the side of him,
In that degree waneth her splendour,

tokens.hebrew: עַד כְּלוֹת חָדְשׁוֹ וּתְקוּפָתוֹ. וְיָבֹא בִּגְבוּל שְׂפָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: Till the end of her month and her circuit, And she declineth to her extreme rim.
tokens.transliteration: ahd ke-loht khohd-shoh oo-te-koo-fah-toh. ve-yah-voh beeg-vool se-fah-toh:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְהִדָּבְקוֹ עִמָּהּ. יִסָּתֵר בְּמִסְתָּרִים. כְּפִי יוֹם וַחֲצִי שָׁעָה וּרְגָעִים סְפוּרִים:
tokens.translation: And when she is in conjunction with him She is hid in secret places For a day and half an hour And some numbered moments,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-hee-dah-ve-koh ee-mahh. yee-sah-tehr be-mees-tah-reem. ke-fee yohm vah-khah-tsee shah-ah oo-re-gah-eem se-foo-reem:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כֵן יִתְחַדֵּשׁ וְיָשׁוּב לְקַדְמוּתוֹ. וְהוּא כְּחָתָן יוֹצֵא מֵחֻפָּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: And after that she is renewed and returneth to her prior self And "issueth forth as a bridegroom from his chamber."
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-khah-rey khehn yeet-khah-dehsh ve-yah-shoov le-kahd-moo-toh. ve-hoo ke-khah-tahn yoh-tseh meh-khoo-pah-toh:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.18
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יֵדַע פְּלִיאוֹתֶיךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל חַמָּה גַּלְגַּל חֲמִישִׁי וּבוֹ מַאֲדִים כְּמֶלֶךְ בְּהֵיכָלוֹ.
tokens.translation: Who can know Thy wondrous works? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of the Sun with a fifth sphere, And therein Mars like a king in his palace,
tokens.transliteration: mee yeh-dah pe-lee-oh-tey-khah be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl khah-mah gahl-gahl khah-mee-shee oo-voh mah-ah-deem ke-meh-lehkh be-hey-khah-loh.

tokens.translation: And in eighteen months he completeth his circuit.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִדָּתוֹ כְּגוּף הָאָרֶץ פַּעַם וָחֵצִי וּשְׁמִינִית פַּעַם וְזֶה תַּכְלִית גָּדְלוֹ:
tokens.translation: And his measure to the body of the earth Is as one and five-eighths to one. And this is the scope of his greatness,
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-dah-toh ke-goof hah-ah-rehts pah-ahm vah-kheh-tsee oo-she-mee-neet pah-ahm ve-zeh tahkh-leet gohd-loh:

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא כְּגִבּוֹר עָרִיץ מָגֵן גִּבּוֹרֵיהוּ מְאָדָּם.
tokens.translation: That he is like a terror-striking warrior Whose shield of red gives him might,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo ke-gee-bohr ah-reets mah-gehn gee-boh-rey-hoo me-ah-dahm.

tokens.translation: And who stirreth up wars, And slaughter and destruction,

tokens.hebrew: וּמֻכֵּי חֶרֶב וּלְחֻמֵי רֶשֶׁף נֶהְפַּךְ לְחֹרֶב לְשַׁדָּם.
tokens.translation: With men smitten of the sword And consumed of flame, Their sap burned to dryness;
tokens.transliteration: oo-moo-key kheh-rehv oo-le-khoo-mey reh-shehf neh-pahkh le-khoh-rehv le-shah-dahm.

tokens.hebrew: וּשְׁנַת בַּצֹּרֶת וּשְׂרֵפַת אֵשׁ וּרְעָמִים וְאַבְנֵי אֶלְגָּבִישׁ וּמְדֻקָּרִים וּשְׁלוּפֵי חֶרֶב כְּנֶגְדָּם.
tokens.translation: And years of dearth And fiery burnings and thunders and hail-stones And piercings and withdrawings of the sword in consonance with them,
tokens.transliteration: oo-she-naht bah-tsoh-reht oo-se-reh-faht ehsh oo-re-ah-meem ve-ahv-ney ehl-gah-veesh oo-me-doo-kah-reem oo-she-loo-fey kheh-rehv ke-nehg-dahm.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי רַגְלֵיהֶם לָרַע יָרוּצוּ וִימַהֲרוּ לִשְׁפָּךְ דָּם:
tokens.translation: "For their feet run swiftly to commit evil and hasten to shed blood."
tokens.transliteration: kee rahg-ley-hehm lah-rah yah-roo-tsoo vee-mah-hah-roo leesh-pahkh dahm:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.19
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַבִּיעַ נוֹרְאוֹתֶיךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל מַאֲדִים גַּלְגַּל שִׁשִּׁי הוֹלֵךְ בִּמְסִבָּה.
tokens.translation: Who shall find words for Thy tremendous works? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of Mars with a sixth sphere,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-bee-ah noh-re-oh-tey-khah be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl mah-ah-deem gahl-gahl shee-shee hoh-lehkh beem-see-bah.

tokens.translation: A vast and mighty encompassing sphere,
Wherein dwelleth the righteous planet (Jupiter).

tokens.hebrew: וְגוּפוֹ גָדוֹל מִגּוּף הָאָרֶץ חֲמִשָּׁה וְשִׁבְעִים פַּעַם בְּמִדַּת רָחְבָּהּ.
tokens.translation: And his body is greater than that of the earth seventy-five times By the measure of her breadth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-goo-foh gah-dohl mee-goof hah-ah-rehts khah-mee-shah ve-sheev-eem pah-ahm be-mee-daht rohkh-bahh.

tokens.hebrew: וְסוֹבֵב הַגַּלְגַּל בִּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה וְהוּא כּוֹכַב רָצוֹן וְהָאַהֲבָה.
tokens.translation: And he completeth his revolution in twelve years, And is as a planet of goodwill and love,
tokens.transliteration: ve-soh-vehv hah-gahl-gahl beesh-teym ehs-reh shah-nah ve-hoo koh-khahv rah-tsohn ve-hah-ah-hah-vah.

tokens.hebrew: וּמְעוֹרֵר יִרְאַת הַשֵּׁם וְיֹשֶׁר וּתְשׁוּבָה. וְכָל מִדָּה טוֹבָה.
tokens.translation: Stirring up the fear of heaven, And righteousness and repentance and every good quality,
tokens.transliteration: oo-me-oh-rehr yeer-aht hah-shehm ve-yoh-shehr oo-te-shoo-vah. ve-khohl mee-dah toh-vah.

tokens.translation: And increasing all crops and fruits,
And causing wars to cease, And enmity and strife;

tokens.hebrew: וְדָתוֹ לְחַזֵּק בְּיָשְׁרוֹ כָּל בֶּדֶק. וְהוּא יִשְׁפּוֹט תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק:
tokens.translation: And his appointed task is to repair by righteousness every breach, "For He judgeth the world in righteousness."
tokens.transliteration: ve-dah-toh le-khah-zehk be-yohsh-roh kohl beh-dehk. ve-hoo yeesh-poht teh-vehl be-tseh-dehk:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְשׂוֹחֵחַ גְּדֻלָּתֶךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל צֶדֶק גַּלְגַּל שְׁבִיעִי וּבוֹ שַׁבְּתַי בִּתְקוּפָתוֹ.
tokens.translation: Who shall reason of Thy greatness? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of Jupiter with a seventh sphere, And therein revolveth Saturn.
tokens.transliteration: mee ye-soh-kheh-ahkh ge-doo-lah-teh-khah be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl tseh-dehk gahl-gahl she-vee-ee oo-voh shah-be-tahy beet-koo-fah-toh.

tokens.hebrew: וְגוּפוֹ גָדוֹל מִגּוּף הָאָרֶץ אֶחָד וְתִשְׁעִים פַּעַם בְּמִדָּתוֹ.
tokens.translation: And his body is greater than that of the earth ninety-one times by the measure of him,
tokens.transliteration: ve-goo-foh gah-dohl mee-goof hah-ah-rehts eh-khahd ve-teesh-eem pah-ahm be-mee-dah-toh.

tokens.translation: And he completeth his revolution in thirty years of his course,

tokens.hebrew: וּמְעוֹרֵר מִלְחָמוֹת וּבִזָּה וּשְׁבִי וְרָעָב כִּי כֵן דָּתוֹ.
tokens.translation: And stirreth up wars, And spoliation and captivity and famine, For such is his appointed task;
tokens.transliteration: oo-me-oh-rehr meel-khah-moht oo-vee-zah oo-she-vee ve-rah-ahv kee khehn dah-toh.

tokens.hebrew: וּמַחֲרִיב אֲרָצוֹת וְעוֹקֵר מַלְכֻיּוֹת בִּרְצוֹן הַמַּפְקִיד אוֹתוֹ. לַעֲבוֹד עֲבוֹדָתוֹ נָכְרִיָּה עֲבוֹדָתוֹ:
tokens.translation: And devastateth the lands, And rooteth up kingdoms According to the will of Him "Who hath appointed him to His service, Even such strange service."
tokens.transliteration: oo-mah-khah-reev ah-rah-tsoht ve-oh-kehr mahl-khoo-yoht beer-tsohn hah-mahf-keed oh-toh. lah-ah-vohd ah-voh-dah-toh nah-khe-ree-yah ah-voh-dah-toh:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַגִּיעַ לְרוֹמְמוּתֶךָ בְּהַקִּיפְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל שַׁבְּתַי גַּלְגַּל שְׁמִינִי בִּמְסִבָּתוֹ.
tokens.translation: Who shall attain to Thy exaltation? For Thou hast encompassed the sphere of Saturn with an eighth sphere of encompassment,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-gee-ah le-roh-me-moo-teh-khah be-hah-kee-fe-khah ahl gahl-gahl shah-be-tahy gahl-gahl she-mee-nee beem-see-bah-toh.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא סוֹבֵל שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה מַזָּלוֹת עַל קַו חֵשֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ.
tokens.translation: And it is laden with the twelve constellations On the line of the belt of its ephod,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo soh-vehl she-teym ehs-reh mah-zah-loht ahl kahv kheh-shehv ah-foo-dah-toh.

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל כּוֹכְבֵי שַׁחַק הָעֶלְיוֹנִים יְצוּקִים בִּיצוּקָתוֹ. וְכָל כּוֹכָב מֵהֶם יַקִּיף הַגַּלְגַּל בְּשִׁשָּׁה וּשְׁלֹשִׁים אֶלֶף שָׁנִים מֵרֹב גַּבְהוּתוֹ.
tokens.translation: And all the higher stars of cloudland Fixed in its rigidity. And every star of them compasseth its circuit in six and thirty thousand years, From the greatness of its altitude;
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl koh-khe-vey shah-khahk hah-ehl-yoh-neem ye-tsoo-keem bee-tsoo-kah-toh. ve-khohl koh-khahv meh-hehm yah-keef hah-gahl-gahl be-shee-shah oo-she-loh-sheem eh-lehf shah-neem meh-rohv gahv-hoo-toh.

tokens.hebrew: וְגוּף כָּל כּוֹכָב מֵהֶם מֵאָה וְשֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים כְּגוּף הָאָרֶץ וְזֹאת תַּכְלִית גְּדֻלָּתוֹ:
tokens.translation: And the body of each is a hundred and seven times that of the earth, And this is the limit of its greatness.
tokens.transliteration: ve-goof kohl koh-khahv meh-hehm meh-ah ve-sheh-vah pe-ah-meem ke-goof hah-ah-rehts ve-zoht tahkh-leet ge-doo-lah-toh:

tokens.hebrew: וּמִכֹּחַ הַמַּזָּלוֹת הָהֵם. נֶאֱצַל כֹּחַ כָּל בְּרוּאֵי מַטָּה לְמִינֵיהֶם. בִּרְצוֹן בּוֹרְאָם וּמַפְקִידָם עֲלֵיהֶם:
tokens.translation: And from the might of these stars Is drawn the strength of all creatures below, Each after its kind, According to the will of the Creator who hath appointed them,
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-koh-ahkh hah-mah-zah-loht hah-hehm. neh-eh-tsahl koh-ahkh kohl be-roo-ey mah-tah le-mee-ney-hehm. beer-tsohn boh-re-ahm oo-mahf-kee-dahm ah-ley-hehm:

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל אֶחָד מֵהֶם עַל מַתְכֻּנְתּוֹ בָּרְאוֹ. וּבְשֵׁם קְרָאוֹ. אִישׁ אִישׁ עַל עֲבוֹדָתוֹ וְעַל מַשָּׂאוֹ:
tokens.translation: And set every one of them in its fit station, And given it its name, "Each man to his service and his station."
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl eh-khahd meh-hehm ahl maht-koon-toh bah-re-oh. oo-ve-shehm ke-rah-oh. eesh eesh ahl ah-voh-dah-toh ve-ahl mah-sah-oh:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.22
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יֵדַע הֲלִיכוֹתֶךָ בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ לְשִׁבְעָה כּוֹכְבֵי לֶכֶת הֵיכָלוֹת. בִּשְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה מַזָּלוֹת:
tokens.translation: Who can know Thy pathways? For Thou hast made palaces for the seven planets In the twelve constellations,
tokens.transliteration: mee yeh-dah hah-lee-khoh-teh-khah bah-ah-soh-te-khah le-sheev-ah koh-khe-vey leh-kheht hey-khah-loht. beesh-teym ehs-reh mah-zah-loht:

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל טָלֶה וָשׁוֹר אָצַלְתָּ כֹּחֲךָ בְּהִתְיַחֲדָם. וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁי תְּאוֹמִים כִּשְׁנֵי אַחִים בְּהִתְאַחֲדָם. וּדְמוּת פְּנֵיהֶם פְּנֵי אָדָם.
tokens.translation: And to the Ram and the Bull Thou hast imparted Thy strength in uniting them, And the third is the Twins, like two brothers in their unity And their human likeness.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl tah-leh vah-shohr ah-tsahl-tah koh-khah-khah be-heet-yah-khah-dahm. ve-hah-she-lee-shee te-oh-meem keesh-ney ah-kheem be-heet-ah-khah-dahm. oo-de-moot pe-ney-hehm pe-ney ah-dahm.

tokens.hebrew: וְלָרְבִיעִי וְהוּא סַרְטָן גַּם לָאַרְיֵה נָתַתָּ מֵהוֹדְךָ עָלָיו. וְלַאֲחוֹתוֹ הַבְּתוּלָה הַקְּרוֹבָה אֵלָיו.
tokens.translation: And the fourth is the Crab, And on him, as on the Lion, hast Thou bestowed of Thy splendour, And on his sister the Virgin, who is near unto him,
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-re-vee-ee ve-hoo sahr-tahn gahm lah-ahr-yeh nah-tah-tah meh-hoh-de-khah ah-lahv. ve-lah-ah-khoh-toh hah-be-too-lah hah-ke-roh-vah eh-lahv.

tokens.hebrew: וְכֵן לַמֹּאזְנַיִם וְלָעַקְרָב אֲשֶׁר בְּצִדּוֹ הוּשַׁת. וְהַתְּשִׁיעִי הַנִּבְרָא כְּצוּרַת גִּבּוֹר כֹחוֹ וְלֹא נָשָׁת. וַיְהִי רֹבֶה קַשָּׁת.
tokens.translation: And on the Scales and the Scorpion placed by his side, And on the ninth that was created in the form of a man of might, whose strength runs not dry, For he is the Archer, mighty of the bow.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khehn lah-moh-ze-nah-yeem ve-lah-ahk-rahv ah-shehr be-tsee-doh hoo-shaht. ve-hah-te-shee-ee hah-neev-rah ke-tsoo-raht gee-bohr khoh-khoh ve-loh nah-shaht. vah-ye-hee roh-veh kah-shaht.

tokens.hebrew: וְכֵן נִבְרָא גְּדִי וּדְלִי בְּכֹחֲךָ הַגָּדוֹל. וּלְבַדּוֹ הַמַּזָּל הָאַחֲרוֹן וַיְמַן יְיָ דָּג גָּדוֹל:
tokens.translation: And thus too by Thy great power are created the Goat and the Water-Bearer, While alone is the last constellation, "For the Lord did appoint a great Fish."
tokens.transliteration: ve-khehn neev-rah ge-dee oo-de-lee be-khoh-khah-khah hah-gah-dohl. oo-le-vah-doh hah-mah-zahl hah-ah-khah-rohn vah-ye-mahn ye-yah dahg gah-dohl:

tokens.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַמַּזָּלוֹת הַגְּבוֹהִים וְנִשָּׂאִים בְּמַעֲלוֹתָם. שְׁנֵי עָשָׂר לְאֻמּוֹתָם:
tokens.translation: And these are the constellations high and exalted in their degrees, "Twelve princes according to the nations."
tokens.transliteration: ve-eh-leh hah-mah-zah-loht hah-ge-voh-heem ve-nee-sah-eem be-mah-ah-loh-tahm. she-ney ah-sahr le-oo-moh-tahm:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.23
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יְיָ מִי יַחֲקוֹר תַּעֲלוּמוֹתֶיךָ בְּהַאֲצִילְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל הַמַּזָּלוֹת גַּלְגַּל תְּשִׁיעִי בְּמַעֲרָכוֹ.
tokens.translation: O Lord, who shall search out Thy profundities? For Thou hast set apart above the sphere of the constellations The sphere that is ninth in order,
tokens.transliteration: ye-yah mee yah-khah-kohr tah-ah-loo-moh-tey-khah be-hah-ah-tsee-le-khah ahl gahl-gahl hah-mah-zah-loht gahl-gahl te-shee-ee be-mah-ah-rah-khoh.

tokens.hebrew: הַמַּקִּיף עַל כָּל הַגַּלְגַּלִּים וּבְרוּאֵיהֶם וְהֵם סְגוּרִים בְּתוֹכוֹ.
tokens.translation: That encompasseth all the spheres and their creatures, Wherein they are closed up,
tokens.transliteration: hah-mah-keef ahl kohl hah-gahl-gah-leem oo-ve-roo-ey-hehm ve-hehm se-goo-reem be-toh-khoh.

tokens.hebrew: הַמַּנְהִיג כָּל כּוֹכְבֵי שָׁמַיִם וְגַלְגַּלֵּיהֶם מִמִּזְרָח לְמַעֲרָב לְתֹקֶף מַהֲלָכוֹ.
tokens.translation: Which driveth all the stars of heaven and their planets From the east to the west in the might of its movement.
tokens.transliteration: hah-mahn-heeg kohl koh-khe-vey shah-mah-yeem ve-gahl-gah-ley-hehm mee-meez-rahkh le-mah-ah-rahv le-toh-kehf mah-hah-lah-khoh.

tokens.hebrew: הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶה פַּעַם בְּכָל יוֹם לִפְאַת מַעֲרָב לְמַלְכּוֹ וּמַמְלִיכוֹ.
tokens.translation: Once a day it bows down in the west to the King who enthroned it,
tokens.transliteration: hah-meesh-tah-khah-veh pah-ahm be-khohl yohm leef-aht mah-ah-rahv le-mahl-koh oo-mahm-lee-khoh.

tokens.translation: And all the creatures of the universe in its midst

tokens.hebrew: כְּגַרְגִּיר חַרְדָּל בַּיָּם הַגָּדוֹל לְתֹקֶף גָּדְלוֹ וְעֶרְכּוֹ.
tokens.translation: are as a grain of mustard in the vast ocean From the mighty vastness of its breadth.
tokens.transliteration: ke-gahr-geer khahr-dahl bah-yahm hah-gah-dohl le-toh-kehf gohd-loh ve-ehr-koh.

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא וּגְדֻלָּתוֹ נֶחְשַׁב כְּאַיִן וּכְאֶפֶס לִגְדֻלַּת בּוֹרְאוֹ וּמַלְכּוֹ:
tokens.translation: Yet all this and its greatness are accounted as nothing and naught By the side of the greatness of its Creator and King,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo oo-ge-doo-lah-toh nehkh-shahv ke-ah-yeen oo-khe-eh-fehs leeg-doo-laht boh-re-oh oo-mahl-koh:

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל מַעֲלוֹתָיו וְגָדְלוֹ. מֵאֶפֶס וָתֹהוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ לוֹ:
tokens.translation: And all its sublimities and grandeur "Are vain and void in comparison with Him."
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl mah-ah-loh-tahv ve-gohd-loh. meh-eh-fehs vah-toh-hoo nehkh-she-voo loh:

sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.24
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָבִין סוֹדוֹת נוֹרְאוֹתֶיךָ בַּהֲרִימְךָ עַל גַּלְגַּל הַתְּשִׁיעִי גַּלְגַּל הַשֵּׂכֶל הוּא הַהֵיכָל לִפְנָי. הָעֲשִׂירִי יִהְיֶה קֹדֶשׁ לַיָי:
tokens.translation: Who shall understand the mysteries of Thy creations? For Thou hast exalted above the ninth sphere the sphere of Intelligence. It is the Temple confronting us, "The tenth that shall be sacred to the Lord,"
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-veen soh-doht noh-re-oh-tey-khah bah-hah-ree-me-khah ahl gahl-gahl hah-te-shee-ee gahl-gahl hah-seh-khehl hoo hah-hey-khahl leef-nahy. hah-ah-see-ree yeeh-yeh koh-dehsh lah-yahy:

tokens.hebrew: וְהוּא הַגַּלְגַּל הַנַּעֲלֶה עַל כָּל עֶלְיוֹן. אֲשֶׁר לֹא יַשִּׂיגֵהוּ רַעְיוֹן.
tokens.translation: It is the Sphere transcending height, To which conception cannot reach,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hoo hah-gahl-gahl hah-nah-ah-leh ahl kohl ehl-yohn. ah-shehr loh yah-see-geh-hoo rah-yohn.

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁם הַחֶבְיוֹן אֲשֶׁר הוּא לִכְבוֹדְךָ לְאַפִּרְיוֹן.
tokens.translation: And there stands the veiled palanquin of Thy glory.
tokens.transliteration: ve-shahm hah-khehv-yohn ah-shehr hoo leekh-voh-de-khah le-ah-peer-yohn.

tokens.hebrew: מִכֶּסֶף הָאֱמֶת יָצַקְתָּ אוֹתוֹ. וּמִזְּהַב הַשֵּׂכֶל עָשִׂיתָ רְפִידָתוֹ.
tokens.translation: From the silver of Truth hast Thou cast it, And of the gold of Reason hast Thou wrought its arms,
tokens.transliteration: mee-keh-sehf hah-eh-meht yah-tsahk-tah oh-toh. oo-mee-ze-hahv hah-seh-khehl ah-see-tah re-fee-dah-toh.

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל עַמּוּדֵי צֶדֶק שַׂמְתָּ מְסִבָּתוֹ. וּמִכֹּחֲךָ מְצִיאוּתוֹ.
tokens.translation: And on a pillar of Righteousness set its cushions And from Thy power is its existence,
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl ah-moo-dey tseh-dehk sahm-tah me-see-bah-toh. oo-mee-koh-khah-khah me-tsee-oo-toh.

tokens.translation: And from and toward Thee its yearning, "And unto Thee shall be its desire."

translationVersions.versionTitle: Selected Religious Poems of Solomon Ibn Gabirol, trans. Israel Zangwill. JPS, Philadelphia, 1923

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.25
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַעֲמִיק לְמַחְשְׁבוֹתֶיךָ בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ מִזִּיו הַשְּׁכִינָה זֹהַר הַנְּשָׁמוֹת. וְהַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָרָמוֹת.
tokens.translation: Who shall descend as deep as Thy thoughts? For from the splendour of the sphere of Intelligence Thou hast wrought the radiance of souls,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-ah-meek le-mahkh-she-voh-tey-khah bah-ah-soh-te-khah mee-zeev hah-she-khee-nah zoh-hahr hah-ne-shah-moht. ve-hah-ne-fah-shoht hah-rah-moht.

tokens.translation: And the high angels that are the messengers of Thy will, The ministers of Thy presence,

tokens.hebrew: הֵם אַדִּירֵי כֹחַ וְגִבּוֹרֵי מַמְלֶכֶת. בְּיָדָם לַהַט הַחֶרֶב הַמִּתְהַפֶּכֶת.
tokens.translation: Majestic of power and great in the Kingdom of heaven, "In their hand the flaming sword that turneth every way,"
tokens.transliteration: hehm ah-dee-rey khoh-ahkh ve-gee-boh-rey mahm-leh-kheht. be-yah-dahm lah-haht hah-kheh-rehv hah-meet-hah-peh-kheht.

tokens.hebrew: וְעוֹשֵׂי מְלֶאכֶת. אֶל אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶה שָׁמָּה הָרוּחַ לָלֶכֶת:
tokens.translation: Performing their work whithersoever the spirit wafteth them,
tokens.transliteration: ve-oh-sey me-leh-kheht. ehl ah-shehr yeeh-yeh shah-mah hah-roo-ahkh lah-leh-kheht:

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּם גִּזְרוֹת פְּנִינִיּוֹת וְחַיּוֹת עִלִּיּוֹת. חִיצוֹנִיּוֹת וּפְנִימִיּוֹת. הֲלִיכוֹתֶךָ צוֹפִיּוֹת:
tokens.translation: All of them shapen to comeliness, shimmering as pearls, Transcendent creatures, Angels of the outer courts, or angels of the Presence, Watching Thy movements.
tokens.transliteration: koo-lahm geez-roht pe-nee-nee-yoht ve-khah-yoht ee-lee-yoht. khee-tsoh-nee-yoht oo-fe-nee-mee-yoht. hah-lee-khoh-teh-khah tsoh-fee-yoht:

tokens.hebrew: מִמָּקוֹם קָדוֹשׁ יְהַלֵּכוּ. וּמִמְּקוֹר הָאוֹר יִמָּשֵׁכוּ:
tokens.translation: From a holy place are they come, And from the fount of light are they drawn.
tokens.transliteration: mee-mah-kohm kah-dohsh ye-hah-leh-khoo. oo-mee-me-kohr hah-ohr yee-mah-sheh-khoo:

tokens.translation: They are divided into companies, And on their banner are signs graven

tokens.hebrew: בְּעֵט סוֹפֵר מָהִיר חֲרוּתוֹת. מֵהֶם נְסִיכוֹת וּמֵהֶם מְשָׁרְתוֹת:
tokens.translation: of the pen of the swift scribe. There are superior and attendant bands,
tokens.transliteration: be-eht soh-fehr mah-heer khah-roo-toht. meh-hehm ne-see-khoht oo-meh-hehm me-shah-re-toht:

tokens.translation: And hosts running and returning,

tokens.hebrew: לֹא עֲיֵפוֹת וְלֹא נִלְאוֹת. רוֹאוֹת וְלֹא נִרְאוֹת:
tokens.translation: But never weary and never faint, Seeing but invisible.
tokens.transliteration: loh ah-yeh-foht ve-loh neel-oht. roh-oht ve-loh neer-oht:

tokens.hebrew: מֵהֶם חֲצוּבֵי לֶהָבוֹת. וּמֵהֶם רוּחוֹת נוֹשְׁבוֹת: מֵהֶם מֵאֵשׁ וּמִמַּיִם מֻרְכָּבוֹת:
tokens.translation: And there are some wrought of flame, And some are wafted air, And some compounded of fire and of water,
tokens.transliteration: meh-hehm khah-tsoo-vey leh-hah-voht. oo-meh-hehm roo-khoht noh-she-voht: meh-hehm meh-ehsh oo-mee-mah-yeem moor-kah-voht:

tokens.translation: And there are Seraphim in burning rows,
And winged lightnings and darting arrows of fire,

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל כַּת מֵהֶם מִשְׁתַּחֲוָה לְרוֹכֵב עֲרָבוֹת. וּבְרוּם עוֹלָם נִצָּבִים לַאֲלָפִים וְלִרְבָבוֹת:
tokens.translation: And each troop of them all bows itself down "To Him who rideth the highest heavens." And in the supreme sphere of the universe they stand in thousands and tens of thousands,
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl kaht meh-hehm meesh-tah-khah-vah le-roh-khehv ah-rah-voht. oo-ve-room oh-lahm nee-tsah-veem lah-ah-lah-feem ve-leer-vah-voht:

tokens.hebrew: נֶחֱלָקִים לְמִשְׁמָרוֹת. בַּיּוֹם וּבַלַּיְלָה לְרֹאשׁ אַשְׁמוּרוֹת.
tokens.translation: Divided into watches, That change daily and nightly at the beginning of their vigils,
tokens.transliteration: neh-kheh-lah-keem le-meesh-mah-roht. bah-yohm oo-vah-lahy-lah le-rohsh ahsh-moo-roht.

tokens.translation: For the ritual of psalms and songs, "To Him who is girt with omnipotence."

tokens.hebrew: כֻּלָּם בַּחֲרָדָה וּרְעָדָה כּוֹרְעִים וּמִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לָךְ. וְאוֹמְרִים מוֹדִים אֲנַחְנוּ לָךְ:
tokens.translation: All of them with dread and trembling bow and prostrate themselves to Thee, Saying: To Thee we acknowledge
tokens.transliteration: koo-lahm bah-khah-rah-dah oo-re-ah-dah koh-re-eem oo-meesh-tah-khah-veem lahkh. ve-oh-me-reem moh-deem ah-nahkh-noo lahkh:

tokens.translation: That Thou art He, the Lord our God;
Thou hast made us, and not we ourselves, And the work of Thy hands are we all.

tokens.hebrew: וְכִי אַתָּה אֲדוֹנֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ. וְאַתָּה בוֹרְאֵנוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עֵדֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: For Thou art our Lord, and we are Thy servants, Thou art our Creator, and we are Thy witnesses.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khee ah-tah ah-doh-ney-noo vah-ah-nahkh-noo ah-vah-dey-khah. ve-ah-tah voh-re-eh-noo vah-ah-nahkh-noo eh-dey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָבֹא עַד תְּכוּנָתֶךָ. בְּהַגְבִּיהֲךָ לְמַעְלָה מִגַּלְגַּל הַשֵּׂכֶל כִּסֵּא הַכָּבוֹד אֲשֶׁר שָׁם נְוֵה הַחֶבְיוֹן וְהַהוֹד.
tokens.translation: Who can approach Thy seat? For beyond the sphere of Intelligence hastThou established the throne of Thy glory; There standeth the splendour of Thy veiled habitation,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-voh ahd te-khoo-nah-teh-khah. be-hahg-bee-hah-khah le-mah-lah mee-gahl-gahl hah-seh-khehl kee-seh hah-kah-vohd ah-shehr shahm ne-veh hah-khehv-yohn ve-hah-hohd.

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁם הַסּוֹד וְהַיְסוֹד. וְעָדָיו יַגִּיעַ הַשֵּׂכֶל וְשָׁם יַעֲמֹד:
tokens.translation: And the mystery and the foundation. Thus far reacheth Intelligence, but cometh here to a standstill,
tokens.transliteration: ve-shahm hah-sohd ve-hah-ye-sohd. ve-ah-dahv yah-gee-ah hah-seh-khehl ve-shahm yah-ah-mohd:

tokens.hebrew: וּמִלְמַעְלָה גָאִיתָ וְעָלִיתָ עַל כֵּס תַּעֲצוּמָךְ. וְאִישׁ לֹא יַעֲלֶה עִמָּךְ:
tokens.translation: For higher still hast Thou mounted, and ascended Thy mighty throne, "And no man may go up with Thee."
tokens.transliteration: oo-meel-mah-lah gah-ee-tah ve-ah-lee-tah ahl kehs tah-ah-tsoo-mahkh. ve-eesh loh yah-ah-leh ee-mahkh:

sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.27
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַעֲשֶׂה כְמַעֲשֶׂיךָ. בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ תַּחַת כִּסֵּא כְבוֹדֶךָ. מַעֲמָד לְנַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: O Lord, who shall do deeds like unto Thine? For Thou hast established under the throne of Thy glory A standing-place for the souls of Thy saints,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-ah-seh khe-mah-ah-sey-khah. bah-ah-soh-te-khah tah-khaht kee-seh khe-voh-deh-khah. mah-ah-mahd le-nahf-shoht khah-see-dey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁם נְוֵה הַנְּשָׁמוֹת הַטְּהוֹרוֹת. אֲשֶׁר בִּצְרוֹר הַחַיִּים צְרוּרוֹת:
tokens.translation: And there is the abode of the pure souls That are bound up in the bundle of life.
tokens.transliteration: ve-shahm ne-veh hah-ne-shah-moht hah-te-hoh-roht. ah-shehr beets-rohr hah-khah-yeem tse-roo-roht:

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר יִיגְעוּ וְיִיעֲפוּ שָׁם יַחֲלִיפוּ כֹחַ.
tokens.translation: They who were weary and faint here await new strength,
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-shehr yee-ge-oo ve-yee-ah-foo shahm yah-khah-lee-foo khoh-ahkh.

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁם יָנוּחוּ יְגִיעֵי כֹחַ. וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי נֹחַ:
tokens.translation: And those who failed of strength may here find repose; For these are the children of rest,
tokens.transliteration: ve-shahm yah-noo-khoo ye-gee-ey khoh-ahkh. ve-eh-leh be-ney noh-ahkh:

tokens.hebrew: וּבוֹ נֹעַם בְּלִי תַכְלִית וְקִצְבָה. וְהוּא הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא:
tokens.translation: And here is delight without end or limit, For it is The-World-To-Come.
tokens.transliteration: oo-voh noh-ahm be-lee tahkh-leet ve-keets-vah. ve-hoo hah-oh-lahm hah-bah:

tokens.hebrew: וְשָׁם מַעֲמָדוֹת וּמַרְאוֹת. לַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָעוֹמְדוֹת בְּמַרְאוֹת הַצּוֹבְאוֹת.
tokens.translation: And here are stations and seeing-places for the standing souls, Whence, in "mirrors of the serving-women,"
tokens.transliteration: ve-shahm mah-ah-mah-doht oo-mahr-oht. lah-ne-fah-shoht hah-oh-me-doht be-mahr-oht hah-tsoh-ve-oht.

tokens.translation: They can behold and be seen of the Lord.

tokens.hebrew: שׁוֹכְנוֹת בְּהֵיכְלֵי מֶלֶךְ. וְעוֹמְדוֹת עַל שֻׁלְחַן הַמֶּלֶךְ.
tokens.translation: In the palaces of the King do they dwell, And at the King's table stand,
tokens.transliteration: shoh-khe-noht be-hey-khe-ley meh-lehkh. ve-oh-me-doht ahl shool-khahn hah-meh-lehkh.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִתְעַדְּנוֹת בְּמֶתֶק פְּרִי הַשֵּׂכֶל וְהוּא יִתֵּן מַעֲדַנֵּי מֶלֶךְ:
tokens.translation: And glory in the sweetness of the fruit of Intelligence, For He giveth them of the dainties of the King.
tokens.transliteration: oo-meet-ah-de-noht be-meh-tehk pe-ree hah-seh-khehl ve-hoo yee-tehn mah-ah-dah-ney meh-lehkh:

tokens.hebrew: זֹאת הַמְּנוּחָה וְהַנַּחֲלָה. אֲשֶׁר אֵין תַּכְלִית לְטוּבָהּ וְיָפְיָהּ. וְגַם זָבַת חָלָב וּדְבַשׁ הִיא וְזֶה פִּרְיָהּ:
tokens.translation: This is the rest and the heritage Whose goodness and beauty are endless, Such is "the land which floweth with milk and honey and such the fruit thereof."
tokens.transliteration: zoht hah-me-noo-khah ve-hah-nah-khah-lah. ah-shehr eyn tahkh-leet le-too-vahh ve-yohf-yahh. ve-gahm zah-vaht khah-lahv oo-de-vahsh hee ve-zeh peer-yahh:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יְגַלֶּה צְפוּנוֹתֶיךָ בַּעֲשׂוֹתְךָ בַּמָּרוֹם חֲדָרִים וְאוֹצָרוֹת. מֵהֶם נוֹרָאוֹת סְפוּרוֹת. וּדְבַר גְּבוּרוֹת:
tokens.translation: O Lord, who can unroll Thy mysteries? For Thou hast made in the Height chambers and store-houses, Some of them awesome to tell of, a tale of mighty doings,
tokens.transliteration: mee ye-gah-leh tse-foo-noh-tey-khah bah-ah-soh-te-khah bah-mah-rohm khah-dah-reem ve-oh-tsah-roht. meh-hehm noh-rah-oht se-foo-roht. oo-de-vahr ge-voo-roht:

tokens.translation: And some treasuries of life for the pure and the clean.
For some are treasures of salvation to those who have returned from iniquity,

tokens.hebrew: וּמֵהֶם אוֹצְרוֹת אֵשׁ וְנַחֲלֵי גָּפְרִית. לְעוֹבְרֵי בְרִית:
tokens.translation: And some are treasures of fire, And rivers of brimstone For the breakers of the covenant.
tokens.transliteration: oo-meh-hehm oh-tse-roht ehsh ve-nah-khah-ley gah-fe-reet. le-oh-ve-rey ve-reet:

tokens.hebrew: וְאוֹצְרוֹת שׁוּחוֹת עֲמוּקוֹת לֹא יִכְבֶּה אִשָּׁם. זְעוּם יְיָ יִפָּל שָׁם:
tokens.translation: And there is a provision of deep pits whose fire is never quenched. He that is abhorred of the Lord shall fall therein.
tokens.transliteration: ve-oh-tse-roht shoo-khoht ah-moo-koht loh yeekh-beh ee-shahm. ze-oom ye-yah yee-pahl shahm:

tokens.translation: And there are caverns of storm-winds and tempests And congelation and cold,

tokens.hebrew: וְאוֹצְרוֹת בָּרָד וְקֶרַח וְצִיָּה וָשֶׁלֶג. גַּם חֹם וְנוֹזְלֵי פֶלֶג:
tokens.translation: And treasures of hail and ice and snow and drought, Also of heat and flowing channels
tokens.transliteration: ve-oh-tse-roht bah-rahd ve-keh-rahkh ve-tsee-yah vah-sheh-lehg. gahm khohm ve-noh-ze-ley feh-lehg:

tokens.hebrew: וְקִיטוֹר וּכְפוֹר וְעָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל. וַעֲלָטָה וָאֹפֶל:
tokens.translation: And of thick smoke and hoar-frost and of clouds and thick cloud, And darkness and gloom.
tokens.transliteration: ve-kee-tohr oo-khe-fohr ve-ah-nahn vah-ah-rah-fehl. vah-ah-lah-tah vah-oh-fehl:

tokens.hebrew: הַכֹּל הֲכִינוֹתָ בְּעִתּוֹ אִם לְחֶסֶד אִם לְמִשְׁפָּט שַׂמְתּוֹ.
tokens.translation: The whole hast Thou prepared in its due season, "Thou hast ordained it for mercy or judgment,
tokens.transliteration: hah-kohl hah-khee-noh-tah be-ee-toh eem le-kheh-sehd eem le-meesh-paht sahm-toh.

tokens.translation: And established it, O Rock, for correction!"

tokens.hebrew: מִי יָכִיל עָצְמָתֶךָ בְּבָרְאֲךָ מִזִּיו כְּבוֹדְךָ יִפְעַת טְהוֹרָה. מִצּוּר הַצּוּר נִגְזָרָה. וּמִמַּקֶּבֶת בּוֹר נֻקָּרָה:
tokens.translation: O Lord, who can comprehend Thy power? For Thou hast created for the splendour of Thy glory a pure radiance "Hewn from the rock of rocks and digged from the bottom of the pit."
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-kheel ah-tse-mah-teh-khah be-vah-re-ah-khah mee-zeev ke-voh-de-khah yeef-aht te-hoh-rah. mee-tsoor hah-tsoor neeg-zah-rah. oo-mee-mah-keh-veht bohr noo-kah-rah:

tokens.hebrew: וְאָצַלְתָּ עָלֶיהָ רוּחַ חָכְמָה. וְקָרָאתָ אוֹתָהּ נְשָׁמָה:
tokens.translation: Thou hast imparted to it the spirit of wisdom And called it the Soul.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-tsahl-tah ah-ley-hah roo-ahkh khohkh-mah. ve-kah-rah-tah oh-tahh ne-shah-mah:

tokens.hebrew: עֲשִׂיתָהּ מִלַּהֲבוֹת אֵשׁ הַשֵּׂכֶל חֲצוּבָה. וְנִשְׁמָתוֹ כָּאֵשׁ בּוֹעֲרָה בָהּ:
tokens.translation: And of flames of intellectual fire hast Thou wrought its form, And like a burning fire hast Thou wafted it,
tokens.transliteration: ah-see-tahh mee-lah-hah-voht ehsh hah-seh-khehl khah-tsoo-vah. ve-neesh-mah-toh kah-ehsh boh-ah-rah vahh:

tokens.hebrew: שִׁלַּחְתָּהּ אֶל הַגּוּף לְעָבְדוֹ וּלְשָׁמְרֵהוּ. וְהִיא כָּאֵשׁ בְּתוֹכוֹ וְלֹא תִשְׂרְפֵהוּ.
tokens.translation: And sent it to the body to serve and guard it, And it is as fire in the midst thereof yet doth not consume it,
tokens.transliteration: shee-lahkh-tahh ehl hah-goof le-ah-ve-doh oo-le-shah-me-reh-hoo. ve-hee kah-ehsh be-toh-khoh ve-loh tees-re-feh-hoo.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מֵאֵשׁ הַנְּשָׁמָה נִבְרָא הַגּוּף וְיָצָא מֵאַיִן לַיֵּשׁ. מִפְּנֵי אֲשֶׁר יָרַד עָלָיו יְיָ בָּאֵשׁ:
tokens.translation: For it is from the fire of the soul that the body hath been created, And goeth from Nothingness to Being, "Because the Lord descended on him in fire."
tokens.transliteration: kee meh-ehsh hah-ne-shah-mah neev-rah hah-goof ve-yah-tsah meh-ah-yeen lah-yehsh. mee-pe-ney ah-shehr yah-rahd ah-lahv ye-yah bah-ehsh:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יַגִּיעַ לְחָכְמָתֶךָ בְּתִתְּךָ לַנֶּפֶשׁ כֹּחַ הַדַּעַת אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ תְּקוּעָה.
tokens.translation: O Lord, who can reach Thy wisdom? For Thou gavest the soul the faculty of knowledge that is fixed therein,
tokens.transliteration: mee yah-gee-ah le-khohkh-mah-teh-khah be-tee-te-khah lah-neh-fehsh koh-ahkh hah-dah-aht ah-shehr bahh te-koo-ah.

tokens.translation: And knowledge is the fount of her glory.

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל כֵּן לֹא יִשְׁלוֹט עָלֶיהָ כִּלָּיוֹן וְתִתְקַיֵּם כְּפִי קִיּוּם יְסוֹדָהּ. וְזֶה עִנְיָנָהּ וְסוֹדָהּ:
tokens.translation: Therefore hath destruction no power over her, But she maintaineth herself by the stability of her foundation, For such is her nature and secret;
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl kehn loh yeesh-loht ah-ley-hah kee-lah-yohn ve-teet-kah-yehm ke-fee kee-yoom ye-soh-dahh. ve-zeh een-yah-nahh ve-soh-dahh:

tokens.hebrew: וְהַנֶּפֶשׁ הַחֲכָמָה לֹא תִרְאֶה מָוֶת. אַךְ תְּקַבֵּל עַל עֲוֹנָהּ עֹנֶשׁ מַר מִמָּוֶת:
tokens.translation: The soul with her wisdom shall not see death. Nevertheless shall her punishment be visited upon her, A punishment bitterer than death,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-neh-fehsh hah-khah-khah-mah loh teer-eh mah-veht. ahkh te-kah-behl ahl ah-voh-nahh oh-nehsh mahr mee-mah-veht:

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם טָהֳרָה תָּפִיק רָצוֹן. וַתִּשְׂחַק לְיוֹם אַחֲרוֹן.
tokens.translation: Though be she pure she shall obtain favour And shall laugh on the last day.
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem toh-hoh-rah tah-feek rah-tsohn. vah-tees-khahk le-yohm ah-khah-rohn.

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם נִטְמְאָה תָּנוּד בְּשֶׁצֶף קֶצֶף וְחָרוֹן:
tokens.translation: But if she hath been defiled, She shall wander to and fro for a space in wrath and anger,
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem neet-me-ah tah-nood be-sheh-tsehf keh-tsehf ve-khah-rohn:

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל יְמֵי טֻמְאָתָהּ בָּדָד תֵּשֵׁב גּוֹלָה וְסוּרָה.
tokens.translation: And all the days of her uncleanness Shall she dwell vagabond and outcast;
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl ye-mey toom-ah-tahh bah-dahd teh-shehv goh-lah ve-soo-rah.

tokens.hebrew: בְּכָל קֹדֶשׁ לֹא תִגָּע וְאֶל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ לֹא תָבֹא עַד מְלֹאת יְמֵי טָהֳרָהּ:
tokens.translation: She shall touch no hallowed thing, And to the sanctuary she shall not come Till the days of her purification be fulfilled.
tokens.transliteration: be-khohl koh-dehsh loh tee-gah ve-ehl hah-meek-dahsh loh tah-voh ahd me-loht ye-mey toh-hoh-rahh:

tokens.hebrew: מִי יִגְמֹל עַל טוֹבוֹתֶיךָ בְּשׂוּמְךָ הַנְּשָׁמָה לַגּוּף לְהַחֲיוֹתוֹ. וְאֹרַח לְהוֹרוֹתוֹ לְהַרְאוֹתוֹ.
tokens.translation: O Lord, who shall requite Thy goodness? For Thou hast placed the soul in the body to vivify it, And to teach and show it the path of life
tokens.transliteration: mee yeeg-mohl ahl toh-voh-tey-khah be-soo-me-khah hah-ne-shah-mah lah-goof le-hah-khah-yoh-toh. ve-oh-rahkh le-hoh-roh-toh le-hahr-oh-toh.

tokens.translation: And to deliver it from evil;
Thou hast formed man from a pinch of clay and breathed into him a soul,

tokens.hebrew: וְאָצַלְתָּ עָלָיו רוּחַ חָכְמָה. אֲשֶׁר בָּהּ יִבָּדֵל מִבְּהֵמָה. וְיַעֲלֶה אֶל מַעֲלָה רָמָה:
tokens.translation: And didst impart to him the spirit of wisdom Whereby man is divided from the beasts That he may ascend to a higher sphere.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-tsahl-tah ah-lahv roo-ahkh khohkh-mah. ah-shehr bahh yee-bah-dehl mee-be-heh-mah. ve-yah-ah-leh ehl mah-ah-lah rah-mah:

tokens.hebrew: שַׂמְתּוֹ בְּעוֹלָמְךָ סָגוּר וְאַתָּה מִחוּץ תָּכִין מַעֲשָׂיו וְתִרְאֶנּוּ.
tokens.translation: Thou hast him enclosed in Thy universe, And directest and beholdest his deeds from without,
tokens.transliteration: sahm-toh be-oh-lah-me-khah sah-goor ve-ah-tah mee-khoots tah-kheen mah-ah-sahv ve-teer-eh-noo.

tokens.hebrew: וְכָל אֲשֶׁר מִמְּךָ יַעְלִימֶנּוּ. מִבַּיִת וּמִחוּץ תְּצַפֶּנּוּ:
tokens.translation: And all that would conceal him from Thee Thou beholdest from within and without.
tokens.transliteration: ve-khohl ah-shehr mee-me-khah yah-lee-meh-noo. mee-bah-yeet oo-mee-khoots te-tsah-peh-noo:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.32
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: Who shall know the secret of Thy operations?
For Thou hast provided the body with the means to do Thy work,
And Thou hast given it eyes to see Thy signs
And ears to hear of Thy tremendous deeds,
And thought to understand the fringe of Thy secrets,
And a mouth to declare Thy praise,
And a tongue to proclaim Thy might to all comers,

tokens.hebrew: כָּמוֹנִי הַיּוֹם אֲנִי עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן אֲמָתֶךָ.
tokens.translation: Even as I to-day, "Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid",
tokens.transliteration: kah-moh-nee hah-yohm ah-nee ahv-de-khah behn ah-mah-teh-khah.

tokens.hebrew: הַמְסַפֵּר כְּפִי קֹצֶר לְשׁוֹנִי מְעַט מִזְעָר מֵרוֹמְמוּתֶךָ.
tokens.translation: Am declaring according to the feebleness of my tongue. A shadow of a shade of Thy sublimity,
tokens.transliteration: hah-me-sah-pehr ke-fee koh-tsehr le-shoh-nee me-aht meez-ahr meh-roh-me-moo-teh-khah.

tokens.translation: For these are but a fraction of Thy ways.

tokens.hebrew: וּמֶה עָצְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶם. כִּי חַיִּים הֵם לְמֹצְאֵיהֶם:
tokens.translation: How mighty then must be the sum of them, "For they are life to those who find them."
tokens.transliteration: oo-meh ah-tse-moo rah-shey-hehm. kee khah-yeem hehm le-moh-tse-ey-hehm:

tokens.translation: By them, all who hear of them may recognize Thee,
Even if they cannot see the face of Thy splendour.
For whoso hath not heard of Thy might,
How can he recognize Thy Godhead,
And how can Thy truth enter his heart,
And how can he fix his thoughts on Thy service?

tokens.hebrew: עַל כֵּן מָצָא עַבְדְּךָ אֶת לִבּוֹ לִזְכּוֹר לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהָיו. מְעַט מִזְעָר מֵרָאשֵׁי תְהִלּוֹתָיו:
tokens.translation: Therefore hath Thy servant found the heart To make mention before his God Of a shade of a shadow of the sum of His praises.
tokens.transliteration: ahl kehn mah-tsah ahv-de-khah eht lee-boh leez-kohr leef-ney eh-loh-hahv. me-aht meez-ahr meh-rah-shey te-hee-loh-tahv:

tokens.hebrew: אוּלַי בָּם מֵעֲוֹנוֹ יַשֶּׁה. וּבַמֶּה יִתְרַצֶּה זֶה אֶל אֲדוֹנָיו הֲלֹא בְרָאשֵׁי:
tokens.translation: Peradventure thereby less shall be exacted of his iniquity "For wherewith should he reconcile himself unto his Lord if not with these heads?"
tokens.transliteration: oo-lahy bahm meh-ah-voh-noh yah-sheh. oo-vah-meh yeet-rah-tseh zeh ehl ah-doh-nahv hah-loh ve-rah-shey:

translationVersions.versionTitle: Selected Religious Poems of Solomon Ibn Gabirol, trans. Israel Zangwill. JPS, Philadelphia, 1923

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.33
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי בֹּשְׁתִּי וְנִכְלַמְתִּי לַעֲמֹד לְפָנֶיךָ לְדַעְתִּי.
tokens.translation: O God, I am ashamed and confounded To stand before Thee with this my knowledge
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hahy boh-she-tee ve-neekh-lahm-tee lah-ah-mohd le-fah-ney-khah le-dah-tee.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי כְפִי עָצְמַת גְּדֻלָתֶךָ כֵּן תַּכְלִית דַּלּוּתִי וְשִׁפְלוּתִי:
tokens.translation: That even as the might of Thy greatness, So is the completeness of my poverty and humbleness,
tokens.transliteration: kee khe-fee ah-tse-maht ge-doo-lah-teh-khah kehn tahkh-leet dah-loo-tee ve-sheef-loo-tee:

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי תֹּקֶף יְכָלְתֶּךָ כֵּן חֻלְשַׁת יְכָלְתִּי.
tokens.translation: That even as the might of Thy potency So is the weakness of my ability,
tokens.transliteration: oo-khe-fee toh-kehf ye-khah-le-teh-khah kehn khool-shaht ye-khah-le-tee.

tokens.translation: And that even as Thou art perfect, so am I wanting.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אַתָּה אֶחָד וְאַתָּה חַי וְאַתָּה גִּבּוֹר וְאַתָּה קַיָּם וְאַתָּה גָדוֹל וְאַתָּה חָכָם וְאַתָּה אֱלוֹהַּ:
tokens.translation: For Thou art a Unity, and Thou art living, Thou art mighty, and Thou art permanent, And Thou art great, and Thou art wise, and Thou art God!
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-tah eh-khahd ve-ah-tah khahy ve-ah-tah gee-bohr ve-ah-tah kah-yahm ve-ah-tah gah-dohl ve-ah-tah khah-khahm ve-ah-tah eh-loh-ahh:

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי גוּשׁ וְרִמָּה. עָפָר מִן הָאֲדָמָה.
tokens.translation: And I am but a clod, and a worm, Dust from the ground,
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-nee goosh ve-ree-mah. ah-fahr meen hah-ah-dah-mah.

tokens.translation: A vessel full of shame, A mute stone, A passing shadow,

tokens.hebrew: צֵל עוֹבֵר רוּחַ הוֹלֵךְ וְלֹא יָשׁוּב. חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב:
tokens.translation: "A wind that fleeth away and returneth not again." To an asp akin,
tokens.transliteration: tsehl oh-vehr roo-ahkh hoh-lehkh ve-loh yah-shoov. khah-maht ahkh-shoov:

tokens.translation: Deceitful underneath, Uncircumcised of heart,
Great in wrath, Craftsman in sin and deception,

tokens.hebrew: גְּבַהּ עֵינַיִם. קְצַר אַפַּיִם. טְמֵא שְׂפָתַיִם.
tokens.translation: Haughty of eye, Short in forbearance, Impure of lips,
tokens.transliteration: ge-vahh ey-nah-yeem. ke-tsahr ah-pah-yeem. te-meh se-fah-tah-yeem.

tokens.translation: Crooked of ways, And hot-footed.

tokens.hebrew: מָה אֲנִי מֶה חַיַּי וּמַה גְּבוּרָתִי. וּמַה צִדְקָתִי.
tokens.translation: What am I? What is my life? What my might and what my righteousness?
tokens.transliteration: mah ah-nee meh khah-yahy oo-mahh ge-voo-rah-tee. oo-mahh tseed-kah-tee.

tokens.hebrew: נֶחְשָׁב לְאַיִן כָּל יְמֵי הֱיוֹתִי. וְאַף כִּי אַחֲרֵי מוֹתִי:
tokens.translation: Naught is the sum of me all the days of my being, And how much the more so after my death!
tokens.transliteration: nehkh-shahv le-ah-yeen kohl ye-mey heh-yoh-tee. ve-ahf kee ah-khah-rey moh-tee:

tokens.translation: From nothing I came, And to nothing I go.

tokens.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה בָאתִי לְפָנֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר לֹא כַדָּת בְּעַזּוּת מֵצַח וְטֻמְאַת רַעְיוֹנִים.
tokens.translation: Lo! before Thee am I come, as one "not according to the law," With insolence of brow, And uncleanness of thoughts,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hee-neh vah-tee le-fah-ney-khah ah-shehr loh khah-daht be-ah-zoot meh-tsahkh ve-toom-aht rah-yoh-neem.

tokens.translation: And a lewd desire On his idols turned,
And lust showing itself master;
With a soul impure And a heart unclean, Perishing and corrupted,

tokens.hebrew: וְגוּף נָגוּף. מְלֹא אֲסַפְסוּף. יוֹסִיף וְלֹא יָסוּף:
tokens.translation: And a body plagued With a rabble of pains Increasing until increase is impossible.
tokens.transliteration: ve-goof nah-goof. me-loh ah-sahf-soof. yoh-seef ve-loh yah-soof:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.34
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי עֲוֹנוֹתַי עָצְמוּ מִסַּפֵּר. וְאַשְׁמוֹתַי עָצְמוּ מִלִּזְכֹּר:
tokens.translation: O my God, I know that my sins are too great to tell, And my trespasses too many to remember,
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hahy yah-dah-tee kee ah-voh-noh-tahy ah-tse-moo mee-sah-pehr. ve-ahsh-moh-tahy ah-tse-moo mee-leez-kohr:

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ אֶזְכֹּר מֵהֶם כְּטִפָּה מִן הַיָּם. וְאֶתְוַדֶּה בָּהֶם אוּלַי אַשְׁבִּיחַ שְׁאוֹן גַּלֵּיהֶם וְדָכְיָם:
tokens.translation: Yet as a drop from the sea will I make mention of some, And make confession of them; Perhaps I shall silence the roar of their waves and their crashing,
tokens.transliteration: ahkh ehz-kohr meh-hehm ke-tee-pah meen hah-yahm. ve-eht-vah-deh bah-hehm oo-lahy ahsh-bee-ahkh she-ohn gah-ley-hehm ve-dah-khe-yahm:

tokens.translation: "And Thou wilt hear from heaven and forgive."
I have trespassed against Thy law, I have despised Thy commandments,

tokens.hebrew: גָּעַלְתִּי בְּלִבִּי וּבְמוֹ פִי. דִּבַּרְתִּי דֹּפִי.
tokens.translation: I have abhorred them in my heart, And with my mouth spoken slander.
tokens.transliteration: gah-ahl-tee be-lee-bee oo-ve-moh fee. dee-bahr-tee doh-fee.

tokens.hebrew: הֶעֱוִיתִי. וְהִרְשַׁעְתִּי. זַדְתִּי. חָמַסְתִּי. טָפַלְתִּי שֶׁקֶר. יָעַצְתִּי רַע לְאֵין חֵקֶר.
tokens.translation: I have committed iniquity, And I have wrought evil, I have been presumptuous, I have done violence, I have plastered over falsehood, I have counselled evil,
tokens.transliteration: heh-eh-vee-tee. ve-heer-shah-tee. zahd-tee. khah-mahs-tee. tah-fahl-tee sheh-kehr. yah-ahts-tee rah le-eyn kheh-kehr.

tokens.hebrew: כִּזַּבְתִּי. לַצְתִּי. מָרַדְתִּי. נִאַצְתִּי. סָרַרְתִּי. עָוִיתִי. פָּשַׁעְתִּי וְעֹרֶף הִקְשֵׁיתִי.
tokens.translation: I have lied, I have scoffed, I have revolted, I have blasphemed, I have been rebellious and perverse and sinful, I have stiffened my neck,
tokens.transliteration: kee-zahv-tee. lahts-tee. mah-rahd-tee. nee-ahts-tee. sah-rahr-tee. ah-vee-tee. pah-shah-tee ve-oh-rehf heek-shey-tee.

tokens.translation: I have loathed Thy rebukes and done wickedly,
I have corrupted my ways, I have strayed from my paths,

tokens.hebrew: עָבַרְתִּי מִמִּצְוֹתֶיךָ וְסַרְתִּי. וְאַתָּה צַדִּיק עַל כָּל הַבָּא עָלַי כִּי אֱמֶת עָשִׂיתָ וַאֲנִי הִרְשָׁעְתִּי:
tokens.translation: I have transgressed and turned away from Thy commandments. But Thou art just in all that is come upon me For Thou hast dealt truly and I have dealt wickedly.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vahr-tee mee-meets-voh-tey-khah ve-sahr-tee. ve-ah-tah tsah-deek ahl kohl hah-bah ah-lahy kee eh-meht ah-see-tah vah-ah-nee heer-shah-e-tee:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.35
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי נָפְלוּ פָנַי בְּזָכְרִי כָּל אֲשֶׁר הִכְעַסְתִּיךָ. כִּי עַל כָּל טוֹבוֹת שֶׁגְּמַלְתַּנִי רָעָה גְּמַלְתִּיךָ:
tokens.translation: O God, my countenance falleth, When I remember all wherein I have provoked Thee. For all the good which Thou hast bestowed on me I have requited Thee with evil.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hahy nah-fe-loo fah-nahy be-zah-khe-ree kohl ah-shehr heekh-ahs-tee-khah. kee ahl kohl toh-voht sheh-ge-mahl-tah-nee rah-ah ge-mahl-tee-khah:

tokens.hebrew: כִּי בְרָאתַנִי לֹא לְצֹרֶךְ רַק נְדָבָה. וְלֹא בְּהֶכְרֵחַ כִּי אִם בְּרָצוֹן וְאַהֲבָה:
tokens.translation: For Thou hast created me not from necessity, but from grace, And not by compulsion of circumstance But by favour and love.
tokens.transliteration: kee ve-rah-tah-nee loh le-tsoh-rehkh rahk ne-dah-vah. ve-loh be-hehkh-reh-ahkh kee eem be-rah-tsohn ve-ah-hah-vah:

tokens.hebrew: וְטֶרֶם הֱיוֹתִי בְּחַסְדְּךָ קִדַּמְתַּנִי. וְנָפַחְתָּ רוּחַ בִּי וְהֶחֱיִיתַנִי.
tokens.translation: And before I was, With Thy mercies didst Thou precede me, And breathe into me a spirit and call me into being,
tokens.transliteration: ve-teh-rehm heh-yoh-tee be-khahs-de-khah kee-dahm-tah-nee. ve-nah-fahkh-tah roo-ahkh bee ve-heh-kheh-yee-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי צֵאתִי לְאַוֵּר הָעוֹלָם לֹא עֲזַבְתָּנִי. אֲבָל כְּאָב חוֹמֵל גִּדַּלְתָּנִי.
tokens.translation: And after I came forth into the light of the world Thou didst not forsake me, But like a tender father didst Thou watch over my growing up,
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-khah-rey tseh-tee le-ah-vehr hah-oh-lahm loh ah-zahv-tah-nee. ah-vahl ke-ahv khoh-mehl gee-dahl-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּכְאוֹמֵן אֶת הַיּוֹנֵק אֲמַנְתַּנִי. עַל שְׁדֵי אִמִּי הִבְטַחְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: And as a nurse fostereth a suckling didst Thou foster me. Upon the breasts of my mother Thou madest me rest trustfully,
tokens.transliteration: oo-khe-oh-mehn eht hah-yoh-nehk ah-mahn-tah-nee. ahl she-dey ee-mee heev-tahkh-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִנְּעִימוֹתֶיךָ הִשְׂבַּעְתַּנִי. וּבְבֹאִי לַעֲמֹד עַל עָמְדִי חִזַקְתָּנִי.
tokens.translation: And with Thy delight didst satisfy me. And when I essayed my feet, Thou didst strengthen my standing
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-ne-ee-moh-tey-khah hees-bah-tah-nee. oo-ve-voh-ee lah-ah-mohd ahl ah-me-dee khee-zahk-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְקַחְתַּנִי עַל זְרוֹעוֹתֶיךָ וְהִרְגַלְתַּנִי. וְחָכְמָה וּמוּסָר לִמַּדְתָּנִי.
tokens.translation: And didst take me in Thine arms and teach me to walk. And wisdom and discipline didst Thou impart to me,
tokens.transliteration: ve-kahkh-tah-nee ahl ze-roh-oh-tey-khah ve-heer-gahl-tah-nee. ve-khohkh-mah oo-moo-sahr lee-mahd-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּמִכָּל צָרָה וְצוּקָה חִלַּצְתַּנִי. וּבְעֵת עֲבָר זַעַם בְּצֵל יָדְךָ הִסְתַּרְתָּנִי.
tokens.translation: And from all trouble and distress didst Thou relieve me, And at the time of the passing away of Thy wrath In the shadow of Thy hand didst Thou hide me,
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-kahl tsah-rah ve-tsoo-kah khee-lahts-tah-nee. oo-ve-eht ah-vahr zah-ahm be-tsehl yah-de-khah hees-tahr-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְכַמֶּה צָרוֹת נֶעְלְמוּ מֵעֵינַי וּמֵהֶם גְּאַלְתָּנִי. וּבְטֶרֶם בּוֹא הַתְּלָאָה הִקְדַּמְתָּ רְפוּאָה לְמַכָּתִי וְלֹא הוֹדַעְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: And from how many sorrows concealed from mine eyes didst Thou deliver me! For before the hardship came Thou didst prepare the remedy for my distress all unbeknown to me,
tokens.transliteration: ve-khah-meh tsah-roht neh-le-moo meh-ey-nahy oo-meh-hehm ge-ahl-tah-nee. oo-ve-teh-rehm boh hah-te-lah-ah heek-dahm-tah re-foo-ah le-mah-kah-tee ve-loh hoh-dah-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְעֵת לֹא נִשְׁמַרְתִּי מִכָּל נֵזֶק אַתָּה שְׁמַרְתָּנִי. וּבְבוֹאִי בֵּין שִׁנֵּי אֲרָיוֹת שִׁבַּרְתָּ מַלְתְּעוֹת כְּפִירִים וּמִשָּׁם הוֹצֵאתַנִי.
tokens.translation: And when from some injury I was unguarded, Thou didst guard me, And when I came within the fangs of lions Thou didst break the teeth of the whelps and deliver me thence,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-eht loh neesh-mahr-tee mee-kohl neh-zehk ah-tah she-mahr-tah-nee. oo-ve-voh-ee beyn shee-ney ah-rah-yoht shee-bahr-tah mahl-te-oht ke-fee-reem oo-mee-shahm hoh-tseh-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְחוּל עָלַי חֳלָיִים רָעִים וְנֶאֱמָנִים חִנָּם רִפֵּאתַנִי. וּבְבוֹא שְׁפָטֶיךָ הָרָעִים עַל הָעוֹלָם מֵחֶרֶב הִצַּלְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: And when evil and constant distress anguished me, Thou hast freely healed me, And when Thy dreadful judgment came upon the world, Thou didst deliver me from the sword
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-khool ah-lahy khoh-lah-yeem rah-eem ve-neh-eh-mah-neem khee-nahm ree-peh-tah-nee. oo-ve-voh she-fah-tey-khah hah-rah-eem ahl hah-oh-lahm meh-kheh-rehv hee-tsahl-tah-nee.

tokens.translation: And didst save me from the pestilence, And in famine didst feed me,
And with plenty sustain me.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְהַכְעִיסִי אוֹתְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יְיַסֵּר אִישׁ אֶת בְּנוֹ יִסַּרְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: And when I provoked Thee, Thou didst chastise me as a father chastiseth his son,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-hahkh-ee-see oh-te-khah kah-ah-shehr ye-yah-sehr eesh eht be-noh yee-sahr-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְקָרְאִי מִצָּרָתִי נַפְשִׁי יָקְרָה בְעֵינֶיךָ וְרֵיקָם לֹא הֱשִׁיבוֹתַנִי:
tokens.translation: And when I called out from the depths of my sorrow, My soul was precious in Thy sight, Nor didst Thou send me empty away.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-kah-re-ee mee-tsah-rah-tee nahf-shee yah-ke-rah ve-ey-ney-khah ve-rey-kahm loh heh-shee-voh-tah-nee:

tokens.hebrew: וְעוֹד הִגְדַּלְתָּ וְהוֹסַפְתָּ עַל כָּל זֶה.
tokens.translation: But all this didst Thou yet exceed and add to
tokens.transliteration: ve-ohd heeg-dahl-tah ve-hoh-sahf-tah ahl kohl zeh.

tokens.hebrew: בְּתִתְּךָ לִי אֱמוּנָה שְׁלֵמָה לְהַאֲמִין כִּי אַתָּה אֵל אֱמֶת. וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת וּנְבִיאֶיךָ אֱמֶת:
tokens.translation: When Thou gavest me a perfect faith To believe that Thou art the God of Truth And that Thy Law is true and Thy prophets are true.
tokens.transliteration: be-tee-te-khah lee eh-moo-nah she-leh-mah le-hah-ah-meen kee ah-tah ehl eh-meht. ve-toh-rah-te-khah eh-meht oo-ne-vee-ey-khah eh-meht:

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹא נָתַתָּ לִי חֵלֶק עִם מוֹרְדֶיךָ וְקָמֶיךָ. וְעַם נָבָל נִאֲצוּ שְׁמֶךָ:
tokens.translation: For Thou hast not set my portion with the rebels and those who rise up against Thee And the foolish multitude that blaspheme Thy name;
tokens.transliteration: ve-loh nah-tah-tah lee kheh-lehk eem moh-re-dey-khah ve-kah-mey-khah. ve-ahm nah-vahl nee-ah-tsoo she-meh-khah:

tokens.translation: Who make mock of Thy law, And contend with Thy servants,
And give the lie to Thy prophets,
Making a show of innocence But with cunning below,

tokens.hebrew: מַרְאִים נֶפֶשׁ זַכָּה וְנִטְהֶרֶת. וְתַחְתֶּיהָ תַּעֲמֹד הַבַּהֶרֶת:
tokens.translation: Exhibiting a pure and stainless soul, While underneath lurketh the bright leprous spot:
tokens.transliteration: mahr-eem neh-fehsh zah-kah ve-neet-heh-reht. ve-tahkh-tey-hah tah-ah-mohd hah-bah-heh-reht:

tokens.hebrew: כִּכְלִי מָלֵא כְלִמָּה. רָחוּץ מִחוּץ בְּמֵי עָרְמָה.
tokens.translation: Like to a vessel full of shameful things, Washed on the outside with the waters of deceit,
tokens.transliteration: keekh-lee mah-leh khe-lee-mah. rah-khoots mee-khoots be-mey ah-re-mah.

tokens.translation: And defiling all that is within.

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.36
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: קָטֹנְתִּי מִכֹּל הַחֲסָדִים וּמִכָּל הָאֱמֶת אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂיתָ אֶת עַבְדֶּךָ. אָמְנָם יְיָ אֱלֹהַי אוֹדֶךָּ:
tokens.translation: Unworthy am I of all the mercies and all the truth Which Thou hast wrought for Thy servant. Verily, O Lord my God, will I thank Thee
tokens.transliteration: kah-toh-ne-tee mee-kohl hah-khah-sah-deem oo-mee-kahl hah-eh-meht ah-shehr ah-see-tah eht ahv-deh-khah. ah-me-nahm ye-yah eh-loh-hahy oh-deh-kah:

tokens.hebrew: כִּי נָתַתָּ בִּי נֶפֶשׁ קְדוֹשָׁה וּבְמַעֲשַׂי טִמֵּאתִיהָ.
tokens.translation: For that Thou hast given me a holy soul, Though by my deeds I have defiled it,
tokens.transliteration: kee nah-tah-tah bee neh-fehsh ke-doh-shah oo-ve-mah-ah-sahy tee-meh-tee-hah.

tokens.translation: Polluted and profaned it with my evil inclination.
But I know that if I wrought wickedly,
I harmed but myself, never Thee.

tokens.hebrew: אֲבָל יִצְרִי הָאַכְזָר נִצָּב עַל יְמִינִי לְשִטְנִי.
tokens.translation: In sooth, at my right hand my fierce inclination As an adversary standeth,
tokens.transliteration: ah-vahl yeets-ree hah-ahkh-zahr nee-tsahv ahl ye-mee-nee le-sheet-nee.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא יִתְּנֵנִי הָשֵׁב רוּחִי. וּלְהָכִין מְנוּחִי.
tokens.translation: Allowing me no breathing-space to establish my tranquillity.
tokens.transliteration: loh yee-te-neh-nee hah-shehv roo-khee. oo-le-hah-kheen me-noo-khee.

tokens.hebrew: וְזֶה כַּמָּה לַהֲבִיאוֹ בְּכֶפֶל רִסְנִי חָשַׁבְתִּי. וְחָתַרְתִּי לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ מִיַּם הַתַּאֲווֹת אֶל הַיַּבָּשָׁה וְלֹא יָכֹלְתִּי.
tokens.translation: Oft have I purposed with double bridle to lead him, From the sea of his lusts to dry land to restore him, But I could not prevail.
tokens.transliteration: ve-zeh kah-mah lah-hah-vee-oh be-kheh-fehl rees-nee khah-shahv-tee. ve-khah-tahr-tee lah-hah-shee-voh mee-yahm hah-tah-ah-voht ehl hah-yah-bah-shah ve-loh yah-khoh-le-tee.

tokens.translation: My devices he baulked, made profanities flow from my lips.

tokens.hebrew: אֲנִי חוֹשֵׁב מַחְשְׁבוֹת תֻּמָּה. וְהוּא חוֹרֵשׁ אָוֶן וּמִרְמָה.
tokens.translation: I think thoughts of simplicity, he fabricates guile and iniquity,
tokens.transliteration: ah-nee khoh-shehv mahkh-she-voht too-mah. ve-hoo khoh-rehsh ah-vehn oo-meer-mah.

tokens.translation: I am for peace, and he is for war,

tokens.hebrew: עַד שָׂמַנִי לְרַגְלָיו הֲדוֹם. וַיָּשֶׂם דְּמֵי מִלְחָמָה בְשָׁלוֹם.
tokens.translation: To the point that he made me his footstool, And even in peace-time shed the blood of war.
tokens.transliteration: ahd sah-mah-nee le-rahg-lahv hah-dohm. vah-yah-sehm de-mey meel-khah-mah ve-shah-lohm.

tokens.hebrew: וְכַמָּה פְעָמִים יָצָאתִי. לְהִלָּחֵם עִמּוֹ וְעָרַכְתִּי.
tokens.translation: How oft have I sallied forth to combat against him, And set in battle-array
tokens.transliteration: ve-khah-mah fe-ah-meem yah-tsah-tee. le-hee-lah-khehm ee-moh ve-ah-rahkh-tee.

tokens.hebrew: מַחֲנֶה עֲבוֹדָתִי וּתְשׁוּבָתִי. וְשַׂמְתִּי מַחֲנֵה רַחֲמֶיךָ לְעֻמָּתִי לְעֶזְרָתִי.
tokens.translation: My camp of service and repentance, And placed the host of Thy mercies beside me for auxiliary,
tokens.transliteration: mah-khah-neh ah-voh-dah-tee oo-te-shoo-vah-tee. ve-sahm-tee mah-khah-neh rah-khah-mey-khah le-oo-mah-tee le-ehz-rah-tee.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אָמַרְתִּי אִם יָבוֹא יִצְרִי אֶל הַמַּחֲנֶה הָאַחַת וְהִכָּהוּ וְהָיָה הַמַּחֲנֶה הַנִּשְׁאָר לִפְלֵיטָה וְכַאֲשֶׁר חָשַׁבְתִּי כֵּן הָיָה.
tokens.translation: For I said, if my evil inclination Shall come to one camp and shall smite it, Then the camp that is left shall escape. As I thought, so it was.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-mahr-tee eem yah-voh yeets-ree ehl hah-mah-khah-neh hah-ah-khaht ve-hee-kah-hoo ve-hah-yah hah-mah-khah-neh hah-neesh-ahr leef-ley-tah ve-khah-ah-shehr khah-shahv-tee kehn hah-yah.

tokens.translation: For temptation has routed me and scattered my forces,

tokens.hebrew: וְלֹא נִשְׁאַר אֵלַי. כִּי אִם מַחֲנֵה רַחֲמֶיךָ:
tokens.translation: So that there is nothing left me but the camp of Thy mercies.
tokens.transliteration: ve-loh neesh-ahr eh-lahy. kee eem mah-khah-neh rah-khah-mey-khah:

tokens.hebrew: אַךְ אֵדַע כִּי בָם אֶתְקְפֶנּוּ. וְיִהְיוּ לִי מֵעִיר לַעֲזֹר אוּלַי אוּכַל נַכֶּה בּוֹ וַאֲגָרְשֶׁנּוּ:
tokens.translation: But yet I know that by these I shall overcome it, And they shall be unto me better than a city of refuge. Peradventure I shall prevail and smite it and drive it away.
tokens.transliteration: ahkh eh-dah kee vahm eht-ke-feh-noo. ve-yeeh-yoo lee meh-eer lah-ah-zohr oo-lahy oo-khahl nah-keh boh vah-ah-gah-re-sheh-noo:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.37
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי לָכוֹף אֶת יִצְרִי הָאַכְזָרִי וְהַסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מֵחֲטָאַי וּמֵאֲשָׁמָי. אַל תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי:
tokens.translation: May it please Thee, O Lord my God, To subdue my fierce desire. O hide Thy face from my sins and trespasses, Do not carry me off in the midst of my days,
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee rah-tsohn mee-le-fah-ney-khah ye-yah eh-loh-hahy lah-khohf eht yeets-ree hah-ahkh-zah-ree ve-hahs-tehr pah-ney-khah meh-khah-tah-ahy oo-meh-ah-shah-mahy. ahl tah-ah-leh-nee bah-khah-tsee yah-mahy:

tokens.translation: Until I shall have prepared what is needful for my way
And provender for the day of my journeying,

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אִם אֵצֵא מֵעוֹלָמְךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר בָּאתִי. וְאָשׁוּב עָרֹם לִמְקוֹמִי כַּאֲשֶׁר יָצָאתִי.
tokens.translation: For if I go out of my world as I came, And return to my place, naked as I came forth,
tokens.transliteration: kee eem eh-tseh meh-oh-lah-me-khah kah-ah-shehr bah-tee. ve-ah-shoov ah-rohm leem-koh-mee kah-ah-shehr yah-tsah-tee.

tokens.translation: Wherefore was I created And called to see sorrow?

tokens.hebrew: טוֹב לִי עוֹד אֲנִי שָׁם. מִצֵּאתִי לְהַגְדִּיל פֶּשַׁע וּלְהַרְבּוֹת אָשָׁם:
tokens.translation: Better were it I had remained where I was Than to have come hither to increase and multiply sin.
tokens.transliteration: tohv lee ohd ah-nee shahm. mee-tseh-tee le-hahg-deel peh-shah oo-le-hahr-boht ah-shahm:

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּא הָאֱלֹהִים בְּמִדַּת רַחֲמֶיךָ שָׁפְטֵנִי. אַל בְּאַפְּךָ פֶּן תַּמְעִיטֵנִי:
tokens.translation: I beseech Thee, O God, judge me by Thine attribute of mercy, And not by Thine anger lest Thou wither me.
tokens.transliteration: ah-nah hah-eh-loh-heem be-mee-daht rah-khah-mey-khah shah-fe-teh-nee. ahl be-ah-pe-khah pehn tahm-ee-teh-nee:

tokens.hebrew: כִּי מָה הָאָדָם כִּי תְדִינֵהוּ. וְהֶבֶל נִדָּף אֵיךְ בְּמִשְׁקָל תְּבִיאֵהוּ.
tokens.translation: For what is man that Thou shouldst judge him? And how shalt Thou weigh a drifting vapour?
tokens.transliteration: kee mah hah-ah-dahm kee te-dee-neh-hoo. ve-heh-vehl nee-dahf eykh be-meesh-kahl te-vee-eh-hoo.

tokens.hebrew: וּבַעֲלוֹתוֹ בְּמֹאזְנֵי מִשְׁקָל. לֹא יִכְבַּד וְלֹא יֵקָל. וּמַה יִסְכָּן לְךָ לַעֲשׂוֹת לָרוּחַ מִשְׁקָל:
tokens.translation: When Thou placest it in the balance, It shall be neither heavy nor light, And what shall it profit Thee to weigh the air?
tokens.transliteration: oo-vah-ah-loh-toh be-moh-ze-ney meesh-kahl. loh yeekh-bahd ve-loh yeh-kahl. oo-mahh yees-kahn le-khah lah-ah-soht lah-roo-ahkh meesh-kahl:

tokens.hebrew: מִיּוֹם הֱיוֹתוֹ הוּא נִגָּשׂ וְנַעֲנֶה. נָגוּעַ מֻכֶּה אֱלֹהִים וּמְעֻנֶּה:
tokens.translation: From the day of his birth man is hard-pressed and harrowed, "Stricken, smitten of God and afflicted."
tokens.transliteration: mee-yohm heh-yoh-toh hoo nee-gahs ve-nah-ah-neh. nah-goo-ah moo-keh eh-loh-heem oo-me-oo-neh:

tokens.hebrew: רֵאשִׁיתוֹ מוֹת נֶהְדָּף. וְאַחֲרִיתוֹ קַשׁ נִדָּף.
tokens.translation: His youth is chaff driven in the wind, And his latter end is flying straw,
tokens.transliteration: reh-shee-toh moht neh-dahf. ve-ah-khah-ree-toh kahsh nee-dahf.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְחַיָּיו כְּעֵשֶׂב נִשְׁדָּף. וְהָאֱלֹהִים יְבַקֵּשׁ אֶת נִרְדָּף:
tokens.translation: And his life withereth like a herb, And God joineth in hunting him.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-khah-yahv ke-eh-sehv neesh-dahf. ve-hah-eh-loh-heem ye-vah-kehsh eht neer-dahf:

tokens.hebrew: מִיּוֹם צֵאתוֹ מֵרֶחֶם אִמּוֹ. יָגוֹן לֵילוֹ וַאֲנָחָה יוֹמוֹ:
tokens.translation: From the day he cometh forth from his mother's womb His night is sorrow and his day is sighing.
tokens.transliteration: mee-yohm tseh-toh meh-reh-khehm ee-moh. yah-gohn ley-loh vah-ah-nah-khah yoh-moh:

tokens.hebrew: אִם הַיּוֹם יָרוּם. מָחָר תּוֹלָעִים יָרֻם:
tokens.translation: If to-day he is exalted, To-morrow he shall crawl with worms.
tokens.transliteration: eem hah-yohm yah-room. mah-khahr toh-lah-eem yah-room:

tokens.translation: A grain of chaff putteth him to flight, And a thorn woundeth him.

tokens.hebrew: אִם יִשְׂבַּע יִרְשַׁע. וְאִם יִרְעַב עַל פַּת לֶחֶם יִפְשָׁע:
tokens.translation: If he is sated, he waxeth wicked, And if he is hungry, he sinneth for a loaf of bread.
tokens.transliteration: eem yees-bah yeer-shah. ve-eem yeer-ahv ahl paht leh-khehm yeef-shah:

tokens.hebrew: לִרְדֹּף הָעֹשֶׁר קַלּוּ נְשָׁרָיו. וְיִשְׁכַּח הַמָּוֶת וְהוּא אַחֲרָיו:
tokens.translation: His steps are swift to pursue riches, But he forgetteth Death, who is after him.
tokens.transliteration: leer-dohf hah-oh-shehr kah-loo ne-shah-rahv. ve-yeesh-kahkh hah-mah-veht ve-hoo ah-khah-rahv:

tokens.hebrew: בְּעֵת הַמֵּצַר יֶרֶב אֲמָרָיו. וְיַחֲלִיק דְּבָרָיו.
tokens.translation: At the time he is straitened, he multiplieth his promises, And scattereth his words,
tokens.transliteration: be-eht hah-meh-tsahr yeh-rehv ah-mah-rahv. ve-yah-khah-leek de-vah-rahv.

tokens.hebrew: וְיַרְבֶּה נְדָרָיו. וּבְצֵאתוֹ לַמֶּרְחָב יַחֵל דְּבָרָיו.
tokens.translation: And is profuse in vows, But when he is enlarged, He keepeth back his word
tokens.transliteration: ve-yahr-beh ne-dah-rahv. oo-ve-tseh-toh lah-mehr-khahv yah-khehl de-vah-rahv.

tokens.translation: and forgetteth his vows, And strengtheneth the bars of his gates,
While Death is in his chambers,

tokens.hebrew: וְיַרְבֶּה שׁוֹמְרִים מִכָּל עֵבֶר. וְהָאוֹרֵב יוֹשֵׁב לוֹ בַּחֶדֶר.
tokens.translation: And he increaseth guards in every quarter While the foe lieth ambushed in his very apartment.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yahr-beh shoh-me-reem mee-kohl eh-vehr. ve-hah-oh-rehv yoh-shehv loh bah-kheh-dehr.

tokens.hebrew: וְהַזְּאֵב לֹא יַעְצְרֶנּוּ גָּדֵר. מִבֹּא אֶל הָעֵדֶר:
tokens.translation: As for the wolf, the fence shall not restrain it From coming to the flock.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-ze-ehv loh yah-tse-reh-noo gah-dehr. mee-boh ehl hah-eh-dehr:

tokens.hebrew: בָּא וְלֹא יֵדַע לָמָּה. וְיִשְׂמַח וְלֹא יֵדַע בַּמָּה. וִיחִי וְלֹא יֵדַע כַּמָּה:
tokens.translation: Man entereth the world, And knoweth not why, And rejoiceth, And knoweth not wherefore, And liveth, And knoweth not how long.
tokens.transliteration: bah ve-loh yeh-dah lah-mah. ve-yees-mahkh ve-loh yeh-dah bah-mah. vee-khee ve-loh yeh-dah kah-mah:

tokens.translation: In his childhood he walketh in his own stubbornness,

tokens.hebrew: וְכַאֲשֶׁר תָּחֵל רוּחַ יְיָ לְפַעֲמוֹ. יִתְעוֹרֵר לֶאֱסֹף חַיִל וָהוֹן וְיִסַּע מִמְּקוֹמוֹ.
tokens.translation: And when the spirit of lust beginneth in its season To stir him up to gather power and wealth, Then he journeyeth from his place
tokens.transliteration: ve-khah-ah-shehr tah-khehl roo-ahkh ye-yah le-fah-ah-moh. yeet-oh-rehr leh-eh-sohf khah-yeel vah-hohn ve-yee-sah mee-me-koh-moh.

tokens.translation: To ride in ships And to tread the deserts,

tokens.hebrew: וּלְהָבִיא נַפְשׁוֹ בִּמְעוֹנוֹת אֲרָיוֹת. וְהִיא מִתְהַלֶּכֶת בֵּין הַחַיּוֹת:
tokens.translation: And to carry his life to dens of lions, Adventuring it among wild beasts;
tokens.transliteration: oo-le-hah-vee nahf-shoh beem-oh-noht ah-rah-yoht. ve-hee meet-hah-leh-kheht beyn hah-khah-yoht:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְחָשְׁבוֹ כִּי רַב הוֹדוֹ. וְכִי כַבִּיר מָצְאָה יָדוֹ:
tokens.translation: And when he imagineth that great is his glory And that mighty is the spoil of his hand,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-khah-she-voh kee rahv hoh-doh. ve-khee khah-beer mah-tse-ah yah-doh:

tokens.hebrew: בַּשָּׁלוֹם שׁוֹדֵד יְבוֹאֶנּוּ. וְעֵינָיו פָּקַח וְאֵינֶנּוּ:
tokens.translation: Quietly stealeth the spoiler upon him, And his eyes are opened and there is naught.
tokens.transliteration: bah-shah-lohm shoh-dehd ye-voh-eh-noo. ve-ey-nahv pah-kahkh ve-ey-neh-noo:

tokens.hebrew: בְּכָל עֵת הוּא מְזֻמָּן לַתְּלָאוֹת. חוֹלְפוֹת וּבָאוֹת.
tokens.translation: At every moment he is destined to troubles, That pass and return,
tokens.transliteration: be-khohl eht hoo me-zoo-mahn lah-te-lah-oht. khoh-le-foht oo-vah-oht.

tokens.translation: And at every hour evils,
And at every moment chances,
And on every day terrors.

tokens.hebrew: אִם רֶגַע יַעֲמֹד בְּשַׁלְוָה. פֶּתַע תְּבוֹאֵהוּ הֹוָה:
tokens.translation: If for an instant he stand in security, Suddenly disaster will come upon him,
tokens.transliteration: eem reh-gah yah-ah-mohd be-shahl-vah. peh-tah te-voh-eh-hoo hoh-vah:

tokens.hebrew: אוֹ בְּמִלְחָמָה יָבֹא וְחֶרֶב תִּגָּפֵהוּ. אוֹ קֶשֶׁת נְחוּשָׁה תַּחְלְפֵהוּ:
tokens.translation: Either war shall come and the sword will smite him, Or the bow of brass transpierce him;
tokens.transliteration: oh be-meel-khah-mah yah-voh ve-kheh-rehv tee-gah-feh-hoo. oh keh-sheht ne-khoo-shah tahkh-le-feh-hoo:

tokens.hebrew: אוֹ יַקִּיפוּהוּ יְגוֹנִים. יִשְׁטְפוּהוּ מַיִם זֵידוֹנִים.
tokens.translation: Or sorrows will overpower him, Or the presumptuous billows flow over him,
tokens.transliteration: oh yah-kee-foo-hoo ye-goh-neem. yeesh-te-foo-hoo mah-yeem zey-doh-neem.

tokens.translation: Or sickness and steadfast evils shall find him,

tokens.hebrew: עַד יִהְיֶה לְמַשָּׂא עַל נַפְשׁוֹ. וְיִמְצָא מְרוֹרַת פְּתָנִים בְּדִבְשׁוֹ:
tokens.translation: Till he becometh a burden on his own soul, And shall find the gall of serpents in his honey.
tokens.transliteration: ahd yeeh-yeh le-mah-sah ahl nahf-shoh. ve-yeem-tsah me-roh-raht pe-tah-neem be-deev-shoh:

tokens.translation: And when his pain increaseth His glory decreaseth,

tokens.hebrew: וּנְעָרִים יִתְקַלְּסוּ בוֹ. וְתַעֲלוּלִים יִמְשְׁלוּ בוֹ:
tokens.translation: And youths make mock of him, And infants rule him,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ne-ah-reem yeet-kah-le-soo voh. ve-tah-ah-loo-leem yeem-she-loo voh:

tokens.hebrew: וְיִהְיֶה לְטֹרַח עַל יוֹצְאֵי מֵעָיו. וְיִתְנַכְּרוּ לוֹ כָּל יוֹדְעָיו:
tokens.translation: And he becometh a burden to the issue of his loins, And all who know him become estranged from him.
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeeh-yeh le-toh-rahkh ahl yoh-tse-ey meh-ahv. ve-yeet-nah-ke-roo loh kohl yoh-de-ahv:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְבֹא עִתּוֹ יֵצֵא מֵחֲצֵרָיו לַחֲצַר מָוֶת. וּמִצֵּל חֲדָרָיו לְצַלְמָוֶת:
tokens.translation: And when his hour hath come, he passeth from the courts of his house to the court of Death, And from the shadow of his chambers to the shadow of Death.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-voh ee-toh yeh-tseh meh-khah-tseh-rahv lah-khah-tsahr mah-veht. oo-mee-tsehl khah-dah-rahv le-tsahl-mah-veht:

tokens.hebrew: וְיִפְשַׁט רִקְמָה וְתוֹלָע. וְיִלְבַּשׁ רִמָּה וְתוֹלָע:
tokens.translation: And he shall strip off his broidery and his scarlet And shall put on corruption and the worm,
tokens.transliteration: ve-yeef-shaht reek-mah ve-toh-lah. ve-yeel-bahsh ree-mah ve-toh-lah:

tokens.hebrew: וְלֶעָפָר יִשְׁכַּב. וְיָשׁוּב אֶל יְסוֹדוֹ אֲשֶׁר מִמֶּנּוּ חֻצָּב:
tokens.translation: And lie down in the dust And return to the foundation from which he came.
tokens.transliteration: ve-leh-ah-fahr yeesh-kahv. ve-yah-shoov ehl ye-soh-doh ah-shehr mee-meh-noo khoo-tsahv:

tokens.hebrew: וּלְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵלֶּה לוֹ מָתַי יִמְצָא עֵת תְּשׁוּבָה. לִרְחֹץ חֶלְאַת מְשׁוּבָה.
tokens.translation: And man, whom these things befall, When shall he find a time for repentance To scour away the rust of his perversion?
tokens.transliteration: oo-le-eesh ah-shehr eh-leh loh mah-tahy yeem-tsah eht te-shoo-vah. leer-khohts khehl-aht me-shoo-vah.

tokens.translation: For the day is short and the work manifold,
And the task-masters irate, Hurrying and scurrying,

tokens.hebrew: וְהַזְּמַן מִמֶּנּוּ שׂוֹחֵק. וּבַעַל הַבַּיִת דּוֹחֵק:
tokens.translation: And Time laughs at him And the Master of the House presses.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-ze-mahn mee-meh-noo soh-khehk. oo-vah-ahl hah-bah-yeet doh-khehk:

tokens.hebrew: לָכֵן נָא אֱלֹהַי זְכוֹר אֵלֶּה הַתְּלָאוֹת. אֲשֶׁר עַל אָדָם בָּאוֹת:
tokens.translation: Therefore I beseech Thee, O my God, Remember the distresses that come upon man,
tokens.transliteration: lah-khehn nah eh-loh-hahy ze-khohr eh-leh hah-te-lah-oht. ah-shehr ahl ah-dahm bah-oht:

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם אֲנִי הֲרֵעוֹתִי. אַתָּה תֵיטִיב אַחֲרִיתִי:
tokens.translation: And if I have done evil Do Thou me good at my latter end,
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem ah-nee hah-reh-oh-tee. ah-tah tey-teev ah-khah-ree-tee:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל תִּגְמֹל מִדָּה בְּמִדָּה. לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר עֲוֹנוֹתָיו בְּלִי מִדָּה.
tokens.translation: Nor requite measure for measure To man whose sins are measureless,
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl teeg-mohl mee-dah be-mee-dah. le-eesh ah-shehr ah-voh-noh-tahv be-lee mee-dah.

tokens.translation: And whose death is a joyless departure.
