title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.38
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי אִם עֲוֹנִי מִנְּשׂוֹא גָּדוֹל. מַה תַּעֲשֶׂה לְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל:
tokens.translation: O my God, If my iniquity is too great to be borne, What wilt Thou do for Thy great name's sake?
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hahy eem ah-voh-nee mee-ne-soh gah-dohl. mahh tah-ah-seh le-sheem-khah hah-gah-dohl:

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם לֹא אוֹחִיל לְרַחֲמֶיךָ. מִי יָחוּס עָלַי חוּץ מִמֶּךָּ:
tokens.translation: And if I do not wait on Thy mercies, Who will have pity on me but Thee?
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem loh oh-kheel le-rah-khah-mey-khah. mee yah-khoos ah-lahy khoots mee-meh-kah:

tokens.translation: Therefore though Thou shouldst slay me, yet will I trust in Thee.

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם תְּבַקֵּשׁ לַעֲוֹנִי אֶבְרַח מִמְּךָ אֵלֶיךָ. וְאֶתְכַּסֶּה מֵחֲמָתְךָ בְּצִלֶּךָ:
tokens.translation: For if Thou shouldst pursue my iniquity, I will flee from Thee to Thyself, And I will shelter myself from Thy wrath in Thy shadow,
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem te-vah-kehsh lah-ah-voh-nee ehv-rahkh mee-me-khah eh-ley-khah. ve-eht-kah-seh meh-khah-mah-te-khah be-tsee-leh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְשׁוּלֵי רַחֲמֶיךָ אַחֲזִיק עַד אִם רִחַמְתָּנִי. וְלֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ כִּי אִם בֵּרַכְתָּנִי:
tokens.translation: And to the skirts of Thy mercies I will lay hold until Thou hast had mercy on me, And I will not let Thee go till Thou hast blessed me.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-shoo-ley rah-khah-mey-khah ah-khah-zeek ahd eem ree-khahm-tah-nee. ve-loh ah-shah-leh-khah-khah kee eem beh-rahkh-tah-nee:

tokens.hebrew: זְכָר נָא כִּי כַּחֹמֶר עֲשִׂיתָנִי. וּבְאֵלֶּה הַתְּלָאוֹת נִסִּיתָנִי:
tokens.translation: Remember, I pray Thee, that of slime Thou hast made me, And by all these hardships tried me,
tokens.transliteration: ze-khahr nah kee kah-khoh-mehr ah-see-tah-nee. oo-ve-eh-leh hah-te-lah-oht nee-see-tah-nee:

tokens.hebrew: עַל כֵּן לֹא תִפְקֹד עָלַי כְּמַעֲלָלַי. וְאַל תַּאֲכִילֵנִי פְּרִי פָעֳלַי:
tokens.translation: Therefore visit me not according to my wanton dealings, Nor feed me on the fruit of my deeds,
tokens.transliteration: ahl kehn loh teef-kohd ah-lahy ke-mah-ah-lah-lahy. ve-ahl tah-ah-khee-leh-nee pe-ree foh-oh-lahy:

tokens.hebrew: וְהַאֲרֶךְ לִי אַפֶּךָ וְאַל תַּקְרִיב יוֹמִי. עַד אָכִין צֵדָה לָשׁוּב אֶל מְקוֹמִי:
tokens.translation: But prolong Thy patience, nor bring near my day, Until I shall have prepared provision for returning to my eternal home,
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-ah-rehkh lee ah-peh-khah ve-ahl tahk-reev yoh-mee. ahd ah-kheen tseh-dah lah-shoov ehl me-koh-mee:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל תַּחֲזִיק עָלַי לְמַהֵר לְשַׁלְּחֵנִי מִן הָאָרֶץ. וּמִשְׁאֲרוֹת אֲשָׁמַי צְרוּרוֹת עַל שִׁכְמִי:
tokens.translation: Nor rage against me to send me hastily from the earth, With my sins bound up in the kneading-trough on my shoulder.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl tah-khah-zeek ah-lahy le-mah-hehr le-shah-le-kheh-nee meen hah-ah-rehts. oo-meesh-ah-roht ah-shah-mahy tse-roo-roht ahl sheekh-mee:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְהַעֲלוֹתְךָ בְּמִשְׁקָל עֲוֹנוֹתַי. שִׂים לְךָ בְּכַף שְׁנִיָּה תְּלָאוֹתַי.
tokens.translation: And when Thou placest my sins in the balance Place Thou in the other scale my sorrows,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-hah-ah-loh-te-khah be-meesh-kahl ah-voh-noh-tahy. seem le-khah be-khahf she-nee-yah te-lah-oh-tahy.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְזָכְרְךָ רִשְׁעִי וּמִרְדִּי. זְכָר עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי.
tokens.translation: And while recalling my depravity and frowardness, Remember my affliction and my harrying,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-zah-khe-re-khah reesh-ee oo-meer-dee. ze-khahr ohn-yee oo-me-roo-dee.

tokens.translation: And place these against the others.

tokens.hebrew: וּזְכָר נָא אֱלֹהַי כִּי זֶה כַּמֶּה לְאֶרֶץ נוֹד צְנַפְתַּנִי. וּבְכוּר גָּלוּת בְּחַנְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: And remember, I pray Thee, O my God, That Thou hast driven me rolling and wandering like Cain, And in the furnace of exile hast tried me,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ze-khahr nah eh-loh-hahy kee zeh kah-meh le-eh-rehts nohd tse-nahf-tah-nee. oo-ve-khoor gah-loot be-khahn-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וּמֵרֹב רִשְׁעִי צְרַפְתַּנִי. וְיָדַעְתִּי כִּי לְטוֹבָתִי נִסִּיתַנִי.
tokens.translation: And from the mass of my wickedness refined me, And I know 'tis for my good Thou hast proved me,
tokens.transliteration: oo-meh-rohv reesh-ee tse-rahf-tah-nee. ve-yah-dah-tee kee le-toh-vah-tee nee-see-tah-nee.

tokens.translation: And in faithfulness afflicted me,

tokens.hebrew: וּלְהֵיטִיב לִי בְּאַחֲרִיתִי בְּמִבְחַן הַתְּלָאוֹת הֲבֵאתַנִי:
tokens.translation: And that it is to profit me at my latter end That Thou hast brought me through this testing by troubles.
tokens.transliteration: oo-le-hey-teev lee be-ah-khah-ree-tee be-meev-khahn hah-te-lah-oht hah-veh-tah-nee:

tokens.hebrew: לָכֵן אֱלֹהַי יֶהֱמוּ עָלַי רַחֲמֶיךָ. וְאַל תְּכַלֶּה עָלַי זַעְמֶךָ:
tokens.translation: Therefore, O God, let Thy mercies be moved toward me, And do not exhaust Thy wrath upon me,
tokens.transliteration: lah-khehn eh-loh-hahy yeh-heh-moo ah-lahy rah-khah-mey-khah. ve-ahl te-khah-leh ah-lahy zah-meh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל תִּגְמְלֵנִי כְּמַעְבָּדַי. וֶאֱמֹר לַמַּלְאָךְ הַמַּשְׁחִית דָּי:
tokens.translation: Nor reward me according to my works, But cry to the Destroying Angel: Enough!
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl teeg-me-leh-nee ke-mah-bah-dahy. veh-eh-mohr lah-mahl-ahkh hah-mahsh-kheet dahy:

tokens.hebrew: וּמַה מַּעֲלָתִי וְיִתְרוֹנִי. כִּי תְבַקֵּשׁ לַעֲוֹנִי:
tokens.translation: For what height or advantage have I attained That Thou shouldst pursue me for my iniquity,
tokens.transliteration: oo-mahh mah-ah-lah-tee ve-yeet-roh-nee. kee te-vah-kehsh lah-ah-voh-nee:

tokens.hebrew: וְתָשִׂים עָלַי מִשְׁמָר. וּתְצוּדֵנִי כְּתוֹא מִכְמָר:
tokens.translation: And shouldst post a watch over me, And trap me like an antelope in a snare?
tokens.transliteration: ve-tah-seem ah-lahy meesh-mahr. oo-te-tsoo-deh-nee ke-toh meekh-mahr:

tokens.hebrew: הֲלֹא יָמַי חָלַף רֻבָּם וְאֵינָם. וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִים יִמַּקּוּ בַּעֲוֹנָם:
tokens.translation: Is not the bulk of my days past and vanished? Shall the rest consume in their iniquity?
tokens.transliteration: hah-loh yah-mahy khah-lahf roo-bahm ve-ey-nahm. ve-hah-neesh-ah-reem yee-mah-koo bah-ah-voh-nahm:

tokens.hebrew: וְאִם הַיּוֹם לְפָנֶיךָ הִנֵּנִי. מָחָר עֵינֶיךָ בִּי וְאֵינֶנִּי:
tokens.translation: And if I am here to-day before Thee, "To-morrow Thine eyes are upon me and I am not."
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem hah-yohm le-fah-ney-khah hee-neh-nee. mah-khahr ey-ney-khah bee ve-ey-neh-nee:

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לָמָּה אָמוּת. כִּי תֹאכְלֵנִי הָאֵשׁ הַגְּדוֹלָה הַזֹּאת:
tokens.translation: And now wherefore should I die And this Thy great fire devour me?
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-tah lah-mah ah-moot. kee toh-khe-leh-nee hah-ehsh hah-ge-doh-lah hah-zoht:

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהַי שִׂים עֵינֶיךָ עָלַי לְטוֹבָה לִשְׁאֵרִית יָמַי הַמְּעַטִּים. וְאַל תִּרְדֹּף הַשְּׂרִידִים וְהַפְּלֵטִים:
tokens.translation: O my God, turn Thine eyes favourably upon me For the remainder of my brief days, Pursue not their escaping survivors,
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-hahy seem ey-ney-khah ah-lahy le-toh-vah leesh-eh-reet yah-mahy hah-me-ah-teem. ve-ahl teer-dohf hah-se-ree-deem ve-hah-pe-leh-teem:

tokens.hebrew: וְהַפְּלֵטָה הַנִּשְׁאֶרֶת מִבְּרַד מְהוּמוֹתַי. אַל יַחְסְלֶנָּה יֶלֶק אַשְׁמוֹתַי:
tokens.translation: Nor let the remnant of the crops that the hail hath spared Be finished off by the locust for my sins.
tokens.transliteration: ve-hah-pe-leh-tah hah-neesh-eh-reht mee-be-rahd me-hoo-moh-tahy. ahl yahkh-se-leh-nah yeh-lehk ahsh-moh-tahy:

tokens.translation: For am I not the creation of Thy hands,

tokens.hebrew: וּמַה יִּסְכָּן לְךָ כִּי רִמָּה תִקָּחֵנִי לְאֹכֶל. יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל:
tokens.translation: And what shall it avail Thee That the worm shall take me for its meal And feed on the product of Thy hands?
tokens.transliteration: oo-mahh yees-kahn le-khah kee ree-mah tee-kah-kheh-nee le-oh-khehl. ye-gee-ah kah-pey-khah kee toh-khehl:

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.39
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהַי לָשׁוּב עָלַי בְּרַחֲמִים. וְלַהֲשִׁיבֵנִי בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: May it please Thee, O Lord my God, To return to me in mercy, And to bring me back to Thee in perfect repentance.
tokens.transliteration: ye-hee rah-tsohn mee-le-fah-ney-khah ye-yah eh-loh-hahy lah-shoov ah-lahy be-rah-khah-meem. ve-lah-hah-shee-veh-nee beet-shoo-vah she-leh-mah le-fah-ney-khah.

tokens.hebrew: וְלִתְחִנָּתִי תָּכִין לִבִּי וְתַקְשִׁיב אָזְנֶךָ. וְתִפְתַּח לִבִּי בְּתוֹרָתֶךָ.
tokens.translation: O dispose my heart and turn Thine ear to supplication, And open my heart to Thy law,
tokens.transliteration: ve-leet-khee-nah-tee tah-kheen lee-bee ve-tahk-sheev ohz-neh-khah. ve-teef-tahkh lee-bee be-toh-rah-teh-khah.

tokens.translation: And plant in my thoughts the fear of Thee,

tokens.hebrew: וְתִגְזֹר עָלַי גְּזֵרוֹת טוֹבוֹת. וּתְבַטֵּל מֵעָלַי גְּזֵרוֹת רָעוֹת:
tokens.translation: And decree for me good decrees, And annul the evil decrees against me,
tokens.transliteration: ve-teeg-zohr ah-lahy ge-zeh-roht toh-voht. oo-te-vah-tehl meh-ah-lahy ge-zeh-roht rah-oht:

tokens.hebrew: וְאַל תְּבִיאֵנִי לִידֵי נִסָּיוֹן. וְלֹא לִידֵי בִזָּיוֹן:
tokens.translation: And lead me not into the power of temptation, Nor into the power of contempt,
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl te-vee-eh-nee lee-dey nee-sah-yohn. ve-loh lee-dey vee-zah-yohn:

tokens.hebrew: וּמִכָּל פְּגָעִים רָעִים הַצִּילֵנִי. וְעַד יַעֲבֹר הַוּוֹת בְּצִלְּךָ תַּסְתִּירֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And from all evil chances deliver me, And hide me in Thy shadow until the havoc pass by,
tokens.transliteration: oo-mee-kahl pe-gah-eem rah-eem hah-tsee-leh-nee. ve-ahd yah-ah-vohr hah-voht be-tsee-le-khah tahs-tee-reh-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וֶהְיֵה עִם פִּי וְהֶגְיוֹנִי. וּשְׁמוֹר דְּרָכַי מֵחֲטוֹא בִלְשׁוֹנִי:
tokens.translation: And be with my mouth in my meditation, And keep my ways from sin through my tongue,
tokens.transliteration: veh-yeh eem pee ve-hehg-yoh-nee. oo-she-mohr de-rah-khahy meh-khah-toh veel-shoh-nee:

tokens.hebrew: וְזָכְרֵנִי בְּזִכְרוֹן וּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ. וּבְבִנְיַן אוּלָמֶךָ.
tokens.translation: And remember me when Thou rememberest and favourest Thy people, And when Thou rebuildest Thy Temple,
tokens.transliteration: ve-zah-khe-reh-nee be-zeekh-rohn oo-re-tsohn ah-meh-khah. oo-ve-veen-yahn oo-lah-meh-khah.

tokens.hebrew: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶךָ. וְזַכֵּנִי לְשַׁחֵר דְּבִירֶךָ.
tokens.translation: That I may behold the bliss of Thy chosen ones, And purify me to seek diligently Thy Sanctuary
tokens.transliteration: leer-oht be-toh-vaht be-khee-reh-khah. ve-zah-keh-nee le-shah-khehr de-vee-reh-khah.

tokens.translation: devastated and ruined, And to cherish its stones and its dust,
And the clods of its desolation, And rebuild Thou its wastes!

title: Keter Malkhut
sefariaRef: Keter Malkhut.40
useCase: Keter Malkhut · Keter Malkhut Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: O my God, I know that those who implore favour from Thee

tokens.hebrew: יָלִיצוּ עֲלֵיהֶם מַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים אֲשֶׁר הִקְדִּימוּ. אוֹ צִדְקוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר הֵרִימוּ.
tokens.translation: Have for ambassadors their antecedent virtues, And the righteousness which they have heaped up,
tokens.transliteration: yah-lee-tsoo ah-ley-hehm mah-ah-seem toh-veem ah-shehr heek-dee-moo. oh tseed-koh-tey-hehm ah-shehr heh-ree-moo.

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵין בִּי מַעֲשִׂים כִּי אֲנִי נָעוּר וָרֵק. כְּגֶפֶן בּוֹקֵק.
tokens.translation: But in me are no good deeds, For I am shaken and emptied like a stripped vine,
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-nee eyn bee mah-ah-seem kee ah-nee nah-oor vah-rehk. ke-geh-fehn boh-kehk.

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲנִי אֵין בִּי לֹא צֶדֶק וְלֹא כֹשֶׁר. לֹא חֶסֶד וְלֹא יֹשֶׁר.
tokens.translation: And I have no righteousness, no rectitude, No piety, no uprightness,
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-nee eyn bee loh tseh-dehk ve-loh khoh-shehr. loh kheh-sehd ve-loh yoh-shehr.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא תְפִלָּה וְלֹא תְחִנָּה. לֹא תֻמָּה וְלֹא אֱמוּנָה.
tokens.translation: No prayer, no plea, No innocence, no faith,
tokens.transliteration: loh te-fee-lah ve-loh te-khee-nah. loh too-mah ve-loh eh-moo-nah.

tokens.hebrew: לֹא צֶדֶק וְלֹא מִדָּה טוֹבָה. לֹא עֲבוֹדָה וְלֹא תְשׁוּבָה:
tokens.translation: No justice, no quality of goodness, Neither service of God nor turning from sin.
tokens.transliteration: loh tseh-dehk ve-loh mee-dah toh-vah. loh ah-voh-dah ve-loh te-shoo-vah:

tokens.hebrew: וּבְכֵן יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיך יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ רִבּוֹן כָּל הָעוֹלָמִים לְרַחֵם עָלַי. וְהָיִיתָ קָרוֹב אֵלַי.
tokens.translation: May it be Thy will, O Lord our God and God of our Fathers, Master of the Worlds, To have mercy upon me, And be Thou near me,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-khehn ye-hee rah-tsohn mee-le-fah-neykh ye-yah eh-loh-hey-noo veh-loh-hey ah-voh-tey-noo ree-bohn kohl hah-oh-lah-meem le-rah-khehm ah-lahy. ve-hah-yee-tah kah-rohv eh-lahy.

tokens.hebrew: לְפָקְדֵנִי בִּפְקֻדַּת רְצוֹנֶךָ. וְלָשֵׂאת אֵלַי אוֹר פָּנֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: To favour me with the visitation of Thy goodwill, And to lift up to me the light of Thy face,
tokens.transliteration: le-fah-ke-deh-nee beef-koo-daht re-tsoh-neh-khah. ve-lah-seht eh-lahy ohr pah-ney-khah.

tokens.translation: And to show me Thy graciousness!

tokens.hebrew: וּכְפִי מַעֲשַׂי אַל תִּגְמְלֵנִי. וְחֶרְפַּת נָבָל אַל תְּשִׂימֵנִי .
tokens.translation: Requite me not according to my deeds And make me not a byword to the base.
tokens.transliteration: oo-khe-fee mah-ah-sahy ahl teeg-me-leh-nee. ve-khehr-paht nah-vahl ahl te-see-meh-nee .

tokens.hebrew: וּבַחֲצִי יָמַי אַל תַּעֲלֵנִי. וְאַל תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי.
tokens.translation: Take me not away in the midst of my days Nor hide Thy face from me.
tokens.transliteration: oo-vah-khah-tsee yah-mahy ahl tah-ah-leh-nee. ve-ahl tahs-tehr pah-ney-khah mee-meh-nee.

tokens.translation: Purify me from my sins, And cast me not out from Thy presence,
But quicken me with glory And with glory receive me afterwards.

tokens.hebrew: וּבְעֵת מִן הָעוֹלָם תּוֹצִיאֵנִי. לְחַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא בְּשָׁלוֹם תְּבִיאֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And when Thou shalt bring me out of this world, Bring me in peace to the life of the world to come,
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-eht meen hah-oh-lahm toh-tsee-eh-nee. le-khah-yey hah-oh-lahm hah-bah be-shah-lohm te-vee-eh-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶל עָל תִּקְרָאֵנִי. וּבֵין הַחֲסִידִים תּוֹשִׁיבֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And place me in glory among the saints,
tokens.transliteration: ve-ehl ahl teek-rah-eh-nee. oo-veyn hah-khah-see-deem toh-shee-veh-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְעִם הַמְּנוּיִים בְּחֶלֶד חֶלְקָם בַּחַיִּים תִּמְנֵנִי. וְלֵאוֹר בְּאוֹר פָּנֶיךָ תְּזַכֵּנִי.
tokens.translation: And number me with those whose portion is appointed in the world of life And purify me to shine in the light of Thy countenance,
tokens.transliteration: ve-eem hah-me-noo-yeem be-kheh-lehd khehl-kahm bah-khah-yeem teem-neh-nee. ve-leh-ohr be-ohr pah-ney-khah te-zah-keh-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְתָשׁוּב תְּחַיֵּנִי. וּמִתְּהוֹמוֹת הָאָרֶץ תָּשׁוּב וְתַעֲלֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And restore and revive me And bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-tah-shoov te-khah-yeh-nee. oo-mee-te-hoh-moht hah-ah-rehts tah-shoov ve-tah-ah-leh-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וָאֹמַר אוֹדְךָ יְיָ כִּי אָנַפְתָּ בִּי יָשׁוּב אַפְּךָ וּתְנַחֲמֵנִי. וּלְךָ יְיָ חֶסֶד עַל כָּל הַטּוֹבָה אֲשֶׁר גְּמַלְתַּנִי.
tokens.translation: Then will I say: I thank Thee, O Lord, that though wroth with me, Thine anger is turned away and Thou hast comforted me. Thine, O Lord, is loving-kindness In all the goodness Thou hast bestowed on me,
tokens.transliteration: vah-oh-mahr oh-de-khah ye-yah kee ah-nahf-tah bee yah-shoov ah-pe-khah oo-te-nah-khah-meh-nee. oo-le-khah ye-yah kheh-sehd ahl kohl hah-toh-vah ah-shehr ge-mahl-tah-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁר עַד יוֹם מוֹתִי תִּגְמְלֵנִי. וּבְיִרְאָתְךָ הַטְּהוֹרָה אֵל אֶחָד תְּחַזְּקֵנִי. וּבְתוֹרָתְךָ הַתְּמִימָה תְּאַמְּצֵנִי.
tokens.translation: And which Thou wilt bestow till the day of my death.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-shehr ahd yohm moh-tee teeg-me-leh-nee. oo-ve-yeer-ah-te-khah hah-te-hoh-rah ehl eh-khahd te-khah-ze-keh-nee. oo-ve-toh-rah-te-khah hah-te-mee-mah te-ah-me-tseh-nee.

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל כָּל זֶה אֲנִי חַיָּב לְהוֹדוֹת לְהַלֵּל לְפָאֵר וּלְרוֹמֵם אוֹתָךְ.
tokens.translation: And for all this it behoves me to give thanks, To laud, to glorify, to extol Thee.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl kohl zeh ah-nee khah-yahv le-hoh-doht le-hah-lehl le-fah-ehr oo-le-roh-mehm oh-tahkh.

tokens.hebrew: תִּשְׁתַּבַּח בְּפִי בְרוּאֶיךָ. תִּתְקַדַּשׁ בְּפִי מַקְדִּישֶׁיךָ.
tokens.translation: By the mouth of Thy creatures O yield Thyself praise, By those hallowing Thee be Thou self-sanctified,
tokens.transliteration: teesh-tah-bahkh be-fee ve-roo-ey-khah. teet-kah-dahsh be-fee mahk-dee-shey-khah.

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְיַחֵד בְּפִי מְיַחֲדֶךָ. תִּתְפָּאֵר בְּפִי מְפָאֲרֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: Through those owning Thy Unity cry Thou Thy oneness, With the lips of Thy glorifiers chant Thee Thy glory,
tokens.transliteration: teet-yah-khehd be-fee me-yah-khah-deh-khah. teet-pah-ehr be-fee me-fah-ah-rey-khah.

tokens.hebrew: תִּתְרוֹמַם בְּפִי מְרוֹמֲמֶיךָ. תִּתְנַשֵּׂא בְּפִי מְנַשְּׂאֶיךָ.
tokens.translation: And exalt Thee in rhapsody through Thine exalters, Supremely upborne on Thy worshippers' breath,
tokens.transliteration: teet-roh-mahm be-fee me-roh-mah-mey-khah. teet-nah-seh be-fee me-nah-se-ey-khah.

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אֵין כָּמוֹךָ בָּאֱלֹהִים אֲדֹנָי וְאֵין כְּמַעֲשֶׂיךָ:
tokens.translation: For 'mid the gods and their works, O Lord, there is none like to Thee and Thine.
tokens.transliteration: kee eyn kah-moh-khah bah-eh-loh-heem ah-doh-nahy ve-eyn ke-mah-ah-sey-khah:

title: Shalom Aleichem
sefariaRef: Shalom Aleichem.1
useCase: Shalom Aleichem · Shalom Aleichem Themes: peace, shabbat. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שָׁלוֹם עֲלֵיכֶם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁרֵת, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Peace be with you, ministering angels, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration: shah-lohm ah-ley-khehm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-reht, mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-me-lah-kheem, hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo.

tokens.hebrew: בּוֹאֲכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Come in peace, messengers of peace, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration: boh-ah-khehm le-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-lohm, mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-me-lah-kheem, hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo.

tokens.hebrew: בָּרְכֽוּנִי לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Bless me with peace, messengers of peace, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration: bah-re-khoo-nee le-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-lohm, mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-me-lah-kheem, hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo.

tokens.hebrew: צֵאתְכֶם לְשָׁלוֹם מַלְאֲכֵי הַשָּׁלוֹם, מַלְאֲכֵי עֶלְיוֹן מִמֶּֽלֶךְ מַלְכֵי הַמְּלָכִים, הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא.
tokens.translation: Go in peace, messengers of peace, messengers of the Most High, sent by the King of Kings, the Holy One, Blessed be He.
tokens.transliteration: tseh-te-khehm le-shah-lohm mahl-ah-khey hah-shah-lohm, mahl-ah-khey ehl-yohn mee-meh-lehkh mahl-khey hah-me-lah-kheem, hah-kah-dohsh bah-rookh hoo.

title: Yedid Nefesh
sefariaRef: Yedid Nefesh
useCase: Yedid Nefesh · Yedid Nefesh Themes: general. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: My soul's beloved, merciful father,
Draw your surrendered to your will rendered.
Your surrendered will run like a gazelle,
He will bow before your splendor.
For to him, your love is sweeter,
Than the dripping honeycomb, and any taste at all.
Resplendent, beautiful, radiance of the world,
My soul is sick for your amore,

tokens.hebrew: אָנָּא אֵל נָא, רְפָא נָא לָהּ
tokens.translation: Please, O God, heal her now,
tokens.transliteration: ah-nah ehl nah, re-fah nah lahh

tokens.translation: By the beauty of your radiance, by showing her.
Then she will be strong, she will be healed,
And she will be your handmaiden forever more.
Ancient one, rouse, please, your mercy.
Please have pity on the son of your beloved,
For so much has this yearning been,
To see your strength, in its beauty,
Please, my god, the love of my heart,
Hurry, please, and do not hide yourself.
Please, be revealed and spread the covering, beloved,
Upon me, the shelter of your tranquility
Illuminate the earth with your nobility
We will rejoice in you, we will be in festivity
Hurry, beloved, for the time has come,
And be good to me, like days long ago.

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night.1
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: זְכוֹר יְיָ מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ אוֹי. הַבִּיטָה וּרְאֵה אֶת חֶרְפָּתֵנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Remember, LORD, what has occurred to us, Alas! Look and see our disgrace. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ze-khohr ye-yah meh hah-yah lah-noo ohy. hah-bee-tah oo-re-eh eht khehr-pah-teh-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: נַחֲלָתֵנוּ נֶהֶפְכָה לְזָרִים אוֹי. בָּתֵּינוּ לְנָכְרִים. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our property has been handed over to strangers, Alas! Our homes to foreigners. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: nah-khah-lah-teh-noo neh-hehf-khah le-zah-reem ohy. bah-tey-noo le-nah-khe-reem. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: יְתוֹמִים הָיִינוּ וְאֵין אָב אוֹי. אִמּוֹתֵינוּ מְקוֹנְנוֹת בְּחֹדֶשׁ אָב. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We have become orphans without a father. Alas! Our mothers mourn in the month of Av. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ye-toh-meem hah-yee-noo ve-eyn ahv ohy. ee-moh-tey-noo me-koh-ne-noht be-khoh-dehsh ahv. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: מֵימֵינוּ בְּכֶסֶף שָׁתִינוּ אוֹי. כִּי נִסּוּךְ הַמַּיִם בָּזִינוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We had to purchase water to drink. Alas! Because we abused the water libation. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: mey-mey-noo be-kheh-sehf shah-tee-noo ohy. kee nee-sookh hah-mah-yeem bah-zee-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדָּפְנוּ אוֹי. כִּי שִׂנְאַת חִנָּם רָדָפְנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We had yokes put on our necks, Alas! Because we hatefully persecuted others. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ahl tsah-vah-reh-noo neer-dah-fe-noo ohy. kee seen-aht khee-nahm rah-dah-fe-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: מִצְרַיִם נָתַנּוּ יָד אוי. וְאַשּׁוּר צָדוּנוּ כְּצַיָּד. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: To the Egyptians we stretched out our hand, Alas! And the Assyrians trapped us like a hunter. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: meets-rah-yeem nah-tah-noo yahd vy. ve-ah-shoor tsah-doo-noo ke-tsah-yahd. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אֲבֹתֵינוּ חָטְאוּ וְאֵינָם אוי. וַאֲנַחְנוּ סוֹבְלִים אֶת עֲוֹנָם. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our ancestors have sinned and are no more, Alas! And we suffer for their sins. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-voh-tey-noo khah-te-oo ve-ey-nahm vy. vah-ah-nahkh-noo soh-ve-leem eht ah-voh-nahm. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: עֲבָדִים מָשְׁלוּ בָנוּ אוי. כִּי שִׁלּוּחַ עֲבָדִים בִּטַּלְנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Slaves rule over us, Alas! Because we did not release our slaves. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ah-vah-deem mah-she-loo vah-noo vy. kee shee-loo-ahkh ah-vah-deem bee-tahl-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: בְּנַפְשֵׁנוּ נָבִיא לַחְמֵנוּ אוי. כִּי קָפַצְנוּ מֵעָנִי יָדֵינוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: We risk our lives to get our bread. Alas! Because we closed our hands to the needy. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: be-nahf-sheh-noo nah-vee lahkh-meh-noo vy. kee kah-fahts-noo meh-ah-nee yah-dey-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: עוֹרֵנוּ כְּתַנּוּר נִכְמָרוּ אוי. כִּי כְבוֹדָם בְּקָלוֹן הֵמִירוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our skin has shriveled as from the heat of an oven. Alas! Because they exchanged their honour for disgrace. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: oh-reh-noo ke-tah-noor neekh-mah-roo vy. kee khe-voh-dahm be-kah-lohn heh-mee-roo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: נָשִׁים בְּצִיּוֹן עִנּוּ אוֹי. כִּי אִישׁ אֶת אֵשֶׁת רֵעֵהוּ טִמְּאוּ וְזִנּוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: They tortured the women of Zion. Alas! Because we violated our friends wives. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: nah-sheem be-tsee-yohn ee-noo ohy. kee eesh eht eh-sheht reh-eh-hoo tee-me-oo ve-zee-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: שָׂרִים בְּיָדָם נִתְלוּ אוֹי. כִּי גְּזֵלַת הֶעָנִי חָמְסוּ וְגָזְלוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Princes were hung by their hands. Alas! Because they were violent and robbed the poor. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: sah-reem be-yah-dahm neet-loo ohy. kee ge-zeh-laht heh-ah-nee khah-me-soo ve-gah-ze-loo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: בַּחוּרִים טְחוֹן נָשָׂאוּ אוֹי. כִּי בְּבֵית זוֹנָה נִמְצָאוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: Our young men were forced to carry millstone. Alas! Because they were found in the houses of harlots. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: bah-khoo-reem te-khohn nah-sah-oo ohy. kee be-veyt zoh-nah neem-tsah-oo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: זְקֵנִים מִשַּׁעַר שָׁבָתוּ אוֹי. כִּי מִשְׁפַּט יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה עִוְּתוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: The elders ceased to be at the city gates. Alas! Because they perverted the judgements against the orphan and widow. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ze-keh-neem mee-shah-ahr shah-vah-too ohy. kee meesh-paht yah-tohm ve-ahl-mah-nah ee-ve-too. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: שָׁבַת מְשׂוֹשׂ לִבֵּנוּ אוֹי. כִּי נִבְטְלוּ עוֹלֵי רְגָלֵינוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: The joy in our heart has ceased, Alas! Because we annulled our pilgrimages to the Temple. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: shah-vaht me-sohs lee-beh-noo ohy. kee neev-te-loo oh-ley re-gah-ley-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: נָפְלָה עֲטֶרֶת רֹאשֵׁנוּ אוֹי. כִּי נִשְׂרַף בֵּית מִקְדָּשֵׁנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: The crown has fallen from our head, Alas! Because our Holy Temple has burnt down. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: nah-fe-lah ah-teh-reht roh-sheh-noo ohy. kee nees-rahf beyt meek-dah-sheh-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: עַל זֶה הָיָה דָוֶה לִבֵּנוּ אוֹי. כִּי נֻטַּל כְּבוֹד בֵּית מַאֲוָיֵנוּ. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: It is due to this that we became faint hearted, Alas! Because the honour of our beloved House has been removed. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ahl zeh hah-yah dah-veh lee-beh-noo ohy. kee noo-tahl ke-vohd beyt mah-ah-vah-yeh-noo. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: עַל הַר צִיּוֹן שֶׁשָּׁמֵם אוֹי. כִּי נִתַּן עָלָיו שִׁקּוּץ מְשׁוֹמֵם. אוֹי מֶה הָיָה לָנוּ:
tokens.translation: For Mount Zion has become desolate, Alas! Because we have placed an abomination on it. Alas! what has occurred to us.
tokens.transliteration: ahl hahr tsee-yohn sheh-shah-mehm ohy. kee nee-tahn ah-lahv shee-koots me-shoh-mehm. ohy meh hah-yah lah-noo:

tokens.hebrew: אַתָּה יְיָ לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב כִּסְאֲךָ לְדוֹר וָדוֹר:
tokens.translation: For You, LORD, shall reign forever, for Your throne endures from generation to generation.
tokens.transliteration: ah-tah ye-yah le-oh-lahm teh-shehv kees-ah-khah le-dohr vah-dohr:

tokens.hebrew: לָמָּה לָנֶצַח תִּשְׁכָּחֵנוּ תַּעַזְבֵנוּ לְאֹרֶךְ יָמִים:
tokens.translation: Why have You forgotten us for ever and forsaken us for so long?
tokens.transliteration: lah-mah lah-neh-tsahkh teesh-kah-kheh-noo tah-ahz-veh-noo le-oh-rehkh yah-meem:

tokens.hebrew: הֲשִׁיבֵנוּ יְיָ אֵלֶיךָ וְנָשׁוּבָה חַדֵּשׁ יָמֵינוּ כְּקֶדֶם:
tokens.translation: Return us to You, LORD, and we will return. renew our days as of old.
tokens.transliteration: hah-shee-veh-noo ye-yah eh-ley-khah ve-nah-shoo-vah khah-dehsh yah-mey-noo ke-keh-dehm:

tokens.hebrew: כִּי אִם מָאֹס מְאַסְתָּנוּ קָצַפְתָּ עָלֵינוּ עַד מְאֹד:
tokens.translation: For if You utterly despised us, with a exceedingly furious anger against us.
tokens.transliteration: kee eem mah-ohs me-ahs-tah-noo kah-tsahf-tah ah-ley-noo ahd me-ohd:

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night.5
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Night · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: עַד אָנָה בִּכְיָה בְצִיּוֹן וּמִסְפֵּד בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם. תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן וְתִבְנֶה חוֹמוֹת יְרוּשָׁלָיִם:
tokens.translation: How long will there be crying in Zion and eulogies in Jerusalem? Have compassion for Zion and build the walls of Jerusalem.
tokens.transliteration: ahd ah-nah beekh-yah ve-tsee-yohn oo-mees-pehd bee-roo-shah-lah-yeem. te-rah-khehm tsee-yohn ve-teev-neh khoh-moht ye-roo-shah-lah-yeem:

tokens.hebrew: אָז בַּחֲטָאֵינוּ חָרַב מִקְדָּשׁ וּבַעֲוֹנוֹתֵינוּ נִשְׂרַף הֵיכָל. בְּאֶרֶץ חֻבְּרָה לָהּ קָשְׁרָה מִסְפֵּד. וּצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם נָשְׂאוּ קִינָה: עד אנה:
tokens.translation: א. Then, for our sins, the Sanctuary was destroyed, and for our violations, the Temple building was burnt. ב. On Earth, they gathered to her, compiling a eulogy. And the host of the Heavens raised a lament. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: ahz bah-khah-tah-ey-noo khah-rahv meek-dahsh oo-vah-ah-voh-noh-tey-noo nees-rahf hey-khahl. be-eh-rehts khoo-be-rah lahh kah-she-rah mees-pehd. oo-tse-vah hah-shah-mah-yeem nah-se-oo kee-nah: d nh:

tokens.hebrew: גַּם בָּכוּ בְּמֶרֶר שִׁבְטֵי יַעֲקֹב. וְאַף מַזָּלוֹת יִזְּלוּ דִּמְעָה. דִּגְלֵי יְשֻׁרוּן חָפוּ רֹאשָׁם. וְכִימָה וּכְסִיל קָדְרוּ פְּנֵיהֶם. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ג. Also the tribes of Jacob cried bitterly, and even the astrological constellations flowed with tears. ד. The flags of Jeshurun were despondent, and the Pleiades and Orion looked upset. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: gahm bah-khoo be-meh-rehr sheev-tey yah-ah-kohv. ve-ahf mah-zah-loht yee-ze-loo deem-ah. deeg-ley ye-shoo-roon khah-foo roh-shahm. ve-khee-mah oo-khe-seel kah-de-roo pe-ney-hehm. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: הֶעְתִּירוּ אָבוֹת וְלֹא שָׁמַע אֵל. צָעֲקוּ בָנִים וְלֹא עָנָה אָב. וְקוֹל הַתֹּר נִשְׁמַע בַּמָּרוֹם. וְרוֹעֶה נֶאֱמָן לֹא הִטָּה אֹזֶן. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ה. Fathers pleaded, but God did not listen. Sons screamed, but the Father did not answer. ו. And the sound of the dove was heard on high, but the faithful shepherd did not pay attention. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: heh-tee-roo ah-voht ve-loh shah-mah ehl. tsah-ah-koo vah-neem ve-loh ah-nah ahv. ve-kohl hah-tohr neesh-mah bah-mah-rohm. ve-roh-eh neh-eh-mahn loh hee-tah oh-zehn. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: זֶרַע קֹדֶשׁ לָבְשׁוּ שַׂקִּים. וּצְבָא הַשָּׁמַיִם גַּם הֵם שַׂק הוּשַׂם כְּסוּתָם. חָשַׁךְ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ קָדַר. וְכוֹכָבִים וּמַזָּלוֹת אָסְפוּ נָגְהָם. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ז. Holy descendants wore sackcloth, and even the host of the Heavens were put in sackcloth garments. ח. The sun got dark and the moon blackened, and stars and constellations gathered their moans. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: zeh-rah koh-dehsh lah-ve-shoo sah-keem. oo-tse-vah hah-shah-mah-yeem gahm hehm sahk hoo-sahm ke-soo-tahm. khah-shahkh hah-sheh-mehsh ve-yah-reh-ahkh kah-dahr. ve-khoh-khah-veem oo-mah-zah-loht ah-se-foo nah-ge-hahm. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: טָלֶה רִאשׁוֹן בָּכָה בְּמַר נֶפֶשׁ. עַל כִּי כְבָשָׂיו לָטֶבַח הוּבָלוּ. יְלָלָה הִשְׁמִיעַ שׁוֹר בַּמְּרוֹמִים. כִּי עַל צַוָּארֵנוּ נִרְדַּפְנוּ כֻּלָּנוּ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ט. First the ram (Aries) cried with a bitter soul for the fact that his lambs were brought to slaughter. י. A wail was sounded by the bull (Taurus) among the heights, because we were all chased by the neck. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: tah-leh ree-shohn bah-khah be-mahr neh-fehsh. ahl kee khe-vah-sahv lah-teh-vahkh hoo-vah-loo. ye-lah-lah heesh-mee-ah shohr bah-me-roh-meem. kee ahl tsah-vah-reh-noo neer-dahf-noo koo-lah-noo. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: כּוֹכַב תְּאוֹמִים נִרְאָה חָלוּק. כִּי דַּם אַחִים נִשְׁפַּךְ כַּמַּיִם. לָאָרֶץ בִּקֵּשׁ לִפֹּל סַרְטָן. כִּי נִתְעַלַּפְנוּ מִפְּנֵי צָמָא. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: כ. The twin star (Gemini) seemed split apart, because the blood of brothers was spilled like water. ל. The crab (Cancer) wished to fall to the ground, because we were fainting from thirst. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: koh-khahv te-oh-meem neer-ah khah-look. kee dahm ah-kheem neesh-pahkh kah-mah-yeem. lah-ah-rehts bee-kehsh lee-pohl sahr-tahn. kee neet-ah-lahf-noo mee-pe-ney tsah-mah. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: מָרוֹם נִבְעַת מִפְּנֵי אַרְיֵה. כִּי שַׁאֲגָתֵנוּ לֹא עָלְתָה לַמָּרוֹם. נֶהֶרְגוּ בְתוּלוֹת וְגַם בַּחוּרִים. כִּי עַל כֵּן בְּתוּלָה קָדְרָה פָּנֶיהָ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: מ. The high heavens were afraid of the lion (Leo) because our roar did not ascend to on high. נ. Young girls and boys were killed, so the maiden (Virgo)'s face looked upset. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: mah-rohm neev-aht mee-pe-ney ahr-yeh. kee shah-ah-gah-teh-noo loh ah-le-tah lah-mah-rohm. neh-hehr-goo ve-too-loht ve-gahm bah-khoo-reem. kee ahl kehn be-too-lah kah-de-rah pah-ney-hah. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: סִבֵּב מֹאזְנַיִם וּבִקֵּשׁ תְּחִנָּה. כִּי נִבְחַר לָנוּ מָוֶת מֵחַיִּים. עַקְרָב לָבַשׁ פַּחַד וּרְעָדָה. כִּי בְּחֶרֶב וּבְרָעָב שְׁפָטָנוּ צוּרֵנוּ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ס. The balance (Libra) spun and wished for rest, because death was preferable to us over life. ע. The scorpion (Scorpio) wore fear and trembling, because our enemies judged us with sword and hunger. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: see-behv moh-ze-nah-yeem oo-vee-kehsh te-khee-nah. kee neev-khahr lah-noo mah-veht meh-khah-yeem. ahk-rahv lah-vahsh pah-khahd oo-re-ah-dah. kee be-kheh-rehv oo-ve-rah-ahv she-fah-tah-noo tsoo-reh-noo. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: פַּלְגֵי מַיִם הוֹרִידוּ דִּמְעָה כַּנַּחַל. כִּי אוֹת בַּקֶּשֶׁת לֹא נִתַּן לָנוּ. צָפוּ מַיִם עַל רֹאשֵׁנוּ. וּבִדְלִי מָלֵא חִכֵּנוּ יָבֵשׁ. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: פ. Streams of water, let tears fall like a river, because the sign of the bow (Sagittarius) was not given to us. צ. Waters rise over our heads, and inside a full bucket (Aquarius) our throats are dry. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: pahl-gey mah-yeem hoh-ree-doo deem-ah kah-nah-khahl. kee oht bah-keh-sheht loh nee-tahn lah-noo. tsah-foo mah-yeem ahl roh-sheh-noo. oo-veed-lee mah-leh khee-keh-noo yah-vehsh. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: קֵרַבְנוּ קָרְבָּן וְלֹא נִתְקַבֵּל. וּגְדִי פָּסַק שְׂעִיר חַטֹּאתֵינוּ. רַחֲמָנִיּוֹת בִּשְּׁלוּ יַלְדֵּיהֶן. וּמַזַּל דָּגִים הֶעֱלִים עֵינָיו. עד אנה:
tokens.translation: ק. We offered a sacrifice but it was not accepted, and the goat (Capricorn) stopped our chatat-offering goats. ר. Merciful ones cooked their children, and the constellation of fish (Pisces) looked away. "How long..."
tokens.transliteration: keh-rahv-noo kohr-bahn ve-loh neet-kah-behl. oo-ge-dee pah-sahk se-eer khah-toh-tey-noo. rah-khah-mah-nee-yoht bee-she-loo yahl-dey-hehn. oo-mah-zahl dah-geem heh-eh-leem ey-nahv. d nh:

tokens.hebrew: שָׁכַחְנוּ שַׁבָּת בְּלִבּוֹת שׁוֹבָבִים. שַׁדַּי שִׁכַּח כָּל צִדְקוֹתֵינוּ. תְּקַנֵּא לְצִיּוֹן קִנְאָה גְּדוֹלָה. וְתָאִיר לְרַבָּתִי עָם מֵאוֹר נָגְהֶךָ:
tokens.translation: ש. We have forgotten about rest in our backsliding hearts. The Eternal has made all our righteousness irrelevant. ת. Engage passionately for Zion, with great jealousy, and light up the city full of people from your glowing light.
tokens.transliteration: shah-khahkh-noo shah-baht be-lee-boht shoh-vah-veem. shah-dahy shee-kahkh kohl tseed-koh-tey-noo. te-kah-neh le-tsee-yohn keen-ah ge-doh-lah. ve-tah-eer le-rah-bah-tee ahm meh-ohr nah-ge-heh-khah:

tokens.hebrew: תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַרְתָּ וּתְכוֹנְנֶהָ כַּאֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתָּ. תְּמַהֵר יְשׁוּעָה וְתָחִישׁ גְּאֻלָּה וְתָשׁוּב לִירוּשָׁלַיִם בְּרַחֲמִים רַבִּים: כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ לָכֵן כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ שַׁבְתִּי לִירוּשָׁלַיִם בְּרַחֲמִים בֵּיתִי יִבָּנֶה בָּהּ נְאֻם יְיָ צְבָאוֹת וְקָו יִנָּטֶה עַל יְרוּשָׁלָיִם: וְנֶאֱמַר. עוֹד קְרָא לֵאמֹר כֹּה אָמַר יְיָ צְבָאוֹת עוֹד תְּפוּצֶנָה עָרַי מִטּוֹב וְנִחַם יְיָ עוֹד אֶת צִיּוֹן וּבָחַר עוֹד בִּירוּשָׁלָיִם: וְנֶאֱמַר כִּי נִחַם יְיָ צִיּוֹן נִחַם כָּל חָרְבֹתֶיהָ וַיָּשֶׂם מִדְבָּרָהּ כְּעֵדֶן וְעַרְבָתָהּ כְּגַן יְיָ שָׂשׂוֹן וְשִׂמְחָה יִמָּצֵא בָהּ תּוֹדָה וְקוֹל זִמְרָה:
tokens.translation: Have mercy on Zion as you said, and build her as you stated. Hasten salvation, hurry redemption, and return to Jerusalem with great mercy. As was written by your prophet: "Therefore, this is what God says- I will return to Jerusalem mercifully, my house will be built in her, says God of Hosts, and a plumbline will be stretched over Jerusalem." And it is said: "Also call out saying: This is what God says- My cities will again be exploding with goodness, and God will comfort Zion and choose Jersualem again." And it is said: "For God has comforted Zion, comforted all her ruins, and has made her deserts like Eden and her wilderness like God's garden. Joy and happiness are to be found there, gratitude and the sound of song."
tokens.transliteration: te-rah-khehm tsee-yohn kah-ah-shehr ah-mahr-tah oo-te-khoh-ne-neh-hah kah-ah-shehr dee-bahr-tah. te-mah-hehr ye-shoo-ah ve-tah-kheesh ge-oo-lah ve-tah-shoov lee-roo-shah-lah-yeem be-rah-khah-meem rah-beem: kah-kah-toov ahl yahd ne-vee-eh-khah lah-khehn kohh ah-mahr ye-yah shahv-tee lee-roo-shah-lah-yeem be-rah-khah-meem bey-tee yee-bah-neh bahh ne-oom ye-yah tse-vah-oht ve-kahv yee-nah-teh ahl ye-roo-shah-lah-yeem: ve-neh-eh-mahr. ohd ke-rah leh-mohr kohh ah-mahr ye-yah tse-vah-oht ohd te-foo-tseh-nah ah-rahy mee-tohv ve-nee-khahm ye-yah ohd eht tsee-yohn oo-vah-khahr ohd bee-roo-shah-lah-yeem: ve-neh-eh-mahr kee nee-khahm ye-yah tsee-yohn nee-khahm kohl khohr-voh-tey-hah vah-yah-sehm meed-bah-rahh ke-eh-dehn ve-ahr-vah-tahh ke-gahn ye-yah sah-sohn ve-seem-khah yee-mah-tseh vahh toh-dah ve-kohl zeem-rah:

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day.19
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּאוֹתוֹת אֲשֶׁר הִפְלֵאתָ מֵאָז וְעַד עָתָּה,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness, because of the wondrous signs You have displayed from then until now;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah be-oh-toht ah-shehr heef-leh-tah meh-ahz ve-ahd ah-tah,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בִּבְחִינָה אֲשֶׁר נִצְרַפְנוּ וְאוֹתָנוּ תִּעָבְתָּ:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness, because of the trial with which You sought to refine us, (but as a result of our failure) You despised us.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem beev-khee-nah ah-shehr neets-rahf-noo ve-oh-tah-noo tee-ah-ve-tah:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצּדָקָה בְּגוֹי מִקֶּרֶב גּוֹי לָקַחְתָּ בְּמַסּוֹת,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because You have taken (our) nation from amidst another nation, with miracles;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-ts-dah-kah be-gohy mee-keh-rehv gohy lah-kahkh-tah be-mah-soht,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּדֺפִי אֲשֶׁר נִמְצָא בָנוּ כְּמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם עֲשׂוֹת:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness, because of the hypocrisy to be found within us as we emulated (Egypt's abominable) deeds.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-doh-fee ah-shehr neem-tsah vah-noo ke-mah-ah-sey-hehm ah-soht:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצּדָקָה בְּהָלְכוּ אֱלֹהִים לִפְדּוֹת לוֹ לְעָם,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because God went out to redeem us as a people unto Himself;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-ts-dah-kah be-hah-le-khoo eh-loh-heem leef-doht loh le-ahm,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּוַיַּמְרוּ עַל יָם בְּיַם סוּף גּוֹי בֵּאלֹהָיו בְּפָשְׁעָם:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness, because they (our forefathers) rebelled on the shore of the Sea of reeds, the nation sinning against its God!
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-vah-yahm-roo ahl yahm be-yahm soof gohy beh-loh-hahv be-fah-she-ahm:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצַּדָקָה בְּזֵכֶר וְאַתֶּם עֵדַי וַאֲנִי אֱלֹהִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness when we recall the proclamation, 'You are witnesses, and I am God!'
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tsah-dah-kah be-zeh-khehr ve-ah-tehm eh-dahy vah-ah-nee eh-loh-heem,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּחָרְפֵנוּ בְּסִין קוּם עֲשֵׂה לָנוּ אֱלֹהִים:
tokens.translation: and, ours is the shamefacedness, because we blasphemed Hashem in (the Wilderness of) Sin (when we demanded of Aaron), 'Arise and create a god for us!'
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-khah-re-feh-noo be-seen koom ah-seh lah-noo eh-loh-heem:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּטַעַם שֶׁהִטְעַמְתָּנוּ כְּצַפִּיחִת בִּדְבָשׁ,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because You fed us (the manna) that tasted like dough fried in honey;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah be-tah-ahm sheh-heet-ahm-tah-noo ke-tsah-pee-kheet beed-vahsh,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּיוֹם הִקְרַבְנוּ לְפָנָיו סֺלֶת וָשֶׁמֶן וּדְבָשׁ:
tokens.translation: and ours, is the shamefacedness, because on the day (we made the Golden Calf), we brought it an offering of fine flour with oil and honey.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-yohm heek-rahv-noo le-fah-nahv soh-leht vah-sheh-mehn oo-de-vahsh:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּכִלְכּוּל מָן וּבְאֵר וְעַמּוּד עָנָן,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because you provided us with the manna, the well and the pillar of clouds;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah be-kheel-kool mahn oo-ve-ehr ve-ah-mood ah-nahn,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּלֶחֶם הַקְּלֹקֵל אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְּאָהֳלֵיהֶם בְּרָגְנָן:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because our forefathers grumbled in their tents about (the manna and called it) the destructive bread.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-leh-khehm hah-ke-loh-kehl ah-voh-tey-noo be-oh-hoh-ley-hehm be-rah-ge-nahn:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בַּמִּדְבָּר לֹא חָסַרְנוּ דָּבָר,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because in the wilderness we lacked for nothing;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah bah-meed-bahr loh khah-sahr-noo dah-vahr,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּנִאֲצוֹת לָבָן וְחֲצֵרֺת וְדִי זָהָב כִּמְדֻבָּר:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because we defied You as Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab as related (by Moses),
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-nee-ah-tsoht lah-vahn ve-khah-tseh-roht ve-dee zah-hahv keem-doo-bahr:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּסִיחוֹן וְעוֹג וְכֺל מַלְכֵי כְנָעַן,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because of (how You waged war for us with) Sihon and Og and all the kings of Canaan;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah be-see-khohn ve-ohg ve-khohl mahl-khey khe-nah-ahn,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּעָכָן אֲשֶׁר מָעַל בַּחֵרֶם בְּלִי מְצֺא מַעַן:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because of Achan who appropriated for himself from the forbidden spoils (of Jericho) and found no excuse (for his crime).
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-ah-khahn ah-shehr mah-ahl bah-kheh-rehm be-lee me-tsoh mah-ahn:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּפֺעַל אֲשֶׁר פָּעַלְתָּ בְּאַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר מוֹשִׁיעִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because of all that You accomplished through the fourteen saviors(-Judges);
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah be-foh-ahl ah-shehr pah-ahl-tah be-ahr-bah-ah ah-sahr moh-shee-eem,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּצֶלֶם מִיכָה כִּי בוֹ אֲנַחְנוּ פוֹשְׁעִים:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because of Micah's idol through which we transgressed.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-tseh-lehm mee-khah kee voh ah-nahkh-noo foh-she-eem:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בְּקִימַת שִׁילֹה וְנוֹב וְגִבְעוֹן וּבֵית עוֹלָמִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because You erected (Tabernacles) at Shiloh, Nob, Gibeon and the Eternal Temple (in Jerusalem);
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah be-kee-maht shee-lohh ve-nohv ve-geev-ohn oo-veyt oh-lah-meem,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּרֶשַׁע שֶׁנִּמְצָא בָנוּ שֶׁחָרְבוּ וּבָם אָנוּ נִכְלָמִים:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because the evil in our midst caused each one's destruction, and in their loss, we have been humiliated.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-reh-shah sheh-neem-tsah vah-noo sheh-khohr-voo oo-vahm ah-noo neekh-lah-meem:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בִּשְׁנֵי חָרְבָּנוֹת שֶׁחָרְבוּ בְּבִצְעֵנוּ וְאָנוּ קַיָּמִים,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because although the Destructions of the two Temples were caused by our corruption, we ourselves were spared;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah beesh-ney khohr-bah-noht sheh-khohr-voo be-veets-eh-noo ve-ah-noo kah-yah-meem,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים בְּשׁוּבֵנוּ אֵלֶיךָ בְּכָָל לֵב שֶׁתָּשׁוּב אֵלֵינוּ בְּרַחֲמִים:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because we should have repented to You wholeheartedly so that You would return to us in compassion.
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem be-shoo-veh-noo eh-ley-khah be-khahahl lehv sheh-tah-shoov eh-ley-noo be-rah-khah-meem:

tokens.hebrew: לְךָ יהוה הַצְּדָקָה בִּתְשַׁע מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה שֶׁהָיְתָה שִׂנְאָה כְּבוּשָׁה מִלְּהִשָּׁמַע,
tokens.translation: Yours, my Lord, is the righteousness because of the (almost) nine centuries throughout which You withheld Your anger (over our sins) and didn't broadcast it;
tokens.transliteration: le-khah ah-doh-NAI hah-tse-dah-kah beet-shah meh-oht shah-nah sheh-hah-ye-tah seen-ah ke-voo-shah mee-le-hee-shah-mah,

tokens.hebrew: וְלָנוּ בּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים כְּתָבַע אִישׁ חַמוּדוֹת וְשִׁוַּע הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשֲׁמָע:
tokens.translation: and ours is the shamefacedness because (Daniel) the man of delights pleaded with You (to end the Babylonian Exile after a mere seventy years, even though we were not worthy,) saying, 'Incline Your ear, O my God, and hear!'
tokens.transliteration: ve-lah-noo b-sheht hah-pah-neem ke-tah-vah eesh khah-moo-doht ve-shee-vah hah-teh eh-loh-hahy ohz-ne-khah oo-shah-mah:

hebrewReview.sourceRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day.19

title: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day
sefariaRef: Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz), Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day.45
summary: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz)
useCase: Kinot for Tisha B'Av Day · Kinnot for Tisha B'Av (Ashkenaz) Themes: grief. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלִי צִיּוֹן וְעָרֶיהָ, כְּמוֹ אִשָּׁה בְּצִירֶיהָ, וְכִבְתוּלָה חֲגוּרַת שַׂק, עַל בַּעַל נְעוּרֶיהָ
tokens.translation: Mourn for Zion and her cities, like a woman giving birth, like a maiden wrapped in sack-cloth for the husband of her youth
tokens.transliteration: eh-lee tsee-yohn ve-ah-rey-hah, ke-moh ee-shah be-tsee-rey-hah, ve-kheev-too-lah khah-goo-raht sahk, ahl bah-ahl ne-oo-rey-hah

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי אַרְמוֹן אֲשֶׁר נֻטַּשׁ, בְּאַשְׁמַת צֹאן עֲדָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the palace that was abandoned like a sheep’s negligence of its flock,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley ahr-mohn ah-shehr noo-tahsh, be-ahsh-maht tsohn ah-dah-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל בִּיאַת מְחָרְפֵי אֵל, בְּתוֹךְ מִקְדַּשׁ חֲדָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the entry of God’s blasphemers into her holy sanctuary.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl bee-aht me-khah-re-fey ehl, be-tohkh meek-dahsh khah-dah-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי גָלוּת מְשָׁרְתֵי אֵל, נְעִימֵי שִׁיר זְמָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for God’s exiled servants who beautifully sang her songs,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley gah-loot me-shah-re-tey ehl, ne-ee-mey sheer ze-mah-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל דָּמָם אֲשֶׁר שֻׁפַּךְ כְּמוֹ מֵימֵי יְאוֹרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for their blood that was spilled like the waters of her rivers.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl dah-mahm ah-shehr shoo-pahkh ke-moh mey-mey ye-oh-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי הֶגְיוֹן מְחוֹלֶיהָ, אֲשֶׁר דָּמַם בְּעָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the chatter of her dancers whose silence fills her cities,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley hehg-yohn me-khoh-ley-hah, ah-shehr dah-mahm be-ah-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל וַעַד אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַם וּבִטּוּל סַנְהֶדְרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the assembly that was destroyed and the abolition of her Sanhedrin.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl vah-ahd ah-shehr shah-mahm oo-vee-tool sahn-hehd-rey-hah.

tokens.translation: Mourn for the daily sacrifices and the redemption of her firstborn,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל חִלּוּל כְּלֵי הֵיכָל וּמִזְבֵּחַ קְטוֹרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the desecration of the Temple vessels and the altar of her incense.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl khee-lool ke-ley hey-khahl oo-meez-beh-ahkh ke-toh-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי טַפֵּי מְלָכֶיהָ בְּנֵי דָוִד גְּבִירֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the babes of her kings, noble children of David,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley tah-pey me-lah-khey-hah be-ney dah-veed ge-vee-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל יָפְיָם אֲשֶׁר חָשַׁךְ בְּעֵת סָרוּ כְּתָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for their beauty that was darkened at the time of the removal of her crowns.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl yohf-yahm ah-shehr khah-shahkh be-eht sah-roo ke-tah-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי כָבוֹד אֲשֶׁר גָּלָה בְּעֵת חָרְבַּן דְּבִירֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the glory that was dispelled at the time of the destruction of her Holy of Holies,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley khah-vohd ah-shehr gah-lah be-eht khohr-bahn de-vee-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל לוֹחֵץ אֲשֶׁר לָחַץ וְשָׂם שַׂקִּים חֲגוֹרֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: and for the oppressor who tormented her whilst girding her in sackcloth.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl loh-khehts ah-shehr lah-khahts ve-sahm sah-keem khah-goh-rey-hah:

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי מַחַץ וְרֹב מַכּוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֻכּוּ נְזִירֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the wounds and the many blows that struck her sainted ones,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley mah-khahts ve-rohv mah-koht ah-shehr hoo-koo ne-zee-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל נִפּוּץ אֱלֵי סֶלַע עֲוִילֶיהָ נְעָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the smashing on the rock of her young children.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl nee-poots eh-ley seh-lah ah-vee-ley-hah ne-ah-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי שִׂמְחַת מְשַׂנְאֶיהָ בְּשָׂחְקָם עַל שְׁבָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the joy of her haters who rejoiced over her downfall,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley seem-khaht me-sahn-ey-hah be-sah-khe-kahm ahl she-vah-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל עִנּוּי בְּנֵי חוֹרִין נְדִיבֶיהָ טְהוֹרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the torment of her pure and noble citizens.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl ee-nooy be-ney khoh-reen ne-dee-vey-hah te-hoh-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי פֶשַׁע אֲשֶׁר עָוְתָה סְלוֹל דֶּרֶךְ אֲשׁוּרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the sins that caused her to deviate from the true path,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley feh-shah ah-shehr ah-ve-tah se-lohl deh-rehkh ah-shoo-rey-hah,

tokens.translation: and for her numerous congregations, which were tarnished and blackened.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי קוֹלוֹת מְחָרְפֶיהָ בְּעֵת רַבּוּ פְגָרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for the voices of her abusers as her rising corpses mounted,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley koh-loht me-khah-re-fey-hah be-eht rah-boo fe-gah-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל רִגְשַׁת מְגַדְפֶיהָ בְּתוֹך מִשְׁכַּן חֲצֵרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for the jeering mobs within her holy courtyards.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl reeg-shaht me-gahd-fey-hah be-tohkh meesh-kahn khah-tseh-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: עֲלֵי שִׁמְךָ אֲשֶׁר חֻלַּל בְּפִי קָמֵי מְצֵרֶיהָ,
tokens.translation: Mourn for Your name which was desecrated in the mouths of those who stand against her,
tokens.transliteration: ah-ley sheem-khah ah-shehr khoo-lahl be-fee kah-mey me-tseh-rey-hah,

tokens.hebrew: וְעַל תַּחַן יְצַוְּחוּ לָךְ קְשׁוֹב וּשְׁמַע אֲמָרֶיהָ.
tokens.translation: and for their prayers which they cry out to you, heed and hear her words....
tokens.transliteration: ve-ahl tah-khahn ye-tsah-ve-khoo lahkh ke-shohv oo-she-mah ah-mah-rey-hah.

tokens.hebrew: אֱלִי צִיּוֹן וְעָרֶיהָ, כְּמוֹ אִשָּׁה בְּצִירֶיהָ, וְכִבְתוּלָה חֲגוּרַת שַׂק, עַל בַּעַל נְעוּרֶיהָ:
tokens.translation: Mourn for Zion and her cities, like a woman giving birth, like a maiden wrapped in sack-cloth for the husband of her youth
tokens.transliteration: eh-lee tsee-yohn ve-ah-rey-hah, ke-moh ee-shah be-tsee-rey-hah, ve-kheev-too-lah khah-goo-raht sahk, ahl bah-ahl ne-oo-rey-hah:

title: Concluding Prayer
sefariaRef: Perek Shirah, Concluding Prayer
useCase: Concluding Prayer · Perek Shirah Themes: nature. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.translation: After reciting the chapter of Shirah:

tokens.hebrew: רִבּוֹן כֹּל הָעוֹלָמִים, יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יי אֱלֹהַי וֶאֱלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתַי, שֶׁבִּזְכוּת "פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה שֶׁקָּרָאתִי, שֶׁהוּא שִׁירַת הַדּוֹמֵם הַצּוֹמֵחַ וְהַחַי, וְהַמַּלְאָכִים הַמְּמֻנִּים עֲלֵיהֶם מֵאֵת ד' יִתְבָּרֵךְ, שֶׁתְּהֵא אֲמִירָתוֹ כְּהַקְרָבַת קָרְבָּן עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ. שֶׁתְּהֵא שָׁעָה זוּ שְׁעַת רַחֲמִים, שְׁעַת הַקְשָׁבָה, שְׁעַת הַאֲזָנָה, וְנִקְרָאֲךָ וּתְעַנִּינוּ, נַעְתִּיר לְךָ וְהֵעָתֵר לָנוּ.
tokens.translation: Master of all worlds, may it be Your will before You, Lord my God and the God of my ancestors, that in the merit of "the chapter of Shirah" that I have recited – which is the song of the mute, the growing, and the living, and the appointed angels over them from the blessed God – may its recitation be like bringing an offering upon the altar. May this moment be a time of mercy, a time of heeding, a time of listening, and may You be called upon and answer us. We implore You and beseech You to hear our plea....
tokens.transliteration: ree-bohn kohl hah-oh-lah-meem, ye-hee rah-tsohn mee-le-fah-ney-khah yy eh-loh-hahy veh-eh-loh-hey ah-voh-tahy, sheh-beez-khoot "peh-rehk shee-rah sheh-kah-rah-tee, sheh-hoo shee-raht hah-doh-mehm hah-tsoh-meh-ahkh ve-hah-khahy, ve-hah-mahl-ah-kheem hah-me-moo-neem ah-ley-hehm meh-eht d' yeet-bah-rehkh, sheh-te-heh ah-mee-rah-toh ke-hahk-rah-vaht kohr-bahn ahl gah-bey hah-meez-beh-ahkh. sheh-te-heh shah-ah zoo she-aht rah-khah-meem, she-aht hahk-shah-vah, she-aht hah-ah-zah-nah, ve-neek-rah-ah-khah oo-te-ah-nee-noo, nah-teer le-khah ve-heh-ah-tehr lah-noo.

tokens.hebrew: שֶׁתִּהְיֶה עוֹלָה לְפָנֶיךָ אֲמִירַת פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה כְּאִלּוּ הִשַּׂגְנוּ כֹּל הַסּוֹדוֹת הַנִּפְלָאוֹת וְהַנּוֹרָאוֹת אֲשֶׁר הֵם חֲתוּמִים בּוֹ בְּכֹל תְּנָאָיו. הַחְזִירֵנוּ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שְׁלֵמָה לְפָנֶיךָ, וְנִזְכֶּה לְמָקוֹם שֶׁהַנְּפָשׁוֹת הָרוּחוֹת וְהַנְשָׁמוֹת נֶחְצָבוֹת מִשַּׁם, וּכְאִלּוּ עָשִׂינוּ כֹּל אַשֵּׁר מוּטָל עָלֵינוּ לְהַשִּׂיג, בֵּין בְּגִלְגּוּל זֶה בֵּין בְּגִלְגּוּלִים אֲחֵרִים, וּמַלֵּא כֹּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹת לִבֵּנוּ לְטוֹבָה (כָּאן יוֹסִיף בִּפְרָטִיּוּת מַה שֶׁנִּצְרַךְ) וְתִשְׁלַח בְּרָכָה הַצְלָחָה וְהַרְוָחָה בְּכֹל מֵעֲשֵׂה יָדֵינוּ, וְנִזְכֶּה לְשׁוֹרֵר לַעֲתִיד לָבוֹא, וְתַשִּׁיב שְׁכִינָתְךָ לְעִיר קָדְשְׁךָ בִּמְהֵרָה בְּיָמֵינוּ אָמֵן. (מעובד מהרב רבי מרדכי גרוס שליט"א)
tokens.translation: May the recitation of the chapter of Shirah be presented before You as if we had comprehended all the wondrous and awe-inspiring secrets sealed within it, in all its details. Return us in complete repentance before You, and may we merit a place where the soaring souls and spirits are stationed, as if we have accomplished all that is incumbent upon us to achieve, whether in this reincarnation or in subsequent ones. Fulfill all the desires of our hearts for good (here add specific requests as needed), and send blessings, success, and tranquility in all the works of our hands. May we merit to rule in the future, and may You swiftly restore Your divine presence to Your holy city. Amen. (Adapted from Rabbi Mordechai Gross, shlita)

tokens.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֗ה הוֹאֵל֙ וּבָרֵךְ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית עַבְדְּךָ֔ לִהְי֥וֹת לְעוֹלָ֖ם לְפָנֶ֑יךָ כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתָּ וּמִבִּרְכָ֣תְךָ֔ יְבֹרַ֥ךְ בֵּֽית־עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְעוֹלָֽם׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: now therefore let it please Thee to bless the house of Thy servant, that it may continue for ever before Thee; for Thou, O Lord GOD, hast spoken it; and through Thy blessing let the house of Thy servant be blessed for ever.’
tokens.transliteration: ve-ah-TAH hoh-EHL oo-vah-REHKH eht BEYT ahv-de-KHAH leeh-YOHT le-oh-LAHM le-fah-NEY-khah kee ah-TAH ah-doh-NAHY eh-loh-HEEM dee-BAHR-tah oo-mee-beer-KHAH-te-KHAH ye-voh-RAHKH beyt ahv-de-KHAH le-oh-LAHM (f)

translationVersions.versionTitle: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

title: David's song of deliverance
sefariaRef: II Samuel 22
useCase: David's song of deliverance Themes: gratitude, protection. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֖י הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּיוֹם֩ הִצִּ֨יל יְהוָ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כָּל־אֹיְבָ֖יו וּמִכַּ֥ף שָׁאֽוּל׃
tokens.translation: And David spoke unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul;
tokens.transliteration: vah-ye-dah-BEHR dah-VEED lah-ah-doh-NAI eht deev-REY hah-shee-RAH hah-ZOHT be-YOHM hee-TSEEL ah-doh-NAI oh-TOH mee-KAHF kohl oh-ye-VAHV oo-mee-KAHF shah-OOL

tokens.translation: and he said: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-MAHR ah-doh-NAI sah-le-EE oo-me-tsoo-dah-TEE oo-me-fahl-tee LEE

tokens.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵ֥י צוּרִ֖י אֶחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָגִנִּ֞י וְקֶ֣רֶן יִשְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּי֙ וּמְנוּסִ֔י מֹשִׁעִ֕י מֵחָמָ֖ס תֹּשִׁעֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: The God who is my rock, in Him I take refuge; My shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower, and my refuge; My saviour, Thou savest me from violence.
tokens.transliteration: eh-loh-HEY tsoo-REE eh-kheh-seh BOH mah-gee-NEE ve-KEH-rehn yeesh-EE mees-gah-BEE oo-me-noo-SEE moh-shee-EE meh-khah-MAHS toh-shee-EH-nee

tokens.translation: Praised, I cry, is the LORD, and I am saved from mine enemies.

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י אֲפָפֻ֖נִי מִשְׁבְּרֵי־מָ֑וֶת נַחֲלֵ֥י בְלִיַּ֖עַל יְבַעֲתֻֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: For the waves of Death compassed me. The floods of Belial assailed me.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ah-fah-FOO-nee meesh-be-rey MAH-veht nah-khah-LEY ve-lee-YAH-ahl ye-vah-ah-TOO-nee

tokens.translation: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of Death confronted me.
tokens.transliteration: khehv-LEY she-OHL sah-BOO-nee kee-de-MOO-nee moh-ke-shey MAH-veht

tokens.hebrew: בַּצַּר־לִי֙ אֶקְרָ֣א יְהוָ֔ה וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֖י אֶקְרָ֑א וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע מֵהֵֽיכָלוֹ֙ קוֹלִ֔י וְשַׁוְעָתִ֖י בְּאָזְנָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD, yea, I called unto my God; and out of His temple He heard my voice, and my cry did enter into His ears.
tokens.transliteration: bah-tsahr LEE ehk-RAH ah-doh-NAI ve-ehl eh-loh-HAHY ehk-RAH vah-yeesh-MAH meh-hey-khah-LOH koh-LEE ve-shahv-ah-TEE be-ohz-NAHV

tokens.hebrew: ותגעש [וַיִּתְגָּעַ֤שׁ] וַתִּרְעַשׁ֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מוֹסְד֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁ֖וּ כִּֽי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: Then the earth did shake and quake, the foundations of heaven did tremble; they were shaken, because He was wroth.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeet-gah-AHSH vah-teer-AHSH hah-AH-rehts moh-se-DOHT hah-shah-MAH-yeem yeer-GAH-zoo vah-yee-te-gah-ah-SHOO kee KHAH-rah LOH

tokens.hebrew: עָלָ֤ה עָשָׁן֙ בְּאַפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥שׁ מִפִּ֖יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּחָלִ֖ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
tokens.translation: Smoke arose up in His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth did devour; coals flamed forth from Him.
tokens.transliteration: ah-LAH ah-SHAHN be-ah-POH ve-EHSH mee-PEEV toh-KHEHL geh-khah-LEEM bah-ah-ROO mee-MEH-noo

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּ֥ט שָׁמַ֖יִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַעֲרָפֶ֖ל תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and thick darkness was under His feet.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YEHT shah-MAH-yeem vah-yeh-RAHD vah-ah-rah-FEHL TAH-khaht rahg-LAHV

tokens.translation: And He rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, He was seen upon the wings of the wind.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeer-KAHV ahl ke-ROOV vah-yah-OHF vah-yeh-RAH ahl kahn-fey ROO-ahkh

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּ֥שֶׁת חֹ֛שֶׁךְ סְבִיבֹתָ֖יו סֻכּ֑וֹת חַֽשְׁרַת־מַ֖יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃
tokens.translation: And He made darkness pavilions round about Him, gathering of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAH-sheht KHOH-shehkh se-vee-voh-TAHV soo-KOHT khah-she-raht MAH-yeem ah-VEY she-khah-KEEM

tokens.translation: At the brightness before Him coals of fire flamed forth.

tokens.hebrew: יַרְעֵ֥ם מִן־שָׁמַ֖יִם יְהוָ֑ה וְעֶלְי֖וֹן יִתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the Most High gave forth His voice.
tokens.transliteration: yahr-EHM meen shah-MAH-yeem ah-doh-NAI ve-ehl-YOHN yee-TEHN koh-LOH

tokens.translation: And He sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

tokens.hebrew: וַיֵּֽרָאוּ֙ אֲפִ֣קֵי יָ֔ם יִגָּל֖וּ מֹסְד֣וֹת תֵּבֵ֑ל בְּגַעֲרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִנִּשְׁמַ֖ת ר֥וּחַ אַפּֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were laid bare by the rebuke of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of His nostrils.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yeh-rah-OO ah-FEE-key YAHM yee-gah-LOO moh-se-DOHT teh-VEHL be-gah-ah-RAHT ah-doh-NAI mee-neesh-MAHT ROO-ahkh ah-POH

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁלַ֥ח מִמָּר֖וֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽמְשֵׁ֖נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
tokens.translation: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters;
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-LAHKH mee-mah-ROHM yee-kah-KHEH-nee yah-me-SHEH-nee mee-MAH-yeem rah-BEEM

tokens.hebrew: יַצִּילֵ֕נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֖י עָ֑ז מִשֹּׂ֣נְאַ֔י כִּ֥י אָמְצ֖וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
tokens.translation: He delivered me from mine enemy most strong, from them that hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
tokens.transliteration: yah-tsee-LEH-nee meh-oh-ye-VEE AHZ mee-SOH-ne-AHY KEE ah-me-TSOO mee-MEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: יְקַדְּמֻ֖נִי בְּי֣וֹם אֵידִ֑י וַיְהִ֧י יְהוָ֛ה מִשְׁעָ֖ן לִֽי׃
tokens.translation: They confronted me in the day of my calamity; but the LORD was a stay unto me.
tokens.transliteration: ye-kah-de-MOO-nee be-YOHM ey-DEE vah-ye-HEE ah-doh-NAI meesh-AHN LEE

tokens.hebrew: וַיֹּצֵ֥א לַמֶּרְחָ֖ב אֹתִ֑י יְחַלְּצֵ֖נִי כִּי־חָ֥פֵֽץ בִּֽי׃
tokens.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because He delighted in me.
tokens.transliteration: vah-yoh-TSEH lah-mehr-KHAHV oh-TEE ye-khah-le-TSEH-nee kee KHAH-fehts BEE

tokens.hebrew: יִגְמְלֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָדַ֖י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃
tokens.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; According to the cleanness of my hands hath He recompensed me.
tokens.transliteration: yeeg-me-LEH-nee ah-doh-NAI ke-tseed-kah-TEE ke-VOHR yah-DAHY yah-SHEEV LEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖רְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹ֥א רָשַׁ֖עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
tokens.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, And have not wickedly departed from my God.
tokens.transliteration: KEE shah-MAHR-tee dahr-KHEY ah-doh-NAI ve-LOH rah-SHAH-tee meh-eh-loh-HAHY

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י כָל־משפטו [מִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו] לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְחֻקֹּתָ֖יו לֹא־אָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
tokens.translation: For all His ordinances were before me; And as for His statutes, I did not depart from them.
tokens.transliteration: KEE khah-meesh-pah-TAHV le-nehg-DEE ve-khoo-koh-TAHV loh ah-SOOR mee-MEH-nah

tokens.translation: And I was single-hearted toward Him, And I kept myself from mine iniquity.

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י כְּצִדְקָתִ֑י כְּבֹרִ֖י לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
tokens.translation: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, According to my cleanness in His eyes.
tokens.transliteration: vah-YAH-shehv ah-doh-NAI LEE ke-tseed-kah-TEE ke-voh-REE le-NEH-gehd ey-NAHV

tokens.translation: With the merciful Thou dost show Thyself merciful, With the upright man Thou dost show Thyself upright,
tokens.transliteration: eem khah-SEED teet-khah-SAHD eem gee-BOHR tah-MEEM tee-tah-MAHM

tokens.translation: With the pure Thou dost show Thyself pure; And with the crooked Thou dost show Thyself subtle.
tokens.transliteration: eem nah-VAHR tee-tah-VAHR ve-eem ee-KEHSH tee-tah-PAHL

tokens.hebrew: וְאֶת־עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י תּוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינֶ֖יךָ עַל־רָמִ֥ים תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
tokens.translation: And the afflicted people Thou dost save; But Thine eyes are upon the haughty, that Thou mayest humble them.
tokens.transliteration: ve-eht AHM ah-NEE toh-SHEE-ah ve-ey-NEY-khah ahl rah-MEEM tahsh-PEEL

tokens.hebrew: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֥ה נֵירִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וַיהוָ֖ה יַגִּ֥יהַּ חָשְׁכִּֽי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou art my lamp, O LORD; And the LORD doth lighten my darkness.
tokens.transliteration: kee ah-TAH ney-REE ah-doh-NAI vah-ah-doh-NAI yah-GEE-ahh khohsh-KEE

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י בְכָ֖ה אָר֣וּץ גְּד֑וּד בֵּאלֹהַ֖י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃
tokens.translation: For by Thee I run upon a troop; By my God do I scale a wall.
tokens.transliteration: KEE ve-KHAH ah-ROOTS ge-DOOD beh-loh-HAHY ah-dah-lehg SHOOR

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵ֖ל תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכּ֑וֹ אִמְרַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ צְרוּפָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן ה֔וּא לְכֹ֖ל הַחֹסִ֥ים בּֽוֹ׃
tokens.translation: As for God, His way is perfect; The word of the LORD is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in Him.
tokens.transliteration: hah-EHL tah-MEEM dahr-KOH eem-RAHT ah-doh-NAI tse-roo-FAH mah-GEHN HOO le-KHOHL hah-khoh-SEEM BOH

tokens.hebrew: כִּ֥י מִי־אֵ֖ל מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֖וּר מִֽבַּלְעֲדֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
tokens.translation: For who is God, save the LORD? And who is a Rock, save our God?
tokens.transliteration: KEE mee EHL mee-bahl-ah-DEY ah-doh-NAI oo-MEE TSOOR mee-bahl-ah-DEY eh-loh-HEY-noo

tokens.hebrew: הָאֵ֥ל מָעוּזִּ֖י חָ֑יִל וַיַּתֵּ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים דרכו [דַּרְכִּֽי׃]
tokens.translation: The God who is my strong fortress, And who letteth my way go forth straight;
tokens.transliteration: hah-EHL mah-oo-ZEE KHAH-yeel vah-yah-TEHR tah-MEEM dahr-KEE

tokens.hebrew: מְשַׁוֶּ֥ה רגליו [רַגְלַ֖י] כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַעֲמִדֵֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: Who maketh my feet like hinds’, And setteth me upon my high places;
tokens.transliteration: me-shah-VEH rahg-LAHY kah-ah-yah-LOHT ve-AHL bah-moh-TAHY yah-ah-mee-DEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: מְלַמֵּ֥ד יָדַ֖י לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְנִחַ֥ת קֶֽשֶׁת־נְחוּשָׁ֖ה זְרֹעֹתָֽי׃
tokens.translation: Who traineth my hands for war, So that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
tokens.transliteration: me-lah-MEHD yah-DAHY lah-meel-khah-MAH ve-nee-KHAHT keh-sheht ne-khoo-SHAH ze-roh-oh-TAHY

tokens.translation: Thou hast also given me Thy shield of salvation; And Thy condescension hath made me great.
tokens.transliteration: vah-tee-tehn LEE mah-GEHN yeesh-EH-khah vah-ah-noh-te-KHAH tahr-BEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: תַּרְחִ֥יב צַעֲדִ֖י תַּחְתֵּ֑נִי וְלֹ֥א מָעֲד֖וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, And my feet have not slipped.
tokens.transliteration: tahr-KHEEV tsah-ah-DEE tahkh-TEH-nee ve-LOH mah-ah-DOO kahr-soo-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: אֶרְדְּפָ֥ה אֹיְבַ֖י וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
tokens.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; Neither did I turn back till they were consumed.
tokens.transliteration: ehr-de-FAH oh-ye-VAHY vah-ahsh-mee-DEHM ve-LOH ah-SHOOV ahd kah-loh-TAHM

tokens.hebrew: וָאֲכַלֵּ֥ם וָאֶמְחָצֵ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יְקוּמ֑וּן וַֽיִּפְּל֖וּ תַּ֥חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
tokens.translation: And I have consumed them, and smitten them through, that they cannot arise; Yea, they are fallen under my feet.
tokens.transliteration: vah-ah-khah-LEHM vah-ehm-khah-TSEHM ve-LOH ye-koo-MOON vah-yee-pe-LOO TAH-khaht rahg-LAHY

tokens.hebrew: וַתַּזְרֵ֥נִי חַ֖יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֥יעַ קָמַ֖י תַּחְתֵּֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: For Thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
tokens.transliteration: vah-tahz-REH-nee KHAH-yeel lah-meel-khah-MAH tahkh-REE-ah kah-MAHY tahkh-TEH-nee

tokens.hebrew: וְאֹ֣יְבַ֔י תַּ֥תָּה לִּ֖י עֹ֑רֶף מְשַׂנְאַ֖י וָאַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
tokens.translation: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me; Yea, them that hate me, that I might cut them off.
tokens.transliteration: ve-OH-ye-VAHY TAH-tah LEE OH-rehf me-sahn-AHY vah-ahts-mee-TEHM

tokens.hebrew: יִשְׁע֖וּ וְאֵ֣ין מֹשִׁ֑יעַ אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א עָנָֽם׃
tokens.translation: They looked, but there was none to save; Even unto the LORD, but He answered them not.
tokens.transliteration: yeesh-OO ve-EYN moh-SHEE-ah ehl ah-doh-NAI ve-LOH ah-NAHM

tokens.translation: Then did I beat them small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the streets, and did tread them down.
tokens.transliteration: ve-ehsh-khah-KEHM kah-ah-fahr AH-rehts ke-teet khoo-TSOHT ah-dee-KEHM ehr-kah-EHM

tokens.hebrew: וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵ֔נִי מֵרִיבֵ֖י עַמִּ֑י תִּשְׁמְרֵ֙נִי֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֔ם עַ֥ם לֹא־יָדַ֖עְתִּי יַעַבְדֻֽנִי׃
tokens.translation: Thou also hast delivered me from the contentions of my people; Thou hast kept me to be the head of the nations; A people whom I have not known serve me.
tokens.transliteration: vah-te-fah-le-TEH-nee meh-ree-VEY ah-MEE teesh-me-REH-nee le-ROHSH goh-YEEM AHM loh yah-DAH-tee yah-ahv-DOO-nee

tokens.hebrew: בְּנֵ֥י נֵכָ֖ר יִתְכַּֽחֲשׁוּ־לִ֑י לִשְׁמ֥וֹעַ אֹ֖זֶן יִשָּׁ֥מְעוּ לִֽי׃

tokens.transliteration: ve-HEHM vah-ah-voh-TEY-noo heh-ZEE-doo vah-yahk-SHOO eht ohr-PAHM ve-LOH shah-me-OO ehl meets-voh-TEY-khah

tokens.hebrew: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לִשְׁמֹ֗עַ וְלֹא־זָכְר֤וּ נִפְלְאֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֣יתָ עִמָּהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־עָרְפָּ֔ם וַיִּתְּנוּ־רֹ֛אשׁ לָשׁ֥וּב לְעַבְדֻתָ֖ם בְּמִרְיָ֑ם וְאַתָּה֩ אֱל֨וֹהַּ סְלִיח֜וֹת חַנּ֧וּן וְרַח֛וּם אֶֽרֶךְ־אַפַּ֥יִם וְרַב־וחסד [חֶ֖סֶד] וְלֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּֽם׃
tokens.translation: and refused to hearken, neither were mindful of Thy wonders that Thou didst among them; but hardened their neck, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage; but Thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and full of compassion, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy, and forsookest them not.

tokens.hebrew: אַ֗ף כִּֽי־עָשׂ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ עֵ֣גֶל מַסֵּכָ֔ה וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ זֶ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶעֶלְךָ֖ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֔וּ נֶאָצ֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
tokens.translation: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said: ‘This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;

tokens.hebrew: וְאַתָּה֙ בְּרַחֲמֶ֣יךָ הָֽרַבִּ֔ים לֹ֥א עֲזַבְתָּ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר אֶת־עַמּ֣וּד הֶ֠עָנָן לֹא־סָ֨ר מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֤ם בְּיוֹמָם֙ לְהַנְחֹתָ֣ם בְּהַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְאֶת־עַמּ֨וּד הָאֵ֤שׁ בְּלַ֙יְלָה֙ לְהָאִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵֽלְכוּ־בָֽהּ׃
tokens.translation: yet Thou in Thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness; the pillar of cloud departed not from over them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to show them light, and the way wherein they should go.

tokens.translation: Thou gavest also Thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not Thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
tokens.transliteration: ve-roo-khah-KHAH hah-toh-VAH nah-TAH-tah le-hahs-kee-LAHM oo-mahn-KHAH loh mah-NAH-tah mee-pee-HEHM oo-MAH-yeem nah-TAH-tah lah-HEHM leets-mah-AHM

tokens.hebrew: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה כִּלְכַּלְתָּ֥ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר לֹ֣א חָסֵ֑רוּ שַׂלְמֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א בָל֔וּ וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א בָצֵֽקוּ׃
tokens.translation: Yea, forty years didst Thou sustain them in the wilderness, and they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.

tokens.hebrew: וַתִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֤ם מַמְלָכוֹת֙ וַעֲמָמִ֔ים וַֽתַּחְלְקֵ֖ם לְפֵאָ֑ה וַיִּֽירְשׁ֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֣רֶץ סִיח֗וֹן וְאֶת־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן וְאֶת־אֶ֖רֶץ ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
tokens.translation: Moreover Thou gavest them kingdoms and peoples, which Thou didst allot quarter by quarter; so they possessed the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.

tokens.translation: Their children also didst Thou multiply as the stars of heaven, and didst bring them into the land, concerning which Thou didst say to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
tokens.transliteration: oo-ve-ney-HEHM heer-BEE-tah ke-khoh-khe-VEY hah-shah-MAH-yeem vah-te-vee-EHM ehl hah-AH-rehts ah-shehr ah-MAHR-tah lah-ah-voh-tey-HEHM lah-VOH lah-RAH-sheht

tokens.hebrew: וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ הַבָּנִים֙ וַיִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וַתַּכְנַ֨ע לִפְנֵיהֶ֜ם אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ הַכְּנַ֣עֲנִ֔ים וַֽתִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדָ֑ם וְאֶת־מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ וְאֶת־עַֽמְמֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת בָּהֶ֖ם כִּרְצוֹנָֽם׃
tokens.translation: So the children went in and possessed the land, and Thou didst subdue before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the peoples of the land, that they might do with them as they would.

tokens.translation: And they took fortified cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns hewn out, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit-trees in abundance; so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and luxuriated in Thy great goodness.

tokens.translation: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against Thee, and cast Thy law behind their back, and slew Thy prophets that did forewarn them to turn them back unto Thee, and they wrought great provocations.

tokens.translation: Therefore Thou didst deliver them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them; and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto Thee, Thou heardest from heaven; and according to Thy manifold mercies Thou gavest them saviours who might save them out of the hand of their adversaries.

tokens.translation: But after they had rest, they did evil again before Thee; therefore didst Thou leave them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them; yet when they returned, and cried unto Thee, many times didst Thou hear from heaven, and deliver them according to Thy mercies;

tokens.translation: and didst forewarn them, that Thou mightest bring them back unto Thy law; yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto Thy commandments, but sinned against Thine ordinances, which if a man do, he shall live by them, and presented a stubborn shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.

tokens.translation: Yet many years didst Thou extend mercy unto them, and didst forewarn them by Thy spirit through Thy prophets; yet would they not give ear; therefore gavest Thou them into the hand of the peoples of the lands.

tokens.translation: Nevertheless in Thy manifold mercies Thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for Thou art a gracious and merciful God.

tokens.translation: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the awful God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the travail seem little before Thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all Thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.

tokens.hebrew: אִם־תָּב֨וֹא עָלֵ֜ינוּ רָעָ֗ה חֶרֶב֮ שְׁפוֹט֮ וְדֶ֣בֶר וְרָעָב֒ נַֽעַמְדָ֞ה לִפְנֵ֨י הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ וּלְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּ֥י שִׁמְךָ֖ בַּבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֑ה וְנִזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ מִצָּרָתֵ֖נוּ וְתִשְׁמַ֥ע וְתוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
tokens.translation: If evil come upon us, the sword, judgment, or pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house, and before Thee—for Thy name is in this house—and cry unto Thee in our affliction, and Thou wilt hear and save.

tokens.translation: And now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and mount Seir, whom Thou wouldest not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Egypt, but they turned aside from them, and destroyed them not;

tokens.translation: O our God, wilt Thou not execute judgment on them? for we have no might against this great multitude that cometh against us; neither know we what to do; but our eyes are upon Thee.’

title: A request for truthfulness and sufficient provision
sefariaRef: Proverbs 30:7-9
summary: A request for truthfulness and sufficient provision
useCase: A request for truthfulness and sufficient provision Themes: provision, wisdom. Follow your community’s practice.

tokens.hebrew: שְׁ֭תַּיִם שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאִתָּ֑ךְ אַל־תִּמְנַ֥ע מִ֝מֶּ֗נִּי בְּטֶ֣רֶם אָמֽוּת׃
tokens.translation: Two things have I asked of Thee; Deny me them not before I die:
tokens.transliteration: she-tah-YEEM shah-AHL-tee meh-ee-TAHKH ahl teem-NAH mee-MEH-nee be-TEH-rehm ah-MOOT

tokens.hebrew: שָׁ֤וְא ׀ וּֽדְבַר־כָּזָ֡ב הַרְחֵ֬ק מִמֶּ֗נִּי רֵ֣אשׁ וָ֭עֹשֶׁר אַל־תִּֽתֶּן־לִ֑י הַ֝טְרִיפֵ֗נִי לֶ֣חֶם חֻקִּֽי׃
tokens.translation: Remove far from me falsehood and lies; Give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with mine allotted bread;

tokens.hebrew: פֶּ֥ן אֶשְׂבַּ֨ע ׀ וְכִחַשְׁתִּי֮ וְאָמַ֗רְתִּי מִ֥י יְה֫וָ֥ה וּפֶֽן־אִוָּרֵ֥שׁ וְגָנַ֑בְתִּי וְ֝תָפַ֗שְׂתִּי שֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָֽי׃ (פ)
tokens.translation: Lest I be full, and deny, and say: ‘Who is the LORD?’ Or lest I be poor, and steal, And profane the name of my God.
